(107)thego:re21 zur stuno sheste /nyekrung da rag pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis legs sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /
// sgro ༷ ༷sa /

bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bka' gangs can 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi gsung par 'dzam gling spyi nor gyi dkar chag legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// 3sngon du 'gro ba spyir bshad pa/ 3gzhung don dngos bye brag rtu bshad pa/ 71chos kyi sgra don/ 71dam pa'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ 80spyir 'jig rten du chos ji ltar byung tshul/ 80sangs rgyas gang du 'byon pa'i zhing ngos bzung ba/ 80der sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i tshul/ 85rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro chog ji ltar byung tshul/ 108chos khungs btsun par bstan pa'i phyir ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du bsdus nas 'chad pa/ 108nyan thos rje pa'i lugs bshad pa/ 108theg chen pa'i lugs bshad pa/ 120dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i tshul/ 1201

1 spyir sems bskyed kyi rang bzhin ngos bzung ba/ 1202 ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos byang chub mchog tu thugs ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul bye brag tu bshad pa/ 146bar du bskal chen grangs med par tshogs bsags pa'i tshul/ 1551 bsag bya'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin ngos bzung ba/ 1552 dus ji tsam du bsags pa/ 1613 tshul ji ltar gsog pa/ 167mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul/ 1701 'og min du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sku bzhi cig car du mngon du mdzad pa'i skor/ 170gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas ngos bzung ba/ 170sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dngos/ 1732 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pas gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam par thar pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'chad pa/ 177grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ 177so so'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa/ 180dang po/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i mdzad pa sogs bshad pa/ ci 180gnyis pa/ rab tu byung ba'i mdzad pa sogs bshad pa/ 221gdams ngag la yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir chos kyi che ba spyi dang / khyad par bka' thams cad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs su gzhol tshul/ 291lung rtogs kyi chos spyir bstan pa/ 291lung gi chos kyi che ba bye brag ngu bshad pa/ 297che ba gnyis ldan gyi chos la nyan bshad ji ltar bya ba/ 367nyan bshad kyi gzhi sgrub pa/ 367nyan bshad dngos/ 372gdams pa dngos kyi slob ma ji ltar bkri ba'i rim pa dang mthun par dkar chag gi tho dngos 'god pa/ 7042

mdo'i skor/ 704'khor lo rim pa gsum du phye ba'i dang por gtogs pa 'dul ba lung gi skor/ 704'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi skor/ 708'khor lo tha ma legs par rnam par bye ba'i skor/ 713'khor lo gsum ci rigs pa'i sder gtogs pa mdo mang gi skor/ 721sngags kyi skor/ 747'gyur la ltos te gsang sngags gsar ma'i skor/ 747gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor/ 782rnam dkar legs byas kyi phung po zad mi shes par bsgrub pa'i dge rtsa bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i 'brel thogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi gtsos pa'i mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs la bde dge zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i rgyur bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor ba/ 793rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro chog bzhengs pa'iphan yon bstan pa/ 793de nyid zad mi zhes pa'i rgyur bsngo ba/ 801mtshan zhabs stag brag sprul sku ngag dbang gsung rab mthu thob bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /mtshan zhabs tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang gnyis kyis mdzad/:dkar chag gi zur ma na/ chos tshan 'di'i mtshan byang rgyas drags pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod yod/

mtshan dpe'i gzi byin nyid dang mdzes pa'i dpal yon gcig tu ngoms pa bzhin / /nor bu'i cod pan mchog gis dbang bskur mod la bdag cag ma pham zhes / /lha rnams dga' ba'i dbyangs kyi ca co mtshan snyan ba dan sa gsum du/ /rnam par g.yo ba de yi zhabs sen tshangs gnas dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /dag pa don dam dbyings kyi rang gshis mkha' khyab pha mtha' bral ba'i klong / /brtse chen tshon brgya rnam par bkra ba'i 'ja' 'od gur gyi lding khang du/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i lang tshor smin pa dmar ser gzhon nu dpa' bo'i sku/ /shes rab ral gri'i gdengs ka 'bar ba'i 'od rlabs g.yo bas snying mun gzhil/ /thub dbang srid pa'i mig gcig dus kyi rim pas chu lha'i phyogs su yib pa na/ /rgya chen 'phrin las zer phreng rnon pos rgyal bstan ku mud nags tshal skyong byed cing / /dge legs 'od kyi snang bas bdud dang mu stegs smag rum mun pa dbyings bskrad de/ /bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs la mchog tu dpa' ba'i gtad rabs bdun la spyi bos 'dud/ /sa 'og gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od kyis mun pa sel mdzad klu dbang gnas/ /steng phyogs dga' ba brgya phrag ldan pa'i ma pham chos kyi mdun sa nas/ /theg chen spyan drangs zab rgyas chos tshul rgyas mdzad shing rta chen po gnyis / /yab sras brgyud bcas rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes su grags rnams rtag bsngags 'os/ /gangs can skye 'gro'i legs byas na dar smin legs sgeg mo'i bzhin ras su/ /mtha' dag rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i smug rtsi gsar pa'i ri mo ni/ /rnam par 'god mkhas chos rgyal lo paṇa mkhas shing grub pa sngon byon gyi/ /gzhal dka'i bka' drin snying la bkod de mi phyed dad pas phyag bgyi'om/ /bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs gtams theg gsum gdams 107—5

ngag 'dus pa'i gter/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pas rigs can gsum gyi re 'dod skong / /lta sgom spyod gsum bsre slad bsal zhing brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum 'dres mnga'/ /a ti sha zhes snyan pa'i grags 'bar yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /mtha' dag rgyal ba'i blo gros lang tsho mtshan dpe'i gar du rnam par zlos pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ byu/ngur smrig bla gos 'chang ba'i zol bstan kun bzang mdzad pas thub pa'i dbang po gnyis pa zhes/ /snyan par grags pa'i ba dan rab dkar srid gsum bla ru g.yo ba med par btsugs de yi/ /zhabos rmithil bkra shis mtshan gyi ri mo rtag par ral pa'i nags su bkod pa'i shis pas skyongs/ /gang gi thun min bka' srol 'dod pa yid bzhin 'jo ba nor gyi bu/ /lung dang rigs pas byi dor legs bsgrubs don gnyis dgos dgu'i gter du nges/ /thos bsam sgom dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse ru mngon mchod pa/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la mi phyed dad pas lan brgyar 'dud/ /rlabs chen thugs bskyed gru rdzing brtan po gus rtag sbyor ba'i rlung gis rnam par bskyod pa las/ /rab 'byams mdo rgyud grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' brgal nas gdams ngag nor bu'i mdzod drangs te/ /'dzad med chos sbyin gtong ba'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ste bdag blo'i dbul ba sel mdzad pa/ /byams brtse'i bdag nyid rigs pa'i skya ba 'dzin mkhas rnams kyi zhabs sen dmar 'od snying gar bsten/ /'phags ma'i gsang gsum gru char gyis sngo sngo bsang tā ma la yi klong / /brtse chen dmar 'od glog gi rtse dga' dga'o bo 'khyil ba'i ri mo la/ /mig 'bur gtod pa'i rma bya'i snying la la cer rname grol mngal skrun pa/ /sgrol mdzad 'phags ma dbyar skyes dpal sgoso mos 187—6 sgo sgo

bzhin 'dod dgu char du bsnyil/ /gsang gsum gsang ba rgyan gyi 'khor lo sgyu ma 'phrul gyis 'jo sgeg rnam par rol ba'o gar/ byu /ngag rig ngag gi 'dod 'jor zlos pa bai ḍūr rgyud mangs phang par bkod la sen 'debs pa'o/ /dbyangs ldan dbyangs kyi rgyal mor snyan pa'i zhags pa dam pos phyogs kyi 'khor lo dom bcings po'i/ /zla sring zla bzhin 'dzum dkar rlabs 'phreng rnam par g.yo bas ngag dang yid la shisi pa sgruthos/ /srid gsum brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun dbang byed glog gi bu mo ni/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem ut+pal gsar pa'i gzhu la mda' sbyar 'gengs mdzad ma/ /lcags kyu zhags pa'i 'phrul gyi 'khor los snang srid chos kyi dbyings nyid du/ /'ching byed las kyi dbang mo che des dge legs dngos kun 'du bar mdzod/ /mtha' dag skye dgu'i phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas gcig rgyal bstan mchod sdong mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /ston pa'i bka' ni gangs can skad du bsgyur ba ji snyed de snyed kyis ni do shal phreng / /gcig las du ma'i sgyu 'phrul 'dzad med 'char byed par gsar dkar chag rnam dpyod sor mo yis/ /gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer yid la dga' skyed dri med tshig gi srad bur bstar bar bya/ /rnam mang lung gi sprin sngon ral pa'i lding khang du/ /rigs pa'i gser 'od glog phreng 'khyug pa'i rtse dga' dang / /rab 'grogs dkar chag dbyar skyes rnga gsang ldir ba la/ /skal bzang mdongs mthas dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen par mdzod/ /de yang ji skad du/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel / /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan las 'das zhi ba 107—7

bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bsod nams spel zhing 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa dang / bdud kyi bar chad sel zhing zhi ba mchog la blo gzhol ba sogs dgos pa du ma'i phyir/ slob dpon daṇ+ḍis/ sargas bcings pa snyan ngag che/ /de yi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni / /nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir brjod par bya ba'i dngos po gtan la 'bebs pa'i sgo dag gis sdun bsus te/ las su bya ba gang la 'jug pa yin zhe na/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing las/mthong dang ma mthong bde la lam ni legs bshad kyis gsal sgron me lta bur spyod//legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyams myong ldan pas mchog tu dga' ba'i char dag 'bebs/ /legs bshad don gnyer yul la gnyer bya kun mkhyen dag kyang don gnyer nyid du 'gyur/ /de slad dam pa rnams la legs bshad dang mtshungs dga' ba ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par/legs par bshad pa'i gtam gyi phreng ba mngon par bstar te mkhas pa dag gi snyan shal mdzes par byed pa'i thabs la 'jug par byed do/ /gzhi gang las brtsams te gleng bar bya zhe na/ de yang bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod ni ma bcol legs mdzad pa/ /khyod ni rgyu med bzhin du byams/ /khyod ni ma 'dris mdza' bshes te/ /'brel pa med pa'i gnyen 'dun lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i skye 'gro yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i dpal gyi mgur/ dung gi tshems bar nas/ 'phrul gyi ljags brkyangs te/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dus dang skal bar 'tsham par/107—8

chos phung nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter rdol ba las cha shas tsam zhig sprul pa'i chos rgyal lo paṇa sa la zhugs pa rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas rang cag pur rgyal bod kyi ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi par gyi 'phrul 'degs gsar du bskrun pa'i dkar chag bsgrigs pa las brtsams te gleng bar bya'o/ /bar skabs 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis cung zad zlos par byed na/ kun gsal pha mthar 'ching ba'i yid can kun/ /srid dang zhi ba'i g.yang sar mngon gzhol ba / /de dag 'don pa'i ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes/ /de ni thub pa sangs rgyas kho na nyid/ /lnga phrag rtsub 'gyur glal ba'i srin mo'i khar/ /mi bzad duḥkhas mnar ba'i nyam thag la/ /lhag par brtse bas pad dkar ltar bsngags pa/ /de ni mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po nyid/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid 'thug las bslang nas/ /bla med mchog gi dga' ston sbyin pa'i slad/ /gang gi dpal gyi mgur las bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong tshangs pa'i dbyangs su rdol//de las gangs can bsod nams gshong bu ru/ /skal bzang ji snyed thob pa'i par gyi gzhi/ /sngon med gsar pa'i dga' ston las brtsams te/ /bcad lhug spel ma'i dbyangs su zlos la spro/ /de yang paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mngon dgas/ bstan bcos dag ni thams cad dang //las ni ci yang rung ba yi/ /ji srid dgos pa ma smras pa/ /de srid du ni ci zhig 'dzin / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya ste/ slob dpon shan+ta de bas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ skye dgu rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang 107—9

kun 'byung gi nad ma lus pa gzhil ba'i rtsi sman/ mngon mtho nges legs kyis bsdus pa'i bde dge mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyid yin la/ de yang gang la ngos 'dzin zhe na/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gi gnyen pos/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lung gi bstan pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis su nges la/ de gnyis la zhugs shing 'dzin pa'i tshad kyang gang yin zhe na/lung gi bstan pa la dad pas thos sogs kyis zhugs nas smra ba'am 'chad nyan byed pa de ni lung gi bstan par zhugs shing 'dzin pa'i tshad dang / lung gi don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i gnad rnams thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud la skrun par byed pa de ni rtogs pa'i bstan par zhugs shing 'dzin pa'i tshad du gsungs la/de las gzhan bstan pa 'dzin tshul med pa kho na'i don du mdzod 'grel rnams su gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i chos spyod bcu nyams su bstar ba ni gnas skabs kyi dgos pa yin la/ de la brten nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa ni mthar thug gi dgos pa'o/ /'o na chos spyod bcu bshad tshul mang bas gang ltar yin zhe na bden te/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam / /ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang / /gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te/ /chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi/ /mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas/ /blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir/ /bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes/ /bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skabs kyi chos spyod bcu ngos 'dzin la/107—10

rnam bshad las/ sems bskyed sogs rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu la 'dod cing / gser phreng dang / phar phyin rtogs dka'i snang ba gnyis su/sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu la gsungs pa dang / chos bshes kyi 'grel par/ kha cig gi 'dod pa bkod skabs dge ba bcu la 'dod pa zhig dang / dbus mtha' nas bshad pa'i chos spyod bcu la 'dod pa dang / rje sa paṇa gyi bstan pa spyi'i rnam gzhag las/ spyir yan lag bdun pa'i steng du skyabs 'gro dang /smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis dang / bcu la 'dod pa sogs bshad tshul mang yang chos spyod bcu zhes pa'i chos ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis yin par snang ste 'og tu 'chad par bya'o/ /'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ /spyir lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gang la 'jug na'ang shes rab gsum gyis 'jug dgos par gsungs pas/ dbus mtha' las/ de ni chos spyod rnam bcu dang //yang dag ldan par shes par bya/ /yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa'o/ /chos spyod de bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi chos spyod bcu la ngos 'dzin no/ /de skabs su babs tshul 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che par du bsgrubs pa ni chos spyod bcu'i dang po yi ge 'dri ba'i khongs su gtogs shing / de yun ring po dang ske/ dka' tshegs kyis sgrub pa'i ngal ba chen po la ltos mi dgos par/par gyi 'phrul 'dregs bla na med pa la brten nas phyogs ris med kun tu chos sbyin gyi sgo 'phar rgya cher phye ste bsod nams kyi phung po 'dzad med du spel ba ni chos spyod bcu'i gsum pa yin zhing / glegs bam rnams la skye 'gro mtha' yas 187—11

pas mchod bkur sogs byed pas gsum pa'i gzhi sgrub pa'ang yin no/ /mdor na nyams su blang bya'i chos spyod bcu thos bsam sgom pa dang / de'i rgyu bsgrub pa gnyis su 'dus shing / de yang / yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / /zhes pas de gsum gyi rgyu bsgrub tshul bstan pa yin la/ nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /zhes pas thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab skye tshul dang / de sems pa dang sgom pa'o/ /zhes pas bsam sgom gyi shes rab skye tshul bstan to/ /thos pa dang / 'chad pa tha dad pas/ 'chad pa thos byung gi shes rab skye tshul la ji ltar sbyar zhe na/ kun las btus su/ 'dzin pa dang /kha ton byed pa dang / bshad pas thos pa las byung bar blta'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad pa yin no/ /de re re la bsod nams kyi phung po dpag med 'byung tshul rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyis bstan to/ /de dag kyang mdo dang sbyar te mtshon byed tsam smras na/ pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las/ gang rnams mdo 'di phyi dus na/ /yi ge 'dri 'chang nyan pa ni/ /mi yi srid pa nges btang ste/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi bya ba byed/ /ces dang / 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ gang gis/ mdo 'di bshad nas bzung dang mngon par bris pa dang / /gang dag 'dzin bcug gus par rtag tu klog pa dang / /bdug pa me tog 'phreng ba gos mchog rnams kyis mchod/ /bsod nams gang thob de ni brjod par mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo re re'i skabs su/ yi ge 'bri ba dang / mchod sogs byas pa'i phan yon dpag med 'byung bar gsungs pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang yi ge 'dri ba dang / mchod sogs byed pa la bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa 'byung tshul/ sdud pa las/ la las bde 107—12

gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /mchod rten rin chen bdun las byas shing mchod byed la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gaṅgā yi/ /bye ma snyed kyis bye ba phrag stong zhing bkang ste/ /yongs su brtag bzung zhing rnams dbye ba mtha' yas na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ /las gzhan mi byed lha yi me tog spos rab dang / /byug pas dus gsum bskal pa'ang de bas lhag mchod la/ /gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i yum 'di glegs bam la bris te/ /'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur na/ /mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod/ /ces so/ /skabs don glegs bam byin pa las bsod nams kyi phung po dpag med 'byung tshul sher phyin lta bu la mtshon na/sdud pa las/ la las gaṅga'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di'i thad kyi brgyad stong par/ glegs bam sbyin sems dang / sbyin yul gyi sems kyi khyad par/ grangs/ dpe/sbyin tshul sogs kyis/ bsod nams snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i rim pa nyer bdun gsungs pa'i don mtha' dag 'dir dngos shugs ci rigs kyis bsdus nas bstan pas rgyas pa der bltas pas shes par bya'ol/ /glegs bam tsam sbyin pa la bsod nams de 'dra 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ sngar gyi lung de'i 'phror/ sdud pa las/ ci'i phyir zhe na smra mchog de dag 'dir bslabs nas/ /chos rnams mtha' dag stong pa nyid du 'dir ston 107—13

byed / /de thos nyan thos myur du rnam par grol la reg /rang rgyal byang chub dang ni sangs rgyas byang chub reg /ces gsungs shing / gdul bya la byang chub gsum sbyin pa rtags su bkod nas/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag med 'byung tshul bsgrubs pas yin no/ /yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin gsum gyis thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyu bsgrub pa yang dbus mtha'i dngos bstan tsam smras kyi/ /rgyu la de tsam du zad pa yang ma yin te/ sher phyin gyi mdo sde lta bu nyan pa'i snod du rung ba'i rgyu yang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ /'di nyan pa yi snod yin no/ /zhes dang / len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / don mi brjed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i rgyur/ sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas/ /len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i / /snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs shing / len 'dzin thos pa dang / bsam sgom tha ma gnyis la sbyor dgos pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni chos spyod rnam bcu dang / /yang dag ldan par shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i de sgra snyegs sa ni/ de'i gong de ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag par yang / /shes rab gsum gyis yid byed pa'o/ /khams brtas byed dang 'jug byed dang / de ni don rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di la snyegs pa yin la/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis theg chen rigs can rnams kyis kun slong byang chub kyi sems sam/ de bcos ma tshun chad kyis zin par byas te/ dus rtag tu shes rab gsum gyis dam pa'i chos yid la byed par gsungs shing /rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyis shes rab gsum gyi byed las bstan to/ /shes rab 107—14

gsum gyi ngo bo ni/ bye smra ltar na/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /thos sogs las byung blo rnams ni/ /ming dang gnyis ka don yul can/ /zhes rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis go rim dang / phyi ma gnyis kyis thos pa las byung ba dang / bsam pa las byung ba dang / sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab gsum ni rim pa ltar ming dang / ming don gnyis ka dang ske/ don kho na'i yul can du 'dod kyang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen ltar na / ming la dmigs pa thos byung dang / don la dmigs pa sgom byung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de las gzhan pa'i bsam byung mi 'grub par 'gyur bas bdag rkyen yid ches pa'i lung dang / rigs pas dpyad pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa las don rtogs pa ni rim pa ltar shes rab gsum yin no zhes 'chad do/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ thos la sogs pa'i shes gsum gyis / /chos kyi dmigs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum rnyed pa / /sngar bshad de la yang dag brten/ /zhes thos bsam sgom gsum gyi chos kyi dmigs pa rnyed tshul spyir bstan nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum so so'i chos kyi dmigs pa rnyed tshul ni/ yid kyi brjod pa bshad ji bzhin/ /rab dang zhes dang / don du snang ba ni/ brjod las yin par rab 'dzin phyir/ /zhes dang —/ sems ni ming la gnas pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /shes rab gsum gyi yid byed rim gyis thob ste lam bgrod tshul 'di ni/ mu stegs pa rnams la med pa'i nang pa'i khyad chos yin la/ de yi rtogs pa sngon du song ste de dag thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis gsungs te/bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ lung gi don ni bsam pa dang / /sgom dang gus 107—15

par mnyan pa yi/ /dus gsum cha dbye khyod kyi ni/ /bstan las gzhan la mchis ma lags/ zhes gsungs shing / mnyan pa rjes su byung ba ni tshig gi sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis yin par snang ngo / /gzhan yang mdo sde rgyan las/sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung / /bsdus pa'i phyir te rgyu ni dgur 'dod do/ /des ni bag chags rtogs dang zhi ba dang / /rab tu rtogs pas rnam par grol bar byed/ /ces rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis gang la thos bsam bya ba'i yul bstan nas/ phyi ma gnyis kyis thos sogs kyi byed las bstan te/thos pas don mngon du gyur pa'i bag chags 'jog /bsam pas don rtogs par byed/ 'jog sgom zhi gnas kyis nyon mongs gnas skabs su zhi bar byed/dpyad 'jog 'dres pa'i lhag mthong gis chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas nyon mongs spong bar byed par gsungs shing / go rim dang byed las 'di dang cha 'dra bar sngar drangs pa'i mdzod lung / tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i don dang por mi g.yeng ba'i rgyu tshul khrims/ mi rmongs pa'i rgyu thos pa/ don rtogs pa'i rgyu bsam pa/ nyon mongs pa mngon gyur pa dang / sa bon spong ba'i rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rab tu sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ dge slong rtun cing rtag 'grus pa/ /tshul khrims yang dag blangs byas nas/ /sems dang shes rab sgom byed pas/ /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs lung 'di mchims 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mdzod rtsa'i lung de'i shes byed du drangs pa ni gnad che ste/ bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bgrod tshul 'di bstan pa spyi'i chings lta bu yin te/ ji skad du/ thos bsam sgom 107—16

gsum lam gyi sngon 'gro phyir/ /lam zhugs lam ma zhugs dang rigs can gsumal/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang mdo sde rgyan gyi theg chen bka' sgrub kyi le'u las/ mngon sum la brten nas theg chen 'dor mi rigs par sgrub pa'i thad du/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung ske/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /de las chos thob de yod de las blo gros rab tu skye/ /gang tshe de ni so sor rang rig med na ji ltar nges/ /zhes khyed cag theg chen la ma gus pa'i dbang gis de la thos sogs mi byed pa'i phyir/ zhes rgyu ma dmigs pa'i sgo nas sgrub tshul gyis shes so/ /gzhan yang 'di dag mdo las bstan tshul dang / gang gi ched du bstan pa'i dgos pa shes na dgongs pa'i gnad la nges pa skye bas/ de yang mdo sdud pa las/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /'chad dang rigs pa dag dang ldan pa brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthul/ /zhes thos byung gi shes rab skyed pa'i ched du tshig gi sgo nas ston pa dang /bsam byung gi shes rab skyed pa'i ched du tshig 'di'i don 'di dang 'di'o zhes 'chad pa dang / sgom byung gi shes rab skyed pa'i ched du gegs sel bogs 'don byed tshul sogs kyis gsal bar brjod pa dang / de dag kyang tshad ma'am rigs pa dang ldan par brjod pas mchog 'phags bde ba ste mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi 'bras bu thob par byed tshul/ 'di'i thad kyi brgyad stong pa las/nyan thos rnams ni gang ci smra ba dang / ston pa dang / nye bar ston pa dang /rjod par byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par gsal bar 107—17

byed pa de thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu yin par rig par bya'o / /zhes gsungs shing / de'i don rgyan snang las/ de la smra ba zhes bya ba ni / thos pa'i rang bzhin gyi shes pa skyes pa las byang chub kyi sa bon skye ba'i don du gang gis 'don par byed pa'o/ /ston pa ni bsam pa'i rang bzhin gyi shes pa skyes pa las yongs su smin par bya ba'i don du gang gis don 'chad par byed pa'o / /nye bar ston pa ni sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi shes pa skyes pa las yongs su grol bar bya ba'i don du gang gis gzhung dang don la nges pa bskyed pa'i bar du ston par byed pa'o/ /des na de ltar brjod pa dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig gsum ni go rim bzhin du/ smra ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bshad pa yin no / /zhes gsungs pa'i gnad 'gag bsdus te bshad na/ smra ba dang / ston pa dang / nye bar ston pa gsum ming dang / 'don par byed pa/ don 'chad par byed pa/ rab tu ston par byed pa gsum snga ma gsum gyi don 'chad byed brjod pa sogs gsum dang sbyar nas/ dgos pa byang chub kyi sa bon skye ba dang /yongs su smin par bya ba dang / yongs su grol bar bya ba gsum gyi phyir/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab skyed byed la sbyar te bshad pa'i rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'chad lugs 'dis mdo dang byams chos sogs las shes rab gsum bstan tshul dang —/ dgos pa dang / go rim dang / byed las rnams kyang gsal bar bkral 'dug pas 'di ltar du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bgrod tshul 'di ni theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir bsgom bya dang / sgom byed kyi blo'i khyad par mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang / spyi'i chings sngar bshad pa de dag gi steng nas 'gro dgos shing / de bzhin du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog 107—18

re re la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas zhugs shing nyams su bstar lugs spyi 'gro sngar bshad pa de dag gi steng nas yong dgos pas cung zhig spros pa'o/ /'dir ngal bso'i dbyangs kyi phreng ba cung zad spel bar byed na/ srid zhi'i zug rngu mtha' dag drung 'byin cing / /bla med bdud rtsi'i dga' ston mchog gi gter / /thub bstan rin chen 'gro ba'i dpal yon du/ /thob pa sa 'di'i skal bzang snying po nyid/ /chos spyod rnam bcu'i 'dzam bu nā da yi/ /rtsibs stong rnam par g.yo ba'i lung rtogs kyi/ /'khor lo 'gro rgyud gcig nas gcig 'khor bas/ /thub bstan rin chen 'gro 'di'i dpyid du 'phel/ /gang zhig glegs bam 'bri mchod sbyin pa ni/ /thos bsam sgom pa 'phel ba'i rgyu nyid de/ /de phyir de las shes rab rnam gsum gyi/ /yid la byed pa mchog tu gsal bar 'gyur / /zab mo'i ming dang don la chos kyi mig /rim gyis skyes nas sdug kun drung phyung zhing / /zhi bde'i go 'phang bde blag ster ba 'di/ /lugs gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'i khyad par chos/ /chags sogs mgo non rim bzhin drung nas 'byin/ /don la bag chags 'jog dang rtogs pa dang / /nyon mongs gnas su zhi dang gtan spong ba'i/ /byed las rim bzhin 'dzin pa shes rab gsum/ /mi rmongs pa dang don rtogs pa yi rgyu/ /chags sogs mngon gyur 'gog dang sa bon bcas/ /spong ba 'di dag kun kyang shes rab gsum/ /rim gyis skyed pa'i byed las zla med nyid/ /mchog 'phags bde ba'i sa bon skye ba dang / /smin par byed dang yongs su grol byed pa/ /'di yang shes rab rnam gsum rim bzhin du/ /skye ba'i ngo mtshar khyad chos bla med nyid/ /theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi yi/ /bsgom bya sgom byed khyad par gang la yang / /107—19

thos sogs gsum gyis rim gyis 'jug pa 'di/ /thub bstan spyi yi bsgrod tshul e ma ho/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi ngal bso'i dbyangs kyi phreng ba cung zad spel ba'o//thos sogs kyi gzhi bsgrub pa'i phan yon sngar bshad zin pas/ da ni dngos kyi phan yon gleng bar bya ste/ thos pa'i phan yon ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ /thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don med spong bar 'gyur/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces gsungs pa de'i don rnam bshad rigs par/ de la rkang pa bzhi po 'dis ni/ rim pa ltar phyi nang gi grub mtha' shes pas blang dor gyi gnas shes pa dang / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa thob nas nyes spyod las ldog pa dang ske/ sems kyi bslab pa thob nas don med pa'i 'dod pa spong ba dang /shes rab kyi bslab pa thob nas de la brten nas zag zad mngon du byas te myang 'das thob pa ste bzhi'am/ yang dag pa'i lta ba rnyed pa dang / las dang /nyon mongs pa dang / skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa las brgal ba ste bzhi dang /chos 'dul ba la dad pa rnyed pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / dbang po'i sgo bsrungs pas 'dod pa las 'dod chags bral bas gnod pa spong ba dang /bden pa rtogs nas myang 'das thob pa ste bzhi la bshad do/ /zhes bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung las byung ba'i bshad tshul gsum bkod pa'i dang po gnyis kyi tshig rkang dang po spyi dang / phyi ma gsum dgag phyogs dang / sgrub phyogs la sbyar te phyogs gcig tu man ngag gi 'chad tshul ni/ rkang pa dang pos thos pa byas pas blang dor gyi gnas rnams shes par 'gyur zhes spyir bstan nas/ lhag 187—20

ma gsum sgrub phyogs nas bshad na bslab pa gsum rgyud la skye ba'i phan yon ston te / 'dul ba'i sde snod kyis lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pas de la thos bsam byas na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa skye/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyis lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pas de la thos bsam byas pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa rgyud la skye/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyis lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pas de la thos bsam byas pas shes rab kyi bslab pa rgyud la skye ba dang / dgag phyogs nas bshad na dang pos las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / gnyis pas nyon mongs pa'i kun nyon/ gsum pas skye ba'i kun nyon spong bar sbyar te bshad tshul yod do/ /bshad tshul gsum pa'i 'dul ba la dad pa dang / rab tu byung bas tshul khrims/ 'dod chags dang bral bas gnod pa spong ba ting nge 'dzin/ bden pa rtogs pas myang 'das thob pa ni shes rab kyi bslab pas zhi ba thob tshul te 'di yang bslab gsum gyi steng nas bshad pa'o/ /rnam bshad rigs pas gsung tshul ltar na grub mtha' thams cad shes pa yang dag pa'i lta ba skyed pa'i rgyu dang / tshig rkang phyi ma gsum bshad tshul sna tshogs byas kyang 'babs sa bslab pa gsum gyis las kyi kun 'byung sdig pa las ldog pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung rnam g.yeng sogs spong ba dang ske/ skye ba'i kun 'byung 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das thob tshul gsungs pa yin no/ /lung 'di 'ga' zhig tu tshoms las/ zhes dang / 'ga' zhig tu/dkon brtsegs las zhes 'byung yang / snga ma dang mi 'gal te/ mdo las/mi rtag pa/ bag yod/ dad pa/ thos pa sogs so sor gsungs pa rnams dgra bcom pa chos skyobs kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la tshoms zer zhing /107—21

de byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las bsdus pa dang / sde snod de dkon brtsegs su bzhugs pa la 'gal ba med pas so/ /skye rabs las chos thos pa'i phan yon mdor bstan pa ni/ gang zhig thos nas yid ni dad gyur nas/ /legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur/ /rang gis shas kyang de nyid nyo bar rigs/ /zhes pa'i don rkang pa dang pos mchog gsum dang / lam 'bras la dang ba'i dad pa dang / rkang pa gnyis pas lam de dag la nges shes khyad par can skyes nas yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po skye bar bstan/ /rkang pa gsum pas lam de dag la mngon du bya 'dod pa'i dad pa skyes nas lam de dag la 'dris par byed pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab skye zhing 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gti mug med par 'gyur ba dang / sgom byung gi shes rab de thabs mkhas kyi lam dang sbrel nas sgom pas gti mug gi bag chags gnyis snang 'khrul pa yang med par 'gyur ba bstan/ rkang pa bzhi pas de ltar thos pa'i phan yon rlabs che ba rtags su bkod de rang gis shas kyang thos pa de nyid nyo rigs pa sgrub pa ste/ dper na rtag ngu dang / ston pas sngon slob pa'i skabs tshigs bcad re re'i phyir lus srog phangs pa med par btang ste thos pa byas pa bzhin no/ /'di ni shas kyang zhes 'greng bu med pa ltar gyi bshad pa'o/ /lam rim chen mor/ rang gis shes kyang de nyid nyo bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byas na/ rang gis shes zin pa'ang gong 'phel du bya ba'i phyir thos pa ngoms med du bsten dgos pa/ gdams ngag la'ang gdams pa'i gdams ngag dang ske/ rjes bstan gyi gdams ngag gnyis yod pa'i tshul gyis kyang 'grub la/sangs rgya kha'i bar du gzhung sher phyin la thos bsam dang / lam sher phyin la 107—22

nyams len dgos gsungs pa dang / sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyongs skabs/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zhes pas kyang 'grub ces bla ma dam pa'i gsung bshad las 'byung bas/ gcig mthong bas cig shos bsubs pa la snga bar mi bya'o / /gzhan yang dam pa rnams kyi bshad srol mang du snang ste/ tshig dang pos thos byung gi shes rab dang / gnyis pas bsam byung gi shes rab/ gsum pas sgom byung gi shes rab skye bar bstan pa dang / yang tshig dang po thog mar dge ba dang / gnyis pa bar du dge ba dang / gsum pa mtha' mar dge ba la sbyar te bshad pa sogs mang du snang ste ma spros so/ /thos pa'i phan yon rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa'i mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog /zhes pa'i tshig rkang dang po nas 'di'i bar du lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa las brtsam ste ston pa'i phan yon sha stag yin te/dang po la mtshon na/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul la rmongs pa'i gti mug /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa sogs la rmongs pa'i gti mug /dkon mchog gsum dang las 'bras blang dor la rmongs pa'i gti mug /bden bzhi'i blang dor sogs thar pa'i lam la rmongs pa'i gti mug /byang chub kyi sems dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa sogs la rmongs pa'i gti mug gi mun pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gi gnyen po thos pa'i sgron me de snyed cig yod pas bsal dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bar ma rnams kyang de'i 107—23

rigs pas shes la/ tha ma mtshon byed tsam smras na/ lam gyi lus de dag gi mi mthun phyogs kyi dpung ji snyed cig yod pa de dang de dag gi gnyen po phyogs kyi dpung yang de snyed du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /zhes tshig rkang 'di la gter gyi mchog kyang yin zhes smos pa ni / snga ma rnams gnas skabs dang / mthar thug thams cad kyi phan yon dang ske/ 'di nas gnas skabs mthong chos kyi phan yon bstan pas don tshan khyad par 'byed pa'i tshig go /ya rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ /phas kyi rgol la nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra / /'gran pa rnams kyang grags dang dregs pa sel/ /mi shes rnams kyang rab tu dga' gyur nas/ /mig dang bzhin mdangs rab tu gsal gyur cing / /lag pa'i se gol mgu byed rdeb pa yis/ /khyad par rab tu che ba rnam par sgrogs / /zhes pa yan chad kyis gnas skabs mthong chos kyi phan yon bstan to/ /'di dag sde dge'i par du tshig 'di dang mi 'dra ba mang yang / 'di ni lam rim ltar bkod cing / go sla bas ma spros so/ /gtan tshig don rnams rab tu gsal bar ston/ /gtsug lag lung rnams sna tshogs ston dang mtshungs/ /bsnyen zhing sbyangs pas yid du 'ong ba'i phyir/ /me tog phreng ba mar rnying bkram pa bzhin/ /zhes rkang pa bzhi po 'dis tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas chos ston tshul bstan la/ de yang rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis/ chos ston pa na lung tsam la brten pa ma yin par rigs pa'i lam nas drangs te gdul bya la nges shes khyad par can skye thub pa zhig dang / tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis kyis/ chos ston pa na tshig nus pa shin tu che zhing tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pas gdul bya 107—24

mtha' dag gi rgyud la 'jug pa zhig dgos par bstan to/ /de ltar bshad pa na gzhan la phan pa ji ltar 'byung tshul ni/ dul zhing rab tu gsal ba'i spobs pa bskyed / /grags pa chen po 'phral du 'byung bar byed/ /smra lce bde 'gyur khyad par can gyi rgyu/ /thos pa'i dpal goms don gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar la khyad par du/ thos pa'i dpal goms don gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes pas thos pa'i don sgom pa'i bsam byung gi nges pa rnyed tshul dang / de nyid yang yang 'dris par byas te sgom pas sgom byung gis gsal snang dang bcas te mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba yang bstan to/ /de nas/ thos dang ldan na 'gal ba med pa yi/ /'khor gsum lam la rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas sngar bshad pa'i phan yon rnams kyi don bsdus te/rkang pa dang po gnyis ni gnas skabs kyi phan yon bshad pa rnams kyi don bsdu ba dang ske/ phyi ma gnyis ni mthar thug gi phan yon bshad pa rnams kyi don bsdu ba'o//de yang mang du thos pa dang ldan na thos chung rnams la 'gal bar snang ba yang 'gal ba med par 'gro ste/ chos dang / srid dang / longs spyod kyi 'khor gsum lam la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes skye bo thos chung rnams la 'gal ba yang / mang thos shes rab can rnams la mi 'gal bar 'gro tshul bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang de ltar 'gro tshul mang du yod de/ skye bo thos chung rnams la rgyal srid kyi dpal thob na 'dod pas myos te nyes spyod chen po byas nas dal ba don med du 'gyur la/ mang thos blo gros dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur 107—25

pa na 'dod yon gyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi 'gro bar sems can gyi don rlabs po che byed nus pa lta bu dang / sems can thams cad la yid 'ong du mthong ba'i byams pa shugs drag kyang 'dod chags cung zad kyang mi 'dre ba dang / sems can sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa mthong na mi bzod pa'i snying rje shugs drag kyang mya ngan gyis non nas dge ba la mi spro ba'i le lo med pa dang / chos kyi bdud rtsis ngoms pa'i dga' ba tshad med pa dang ldan yang sems dmigs pa la g.yeng ba'i ya ya po med pa dang / btang snyoms chen po dang rgyun du ldan yang 'gro ba'i don la skad cig kyang mi g.yel ba dang / chos thams cad spros bral nam mkha' lta bur rtogs kyang las 'bras phra mo la'ang ches zhib par mdzad pa dang / theg pa gong 'og dang mdo sngags gnyis la gnang bkag mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa rnams thos chung la 'gal ba ltar snang yang / de rnams gang zag gcig gi nyams len du 'khyer ba'i thos pa chen po la mi 'gal ba lta bu'o/ /de yang rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi don/ thos pa gnad du song na de'i rjes su sgrub pa snying por byed pa 'ong la/ sgrub pa snying por byed lugs ni bslab gsum nyams su len tshul la rag las shing / de nyid gnad du song na sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan bcu gcig pa skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung ngus thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'di yang mtshon pa tsam ste/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la sgrub pa snying por byas pas ngan song du skye ba'i rdzong las thar/'bring gi lam la sgrub pa snying por byas pas 'khor bar skye ba'i rdzong las thar/chen po'i lam la sgrub pa snying por byas pas ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang / zag med las kyis skye ba'i rdzong las thar tshul bstan pa yin no/ /de dag la 'di skad 187—26

ces bya ste/ sdug kun rba rlabs drag pos dkrugs pa yi/ /mi bzad srid mtsho nyam nga'i klong chud pa'i/ /nyam thag rnam grol gling du dbugs dbyung ba'i/ /rgyal bstan nor bu'i gzings 'dir cis mi zhugs/ /lam dang lam min gang zhig ji ltar zhes/ /don chen gnad la dpyod pa'i shes rab kyi/ /'dren byed yangs por skyongs pa'i blo ldan dag /'dir ni 'bad pa kun gyis 'jug par rigs / /de phyir thog mar thos pa'i sgron me yis/ /blo yi mun stug rab tu gzhil bya ste/ /phan pa'i yon tan rlabs dang rgya che ba'i/ /ngo mtshar de yi dpal du thob par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che sde snod rnam gsum gyi/ /brjod bya rjod byed ngo mtshar bkra ba'i ris/ /blo gros kun mthong gtsang mar phyis pa'i ngogs / /sim pa'i ltas mo 'byams su klas par 'gyur/ /las dang nyon mongs kun 'byung 'ching brgya yis/ /dam por bcings pa'i skye ba'i kun 'byung gi/ /zo chun 'khyud mo 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad nas/ /zhi ba'i dga' ston dam par reg par 'gyur/ /mngon par dad dang yid ches mngon 'dod kyi/ /dad gsum shing rtas sgom byung nor gyi bu/ /drangs pa'i 'od rlabs g.yo bas srid zhi yi / /mun stug gnyis snang dang bcas gzhil bar 'gyur/ /kun rmongs smag rum snying du gtibs pa yis/ /rnam dpyod 'dren byed ldan bzhin dmus long ltar / /blang dor gnas la kun nas 'thoms pa'i mun/ /gsal ba thos pa'i sgron me nyid las ci/ /nyin byed bye ba 'bum phrag 'od kyi rlabs/ /gcig car spros kyang gsal bar nus min mun/ /srid zhi'i smag rum ji snyed mchis pa yang //thos pa'i sgron me gcig gis gsal bar byed/ /'jig rten 'di yi gces nor ji snyed kyang / /brlag dang 'bral ba'i rang bzhin su yis srung / /thos pa 107—27

'phags pa'i nor nyid gang gis kyang / /dbrog par mi nus gtan gyi dga' ston nyid/ /rdo rje'i 'gyings 'gro 'khor lo'i phyag gi mtshon/ /srid gsum mtshon cha'i char gyis gzhom min pa/ /kun rmongs dgra bo nyid de de yi srog /dbral bar nus pa thos pa'i mtshon cha nyid/ /gces par 'doms kyang kun nyon tsha ba'i zhugs/ /'bar bar ched du 'jug pa'i grogs kyis ci/ /'di dang gtan du bla med zhi bsil gyi/ /thabs tshul 'doms pa thos pa'i grogs bzang nyid / /'byor tshe shin tu mdza' bcug snying nye'i tshul/ /cung zad phongs na phyir zhing gnod bgyid pa/ /'jig rten 'di yi mdza' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /phongs kyang lhag par mdza' ba thos pa'i gnyen/ /phan dang gnod pa zung du 'brel ba la/ /bdud rtsi lta bur bsngags kyang phyogs re tsam/ /srid zhi'i nad brgya sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ /bdud rtsi'i snying po 'dir ni thos pa nyid/ /mi tshe ri yi brdeg byed rno ba'i dbal/ /gdos bcas gshed du 'beb la bsngags pas ci/ /khams gsum g.yul ngo kun gyis bzlog min pa'i/ /stobs ldan nyon mongs dpung 'joms thos pa'i dpung / /snyan par grags pa'i ba dan g.yo byed cing / /phun tshogs 'dod rgyar sbyin pa'i gter kyang ste/ /legs bshad skyes dang mkhas pa dgu ba'i gtam/ /smra ba'i ro 'dzin 'jigs bral spobs pas mtho / /lung rigs gad rgyangs mthon pos smra ngan gyi/ /wa tshogs klad bum gcig car bral byed cing / /legs bshad ga pur zer phreng skyugs pa yis/ /skye rgya'i gdung ba kun nas 'phrog par byed/ /thos nyung blo yi ra bar chud min pa'i / /'gal 'du'i phung po mthon por brtsegs pa yang / /mang thos rnam dpyod yangs pa'i lha lam du/ /shong bar mi nus dngos de ci zhig mchis/ /skye 107—28

ba'i rba rlabs drag por 'khrugs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal na kra'i grong khyer brgal dka'i rdzong / /mang thos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rin chen grus/ /skad cig pha mthar bsgrod la ji ltar ngal/ /de phyir gnas skabs dang ni mthar thug gi/ /'di ltar phan yon rlabs dang rgya che ba/ /bsam zhing mang du thos pa'i nor bu'i mdzodarka/ /bsog la blo dang ldan rnams brtson par rigs/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcas pa'i lam nas cung spros te gleng ba'o//rgyud bla mar/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams dang / bsam gtan las byung ba'i bsod nams bskal pa mang por bsags pa las gzhung 'di las tshig tsam thos shing / thos nas mos par byas na snga ma de dag las bsod nams ches mang ba thob par 'gyur ba'i sgrub byed du/ gang phyir sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni sgrub byed la/ /khrims kyis mtho ris bsgom pas nyon mongs spong byed la/ /shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spong de yi phyir/ /'di mchog nyid de de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos pa'i phan yon ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams kyang thos pa'i rjes su bsam sgom 'byung ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi thos rkyang gi phan yon ma yin te/ thos pa bsam sgom gyi ched du ma dmigs par thos rkyang byas na phal cher tshe 'di'i snang zhen gyis 'chings par 'gyur zhing / de ltar na chos brgyad gang rung gis zin par 'gyur bas nyes dmigs chen po skyed par lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las bshad de/ smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /zhes mang du 'byung ba rnams bsam sgom med pa'i thos rkyang la bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ mi dag na zhing lus ni sdug bsngal te/ /107—29

lo grangs mang po res 'ga' ma thar ba/ /de ni yun ring nad kyis nyon mongs pas / nad rnams gso ba'i phyir yang sman pa btsal/ /yang dag yang du de yis btsal ba yis/ /sman pa mkhas shing rig pa de rnyed de/ /des kyang snying rje nye bar bzhag nas ni/ /sman 'di btang bar gyis zhes byin pa dang / /sman mang bzang zhing phangs pa de blangs nas/ /na ba 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i sman mi 'thung / /sman pas ma lan sman gyis ma nyes te/ /nad pa de nyid kyis ni nyes pa yin/ /de bzhin bstan pa 'di la rab byung nas/ /stobs dang bsam gtan dbang po kun rig nas/ /bsgom pa la ni mngon par brtson mi byed/ /rigs par mi brtson ga la mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes nad pas yun ring po'i bar du sman pa bzang po btsal te rnyed pa na/ /des snying rje nye bar bzhag nas sman bzang mang po bsdebs te 'di 'thung na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes byin pa na sman mi 'thung bas nad ma gsos pa ni sman pas ma lan/ sman gyis kyang ma lan/nad pa de nyid kyis nyes pa yin par gsungs pa bzhin du don la sbyar ba na/stobs dang bsam gtan dbang po kun rig nas/ /bsgom pa la ni mngon par brtson mi byed/ /ces thos pa gcig pus mi chog par ma zad/ thos bsam gyis de thams cad shes kyang / sgom pas nyams su ma blangs na thos bsam sgom pa ya bral du gyur pas myang 'das mi thob par gsungs pa dang / ngas ni rab tu bzang po'i chos bshad kyang / /khyed kyis thos nas yang dag ma dpyad na/ /nad pa sman gyi rkyal pa thogs pa dag /bdag gi nad ni gso bar mi nus bzhin//zhes thos rkyang ni nad pas sman gyi rkyal pa mgul du thogs nas sman mi 'thung ba dang 'dra bar gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ lus kyis 'di 107—30

dag spyad par bya/ /tshig tsam brjod pas ci zhig 'grub/ /sman dpyad bklags pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad pa dag la phan 'gyur ram/ /zhes thos rkyang ni sman mi 'thung ba sman dpyad bklags pa dang 'dra bar gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ de ltar rnam bsam ji skad bshad pa yi/ /bslab pa bsgrub pa'i ched du 'bad par bya/ /sman pa'i ngag ma mnyan na sman dag gis/ /bcos dgos nad pa gsos pa ga la yod/ /ces/ thos rkyang ni sman pa'i ngag mi nyan par nad gso bar 'dod pa dang 'dra bar gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang bu ston chos 'byung las/ mang du thos kyang sgrub pa dang bral ba ni nyes pa chen po ste/ drag shul can gyis zhus par/ gal te thos pa dang ldan pa dal ba phun sum tshogs pa 'di rnyed nas rnyed pa la sogs pa la chags pa'i sems mi sbyor na de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la bslu ba gcig pur 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / dkon brtsegs las kyang 'od srung 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig rgya mtsho'i chu chen pos khyer la chus skom bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de bzhin du 'od srung 'di la dge sbyong dang bram ze kha cig chos mang po bslabs te kun chub par byas kyang 'dod chags la sred pa mi sel/ zhe sdang la sred pa mi sel/gti mug la sred pa mi sel ba de dag chos kyi rgya mtshos khyer la nyon mongs pa'i skom pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur te ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag lta bu kha bshad la song nas lag len med pa la snying po med pas don sems shing lag len gal che ste/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/thos pas rgyags na gus par mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par 'gyed pa'i smra ba rnams la chagasal/ /brjed par 'gyur zhing shes bzhin med par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' 107—31

ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /nang gi sems las shin tu ring bar 'gyur/ /lus dang sems kyang rab sbyangs ma yin 'gyur/ /khengs pa dang ni mdud pa mang por 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /byis pa dam pa'i chos bsam rab tu nyams/ /sems ni mi gnyen shin tu rtsub par 'gyur/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong dag dang rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag gol/ /rtag tu bla ma dag la gus pa med/ /sngags pa'i gtam dag la ni dga' ba bskyed/ /snying po med la gnas shing shes rab nyams/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /de ni lha tshogs rnams kyis mi bkur zhing / /de tshe de la'ang 'dod pa mi bskyed la/ /so so yang dag rig las nyams 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /gang dag lus ni mngon sum mang yod pa/ /mkhas pade dag gis ni spyo bar 'gyur/ /de yi srog ni don med 'gyur ba ste/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /zhes thos pa'i don mi sems par tshig tsam du song ba'i nyes dmigs dang / lag len med pa'i kha bshad tsam la snying po med pa'i shes byed du 'di dag drangs so/ /gzhan yang / thos pa byed dus nas don la nges pa rnyed pa'i phyir du dmigs dgos kyi/ gzhan la 'chad pa na tshig gis brda 'phrod pa tsam dang / rtsod pa'i tshe thal phyir 'phreng ba bsgrigs shes pa'i phyir du nyan pa ni/ nyan dus nas phyin ci log tu song ba shin tu smad de / rnam bshad rigs pa las/ tshig gi khur thogs kyang mngon par mi shes na de'i don mi 'thob ste khye'u'i mgul du gter gyi kha chems kyi yi ge btags pa dang 'dra'o / /de lta bas na mang du thos pas kyang don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir mdo sde'i don mnyan pa la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /mel tshe ba so sor mi 107—32

rtog pa ni/ ma nyal zhes zer bzhin du choms po rnams kyis bcom mo/ /de bzhin du smra tsam la brtson pa'i mang du thos pa so sor mi rtog pa yang nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams kyis 'joms so/ /so sor rtog pa de yang don shes pa nyid med na med pas de lta bas na don gzung bar ni 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rol mo mkhan rkun pos 'jigs nas mi nyal ba bya ba'i phyir glu len bzhin du bcom mo/ /zhes bya ba yang dper brjod par bya'o/ /ji ltar long ba mar me 'dzin pa ni/ gzhan dag la phan par 'gyur ba dang 'dra bar don mngon par mi shes pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa yang de lta bu yin pas de lta bas na don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir don mnyan pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dbu ma bzhi brgya pa las/ shākya gos med bram ze rnams / /chos ni rim bzhin yid dang ni/ /mig dang rna ba yis 'dzin pa/ /de'i phyir thub pa'i gzhung lugs phra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos pa rkyang pa byas te don la bsam sgom med na chos rna bas 'dzin pa'i bram ze bzhin du 'gyur bar gsungs pas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la chos 'dzin tshul yid gtso che bas yid kyis 'dzin dgos par gsungs pas de'i 'dzin lugs thos pa'i don la yang dang yang du bsam pa dang / bsam pa'i don la yang dang yang du sgom pa rgyun mi chad du bsten dgos pa las lan re lan gnyis tsam gyi bsam sgom byas pas kyang mi yong ba mdze can gyis sman thun re gnyis 'thung bas mi phan pa dang 'dra bar gsungs te/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra gi mis bshags bstod las/der yang rgyun du sems ni rnam rmongs la/ /yun ring dus su nad gzhi sten byed cing ske/ /myo/dze can rkang pa lag pa chad pa la/ /thang 'ga' sman bsten pa yi ci 107—33

bgyir mchi/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ sems kyi shing ni thog ma med dus can/ /nyon mongs kha ba'i khu bas brlan bsgos pa/ /ro zhim dngos por bgyi ba mi nus la/ /yon tan chu yi thigs pas ci ru 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar / sems thog med nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs su song ba gnyan po chu yi thigs pa lta bu lan re lan gnyis kyis mi yong bar rgyun ldan du bsam sgom gyis bskyangs dgos par gsungs shing / skyong tshul yang phar phyin bsdus pa las/rgyun mi chad pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsam gtan bsgrub la brtson par bya/ /yang dang yang zhing ngal gso na/ /gtsubs pas mi phyin mi 'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor tshul la'ang de bzhin du/ /khyad par ma thob btang mi bya/ /zhes bsam pa'i don de nyid sgo ma tshul gtsubs shing gtsubs pa dang dpe sbyar te yang dang yang du rgyun bskyangs dgos pa bzhin du thos bsam la'ang 'dra'o/ /de yang thog mar nyon mongs pa gang dang gang shas che ba'i gnyen po byams pa la sogs pa'i gdams ngag thos pa la sbyor zhing / thos pa'i don yang yang bsam pas bskyangs te sgom na ring por mi thogs par zhi bar 'gyur bar gsungs te/ bshags bstod las/ bsam pa bag la nyal dang khams bag chags/ /nyes pa'i rgyu yi gnyen po la sbyar ba/ /bsam pa'i man ngag de ni bsgom pa na/ /'di ni ring por mi thogs zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhes sgom pa'i phan yon gsungs pa rnams kyang thos bsam sngon du song ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ sgom pa tsam gyi ma yin te/ de dag re re bas mi 'grub pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de ltas rnal 'byor can gyi sgom pa gang yin de ni don med yin/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa gang yin de ni don med yin/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 187—34

'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar nyams su len dgos pas/ de dag ston lugs kyang mdo bstan bcos nas ya ma bral bar bstan la/ phan yon kyang ya ma bral bar 'byung bas/thos pa'i phan yon bstan pa rnams kyis bsam sgom gyi phan yon ston tshul phal mo che 'bras bu'i sgo nas ston pa/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs sngar bstan pa'i phan yon rnams dgongs pa 'grel tshul gyis shes la/'ga' zhig tshig gis dngos su bstan pa yang mang du yod pa/ thos pa'i dpal goms don gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ /sogs dang / stobs dang bsam gtan dbang po kun rig nas / /zhes sogs kyis 'grub pa yang dran par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / lung la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis zhugs pa dang / de'i don thos bsam sgom gsum gyis nyams su bstar ba mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'am dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa yin te/ sngar drangs pa'i mdzod lung / ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes pas 'grub bo/ /chos 'dzin pa'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bstan pa las/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang / /mtha' mar phyin par 'gyur ma lags/ /zhes dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis yongs su bzung bar 107—35

'gyur / /lha dang klu dang mi'am ci rnams dang / /bsod nams ye shes kyis ni yongs su bzung / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /dran ldan blo gros ldan zhing blo ldan 'gyur/ /shes rab rgya chen kun nas ye shes ldan/ /mkhas pa bag chags bcas pa'i nyon mongs spong / /zhes pa nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /brgya byin tshangs pa de bzhin 'jig rten skyong / /'khor los bsgyur dang mi yi rgyal por 'gyur/ /bde dang yid bde byang chub de 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bstan pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams kyi/ /phung po ji snyed brjod pa bas/ /dam pa'i chos ni yongs 'dzin na/ /de bas bsod nams ches mang ngo ske/ /zhes pa 'di dag ni/ bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces pa'i don cung zhig bkral ba yin no/ /de yang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir phal cher bshad pa'i chos dang / sgrub pa'i chos so sor phye nas thos bsam logs su byas te bsgom pa'i tshe na gang du mi bsam mi phan no zhes zer ba mang du byung ba ni/rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ /kye ma'o skye dgu'i don gnyis 'grub pa ni/ /rnam dag gzhung lugs dag la ma brten min/ /de la brten pa'ang smra tsam lhur len pas/ /'das par byas nas de las bslus pa gang / /chus khyer 'ga' zhig skom pas shi ba bzhin/ /mang du thos kyang chos kyi phongs pa ni/ /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba med pas nongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/dpyad sgom sgom du ma shes pas 'khrul pa yin no/ /sgra spyi tsam 'dzin pa'i thos byung gi mi chog par don la bsam nas nges pa rnyed pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab skye dgos te/ bsam byung gi nges pa ma rnyed par tshig tsam du song na gar la blta 107—36

ba dang / dpa' bo gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa bzhin du snying po med par gsungs te/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ gar la blta ba'i khrod na 'dug pa bzhin/ /dpa' bo gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid nan tan nyams par 'gyur ba ste/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /zhes dang / bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug /shun pa zos pa'i mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro lta bu ni 'di la don sems yin / /de lta bas na smra la dga' spong ste/ /rtag tu bag yod byas la don soms shig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa ni long gtam smra ba la dga' ba tsam zhig ma yin par sde snod kyi tshig thos nas bsam byung gi nges pa mi 'tshol bar gzhan la 'chad pa la dga' ba'i nyes dmigs yin te/ tshig tsam la shing shun ltar snying po med cing / don la sems pa ni bu ram dngos kyi ro lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thos byung gi nges pa ni rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten nas nges pa ltar snang yin pas dam bca' mi brtan zhing / bag chags brtan po 'jog mi nus par gsungs te/ rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las / gal te yang dag dam bca' tsam zhig gis/ /nges pa rnyed kyang sgrub dang sun 'byin gyis/ /tshad ma'i stobs kyis the tshom ma chod phyir/ /'dam la btab pa'i phur pa bzhin 'gyur bas/ /yang dag bag chags brtan po 'jog mi nus / /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ rtswa bskyod bzhin du 'gul zhing g.yo ba ste/ /de ni de ltar the tshom 'gyur du nges/ /de ni nam yang blo brtan mi 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /zhes dang /107—37

de ni g.yo ldan yangs shing re chad 'gyur/ /phyir phyir zhing ni rnam par 'gyed pa rtsom / /'phags pa dam pa'i chos las rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /mthu chung bsti stang gis ni dga' 'gyur te/ /mi shes ldan pa g.yo zhing 'gyur ba yi/ /spre'u ltar de yi sems ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang nyon mongs pa'i 'go mi non zhing / rang gis tshig tsam gyi sgo nas shes pa de la rang yang yid mi rton par 'gyur te/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ chos dang mthun pa'i tshig gis smra gyur kyang / /khro dang zhe sdang yid mi ches pa dag /rab tu smra ste 'di ni byis pa'i chos/ /don de rnam par shes nas yid mi rton/ /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ rang gi blo yi shes pa dma' ba'i phyir/ /rmongs pa de ni gzhan gyi dring la 'jog /de ni nyon mongs phyogs kyi dbang du 'gro/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /mig kyang 'khrul zhing de bzhin rna ba'ang 'khrul / /sna yang 'khrul zhing de bzhin lce yang 'khrul/ /lus kyang 'khrul zhing yid kyang 'khrul par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /de yi sems ni rna ba'i rnam shes la/ /rab tu chags shing smras rgyags shes rab nyams/ /log par sems shing lam ngan 'gro bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/ /zhes dang / po to ba'i lam rim bsdus pa las/ snga ma mi sgrub phyi ma 'tshol byed pa/ /khyi la zan byin khyur mid byed dang 'dra/ /rang la mi phan gzhan la zlos byed pa/ /mdze pos mdze gso'i man ngag bzlo dang mtshungs/ /tshig la mkhas shing nyams su ma blang na/ /chu bos khyer ba skom ril shi dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshig tsam gyi thos pa ji tsam bsags kyang 'dod pa'i don 107—38

grub te rang nyid dga' ba mi thob la/ tshig gcig gi steng nas bsam ste nges pa rnyed na dga' ba khyad par du 'phags pa thob par 'gyur te/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ yun ring dus nas smra la dga' bas na/ /de ni bdag nyid dga' ba mi thob bo/ /tshig gang dga' ba mtha' yas thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsam kyang mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don la bsam nas nges shes rnal ma gzhi gcig gi steng nas skye na yang gzhan rnams tshegs med par skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ rgyal ba'i sras po po to bas/ blo yi skyes tshad rtags kyis mtshon gyur te/ /chos kun rtags med skye ba mi srid gsungs / /dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba go gyur na/ /yo byad phugs dgos bsog pa ga la srid/ /tshe la long med snyam du go gyur na/ /shes bya thams cad sbyong ba ga la srid/ /nges par chos bden snyam du go gyur na/ /rkyen gyi stobs kyis 'gyur ba ga la srid/ /sdig pa rang la gnod pa go gyur na/ /srog la babs kyang nus par ga la srid/ /dge ba rang la gces par go gyur na/ /gzhan la yus su sgom pa ga la srid/ /bde sdug las las byung bar shes gyur na/ /le lan gzhan la 'dred pa ga la srid/ /'dod la nyes dmigs lta ba'i blo skyes na / /'jig rten 'dod pas gdungs pa ga la srid/ /'khor ba duḥkha yin par go gyur na/ /phun sum tshogs la smon pa ga la srid/ /nges par thar pa 'dod pa'i blo skyes na/ /'jig rten chos brgyad 'dod pa ga la srid/ /sems can kun la pha ma'i blo skyes na/ /zhe sdang phrag dog gsog pa ga la srid/ /gzhan phan bcos ma ma yin skyes gyur na/ /phyis nas rtog pa 'gyur ba ga la srid/ /bdag dang chos su 'dzin pa 'khrul shes na/ /rlom sems nga rgyal gsog pa ga la 187—39

srid / /chos rnams rang bzhin skye med yin shes na/ /dngos dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa ga la srid/ /rang gi nyon mongs pa la dgrar shes na/ /'thab cing mi mthun pa dag ga la srid/ /chos la rtag tu snying nas bsam gyur na/ /rkyen dang thug na gtong ba ga la srid/ /chos de rnams las gsha' ma gcig skyes na/ /phyin ci log de kun gyi gnyen por 'gro/ /zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos ma gcig dpon po nam mkha' dpal la springs pa las/ khyed ni bdag gis smras pa'i rjes slob na/ /dal ba shin tu rnyed dka' don che dang / /de yang chu bur bzhin du myur 'jig cing / /de nas gzhan gang rjes su mi 'brang la/ /dkar nag las 'bras phra ba'ang mi bslu ba/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung 'di ring du soms / /de yis phan bde'i rtsa ba'ang ma bzung ba'i/ /mkhas par rlom dang yun ring bsam gtan la/ /spyad pa'i yus kyis gnongs pa de dag kun/ /nor bur 'khrul nas 'ching bu'i khur thogs pa'i/ /gser gling phyin pa'i tshong pa slar log nas/ /rang gi yul du 'gro bzhin rig par mdzod/ /rnyed dka' rig na gyi nar sdod thabs med/ /don chen mthong na don med 'da' ba phangs//'chi ba bsam na phyi mar 'gro grabs byed/ /las 'bras bsam na bag med gnas las ldog /de ltar de bzhi'i rtsa ba brtan gyur na/ /dge chos lhag ma bde blag nyid du skye/ /de phyir 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang rul la/ /dga' bar ma sems rtsa ba bzhi la slobs/ /zhes rnyed dka' rig na zhes dang / don chen mthong na zhes pa dang / 'chi ba bsam na zhes pa dang / las 'bras bsam na zhes pa rnams bsam byung gi tshad ma'i sgo nas rig pa dang mthong ba'i don yin zhing / rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi bsam na zhes pa yang thos pa'i don la bsam byung 107—40

gi nges pa rnyed pa na zhes pa yin pas de dag rnal ma rgyud la skyes ma skyes gyi nar sdod thabs med/ zhes sogs rtags rnams kyis shes dgos par gsungs pa sngar drangs pa'i blo yi skyes tshad rtags kyis mtshon gyur te/ /zhes pa dang cha 'dra bas / gang dang gang la dmigs pa'i bsam byung gi tshad ma'i sgo nas go ba rnam dag chags na de dang de'i mi mthun phyogs skye mi srid par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar nges pa brtan po yong ba ni dpyad sgom sgom du shes shing / de rtsal du ston pa'i gsung rab ma lus pa gdams ngag tu 'char ba la rag las pas/dpal a ti sha dang / 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po rnam gnyis kyi lugs la bshad chos dang / sgrub chos so sor 'byed rgyu med par/ gang la thos pa byas pa de nyid la thos byung gi yid dpyod tsam gyi go ba legs par chags su bcug /don de nyid yang yang dpyad pas bsam byung gi tshad ma'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ de nyid sgom pas nyams su bstar te mthar dbyung dgos pa ni dpal a ti sha'i gdams ngag bzhin du 'brom chos kyi rgyal pos/ rje sangs rgyas bya ba kun mkhyen yin/ /de spangs rtogs tshogs gnyis mthar phyin yin/ /nga pha ma'i don du de 'dod pas/ /dus dang por thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /dus gnyis par bsams nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /dus gsum par bsgom nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis cung zad bsnyad par bya ste/ gang zhig mang du thos pa tshol ba yang //thos don tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yis/ /grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por spyod phyir te/ /de slad thos don sgrub la lhag par sgrims/ /yid la byed pa bral ba'i thos rkyang gi/ /tshig tsam lhur len chos la blo dred nas/ /nyal 'gro 'bar ba'i 107—41

rang bzhin nyid 'gyur bzhin/ /zhi bsil dga' ston skal bas phra bar 'gyur/ /rnam dpyod dpal gyi dka' thub mgrin sngon rtsal/ /mang thos gangs kyi ri bor dbang bsgyur yang / /bsam sgom g.yar dam lhod pas chos brgyad kyi/ /ri skyes 'dod pa'i rtse dga'i myos la ltos/ /mtshan ldan bshes gnyen sman pa mkhas pa las/ gdams zab bdud rtsi'i snying po legs blangs nas/ /bsam sgom bcud du myong bar mi byed na/ /kun nyon nad brgya ji ltar sel bar nus/ /zhi bsil sman gyi phung po thogs bzhin du/ /phyir zhing nyon mongs zug rngu rab 'khrugs pa/ /'di dag rang gis legs par ma dpyad pa'i/ /nongs so gzhan la ji ltar 'gol du yod/ /don gyi nyams myong rgyud la mi bskrun par/ /tshig tsam la zhen thos rkyang lhur len pa/ /sman dpyad bklag la snying por zhen pa yis//nad pa rang la phan par mi nus bzhin/ /mang thos 'dren byed yangs por skyongs bzhin du/ /'di snang rnyed bkur ljon 'bras la chags pas/ /ngan song g.yang khar ched du lceb pa 'di/ /tshul bzhin yid la ma byas pa yi skyon/ /gsung rab na kra'i grong du rtag gnas kyang / /nyon mongs skom pa'i me yis gdung bzhin du/ /phan bde'i srog rtsa chad pa'i nyes pa yang / /bsam sgom kha sgo por bzhin bsdams pa'i skyon/ /thos dus nyid nas don la mi sems par/ /'chad dang rtsod pa'i tshig tshul lhur len phyir/ /zhugs pa nyan pa nyid nas smad pa'i gnas/ /de phyir don la sems pa gtso bor zungs/ /blo gros mang thos tshig gi khur thogs kyang / /don la sems pa'i yid byed mi ldan na/ /khye'u'i mgul du gter gyi kha byang ni/ /btags kyang phongs pa sel bar mi nus bzhin/ /don la so sor rtog cing mi dpyod par/ /sgra tsam mang du bzung nas zlos byed 107—42

pal/ /mel tshes ma nyal sgra bzhin chom pos 'phrog /legs par bshad pa sgrogs bzhin nyon mongs 'phel/ /ji ltar rol mo mkhas pas chom rkun dag /bsrung phyir glu dbyangs len cing mi nyal bar/ /gnas bzhin chom pos 'phrog pa ji bzhin du/ /zab don dbyangs su sgrog bzhin rmongs pas bcom mang thos snang byed sug par thogs bzhin du/ /rang gi gti mug mun stug slar 'phel ba//dmus long mar me 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul yang / /nang du yang dag sems dang bral ba'i skyon/ /gos med pa dang bram ze ji bzhin du/ /mig dang rna ba tsam gyis chos 'dzin pa/ /de dag rnams las lhag par khyad zhugs pa/ /yid gtso yid kyis 'dzin pa rang gi lugs/ /chags sogs tshabs che'i nad yun thog med nas / /shugs drag btab pa sel ba'i dam chos sman/ /bsam dang sgom pa lan re lan gnyis kyis/ /gar yang mi phyin yun du skyongs pa gnad/ /sems rgyud thog med nas rengs tha rgod zhing / /gnyen po'i chu thig re zung bran pas ci / /yongs rdzogs lam gyi bsam sgom chu bo'i rgyun/ /rgya cher yun du drangs pas dul bar 'gyur/ /sems kyi rtsub stan gnyen po'i rtsub shing gis/ /shugs drag rgyun mi 'chad par rtsub pa las/ /nyams rtogs me lce 'bar bar 'gyur gyi gzhanaske/ /ngal bso bzhin du 'bad kyang dgos pas stong / /de phyir ji ltar thos pa'i don nyid la/ /bsam dang sgom pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /bsrings pas sgrib gnyis g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /gdod ma'i rgyal sa myur du zin par 'gyur/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel kun las dbyangs gcig gis/ /thos bsam sgom gsum phyogs re min par bsngags/ /phan yon dag kyang phan tshun 'brel bzhin du/ /'byung ba'i tshul la nges pa 'dren pa gnad/ /lung chos sde 107—43

snod rnam gsum 'chad nyan dang / /de don rgyud la sbyar bas rtogs pa'i bstan//'dzin pa thub bstan spyi yi gzhung srol te/ /kye ma gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir phyogs rer spyod/ /gang zhig bshad dang thos pa de sgrub cing / /gang zhig sgrub pa de nyid thos cing bshad/ /gzhan du bu ram shing shun la chags dang / /bro ba'i chos bshad ji bzhin slu brid nyid/ /so sor rtogs pa sgom gyi gegs su bsamane/ /mi rtog tsam 'jog tsam la snying por zhen/ /'chug med sgom dang sgom gyi gegs 'khrul ba/ /dpyad sgom sgom du ma shes pa yi skyon/ /thos pa gzhan stobs las nges yid dpyod kyi/ /gnad la lung dang rigs pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /rang stobs nges pa 'dren la dpyad sgom zhes/ /mkhas grub du mas sgom gyi mchog tu bsngags/ /dpyad sgom stobs kyis drangs pa'i nges shes la / /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i go 'phang mthon po la/ /spyod 'di shing rta chen po'i bzhed srol nyid/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//de bzhin du rje rgyal ba gnyis pas thos bsam sgom pa nyams su bstar tshul myong khrid kyi tshul du smon lam gnang ba ni/ rnam dag rigs pa'i stobs kyis gsung rab don/ /ji bzhin 'byed la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i gam du mtha' yas gsung rab la/ /ngoms pa med pa'i thos pa byed par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang zhig thos pa dang / gang las thos pa dang / ji ltar thos tshul sogs gang byung byung zhig gis mi chog par gang zhig thos pa'i thos bya mtha' yas pa'i gsung rab ste legs gsung bcu dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rnams/ de yang re gnyis tsam ma 107—44

yin pa mtha' yas pa zhig thos dgos pas/ zab zab mor bsgrags pa tsam gyis mi yong ngo / /gang las thos pa'i yul yang lung don rigs pas 'byed nus pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig dgos pa las bshad mkhan gyi ming btags pa tsam gyis mi yong zhing / thos tshul yang lan re lan gnyis tsam gyis mi chog par/thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngoms pa med pa'i thos pa byed dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thos pa'i don de nyid bsam byung gis sgro 'dogs chod pa'i phyir du skyong tshul ni/ ji ltar thos pa'i don la rigs pa bzhis/ /nyin dang mtshan du tshul bzhin rab brtags nas/ /bsam bya'i gnas la bsams las byung ba yi/ /rnam dpyod blo yis the tshom chod par shog /ces bsam byung rang gi ngo bo yang gang thos pa'i don de nyid la rigs pa bzhi sogs kyis dpyod tshul dang / dpyod pa'i dus rgyun chad med par dang /bsam byung du gyur tshad dang / byed las sogs tshig la gsal ba ltar ro/ /bsam byung gi nges pa rnyed nas sgom tshul yang / gang tshe shin tu zab pa'i chos tshul la/ /bsam byung blo yis nges shes rnyed pa'i tshe/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /dben pa bsten nas tshul bzhin bsgrub par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang bsgom bya'i chos/ sgom pa'i kun slong gi ma mtha' tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod pa/ sgom tshul gus sbyor dang / rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas/ sgom pa'i gnas/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /zhes sogs ltar 'du 'dzis dben pa/ dbus mtha' las bshad pa'i nyes pa lnga spong /'du byed brgyad bsten pas gzhung bsrang / sems gnas pa dgu/ yid byed bzhi ldan du gzhung lugs nas tshul ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du sgrub pa zhig dgos 107—45

zhes pa ltar ro/ /de'i don ji lta ba bzhin du rgyal ba'i dbang po dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs pa'i rgyan las/ mang du thos pa'i sgron me ma bsten na/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa sel bar mi nus shing / /yang yang bsam pa'i dran pas ma bskyangs na/ /thos pa'i nor mchog bsrung bar nus ma yin/ /bsam pa'i don la rtse gcig ma bsgoms na/ /srid pa'i sa bon spong bar ga la nus/ /de phyir thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /dal ba'i rten la snying po len pa gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag ni sngar drangs pa'i mdo dang / bstan bcos de dag gi rgyab brten tshad ma dang ldan pa bka' dge'i dam pa rnams kyi bzhed srol gyi spyi chings yin la/ thun mong snang tshul gyi rnam thar yang 'di dang mthun pa yin te/ dang po rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal//bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha ma nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blang / /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar / dang po rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal tshul dang / bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar tshul gnyis rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i skabs dang po gnyis kyis gsal bar bstan la/ tha ma nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blang tshul ni/ de ltar gdams pa'i gter du gyur pa na/ /theg chen gnyis kyi thun mong lam dang ni/ /thun mong min pa'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis/ /gnad bsdus tshang ba'i lam la 'dris par sbyangs/ /zhes rtogs brjod 'dir mdor bsdus tsam las ma gsungs kyang / lam rim bsdus don du lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste zung 'jug gi bar gyi lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ /thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin 107—46

bskyangs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs so/ /de dag kun kyang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin tshul yin la/ de'i dge rtsa rnams kyang rang gzhan gyi rgyud la lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa'i tshul 'di la bsam shes na rje bla ma'i rnam thar gyi gnad 'gag go bar 'gyur ro/ /de tsam du ma zad/ thos bsam sgom pa re re'i skabs su chos thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas sgom tshul/ gcig grogs su gcig 'gro tshul sogs ston par/ rgyal ba 'brom gyis/ nga btsun po rmongs par ma shor ba / /chos rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bskyangs pa'i drin/ /nga mkhas pas btsun tshugs ma bcom pa/ /las rgyu 'bras zab mo bsgoms pa'i drin/ /nga bsgoms pas kha ton mi 'joms pa/ /bka' mdo sde zab mo bltas pa'i drin/ /nga klog pas bsam gtan mi 'joms pa/ /rje bla ma'i man ngag 'chun pa'i drin/ /chos thams cad gcig tu rab bsdus nas/ /gnas stan thog gcig tu sgom shes pa / /skye dka' spyad chos la spyad pa'i drin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos bsam sgom pa re re'i skabs su chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas sgom tshul rtogs dka' bas/ rje rgyal ba gnyis pas/ de ltar thos bsam sgom pas rgyal ba yi/ /dgongs pa'i gnad rnams rgyud la bskrun pa'i tshe/ /srid la brkam pa'i tshe 'di'i snang ba dang / /rang bde 'dod pa'i blo rnams mi 'byung shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ thos bsam sgom pa re re'i tshe rgyal bas dgongs pa'i gnad rang rgyud la bskrun pa na/ srid pa la brkam pa'i blo nges 'byung gi mi mthun phyogs spyir 'gog pas skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor dang / khyad par tshe 'di snang gi zhen pa 'gog pas skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor dang / rang bde 187—47

'dod pa'i blo'am rang gces 'dzin 'gog pas skyes bu chen po'i chos skor te/de gsum tshang bar byas nas thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa gang la zhugs kyang de'i nang du chos thams cad tshang bar bsdus nas sgom tshul yin nam snyam ste blo gsal zhing / yid gzhungs pa rnams kyis dpyad par mdzod cig /rje rol pa'i rdo rjes/ thos bsam phyogs su ma song zhing / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba yis/ /mnyan 'os rigs pa'i lam smra ba/ /de nyid la ni mkhas pa zer/ /nyon mongs dpal ni chog pa dang / /rang dang gzhan rgyud 'dul bar nus/ /lta sgom 'khrul bral gdengs ldan pa/ /de nyid la ni grub pa zer / /mkhas pas grub pa ma bcom zhing / /grub pas btsun pa ma bcom par//bstan la phan pa sgrub pa la/ /skyes bu dam pa zhes kyang zer/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyang snga ma ltar gcig grogs su gcig 'gro tshul lo/ /gcig grogs su gcig mi 'gro bar ya bral du gyur pa ni/ de gsum so so'i dgos pa ma shes pas lan pa yin te/ chos byed pa la shes dgos pa sogs snga phyi'i 'brel bsgrigs tshul mdo dang / shing rta chen po rnams kyi dgongs pa ltar bka' gdams snga phyi'i gzhung de dag gis bsgrubs shing / mdor bsdus na/ lam rim chen mo las / de yang byed pa la shes dgos shing de la thos dgos pa dang / thos nas shes par byas pa'i dgos pa yang byed pa yin pas thos pa'i don la nus pa dang bstun pa'i lag len re gnad du che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos pa ni shes pa'i ched du yin la/ shes pa ni sgrub pa'i ched du yin pas thos dus nas chos sgrub pa'i kun slong dgos kyi/ nyams su blang bya'i chos rang sgrub pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos yin kyang / kun slong gis ma zin na thos rtsod lhur len 187—48

du 'gyur ba ni/ sa sde las/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag la 'di skad ces smra ste/ thos bsam sgom pa phyogs char ma lhung ba'i/ /'phrul gyi yan las/ kun ldan shing rta'i rlabs/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i thang chen yud brgal nas/ /sku gsum gling du 'jug la cis mi rings/ /gang zhig thos bya zab don yid bzhin nor/ /gzhung lugs rin chen 'byung gnas las tshol gyi/ /zab mor grags kyang ltar snang phyogs re yi/ /khron par 'bad pas zhugs kyang ngal ba tsam / /gang las thos pa theg mchog mtshan ldan bshes/ /dbang gi rgyal po gtsug na bsten pa las/ /srid zhi'i 'dod rgu yid bzhin 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /dman pa mching bu'i gor mas ci zhig phan/ /ji ltar thos tshul ngoms pa med pa yis / /mtha' yas gzhung gi dgongs zab legs tshol gyi/ /gzhan du lan 'ga' 'ol spyi rags pa res/ /gzhung don ji bzhin rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /thos pa'i don la bsam dang dpyod pa yi/ /lung rigs 'phrul 'khor rnon po'i rtsibs g.yo bas/ /sgro 'dogs 'ching rgya bcad pa'i nges shes kyis/ /gzhung lugs gdams par 'char ba'i dpal thob 'gyur/ /de ltar bsam pas sgro 'dogs legs chod nas/ /tshul bzhin sgom la rtag tu 'grus bya ste/ /gang zhig sgom pa zab mo'i chos kyi tshul/ /bsam byung blo yi nges shes rnyed pa'i gnad//gang du sgom pa mtshan nyid lnga ldan gnas/ /kun slong srid bde'i 'khri ba chod pas sgom/ /sgom tshul rtag 'grus brtson pas nyes pa lnga/ /spong gnyen 'du byed brgyad bsten rtse gcig sgom/ /de las sems gnas dgu dang zhi lhag 107—49

sogs / /gong ma'i yon tan khyad par thob par 'gyur/ /'di dag thub bstan spyi yi bgrod tshul te/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i bzhed srol mthil kyang ngo / /de ltar thos bsam sgom pa gcig grogs gcig /'gro ba'i tshul la nges pa legs rnyed nas/ /thog mar mang du thos pa tshol bya ste/ /de las bsam sgom snang ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smras pa'o//rtsom pa po'i kun slong ltar chos nyan pa po'i kun slong la'ang dgos pas kun slong bcos tshul rnam bshad rigs par skyon bcu gsum gyi gnyen por rnam pa bcu drug gis chos mnyan par gsungs shing / bcu gsum ni nang du yang dag par 'jog pa'i tshe smra ba po la bdag nyid kyis bskyed pa dang / spyod lam mi sdug pa'i skyon dang / rigs mtho ba la sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'i skyon dang /don du mi gnyer ba'i skyon dang / gzhan gyi phyogs byed pas snying na ba'i skyon dang / mchod par mi 'gyur bas smra ba po rab tu mi 'dzin pa'i skyon dang /sun ci phyin du rgol ba'i bsam pa'i skyon dang / chos dang chos smra ba la yon tan yid la mi byed pa'i phyir rim gro mi byed pa'i skyon dang / chos la tshig dang /yig 'bru ma 'brel ba'i chos smra ba la tshul khrims dang / rigs dang / byad gzugs dang / tshig 'byin pa ma tshang ba la sogs pa'i skyon yid la byed pa'i phyir brnyas pa'i skyon dang / smad pa'i skyon dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur sti 'dod pa'i skyon dang / sems rnam par g.yeng ba dang gnyid rmugs kyis bsdus pas mi nyan pa'i skyon dang / dgongs pa dang chos nyid la phyin ci log tu rtog pas legs par yid la mi byed pa'i skyon dang / 'dun pa dang 'jug pa zhan pa 107—50

nyid kyis rab tu yid la mi byed pa'i skyon dang bcu gsum mo/ /gzhan yang skyon drug tshan gnyis kyang gsungs te/ rnam bshad rigs par/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang bsdus dang ske/ /skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin/ /zhes dang / yang las kyi skyon dang /mos pa med pa'i skyon dang / mchod par mi 'gyur ba'i skyon dang / bsam pa'i skyon dang / mi mthun pa'i skyon dang / 'dzin pa'i skyon dang drug gsungs shing ske/ dang po las kyi skyon la lus kyi las spyod lam mi sdug pa dang / lus ngag gnyis ku'i las de gnyis kyis bskul bar mi byed pa dang / yid kyi las nyan par mi 'dod pa dang gsum mo/ /bzhi pa bsam pa'i skyon la'ang gnyis bshad de/ gzhan la klan ka btsal ba dang / 'di lta bu zhig tu rgol ba las mthar bar bya ba'i bsam pa'o/ /lnga pa mi mthun pa'i rkyen la lnga ste/ chos la nges 'byin gyi lam min par go nas mi gus pa dang / tshig dang yi ge ma 'brel bas brnyas pa dang / gang zag dang tshul khrims dang tshig 'byin pa'i skyon gyis gus pa med pa dang / rigs kyi skyon gyis brnyas pa dang / khong du chud pa dang sgrub pa'i nus pa mi 'byung snyam pa bdag la brnyas pa'o/ /'dzin pa'i skyon lnga ste/log par 'dzin pa dang / don mi 'dzin pa dang / tshig 'bru mi 'dzin pa dang /brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa dang / ma lus par mi 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes deng dus kyi chos nyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod kyi tshul gnad du mi 'gro ba rnams 'byung 'gyur lung bstan pa lta bur snang bas 'dir zhib tu bris pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba'i chos nyan pa'i sde tshan las byung ba'i nyan tshul gyi skyon rnams dang /mngon rtogs rgyan las/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /drug tu nges par 107—51

rtogs par bya/ /zhes pa'i thad kyi mdo las/ 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyi shul/ rang gzhan gang rung la brten pa mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum/'gal rkyen gzhan la brten pa gsum ste snod kyi skyon mang du gsungs pa 'di dag kyang snod kyi skyon gsum du 'du bas de gsum spong tshul mdo bstan bcos nas du mar bshad de/ de yang mdo dag las/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig ces mang du 'byung ba rnams kyi don cung zhig bgrol na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ snod kyi skyon gsum spong bar bstan par bzhed la/'phags pa lhas ni/ de gsum gyis rim bzhin gzu bor gnas pa dang don du gnyer bar 'gyur bas nyon la nges par rtogs shig ces nyan pa po'i mtshan nyid bstan par 'chad do/ /de gnyis kyang mi 'gal te/ snga mas dgag phyogs nas skyon gsum spong tshul la mdo de gsum rim par sbyar la/ phyi mas nyan pa po'i snod kyi mtshan nyid gsum tshang dgos pa la sbyar bar snang ngo / /dang po ltar na legs par zhes pas snod kha sbub pa lta bu'i skyon bsal dgos pa dang / rab tu zhes pas snod dri ma can lta bu'i skyon bsal dgos pa dang / yid la zungs shig ces pas snod zhabs rdol ba lta bu'i skyon bsal dgos par bstan pa yin no/ /de yang dper na/ char babs kyang chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i snod kyi skyon gsum ste/kha sbub pas nang du char mi 'bab pa dang / mi gtsang bas babs kyang skyon can du gyur pa dang / zhabs rdol bas babs kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos kyi char babs kyang chos kyi chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i skyon gsum ste/ rnam g.yeng dang gnyid rmugs kyi skyon ma bsal na yid dang rna ba mi gtod pas mi 'bab pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i kun slong legs par ma bcos na 187—52
