rtog pas gsal shing la khol cig zer nas de ltar byas so/ /drang srong mdog nag po dus dus su der 'gro bas/ song nas de ma mthong ba dang btsal bas gsal shing la gshon par mthong nas/ bu ci yin/ las lag mod/ rma ma phyung ngam/ lus kyi rma phyung ste/ sems kyis ma yin no/ /ji ltar shes/bden pa'i tshig gis bdag gi lus kyi rma phyung gi sems kyis ma yin na mkhan po'i pags pa'i mdog gser gyi mdog tu gyur cig ces smras ma thag tu gser mdog tu gyur te yid ches so/ /gi ta mas mkhan po bdag gi 'gro ba ni gang / skye ba ni gang / bu bram ze na re bu med pa la 'gro ba med do zer na/ bu skyes pa'i nus pa lta yod dam/ bdag gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / bud med kyi rgyus kyang ma 'tshal na lta ga la mchis/ bu sngon spyad pa'i yul dran par gyis shig /gnad chad pa'i tshor bas nyen na yul dran par ga la 'gyur/ des rdzu 'phrul gyis rdzi char chen po phab ste char pa'i thigs pa lus la phog cing rlung grang mos lus la reg pas sdug bsngal mnan nas sngon gyi yul dran par byas te 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags dran nas khu ba khrag dang 'dres pa gnyis lhung ngo / /de gnyis sgo nga gnyis su gyur nas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis smin nas rdol ba dang khye'u gnyis byung ste/de dang nye ba'i bu ram shing gseb tu zhugs so/ /gi ta ma nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis shin tu tsha nas shi'o/ /drang srong 'ongs nas nye 'khor bltas pas/ sgong skog mthong nas btsal bas bu ram shing gi tshal na khye'u gnyis 'dug pa mthong ste/de de'i bu ru shes te gnas su khrid nas mnun bstod de gsos pas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis smin par byas pas nyi ma'i rigs/ gi ta ma'i bu yin pas gi ta ma/rang gi yan lag las skyes pas yan lag skyes/ bu ram shing gi tshal nas rnyed 107—102

pas bu ram shing pa zhes btags so/ /dus gcig na rgyal po bha ra dh+wa dza bu med par shi nas/ blon po rnams gros byas te su rgyal por dbang bskur/ 'di'i gcen no/ /de drang srong gi drung du song nas gi ta ma gang du mchis/ khyed kyis bsad do/ /bdag cag gis mthong bar yang mi dran na ji ltar bsad/ dran par bya'o zhes rgyas par bshad pas/ sdig pa spyod pa de'i ming tsam yang bsgrags pa ma lags kyi/ zhig cig /sdig pa ci byas/ 'di'o/ /de skyon med par khyed kyis bsad pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par bshad pa dang khye'u de gnyis phyogs der 'ongs so/ /'di su'i bu/ de kho na'i bu'o/ /de mthong nas ngo mtshar skye ste de gnyis khrid nas phu bo rgyal srid la dbang bskur ro/ /de'ang bu med par shi nas nu bo rgyal srid la dbang bskur bas rgyal po bu ram shing pa zhes bya bar gyur/de'i bu brgyud la rgyal po bu ram shing pa brgya yul gru 'dzin du byung / de'i tha ma bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po/ de la bu bzhi ste/ skar mda' gdong dang /lag rna dang / glang po che 'dul dang / rkang gdub can no/ /dus gcig na de'i btsun mo dam pa shi nas yid khong du chud de 'dug pa la/ blon pos dris pas rgyas par smras pa dang / btsun mo gzhan btsal/ gzhon nu 'di dag rgyal srid 'dod pas su'i bu mo gter/ bdag cag gis btsal lo/ /ji tsam na rgyal po gzhan zhig gi bu mo gzugs bzang ba zhig mthong nas/ rgyal po de can song ste bkra shis par gyur cig /ci slong / bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po'i btsun mo dam pa gum pas sras mo slong ngo / /rung mod kyi dam zhig bca' ste/nga'i bu mo la khye'u byung ba rgyal srid du 'jog na sbyin no/ /bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po la smras pas/ phu bo bzhag nas nu bo rgyal srid la 107—103

ji ltar bzhag /don 'di la nges pa ma mchis te/ bu tsha 'byung ba'i nges pa'ang med/ byung na'ang bu dang bu mo gang 'byung gi nges pa'ang ma mchis so zhes smras pas/ de blangs nas dga' mgur spyad pas bu gcig byung ba ma skyes pa nas rgyal srid 'dod pas rgyal srid dga' zhes ming btags so/ /de cher skyes pa dang rgyal srid la ma bzhag pa zhang pos thos nas tshig rtsub mo dang bcas pa springs pa/ khyod sngon khas blangs pa bzhin byas na legs/ mi byed na mthu bskyed la sdod cig /kho bo 'o nir 'ongs la yul 'khor phur mar brlag go zhes springs pa dang / 'di la ji ltar rgyal srid dga' rgyal srid la dbang bskur mod/phu bo bzhag nas nu bo dbang bskur ba 'os pa ma yin no/ /rgyal po de ni stobs dang ldan pas 'di dbang bskur la gzhon nu rnams spyug tu gsol/ nyes pa med par ji ltar spyugs/ bdag cag ni blon po lags pas lha'i don sems shing nyes pa med pa'ang sgyugs/ yod pa'ang 'jog go/ cang mi smra ba dang blon po rnams gros byas te gzhon nu rnams rgyal po'i thugs phyung ba'i thabs bya'o zhes bgros nas / skyed mos tshal byi dor byas pa ri mo sna tshogs bris pa zhig tu rtsed chas sna tshogs bzhag ste sgor byung ba dang gzhon nu rnams kyis dris pa su'i tshal/ lha'i 'ol/ /log par brtsams pas zhugs shig /de dag skyed mos tshal du rtse ba dang /blon pos rgyal po spyan drangs te 'ongs pas/ ku co'i sgra thos nas ci yin dris pas / gzhon nu rnams so/ /ngas gzhon nu spangs so/ /lha mi spang bar gsol/sgyugs par bgyi'o/ /gyis shig /de rnams sgyugs par byas pa dang rgyal po'i rkang pa la gtug ste bdag cag 'khor gyi skye bo dang lhan cig mchis na mi dgag par gsol/ gyis shig /de nas de rnams la dga' ba'i 'khor gyi skye bo'i 107—104

tshogs dang lhan cig chas te/ zhag bdun du gru 'dzin gyi sgo phye nas skye bo'i tshogs song ba dang / blon pos sgo ma bkum na gru 'dzin stong par 'gyur ro/ /sgo chod cig /bcad do/ /de nas de rnams rang rang gi sring mo khrid nas mthar gyis gangs ri dang nye ba chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram drang srong ser skya'i bste gnas dang nye ba zhig tu lo ma'i spyil bu btab ste gnas bcas nas ri dwags bsad cing 'tsho'o/ /de dag dus gsum du ser skya'i bsti gnas su 'gro'o/ /de rnams lang tsho dar 'dod chags kyis nyen nas skya bo seng seng por gyur pa dang ske/ ser skyas dris pas ji ltar yin pa smras pas/ rang rang gi sring mo spongs la/ mas dben gyi sring mo sten cig /rung ngam/ rgyal rigs rgyal srid stong pa la rung ngo / /de rnams drang srong gi tshig tshad ma yin snyam nas/mas dben gyi sring mo dang lhan cig spyad pas bu dang bu mo mang po btsas te chen por gyur pa dang / bsam gtan gyi tsher ma sgra yin pas/ ser skyas sems rtse gcig pa ma thob pa dang / ser skyas mthong gis/ 'gro'o/ /ci'i phyir/'di'i phyir ro/ khyod 'di nyid du bzhugs shig /bdag cag gnas gzhan du mchi'o / /sa phyogs phog cig /drang srong des gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te chu rgyun gyis grong khyer gyi rnam pa bris nas/ de rnams kyis grong khyer brtsigs pas ser skya'i gzhi zhes grags so/ /der de rnams 'phel bar gyur nas dogs pas 'phel bar ma gyur pa dang / lhas de rnams kyi sems shes nas phyogs gzhan zhig bstan pas/ der grong khyer brtsigs pas lhas bstan zhes bya'o/ /de rnams tshogs nas bdag cag spyugs pa de rigs mnyam pa las chun ma blangs pas 'gyur gyi der sus kyang rigs mnyam pa las chun ma blang bar mi bya'o/ /187—105

gcig kho nas chog shes par bya'o zhes bcas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po 'phags skyes po bu rnams dran te/ de rnams gang na 'dug /blon pos rgyas par bshad pas/gzhon nu rnams sring mo dang lhan cig byed phod dam/ rngo thogs lags so/ /kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni phod pa'o/ /zhes dbang chen pos tshig tu brjod pas phod pa zhes grags te shākya zhes bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po 'phags skyes po shi nas rgyal srid dga' dbang bskur/ de'ang bu med par shi nas skar mda' gdong dang ske/ lag rna dang / glang po che 'dul rnams bskos pas kyang bu med par shi nas / rkang gdub can rgyal por gyur te/ de'i bu gnas 'jog /de'i bu sa khyim nas brgyud pa rgyal po lnga khri lnga stong ser skyar byung ngo / /de'i tha ma rgyal po shing rta bcu pa sogs ming smos pa bcu gnyis byung ba'i tha ma gzhu brtan/ de la bu seng ge'i 'gram dang / seng ge sgra gnyis te/ seng ge'i 'gram ni 'dzam bu'i gling na gzhu thogs rnams kyi mchog go/ /de la bu bzhi ste/ zas gtsang dang ske/ zas dkar dang / bre'o zas dang / bdud rtsi zas so/ /bu mo gtsang ma dang / dkar mo dang / bre'o ma dang / bdud rtsi ma'o/ /zas gtsang la bu bcom ldan 'das dang / cung dga' bo/ /zas dkar la rgyal ba dang /rgyal po bzang ldan no/ /bre'o zas la ming chen dang / ma 'gag pa'o/ /bdud rtsi zas la kun dga' bo dang / lha sbyin no/ /gtsang ma'i bu legs par rab sad do/ /dkar mo'i bu phreng ba can/ bre'o ma'i bu bzang len/ bdud rtsi ma'i bu dge 'phel lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sras sgra gcan zin te/ des mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud rdzogs/ de la zas gtsang yan du sa ya chig 'bum nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya bcu bzhi rnams byung ngo / /'jig rten gdags par ni 107—106

mang pos bkur ba nas zas gtsang yan du rgyal po sa ya gcig dang bdun khri bzhi stong lnga brgya bcu gcig go/ /yang 'jig rten gdags pa de nyid las 'dul ba las 'byung ba'i rgyal po'i rabs bris par/ mang pos bkur ba nas zas gtsang yan du rgyal po 'bum phrag brgyad sum khri bzhi stong lnga brgya sum cu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /'di dag ni deb sngon gyi don bsdus te bshad pa yin la/ gzhan yang mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo las ston pa'i gdung rabs bshad tshul 'di dag dang mi 'dra zhing / de'i bshad zin ltar na mang pos bkur ba nas zas gtsang yan du rgyal po bye ba bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya re lnga rnams byung ngo / /mkhas pa snga ma dag sde snod gsum du ston pa'i gdung rabs bshad tshul mi 'dra bar 'byung ba ni sde snod gsum 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis yin zhes bshad pa'ang yod do/ /'on kyang gdung rabs bshad tshul 'di dag ston pas bka' stsal pa bzhin moṅgal gyi bus gdung rabs 'chad pa la brten pa yin par bshad tshul de dag gi byung ba la bltas na gsal bas sde snod gsum 'chad tshul mi 'dra bas yin min dpyad par bya'o/ /bar skabs 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis ngal gso cung zad spros na/ 'jigs rung srid pa na kra'i grong khyer du/ /mi bzad tshor ba drag pos rtag nyen pa/ /shin tu nyam thag lus can skyob pa'i mgon/ /de ni thub pa sangs rgyas kho na nyid/ /bsod nams min pa mun pa'i phung po ru/ /spungs pa'i bskal pa smag rum gtibs pa'i khrod/ /rin chen gsum gyi snang ba dkar po yis/ /bde 'thung 'od chags 'grem pa brgya lam tsam/ /de lta na yang bzang po'i bskal pa 'dir/ /rnam 'dren nyin byed stong du 'bar ba yi/ /sa gsum khyon du spungs pa'i nges legs kyi/ /snang ba zad mi shes pa'i dga' 107—107

ston bskrun/ /gang gis skyob pa'i skyabs nyid chos dkon mchog /skyabs de ston pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas mchog /skyabs de sgrub pa dge 'dun dkon mchog ste / /rin chen gsum gyis skal bzang 'gro 'dir 'dzin/ /'das pa na yang bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jig /gser thub 'od srung rnam 'dren nyi ma gsum/ /skye rgya'i bsod nams dgung mkhar rim bzhin du/ /'char ba'i skal bzang la gzhol 'gro rnams rmad/ /lhag par rtsod dus tshe lo brgya pa zhes/ /snyigs lnga srin mo khros pa'i mche phrag tu/ /shin tu gdung la shākya'i rgyal po zhes/ /nyam thag skyob pa mchog gcig deng 'dir byon/ /mtshan dpe dpe zla med pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor/ /gsung dbyangs dbyangs kyi yan lag jag rbe'i gdangs/ /mkhyen rab rab 'byams shes bye kun chutho pa'i/ /ma lus lus can gnyen gcig 'gro 'dor lhab/ /ma 'ong na yang rnam 'dren byams tho na / /mos pa snang mdzad nyid bar dpal stug gar/ /'khor dang sku tshe dam chos khyad par ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bye ba sa 'di'i skal bzang 'gyur/ /e ma mi bzad srid mtsho'i klong chud de/ /sdug kun rba rlabs drag po'i khar g.yengs kyang / /thub bstan yid bzhin nor bu spungs 'dabs kyi/ /dga' ston bsod nams sa gsum khyon las brgal / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog ji ltar byung tshul ni/ chos khungs btsun par bstan pa'i phyir ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du bsdus nas 'chad pa/ gdams ngag la yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir chos kyi che ba spyi dang khyad par bka' thams cad thar pa dang thams cad 107—108

mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs su gzhol tshul/ che ba gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos la nyan bshad ji ltar bya ba/ gdul bya ji ltar bkri ba'i rim pa dang mthun par dkar chag gi tho dngos 'god pa/ rnam dkar legs byas kyi phung po zad mi shes pa bsgrubs pa'i dge rtsa bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i 'brel thogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis gtsos mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba yongs la bde dge zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i rgyur bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor ba'o / /dang po chos khungs btsun par bstan pa'i phyir ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du bsdus nas 'chad pa la/ nyan thos sde pa'i lugs bshad pa dang / theg chen pa'i lugs bshad pa gnyis/dang po ni/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan shāka seng de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshul/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags tshul / mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas tshul lo/ /de dag kyang nyan thos sde pa dang / gong ma'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ltar na/ lung sman gyi gzhi las/ kun dga' bos/ 'jig rten gtso bo rnam 'dren pa/ thub pa khyod kyis byang chub thugs/ /thog mar gang du bskyed pa dang / skal ldan chen po bdag la gsungs/ /zhes zhus pa na/ sangs rgyas 'dod chags bral thos shing —/ /glang po dregs pa'i shas chen dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal gyur mthong nas/ /ngas ni byang chub sems bskyed do/ /mi dbang 'od ldan gyur pa 187—109

na / /ngas ni byang chub 'dod pa'i phyir/ /ngas ni brtan por dam bcas te/ /skyon med pa yi sbyin pa btang / /zhes 'byung bas/ sngon rgyal po 'od ldan zhes bya bar gyur pa na dang po sems bskyed par 'dod do/ /de skad du yang /dpag bsam 'khri shing yal 'dab dang po las/ de ltar sangs rgyas mtshan thos pas / /skye ba sngar skyes goms pa las/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /rgyal po yis ni smon lam skyes/ /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas su/ /rnam par bying ba'i 'gro ba 'di/ /dge ba'i lam nas rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub grol bar yang dag bsgral/ /de nas de la nam mkha' las/ /gtsang ma ris kyi lha yis smras / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ /sa bdag mngon par 'tshang rgya 'gyur / /zhes gsungs pa'i sho lo ka dang pos grogs byang chub 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed dang / gnyis pas gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa drangs tshul/ gsum pas gtsang ris kyi lhas bsngags pa brjod tshul bstan to/ /de yang / 'khri shing yal 'dab dang por/ 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las/ /'gro ba 'don pa'i blo gros ni/ /mthu chen rnams la 'byung 'gyur te/ /de yang 'di skad rjes su thos/ /gser gyi ba gam gzhal yas khang / /khang pas bskor ba'i grong khyer ni/ /'od ldan zhes bya bsod nams las/ /'od ldan mtho ris lta bu yod/ /ces sogs 'di'i lo rgyus mtha' dag lung sman gyi gzhi la brten par snang ste/ lung sman gzhir/ mi dbang 'od ldan gyur pa na/ /zhes pa'i 'od ldan dang rab gsal gnyis 'gyur gyi khyad par yin par snang ngo / /a bh+ya ka ras kyang / dper na bdag cag gi ston pas ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 187—110

la / rab gsal zhes bya ba'i rgyal por gyur pas smon pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das mar me mdzad la yang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ rab gsal gyi thugs bskyed pa'i yul sangs rgyas shākya thub chen yin pa 'dra yang / lung sman gzhi dang /dpag bsam 'khri shing du gsal kha ma byung ba tsam du ma zad/ lung sman gzhir/sangs rgyas 'dod chags bral thos shing / /zhes sogs dang / 'khri shing du/de ltar sangs rgyas mtshan thos pas/ /zhes sogs ltar na mtshan thos pa'i rkyen gyis sems bskyed pa las sangs rgyas zhig gi drung du bskyed pa min par snang ste/cis kyang sangs rgyas kyi drung du bskyed mi dgos pa/ drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las / de bas na sems can thams cad kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i don gyi dngos po ni gcig tu ma zad de/ la la ni snying rje'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni zhe sdang gi rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni sbyin pa'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni ser sna'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni dga' ba'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni mya ngan gyi rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni 'dod pa dang bye bral gyi rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad pa'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni dge ba'i bshese gnyen la bsten pa'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rkyen gyis skye'o//la la ni sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rkyen gyis skye'o/ /la la ni chos thos pa'i rkyen gyis skye'o / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di ltar na rkyen bzang ngan gang dang gang byung ba thams cad byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i rkyen du 'char ba'i dus tshod gcig kyang yod par snang bas/ da ni de'i rgyu la 'bad par bya'o/ /'on kyang grub pa'i dbang phyug a bh+ya ka ras khungs gang la brten par 'tshol zhing /187—111

de ltar nges tshe mdo sde bskal bzang dang / lung sman gyi gzhi/ mngon pa mdzod / 'khri shing sogs nas bshad pa'i sems bskyed yul 'dra yang / bskyed pa po mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'byed dam dpyad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshogs bsags tshul ni/ lung sman gyi gzhi las/ 'jig rten gtso bo rnam 'dren pa/ /khyod sngon byang chub spyod pa na/ /sangs rgyas ji snyed dus gang du/ /ji lta bur ni bsnyen bkur mdzad/ /ces dri ba zhus pa'i lan du 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byung la/ dri ba zhu ba po kun dga' bo dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gnyis kus zhus pa lta bu mdzod shig mngon pa'i rgyan du 'byung ba ni/ mchan dkyus su shor ba'am / don 'dra bas phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bstan pa yin gyi/ lung rang na dri ba dris lan gyi mdo tshan tha dad pa gnyis byung ngo / /dri ba'i lan ni/sangs rgyas shākya thub chen nas/ /'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ /bdun khri dang ni lnga stong gi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ /thub pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan bar/ /bdun khri dang ni drug stong gi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /sangs rgyas legs mdzad nas bzung ste/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung bar dag tu/ /bdun khri bdun stong nga yis mchod/ /grangs med gsum po de la ni/ /rgyal ba ngas ni mchod byas te/ /byang chub phyir ni spyod pa na/ /de tshe nga la skyo sems med/ /ces gsungs/ sho lo ka dang po gsum gyis sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong / bdun khri drug stong /bdun khri bdun stong la mchod tshul gsungs te/ des ni grangs med dang po dang ske/ gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i tshogs rdzogs tshul bstan nas/ tha mas bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang skyo ngal med par bstan to/ /107—112

mdzod las/ grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung ba'i sangs rgyas lung sman gzhi dang cung mi 'dra bar/ rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung / /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /zhes mdzod rtsa'i gzhung gi go rim las ldog ste/ dang po shākya thub pa nas/ rin chen gtsug tor can yan chad kyis grangs med dang po'i tshogs rdzogs/ de nas mar me mdzad yan chad kyis grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs rdzogs/ de nas rnam gzigs yan chad kyis grangs med gsum pa'i chogs rdzogs par 'dod do/ /de nas bskal pa chen po brgyar mtshan bzang gi rgyu sgrub par byed dgos pas/ bram ze'i khye'ur gyur pa na sangs rgyas skar rgyal la zhag bdun du bskor ba byas te/ skyes bu chen po khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag lha yul pa la med/ /'jig rten 'di na yod pa ma yin rnam thos bu yi gnas na'ang med/ /lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na'ang yod min phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med/ /ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa steng rgyas pa kun tu bskor kyang yul gcig ga la yod / /ces tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis bskal pa chen po dgu'i tshogs 'dum ste/ de nas bskal pa chen po dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'das pa na grong khyer nyer ldan du sangs rgyas 'od sung byon pa'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa yan chad kyis mtshan bzang gi rgyu rdzogs te/ de sgrub pa'i gnas skabs la byang chub sems dpa' nges gnas zhes zer ro/ /de'i khyad par rnams ni / mdzod las/ gang nas byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /gang nas mtshan gyi las byed pa/ /bde 'gro rigs mthor skyes dbang tshang / /phor 'gyur tshe rabs dran mi ldog /de ni 'dzam gling phor gyur nyid/ /mngon sum sangs rgyas 107—113

la sems pa/ /bsam pa las byung bskal pa brgya/ /lus pa dag tu 'phen par byed / /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas tshe 'phos te dga' ldan gyi gnas su dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /bshad tshul 'di ni mchims mdzod las / gal te sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi dus nyid du bskal pa grangs med gsum po rdzogs na gtsug tor can nas 'od srung gi bar du 'tshang mi rgya ba mi rigs te/ bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis tshogs rdzogs shing / tshogs rdzogs par ni zhes par mi rigs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de'i tshe tshogs rdzogs shing grangs med par rdzogs mod kyi rnam pa thams cad du yongs su rdzogs pa ni ma yin pas 'od srung sangs rgyas pa'i tshe tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas 'di nas shi 'phos nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i rigs su 'khrungs so zhes 'byung ba'i mdo 'di yang tshad mar byas pa yin no/ /zhes slob dpon gang spel 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/lung don rigs pas 'byed nus pa'i rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta'i bshad srol 'dis/mdzod dang / lung du/ grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba'i dogs gnas kyi phyogs gsum gsal bar byed tshul gyis dmigs 'byed pa 'dis dang po gnyis kyi 'gal spong dang / mdzod kyi lung gang la brten pa yang 'tshol bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gnas skabs gang du phar phyin rdzogs tshul ni/ mdzod las/ kun la thams cad snying rje yis/ /sbyin par byed pas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /chags bcas yan lag bcad kyang ni/ /mi 'khrugs bzod dang tshul khrims kyi/ /skar rgyal bstod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi/ /de ma thag la ting 'dzin blo'i/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang gi tshe sems can kun la/ dngos po mig nas rkang gi bar lus dang longs spyod 107—114

thams cad kun slong mngon mtho'i khyad par la mi re bar snying rjes sbyin par byed pa'i khyad par de 'dra tshang ba'i tshe sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par gsungs la/lung gzhi las byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa chen po'i dus na sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par gsungs so/ /gang gi tshe 'dod chags dang bcas bzhin du yan lag bcad kyang sems mi 'khrugs pa de'i tshe sems mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir dang / lus ngag gi nyes spyod rdzogs pa'i phyir go rim bzhin du bzod pa dang tshul khrims kyi phar phyin rdzogs te drang srong bzod pa smra ba'i skyes pa'i rabs bzhin no/ /lung sman gyi gzhi las/ rin chen bkra ba'i phug na yang / /sangs rgyas skar rgyal la ni ngas/ /de tshe tshigs bcad gcig bstod pas/ /bskal pa dgu ni phyir bsnyil to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa bram ze'i khye'ur gyur pa na zhag bdun gyi bar du sngar drangs pa ltar tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod pas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs so/ /de ma thag la ste rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshe ni ting nge 'dzin te bsam gtan dang / blo'i ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs par 'dod do/ /de ltar dam pa tog dkar po dga' ldan du ji tsam bzhugs zhe na/ gdags par/ de de na che'i tshad ji srid pa de srid du gnas so zhes dga' ldan pa'i tshe tshad du gnas par bshad la/ rgyu gdags pa las kyang / dga' ldan pa'i tshe tshad lo bye ba phrag lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang sa ya drug tu gnas par bshad do/ /gsum pa sangs rgyas tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar pos dga' ldan du lo de snyed du gdul bya'i don mdzad nas 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs par dgongs nas/ dga' ldan du gnas pa la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i lha rigs drug la lan gsum du 'di skad ces bsgrags te/107—115

nga ni dga' ldan gyi lha'i rigs 'di nas 'phos te rgyal po zas gtsang gi bur gyur nas bdud rtsi rtogs par bya yi khyed cag bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba rnams yul dbus kyi mir skye ba longs shig /ces bka' stsal pa na/ dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol te/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhyen par mdzod cig /da lta 'dzam bu'i gling ni mu stegs pa'i ston pa rtog ge pa drug dang /rjes su sgrogs pa drug dang / snyoms 'jug pa drug ste bco brgyad kyis dkrugs pa lags so/ /dga' ldan gyi gnas 'dir dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa'i chos kyi khri bsham par bgyi na 'dir chos ston cing bzhugs pa legs so/ /zhes zhus pa nam/ de nas byang chub sems dpas grogs po dag /de'i phyir rol mo'i cha byad thams cad rdungs shig /de rnams kyis rol mo thams cad brdungs pa na/byang chub sems dpas kyang dung 'bud par mdzad nas 'di rnams las sgra lhag par che ba gang yin/ gsol pa/ dung gi sgra lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/dung gi sgras rol mo'i sgra gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du/ ngas kyang de dag zil gyis mnan te bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshims par bya'o/ /seng ge gcig gis gcan gzan tshogs rnams du ma 'joms/ /rdo rje gcig gis brag rtse du ma rnam par 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lha min dbang po du ma 'joms/ /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa du ma rnam par gsal/ /khyed cag las bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba rnams grong khyer drug tu skye ba longs shig /ces bka' stsal nas gzigs pa rnam pa lnga la gzigs nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras su sku bltams shing de'i nyin zhag de la lnga brgya tshan pa drug btsas shing / gter lnga brgya yang kha phye bas yab rgyal pos/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na don thams cad grub par gyur 187—116

pas / gzhon nu'i mtshan don thams cad grub par btags so/ /zhes brjod de mtshan yang de ltar grags so/ /de nas rim gyis sku nar son pa na/ yi ge dang ske/ rtsis dang / glang chen zhin pa dang / 'phongs kyi gnad lnga dang / sgyu rtsal gyi stobs la sogs pa yon tan ma lus pa mthar phyin te/ shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma sogs btsun mo stong phrag du ma khab tu bzhes nas khyim du bzhugs pa'i tshe gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bskul nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du rab tu byung bar mdzad do/ /de nas chu bo ne rañdza na'i 'gram du lo drug tu dka' ba spyod par mdzad do/ /de nas bsod snyoms kyis sku gser gyi kha dog ltar gsal bar byas nas ma gha ta rdo rje gdan gyi shing drung du gshegs par mdzad do/ /de nas srod kyi dus su bdud sdig can gyis nag phyogs kyi 'byung po thams cad sbran te mtshon cha'i char phabs pa rnams kyang byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus me tog gi char par byin gyis brlabs nas bdud kyi sde chen po 'dul bar mdzad de/rje rgyal ba gnyis pas/ dpa' bo khyod kyis byang chub shing drung du/ /mkhyen brtse'i dpung gis yid srubs bdag po'i sde/ /ma lus zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa ni/ /drag po'i rlung dang nye ba'i sprin nag bzhin/ /mda' mtshon go cha ma bzung bar/ /rang nyid gcig pus bye ba'i bdud/ /ma lus pham mdzad g.yul gyi las/ /khyod las gzhan pa su yis shes/ /de ltar khyod kyi byams pa'i mes / /'dod lha'i snying ni rab gdung kyang / /brtse ba'i gter khyod lus can la / /ris su chad par gyur pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas mdzod las/ ston dang bse ru byang chub bar/ /bsam gtan mtha' brten gcig la kun/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nam gyi dgung la mnyam par gzhag ste 187—117

bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas sbyor lam yan chad rgyud la bskyed nas tho rangs skya rengs 'char ku'i tshe rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dug gsum sa bon dang bcas pa drung nas phyung ste mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ni/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ gang tshe bdud rnams mngon btul ba/ /de yi nub mo kho na la/ /nyon mongs shin tu che spangs pa/ /de nyid rmad du byung ba lags/ /'od zer phreng ba stong ldan pa'i/ /nyi mas mun bsal gang lags dang / /dpa' bo khyod kyis mu stegs las/ /rgyal bar mdzad pa ci zhig mtshar//'dod chags bral bas chags bcas dang / /zhe sdang bral bas zhe sdang can/ /gti mug bral bas rmongs pa ste/ /gsum pos rtag tu gsum dag btul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing / de nas wa ra ṇa sir byon te/ kun shes sogs lnga sde dang / grags pa sogs nye ba'i lnga sdes mtshon yul gru kun tu skal ba ldan pa mtha' dag gi khams dang bsam pa dbang po ji lta ba bzhin du rjes su bzung ste kun tu rgyu rab bzang gi bar la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te gdul bya'i tshogs kun btul bar mdzad pa ni slob dpon dpa' bos/ 'jig rten rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /yun ring sa steng dam chos bshad/ /'jig rten gsum phan 'dod nus pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa'ang mang du bskrun/ /mngon du gdul bya'i tshogs kyang ni/ /mdzes bzang yan chad btul lags pas/ /de ko khyod la sems can gyi/ /bu lon lhag ma ci mchis na/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mthar gyad kyi yul rtswa mchog gi gnas su mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzad de/gsung rab dang ring bsrel gyis kyang 'gro ba mgon dang bcas pa mdzad tshul/brgya lnga bcu pa las/ de slad chos sku ma lus pa/ /sras kyi mchog la gtad 107—118

mdzad de/ /gzugs sku til 'bru ltar bshig nas/ /khyod ni yongs su mya ngan 'das / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag las grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa dang / srod la bdud btul ba'i bar ni so skye tshogs lam pa mtshan nyid par 'dod do/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad de brjod na/ thugs bskyed mgyogs 'gros drangs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi/ /nor bu'i rdul mang spungs pa'i gzhal med khang / /chos dbyings mkha' dkyil mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /ngo mtshar rnam gsum dad pa'i phung por brten/ /dman pa'i sde pa'i blo yi khab mig tu/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab dar gyi yug /chud pa min kyang mdzad mchog pañtsa li'i/ /khyad par thob pa'i dga' ston 'di ltar gyur/ /sa bdag rab gsal thos 'dzin pad+mo'i kha/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya'i mtshan snyan 'od rnon gyis / /phye ba'i mod la 'gro kun ngas sgrol zhes/ /snying stobs dam bca' snying du brtan par bcings/ /de nas grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis kyi/ /phung po mngon par bskrun la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i pha mthar gzhug kyang shong min pa'i/ /ngo mtshar blo yi ra bar ji ltar 'god/ /nges gnas sems dpas bskal brgyar mtshan dpe'i rgyu/ /bsgrub pa de phyir 'dren pa skar rgyal la/ /bgrod byed gcig gis zhag bdun bskor ba yi/ /brtson pa'i khyad par 'di 'dra su yi nus/ /de ltas bskal chen dgu yi tshogs 'dum pas/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig mtshan dpe'i rgyu rdzogs nas/ /bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa na/ /'od srung 'dren pas mchog tu lung bstan byin/ /de nas dga' ldan zhing gi 'dren mchog gtso/ /dam pa tog dkar nyid gyur legs bris tshogs/ /theg mchog bdud rtsi'i ro yis tshim mdzad nas/ /gzigs pa lnga yis zhing 'dir byon la 107—119

brel / /zas gtsang sras su bltams nas 'khor sgyur gyi/ /rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas/ /'dod chung chog shes bsod snyoms kyis 'tsho ba'i/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i dpal du bsgreng / /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs bdud kyi dpung / /mda' mtshon bzung ba med par btul dbang dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ni/ /dug gsum sa bon dang bcas drung nas phyung / /grangs med bskal par tshogs rab rab bskrun 'bras/ /bdud rtsi rnyed de 'gro kun kun mkhyen sar/ /'khridang parang bzhed nas gsung snyan snyan dgu'i dbyangs/ sgo/'khrol ba dbang por 'tshams zhing zhing kun 'gengs/snyo /zhos bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// sgo sgoganyis pa grub mtha' gong ma'i lugs ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gang phyir dang por nges par bya ba 'di dka' ste/ /de ni bskal pa stong phrag du mar bsgrub par dka'/ /gang phyir grub na sems can phan byed don chen de/ /de phyir theg chen 'di la skyabs don mchog yin no/ /zhes dang / de'i thad kyi mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel par/ 'dis ni skyabs su 'gro ba de nges pa ste smon lam dang grub pa'i khyad par dag gis grags pa'i rgyu nyid du ston par byed done/ /'bras bu thob pa'i khyad par gyi don chen po nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang gi phyir theg pa chen po 'di la dang po nges par bya ba ste/ gzhan don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang /de thob pa'i thabs yang dag par bsgrub pa'i 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di shin tu dka' ste/ de'i bslab bya thob bya'i sangs rgyas de'i rgyu phun sum tshogs 107—120

pa sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa de ni bskal pa stong phrag du mar 'bad pa chen pos sgrub par byed dgos pas shin tu dka' med kyi/ dka' yang 'jug dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na de'i 'bras bu thob pa'i khyad par sangs rgyas de grub na mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la phan pa tshad med pa byed pa'i gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa dang /rang don du yang spangs rtogs kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa ste don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i don chen po thob par byed de/ de'i phyir theg pa chen po 'di la skyabs su 'gro ba ste 'bras bu'i skyabs bsgrub pa ni don chen po mchog dang ldan pa yin no/ /yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu skyabs 'dong mchog yin no zhes snang ba ltar na / skyabs su 'dong ba ste skyabs su 'gro ba ni don mchog tu ldan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byams pa dang snying rje'i rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa dang /nyan rang bdag nyid chen po dag gis kyang thugs su chud par dka' ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bdag pas gzhan gces par bzung ba la sogs pas mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba la tshad med pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ thob bya sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' yas pa thob pa'i phyir du bya dka' ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob par dam bcas te/ don der dka' ba du mas 'bad pa la zhugs dgos pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' dang / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /ji ltar mtha' yas de bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal sems can mtha' yas 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying brtse bas/ /sdug bsngal dag las drangs byas te/ /sangs rgyas nyid la 'god par nges/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las kyang /187—121

sems can de dag rnams la sngon/ /rang gi don du 'di 'dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /gzhan dag rang gi don du yang / /mi 'byung sems can don sems gang / /sems kyi rin chen khyad par 'di/ /snga na med pa'i rmad cig 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing ske/ sems skyes nas kyang phal pa dag gis yi rang tsam yang bya dka' ba'i mgo dang / lus sbyin par gtong ba la sogs pa'i zang zing gi sbyin pa dang /des mtshon chos dang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ste sbyin pa rnam pa gsum dang /gzhan yang tshul khrims dang / bzod pa sogs rang rgyud smin par byed pa'i phar phyin drug gam bcu/ gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa'i bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi/sems can gyi don bya ba bcu gcig la sogs pa rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i gnad re re la yang bskal chen stong phrag du mar 'bad pa chen pos bslab pa la 'jug dgos te/ par phyin bsdus pa las/ snga phyir 'khor ba'i mtha' dang mnyam tsam du/ /rgya che ring ba'i nyin dang mtshan gyur la/ /de 'dra bsags pas lor gyur dus ring ba'i/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i chu thig grangs rnyed kyis/ /byang chub mchog gi sems gcig skye 'gyur la/ /de 'dra'i rnam pas tshogs gzhan re re zhing / /sgrub dgos gyur kyang snying rjes skyo ba med/ /byang chub dam pa sgyid lug med par bsgrub/ /ces dang / dpal ldan ma khol gyis/ dka' spyad las ni ma bgyid par/ /go 'phang rnyed dka' mi 'thob ces/ /de slad nyid la'ang ma gzigs par/ /khyod kyis brtson 'grus legs par spel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas de 'grub na sems can rnams la phan pa tshad med pa sgrub pa'i don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa 107—122

'byung ba yang / rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / dar ṭika las/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi yon tan gnyis su 'dus te/ rang don chos kyi sku dang /gzhan don gzugs kyi sku'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dbyings dang / rig pa'o/ /dang po la rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'dus ma byas pa don dam pa'i bden pa dang / glo bur rnam dag 'bad rtsol nye bar zhi ba'i lhun gyis grub pa dang /rig pa ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa min pa so so rang gis rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa gzhan don gzugs kyi sku la/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang brtse ba dang mkhyen brtse gnyis kyi nus par ldan pa don gnyis ldan pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi yon tan brgyad du gsungs pa'i dbye gzhi rang don phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa re re la gsum gsum du phye ba ste/ de yang rang don phun sum tshogs pa ni skye 'jig gnas gsum gyi 'dus ma byas pa'i yon tan/ 'bad rtsol dang rnam rtog spangs pas lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan/ sgra rtog sogs kyi rkyen tsam gyis rtogs par mi nus pa'i yon tan dang gsum yod pas rim pa bzhin skye gnas 'jig gsum gyis bsdus pa'i thog ma dang / dbus dang / mtha' med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir 'dus ma byas pa zhes spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i don dam pa'i bden pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan dang / gnyen po glo bur gyi dri ma 'bad rtsol dang gzung 'dzin gyi spros 107—123

pa dang / bden 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i spangs pa mthar thug thob pas gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jug pa glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku'i yon tan/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa so so rang gi rig par bya ba kho na las sgra dang rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs par mi nus pa'i yon tan rnams so/ /'dir rang don glo bur rnam dag gi spangs pa phun tshogs 'chad pa'i skabs su gzhan don 'bad med lhun 'grub kyi yon tan 'chad pa ni gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jug pa'i 'gal rkyen shin tu phra ba shes sgrib kyis bsdus pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi nang nas zag pa med pa'i las zhes pa kun slong gi rtsol ba phra mo de spangs pas gzhan don la 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub tu 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /de'i phyir chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i ngang nas kun slong gi rtsol ba phra mo tsam med par sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje mthar phyin pa'i rgyu las sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du sems can thams cad la lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad du rab tu 'jug pa yin no/ /gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa la yang / mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / brtse ba dang nus pa gsum ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa'i ngo bo nyid ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la mnyam par gzhag bzhin du ji snyed pa thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i ye shes sgrib pa med pa'i mkhyen pas rigs can gsum sogs sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po khyad par med par yod pa gzigs nas glo 107—124

bur gyi dri ma de dag sbyong bar dgongs te thugs rje chen po rgyun chad med par 'jug tshul dpe dang bcas te bstan na/ mkhyen brtse'i ral gri mchog bsnams pas rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i myu gu gcod par mdzad pa dang ske/ mkhyen brtse'i rdo rje mchog bsnams pas lta ngan gyi nags 'thib pos bskor ba'i the tshom nyon mongs can gyi rtsig pa 'jig par mdzad pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med zhi sangs rgyas nyid rang rnams sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs rtogs phyir 'jig med rtag pa'i lam ston pa/ /mkhyen brtse ral gri rdo rje mchog bsnams sdug bsngal myu gu gcod mdzad cing / /sna tshogs lta 'thibs kyis bskor the tshom rtsig pa 'jig mdzad de la 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mdor na rang don chos kyi sku dang / gzhan don gzugs kyi sku ste/ rang don chos kyi sku la'ang gnyis te ngo bo nyid sku ni/ sku lhag ma gsum bden pas stong pa'i chos nyid kyi cha nas rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang / sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i cha nas glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku gnyis te / de yang skye 'jig spangs pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan sogs mtshan nyid lnga dang / rgya che bas gzhal du med pa sogs yon tan lnga dang / ldan pa'i khyad par sogs khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa yin no/ /ye shes chos sku ni/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i mthar thug pa'i ye shes te/ byed las kyi sgo nas me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs lnga dang / sde tshan gyi sgo nas zag med ye shes kyi sde tshan nyer gcig sogs yod do/ /gzhan don gzugs sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang —/ sprul sku gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar 107—125

thug ste/ nges pa lnga ni/ gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa/ sku nges pa mtshan dpe'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba'i gdul bya'i 'khor nges pa sa bcu'i byang sems 'phags pa/ chos nges pa theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa / dus nges pa 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mya ngan las 'da' tshul mi ston par bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshan dpes spras pa sogs kyi sku ston pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/drang nges gsung sna tshogs brjod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ thugs mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ de dag la rtog pa'i kun slong med pa'i lhun gyis grub pa/ de dang de'i rang bzhin du ma grub kyang mdzad pa sna tshogs su snang ba ste khyad chos lnga dang /mtshan bzang dang dpe byad khyad par du 'phags pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ /sprul sku la yang so skye las dag yan chad la snang du rung ba'i mchog gi sprul sku dang / gzhan yang skye ba sprul sku/ bzo bo sprul sku sogs sprul pa'i rol gar mtha' yas pa ston no/ /de'i phyir 'o skol gyi ston pa ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes gcig pu sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang / skyabs dang /gling dang / dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa shākya'i rgyal po 'dis kyang theg pa chen po 'di la dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / bar du bskal chen grangs med mang por tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa sogs nam mkha' ji srid kyi bar du sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul las brtsam pa'i rnam par thar pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rgya mtsho lta bu las chu thigs kyi zegs ma tsam zhig 'dir rang gzhan gyi sdug kun gyi tsha gdung sel ba'i bsang gtor gyi tshul du 'god par bya ba la zhugs so/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i 107—126

dbyangs kyis bsnyad na/ gang phyir snying stobs yangs pa nam mkha'i khyon/ /brlings pa lhun po zab pa chu gter bzhin/ /phal gyis yi rang tsam yang dka' ba'i blo/ /theg mchog rigs can rnams kyis yongs su 'dzin/ /blo mchog dgra bcom chen po dag gis kyang / /thugs su chud pa min pa'i lhag bsam khur/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol ba'i snying stobs ni/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu nyid las su yis 'dzinam/ /gces pa'i mgo dang snying khrag phangs med du/ /gtong ba'i sbyin sogs bdag dang gzhan gyi rgyud/ /smin pa'i spyod pa bskal chen grangs med du/ /spyod pa'i snying stobs 'di 'dra su yis nus/ /mkha' khyab khur du 'khyer ba'i snying stobs dang / /bya dka'i spyod pa shing rta bye ba'i shugs/ /sbyar bas drangs pa'i don gnyis phun tshogs kyi/ /nor bu'i phung po blo chen 'di yis rnyed/ /sgrib gnyis skyon gyi rigs kun zad par spangs/ /bden gnyis gcig car gzigaso pa'i mkhyen rab rgyas/ /don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis nga'agrub pa yis//sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ /blo chung rang don la sred ltar snang rlam/ /sbrang bu'i gshog pa bskyod pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /kun mkhyen lha lam pha mtha' gzhal 'dod pa/ /de las bzhad gad che ba ci zhig brten/ /de phyir blo dang ldan pas don gnyis kyi/ /kun khyab pha mtha'i go 'phang gzhal 'dod na/ /rin chen sems kyis drangs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi/ /gshog rlabs rdzu 'phrul shugs la brten par rigs/ /snying stobs stobs chen rgyas pa'i snying dbus su/ /bya dka' dka' ba med par bya stoba'i khyer/ byu /gzung na na rga mchi dang gzung 'dzino kune/ sto/rab bcom bcorme ldan go 'phang rab sgomachog rnyed/ /de phyir thodag gi ston pa sangaso rgyasang kyang /sgo /dang po bskyod dka' byang chub 107—127

thugs rab bskyed/ /bar du bsgrub dka' rgyal sras spyod mthar phyin/ /tha mar rnyed dka'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//de la gsum/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i tshul/ bar du bskal chen grangs med par tshogs bsags pa'i tshul/ mthar mngon par sangs rgyas nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/spyir sems bskyed kyi rang bzhin ngos bzung ba dang / bye brag tu ston pa thugs rje can gyis thugs bskyed pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni theg pa chen po'i lam gyi 'jug sgo dang / gzhung shing gcig pu nyid de/de yang theg pa chen po la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen po dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa chen po gnyis su gsungs pas/ de gnyis gang gi sgor zhugs kyang 'jug sgo byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye ba kho na la rag las shing /'di nyid rgyud la skyes na gzhan ma'i yon tan gang yang med kyang theg chen par 'jog pa yin la/ de dang nam bral ba na stong nyid rtogs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan ci yod kyang theg dman gyi sar lhung zhing theg chen las nyams pa yin par gzhung du ma las gsungs shing / rigs pas kyang grub pa yin no/ /de ltar yang sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis / bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na / /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang / /zhes dang —/ jo bo rjes kyang / theg chen chos sgor 'jug 'dod pas/ /mun sel 107—128

gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /nyi zla lta bu'i byang chub sems/ /bskal par 'bad pas skye yang rung / /zhes dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las kyang /byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzungs sngags chen po'i dkyil 'khor shin tu rgya che ba 'di dang / shin tu zab pa 'di dang / gting dpag dka' ba dang gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba/ sems can sdig can rnams la bstan du mi rung ba 'di ni lag na rdo rje khyod kyis shin tu dkon pa zhig smras te/ 'di ni sngon ma thos na 'di ji lta bu dag la bshad par bya/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/'jam dpal gang byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la zhugs pa dang / gang gi tshe de dag ni byang chub kyi sems grub par gyur pa de'i tshe/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ye shes chen pos dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya yi/ /gang dag gi byang chub kyi sems rdzogs par ma gyur pa de dag ni gzhug par mi bya ste/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor yang bltar mi gzhug go/ /de dag la ni phyag rgya dang gsang sngags kyang bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 'di ni theg pa chen po mdo dang / sngags gnyis ku'i lam gyi 'jug sgo dang / gzhung shing lta bur shin tu gal che bar rig par bya'o / /des na theg chen par tshud pa yang byang chub kyi sems de skyes pa tsam gyis 'jog la/ phyis theg chen pa'i nang nas thon pa yang de dang bral ba tsam gyis 'jog pas na theg pa chen po ni sems 'di yod med kho na'i rjes su 'gro ldog byed do/ /de ltar yang spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde 187—129

gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems 'di skyes na las nyon can gyi 'gro ba nyam thag pa zhig yin kyang byang chub sems dpa'i grangs su tshud la/ ma skyes na mngon shes dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa dang —/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa dang / khams gsum kus bsdus pa'i nyon mongs zad par spangs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan ji lta bu dang ldan yang theg chen pa'i grangs su mi 'gro'o/ /nyan rang bdag nyid chen po khams gsum la 'dod chags dang bral ba/ gser dang bong ba mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa thob pa rnams kyang byang chub kyi sems 'di ma skyes pas theg chen par ma tshud pa lta bu'o/ /de 'dra'i byang chub kyi sems de skyes ma thag rgyal ba'i sras zhes bya ba'i ming thob pa ste gong du drangs ma thag pa'i spyod 'jug gi lung ltar dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to / /zhes gsungs so/ /byang sems las dang po bas kyang sems 'di nyid skyes pa'i stobs kyis nyan rang bdag nyid chen po rnams zil gyis gnon pa ni/dper na/ nor bu rin po ches 'ching bu'i nor bu zil gyis gnon pa dang /rgyal po'i bu skyes nas ring por ma lon pas blon po'i gtso bor gyur pa rnams kyang rigs kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi phrug gus bya'i tshogs rgan po'i gtso bor gyur pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa dang 'dra bar gsungs te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po nas grus blangs pa'i nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa tshong pa'i 107—130

lag tu 'ong ba ni grong khyer du phyin na/ /nor bu 'ching bu brgya phrag stong yang kha dog dang / rin thang gis zil gyis gnon to/ /de bzhin du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po na gnas kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i nor bu rin po che chen po rin thang med pa smon lam gyi grur bcug pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po skyes pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas rgyud la 'dug ste thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du ma phyin kyang / rnam par grol ba'i grong khyer du phyin pa'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas nor bu 'ching bu lta bu thams cad zil gyis gnon no/ /zhes dang / byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las kyang /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po'i bu skyes nas yun ring po ma lon pa yang ske/ blon po'i mchog tu bya ba rgan po thams cad rgyal po'i rigs dang ldan par skyes pa'i dbang gis zil gyis gnon to/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ring por ma lon pa chos kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa'i las dang po ba dang / yun ring po nas tshangs par spyod spyod pa'i nyan thos na rgan pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang gis zil gyis gnon to/ /zhes gsungs/ yang dper na nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i phrug gu skyes nas ring por ma lon pa'i gshog pa'i rlung gi shugs dang / mig yongs su dag pa'i yon tan gang yin pa de ni/ de las gzhan pa'i bya'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa rgas par gyur pa thams cad la yod pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub tu sems dang po bskyed pa / de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chen po'i rigs kyi rgyud du yang dag par byung ba/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i phrug gu thams cad 107—131

mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i gshog pa'i stobs kyis pha rol gnon pa dang /lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa'i mig gi yon tan gang yin pa de ni/bskal pa brgya stong du nges par byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad la yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / rdo rje rin po che ste pha lam ni chag kyang gser la sogs pa'i rgyan khyad par du 'phags pa rnams kyang zil gyis gnon cing / rdo rje'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ dbul ba thams cad las rnam par bzlog pa de bzhin du sems dang por skyes pa'i byang sems las dang po bas kyang rdo rje pha lam chag pa dang 'dra ba spyod pa nyams len gyi bya ba nan tan dang bral yang nyan rang gi yon tan gser gyi rgyan lta bu rnams zil gyis gnon cing / rgyal ba'i sras dang byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa'i ming yang mi 'dor la 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par bzlog pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ rdo rje rin po che ni chag kyang gser gyi rgyan khyad par du 'phags pa thams cad zil gyis gnon cing rdo rje rin po che'i ming yang mi 'dor la dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par bzlog go/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che nan tan dang bral yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon cing byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par bzlog go/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang mdo de nyid las / rdo rje rin po che ni snod ngan pas bzung bar mi nus pa dang / thams cad 'bug pa dang / brag thams cad bshig pa dang / skye bo ma rabs kyi lag tu phyin par mi 'gyur ba la sogs dpe du ma'i sgo nas rgya cher bsngags so/ /107—132

sems rin po che 'di skyes pa na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi gdan 'gul ba dang /zhing thams cad rab tu g.yo bar 'gyur/ de ltar gyur pa na sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di ci zhig gi ltas yin snyam du dgongs pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di zhes bya bar rigs kyi bu 'di zhes bya bas byang chub tu sems bskyed pas mthu'o snyam du dgongs par gyur nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la bu zhig byung ba ltar/rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung 'tshob byung bar dgongs nas thugs dgyes pa chen pos byang chub sems dpa' de la byin gyis rlobs par mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis kyang de'i sems rin po che skyes pa de mthar phyin pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa lha mthu bo che thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' de'i rkang pa la spyi bos gtug cing phyag 'tshal / mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs kyis mchod cing de'i lus la gzi byin bskyed par byed cing bsam thams cad 'grub pa'i grogs byed par gsungs so/ /de tsam du ma zad sems rin po che de gang la yod pa de la ni rgyal ba rnams kyang bkur sti dang rim gro mdzad par bzhed na gzhan rnams lta ci smos de ltar yang rin po che phung po'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo gal te byang chub sems dpa' shing rta'i nang du zhugs te 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rtse zhing dga' mgur spyod la/de'i shing rta 'dren pa gzhan med na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de'i shing rta ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la yang bskur ro/ /gal te gnas brtan shā ri'i bu dang / moṅgal gyi bu rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par gnas kyang / de la de bzhin gshegs pa rim gro dang g.yog bya ba la brtson par mi mdzad do/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las kyang /187—133

gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen 'di/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di la brten nas tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs shing de'i dge rtsa zad par mi 'gyur ba ni mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ de skad brjod pa'i bsod nams gang / /gal te de ni gzugs can gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi ni/ /'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan gzung / /'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos/ /legs par yongs su brtags na rin che bas/ /'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams/ /rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan par gzung / /dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ /bsal lo snyam du bsams na yang / /phan 'dogs bsam pa dang ldan de/ /bsod nams dpag med ldan gyur na/ /sems can re re'i mi bde ba/ /dpag tu med pa bsal 'dod cing / /re re'ang yon tan dpag med du/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa smos ci dgos / /zhes dang / 'gro ba kun gyi dga' ba'i rgyu/ /sems can sdug bsngal rtsir gyur pa/ /rin chen sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la ci ltar gzhal gyis lang / /phan par sems pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas mchod las khyad 107—134

'phags na/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /bde don brtson pa smos ci dgos / /zhes dang / 'gro ba nyung zad nar ma'i zas sbyor ba/ /skad cig zas tsam sbyin par byed pa dang / /brnyas bcas nyin phyed 'grang bar byed pa yang ske/ /dge ba byed pa yin zhes skye bos bkur/ /sems can grangs mtha' yas la dus ring du/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bde ba bla na med/ /yid la bsam pa mtha' dag rdzogs byed pa/ /rtag tu sbyin pa lta zhig smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di ni sdig sgrib sbyong ba la'ang shin tu stobs che bar gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min par/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /bskal pa du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/ /zhes dang ske/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar/ /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ /des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ /ces dang / bslab btus las kyang ske/ gang ma thos pas dmyal ba la sogs g.yang sar ni/ /bsreg la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad mtha' yas dang / /sems ma zhi ba khyed kyis yang dag myong gyur pa/ /de ni mnyan phyir gus pa shin tu rgya cher bsten/ /gang thos nas kyang g.yeng ba med pa'i bdag can gyis/ /sdig spong sngon byas mang po ma lus zad byang la/ /sngon chad ma thob pa yi bde ba'ang rab thob cing / /bde ba las ni nam yang nyams par mi 'gyur dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems 107—135

dpa'i bde mchog mi zad dang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang mnyam med phun tshogs 'thob byed pa/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i rin chen chos de deng thob na/ /legs par brjod pa 'di la ngal thob gus par nyon/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams kyis yang dag pa'i mtha' la bskal pa'i bar du mnyam par bzhag kyang gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags sbyong mi nus par byang chub sems dpa' rnams de ltar sbyong nus pa yang grogs byang chub kyi sems kyis lhag par zin pa'i stobs kyis yin no/ /sems rin po che 'di la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bde blag tu 'grub cing / 'di dang ldan pa la gnod pa dang /bar chad gang gis mi tshugs pa yang / spyod 'jug las/ 'dis ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du thob par byed/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing / /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / /bde yang brgya phrag spyod par 'dod pas kyang / /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu gtong mi bya/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ rnam par mi gtong ba zhes bya ba'i rtsi yod de/ de 'chang na gzhan gyis gnod par bya ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems kyi ye shes kyi rtsi 'chang ba la'ang 'khor ba'i gnod pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du mchu zhes bya ba'i rtsi dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bye ba'i rtsi dang / rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i rtsi dang / rtsi'i rgyal po lta na sdug pa zhes bya ba sogs kyi dpe dang sbyar nas mtha' klas par gsungs so/ /de 'dra ba'i byang chub sems dpar rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / lag na rdo rje 'khor 107—136

brgya phrag dang bcas pa la sogs pa 'khor los sgyur rgyal bsrung ba'i srung ma nyis 'gyur gyis rtag tu bsrung bas gnyid log gam/ myos sam/ bag med par gyur pa'i gnas skabs na yang gnod sbyin dang mi ma yin sogs kyi gnod pa dang /bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi tshig sems can gzhan gyis ma grub pa rnams kyang 'dis 'grub par sla zhing / de 'dra'i bdag nyid chen po gang na gnas pa'i yul der yang 'jigs pa dang / yams dang ske/ mu ge dang / gnod pa la sogs pa mi 'byung zhing / 'byung ba rnams kyang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems rin po che 'di ni 'gro ba'i bde skyid ma lus pa 'byung ba'i zhing sa lta bu yin te/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ myu gu med par 'jig rten sdong 'byung yod med na/ de la yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu ga la 'byung / /byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na / /'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung / /zhes dang /'jug pa las kyang / nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /spyod 'jug las kyang / 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi//mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i/ /sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa yi/ /'gro ba'i ngal bso'i ljon shing yin/ /'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ /sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /sems kyi zla ba 107—137

shar ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /sems rin po che 'di la brten nas sa lam thams cad myur du rdzogs par 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ de yi phan yon dpag tu med pa dag /byams mgon blo dang ldan pas nor bzang bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu nor bzang la byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pas/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du zhing dang /sa dang / chu dang / me dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / sgron me dang /mig sogs kyi dpe dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang /smon lam thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du rdzi'u lta bu/ srung ma lta bu/ dbang po'i mig 'khrul lta bu/ chu'i zhags pa lta bu/ dbang po'i me lta bu/ mchod rten lta bu sogs kyi dpe dang sbyar te rgya cher gsungs pa 'dri bar mi lang ngo / /des na byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni theg pa chen po'i lam gyi 'jug sgo dang / rtsa ba dang / gzhung shing dang / snying po mchog tu gyur par nges pa bskyed nas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis nges 'byung gi bsam pa shugs drag pos yongs su drangs pa'i byams pa dang snying rje'i rtsa ba can gyi 'dun pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed bcos ma ma yin pa bskyed pa la 'bad pa du mas zhugs par bya'o/ /de dag la 'di ltar bya ste/ srid pa chu srin 'byung gnas klong byings pa'i/ /yid can rnam grol rin chen gling mchog tu/ /bkri bar 'dod pa'i ded dpon chen po dag /sems bskyed nor bu'i gru gzings la brten rigs/ /rin chen sems kyi sa bon la brten na/ /theg mchog lam gyi 107—138

myu gu rgyas 'gyur gyi/ /gzhan du zhing sa stong par so nam gyi/ /ngal bas lo tog phun tshogs re ba bzhin/ /sems bskyed sa bon las 'khrungs myu gu'i 'phang ske/ /dma' yang rnam grol gser gyi snye mas dud/ /yon tan du ma'i mgo 'phang mtho yang gzhan/ /bla med 'bras bus stong pa chu shing bzhin/ /sems kyi rin chen gang gi rgyud bsten pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ba dan bsgreng / /tshangs dbang lag na rdo rje bcas pas kyang / /zhabs rdul gtsug rgyan nor bu'i dpyid du bsten/ /rgyal sras gzhon nus blon po rgan po'i tshogs / /mkha' lding phrug gus bya tshogs zil non ltar/ /dang po'i las can sems dpa' 'di yis kyang / /nyan rang bdag nyid che rnams zil gyis gnon/ /sgrib gnyis bud shing skad cig sreg byed cing / /tshogs gnyis yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' sbyin/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang bde blag ster ba yang / /rin chen sems kyi khyad chos kho nar bskrun/ /srid pa ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur pa/ /rin chen sems kyis sgrub pa'i dga' ston nyid/ /gnyis snang bag chags chags sogs drung nas 'byin/ /tshogs gnyis spel zhing zhing yang sbyong b.re byed/ོ /don gnyis mngon 'dod 'dod dgu sbyin pa dang sgo/ byu /yon tan lhun rdzogs rdzogs byang 'di las rnyedang/ /byasnga phyogs so bdun yal ga'i khyon yangs por/sgo /stobos bcu mi 'jigs ma 'dres nor bu'i 'bras/ /'dzin pa'i dpag bsam gcig pu rin chen sems/ /'bad pa kun gyis bskyed pa'i thabs la brtson/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//'o na de ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa theg pa chen po'i lam gyi 187—139

'jug sgo med mi rung ba yin na/ de'i ngo bo ji lta bu/ dbye ba'i khyad par sogs ji ltar yin zhe na/ dang po ngo bo ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'dun pa gnyis ldan gyi theg chen gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can zhig la byed dgos pa/ des na rang rgyu gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa las byung zhing rang grogs byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi lam gyi gzhung shing du bstan pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can ni theg chen sems bskyed kyi 'jog byed du gsungs so/ /mdo sde rgyan las kyang / spro ba che dang rtsom pa che/ /don che ba dang 'byung ba che/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' ste/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba/ /zhes dang / nyi snang las kyang / sems bskyed pa'i gnas skabs ni don du gnyer ba gtso bo yin pas na de dang lhan cig spyod pa'i sems bskyed pa la don du gnyer ba bstan pa yin te/ de lta na byang chub sems dpa' rnams smon lam dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba 'thad par 'gyur zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba la sems pa ni rnam par shes pa ste rnam par rig pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa gang yin zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang yid smon tsam dang thun gyi 'gor tshig bshar tsam la 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ lam rim chen mo las/ de'i phyir byang chub kyi sems gdams pa'i mthil du bzung nas sbyong ba med cing thun 'go la tshig tsam zhig dran par byas nas lam gyi cha shas phra 187—140

mo re la nan tan du mas 'bad pa ni chos rgyus shin tu chung bar gsal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ des na byams pa dang snying rje'i rtsal yongs su rdzogs pas drangs pa'i lhag bsam la brten nas byang chub don gnyer la rtsol med kyi myong ba thon pa zhig la bya dgos shing / de yang snying rje chen po skyes pa'i tshad la dpag nas byams pa dang / lhag bsam dang / sems bskyed la myong ba thon pa'i tshad rig par bya'o/ /snying rje chen po skyes pa'i tshad ni/ sgom rim dang po las/gang gi tshe yid du 'ong ba'i bu mi bde ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la yang sdug bsngal gtan nas byang bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa'i snying rje rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa bdag nyid kyis mtshungs par 'jug par gyur pa de'i tshe rdzogs pa yin pas snying rje chen po'i ming 'thob ste/ zhes bu chung ngu snying du ches sdug pa sdug bsngal bar gyur pa la ma de snying rje ji tsam skye ba de tsam pa'i blo'i tshod cig sems can thams cad la rang gi ngang gis skye ba na snying rje chen po'i mtshan nyid tshang bar gsungs so/ /'dis byams pa chen po skyes pa'i tshad kyang rigs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i phyir thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod na rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brje sogs byang chub sems sbyong gi man ngag khyad par can la brten nas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / lhag bsam dang / sems bskyed sogs tshig tsam la yid mi rton par bcos min gyi myong ba 'don pas theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsab tshugs pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /'o na theg chen sems bskyed de'i dbye ba'i khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ de lta bu'i theg chen sems bskyed de la sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / don dam 107—141

sems bskyed gnyis/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis/sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mos pa spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed/ rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi/ bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed / rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed/ mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang gsum / dpe grogs chos mthun gyi sgo nas dbye na/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs nyer gnyis yod de/ de la dang po sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed ni sngar rgyas par bshad zin la/ don dam sems bskyed ni/ don dam bden pa la gnyis snang nub pa'i theg chen 'phags rgyud kyi gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rig mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sgrub byed kyi bsam pa phun tshogs kyi rigs su gnas pa'i lta ba'i char gtogs pa'i mkhyen pa zhig la byed pa yin te/ sgom rim las/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'bad par bya'o/ /shen dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de ni log pa las 'das pa spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba shin tu gsal ba don dam pa'i spyod yul dri ma med pa/ mi g.yo ba rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun bzhin du mi g.yo ba'o/ /de grub pa ni rtag tu gus pas zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor bsgom par byas pa las 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis kyi khyad par ni/spyir mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed tshul mang yang / 'jug sdom thob cing spyod pa nyams len gyi bya bas dngos su zin pa'i sems bskyed 'jug sems dang / de dang mi ldan pa'i sems bskyed smon sems su gsungs te/ de yang dper na grong 107—142

khyer du 'gro 'dod kyi bsam pa gzhir byas pa la lus kyis gom pa 'dor len gyi bya bas dngos su zin ma zin gnyis yod pa bzhin du rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi bsam pa gzhir byas pa la/ spyod pa nyams len gyi bya bas dngos su zin ma zin gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'di la sgom rim dang / spyod 'jug /rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa rnams mi 'dra ba med de/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni / /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes dang / sgom rim dang po las/ de la 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces gang thog mar don du gnyer ba de ni smon pa'i sems so/ /gang phan chad sdom pa bzung ste tshogs rnams la zhugs pa de ni 'jug pa'i sems so/ /zhes dang / lam rim chen mo las/'di la mi mthun pa mang du snang yang sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas su gyur cig snyam pa'am sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar bya'o snyam du smon la sbyin pa la sogs pa'i spyod pa la slob kyang rung mi slob kyang rung ji srid du sdom pa ma bzung ba de srid du smon pa'i sems yin la/ sdom pa bzung ba nas sems de 'jug pa'i sems su shes par bya ste zhes gsungs so/ /mos spyod kyi sems bskyed sogs bzhi'i khyad par yang / sems bskyed kyi 'khor gsum bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyi zhen yul med pa mos pa yid byed kyis bsgom pa'i tshogs sbyor gyi skabs kyi sems bskyed rnams mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed dang / bden 'dzin kun brtags kyis dag pa'i ma dag sa bdun gyi gnas skabs kyi sems 107—143

bskyed rnams lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed dang / dag pa sa gsum gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed rnams rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sems bskyed rnams sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed du 'jog pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sems bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba gsum ni/dang por rang nyid kyis rdzogs byang thob par byas nas de nas sems can gzhan rdzogs byang la 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed / dang por rgozhan rdzogs byang la bkod nas de nas rang nyid rdzogs byang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed/ rang nyid dang sems can thams cad dus mnyam du rdzogs byang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed du gsungs so/ /dpe grogs chos mthun gyi sgo nas dbye ba sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs kyang 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa sa lta bu'i sems bskyed nas/ chos kyi sku dang mtshungs par ldan pa sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis su gsungs te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma klu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyi/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag ni theg chen sems bskyed la nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir sems bskyed kyi phan yon/ ngo bo/ dbye ba sogs mdor bsdus tsam zhig smras par zad kyi/ phye ba so so'i don zhib tu 'bri 107—144

ba ma langs pas rgyas par shes 'dod na mdo sde rin po che dang / rgyan rtsa 'grel/bslab spyod/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa sogs la thos bsam gyis ngal ba zhib tu byas pa las legs par shes par bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis sems bskyed kyi rang bzhin ngos bzung ba legs par bshad zin to/ /de dag la 'di ltar smreng te/bgrang yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon gcig /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dpal kyang 'bad med du/ /gang la rag las rin chen byang chub sems/ /'di la 'bad pa kun gyis brtson par rigs/ /mkha' khyab 'gro 'di bdag gi mar gyur nas/ /snying gi dum bu bzhin du gces pa'i drin/ /tshe rabs bgrang du med par bskyangs pa'i tshul/ /bsams tshe yal bar 'dor ba ga la phod/ /shin tu nyam thag gyur kyang bdag nyid la/ /bzod med brtse bas phan thog sgrub pa rnams/ /sdug bsngal me 'obs drag po'i klong chud pa/ /'di las gang gis 'don pa 'ba' zhig sems/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ji snyed khur/ /bdag nyid gcig pus mngon par spro ba yi/ /grogs su byang chub snying nas don gnyer ba'i/ /rin chen sems kyi goms pa rdzogs pa gnad/ /snying rje'i 'o mtsho dkar po'i maṇ+ḍa lar/ /lhag bsam ngang mo dkar po'i tshom bu bkram/ /'phyo zhing lding ba'i 'dun pa gnyis ldan rtsal/ /ngoms pa'i grogs su mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol/ /dmigs rnam gang ba rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /thig le ga bur rgyun du rab bsil ba/ /rin chen sems kyi zla ba snying dbus su/ /'char ba'i dga' ston bla na med par spyod/ /dbye ba'i khyad par ngo bo sa mtshams dang ske/ /dpe grogs chos mthun bskyed tshul la sogs pa/ /chu phran tha dad rnam par nyer bstan kyang / /byang chen rgya mtsho gcig tu gzhol bar 'gyur/ /187—145

sems kyi dkar 'dzum 'dzum bag lang tsho'i dpyid/ /lhag bsam ngo mtshar mtshar sdug bskyed sku yis/sgo /don gnyis dpal yon yon du 'gugs byed rme/ /'di ni thugs dam dam bca'i mthil du zungs/ d+ngha/zheso bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad 4pa'ong//gnyis pa ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos byang chub mchog tu thugs ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can 'di nyid kyis rang cag khams gsum gyi 'gro ba nyon mongs shing sdug bsngal brgya phrag du mas yun ring la shugs drag par mnar bar thugs kyis ma bzod nas de bzhin gshegs pa grangs las 'das pa'i spyan sngar thugs bskyed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i rol gar tha mal pa'i rnam pa can gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i spyan sngar thugs bskyed pa grangs las 'das pa zhig mdzad do/ /de yang mdo sde las 'byung ba grags che ba 'ga' zhig ston pa rang nyid kyi gsung gi rjes su bzlas nas mdor bsdus smos na/ de yang drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las gsungs tshul ni/ ston pa thugs rje can 'di nyid sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren par 'khrungs pa na/ grogs zla bo zhig dang gnyis kyis lcags sreg gi sa gzhir gshin rje a glang gi shing rta 'dren pa las zla bo de nyam chung bas shing rta 'dren ma nus pa na/ gshin rje a glang gis lcags kyi mdung rtse gsum pa brang la bsnun pas khrag gi char babs cing sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag nas smre sngags 'don pa na/ de la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje 'khrungs nas sems can 'di sdug bsngal las thar bar byas te dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'di nga gcig pus 187—146

bzod par bya'o snyam du thugs bskyed cing / sems can des mtshon las ngan pa'i dbang gis dmyal bar lhung ba dang lhung bar 'gyur ba'i sems can thams cad la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje skyes nas byang chub tu thugs bskyed de/gshin rje a glang la sems can nyam thag 'di thongs la 'di'i thag pa nga'i mgo la skon cig /nga gcig pus drangs par bya'o zhes gsungs pa na/ a glang khros nas lcags kyi mdung rtse gsum pa bsnun pas bskal pa brgyar bsags pa'i sdig pa dag cing / de nas tshe 'phos te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes par gsungs so / /'di bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa'i thugs bskyed pa'i thog ma yin pa dang ske/ de nas bzung ste mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar du sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje'i sems rgyun ma chad par skyes pa mdzangs blun las gsungs so/ /mdo sde bskal bzang las gsungs pa'i tshul ni/mdo de nyid las/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen la/ /'jam gang zhig gi dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di'i sngon gyi byung tshul ni/'dul ba lung las/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis ston pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi phyir thog mar sangs rgyas gang la bsod snyoms phul lags zhes zhus pa na/ston pas bka' stsal pa/ sngon yangs pa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na rdza mkhan yangs pa'i 'od ces bya ba des/ de'i tshe ston pa shākya thub pa chen po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te bsod snyoms phul nas zhabs la gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ bdag kyang rab tu sbyin pa 'di yis shākya'i rigs skyes pa/ /yon tan rigs dang rus dag mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /bdag 107—147

gis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar gyi nyam thag 'chi ba yi/ /pha rol zhi ba rgya chen 'jigs pa med par sgrol bar shog /ces thugs bskyed par gsungs/ mdzod 'grel sogs bstan bcos mang por rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang byed ces 'byung la/sngon gyi chos 'byung mang por rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang byed du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te rdza'i bum pa 'jam gyis bkang ba me long gis kha brgyan pa sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci yod phul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku che'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod nas byang chub tu thugs bskyed par gsungs so/ /yang rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shāka thub chen po la kham sa'i bum pa gcig /mgron bu lnga/mchil lham zung gcig /gdugs gcig rnams phul te de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra sogs kyis smon lam btab ste thugs bskyed par bu ston chos 'byung las gsungs/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo las thugs bskyed tshul gsungs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa'i sngon rol gyi yang sngon rol na tshong dpon gyi bu dri ma med pa'i dpung pa zhes bya bar 'khrungs pa'i tshe rje btsun 'jam dpal dge slong chos smra ba ye shes rgyal po zhes bya bar 'khrungs pa des bskul nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi thub zla ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi spyan sngar khrid nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la bsod snyoms 'bul du bcug pa na/ tshong dpon gyi bu dri ma med pa'i dpung pa zhes bya ba des kyang bsod snyoms phul ba na bsod snyoms 107—148

gcig phul bas de bzhin gshegs pa mi thub zla ba'i rgyal mtshan 'khor nyan thos brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / byang chub sems dpa' khri nyis stong dang bcas pa phebs shing thams cad tshim par bzhes kyang / bsod snyoms de zad par ma gyur pa na khye'u de rab tu dga' zhing dad pa lhag par skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa de'i spyan sngar 'dug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mi thub zla ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis khye'u de la byang chub kyi lam bstan pa na tshong dpon gyi bu dri ma med pa'i dpung pas phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa chen pos skyabs su song zhing byang chub tu thugs bskyed do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu dri ma med pa'i dpung pas rang gi pha ma la sogs pa'i srog chags grangs med pa zhig la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/lus can kun la bde ba'i phyir/ /bdag ni byang chub rab zhugs kyi/ /khyed kyang legs par gnas par gyis/ /dal 'byor shin tu dkon pa'o/ /sangs rgyas sku ni 'bar ba dang / /mtshan dag gis kyang brgyan la ltos/ /ye shes kyi ni pha rol phyin/ /byang chub de la su mi smon/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu dkon / /bdag ni khyim nas khyim med par/ /'di nyid du ni rab tu 'byung / /khyed cag gnyis kyis gnang bar mdzod/ /ces bskul nas pha ma la sogs pa'i srog chags grangs med pa zhig byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug cing / rang nyid khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste byang chub kyi lam bsgrubs so zhes 'byung ngo / /lhag par ston pa thugs rje can 'di nyid kyis rang cag rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan thams cad kyis 'dul bar ma nus pas yal bar bor ba'i mgon med nyam thag pa rnams kyi don du mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing 'di ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul snying rje 107—149

pad dkar las byung ba gong du bris pa ltar dang / sngon bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i dus su bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe rang gi sras bram ze rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya ba khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po zhes bya bar gyur pa de'i spyan sngar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud dang ske/ rang gi slob ma bram ze rig byed klog pa stong la sogs pa srog chags bye ba phrag mang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug cing de dag phal cher gyis rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su bzung ba na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa blo la bzung nas dag pa'i zhing de 'grub pa'i phyir du thugs bskyed cing dam bcas/ /khyab 'jug rlung bya ba bdag nyid chen po zhig gis ma dag pa'i 'jig rten du sems can gyi don byed par thugs bskyed cing ma dag pa'i zhing bzung / de ma gtogs pa rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po de dag thams cad kyis gdul sla ba dang zhing dag pa 'ba' zhig bzung nas rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus 'di thams cad kyis spangs shing yal bar bor ba na/ bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis snying rje chen po skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i spyan sngar bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la gtsugs te yon tan du mas bstod cing mchod nas/ bdag cag snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams kyi mgon skyabs su 'byon pa'i thugs bskyed dang dam bca' 'di ltar mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis srog chags bye ba phrag mang po dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du stsal te/107—150
