de dag gis kyang rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya che dgu dag yongs su bzung zhing 'dul ba'i sems can yang bsam pa yongs su dag pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / gdul sla ba dag yongs su bzung lags so/ /gang dag skar ma skyong la sogs pa'i bram ze'i khye'u rig byed klog pa stong rtsa bzhi po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas bskal pa bzang por lung bstan te/ skyes bu dam pa de dag gis kyang 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / nga rgyal la spyod pa dag theg pa gsum po dag gis 'dul bar bgyid lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang de dag gis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa shas che ba dang / rtsod pa'i dus kyi snyigs ma dag yongs su spangs pas/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang mtshams ma mchis pa bgyid pa rnams dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams dang / 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa rnams dang / log par lta ba rnams dang / 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang bral ba rnams dang / phar mi 'dzin pa rnams dang /mar mi 'dzin pa rnams dang / dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa rnams dang / bram zer mi 'dzin pa rnams dang / bgyi ba ma lags par bgyid pa rnams dang /bsod nams ma lags pa bgyid pa rnams dang / 'jig rten pha rol la 'jigs par mi blta ba rnams dang / legs par spyod pa gsum po dag don du mi gnyer ba rnams dang / de bzhin du lha dang mi rnams kyi dpal dang 'byor pa dag la brtson pa rnams dang / nyes par spyod pa gsum po dag la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang bral ba rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyis spangs pa rnams dang / mkhas pa thams cad kyis bor ba rnams dang / srid pa'i btson rar chud pa rnams dang / rgyun 107—151

phyogs su bdas pa rnams dang / 'gyur byed kyi chu klung du nub pa rnams dang /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba rnams dang / gti mug gi mun pa dang ma bral ba rnams dang / mi dge ba'i bgyi ba thams cad ma btang ba rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa thams cad du bor ba rnams dang / mi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang 'grogs par gyur pa rnams dang / lam ngan pas bcom par gyur pa rnams dang / nyam nga ba chen po thob par gyur pa rnams spangs lags te/de'i tshe na bskal pa bzang po la sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed na mi'i tshe lo brgyad cu thub par 'gyur ba thams cad skyes bu dam pa mkhas pa 'di dag gis spangs shing bor bas de'i tshe srid pa'i rba klong dang 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor na skyob pa ma mchis pa dang / skyabs ma mchis pa dang / dpung gnyen ma mchis pa dang /sdug bsngal gyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can de dag spangs nas rang rang gi zhing bzang dgu yongs su bzung zhing / shin tu dul ba dang / bsam pa yongs su dag pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang /sangs rgyas mang po la lhag par bgyi ba bgyis pa'i 'dul ba rnams yongs su bzung ba de lta bu ma lags sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos bka' stsal pa/ bram ze de bzhin te/ sems can bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du smon lam 'debs par byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa yang yongs su bzung ba rnams ngas kyang de nyid du lung bstan to/ /bram zes gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ni dper bgyi na shing keng shu ku'i 'dab ma bzhin du snying 'dar zhing bdag gi yid ni shin tu skyo la/ bdag gi lus thams cad sha thang bar gyur cing mchis na btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gal 107—152

te de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spangs shing rtsod pa chen po'i dus kyi mun par 'phangs te thams cad kyis yongs su spangs pa'i sems can rnams bdag gi snying rje'i gnas su gyur pa la/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa gaṅgā'i klung gcig gi bye ma snyed 'das nas bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gnyis pa la bab pa na bskal pa bzang po de la skye rgya'i tshe lo stong thub pa sdod cing / bdag yun ring po de srid du byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa na 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo bar gyur cig /ces sogs dang / gang dag bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu ma mchis grangs ma mchis pa dag tu spro ba brtan po'i stobs kyi shugs kyis spyod pa la ji ltar sngon chad byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi slad du spyad pa spyod pa 'gas kyang de ltar spro ba brtan po'i stobs kyi shugs kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ma spyad cing / slad kyi byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi slad du spyad pa spyod par 'gyur ba dag kyang de ltar spro ba brtan po'i stobs kyi shugs kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par mi 'gyur ba de lta bu la bdag spyod par gyur cig /slad ma'i byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po dang ldan pa gang lags pa rnams kyang tshul khrims kyi yon tan la 'god par gyur cig /bdag gis sems dang po bskyed pas kyang slad ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po 'grub par gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab nas mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing 'di bzung zhing / snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du 'byon par thugs dam bcas pa na/ de 107—153

bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis legs so zhes rgya cher bsngags shing / me tog thams cad kyi nang na me tog pad+ma dkar po zla dang bral ba zhig yod pa ltar rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyi nang nas khyod ni snying rje chen po dang ldan pa snying stobs phul du byung ba'o zhes bsngags pa bla na med pa mdzad cing / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis me tog gi skyes bskur zhing bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi thugs bskyed dang dam bca' ji ltar mdzad pa de ltar 'grub pa'i thugs smon dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu mdzad do/ /de ltar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshul 'di dag kyang rnam grangs nyung ngu tsam zhig ston pa rang nyid kyis mdo sde las gsungs pa'i rjes su bzlas nas phyogs tsam smras par zad kyi thugs bskyed tshul gyi rnam grangs grangs las 'das pa mtha' dag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa nang phan tshun kho na'i spyod yul nyid do/ /de dag gis ston pa thub pa'i dbang po byang chub tu thugs bskyed tshul mdor bsdus bshad zin to/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ snying rje'i zhags pa dam pos ma 'dris 'gror/ /rjes chags dam du 'khyud pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /de yis 'gro ba sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed kyang / /bde gshegs du ma'i spyan sngar dam du bcas//rtse gsum snying khar bsnun pas khrag gi rgyun/ /tshil chil babs pa dmyal ba'i gyad kyi grogs/ /de bzhin mnar ba'i 'gro la thugs brtse ba'i/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje ba'i thugs rab bskyed/ /lus can srid zhi'i g.yang sar gzhol ba rnams / /'jigs bral go 'phang mchog la ngas 'god ces/ /rdza mkhan khye'u snang byed nyid gyur skabs/ /shākya thub chen spyan sngar dam bca' mdzad/ /bde 107—154

gshegs mi thub zla ba rgyal mtshan drung / /dri med dpung pa zhes byar gyur pa'i tshe / /mtha' yas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed nas/ /grangs med skye dgu theg mchog rigs la bkod/ /lta ngan mun pa bye bas zum pa'i khrod/ /mi 'dod sna dgu'i mtshon cha'i drag char gtibs/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur byed drag pos snying gas kyang / /skyob pa ma mchis snyigs lnga'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam 'dren gzhan gyis yal bar 'dor ba na/ /rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis lhag par rjes su bzung ske/ /snying stobs dpe med pad+ma dkar po bzhin/ /bsngags pa'i rdza rnga phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas 'khrol/ /mgon dang skyob pa skyabs med snyigs lnga'i 'gro//smon lam chen po lnga brgyas yongs bzung ba'i/ /srid zhi'i mngon 'dod srungs pa'i snang ba la/ /bdag cag spyod pa'i skal ba mtho bar gyur/ /bde gshegs nyid kyi gsung gi rjes zlos nas/ /ji ltar thugs bskyed cha shas tsam smos kyi/ /mtha' dag gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rjes bsnyegs pa/ /rgyal ba rang nyid kho na'i spyod yul nyid / /rgyal ba'i nyi ma ma lus 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /brtse chen thugs rjes rjes chags 'gror 'khyud pa'o/ byu /zhum med snying stobs stobs chen dam bca'i khyer/sgo /ji ltar mdzad de de yi rjes su smon/ /zhos bya bo ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyong su 'du bgyis pa'o//gnyis pa bar du bskal chen grangs med par tshogs bsags tshul la/bsag bya'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin ngos bzung ba dang / dus ji tsam gyi bar du gsog pa/ tshul ji ltar gsog pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku 'di/ /bsod nams tshogs las byung ba ste/ /187—155

chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i dge ba thabs dang / shes rab ci rigs kyi bsdus pa ni tshogs kyi ngo bo yin no/ /de yang gzugs sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lag rjes 'jog byed kyi dge ba thabs kyi bsdus pa rnams ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / chos sku'i lag rjes 'jog byed thun mong ma yin pa'i ye shes shes rab kyi chas bsdus pa rnams ni ye shes kyi tshogs kyi ngo bo yin no/ /de la srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par shes rab chen pos sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yang dag par bcom nas ji lta ba la slar ldang ba med pa'i tshul gyi mnyam par bzhag pa ye shes chos sku dang /de'i rang bzhin ngo bo nyid sku la sogs pa ni slob lam du de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / don dam bden pa la brten pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang / zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa shes rab kyi cha ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par rdzogs par byas pa las byung ba yin la/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / mchog gi sprul sku la sogs pa gzugs kyi skus nam mkha' ji srid kyi bar du sems can gyi don la rol ba ni ji snyed pa rig pa'i shes rab dang / kun rdzob bden pa la brten pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang / rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa thabs kyi cha bsod nams kyi tshogs yang dag par rdzogs pa las 'khrungs pa yin no/ /de skad du yang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ye shes kyi tshogs ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spong bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis ni sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas byang chub sems dpa' sems 107—156

dpa' chen pos bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs la brtson par bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod las kyang / de shes rab kyi shes pas ni nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su 'dor ro/ /thabs kyi shes pas ni sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ngo / /des na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par 'dod pas thabs dang shes rab gnyis ma bral ba'i tshogs gnyis zung 'brel du bsgrub pa la brtson par bya dgos te/ de gnyis zung du 'brel na thar pa dang / de gnyis las gang yang rung ba zhig dang mi ldan na 'ching bar gsungs te/ dri ma med pa grags pas bstan pa'i mdo las byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba ni gang / thar pa ni gang zhe na/ thabs med par srid par 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'ching ba'o / /thabs kyis srid pa'i 'gro bar 'gro ba ni thar pa'o/ /shes rab med par srid par 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'ching ba'o/ /shes rab kyis srid pa'i 'gro bar 'gro ba ni thar pa'o/ /thabs kyis ma zin pa'i shes rab ni 'ching ba'o/ /thabs kyis zin pa'i shes rab ni thar pa'o/ /shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i thabs ni 'ching ba'o/ /shes rab kyis zin pa'i thabs ni thar pa'o/ /zhes rgya cher gsungs so/ /de ltar thabs shes zung du 'brel ba ni byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu 'gro ba la bya ngang pa'i rgyal po mkha' la 'phur ba'i gshog yangs gnyis ldan dang 'dra bar gsungs te/ 'jug pa las/ kun rdzob de nyid gshog yangs dkar po rgyas gyur pa/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni skye bo'i ngang pa yis/ /mdun du bdar nas dge ba'i rlung gi shugs stobs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya 187—157

mcho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro/ zhes dang / dgongs pa rab gsal las/kun rdzob rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa dang / de kho na nyid zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi gshog pa yangs pa dkar po rgyas par gyur pa'i ngang pa'i rgyal po sa drug pa ba de ni/ gdul bya'i skye bo ngang pa phul du byung ba skyed pa rnams kyis mdun du bdar nas/ sngon lan mang bsags pa'i dge ba'i rlung gi shugs chen po'i stobs kyis/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro bar 'gyur bas/ de'i rjes su slob par 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang lam rim pa gnyis ma'i gshog pas bgrod dgos kyi/ gshog pa gnyis gang yang med pa dang / phyogs re ba'i lam gshog pa gcig chag pa lta bus mi tshim par/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis ka tshang ba'i lam gyis sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par bya'o/ /zhes byang sems sa drug pa ba dngos dang / de'i rjes su slob par 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du bgrod dgos par nan tan du gsungs so/ /ga ya go ri'i mdo las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam ni mdor bsdu na 'di gnyis te gnyis gang zhe na 'di lta ste thabs dang shes rab bo/ /zhes dang / dpal mchog dang po las kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ma yin no/ /thabs la mkhas pa ni pha yin no/ /zhes gsungs / tshogs zhes bya ba'i nges tshig kyang / /rgyun du goms pa thob nas ni/ /dge ba yang dang yang du sgrub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du/saṃ bha ra zhes 'byung / de yang sad na rgyun du/ bha na goms pa/ ra ti na yang yang ste/ rgyun mi chad par yang yang sgom pas thob pas tshogs zhes bya'o/ /de la dbye na/ mtshan 'dzin gcod pa'i shes rab dang / dge rtsa bsdud pa'i 187—158

thabs te thabs shes gnyis su dbye ba dang / sa yi sgo nas dbye ba slob dpon sharnyi pas/ sems bskyed bsam sbyor lhag bsam dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mi zad pa brgyad cur dbye ba sogs dbye sgo du ma zhig yod kyang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu dbye ba ni theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gnad bsdus pa'i sdom chen por gsungs shing / de'i dang po sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims/ bzod pa gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / bzhi pa brtson 'grus la gnyis kyi cha yod pa dang / lnga pa bsam gtan dang / drug pa shes rab kyi phar phyin gnyis ni ye shes kyi tshogs su gsungs te/ de'i dang po ni 'jug pa las/ sbyin sogs chos gsum de dag phal mo che/ /bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs/ brtson 'grus la gnyis ma'i cha yod de/'jug pa las/ yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro zhing / /bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong gi sbyin sogs gsum zhes 'jug pa'i lung gi shugs la/ bsam gtan chos gnyis 'di dag phal mo che/ /bde bar gshegs pas rab byung rnams la bsngags/ /ye shes zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de nyid de/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu/ /zhes pa zhig don gyis 'thob par mkhas pa rnams bzhed pa'i phyir/ zhes kun mkhyen bla ma mkhas mchog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas gsungs so/ /sbyin sogs gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs su gsungs pa sogs ni gtso che ba la dgongs te/mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa gnyis la ye shes kyi tshogs dang / bsam gtan la bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang yod pa'i phyir 187—159

ro / /'o na phar phyin bcur gsungs pa ma yin nam/ drug tu ji ltar 'du snyam na / skyon med de/ de la thabs ni bsngo ba'o/ /stobs ni so sor rtog pa dang /sgom pa'i stobs kyis spangs bya 'joms pa'o/ /smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa'i skye ba 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes ni sems can smin par byed pa ste thams cad kyang shes rab kyis byed do/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i ngag gis spel na/ rin chen sems kyi cang shes sprin gyi shugs/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i thang chen rab yangs por/ /brtson pa'i lcag gis bskul bar ma bgyis na/ /rnam grol nor bu'i gling du ga la bgrod/ /srid pa'i dra ba bag chags bcas pa'i rgyun / /bcad nas chos sku'i dbyings su ngal bso ba'i/ /bla med zhi ba chen po'i go 'phang 'di/ /zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa'i lag rjes nyid/ /zhi ba phyogs gcig mtha' ru mi gnas par/ /gzugs skus nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba'i don / /sgyu 'phrul 'byams su klas pa'i dga' ston ni/ /rgya che'i lam gyi rim pa'i lag rjes nyid/ /zab dang rgya che thabs shes zung 'brel bas/ /tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug la brtson bya ste/ /ya bral thabs dang shes rab 'ching ba'i rgyu / /gshog chag 'dab bya 'phur 'dod ngal ba bzhin/ /tshogs gnyis zab dang rgya cher zung 'brel ba'i/ /gshog yangs dkar po bskyod pa'i ngang mo ni/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu/ /bde blag bgrod ces dpal ldan zla bas bsngags/ /mkhyen zab zab mo'i dbyings su mnyam par 'jug /snying rjes rjes chags mkha' khyab done la snol/ /sku gnyis gnyis su med par zung 'dzug sku / /tshogs gnyis gnyis su med par bskrun spa'i masbru/ /de phyir chos gzugs sku gnyis zung 'jig 'bris/ /tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pas bskrun pa'i slad//107—160

zab dang rgya che'i lam gyi rim pa dang / /stong dang snying rje'i goms pa spel la brtson / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa dus ji tsam du bsags pa ni/ brgyad stong 'grel chen dang /mdzod 'grel mthun par grangs med gsum zhes pa drang don dgongs pa can yin gyi / nges don du grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum du tshogs bsags dgos par gsungs te/ de yang tshogs lam la gcig /sbyor lam la gnyis/ sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar re re la gsum gsum ste sum cu rtsa gsum dgos kyang sum tshan du 'dra bas na grangs med gsum zhes gsungs par bzhed/ slob dpon dul ba'i lhas sde pa tha dad bklag par grangs med bcur bshad/ 'phags pa rgya cher rol par/ bskal pa grangs med bdun du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par sgrub pa zhes grangs med bdun du bshad la/ dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i dbang gis grangs med gsum gyi nges pa med ces grangs med gsum las nyung bas chog pa dang / grangs med mtha' yas pa dgos pa yang yod par bzhed pa sogs lugs srol shin tu mang na yang / mkhas pa mang pos bzhed cing thams cad la grags che ba ni/ byams pa mgon pos/ sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ /'di ni bskal pa dpag med kyi/ /zhes dang / grangs med gsum ni rdzogs pa yisal/ /sgom pa'i lam ni mthar phyin to/ /zhes tshogs sbyor la gcig /ma dag sa bdun la gcig /dag pa sa gsum la gcig ste grangs med gsum gyi bar du tshogs bsags par gsungs pa 'di nyid gtso bor bzung bar bya'o/ /grangs 187—161

med sum cu rtsa gsum gsungs pa dang nang 'gal du mi 'gyur ba yang gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /de ltar grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa las 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs pa'i grangs med ni bgrang du med pa'i grangs med ma yin par grangs kyi gnas gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum sogs grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i bar du bcu 'gyur du bsgres pas tha ma la grangs med du mdzod rang 'grel dang / thub pa dgongs rgyan sogs du ma las gsungs sol/ /de lta bu'i grangs kyi gnas drug cu'i bar du 'dren tshul ni/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams / /rkyang pa yin par shes par bya/ /ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang ske/ /gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang / /pang rten ded 'dren mtha' snang dang / /rgyu rigs 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs phyin rtogs 'gro bying rdul dang / /rgya rtags stobs 'khor brda shes dang / /rnam 'byung dang ni stobs mig dang / /zhes pa nas/ chen por byas te bgrang bar bya /grangs med pa ni mtha' ma yin/ /gnas gzhan drug cu pa ni grags/ /zhes pa ltar gcig nas dung phyur gyi bar rkyang par bgrang / de nas ther 'bum ther 'bum chen po nas/ stobs mig chen po'i bar chen po bcas bgrang / de nas grangs med pa bsnan pas drug cur bgrang ba'i grangs med ces pa de yin la/drangs ma thag pa'i grangs kyi sdom de mdzod rang 'grel las 'byung / gzhan yang stobs mig gi rjes su/ nyal nyul/ wal wal/ khyad khyud/ phyad phyin rnams chen po dang bcas brgyad kyi grangs 'dren/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs sil bu'i mdo las btus te kha bskangs par gsungs/ spyir btang la/ kha skong nyal nyul/107—162

nyal nyul chen po sogs brgyad kyi tshab tu tshad med bzhi'i ming can chen po dang bcas pa'i thog grangs med bsnan te drug cu 'dren tshul zhig kyang snang ste rtsis kyi bstan bcos las/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur te/ /dgu po rkyang pa'i grangs su brjod/ /ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang / /gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad 'byin dang / /pang rten ded 'dren snang mtha' dang / /rgyu rigs 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs phyin rtogs 'gro 'byin rdul dang / /rgya rtags dang ni stobs 'khor dang / /brda shes rnam 'byung stobs mig dang / /byams pa snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms rnams ni chen por bcas/ /lnga bcu khug pa'i grangs yin te/ /grangs med pa ni tha ma 'o/ /gong nas gong du bcu 'gyur bsgre/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na de lta bu'i grangs med kyi 'go gang nas 'dzin pa yin snyam na/ mdo dkon mchog sprin las/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni bskal pa grangs med pa du mas yang dag par grub pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni dpag pa dang / bsam pa dang / brtag par mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yang dag par 'grub pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul bsgrub par bya ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de ni bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par mi nus kyi/ nam byang chub sems dpa' chos mnyam pa nyid du zhugs par gyur pa de'i tshe de nas brtsams te bskal pa bgrang 107—163

bar bya yi/ thog ma'i sems nas brtsams te ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang /theg bsdus las kyang / bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /sems brtan khyad par 'gro ba yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ de ltar gang gi tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba dang smon lam gyi stobs can dang sems brtan te bar ma dor mi ldog pa dang / khyad par du 'gro ba ste yon tan cung zad kyis chog par mi 'dzin pa de nas brtsams te grangs med pa gsum brtsams so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/tshogs lam du bzang po ni dge ba dang / smon pa ni smon lam/ de gnyis kyi stobs chen te/ dge ba'i stobs dang ldan pas dge ba'i mi mthun phyogs kyis zil gyis mi gnon pa/ smon lam gyi stobs can rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa/ mi dge ba'i grogs pos bzlog kyang byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba sems brtan pa/ khyad par 'gro ba ste mthong chos 'di nas ma mthong ba tshe rabs phyi ma la dge ba'i chos 'phel zhing mi nyams par yon tan cung zad tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin pa ste/ yon tan bzhi po de dag dang nam ldan pa nas grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i 'go brtsams pa yin no/ /de yang sngar theg pa thun mong ba'i skabs bsnyen bkur yul gyi de bzhin gshegs pa bdun khri lnga stong la sogs pa grangs nges bzung du bshad pa ni thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i snang ngo dang bstun nas sangs rgyas gtso bo dag gi grangs bstan pa yin gyi/theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba khrag khrig dang / /de las lhag pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /kun kyang bya rgod phung po 'dir bzhugs te/ /mi dbang de kun nga yis bkur sti 107—164

byas / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsnyen bkur zhing mchod par mdzad par gsungs shing / 'jug pa las/ de tshe 'dis ni sangs rgyas brgya mthong zhing / /de dag byin gyis brlabs kyang 'di yis rtogs/ /zhes sogs dang / blo ldan rab tu dga' bar gnas pas yon tan de dag ni/ /thob par gyur nas de bzhin kho nar dri ma med gnas pas/ /de dag stong ni yang dag 'thob par 'gyur te sa lnga po/ /'di dag rnams la byang chub sems dpa' yis ni 'bum phrag dang / /bye ba phrag brgya 'thob cing de yis bye ba stong 'gyur 'thob/ /de nas bye ba brgya phrag stong 'gyur yang thob bye ba phrag /khrag khrig phrag brgyar rdzogs par bsgyur dang slar yang stong phrag tu/ /yang dag par ni bsgyur ba mtha' dag rab tu 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po pas skad cig re re la'ang lus brgya phrag tu sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag tu de bzhin gshegs pa brgya phrag gi spyan sngar mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba dang / chos nyan pa sogs mdzad pa dang / de bzhin du sa gnyis pa yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis po de dag bcu 'gyur du 'phel te/ de yang sa gnyis pa bas skad cig re re la'ang lus stong phrag tu sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag tu de bzhin gshegs pa stong phrag gi spyan sngar mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba dang / de bzhin du sa gsum pa bas 'bum phrag /bzhi pas bye ba phrag brgya/lnga pas bye ba phrag stong / drug pas bye ba brgya phrag stong / bdun pas bye ba khrag khrig phrag brgya dang / sa brgyad pa nas grangs kyi gnas kyis bgrang bar mi nus pas rdul phra rab rnams kyis yongs su bgrang ste/ de yang sa brgyad pa la stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul gyi grangs tshad ji snyed yod pa de snyed 187—165

dang / sa dgu pa la stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa dang / sa bcu pa nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul gyi grangs dag ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pas de bzhin gshegs pa skad cig re rer la'ang mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i yon tan thob pa sogs mdo sde sa bcu pa dang /'jug pa las rgyas par gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag la 'di skad ces brjod de/ji ltar stong gsum 'jig rten tshad med pa/ /de yi go 'byed nam mkha' nyid las ci/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon tan tshad med pa/ /tshogs gnyis mkha' ltar yangs pas bskrun las ci/ /rgyal sras snying stobs mkha' ltar yangs pa'i nang / /grangs med dka' spyad rdul phran ltar brten pa'i/ /grangs med gsum dang bdun dang bcu so gsum/ /grangs med mtha' yas la sogs brtson tshul mang / /grangs med gsum dang bdun khri lnga stong sogs/ /gsungs pa thun mong gdul bya'i dbang tsam ste/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed bskal par sangs rgyas ni/ /bye ba khrag khrig bkur zhes rang gis gsungs/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' yas de bzhin du/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i thabs mkhas mtha' yas te/ /de bzhin bsod nams ye shes mtha' yas tshogs/ /skad cig skad cig la ni sdud par byed / /rab dga'i sa nas lus ni brgyar sprul nas/ /zhing brgyar bde gshegs brgya phrag mchod pa sogs/ /brgya phrag bcu gnyis yon tan gong 'phel ba/ /sa bcu pa la brjod du med par 'gyur/ /grangs med bskal chen gsum du du ma'i tshogs/ /bla med byang chub gsos su su yis brten/ /de dag bdud rbezhi las rgyal rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang bla mede mchog rab rab 'jogs 'gyur/ /101—1rā6 sgo sgo

zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi ngal bso'i dbyangs su smras pa'o//gsum pa tshul ji ltar gsog pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bzhin du bshad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sngon rol na chos kyi rgyal po tshe rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i bu gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod pa zhes bya bar 'khrungs tshe de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te de bzhin gshegs pa des rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod pa yid 'dun par byas te byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis bsdus pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rnams la slob tshul rgyas par bstan cing / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams rgya cher bsgrags pa na gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod pa theg pa chen po'i lam la phyir mi ldog pa'i nges pa brtan po thob nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phung po chen po nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lo bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug tu mchod pa'i dngos po thams cad kyis mchod cing bsnyen bkur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa nas 'go brtsams te bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob par gyur to/ /de nas grong khyer 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser du tshong dpon shes rab bzang po zhes bya bar 'khrungs tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag ces bya ba 'jig rten 107—167

du byon pa dang mjal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag gis tshong dpon shes rab bzang po la byang chub kyi lam rgyas par bstan cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma'ang bstan pas dad pa dang dga' ba rgya chen po dang byang chub kyi lam la phyir mi ldog pa'i nges pa brtan par gyur nas/ tshong dpon shes rab bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lo stong du mchod cing bsnyen bkur zhing rjes su mnos pa nas bzung ste grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bdun pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u gzhon nu sprin du 'khrungs pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te/ dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang /dad pa rgya chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad kyi spyan sngar lo bcu gnyis su ral pa gser gyi mdog can bting nas/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung mi ston na bdag 'di nyid du lus bskam par bya'o zhes dam bcas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kun nas mkhyen pa dus gsum gang yang mi mkhyen pa cung zad kyang med pa des bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyi bsam pa mkhyen nas de'i ral pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu la zhabs bzhag go/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis langs nas de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad la ut+pa la'i me tog snyim pa bkang ste gtor ro/ /gtor ma thag tu de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gtsug gi steng gi thad du ut+pa la'i khang pa brtsegs pa grwa bzhir ka ba bzhi zug pa/cha mnyam pa shin tu rnam par phye ba/ nyams dga' ba/ yid du 'ong ba zhig gnas par gyur te/ khang pa brtsegs pa de nang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku snang 107—168

ngo ske/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bram ze'i khye'u sprin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//bram ze'i khye'u khyod dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis ma 'ong pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to//de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin bdag nyid lung bstan pa thos nas dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas de'i tshe mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob bo/ /de bzod pa thob nas steng gi nam mkha' la ta la bdun srid du 'phags nas ting nge 'dzin drug stong mngon du gyur cing / de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag kyang mngon du gyur nas sa brgyad pa thob ste/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la ut+pal lngas/ /gtor te ral pa stan du bting byas pas/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob gyur nas/ /shākya'i rgyal por 'gyur zhes nga lung bstan/ /zhes dang / lung las/ gang tshe mar me mdzad kyis nga / /lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur te/ /dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas bzung ste grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bcu rdzogs so/ /de ltar ston pa thugs rje can gyis bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de dag la dbyangs kyis bsngags par byed na/ 'gro ba sgrol la rings pa'i brtse chen gyi/ /chu gter snying dbus gyen du 'phyur ba yi/ /dbu ba 107—169

bsod nams ye shes dkar po'i 'dzum/ /chu 'dzin phreng ba mkha' la 'thor ba bzhin / /grangs med bskal pa rgya mtsho'i dbyig 'dzin khyon/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter 'og pag gis bcings kyang / /dal dang ngoms pa'i pha mtha' ci zhig ces / /kun gsal sgeg mos 'phya ba'i tshul la ltos/ /gces pa'i srog dang bu yang tshod ma ltar/ /gtong la spro ba ngang pa pad mtshor bzhin/ /'di ni snying rje'i chang gis myos pa'am/ /yang na snying stobs lhag par brtan pa nyid/ /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod brtson bsam gtan dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin par spyod pa'i tshul/ /bgrang bar mi zad gaṅgā'i bye ma'i rdul/ /de la yid rang tsam yang ji ltar sems/ /bya dka'i spyod pa rig sngags bzlas brjod bzhin/ /grangs med bskal chen phreng rdog 'dren pa bzhin/ /bsgrub pa bdag cag kho na'i don nyid las/ /nyid kyi don du til tsam ga la zhig /bdag cag don du du ma'i dka' spyad kyis/ /sgrub pa'i dam chos chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /'irgo 'dir thob 'di 'di dang tshe rabs kun/ sgo/ji rbezhin spyod la la 'ur brtson cing smon / /zhesang bya rbo ni tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsngargiso pa'o//gsum pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul la gnyis/ 'og min du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sku bzhi cig car du mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul dang /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pas gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam par thar pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du ston nas 'chad pa dngos so/ /dang po la gnyis/ gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i 107—170

gnas ngos bzung ba dang / der sangs rgyas pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po longs sku'i zhing 'og min gyi ngos 'dzin ni/ bo dong 'jigs med grags pa'i gsung las / yul gang du sangs rgya na/ kha cig na re/ gnas 'og min te/ de yang gtsang ma'i gnas kyi logs gcig na yod do zhes zer ro/ /de ni ma yin te/mdo las/ rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa yi/ /'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar / /gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs nas/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po ni 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan dag na re/ gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min gyi steng na byang chub chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ der byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma kho na skye ba bzhes pa yin pas der 'tshang rgya'o zhes zer ro/ /de ni ma yin te/der srid pa tha ma kho na skye na de nyid sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' gzhan med par 'gyur ba dang / rtogs pa mnyam pa dag 'khor du mi rigs pa'i phyir/ srid pa tha ma pa'i 'khor de dag gzhan du 'tshang rgya ba yin na / de'i tshe rtogs pa mnyam bzhin du rang gi zhing sbyangs pa grub pa dang ma grub pa'i khyad par kyang mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig de nyid shes byed du byas nas gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams nyid 'og min du byed pa ni rigs pa ma yin te/ zhing khams de ni gnas gtsang ma'i steng na yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan dag ni de dag gi phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'og min gyi zhing khams ni gcig nyid yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ni gyi na pa chen po yin te/ de lta na longs sku thams cad kyang gcig la thim pa'am gcig nyid du 'gyur bas mu stegs pa'i thar pa bzhin du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /mdo las/107—171

klu yi rgyal pos sprin phung rnams/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas smon lam gyis/ /zhing rnams kun tu 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa'i smon lam gyi khyad par sna tshogs las zhing gi khyad par sna tshogs su bzhed pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / so sor rang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa don med du 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i zhing nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gsang ba zab mo khong du ma chud par zad pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sku 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas so zhes gsungs kyang / 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad gcig yin mi dgos pa bzhin du longs sku 'og min du sangs rgyas so zhes pa'i 'og min thams cad gcig yin mi dgos par shes par bya'o/ /'o na ji ltar zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dbang phyug chen po'i gnas na 'dug pa des zhing khams yongs su sbyangs pa la sogs pa'i mthus de nas tshe 'phos ma thag tu dper na bsam gtan bzhi par lha dang gzhal yas khang lhan cig 'byung ba ltar rang gi zhing 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba/bai ḍūr+ya dang / pad ma rā ga dang / shel la sogs pa'i rang bzhin can/lag mthil ltar mnyam pa shin tu yangs pa/ reg na 'jam pa/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa'i phreng ba mtha' yas pa tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa dri bsung ngad zhim pas khyab pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs g.yur za zhing ldem pa/ mtsho dang / rdzing bu dang / lteng ka la sogs pa yid 'phrog pa du mas mdzes pa/ smon lam tsam las grub pa'i chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrogs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i mdog can gyi byi'u dang /187—172

bung ba dang / ri dwags la sogs pa sems can du snang ba khyad par gyis nye bar mdzes pa/ rin po che mig mangs ris dang / gser gyi bye ma bdal ba dang /nye'i me tog sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa mig 'phrul gyi rnam pa lta bu khyad par mtha' yas pa dang ldan par gyur pa/ der sangs rgyas pa yin te zhes gsungs pa'i bar du gsungs pa ni legs par bshad pa chen por mngon no//gnyis pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dngos ni/ 'jug pa las/ gang phyir nam mkha' dri ma med la zla snang gsal bar gyur pa'i phyir/ /sngon tshe stobs bcu bskyed pa'i sa la khyod kyis slar yang 'bad gyur cing / /'og min du ni gang gi don du 'bad gyur go 'phang mchog zhi ba/ /yon tan mtha' dag mthar thug mtshungs pa med pa de ni khyod kyis brnyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje can de nyid srid pa mtha' ma'i byang sems su gyur pa de'i tshe rang gi zhing sbyangs pa las grub pa'i 'og min gyi zhing khams der smon lam legs par sad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshad med pas bskor nas sangs rgyas te / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'am/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad pas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs thams cad la de kho na nyid du yod pa dang med pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin par spros pa'i bag chags phra mo gang bud shing rlan med ltar zhen pa'i gsher dang yun ring mo nas bral ba gnyen po ye shes kyi me lce grangs med pa 'bar bas shin tu phra bar byas pa de dag /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 107—173

skad cig gcig gis legs par bcom ste/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa mngon du gyur pa yin la/ de dang dus mnyam pa kho nar slar gyi byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs kyi lus de nyid mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa sngar las mchog tu gyur te/nang gi rten 'brel gyis phyi'i rten 'brel khyad par du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nyid la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya la/ nyi ma dang de'i 'od zer bzhin du sprul pa'i sku yang de dang dus mnyam pa kho nar 'char bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /des 'og min du rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam sgom lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib pa kun bcom ste rnam grol lam thob pa'i chos kyi dbyings de ngo bo nyid sku dang / ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ye shes chos sku rnam mkhyen dang /mtshan dpes spras pa'i gang zag rang nyid longs sku dang / gdul bya'i grangs snyed kyi sprul sku thob pa bzhi dus mnyam pas sku bzhi cig car thob ste/ theg bsdus las/ yang ji ltar chos kyi sku 'di reg pas thog ma nyid du thob ce na/theg pa chen po'i chos ma 'dres pa la dmigs pa rnam par mi rtogs pa dang /de'i rjes las thob pa'i ye shes rnam pa lnga legs par bsgoms pas thams cad du tshogs legs par bsags pa/ sgrib pa srab mo zhig par dka' ba bshig pa'i phyir / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ting nge 'dzin de'i mjug thogs su sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba'i de dag gnas 'gyur ba de thob bo zhes dang / rnam bshad snying po rgyan las/ de nas skad cig gnyis pa la rnam grol lam skyes pa'i tshe shes bya ji lta ba la gnyis snang nub nas chu la chu bzhag tu song ba de'i gzigs pa'i ngor shes bya ji snyed pa thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar 107—174

mngon sum du gzigs pa de'i tshe shes sgrib zad par spangs pa dang / yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa dang / chos kyi sku mngon du byas pa dang / chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub zhes bya'o/ /sa bcu'i rgyun mthar gnas pa'i tshe mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku de nyid kyi rigs 'dra phyi ma chos sku thob pa'i tshe mtshan nyid lnga ldan/ yon tan lnga ldan/ nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku grub la zhes dang / sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i bye brag 'ga' zhig longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / dngos rgyu tshogs pa tshar gcig la rag las kyi 'brel ba grub pa'i tshul du thob par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sbyor bzhi bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i thob bya mthar thug ni 'bras bu chos sku'i ngo bo yin la/ nges tshig ni/ dharma ka ya zhes pa chos sku ste/ ka ya'i bying ni tsi tsa ye zhes pa bsags pa ste/ zag med kyi chos bsags pa'i sku zhes pa'am/bden gnyis las/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir/ /yon tan bsam yas kun rten phyir/ /rig pa'i rjes 'brang ngo bo'i phyir/ skyob pa rnams kyi chos sku yin / /zhes pa ltar rten byed pa dang / /ngo bo nyid du grub pa'i chos sku'o/ /de la gnyis su dbye ba/ gsum du dbye ba/ bzhir dbye ba/ lngar dbye ba rnams su gsungs pa las/ gnyis su dbye ba ni/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste / /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /zhes dang / zab pa dang / sna tshogs tshul gyis ston pa'o/ /zhes zab pa longs sku dang / sna tshogs pa sprul sku'o / /gsum du dbye ba ni/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes bya ste/ /sku gsum dag gis rang gzhan gyi/ /don 'di rten dang bcas par bstan/ /zhes rang don longs sku dang / gzhan 187—175

don sprul sku/ de gnyis ma'i rten ngo bo nyid sku dang gsum mo/ /bzhir dbye ba ni / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces ngo bo nyid sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ chos sku dang bzhir dbye'o/ /lngar dbye ba ni/ ngo bo nyid sku/ ye shes chos sku/ longs sku/mchog sprul rnam smin gyi sku/ skye bzo'i sprul sku rnam smin ma yin pa ste lngar dbye ba gcig dang / longs sku/ sprul sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku/ ye shes chos sku ste lngar dbye ba gnyis yod de/ dang po ni tshig gsal las/ gzhan dag ni sprul pa'i sku la rnam par smin pa dang / rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i dbye bas sku lngar ston par byed do zhes dang / gnyis pa ni/ legs bshad gser phreng las / slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ ngo bo nyid sku dang / chos kyi sku dang / ye shes kyi sku ste/ chos kyi sku'i dbye ba gsum dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa'i sku'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smon pa/ grangs med bskal pa rgya mtshor sgrub pa'i rgyu/ /tshogs pa'i 'bras bu bston du ga la zhig /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum nor bu'i gzings 'grub pas/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur/ /stug po bkod ces rin chen rang bzhin can/ /khyad par du mas yongs su 'phags pa yi/ /ngo mtshar gzhal du med pa'i zhing khams ni/ /rang gis yongs su sbyang ba nyid kyis thob/ /smon lam legs par sad pa'i sems dpa'i 'khor / /skar tshogs rgyas pa'i dbus na zla ba bzhin/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas 'od zer chen po'i dbang / /byang chub chen po'i rgyal sar mnga' gsol mdzad/ /187—176

ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i rno mtshon gyis/ /gnyis snang phra mo'i dra ba kun bcad pas/ /sgrib gnyis mi mthun dpung tshogs g.yul ngo las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad/ /bden gnyis ngo bo spros dang spros bral gyi/ /khyad par tha dad cig car su yis dpogs/ /spros dang bral la gnyis snang nub bzhin du/ /spros kun cig car gzigs pa'i ye shes mtshar/ /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bsil sbyin dbang / /rdul bral chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /bye ba ther 'bum gdul bya'i chu snod du/ /sprul pa'i snang brnyan cig car ston par byed / /ji srid srid pa stong min de srid du/ /longs sku sku bzhi nges pa lnga ldan dpal / /rme lus lus can mgon du rtag bzhugs pa/ byu nga/bsam bzhin bzhin 'dzum dbyangs skyas mngon par bstod/ /ces bya ba ni tshigs su bocad pe'i dbyangs kyis smon pa'o//gnyis pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam pas gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam par thar pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'chad pa dngos ni/ 'jam/ mgon rgyal ba gnyis pas/ khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi/ /tshul 'di rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos kyis//ji tsam brtag kyang blo yi yul min na/ /tshangs dang dbang po sogs kyis smos ci 'tshal / /mkha' lding dbang pos mkha' la bgrod bgrod nas/ /nam zhig rang stobs bri bas ldog 'gyur gyi/ /nam mkha' zad pas ldog par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /khyed kyi yon tan brjod pa'ang de ltar lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thugs rje can gyi gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa'i 107—177

tshul rnams sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na las gzhan sa la gnas pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnam thar brgyad la dbang thob pa dag gis kyang ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa dang gleng ba'i go skabs bral na'ang / grangs la dga' ba'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ba dang / gtso bo'i dbang du mdzad de mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis su tha snyad mdzad nas gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang dam pa'i gsung las byung ba rnams phyogs su bsdebs pa'i tshul du cung zad bri bar bya ste/ de yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi grangs 'dren lugs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba byung ba'i tshul ni/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung du/ de la'ang rin chen phreng ba las/ snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa rnamasal/ /gshegs dang bltams dang rol pa dang / /khab nas 'byung dang dka' spyod dang / /byang chub ched du bdud sde 'joms/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /lha rnams kun nas babs pa dang / /de bzhin du ni mya ngan las / /'das pa ston pa'i mdzad pa yin/ /zhes lha las babs pa'i mdzad pa zhes pa gcig tu bgrangs te/ de yang sgra can zhes bya ba'i rgya gar gyi grong khyer chen por bcom ldan 'das kyis sum cu rtsa gsum du yum 'dul ba la byon nas mar lam be+e ḍūr+ya'i skas la byon pa la lha las bab pa zhes zer ro thabs la mkhas pa zhes pa la sogs pa'i mdo las/ dam pa'i chos nub pa la mkhas pa zhes chos nub pa'ang mdzad pa gcig tu gsungs te chos don du mi 'gyur ba na chos nub par bstan nas sems can la chos spong gi las mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir yin te/ gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /zhes so/ /kha cig na re/ dga' ldan nas 107—178

'pho ba zhes gcig tu byed pa la/ gzhan dag na re/ mi rigs te/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel par/ dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa ston pa'i sgo nas/ zhes pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel par yang / dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa kun tu ston par rung ba/ zhes pa dang /rgyud blar/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /zhes dga' ldan na gnas pa mdzad pa'i thog mar bshad pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ltar lags shing / re zhig 'dir ni rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang —/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang ske/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang ske/ /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang —/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bshad pa la/ grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / so so'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gong du smos pa ltar grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs rdzogs te sa bcu'i srid pa tha ma'i rten la 'og min du chos sku mngon du mdzad de slar yang chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du 'dzam bu'i gling du sprul pa'i zlos gar sna tshogs pas dga' ldan nas 'pho ba dang / lhums su zhugs pa dang / sku bltams pa dang / bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang /187—179

btsun mo'i 'khor rnams dgyes par rol ba dang / khyim nas nges par 'byung ba dang / dka' ba spyad pa dang / byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / bdud sde 'joms pa dang / sangs rgyas pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang /mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa rnams mdzad la/ de dag kyang dus lan cig tsam ma yin pa 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar yang dang yang du dang / mdzad pa po dang gnas kyang gcig tsam ma yin par dam pa tog dkar bye ba phrag brgyas 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar 'pho ba'i mdzad pa bye ba phrag brgya dus gcig tu bstan pa sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa'i rnam rol mtha' las 'das pa ni rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyis bstan to/ /gal te skye ba mngon par skye ba dang /zhes byung bas skye ba mngon par skye ba'i mdzad pa thog mar 'dren dgos so snyam na/lhums su zhugs pa dang bltams pa'i mdzad pa gcig tu byas te skye ba mngon par skye ba'i mdzad pa thog mar 'dren pa'i tshul kyang yod la/ gzhan dag de ni 'pho ba la sogs pa'i mdzad pa lhag ma rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi ston pa'i ched du gsungs pa tsam yin gyi bcu gnyis kyi grangs su mi 'dren par bshad pa'ang snang mod kyang / skye ba mngon par skye ba'i mdzad pa dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba'i mdzad pa gnyis 'dam ga can du gsungs pas 'dir dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i mdzad pa dang por 'chad do//gnyis pa so so'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa la/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i mdzad pa sogs lnga bshad pa/ rab tu byung ba'i mdzad pa sogs bdun bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ bskul nas gzigs pa mdzad tshul dang / lha 107—180

rnams kyis bshol btab nas lan mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bram ze khye'u bla ma nas tshe 'phos te dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar zhes bya ba skye ba gcig thogs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung nas rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya par thug gi bar dga' ldan gyi lha'i gzhal med khang yon tan dang rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par lha rnams la chos ston cing bzhugs pa'i tshe nyid kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra las/ bsod nams rgya chen tshogs mnga' dran rtogs dang / /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' sgyu rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /rgya chen dri ma med pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dri ma gsum spangs rgyag dang skyon zhi ba/ /dge ba dri med rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /sngon tshe ji ltar sbyin spyad dgongs par mdzod/ /zhi gnas tshul khrims brtul zhugs bzod pa dang / /dul dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab stobs/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig rnam spyad pa/ /spyod rigs cher byung dgongs mdzod dgongs par mdzod/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse mdzad gyur cing / /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig khyod kyis mchod/ /dgongs mdzod dgongs par mdzod cig grags mtha' yas/ /de'i dus lags kyi btang snyoms ma mdzad cig /ces sogs kyis bskul ba na gzhal med khang de nas byung ste chos kyis mtho ba'i khang bzang du seṅge'i khri chos bzang po zhes bya bar bzhugs te byams pa la sogs pa lha'i 'khor bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad 'dus pa la chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi mngal da 'jug pa'i lo bcu gnyis kyi gong na gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams rang 187—181

rang gi gzugs dang kha dog mi snang bar bram ze'i cha byad kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du lhags te 'og nas 'chad 'gyur gyi rnam pas mngal du 'jug na mtshan dpe dang ldan pa 'khor los sgyur rgyal lam/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes rig byed 'don du bcug cing / rang sangs rgyas rnams la lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' mngal du 'jug gi zhing 'di bor cig ces smras pa rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por mjug ma bsgyur ba zhes bya ba'i ri la rang rgyal glang po zhes pas thos te rdo la rkang rjes bzhag nas 'das so/ /de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya tsam gnas pa rnams phan tshun du 'dus te wa ra ṇa sir byon/da ste sangs rgyas myur du 'byon pas bdag cag gis 'gro ba'i don bya mi dgos so snyam ste phung po lhag med kyi dbyings su 'das/ gdung la rang byung gi me sbar te nam mkha' la song ba'i ring bsrel rnams sar lhung bas drang srong lhung ba zhes grags so/ /de nas dam pa tog dkar des lha rnams kyis bskul ba'i don rjes su dgongs te 'dzam bu'i gling du gzigs pa lnga la gzigs te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams rigs dman par mi skye ba bram ze dang rgyal rigs kho nar nges pa las da lta rgyal rigs btsun par bkur bas na rgyal rigs su nying mtshams sbyor ro snyam ste rigs la gzigs pa dang / gling gzhan gsum dang yul mtha' 'khob tu nam yang mi skye bar 'dzam bu'i gling dang yul dbus su skye bar dgongs te gling dang yul la gzigs pa dang / mi rnams kyi tshe 'phel ba'i dus na yid skyo bar dka' zhing / mar 'grib pa'i tshe yang ha cang snyigs pas gnas skabs de gnyis dang bral ba'i tshe lo brgya pa'i dus la gzigs pa dang / gang dag ma mes dang pha mes zung bdun gyi bar du spyod pa la skyon med pa'i rgyal po'i 187—182

rgyud la gzigs pa dang / bud med gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi yum du smon lam btab cing zla ba bcu mngal du 'dzin nus pa'i yum la gzigs so/ /rgyal po'i rgyud kyang mang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi yum du smon lam gyi mthu btsan po dang ldan pa'i bud med de lta bu'ang su zhig gam snyam ste 'khor rnams bgro bar byed pa las ma ga dha la sogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul chen po bcu drug po thams cad na rgyal rigs mtho ba ji snyed mchis pa rnams skyon dang bcas par mthong ste bsam pa na lha'i bu ye shes tog gi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi drung du dong ste 'dri bar bya'o smras pas thams cad kyang thal mo sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa' nyid la dris so/ /byang chub sems dpas grogs po dag /srid pa tha ma pa ni rigs btsun pa dang / mngon par shes pa sogs yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i rigs su skye shing / bud med yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa der zla ba nya ba skar ma'i rgyal po rgyal dang ldan pa'i tshe mngal du 'jug go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyis brtag pa na shākya'i grong du zas gtsang gi rigs 'di phun sum tshogs shing / lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma'ang yon tan de dag dang ldan par mthong nas thams cad kyis bsngags shing 'dug go/ /de la yab kyi gdung rabs gong du rgyas par bris zin la/yum 'di ni lhas bstan gyi rgyal po legs pa rab sad dang btsun mo lum bi ni gnyis la sras mo gnyis byung ba'i snga ma 'khrungs pa'i tshe ltas khyad par can byung zhing lha'i bzo bos bcos pa lta bu gzugs shin tu mdzes pa bi shwa kurmas sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul dang 'dra bas na ming sgyu 'phrul ma zhes btags/ mtshan mkhan rnams kyis de la mtshan dang ldan pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur bas de stobs kyi 'khor 107—183

los sgyur bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ bu mo phyi ma ni snga ma las lhag par gzugs mdzes shing btsas pa na 'jig rten thams cad 'od kyis khyab pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sgra grags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas ming sgyu ma lha mdzes dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang / lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma zhes bya bar grags so/ /de la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i bu zhig btsa' ste 'khor los sgyur rgyal lam sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan/ de nas rgyal po legs pa rab sad kyis shākya'i rgyal po seṅge 'gram la pho nya btang ste bdag la bu mo sgyu 'phrul ma dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo gnyis btsas pa mtshan mkhan rnams kyis de dang de lta bur 'gyur zhes lung bstan gyi/ 'di gnyis las gang 'os pa gzhon nu zas gtsang gi chung mar snoms shig ces bskul ba na chung ba sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas zas gtsang gi btsun mor blangs shing /rjes su che ba sgyu 'phrul ma'ang blangs so/ /de nas mtshan mkhan gyis ji ltar lung bstan pa ltar sgyu 'phrul mar bu stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i mtshan rtags dang ldan pa dga' bo 'khrungs/ chung ba sgyu 'phrul chen mo ni byang sems 'di nyid gang gi mngal du 'jug pa'i smon lam gyi mthu btsan zhing yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de ltar skye ba'i rigs la gzigs nas lha rnams la grogs po dag nga'i lus bsod nams brgya'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa la ltos/phyogs bcu na byang chub sems dpa' nga dang 'dra ba grangs las 'das pa la'ang ltos / zhes gsungs pa dang nyid kyi byin rlabs kyis phyogs kun na byang sems dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa 'di dang 'dra ba tshad med pa snang ste de dag 107—184

bdag nyid chen po de'i mthu yin par shes te ched du brjod do/ /gnyis pa lha rnams kyis bshol btab nas lan mdzad tshul ni/ de nas dam pa tog dkar des byams pa la sogs pa lha rnams la grogs po dag /dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste bsam pa mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /dang ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems rnyog pa can dang bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu dga' ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste lus shin tu sbyang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs chos snang ba'i sgo brgya rtsa brgyad bstan/rang gi cod pan byams pa'i dbu la bcings te dam pa khyed nga'i 'og tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes dga' ldan gnas kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ lha rnams la kho bo ni 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro bas khyed cag la ma pham pas chos bstan to/ /zhes gsungs nas 'byon par dgongs pa na dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu de dag byang chub sems dpa' dang 'bral bas yid gdung ste zhabs gnyis la 'jus nas skyes bu dam pa khyed mi bzhugs na dga' ldan gyi gnas 'di mdzes par mi 'gyur la/ 'dzam bu'i gling du 'od srung rdzogs byed la sogs pa'i rtog ge pa drug dang / bram ze rgyu rgyal la sogs pa'i rjes su sgrog pa drug /rang sa byed kyi bu lhag spyod la sogs pa snyoms par 'jug pa drug ste ston pa bco brgyad kyis sems can rnams ma rung bar byas pas gshegs pa'i skabs ma lags/'dir ni chos mnyan pa'i slad du bkur sti phun sum tshogs shing / chos bshad pa des kyang bdag cag la phan pa bsgrub par sems so zhes bshol btab kyang /dung gi sgras rol mo'i cha byad kun zil gyis gnon pa'i dpes ston pa bco brgyad nga nyid kyis zil gyis mnan nas chos kyi bdud rtsis 'gro ba rnams tshim par bya'o//107—185

kho bo ma'i mngal du ci'i gzugs kyis 'gro bar bya gsungs pa na/ kha cig gis bram ze khye'u'i gzugs kyis 'jug par rigs so zer/ kha cig gis brgya byin gyi gzugs dang / kha cig gis tshangs pa'i gzugs/ kha cig gis rgyal po chen po'i gzugs dang / de bzhin du rnam thos kyi bu'i gzugs dang / sgra gcan dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / dbang phyug dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / mkha' lding dbang po'i gzugs kyis 'jug par rigs so zer zhing / tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu gzi brjid dam pa zhes rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa des bram ze rnams kyi rig byed las byung ba'i gzugs glang po che dam pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa rigs so gsol bas/ de bzhin du 'jug par dgongs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gi khyim du snga ltas brgyad byung ste/ sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing khyim du rdul med la chag chag btab pa sbrang bu dang phye ma leb dang sdig sbrul med cing me tog sna tshogs kyis kun nas gang ba dang / gang / ri'i bya khu byug dang / ne tso dang / rma bya sogs khyim gyi stegs bur bag phebs par gnas te rang rang gi sgra skad snyan par sgrogs pa dang / skyed mos tshal dang kun dga' ra ba'i me tog rgyas pa dang /rdzing bu sogs la pad+ma 'dab ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang ldan pas khebs pa dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi sogs longs spyod kyang zad par mi 'gyur ba dang /rol mo rnams ma blangs par 'khrol ba dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi snod rang bye ste 'bar ba dang / nyi zla'i 'od zil gyis gnon cing lus sems bde ba bskyed pa'i 'od snang ba rnams byung ngo / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul yang khrus byas byug pas byugs rgyan gyis brgyan te bud med stong phrag bcus bskor zhing song nas rgyal po zas 107—186

gtsang rol mo bya ba'i khang bzang du g.yas rol na rin po che'i dra bas brgyan pa'i khri bzang po la 'dug nas gsol ba/ lha bdag bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad kyi khrims dang dge ba bcu'i lam la bde bar gnas te khang bzang bsil ldan dang skya ldan du mchi'o/ /bcings pa rnams bkrol ba dang / nor gyis brel ba'i mi rnams la nor stsol ba dang / dbul po rnams la zas skom dang / 'gro ba bde ba'i slad du shing rta dang / khyog dang bzhon pa sogs dgung bdun du stsol ba dang ske/ pho brang 'khor gyi skye bo rnams la 'thab rtsod dang khro ba'i tshig spangs shing /phan tshun byams pa dang phan pa'i sems kyis dga' ba'i tshal na gnas pa'i lha bzhin du bde bar spyod cing kun la sras gcig pa bzhin du gzigs par mdzod cig /rgyal pos de bzhin du gnang nas 'khor rnams la khang bzang gi steng du gdugs dang / ba dan dang / phreng ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / bdug spos dang ske/ byug pa dri zhim po/ go cha thogs pa sna tshogs kyis ngang skya ldan gyi mtha' bskor ba rnams gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma ngang skya ldan du song ste lha'i rin po che rin thang chen po'i khrir mal bshams pa'i steng na gtsug gi nor bu glod nas 'dug go/ /'dod gzugs na spyod pa'i lha mthu che ba rnams phan tshun 'di skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' gcig pu gshegs su gsol na bdag cag gis byas pa ma shes par 'gyur te/ khyed cag las byang chub sems dpa' lhums su gshegs pa nas mya ngan la sa 'das pa chen po bstan gyi bar du phan pa dang / byams pa dang / mnyen pa'i sems kyis zhabs 'bring du 'khod par spro ba dag mchis sam smras pas lha'i bu mang pos de bzhin du khas blangs so/ /'dod spyod kyi lha'i bu mo dag gis kyang sems can mchog dam pa 'di lta bu rum 187—187

du 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i gzhon nu ma de ji lta bu zhig gam snyam ngang skya ldan du lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma bltar dong ste mig tshugs su bltas shing phyag byas me tog gtor/ched du brjod de song nas lha mthu che ba rnams la sgyu 'phrul bsrung ba'i phyir bskul lo / /de nas byang sems dam bcas pa mi 'dor ba'i phyir 'chi 'pho ba'i dus kyi tshe phyogs bcu nas skye ba gcig gis thogs pa brgya stong phrag mang po dag dang /'dod spyod kyi lha'i bu mo dag mchod pa'i phyir sil snyan sgrog cing lhags so/ /byang chub sems dpa'ang lha rnams kyis kun nas blta ba'i khang brtsegs chen po bsod nams thams cad kyis yang dag par byung ba dpal gyi snying por bzhugs te 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis bskor zhing mdun du bdar te dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho bar brtsams so /gnyis pa lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' bde ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'od zer dgu la sogs pa 'od zer grangs med pa bkye bas stong gsum gyi mun pa sel zhing nyi zla'i 'od kyang zil gyis gnon pa dang /ngan song gi sdug bsngal rnams skad cig la zhi ba dang / sems can rnams la nyon mongs pas gnod pa med pa dang / lag na rdo rje phyi bzhin du 'brang ba dang / 'dul ba sna tshogs pa dag mthong ba sna tshogs pas mthong bzhin pa'i las de dag la sogs pa byed do/ /yum la khyad par du bya ba'i 'od ba spu'i sgo nas bkye ba yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lus la zhugs ma thag lus bde la rum nam mkha' ltar yangs par gyur/ glo g.yas par byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che'i bkod pa zhes bya ba tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi pa/ mdzes shing blta na sdug pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/107—188

steng khang pa brtsegs pas legs par brgyan pa'i 'phang du byis pa btsas nas zla drug lon pa'i tshad tsam pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa de'i nang na khang brtsegs gnyis pa dang / gsum pa yang de dang der ma reg pa sra zhing brtan pa be+e ḍūr+ya'i mdog dang ldan pa'i phye ma zho gcig la'ang stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyis rin du mi chog pa/ khang brtsegs gsum pa'i nang khri zlum po tshangs pa'i 'od kyang mog mog por byed pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i steng na mchog gi gdan la stong phrag brgya'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i gos phrug gcig kyang yod pa longs spyod kyi don du grub bo/ /der bsam bzhin du glang po che'i phrug gu thal kur mche ba drug pa 'od dang ldan pa'i gzugs kyis zhugs ma thag byis pa btsas nas zla drug lon pa'i tshad tsam mtshan gyis brgyan par gyur te byang chub sems dpa' zhing bcu'i rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa 'khod pa dag dang lhan cig tu khri stan la skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so/ /yum sgyu 'phrul chen mor rmi ltas bzhi rmis te/ stong gsum mthong zhing lha bye bas bstod de glang po che'i phrug gu rum g.yas par song ba dang / steng gi nam mkhar skyil mo krung gis 'chag pa dang / ri brag la 'dzegs te seng ge'i gdan la 'dug nas chos ston pa dang / lha dang lha min skye bo'i tshogs kyis phyag byed pa rnams so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' zhugs pa'i mod la yum lus dang sems bsam gtan la gzhag pa bzhin du dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang /nyams bde ba thob nas mal dam pa de las langs te rgyan dang gos rnams lhug por gyon/ bud med tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas khang bzang gi steng nas babs te shing mya ngan med kyi nags tshal ga la ba der song nas bde bar 'dug ste rgyal po zas gtsang spyan 'dren du mngags pa na/ rgyal 107—189

po khri bzang po las langs te blon po dang / grong rdal ba dang / 'khor dang /gnyen pa'i skye bo dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas mya ngan med kyi nags tshal du song ngo / /rgyal pos lus shin tu lci ba snyam byed nas nang du 'gro ma nus par nags tshal gyi sgor cung zad sems shing 'dug par gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha dag nam mkha' nas lus phyed mngon par sprul te byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan nas 'phos pa khyod kyi sras su gyur to zhes lung bstan pas/dgyes bzhin du thal mo sbyar zhing nang du zhugs nas nga rgyal dang dregs pa med par lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma'i ngor blta zhing 'dug go/ /sgyu 'phrul mas rmi ltas rnams lung ston pa'i bram ze dgug tu gsol bar bram ze mtshan dang ltas shes shing rnam par 'byed pa dang / rmi lam gzhung la mkhas pa drug cu rtsa bzhi bkug pa la yum gyis rgyas par bsnyad pas/ de rnams na re/ bdag cag gi rig byed dang sbyar na rmi lam dang po ni sras btsa' bar 'gyur te/ khyim na gnas na 'khor los sgyur ba dang / rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ de rdzu 'phrul che ba dang / gsum pa ni/ de 'khor bzhi la chos ston pa dang / bzhi pa ni/ de la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas/ rgyal po rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bram ze de dag bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / myang ba mang pos tshim zhing ngoms par byas nas so sor bkye'o/ /de'i tshe zas gtsang sgyu 'phrul ma khyim gang du nyon mi mongs par bde bar 'dug snyam du sems pa na de ma thag 'dod lha'i gtso bo rnams kyis ser skya'i gnas su rang rang gis khang bzang re re dbul/ zas gtsang gis kyang khang bzang gi mchog bshams pas byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 107—190

'dzin gyi mthus khang bzang thams cad du sgyu 'phrul ma re re mngon par byas so/ /de'i tshe yab zas gtsang gis ser skya'i sgo bzhir rin po che'i char dbab pas dbul ba rnams rgyun bcad cing / rgyal po'i bya ba btang nas tshangs spyod kyi dka' thub la gnas so/ /brgya byin dang / rgyal chen bzhi/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gsang ba'i bdag po rnams ni yum gyi phyi bzhin 'brang /u phu li la sogs pa lha mo bzhi pos ni rtag tu srung bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su tha mal pa ltar ma'i lus zungs kyis 'tsho ba ma yin par lhums su zhugs pa'i dus de nyid du sngon zhing dam pa la zas kyi phud phul ba'i rnam smin las 'jig rten 'di'i 'og gzhi chu'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas pad+ma'i sdong po chen po 'thon te rtse mo tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du 'phags pa/me tog kha bye ba'i ze'u 'bru la bdud rtsi'i snying po chags pa skyes te stong gsum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen pos mthong nas bai ḍūr+ya'i snod bzang por blangs te phul ba bzhes nas sku lus brtas par byed do/ /mi gang dag byang chub sems dpa' blta bar 'ongs pa de dag gis yum gyi lhums su khang bu brtsegs pa'i nang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mthong ba la dga' bar byed pa'i gsung stsol zhing / rgyal chen bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnams snga dro chos nyan pa'i phyir 'ongs par phyag g.yas pa brkyangs te stan ston par byed/ de rnams stan la 'khod nas 'dug pa na chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par dga' bar mdzad de 'khor de dag slar 'gro bar 'dod pa na phyag g.yas pa brkyangs te 'dong ba'i brda ston to/ /de bzhin du nyin mo brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha rnams byung zhing / phyi dro tshangs pas zil mngar gyi thig pa 'bul ba dang / nub thun 187—191

dang por phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'ongs pa na sku lus las bkye ba'i 'od rnams seng ge'i khrir sprul pa la de dag 'khos su bcug ste sngar bzhin phyag brkyang bskum mdzad de chos kyi brda'i sgo chen pos bgro bar mdzad de lha dang mi'i skye rgu khrag khrig sum cu rtsa drug smin grol la bkod par mdzad do/ /de la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsngags na/ rnyog bral chos kyi dbyings su sku bzhi yi/ /nyin byed dkyil 'khor gcig tu mnyam gdal yang / /sgyu 'phrul rol pa 'byams klas nam mkha'i sprin/ /'gro khams rgya mtsho'i rjes su mnyam par 'jug /stong gsum bye ba phrag brgyar 'dzam bu'i gling / /de snyed bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i tshul yang ste/ /cig car bye ba phrag brgya'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /bkod pa sgyu 'phrul rab 'byams sprin gyis bkab/ /rnam 'dren nyin byed skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi/ /kun gsal rnam par yangs pa'i dga' ston du/ /spro ba'i snga ltas bcu phrag khyung sngon skyes/ /lum bi'i tshal du thog mar bkram par gyur / /gzigs pa lnga yis 'dzam bu'i gling du ni/ /mngon par 'tshang rgyar 'byon du bzhed pa yi/ /dam pa tog dkar nyid kyi gtsug rgyan gyis/ /ma pham chos kyis mtho ba'i rgyal sar bskrun/ /de tshe zas gtsang khyim gyi do rar ni/ /bkra shis mtshan ma bkra shis tshom bur rgod/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo yum gyi dkyil 'khor yang / /stug po bkod pa gnyis par byin gyis brlabs/ /rdul gyi cha shas stong gsum nor bus kyang / /rin du bcal min sbrul gyi snying po yi/ /yongs su spyad pa'i bkod pa rab yangs kyang / /yum gyi lus ni gzhan du 'gyur ba min/ /tshangs pa chen po'i gos kyang mog mog por/ /byed pa'i khri stan mdzes par non pa yang / /byang chub sems dpa' nyid de de yi lus/ /byis 107—192

pa'i mtshan gyis lhums de skal bzang bsgrubs/ /yum gyi glo na'ang nor bu'i gzhal med khang / /der ni byang sems tshangs dbang lha klu'i 'khor/ /grangs med chos kyis smin par mdzad pa yi/ /sgyu 'phrul sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i glo na rtse/ /rab 'byams 'byams klas bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing / /gang gdul gdul bya smin pas gajo ba na/ sgo /thugs rjes rjes chags sprul pa'i snang brnyen gyis/ /sgyu 'phrul 'phrul sgeg lha mo'i lhumaso su zhigs/ /zhes bya ba ni tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyengs skyas mngon par bsngags pa'o//gsum pa sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' btsa' ba'i dus la bab pa na/ yab zas gtsang ma'i skyed mos tshal du me tog thams cad dang ske/ rdzing gi me tog dang / shing ljon pa gsar pa rnams kyang kha 'bus nas rgyas par 'gyur/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa'ang brgya byung / gter chen po nyi khri kha 'bus/ khyim gyi nang du rin po che'i myu gu 'thon/ spos chu'i dpal gyi wa 'bru mar dri zhim pos sbag pa 'dzag /gangs ri las 'ongs pa'i seng ge'i phrug gu dag dga' bar rtse zhing ser skya'i grong khyer la bskor ba byas nas sgo na gnas kyang sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed/ glang po'i phrug gu thal kur lnga brgya lhags te rgyal po'i rkang par sna'i rtse mos nyug /lha'i byis pa dag rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi khang pa nas khang pa dag tu 'dre ldog /klu'i bu mo mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i yo byad thogs pa lus phyed phyung nas nam mkha' la rgyu/ lha'i bu mo khri lag na rma bya'i mdongs thogs te nam mkha' la 'khod/ bum pa gang ba thogs pa khri'ang ser skya'i grong la bskor ba byed/ lha'i bu mo spos chu'i ril ba bh+riṅga ra klad la thogs nas 'khod/ lha'i bu mo khri gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan 187—193

dang ske/ ba dan thogs nas 'khod/ lha'i bu mo brgya stong mang po dung dang rnga sogs mgul nas dpyangs te sdod/ rlung dang rdul mi ldang / chu klung dang chu phran thams cad mi 'gul zhing mi 'bab/ nyi zla dang rgyu skar rnams mi rgyu/skar ma rgyal dang yang ldan/ zas gtsang gi khyim rin po che'i dra bas g.yogs/me'ang mi 'bar/ khang brtsegs dang / yang thog dang / rta babs dag la nor bu dang rin po che 'bar ba 'phyang / ras bcos bu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzod rnams gang nas sgo bye/ bya rog dang 'ug pa la sogs pa'i skad med/snyan pa'i sgra skad grags/ skye bo rnams kyi las kyi mtha' rgyun chad/ sa'i phyogs mtho dman du yod pa rnams kyang mnyam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo dang tshong 'dus kyi gzhi rnams me tog sil mas gang / sbrum ma rnams bde bar legs par btsa' bar 'gyur/ sa la'i nags tshal gyi lha rnams shing gi lo ma'i nang nas lus phyed phyung ste phyag 'tshal zhing gnas pa ste snga ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /de nas sgyu 'phrul mas byang chub sems dpa' btsa' ba'i dus la babs par shes nas grong du btsas na der lha rnams kyis mchod par mi 'gyur ba dang / shākya rnams kyang bag med pa skye bar 'gyur bas/ lum bi ni'i tshal dben par 'gro ba dang 'dug pa'i blo skyes te rgyal por gsol to/ /de'i tshe tshal der snga ltas kyi snang ba chen po byung ste/ sa'i steng gi rin po che'i khang bzang thams cad du snang ba byung ba dang / rin po che'i pad+ma kha phye ba'i 'dab ma thams cad las bltam mo zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od byung bas khyab pa dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras rnams kyis sems bskyed pa nas byang chub pa'i bar gyi snang ba la sogs pa bcu'o//de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas rang gi 'khor rnams la ser skya'i pho brang nas lum 107—194

bi ni'i tshal gyi bar lam thams cad byi dor legs par byas shing dri bzang gi chus chag chag gdab pa dang / me tog sna tshogs dgram pa dang / shing ljon pa rnams dus la ma bab par me tog dang 'bras bu skyes pa la gser dang nor bu'i rgyan dang / gos dmar pos legs par brgyan/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi bud med khri khrag mang pos glu dbyangs dang rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod pa dang / rin po che'i shing rta khri khrag mang po bshams pa dang / srung mar bskos pa'i dpa' bo khri khrag mang po phyogs phyogs su 'khod pa dang / shing rta'i mchog rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sogs byed du bcug nas sgyu 'phrul ma spyan drangs te sgo drung du phyin pa'i tshe srog chags brgya stong mang po 'du ba'i sgra bo che grags/ bkra shis kyi don du dril bu brgya stong yang dkrol/rin po ches brgyan pa'i shing rta der lha rnams kyis shing ljon pa la rma bya dang /khrung khrung / ngang pa la sogs pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ steng na lha'i gos dang /dril bu g.yer kha'i dra bas bkab cing / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan btsugs pa'i seṅge'i khri bshams pa la yum zhugs ma thag tu sa rnams g.yos / lha rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' las gos kyi g.yab mo 'byin/ me tog 'thor zhing de ring 'gro ba'i dam pa bltam par 'gyur ro zhes sgra dbyangs snyan par sgrog bzhin du shing rta de la blta'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhis shing rta 'dren / brgya byin ni lam gyi byi dor byed/ tshangs pas sel ba byed/ lha brgya stong ni phyag 'tshal zhing song ngo / /yum gyi shing rta'i rjes su rta dang / glang chen gyi shing rta dang / skyes bu srung ma go cha thogs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gis ni bskor cing bsrungs/ shākya'i bu mo stong phrag drug khris mdun du bdar/ sil 187—195

khrol dang glu len drug khris ni bskor/ lha dang klu dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang lha ma yin gyi bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gis glu dang bsngags pa brjod cing 'brang /rgyal po'ang ser skya'i gzhi nas shing rta dang / dpung gi bkod pa de la blta zhing sras 'di ni nges par sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro snyam du sems so/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul lum bi ni'i tshal du phyin nas shing rta de las babs te skra can ma dang /mi'i bud med rgan mo rnams dang / lha'i bu mo drug khri dang / skye bo'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing shing drung nas shing drung dang / nags tshal nas nags tshal du 'chags / ljon pa nas ljon pa la blta zhing rim gyis song ba dang / sa'i phyogs mnyam la yangs pa rtsa sngon pos gang zhing reg na bde ba na/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yum gyis brten pa gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis phyag byas pa'i shing rin po che mchog 'od zer 'bar ba/ rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga lo ma rnams rin po ches brgyan pa/ mi dang lha'i me tog sna tshogs rgyas pa/ spos mchog gi dri dang ldan pa/ gos kha dog sna tshogs dpyangs pa'i ljon pa'i rgyal po blag sha zhes bya ba dang / me tog gis brgyan pa'i mya ngan 'tshang dang / bkra shis pa'i shing sā la rnams skyes pa der song ba'i mod la byang chub sems dpa'i gzi brjid kyis shing ljon pa yal ga g.yur du za ba de dag gis mngon par btud de phyag byas so/ /de'i tshe lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas byung ba'i 'od kyi snang bas stong gsum gyi 'od ji snyed zil gyis gnon zhing ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa rnams zhi/ stong chen po'i 'jig rten lus su chud cing / 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i rgyal po'i gnas sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal gyi shing drung tha dad par yang lha mo sgyu 'phrul re re 'khod par snang / der yum gyis phyag g.yas pa 107—196

brkyang ste bya rmyong bar byed pa'i tshe rtsibs logs g.yas pa nas gser gyi mchod sdong nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa glo bur du 'thon pa ltar sku bltams so/ /tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis kyis ka shi ma'i ras kyis blangs/ dga' bo dang nye dga'/ gzhan (5nga lha dang lha mo bgrang ba las 'das pas spos chu'i bum pa thogs te sku khrus gsol ba na/ kau shi ka nga thong gsungs nas shar phyogs su gom pa bdun byon te dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs / de bzhin du lhor lha mi rnams kyi sbyin gnas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /nub tu nga ni 'jig rten na phul du byung ba'o/ /'di ni nga'i skye ba'i tha ma ste skye ba dang ske/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba mthar dbyung ngo / /byang du sems can thams cad kyi nang na bla na med par bya'o/ /'og tu bdud dang bdud kyi sde gzhom par bya'o/ /sems can dmyal ba pa thams cad kyi dmyal ba'i me gsod pa'i char sprin chen po'i char phab ste de dag bde bas tshim par bya'o / /steng du sems can thams cad kyis gyen du blta bar 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te phyogs rer gom pa bdun bdun byon pas gom pa re la pad+ma re re byung ngo / /gzhan yang brgya byin gyis yum ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pas mang po'i dkyil du bltam mi phod/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag nyid kho nas blang bar bya'o snyam nas rdzi char drag po phab ste 'khor gyi tshogs rnams 'byer bar byas shing /rang nyid ma ma rgan mo'i cha byad kyis mdun du 'khod/ tshangs pa'ang de na 'dug ste sngon gyi smon lam dang / lha rnams 'dun par bya ba'i phyir lpags pa'i sleb mos lag lcib byas te lha'i gos rin po che ka shi ma'i sleb mos blangs pa na byang chub sems dpas brgya byin gyi dregs pa 'a joms pa'i phyir sku rdo rjer byin 107—197

gyis brlabs pas brgya byin 'dang bar gyur te bzung bar mi nus/ tshangs pas kyang lha'i gos ka shi ma'i sleb mos blangs kyang 'dzin mi nus zhes kyang gsungs shing / byang chub sems dpa' gang du bzhugs pa'i sbrul gyi snying po'i khang bu brtsegs pa ni tshangs pa dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i gnas su khyer to/ /de'i tshe shing thams cad kyi me tog rgyas shing 'bras bu chags/ me tog gi char bab/ ngan song gsum rgyun bcad/ sems can kun la nyon mongs pas mi 'tshe/ dbang po med pa rnams dbang po dang ldan pa sogs bkra shis pa'i ltas phyogs thams cad du gang ba dang / yul chen po bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi la'ang bu btsas te/ mnyan yod du rtsibs kyi 'phur tshangs byin gyi bu btsas pa na yul pra phab pa gsal ba bzhin du snang bas de'i ming gsal rgyal zhes dang / rgyal po'i khab tu pad+ma chen po'i bu btsas pa na nyi ma'i gzugs shar ba ltar snang zhing / gzugs can ma'i bu yin pas gzugs can snying po zhes dang ske/ kau sham bhir dmag brgya pa'i bu btsas pa na 'jig rten nyi ma shar ba ltar snang bar gyur pas shar ba zhes dang / 'phags rgyal du mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten sgron mes snang ba lta bur gyur pas rab snang zhes bya bar btags te de rnams rang rang gi bu'i yon tan du rlom mo/ /shākya'i grong du bzang ldan dga' bo sogs ya rabs lnga brgya dang / shākya gzhan 'bum phrag lnga dang —/ 'dun pa la sogs pa 'bangs brgyad brgya dang / grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa shākya'i bu mo khri dang / 'dun ma la sogs pa bran mo brgyad brgya dang /rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag gi bu mo nyi khri dang / gser gyi 'od dang ldan zhing mdog dkar ba'i chibs pa bsngags ldan la sogs pa rte'u pho 107—198

mo nyi khri dang / glang po che mchog khri dang / ba glang pho mo drug stong rnams kyang btsas so/ /gser gyis brgyan pa'i glang po che nyi khri nam mkha' nas sgra 'byin cing ser skyar 'ong la/ zas gtsang gi mdun na 'don 'char po'i bu 'char ka yang skyes so/ /'dzam bu gling gi dbus su a shwat+tha'i sdong po dang / ma dros pa'i 'gram du u dum wa ra'i me tog dag kyang kha 'bus/ gling phra mo rnams su tsan dan gyi tshal dang / ri'i rtse mo rnams su byi ru'i myu gu dag kyang thon/ 'bab chu ro hi ta'i 'gram du shing dag pa'i snying po zhes bya ba nyi ma gcig bzhin khru brgyar skye bar 'gyur ba/ nyi ma shar ba de srid du sen mos kyang bcad du rung ba/ nyi ma shar nas mes kyang tshig tu mi rung ba rnams longs spyod kyi don du grub bo/ /lum bi ni'i tshal du pad+ma spungs pa lta bu'i mchod rten brtsigs te sku bltams pa'i mchod rten du grags so/ /yab kyis byang chub sems dpa' la phyag byas te ming 'dog par bsam pa na/ bu 'di btsas ma thag tu bdag gi don thams cad grub pas 'di'i ming don thams cad grub par gdags so snyam ste byang chub sems dpa'i ming 'di thog mar btags/ shākya gzhon nu rnams btsas nas ring por ma lon par lha khang du phyag bya ba yul chos yin pas der chas pa na shākya mu cor smra ba'i nang na 'du 'dzis dben pa thub pa bzhin du 'dug pas shākya thub par btags/ shākya 'phel gyis phyag btsal ba'am lha rnams kyis phyag 'tshal bas na lha'i lhar yang btags so/ /zhag bdun nas yum che'i dus byas te sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes te/ de ni byang chub sems dpas nongs pa ma yin gyi/sras mngon par 'byung ba gzigs na yum snying 'gas par 'gyur bas tshe tshad mthar thug pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe shākya rgan rabs rnams 'dus te gzhon nu'i 107—199
