yum ni nongs na/ 'di 'tsho ba'i ma ma yum dang 'dra ba su zhig ces bgros pa na/shākya'i bu mo lnga brgya tsam gyis khas blangs kyang / 'di dag ni byis pa yin pas gzhon nu'i rim gro bya bar mi nus zhes skye rgya'i bdag mo la gtad de/ bang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma brgyad/ nu ma bsnun pa brgyad/ rtse ba'i ma ma brgyad/ dri ma phyi ba brgyad de so gnyis kyis bskyed bsrings so/ /de lta bu'i cho 'phrul de ri bo gangs can na gnas pa drang srong nag po zhes pa mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa zhig gis tshor nas snag tsha mes byin dang bcas pas rdzu 'phrul gyis song ste ser skya'i gzhi nas byang chub sems dpa'i mthus rdzu 'phrul nyams nas pho brang gi chab sgo tshun du rkang kho nas song ngo / /drang srong gis sgo ba la 'phrin du springs pa na rgyal po rab tu dga' bas nang du bos nas bkur ste legs par byas/ gzhon nu ma ma'i pang nas blangs te drang srong la bstan pas/ kye ma 'jig rten du ngo mtshar ba 'di byung ngo zhes phyag byas/ pang du blangs nas ring po'i bar brtag ste/lha / mtshan mkhan gzhan gyis ji ltar lung bstan/ smras pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang / sangs rgyas su'o/ /lha/ rtog pa po de dag ni 'khrul pa ste/ rtsod dus su 'khor los sgyur ba mi 'byung bas mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba dang ldan pa 'di ni nges par sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te rang gnas su song ngo ske/ /phyi zhig na drang srong gis mes byin la khyod shar phyogs su 'dug la gzhon nus bdud rtsi nam brnyes pa na rab tu byung zhig ces bsgo nas dus 'das/mes byin ni ston pa'i nyan thos kā t+ya na yin par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa'i mdzad pa la/ dngos dang / 'phros don sgyu rtsal gyi dbye ba mdo tsam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhon nu don 187—200

grub dgung lo lnga par bab pa ma ma'i pang par 'dug ste gser gyi gzhong par 'bras dang shar bsres pa'i chan gsol ba na ma mas bkag kyang ma thub par rgyal por sbran te skye bo'i tshogs mang pos dbrog par brtsams kyang 'phrog ma nus nas glang po che lnga brgya la snod de btags nas daphrog par brtsam pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdzub mos gser gyi gzhong bar bzung nas bkug pas/ glang po che lnga brgya yang kha phyir bsgyur te dbrog par ma nus so/ /rgyal pos bsam pa/'dis mdzub mos bkug pas glang po che lnga brgya drangs par gyur na lag pa gnyis kyis glang po stong thub par 'gyur bas glang po stong thub ces bya ba'i ming bzhi pa'ang btags so/ /de nas bram ze mdun na 'don 'char pos 'khor bram ze lnga brgya dang bcas skar ma nag pa la bab pa'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gi drung du song ste/ gzhon nu'i rgyan mdzad par gsol ba bzhin du rgyal po dang shākya lnga brgya tsam gyis gzhon nu'i ched du rgyan gyi rnam pa lnga brgya tsam byed du bcug nas byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal bkod pa dri ma med pa na bzhugs pa skye dgu'i bdag mo'i pang du blangs nas/ thog mar shākya'i rgyal po bzang po zhes bya bas rgyan rnams byang chub sems dpa'i lus la btags ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i 'od kyis rgyan rnams mog mog por gyur to/ /tshal de'i lha mo dri ma med pa zhes bya bas rang gi lus mngon sum du bstan te 'di la ni mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rgyan rang chas su yod pas mdzes kyi/ bcos ma'i rgyan mi mdzes so zhes smras te mi snang ngo / /de nas bzo rig pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis sems can gyi don mdzad par dgongs pa na yab zas gtsang gis bskul nas dang po byis pa'i slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen nam ming gzhan srin bu go char grags pa de nyid yi 187—201

ge'i rigs thams cad la mkhas pa yin pas 'khor dang chas kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar ba du ma dang bcas de'i gan du byon pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brjid bzod par ma nus te kha sbub tu 'gyel ba dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu yan lag bzang pos bslangs te zas gtsang dang skye bo'i tshogs la/ byang chub sems dpa'i gong na slob dpon gzhan med mod kyi/ sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir yi ge'i grwar zhugs so zhes smras nas lha'i me tog gis gtor te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur/ de nas zas gtsang dang / 'khor gzhan rnams phyir dong ste 'khor byis pa khri dang / de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig par yi ge'i grwar zhugs nas/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po las byas pa'i yi ge'i byang shing lha'i tshon gyis byugs pa gser gyi yang mig gis btags pa tha ma nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa thogs te yi ge'i rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi las bdag la gang zhig slob gsungs pa dang / slob dpon gyis yi ge de dag gi ming tsam yang ma thos so zhes ngo mtshar du gyur nas nga rgyal dang dregs pa bsnyil te bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcas bsngags brjod tshig gi rol mo brgya phrag tu 'khrol lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyis yi ge bris te srin bu go cha la byin nas gsungs pa/ yi ge 'di'i ming ci yin smros shig /des gsol pa/ ma 'chal lo/ /gsungs pa/ 'jig rten na gnyis shig byung na yi ge 'di mngon par 'byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'khor los sgyur ba'o/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i tshangs pas smras pa / srin bu go cha/ byang chub sems dpas ji skad gsungs pa de de bzhin no zhes zer ro/ /yi ge'i phyi mo slob pa na byang chub sems dpa'i mthus a zhes pa lta bu yig 'bru re re brjod pa'i tshe nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sgo 707—202

brgya stong grangs med pa byung ste slob dpon dang / byis pa sum khri nyis stong bla med byang chub tu smin par byas so/ /dbyar zla ra bar bab pa na kha lo pa 'dun pas bskul nas shākya'i byis pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig zhing pa'i grong gzigs su byon te shing gi grib mar rang nyid gcig pu skyil mo krung gis rtsa'i stan la 'dug ste bsam gtan bzhi bsgrubs/ de'i tshe lho phyogs nas drang srong mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa lnga zhig kyang nam mkha' la 'phur te 'ongs pa tshal der thogs par gyur te brtag pa na/ tshal gyi lha mos 'di na shākya'i sras bzhugs so zhes smras pas / drang srong de rnams sa la babs nas phyag byas/ rang rang gis bstod pa'i dbyangs kyi me tog mngon par 'thor te nam mkha' las dong ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang gzhon nu med pas mi dga' ste tshol ba na nyi ma phyed yol du song nas kyang 'dzam bu'i shing gi grib mas nub phyogs su byang chub sems dpa'i sku la bkab pa mthong ba dang yab kyis/ thub pa gang tshe bltams pa dang / /gang tshe 'od ldan bsam gtan mdzad/ /'dren pa 'di ltar lan gnyis su/ /mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag mdzad/ de nas shākya rgan rabs rnams kyis gzhon nu 'di khab bzhes na 'khor sgyur du 'gyur bar lung bstan na da ni btsun mo blang bar bya'o zhes yab la gsol ba na/ gzhon nu nyid la dris shig ces dris pas dgung bdun pa la lan gsol to zhes smras te bsams pas/ 'dod pa ni dug gi lo ma dang 'dra ba sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa bar mthong ste mi sems mod kyi/ gzhan gyi log rtog sel ba dang / sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang btsun mo bsten pa dang / sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir thabs mkhas dang snying rje'i thugs kyis bud med kyi yon tan rnams yi ger bris te 'di dang 187—203

'di lta bu dang ldan na bgyi'o zhes springs pas/ rgyal pos mdun na 'don la khyod song la gang du bud med yon tan 'di dag dang ldan pa zhig mchis na rgyal rigs sam/ bram ze/ rje rigs dmangs rigs gang yin kyang rung gi/ /de la ni yid dga' bar 'gyur bas ltos shig /ces smras so/ bram ze des yul kun tu song song bas shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma mthong nas yi ge de sbyin pa dang des kyang bzhin 'dzum ste/ bram ze/ yon tan de dag kun bdag la tshang gi/ /phyi bshol ma mdzad par gzhon nu bzhed na bdag gis bgyi'o / /zhes smras pa dang / de mdun na 'don gyis rgyal por gsol bas/bud med de bdag nyid yon tan dang ldan par khas 'che bas yid ma ches te gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che sna tshogs yo byad yid du 'ong ba byed du bcug nas da ste zhag bdun na ser skya'i grong khyer gyi bu mo thams cad 'dun khang du shog cig /gzhon nus yo byad dag sbyin no zhes dril bsgrags so/ /dgung bdun nas gzhon nus 'dun khang du seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste bu mo rnams ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin yo byad dag byin zhing de dag gis kyang gzi brjid ma bzod par yo byad blangs shing myur ba myur bar phyir song ngo / /de nas sa 'tsho ma 'ongs pa na yo byad rnams sbyin zin par gyur pas de 'dzum mul te bdag gis nongs pa ci bgyis nas bdag la ngon snang mdzad/ gzhon nus rngan sdang min gyi khyod phyis pas lan no gsungs nas/ sor gdub srang brgya stong ri ba phud de byin no/ /de song ba dang bya ra ba dag gis rgyal po la gzhon nu sa 'tsho ma la spyan chags te bka' mchid kyang cung zad bgyis so zhes gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos shākya lag na be con can gyi gan du bram ze mdun na 'don pho nyar btang ste khyed kyi bu 107—204

mo gzhon nu la byin cig ces springs pas de na re/ gzhon nu pho brang na skyid de bar 'khrungs pa lags/ bdag cag gi rigs chos la bu mo sgyu rtsal shes pa la gtong ba lags na/ gzhon nu de ni sgyu rtsal shes pa'ang ma lags la/ ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phongs dang / stobs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs kyi tshul shes pa yang ma lags na bdag gis sgyu rtsal mi shes pa la ji ltar sbyin zhes zer ro/ /de bzlas pas rgyal pos nga la 'dis 'di dang lan gnyis su bsdos te/gang gi tshe ngas shākya gzhon nu dag /gzhon nu'i rim gro byed du ci'i phyir mi 'ong zhes byas pa de'i tshe ci nged lugs kyi rim gro byed du 'ong ngam zer la/ de'ang 'di skad brnyas so snyam ste sems shing 'dug go/ /de nas gzhon nus de thos nas rgyal po la cis nongs bka' mi stsol du mi rung ngo / /zhes lan gsum du smras pas rgyal pos don de bsnyad pa na sgyu rtsal 'gran par bzhed de rgyal pos kyang zhag bdun na gzhon nu rang gi sgyu rtsal ston gyi/ der sgyu rtsal shes pa rnams shog cig ces ser skya'i grong khyer chen por dril bsgrags so/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa na byang chub sems dpa' nyid dang skye dgu'i bdag mo'i sras gcung mdzes dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' las sor bzhis dma' ba mtshan dang ldan pa dang / zas dkar gyi bu bzang ldan dag skar ma rgyal la skyes pas rgyal lam legs pa'i skar ma'am rgyu skar bzang po zhes pa dang / bre bo zas kyi bu ming chen dang —/ ma 'gags pa dang / bdud rtsi zas kyi bu lhas sbyin nas skyes pa'i lhas sbyin dang / kun dga' bo dang / mdun na 'don gyi bu 'char ka la sogs pa tshan po che'i stobs dang ldan pa dag khyams su sgyu rtsal gyi phyir tshogs te/ sa 'tsho ma de dag thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du bzhag nas thams cad stobs 187—205

tshad de/ gang stobs dang sgyu rtsal phun sum tshogs pa des 'di khyer cig ces dam bcas so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i bzhon par glang po che dkar po bong shin tu che ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig khrid nas ser skya'i sgo na sdod pa gzhon nu lhas byin grong khyer nas byung ba dang 'phrad pas phrag dog dang shākya'i nga rgyal dang stobs kyis dregs nas lag pa g.yon pas glang po'i sna nas bzung / g.yas pas thal mo lan cig bsnun pas bsad do/ /de'i 'og tu gcung mdzes dga' bo byung ba dang / des glang po che de grong khyer gyi sgor bsad pa mthong nas/sus bsad dris par/ lhas sbyin gyis bsad do smras pas/ lhas sbyin de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so zhes de'i mjug ma nas bzung ste grong khyer gyi sgo nas gom pa bdun du bor ro/ /de'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa' shing rta la zhon te byung ba dang glang po de ltar bsad pa mthong nas sus bsad dris par/ lhas sbyin gyis bsad do smras pas/ lhas sbyin de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so/ /grong khyer 'di'i sgo nas sus bor/ mdzes dga' bos so/ /mdzes dga' bos de ltar byas pa yang legs na/ sems can 'di ni lus stobs chen po dang ldan pas/rul na grong khyer thams cad dri mi zhim pas gang bar 'gyur ro zhes shing rta la bzhugs bzhin du zhabs ya gcig sa la brkyang nas mthe bos glang po de blangs te ra ba bdun rim dang 'obs bdun rim las 'das nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol rgyang grags gcig tsam du 'phangs so/ /glang po de gang du lhungs pa'i phyogs de gshong chen po zhig tu gyur pa da lta glang po che'i gshong zhes grags/ de'i tshe lha mi brgya stong mang po e ma a la la zhes ca co'i sgra brgya stong bsgrags shing gos kyi g.yab mo 'byin/ nam mkha' nas lha'i bu dag gis kyang tshigs su bcad pa'i 107—206

bsngags pa byas so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang dang / kha lo pa rab bzang dang ske/ zas dkar dang / bre bo zas dang / bdud rtsi zas dang / seṅge'i sgra'i bu shākya'i rgyal po bzang po dang / legs pa rab sad dang / shākya rgan rabs dag dang / skye bo phal po che dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad par mthong bar 'dod de phyogs der dong ba dang / sgyu rtsal 'gran par 'dod pa'i shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam yang grong khyer nas 'dus/ thog mar yi ge'i slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen dpang por bzhag ste yi ge mkhas shing yi ge'i tshogs shes pa de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' yi ge 'gran pas shākya gzhon nu mtha' dag las khyad par du 'phags so/ /yang shākya rnams kyis yi ge'i shes pa la khyad par 'phags na'ang grangs kyi shes pa la khyad par ci yod 'gran par bya'o/ /zhes shākya srid sgrub ces pa rtsis pa chen po grangs dang rtsis kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhig yod pa de dpang por byas nas shākya gzhon nu gcig nas lnga brgya'i bar re re dang rtsis 'gran pa na/ shākya gzhan rnams kyi rtsis phug thug par gyur cing / byang chub sems dpa' ni rgya che bas zla med par gyur/ de nas yab zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa' la rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub grangs kyi shes pa la mkhas pa dang rtsis 'gran nus sam smras par/ rngo thog go gsungs pas/ srid sgrub kyis gzhon nu khyod bye ba las brgyar gong du bsgres pa'i brtsi lugs mkhyen nam/ gzhon nus smras pa bye ba phrag brgya na ther 'bum zhes bya'o / /ther 'bum phrag brgya na khrag khrig ces bya'o/ /khrag khrig khrag brgya na gtam pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ rdul phra rab la 'jug pa'i rjes su song ba'i grangs kyi bar bstan nas/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub 107—207

kyi snying po mchog dam par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ma gtogs sems can gyi ris na grangs de shes pa nga'am nga dang 'dra ba'i srid pa tha mar gyur pa ma gtogs gang yang med do gsungs pas/ rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub dang / shākya'i tshogs thams cad kyang tshim zhing ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob nas gos re re ma gtogs gos rgyan thams cad de la yon du phul te srid sgrub kyis tshigs su bcad par/ 'di ltar bye ba brgya na ther 'bum de bzhin du/khrag khrig dang ni gtams pa'i rgyud dang de bzhin du/ /dkrigs pa mi 'khrugs bdag gi shes thug de dor min/ /mtshungs pa med kyi mkhyen pa rtsis la nga bas lhag /ces bstod de shākya gzhon nu thams cad las khyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu rnams kyis 'di la stobs kyi khyad par ci yod sad do snyam nas gzhon nu lnga brgya'i nang nas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de las kyang gcung mdzes dga' bo dang / kun dga' bo gnyis kyis stobs brgal ba'i phyir drung du lhags pa na gzhon nu don grub kyis reg ma thag tu sa la 'gyel to/ /der shākya gzhon nu lhas sbyin de stobs kyi nga rgyal gyis snyems te brgal bas de yang gzhon nus phyag g.yas pas bteg nas nam mkha' la bskor te bor yang lus la gnod par gyur pa med do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas thams cad gcig tu 'dus te brgal ba gyis shig gsungs par/ thams cad nga rgyal gyis rlom zhing rub pa dang / gzhon nu'i phyag gis reg pa tsam gyis thams cad 'gyel bar gyur te/ lha mi brgya stong dag e ma a la la zer ba'i sgra chen po byung zhing /nam mkha' nas lhas me tog gi char chen po phab ste tshigs su bcad pa du mas bstod de khyad par du 'phags so/ /de nas shākya lag na be con can gyis shākya 107—208

gzhon nu de dag la/ 'di dag ni sad kyang zin/ mthong yang zin gyi/ da ni 'phong zhig bstan par gyis shig smras pa dang / kun dga' bos rgyang grags gnyis kyi pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs so/ /de'i 'og tu lha sbyin gyis rgyang grags bzhi'i pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs/mdzes dga' bos rgyang grags drug gi pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs / shākya lag na be con can gyis rgyang grags brgyad kyi pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig dang shing ta la bdun/ de'i pha rol tu lcags kyi phag rgod gzugs 'khrul 'khor du byas pa gcig btsugs so/ /de nas kun dga' bos rgyang grags gnyis kyi pha rol na btsugs pa'i rnga'i 'ben la 'phangs nas phog par gyur te/ de phan chod la ma nus so/ /lha sbyin gyis rgyang grags bzhi'i rnga'i 'ben la phog par gyur te/ de phan chad la ma nus/ mdzes dga' bos rgyang grags drug gi rnga'i 'ben la phog par gyur te/ de phan chad la ma nus/ lag na be con can gyis rgyang grags brgyad kyi rnga'i 'ben la phog par gyur te de phan chad la phog par ma nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' la gzhu gang dang gang byin pa de dag la la ni gzhu rgyud chad/ la la ni chag nas byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ grong khyer 'di na gzhu gzhan la la bdag gis bdungs bzod pa'am/ lus kyi stobs dang mthu bzod pa mchis sam/ rgyal pos bu yod de khyod kyi mes seng ge'i za 'gram zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i gnam ru da ltar lha khang na spos dang phreng bas mchod pa de ni sus kyang dgang pa lta ci bdungs par yang mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ lha de blang du gsol 107—209

sad par bgyi'o/ /de nas gzhu de blangs te 'ongs pa dang / shākya gzhon nu thams cad kyis nan tan gyi mchog gis bsgrims kyang gzhu de bdungs par yang ma nus na dgang bar lta ci smos te ma nus so/ /de nas gzhu de shākya lag na be con can gyis lus kyi stobs thams cad phyung ste/ gzhu de bdungs par brtsams kyang ma bdungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' la byin pas des blangs te stan las ma langs par skyil mo krung bcas te/ lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pa'i sor mo gcig gis bdungs so/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po thams cad du sgra mngos / kha ra grags te/ grong khyer gyi mi thams cad kyang 'di ltar ci'i sgra zhes phan tshun 'dri zhing skrag skrag por gyur to/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpas mda' blangs nas gzhu de dang sbyar te bkang nas 'phangs pa'i stobs kyis kun dga' bo'i dang / lha sbyin/ mdzes dga' bo dang / lag na be con rnams kyi rnga'i 'ben btsugs pa thams cad las thal nas rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol du bdag nyid kyis lcags kyi rnga btsugs pa dang / shing ta la bdun dang / phag rgod kyi gzugs 'khrul 'khor du byas pa las kyang thal te mda' de sa la zug nas mi snang bar nub par gyur te/ gang du mda' zug pa'i phyogs der khron pa zhig byung ba da ltar yang mda'i khron pa zhes grags so/ /de'i tshe lha mi brgya stong dang / shākya'i tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob cing nam mkhar 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang lha'i me tog gis 'thor cing mngon par bstod do/ /de bzhin du mchongs pa dang / lag rtsis dang / cis dang ske/ glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa la sogs pa'i lha dang mi las 'das pa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phags so/ /gnyis 107—210

pa 'phros don sgyu rtsal gyi dbye ba mdo tsam bshad pa ni/ mdzad bcu las/drug cu rtsa bzhi las brgal sgyu rtsal gyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ spyir sgyu rtsal gyi dbye ba mang yang bsdu na drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ mdo sde rgya cher rol pa las / mchongs pa dang / yi ge dang / lag rtsis dang / rtsis dang /grangs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs dang / rgyang nas rdzog pa dang / bang dang ske/ tshar dang / rkyal dang / 'phong dpyad dang / glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa dang / rta rtsal dang / shing rta'i thabs dang / mda' gzhu'i thabs dang ske/ brtan pa dang / mthu dang / dpa' ba dang / 'gyed stobs dang /lcags kyus sgyur thabs dang / zhags pa'i thabs dang / mdun du bsnur ba dang ske/ phyir bsnur ba dang / bzur ba dang / 'dzin stangs dang / gom stabs dang / thor tshugs dang / gcad pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang —/ gzhig pa dang / gshog pa dang / mi tshor bar phog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / sgra grags par phog pa dang / tshab che ba dang / cho lo'i rtsed mo dang / snyan dngags sbyar ba dang / lam dang / ri mo dang / gzugs dang ske/ gzugs kyi las dang / thab kyi dpyad dang / me'i las dang / rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dang / gar dang / glu dang / yi ge bklag pa'i mig 'or dang ske/ gtam dang / bzhad gad dang / rtsed mo dang / bro dang / sgeg pa dang ske/ phreng ba brgyu ba dang / rlung yab g.yab pa dang / nor bu tshon gyis bsgyur ba dang / gos tshon gyis bsgyur ba dang / mig 'phrul gyi cho ga dang /rmi lam gyi dpyad dang / bya'i skad dang / bud med kyi mtshan dang / skyes pa'i mtshan dang / glang po che'i mtshan dang / rta'i mtshan dang / ba glang gi 187—211

mtshan dang / ra'i mtshan dang / lug gi mtshan dang / khyi'i mtshan dang /shes gsal dang / sgra nges par sbyor ba dang / nga ro bsgyur ba dang / sngon gyi rabs dang / sngon byung ba dang / rig byed dang / lung bstan pa dang /nges pa'i tshig dang / yi ge lci yang dang / tshig sdebs pa dang / mchod sbyin gyi cho ga dang / skar ma'i lugs dang / grangs can gyi lugs dang / rnal 'byor gyi lugs dang / las kyi tshogs dang / bye brag pa'i lugs dang / nor gyi rig pa dang / phur bu'i lugs dang / chu'i lugs dang / lha ma yin gyi lugs dang / bya dang ri dwags kyi skad dang / gtan tshigs kyi rig pa dang /rgya skyegs kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / spra tshil gyi las dang / 'drub shur dang /brko gzhog dang / lo ma dra ba dang / spos sbyar ba la sogs pa'i sgyu rtsal 'jig rten pa dang lha'i dang mi'i las 'das pa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan yang slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis lung phran tshegs kyi 'grel par snga ma dang mi 'dra tsam zhig bshad la/ bye brag rtog byed las/bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu dang / rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad/glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/ gar gyi cha byad dgu ste drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad de/dang po ni/ yi ge/ lag rtsis/ grangs rtsis/ grangs rtsis chen po/ thor tshugs / gom stabs/ lcags kyu'i thabs/ ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa 'debs pa/ mda' bo che 'phen pa/ mdun du bsdur ba/ phyir bsnur ba/gcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/ rgyang nas phog pa/ sgra drag par phog pa/gnad du rdzog pa/ mi tshor bar pheg pa/ tshabs cher phog pa/ mchongs pa 107—212

dang ske/ gyad kyi 'dzin stangs/ bang / rkyal/ brgal ba/ glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa/ rta la zhon pa/ shing rta'i bzo thabs/ mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs / gyad stobs dang sum cu'o/ /de la yi ge ni/ dpang lo chen pos/yi ge'i ngo bo 'di bzhin te/ /brjod 'dod dbang gis rlung g.yos shing / /de yi gnas dang byed pa dang / /rtsol ba bskyed de dbugs dbyung ba/ /lhan cig yi ge'i gdangs rnams bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ ming tshig brjod pa mtha' dag gi gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs la byed cing / de'ang rang rgyu kun slong gi shes pa las skye ba yin te/ dpal chos kyi grags pa'i rnam 'grel lasal/ yi ge kun slong shes pa las/ /skye la shes pas sgra skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na bris pa'i yi ge'i gzugs rnams ni yi ge dngos min kyang /der btags pa tsam ste/ dper na bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs la sku zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /yi ge'i gzugs la spyir 'jig rten thams cad na yod pas tshad dka' yang / tshangs pa'i yi ge/ kha ro sti'i yi ge/ de bzhin du aṅga/ maṅga/yul ma ga dha'i/ bkra shis pa'i/ sor mo pa/ sha ka ni/ ya ba na/ bag le ba / ba ru sha /'gro lding ba/ ki ra ta/ lho phyogs pa/ drag shul can gyi/grangs kyi/ spyi'u tshugs pa/ rjes su mthun pa/ bru sha /ke sha /rgya/ phu na/hu na/ 'bring dang rgyas par bri ba/ rgyal/ lha/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding / ri dwags kyi 'khor lo pa/ khu skad shes pa/ sa bla'i lha/ bar snang gi lha/ ba glang spyod/sgra mi snyan/ lus 'phags po/ gdeg pa/ gzhag pa/ bsnan pa/ rgya mtsho/rdo rje/ springs pa/ lan gyi/ rnam 'thor/ rings med/ bstan bcos 187—213

bskor ba/ rtsis bskor ba/ gdeg pa bskor ba/ gzhag pa bskor ba/ rkang pas bskor ba/ tshig lan gnyis su gdab pa'i tshig gi mtshams/ tshig gi mtshams bcur brgyud pa'i bar/ bla thabs su bsnan pa/ sgra thams cad kun tu sdud pa/ rig pa dang mthun pa/ rnam par 'dres pa/ drang srong gi dka' thub spyad pa/ lha nges pa/ sar blta ba/ nam mkhar blta ba/ sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa/ snying po thams cad kun tu sdud pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyi sgra sdud pa'i yi ge ste yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi mdo rgya cher rol pa las gsungs la/ de dag las phal che ba ni bod du ma byung la/ bod du yod pa ni/tshangs pa'i yi ge lañtsa/ de la khong seng dang / sha chen gnyis/ de dang cha mthun pa dha ri ku'i yi ge rigs lnga/ lañtsa mgo gyen du gzed pa na ga ra'i yi ge /thur du bkug pa wartu ste klu'i yi ge //smi ra'i yi ge mi 'dra ba gsum/ de bzhin du bod yig la dbu chen nam gzab ma/ dbu med dam bshar ma/ de la'ang 'bru tsha/ tsheg bsgrig /zlum ris sogs yig gzugs kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang ngo / /gnyis pa rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad ni/ gar mkhan/ bro/rnga bo che/ rdza rnga/ rnga phran/ rdza rnga chen mo/ mkhar rnga/ pi wang rgyud gcig pa / rdza rnga kha gcig pa/ lcags kyi sil khrol/ mkhar ba'i sil khrol/ pi wang rgyud gsum pa/ rnga mu kun+da/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa/ pheg rdob dang / rol mo'i sgra/ pi wang / gling bu rnams so/ /gsum pa dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ bar ma/ drang srong / sa 'dzin/ drug ldan/ lnga pa/blo gsal/ 'khor nyan rnams so/ /bzhi pa gar gyi cha byad dgu ni/ sgeg pa/dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ drag shul/ bzhad pa/ 'jigs rung / snying rje/187—214

rngam pa/ zhi ba rnams so/ /yang shes bya rig gnas che ba lnga ni/ sgra rig pa/gtan tshig /bzo/ gso ba/ nang don rig pa lnga'o/ /de la sgra rig pa ni/brgya byin gyis mdzad pa'i in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa/ bram ze pā ṇis mdzad pa'i pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa/ tsaṇ+ḍa go mis mdzad pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa byā ka ra ṇa/ pi sha li byā ka ra ṇa/ sha kau ṭa ya na byā ka ra ṇa/ su man+t+ra byā ka ra ṇa/ pa tañdza li byā ka ra ṇa/ ma nu dzen+t+ra byā ka ra ṇa ste sgra mdo chen po brgyad ces 'phags yul du byung zhing / bod du ni pā ṇi/ dbyangs can sgra mdo/ tsaṇ+ḍa pa/ ka la pa rnams 'gyur ro/ /gtan tshig rig pa la mang du yod kyang / gtso bo phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun btus dang / chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ de dag las 'phros pa bsdus gzhung rnams so/ /bzo rig la/ lus ngag yid kyi bzo gsum gsungs te/ bris 'bur gyi lha bzo/yig bzo/ shing dang / lcags kyi bzo la sogs pa ni lus bzo yin la/bka' dang bstan bcos/ ming tshig gi brjod pa rnams ngag bzo/ thos bsam chisgom gsum dang / brtag pa rnam pa brgyad la sogs pa ni yid bzor gsungs sol/ /gso ba rig pa ni sman sbyor shes pa ste/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor ba brgyad pa dang / slob dpon dpa' bo'i sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa/ de'i 'grel pa kha che zla ba mngon dgas mdzad pa/ g.yu thog pas mdzad pa'i sman gyi rgyud bzhi sogs rgya bod kyi sman gzhung mang ngo / /nang don rig pa ni/ sde snod gsum sogs mngon mtho dang / nges legs ston pa'i mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rnams te/ rig gnas snga ma gzhan rnams las khyad par du 'phags so/ /gtan tshig rig pa dang / nang don rig pa ston pa'i gzhung 107—215

gnyis mi 'gal te/ tshad ma rnam 'grel lta bus gtan tshig rig pa dang nang don rig pa gnyis ka ston pa'i phyir te/ des thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa dngos stobs kyi rigs pas sgrub cing / nyams len dang 'brel bar 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag ni gzhon nu don grub kyi sgyu rtsal ston pa'i mdzad pa las 'phros te cung zad bris pa yin la/ rab 'byams shes bya'i rnam grangs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgyas par 'dod pa dag gis ni phyogs res ma tshim par gzhung don la zhib mor dpyad pa'i thos bsam gyis 'bad dgos te/ mgon po byams pas / rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes bzung dang / /bdag nyid kun mkhyen bya phyir de la brtson par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//lnga pa btsun mo khab tu bzhes pa'i mdzad pa ni/ shākya lag na be con can gyis byang chub sems dpa' sgyu rtsal phun sum tshogs par mthong ste rang gi bu mo sa 'tsho ma de dbul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong gi mchog tu sa 'tsho ma dbang bskur te de dag dang lhan cig rtse dga' la yongs su spyod cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe sa 'tsho ma de bag gsar gzhon nu bzhin du zhum pa dang / gdong sbed par mi byed pas skye bo'i tshogs kyis 'phya bar byed pa'i gtam de sa 'tsho mas thos nas mi rnams kyi mdun du dam pa rnams kyis kho mo'i spyod tshul rgya mtsho shes shing sdig pas dben la yon tan dang ldan na gdong ji ltar 'gebs zhes smras pa dang / zas gtsang dga' ste/ ras bcos bu rin po ches spras pa zung gcig dang / mu 187—216

tig gi do shal srang bye ba brgya stong ri ba dang / mu tig dmar pos spras pa'i gser gyi phreng ba rnams sa 'tsho mar byin te ched du brjod do/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las byed par spro ba'i lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba du ma de dag rang rang gi dga' ba'i sgra 'byin zhing lhags par gyur to / /dus gzhan zhig na lha klu dag skyes bu dam pa 'di ni btsun mo'i 'khor du yun ring por bzhugs na snod du gyur pa'i sems can rnams med par gyur nas mngon par 'byung bar mi 'gyur grang snyam zhing gus pa dang bcas/ zhe sa dang bcas par thal mo sbyar te byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal nas/ nam zhig na bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' dam pa mchog rab tu dag pa 'di mngon par byung ba dang / mngon par byung nas kyang shing gi rgyal po chen po'i drung du 'dug ste bdud dpung dang bcas pa btul nas bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang ldan pa dang —/ chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor zhing / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa chen pos lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du legs par bshad pas tshim par byed pa mthong bar 'gyur snyam pa'i bsam pas 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams glu dbyangs dang sil snyan gyi sgra las chos kyi sgo rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di dag gis yang dag par bskul bar mdzad 187—217

de / rtag tu mgon med gyur pa'i 'gro ba 'di mthong nas/ /go 'phang mya ngan med mchog rdul med sangs rgyas te/ /skye dang rga dang sdug bsngal dag las grol lo zhes/ /dpa' bo khyod sngon smon lam de skad btab par gyur/ /de phyir dge myur grong khyer mchog 'di nas/ /byung la sngon gyi drang srong zhabs bcags pa/ /sa phyogs de ni rab tu mnan nas su/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes mtshungs med 'tshang rgyar gyis/ /khyod kyis sngon chad sna tshogs rin chen nor/ /rkang lag phangs pa'i lus kyang btang bar gyur/ /drang srong chen po de ring khyod dus 'di/ /chos kyi chu bo mtha' yas 'gro la phye/ /khyod kyi tshul khrims ma nyams dri med dge/ /sngon chad khyod ni rtag tu mchog gis brgyan/ /drang srong chen po khyod khrims 'dra ba med/ /'gro ba nyon mongs rnam pa mang las grol/ /khyod kyis srid pa brgyar ni bzod pa spyad/ /khyod ni 'gro bas ngan brjod rnam mang bzod/ /bzod pas bzod cing dul bas des pa'i bdag /rkang gnyis dbang po mngon par 'byung blo gyis/ /khyod brtson brtan zhing mi g.yo g.yo ba med/ /bde bar gshegs pa sngon mthar rgya chen gyur/ /g.yo can bdud ni sde dang bcas btul te / /ngan song gsum po mtha' dag skam par gyis/ /gang phyir khyed kyis brtul zhugs dka' thub spyad/ /dus ngan nyon mongs snyigs ma sregs gyis la/ /khyod kyis bdud rtsi chu bo'i char phab ste/ /mgon med ring nas skom pa tshim par gyis / /'chi med mya ngan med gnas sangs rgyas te/ /skom pas nyam thag bdud rtsis tshim bya zhes/ /khyod kyis sngon smras tshig mchog dran byas te/ /grong khyer dam pa 'di nas myur du phyungs/ /zhes sogs bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa brgya stong byung ste/ skyes bu dam pa de yun ring po nas chos dang chos smra ba 107—218

rnams la gus par gyur cing / bsam pa thag pa nas chos don du gnyer ba/chos 'dod chos tshol bas ngoms mi shes pa/ ji ltar thos pa'i chos yang dag par ston pa/ bla na med pa'i chos chen po'i sbyin bdag tu gyur pa/ zang zing med par chos ston pa/ chos sbyin pa la ser sna med pa/ chos la slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud dang bral ba/ chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub pa/ chos la nan tan byed pa la dpa' ba/ chos la gnas su 'dzin pa/ chos la skyabs su 'dzin pa/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pas nges par 'byung ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa ste/ thabs la mkhas pas rtogs par khong du chud pa yin pas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug kyang chos mnyan cing yid la byed pa dang ma bral lo/ /des bskul ba las byang chub sems dpas 'dod pa rnams kyi nyes dmigs dang / bdag nyid kyi smon lam dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / sems can smin pa'i dus rig nas/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis btsun mo'i 'khor smin par byas pa'i chos kyi sgo bzhi mngon du mdzad de/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byas pa'i mthus sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs dag las chos kyi sgo brgya stong btsun mo rnams kyis thos par byas nas/bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / lha'i bu sbed pa sogs brgya stong byang chub tu smin par mdzad de/ bud med de dag gis kyang sngon gyi smon lam mthar phyin par byas so/ /bud med de dag las gang 'dod chags kyis gdungs pa de la byang chub sems dpa' nyid dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa sprul nas dga' mgur spyod kyi/byang chub sems dpa' ni bsam gtan gyi dga' bas gnas so/ /de ltar bud med de rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba smin par bya ba dang / rol sgras sangs rgyas 107—219

rnams la mchod pa dang / shin tu phra ba ston pa la sogs pa las rnam pa bcu'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor ston par mdzad do/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bsngags na/ bcu drug zung ldan dge mtshan 'dzum bag gis / /zas gtsang skyed mos tshal gyi bzhin ras rgyas/ /lha mi'i dbang pos mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ /der ni rgyal ba'i yum la sri zhu bskrun/ /chu 'dzin rum rgya las ni nyin byed bzhin/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gcig nor bu'i gter rgya ni/ /lhar bcas skye rgya'i bsod nams 'dzin byed kyi/ /dpal du rgyal yum glo las thogs med sbyin/ /bkra shis thig ler rgod pa'i zhabs kyi mthil/ /reg pas kun bzod 'gram pa'i don ldan nyid/ /'di na nga nyid mchog ces bden pa'i dbyangs / /glal ba srid zhi kun tu mtshungs min nam/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'jig rten kun rmongs smag /gsod pa'i byed por sa gsum 'gengs pa dang / /lhan cig zas gtsang bsod nams yangs pa'i khab/ /dpag bsam 'byor tshogs khur gyis dud par gyur/ /gzi brjid nyi ma'i reg pa mi bzod pas/ /rnam sad rkang pas 'thung rnams thor tshugs 'dud/ /drang srong pags byi'i rdzu 'phrul gshog rlabs btul/ /gtum po'i srog chags 'byung bya'ang bag yod gyur / /rtsis dang yi ge gyad kyi 'dzin stangs sogs/ /phal gyi blo las 'gongs par su yis bsgrun/ /rtsol bas bsgrubs pa'i sgyu rtsal mkhan po dag /rtsol min rdzu 'phrul rlabs la 'gran pa blun/ /nags kyi bung ba ge sar rdzi ngad las/ /phyi sa'i 'dam du rtse bar ga la 'gyur/ /chags bral thub pa drang srong brtul zhugs las / /'dod pa'i 'dam du spro bar 'gyur ram ci/ /'on te pad+mo 'dam gyi khrod na rgyal/ /sems dpa' 'khor gyi dbus na 'gro don 'phel/ /de phyir 107—220

btsun mo sras dang slas bstan kyang / /bag yod bslab pa zhig par ga la 'gyur//gzo byin byin rlabs rlabs brgyar grol ba yis/ /ngo mtshar mtshar sdug sdug gu spungs 4pa'i 4sku/ sgo /'dzam gling gling mchog mchog gi dga' 4ston du/ ོ/rolo rtsed rtsed 'jo 'jo sgeg nyams bsgror rol/4 4/zhes bya ba yang tshigs su bcad sku'i debyangatho kyi rjes su bsngags pa'o//rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rab tu byung ba'i mdzad pa sogs bshad pa la bdun las/dang po khyim nas nges par 'byung ba'i mdzad pa ni/ de ltar btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig spyod kyang 'dod pas ma gos shing dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par mdzad nas mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab pa na yab zas gtsang gi rmi lam du/byang chub sems dpa' mtshan mo mi nyal tsam na/ lha'i tshogs kyis bskor te mngon par 'byung zhing / gos ngur smrig gyon pa rmis so/ /de sad pa dang rings pa rings par nyug rum la dris pa/ gzhon nu btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug gam/ lha bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du/gzhon nu ni gdon mi za bar mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur te/ snga ltas su snang ba ni 'di dag yin no snyam nas/ mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug ste/ da ni skyed mos tshal du nam yang mi 'gro bar bud med kyi nang na mngon par dga' bar bya'o snyam nas gzhon nu'i longs spyod kyi phyir/ dpyid dang / dbyar dang / ston gyi dus ji lta ba bzhin du khang bzang bsil ba dang / ran pa dang / dro ba gsum byed du bcug ste/ khang bzang re re'i gru skas rnams kyang mi lnga brgyaralnga brgyas 'dzugs shing 'bebs pa rnams so/ /de'i tshe gzhon nu sus kyang ma tshor bar 107—221

mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur du 'ong ngo zhes pa'i sgra dpag tshad phyed du grags shing / ltas pa dang mtshan mkhan kun gyis kyang / gzhon nu ni chab sgo bkra shis pa nas mngon par 'byung bar lung bstan to/ /de nas rgyal pos bkra shis kyi sgo'i sgo 'phar chen po re re yang mi lnga brgya lnga brgyas 'byed cing gcod pa sgra yang dpag tshad phyed du grags pa zhig byed du bcug /'dod pa'i yon tan mtshungs pa med pa yang sbyor/ glu dang rol mo'i sgra dbyangs len pa dang /gar byed pa'i na chung dag kyang rtag tu bzhag par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ deng skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba'i shing rta myur du sbyor cig /de nas kha lo sgyur ba rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i gan du song ste don de gsol ba na zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi gzhon nu skyed mos tshal gyi sa bzang po blta ba'i phyir phyung na 'on kyang gzhon nu bud med kyi tshogs kyis bskor te dga' ba myong bar 'gyur bas/ mngon par mi 'byung ngo snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma byang chub sems dpa' la byams pa dang / rim gro byed pas da ste zhag bdun na gzhon nu sa bzang po blta ba'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi sar 'byung gi/ /der khyed kyis gzhon nu'i mig tu mi 'thad cing yid du mi 'ong ba thams cad sel zhing yid du 'ong ba dang / yul nyams dga' ba thams cad sbyor cig ces grong khyer du dril bsgrags so/ /de nas zhag bdun gyi nyin par grong khyer thams cad brgyan/ skyed mos tshal yang mdzes par byas te/ras bcos bu kha dog tha dad pa'i bla re bres/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis legs par brgyan/ byang chub sems dpa' gang nas 'gro ba'i lam de yang byi dor byas/ spos chus chag chag btab ste/ me tog sil ma chal par 107—222

bkram / pog phor nas bdugs/ bum pa gang bas mdzes par byas/ chu shing ljon pa bsgreng / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba dang / rgyan phreng dang chun po dpyangs/ dpung bzhi'i bkod pa byas/ g.yog 'khor yang gzhon nu'i btsun mo'i 'khor brgyan pa'i bya ba la brtson par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa chen pos grong khyer gyi shar sgo nas skyed mos tshal gyi sar byon pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi mthus gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis sprul pa'i mi rgan po gtugs pa/ 'khogs pa/ lus las rtsa rgyus 'thon pa/ so rgal ba/ lus gnyer mas gang ba/ skra byi ba/ sgur zhing 'khar ba la brten pa/ mthu zad pa/ mid pa nas sgra ngar ngar po 'byung ba/yan lag dang nying lag thams cad 'dar ba zhig gzigs nas shes bzhin du kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi rid cing nyam thag pa 'di lta bu ni su zhig gam / kha lo sgyur bas smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di rga ba'i sdug bsngal gyis non pa'o / /'di'i chos 'di rigs kyis yin nam/ 'on te 'gro ba kun la 'di ltar srid pa gang yin gsungs par/ kha lo sgyur bas 'di rigs chos dang yul chos gang yang ma yin gyi/ skye bo dar la bab pa kun la 'di 'byung zhing thar ba'i thabs gzhan ma mchis so zhus pas/ nga yang rga ba la gnas na rtse dgas ci zhig bya / shing rta myur bar phyir sgyur cig /slar song ste don de bsam par bya'o/ /zhes grong khyer du phyir zhugs so/ /dus gzhan zhig na/ bkod pa chen pos grong khyer gyi lho phyogs kyi sgo nas skyed mos tshal gyi sar zhugs pa dang / des lam ka na mi nad kyis nyen pa/ dmu rdzing can lus nyam chung ba/ rang gi gcin skyag tu bying ba/ mgon med pa/ skyabs med pa/ shin tu sha thang bar 107—223

dbugs dbyung zhing rngub dgos pa zhig mthong ste shes bzhin du kha lo sgyur ba la dris pa dang / kha lo sgyur bas smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di shin tu nad kyis btab ste/ nad kyi 'jigs pa nye bar mchis pas 'gum pa la thug pa'o/ /zhes gsol bas/ skyes bu mkhas pas 'di lta bu'i na bas nyam thag pa mthong nas rtse ba dang dga' ba'i las la ci'i phyir 'jug ces sngar bzhin shing rta sgyur te phyir yang grong khyer du zhugs so/ /yang dus gzhan zhig na bkod pa chen pos grong khyer gyi nub phyogs kyi sgo nas skyed mos tshal gyi sar zhugs pa dang / der lam ka na mi shi bar gyur pa/ khyogs la bzhag /ras kyi bla re phub/ nye du'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ kun kyang ngu zhing smre sngags 'don/ /skra bshig la mgo la sas 'thor/ brang brdung cho nge 'don cing phyi bzhin 'brang bar gyur pa zhig mthong nas yang byang chub sems dpas shes bzhin du kha lo sgyur ba la dris pas/kha lo sgyur bas smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di ni pha ma mchis 'brang longs spyod mtha' dag dang bral te gum pa lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang sngar bzhin shing rta sgyur du bcug nas slar yang grong khyer du zhugs so/ /yang dus gzhan zhig na grong khyer gyi byang phyogs kyi sgo nas skyed mos tshal gyi sar zhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthus lha'i bu de dag nyid kyis lam ka der dge slong zhig mngon par sprul pa dang / byang chub sems dpas dge slong zhi ba/dul ba/ yang dag par bsdams pa/ tshangs par spyod pa/ mig phab pa/gnya' shing gang tsam du blta ba/ spyod lam mdzes shing / 'gro ba dang ldog pa mdzes la phun sum tshogs pa/ mdun du lta ba dang / g.yas g.yon du lta ba mdzes pa/ bskum pa dang smyang ba mdzes pa/ chos gos snam sbyar dang lhung 187—224

bzed thogs pa yid du 'ong ba zhig lam ka na 'dug pa mthong nas kyang byang chub sems dpas shes bzhin du kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba/ skyes bu sems rab tu zhi zhing gos ngur smrig gyon nas lag na lhung bzed thogs pa yid du 'ong ba 'di lta bu su zhig yin/ kha lo sgyur bas smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di dge slong zhes bgyi ba 'dod pa'i dga' ba spangs shing rab tu byung ba lags/ byang chub sems dpas de lta na bdag kyang rab tu byung bar bya'o snyam nas shing rta mchog de slar bsgyur te phyir yang grong khyer du zhugs so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' la bskul ba rnam pa 'di lta bu dag rgyal po zas gtsang mas mthong zhing thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir rwa ba rgya chen po byed du bcug ste/ 'obs kyis bskor/ sgo gtan dam po yang 'dzugs/grong khyer chen po'i sgo bzhi'i lam gyi sum mdo rnams su dpung chen po'i bkod pa bzhag ste bsrung du bcug go/ /de nas btsun mo sa 'tsho ma la ljon pa 'gyel ba dang ske/ cod pan lhung ba dang / bdag nyid yan lag chad cing sgren mor mthong ba dang / mu tig dang gser gyi 'og pag chad pa dang / rgyan rnams chus khyer ba dang / mu tig gi do shal chad pas rgya mtsho dkrug pa la sogs pa bcu gnyis rmis pa las sad ma thag tu sngangs te byang chub sems dpa' la gsol pa dang / byang chub sems dpas de dag ni khyod ring por mi thogs par skyes pa'i lus thob ste/ nyon mongs pa'i dra ba bcad cing lha klu sogs kyis mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i mtshan ma yin pas rmi ltas bzang po mis kyi bde bar nyol zhig gsungs/ de'i tshe ngang pa dang rma bya sogs khang bzang du 'dug nas sgra mi 'byin/ pad+ma rnams rnying / ljon 107—225

pa bskams/ pi wang rgyud chad/ rol mo sgra mi 'byin/ skye bo rnams gnyid kyis non/ glu gar la dga' ba med/ rgyal po zas gtsang yang yid skyo ba ste/mngon par 'byung ba'i snga ltas brgyad byung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang la ma sbran par mngon par 'byung na pha mas ma gnang bas mi rigs te byas pa gzo ba ma yin no snyam nas/ mtshan mo mi nyal tsam la rang gi khang bzang nas byung ste rgyal po'i khang bzang du phyin ma thag khang bzang thams cad 'od kyis gsal to/ /rgyal po mel tshe byed kyang gnyid log pa las sad de ci nyug rum nyi ma shar ram/ des gsol pa/ lha da dung dgung phyed kyang ma babs so/ /de nas rgyal po mi dga' bzhin bltas pa dang byang chub sems dpa' mthong ste mal nas ldang bar 'dod kyang ma nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yab la gus pa dang zhe sa'i tshul gyis 'dug nas/lha bdag mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab kyi mi dgyes pa dang gegs ma mdzad cig /rgyal po mig mchi mas gang bzhin du smras pa/ bu 'dir 'dug na bdag cag la phan thogs par 'gyur na dam pa slongs shig /gsol pa/ yab rga dang nad dang rgyad dang 'chi ba las thar ba'i dam pa slong ngo / /bu mi nus so/ /yang gsol pa/ dam pa de bzhi mi stsal na/ 'di nas nying mtshams mi sbyor bar mdzod cig /rgyal pos khyod kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig rjes su yi rang ngo zhes gnang bas/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan sus kyang ma tshor bar rang gi mal du 'dug go/ /de nas nam langs pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang mas shākya'i tshogs thams cad bsags te de'i lo rgyus rnams smos nas/ gzhon nu ni mngon par 'byung na da ji ltar bya zhes smras so/ /shākya rnams kyis smras pa/187—226

lha bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /shākya'i tshogs ni mang la/ de ni gcig pur gyur pas mthus mngon par 'byung ba'i nus pa de la ma mchis so/ /de nas shākya de dag dang rgyal po zas gtsang mas shākya gzhon nu 'thab chos sbyangs pa/ 'os su gyur pa / 'phong bslab pa/ tshan po che chen po'i stobs dang ldan pa lnga brgya byang chub sems dpa' bsrung ba'i phyir grong khyer gyi shar sgor bkod de/ gzhon nu re re la yang 'khor shing rta lnga brgya lnga brgya dang / shing rta re re la yang 'khor dpung bu chung lnga brgya lnga brgya bkod do/ /grong khyer gyi lho dang nub dang byang gi sgor yang de bzhin du bkod do/ /shākya rgan rabs rnams kyang lam gyi bzhi mdo dang ske/ sum mdo dang / lam po che mang po thams cad na sdod cing 'khod/rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang shākya gzhon nu lnga brgyas bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te / rta dang glang po che dag la zhon nas rang gi khyim sgo na mel tshe byed do/ /skye rgya'i bdag mo gi ta mis kyang rang gi bran mo'i tshogs la mar me bus la nor bu thams cad rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor thogs/ mu tig gi phreng ba dpyangs la khyim 'di 'od kyis gang bar byos shig /glu dbyangs gyis shig /sgo rnams chod cig /do mod mel tshe dam du gyis shig ces sngar bas kyang ches mang ba'i srung mas srung bar byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa legs par sems shing sngon gyi smon lam bzhi dran par mdzad de cung zad mnal ba na/ lnga rtsen la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya rnams gcig tu 'dus nas 'di skad ces smras te/ grogs po dag /do mod byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 'byung gi khyed cag de la mchod pa byed pa'i las la spro bar gyis shig /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang lcang lo can gyi 187—227

pho brang du zhugs nas gnod sbyin gyi 'khor chen po la smras pa/ grogs po dag /do mod byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 'byung gi khyed kyis bcibs pa'i rkang lag nas theg la 'byung bar gyis shig /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po dag /do med byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 'byung gi de la khyed thams cad mchod pa'i las la spro bar gyis shig /de na lha'i bu zhi ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba des 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag gis ni ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po'i skyes pa dang / bud med dang khye'u dang bu mo thams cad gnyid kyis log par bgyi'o/ /lha'i bu rtse ba bkod pa zhes bya ba des/ bdag gis ni rta dang glang po che dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo la sogs pa'i srog chags rnams kyi sgra mi grags par bgyi'o/ /lha'i bu bkod pa'i blo gros zhes bya bas/ bdag gis ni nam mkha'i dkyil na shing rta chen po bdun rin po che'i stegs bus 'khor bar bskor ba nor bu rin po che me shel gyi 'od 'bar ba gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba / me tog sna tshogs chal par bkram pa/ pog phor nas bdug spos sna tshogs kyis bdug pa dag byang chub sems dpa' gang nas 'byung ba'i lam du bkod par bgyi'o/ /klu'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu zhes bya bas/ bdag gis bdag nyid kyi sna la khang pa brtsegs pa dpag tshad sum cu rtsa gnyis pa bgyis te der lha'i bu mo dag bkod la sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs len du stsal zhing glu dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra chen pos byang chub sems dpa' la rim gro dang bsnyen bkur bgyid cing mchi bar bgyi'o/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis kho bos ni sgo dbye'o/ /lam mtshon par bya'o/ /lha'i bu chos spyod kyis bdag gis ni btsun mo'i 'khor 107—228

rnams mi sdug par bstan par bgyi'o/ /lha'i bu yang dag skul gyis/ bdag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' gzim mal nas bzhengs par gsol bar bgyi'o/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po chu lha dang / gzi can dang / rgya mtsho dang / ma dros pa dang ske/ dga' bo dang nye dga' bos/ bdag cag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan+dan gyi sprin mngon par sprul te/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma'i char dbab bo/ /de ltar lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis rnam pa 'di lta bu'i bsam pa nges par bsam ste brtsams so/ /skad cig de la lha'i bu chos spyod dang /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis btsun mo'i 'khor mi sdug par bsgyur te/ mi sdug par gnas pa dang / smad pa'i gzugs su bstan nas nam mkha' la 'khod de byang chub sems dpa' la btsun mo'i 'khor shin tu mi sdug pas bskor ba dur khrod dang 'dra bas gnas 'dir bzhugs na ji ltar khyed dgyes pa skye bar 'gyur te ci zhig bya/ zhes bskul bas/ byang chub sems dpas kyang yud tsam zhig na btsun mo'i 'khor rnams la gzigs pas/ btsun mo'i tshogs rnams gos lhungs/ skra zhig /rgyan kyang brul/ kha gdangs/ nu ma 'phyang zhing so yang 'khrig /rdza rnga la 'khyud pa ro dang 'dra ba gzigs nas mi sdug pa'i 'du shes skyes so/ /de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pas byang chub sems dpa'i thugs shes te bskul ba na/ byang chub sems dpas kyang bdag tshul 'di 'dra bas bsrung na ji ltar bya/ brgya byin gyis lha rnams kyis grogs bgyi'o zhes zhus pa dang / des thugs mnyes te nam phyed na nges par 'byung ba'i thugs dang ldan pas lus la lus su song ba'i dran pas gnas so/ /lha'i bu rnams kyang 187—229

da ji lta zhig snyam du 'dug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' skyil mo krung bshig ste / glu dbyangs len pa'i khang bzang chos bzang po zhes bya ba'i mal khri nas shar phyogs su gzigs shing bzhugs nas phyag g.yas pa'i rin po che'i dra ba smad de khang bzang gi steng du song nas sangs rgyas thams cad yid la byed cing thal mo sbyar / phyag 'tshal te nam mkha'i dkyil du gzigs pa na/ der lha'i dbang po mig stong dang ldan pa lha brgya stong gis bskor cing / me tog dang / spos dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / me tog gi rna rgyan dang / rin po che'i do shal gyi chun po thogs te/ lus btud nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa mthong / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi yang gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / klu'i tshogs kyis bskor cing go cha sra ba bgos te/ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung thung dang / mtshon rtse gnyis pa dang / rtse gsum pa lag na thogs shing tshul du shis par nor bu'i cod pan dang gtsug phud 'phyang ba byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa mthong /lha'i bu nyi ma zla ba gnyis kyang glo g.yas g.yon na 'dug pa dang / skar ma'i rgyal po rgyal yang nam phyed na shar ba gzigs so/ /de nas 'byon par bzhed pa dang /brgya byin gyis lngas rtsen la bsgo ba/ grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' steng gi khang bzang nas 'bebs kyi/ skas long zhig /des skas blangs pa la byang chub sems dpa' babs te/ 'dun pa ga na ba der gshegs pa na/ 'dun pa gnyid stug pos non par gzigs nas de sad pa'i phyir/ nga yi bkra shis 'di ni don kun 'grub/ /do mod gdon mi za bar don grub kyi/ /'dun pa phyi 187—230

bshol ma byed la gor du/ /rta rgyal rgyan gyis brgyan pa nga la byin/ /'dun pa mig phye nas mi dga' bzhin du tshigs su bcad par/ smin ma ring zhing pad ma'i 'dab ma rgyas 'dra'i spyan mnga' mi yi seng ge ston ma'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang ske/ /me tog ku mu da dang zla ba dang ni dga' ba'i pad ma'i rdzing bu gsar par 'jam pa'i pad ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal/ /sbyangs pa'i gser dang nyi ma shar ma thag dang zla ba dri med gzi dang mar blugs me yi 'od 'phro nor bu glog 'od 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ /glang po rgyags pa 'gying ba'i glang po'i stobs can pa lang khyu mchog ri dwags rgyal dang ngang pa'i stabs can stabs mdzes shin tu zhabs legs gang du bzhud/ /smras par/ 'dun pa gang gi don du nga yis sngon chad lag pa rkang pa mig dang de bzhin mgo dang lus btang zhing / /chung ma dang ni phangs pa'i rgyal srid nor gser gos dang rin chen gang ba'i shing rta glang po rlung mgyogs shugs ldan rta pho rtsal mchog ldan pa btang / /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang nas tshul khrims ngas bsrung bzod pa yongs bsgom brtson 'grus stobs dang bsam gtan shes rab dag /de lta mod kyi byang chub zhi ba shis pa thob nas rga shi'i rgya mor chud pa'i sems can nga yis yongs su grol ba'i dus la bab / /ces gsungs te lha'i bu nam mkhar 'khod pa dag gis ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong byung zhing / me tog gi char phab nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis kyang mngon par bsngags so/ /de nas lha'i bu zhi ba'i blo gros dang / brtse ba bkod pas ser skya'i yul gyi skye bo thams cad gnyid kyis non par byas/ byang chub sems dpas grong khyer gyi skye bo thams cad gnyid log pa dang / nam gyi dgung la bab ste mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab par rig nas 'dun pa la 107—231

deng skyo bar ma byed par rta bsngags ldan legs par brgyan cig ces smras pas/skad cig de nyid la rgyal po chen po bzhis byang chub sems dpa'i tshig thos nas 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang bcas rang rang gi gnas nas phyungs te/ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por bskor ba byas/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing rang rang gi phyogs su 'khod do/ /'dun pa yid gdung bzhin du rgyugs te/ grags 'dzin ma dang skye bo'i tshogs rnams la sbran pa dang /sus kyang ma tshor bas phyogs su bltas pa na/ brgya byin la sogs pa lha bye ba stong mthong nas/ lha de dag gis smras pa/ 'dun pa bsngags ldan legs par phul cig /byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i phyir ser skya'i gzhir lha mang po 'dug pa la ltos/ lha'i sil snyan mang po sgra sgrogs pas kyang grong khyer sad par ma gyur pas na chibs pa 'bul ba la skyo bar ma byed cig ces smras pa dang /'dun pas bsngags ldan la smras pa/ sems can kha lo sgyur ba 'di 'byon gyi rta skad sgrogs shig /bsngags ldan gyis kyang nges par 'byung bar shes nas cher 'tsher ba'i sgra rgyangs grags tsam du thos zhing rkang lag gser dngul dang nor bus spras pa sa gzhi la brdabs so/ /de nas 'dun pas gser gyi gdong zhur dang —/ rin po che'i tha gu sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'i sga srab kyis spras te/ byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba na/ lha rnams kyis kyang bsngags ldan la byang chub sems dpa' khur ba la ma skyo zhig phyin chad ngan 'gror mi lhung ngo zer ro/ /lha'i bu 'gram dang / nye 'gram dang / lo ma dang / lo ma gyon pa ste/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis chibs pa'i sug bzhi 'degs par bskos pa rnams kyis bsngags ldan btegs nas bskul ba dang / de'i dregs pa gzhom pa'i phyir byang 187—232

chub sems dpas zhabs bzhag pa dang bsgul ba yang ma nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan la bcibs/ 'dun pa yang 'phongs la zhon pa na byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang / lha rnams kyi mthus rta rin po che ni steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dang bral bar gyur pas pho brang na gnas pa'i lha rnams ngu ba'i mchi ma'i thig pa rnams lus dang sa la char bzhin du bab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pho brang gi nang nas yar 'phags te chos bzang gi khang pa btsun mo rnams 'dug pa ga la ba der byon nas sku thams cad kyis glang po che'i sta stangs kyis g.yas su gzigs te dgongs pa nga bud med dang lhan cig khyim du 'dug pa'i tha ma ni 'di yin no snyam mo/ /gal te shar sgo spangs te sgo gzhan nas byung na gzhon nus bdag la tha ma'i dus na yang ma bltas so snyam du rgyal po mi dgyes par 'gyur bas yab rgyal po'i gan du 'gro'o snyam nas shar sgor byon pa dang /rgyal po gnyid stug pos non pa gzigs nas zhabs la btud de bskor ba mdzad/bdag kyang yid la brtser ldan zhing / /bdag kyang nye du rnams la dga'/ /'on kyang 'khor ba rang bzhin ngan/ /'di mthong nas ni mchi ba lags/ /gal te rga nad 'chi ba lags/ /sdug pa'i gnyen bral las byung ba'i/ /gnod byed sdug bsngal ma mchis na/ /khyed ni spong ba su zhig bgyid/ /ces gsungs nas gshegs so/ /shākya ming chen phyogs der phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gshegs pa mthong nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i re ba don med do snyam nas mig mchi mas gang bzhin du grags 'dzin ma dang zas gtsang slong ba'i skad kyi sgra gsang mthon pos smras kyang ma thos te gnyid ma sad do/ /shākya ming 187—233

chen phu nu dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung la rang nyid kyis bzung bar ma nus shing / gzhan gnyid stug pos non pas ci bya gtol med de 'dug go/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' la skye bo rnams zhe mi sdang ba'i phyir lha rnams kyis gnyid log par bgyis nas/ dkar po'i chos don du gnyer ba dag bde ba rgya chen po 'di nyid spangs nas nam phyed na mngon par 'byung ba'i ngo mtshar ston par bzhed de bkra shis pa'i chab sgor byon pa na/ gzugs kyi lha rnams g.yas phyogs dang / 'dod pa'i lha'i bu rnams g.yon phyogs dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa gnyis mdun na gnas/ gzhan yang lha'i bu brgya stong dang gnod sbyin mang pos me tog gi char 'bebs shing gos kyi g.yab mo dag byed la brjod pa brgya stong sgrogs/ klu'i rgyal po sa sung gi bus rang gi sna la khang brtsegs sprul te mchod par bgyid/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa sogs kyis tsan+dan gyi sprin sngon sprul te sprul gyi snying po'i char phab/ lha'i bu bkod pa'i blo gros kyis shing rta rin po che bdun lam der bkod/ 'jig rten skyong ba gsum dang / lha'i bu bzhis bsngags ldan gyi sug pa btegs/ rnam thos kyi bu sngon du 'gro ba na brgya byin gyis chab sgo phye bas skar ma'i rgyal po rgyal shar ba de dang lhan cig khyim gyi gnas smad cing de la dga' ba'i sems can gyen du bskyed pa'i phyir dang / rab tu byung ba'i yon tan dang / rang la rag las pa ston pa dang / khyim gyi bde ba 'dod pa dag skyo bar bya ba la sogs pa'i mngon par 'byung ba'i las bcu mdzad nas gshegs te/ lha rnams kyi the tshom sel ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sku thams cad kyis g.yas phyogs su glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ser skya'i grong khyer la gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa yi/ /lam gyi mchog ni ma thob 707—234

par / /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ni slar/ /nga ni 'jug par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i tshe sa g.yos shing sku las 'od bkye bas ngan song gi sdug bsngal zhi/ skye dgu rnams nyon mongs dang bral bar mdzad do/ /brgya byin dang tshangs pa sogs kyis da ni gegs las thar gyi nam sangs rgyas pa'i tshe dgongs shig ces gsol pa las/ des kyang zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas shākya'i yul dang ske/ ke'u rta'i yul dang / gyad yul las 'das te me ne ya'i yul gyi grong rdal rjes su dpag pa nas kyang dpag tshad drug tu phyin pa spong byed yul gyi khron pa can gyi grong gi nye 'dab chu klung yid 'ong ldan gyi 'gram du byon pa dang nam langs par gyur to/ /me ne+e ya'i yul nas shākya'i yul gyi bar dpag tshad drug yod de/ dril bas dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi bar du byon no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bsngags ldan las babs te sa la 'dug nas/ lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs chen po slar bkye nas kyang 'di snyam du rgyan 'di dag dang rta bsngags ldan yang 'dun pa'i lag tu gtad de slar gtong ngo snyam ste byang chub sems dpas 'dun pa la bos te 'di skad ces smras so/ /'dun pa khyod song la rgyan 'di dag dang rta bsngags ldan khyer te slar logs shig /sa phyogs gang nas 'dun pa slar log pa der mchod rten brtsig ste/'dun pa slar log pa'i mchod rten zhes grags pa yin no/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ltar na gtsug phud kyang yod la rab tu byung ba zhes bya bar yang 'gyur snyam nas der ral gris gtsug phud bcad de bar snang la bor ba dang / de sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i phyir 187—235

blangs te/ gtsug phud kyi dus ston byed cing / der mchod rten yang byas te/gtsug phud blangs pa'i mchod rten zhes ming du chags so/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ rab tu byung yang gos ka shi pa gyon pa ji ltar rung gis gal te nags tshal gyi gnas nas tshul dang mthun pa'i gos shig rnyed na ni legs so snyam du bsam pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams byang chub sems dpa' la ngur smrig dgos par gyur to snyam nas lha'i bu gcig cig lha'i gzugs mi mngon par byas te/ rngon pa'i gzugs lta bus gos ngur smrig bgos nas byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du phyin pa na byang chub sems dpas grogs po khyed kyis gos ngur smrig rnams kho bo la byin na/ kho po'i gos ka shi pa 'di rnams kyang khyod la sbyin no/ /des smras pa/ gos 'di dag kyang khyed la mdzes la/'o ni rnams kyang kho bo la mdzes so/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ kho bos khyed la bslang ngo / /de nas lha'i bu rngon pa'i gzugs lta bu des gos ngur smrig rnams byang chub sems dpa' la phul te gos ka shi pa rnams kyang blangs so/ /de nas lha'i bu des mos pa bskyed de lag pa gnyis gas gos de dag blangs nas spyi bor bzhag ste/ de dag la mchod pa dang bkur sti bya ba'i phyir de nyid nas lha'i 'jig rten du song ngo / /de yang 'dun pas mthong bar gyur nas der mchod rten brtsigs te/ ngur smrig blangs pa'i mchod rten zhes ming du chags so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpas gtsug phud bcad nas/ gos ngur smrig rnams bgos pa de'i tshe/ lha'i bu brgya stong dag dga' zhing mgu la tshim zhing yid rang ste / kye grogs po dag /gzhon nu don grub rab tu byung ngo / /kye grogs po dag gzhon nu don grub rab tu byung ngo / /de ni bla na med pa yang dag par 107—236

rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur te/ sems can skye ba'i chos can grangs med pa dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral nas chos kyi dbyings la 'god par 'gyur ro zhes ca co dang ga zha'i sgra skad phyung ste/ sgra de yang gcig nas gcig tu brgyud nas 'og min gyi bar du grags so//gnyis pa dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sā la'i dpe med kyi grong khyer dka' thub kyi nags drang srong ngan spong gi bste gnas der byon to/ /de'i tshe drang srong ngan spong gi bu lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du chud pa gzigs nas rgyu mtshan dris pa dang / des gsol pa/bdag gi bsti gnas 'di na shing tā la rnams gser gyi lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu chags pa las/ da ni me tog dang 'bras bu rnams med par gyur pas sol/ /gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po/ gang gi mthus bsti gnas 'di na shing tā la rnams gser gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang 'bras bu ldan pa las/ de yid byung ste dka' thub kyi nags su gnas pas me tog rnams med par gyur to/ /gal te de dka' thub kyi nags su song bar ma gyur na/ skyed mos tshal 'di de'i yin par 'gyur bar zhig go /gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba de khyed kho na ma lags grang / gsungs pa/ de ltar nges so/ /de nas ngan spong gi bus byang chub sems dpa' thog mar gdan la spyan drangs shing me tog dang 'bras bu bstabs so/ /de ltar kun tu dgyes par byas pa dang / drang srong chen po/'di nas ser skya'i gzhir ji srid yod/ gsol ba/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis so//byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ ser skya'i gzhi dang nye bas shākya rnams kyis 107—237

'khrug pa byed par 'gyur gyi/ bdag gaṅga brgal lo snyam mo/ /de nas bram ze rigs ldan dang / bram ze pad+ma dang / drang srong nam gru dang / drang srong sgron me'i gnas su rim gyis byon pas de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' gnas par bya ba dang zas la spyan drangs so/ /de nas yangs pa can du byon pas/sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur de nyid 'khor gtso bo rnams dang / slob ma sum brgya dang lhan cig tu/ grong khyer yangs pa can du gnas bcas shing gnas te/de slob ma dag la ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi brtul zhugs dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa des byang chub sems dpa' rgyang ring po nas byon pa mthong nas ngo mtshar tu gyur te slob ma rnams la smras pa/ kye 'di'i gzugs la ltos shig /de dag gis de bzhin du blta bar byas te 'di ni ya mtshan che'o/ /de nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur ga la ba der song ste ring 'phur khyod las bdag gis tshangs par spyod pa spyod do/ /des smras pa/ kye gau ta ma/ dad pa'i rigs kyi bus gang la spyad na tshegs chung ngus kun shes pa thob par 'gyur ba'i chos bstan pa de lta bu la spyod cig /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid la mos pa yang yod/ brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab yang yod kyis/chos de nyid thob par bya ba dang mngon du bya ba'i phyir bdag gcig pu bag yod pa dang / brtun pas dben par gnas par bya'o snyam te/ dben par gnas nas / tshegs chung ngus chos de khong du chud cing mngon du gyur to/ /de nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur la khyod kyis chos 'di tsam zhig khong du chud cing mngon du gyur tam/ des smras pa/ kye gi ta ma de de bzhin no/ /gsungs pa/ kye kho bos kyang chos de mngon du byas shing khong du chud do/ /des smras pa/ kye gi 107—238

ta ma/ de bas na chos gang kho bos shes pa de khyed kyis shes la gang khyed kyis shes pa de yang kho bos shes te/ de bas na bdag cag gnyi gas slob ma'i tshogs 'di la bstan to zhes zer zhing byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa dam pas mchod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ji srid dga' ba'i bar du grong khyer yangs pa can du gnas nas/ yul ma ga dhar yul rgyu zhing yul ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por ri'i rgyal po skya bseng ga la ba der byon nas rtswa'i gdan la gcig pu gnyis su med cing grogs med par lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas bsrungs shing gnas so/ /de nas nang par sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzed thogs te chu dron can gyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs shing / slar ri'i rgyal po der zhugs pa rgyal po'i khab kyi mi rnams kyis mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te/ ci 'di tshangs pa yin nam/ lha'i dbang po 'am/ 'on te rnam thos kyi bu 'am/ ri'i lha 'ga' zhig yin nam snyam mo/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po yang ngo mtshar skyes nas rgyal po'i khab kyi ri skya bseng la rtswa'i gdan la byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i drung du/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po blon pos bskor bas zhabs la phyag byas te/ gdung ji 'dra ba zhig yin zhes gsol pa dang / rgyal po shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i grong / /mchog tu 'byor zhing rgyas pa thos gyur tam/ /kho bo'i pha yi ming ni zas gtsang yin/ /yon tan 'dod pas kho bo der rab byung / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa dang / gsol pa/ khyed la rgyal srid kyi phyed 'bul gyi/ bdag gi grogs mdzod la phyin chad ri'i sul dang rtswa'i gding ba la ma bzhugs shig /gsungs pa/ rtse mo sna tshogs yangs par gyur pa yi/ /lhun 107—239

po gangs can rlung gis bskyod srid kyi/ /nga yi blo ni thar pa la brten pa/ /'dod pa'i shugs kyis bskyod par mi nus so/ /gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs 'dir ci zhig don du gnyer/ gsungs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /gsol pa/ khyed bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa de'i tshe/ bdag la yang dgongs shig /de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsungs nas rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri dang ha cang yang mi ring bar drang srong rnams kyi bsti gnas der gshegs so/ /de na kun nas tshon dang / nag po can dang / 'char byed dang / dga' byed bu rnams gnas pa de dag spyod pa dang gnas pas bsam gtan la brtson par gnas nas de rnams gang gi tshe rkang pa gcig gis nyin thun gcig 'grong ba de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' thun gnyis su bzhengs so/ /de rnams gdung ba lnga'i sbyor bas nyin thun gcig 'dug pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas kyang sbyor ba des thun gnyis su bzhugs pas/ de rnams ya mtshan skyes te/ dge sbyong 'di ni chen po zhig go zhes smras pas/ dge sbyong chen po zhes grags so/ /de rnams la gsungs pa/khyed brtul zhugs 'dis ci zhig don du gnyer/ de rnams kyis so sor brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang bdud nyid don du gnyer ro zhes gsol pas/ drang srong 'di dag kyang slar ltung ba'i chos can yin gyi byang chub thob par mi nus snyam du dgongs so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ma thag rgyal po zas gtsang bu'i mya ngan gyis gdung nas byang chub sems dpa' btsal ba'i phyir pho nya btang ba las/ gzhon nu don grub rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod dang lhan cig bzhugs pa las/ rim gro ba med par rgyal po'i khab nas phyir byung ste 'khyam mo 187—240

zhes pa'i gtam ji lta ba ma yin pa'i 'chal pa dag thos nas yab kyis ser skya nas rim gro byed pa sum brgya btang ngo / /de bzhin du lhas bstan nas kyang legs par rab sad kyis rim gro byed pa nyis brgya btang ngo / /de ltar btang ba'i sum brgya po las kauṇ+ḍin+ya dang / rta thul dang / rlangs pa gsum ni rings 'phur gyi slob mar khas 'che zhing / nyis brgya po las/ ming chen dang bzang po gnyis ni rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi slob mar khas 'che'o/ /de gnyis kyang 'khor 'dre ba yin pas rings 'phur gyi slob ma gsum po yang phal cher lhag spyod dang lhan cig tu gnas te/ kauṇ+ḍin+ya sogs lnga la/ drang srong lnga sde zhes zer ro/ /de'i tshe ring 'phur 'khor sum brgya dang bcas pa yangs pa can nas rgyal po'i khab der lhags nas gnas la/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyang rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por gnas bcas nas slob ma bdun brgya dang lhan cig tu gnas te de dag la 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi brtul cizhugs dang mthun pa'i chos ston to/ /byang chub sems dpas thog ma'i slob dpon ring 'phur gyi drung du byon nas/ de las ci yang med pa'i skye mched yud tsam gyis thob par mdzad / 'dis kyang byang chub mi thob pas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod tshogs dang ldan pa/ tshogs kyi slob dpon/ grags pa mngon par 'dod pa/ skye bo mang pos mchod pa/ mkhas pa kun gyis shes pa yin na/ bdag de'i drung du song ste / brtul zhugs dang dka' thub brtsams par bya'o snyam nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod ga la ba der byon nas/ de las gdams ngag nod de byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dang / ye shes dang / sngon spyod pa legs par spyad pa'i 'bras bu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la 'dris pa'i khyad par dang / de 187—241

sems la dbang sgyur ba'i phyir bsam gtan la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa brgya stong thams cad rnam pa dang bcas/ bye brag dang bcas par mngon sum du gyur te lhag spyod la dris pa/ lam 'di las gong na gzhan 'ga' zhig yod dam/ des med do smras pa/ grogs po khyod gang du nges par 'byung ba'i chos de kho bos kyang khong du chud do/ /des smras pa/ de bas na 'dong /khyod dang kho bos tshogs 'di dag la rjes su bslab bo zhes byang chub sems dpa' don mthun pa dang / slob dpon gyi gnas su bzhag go/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang lam de mkhyen mod/ de gnyis la ma brten na de gnyis kyis mngon du byas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de dge sbyong gi ta mas ji ltar shes snyam pa'i the tshom sel ba'i phyir dang / 'dus byas kyi ting 'dzin snying po med pa dang / 'dis nges par mi 'byung bar bstan pa'i phyir de gnyis kyi slob ma mdzad pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas lam des byang chub mi thob par gzigs nas gshegs pa na / rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod las tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa'i lnga sde bzang po 'di snyam du/ bdag cag gis 'di'i phyir yun ring por btsal cing brtson par byas kyang mtha' dang mu khong du chud par ma nus kyi/ dge sbyong gi ta mas tshegs chung ngus khong du chud pas 'di'i rjes su 'gro'o snyam ste rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi drung nas dong ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i phyi bzhin 'brang ngo / /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ji srid dga' ba'i bar du rgyal po'i khab tu gnas nas lnga sde bzang po dang lhan cig tu yul ma ga dhar yul rgyu zhing song ba'i tshe rgyal po'i khab dang / ri ga ya'i bar na tshogs gzhan dag cig dus ston byed de/tshogs de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' lnga sde bzang po dang lhan cig tu 107—242

gnas par bya ba dang / zas la 'gron du bos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yul ma ga dhar yul rgyu zhing yul ma ga dha'i ri ga ya ga la ba der song ste ri ga ya'i rtse mo der byang chub sems dpas spong ba'i phyir gnas pa'i tshe sngon ma thos pa dang / sngon mi mkhyen pa'i dpe gsum mngon du gyur te/ dpe gsum po gang zhe na/ rgya cher rol pa las/ dge sbyong dang bram ze gang la la 'dod pa dag las lus dben par mi gnas 'dod pa dag las sems dben par mi gnas shing / de dag gi 'dod pa la dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la chags pa dang ske/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / 'dod pa la brkam pa dang / 'dod pa la yongs su gdung ba dang / 'dod pa la zhen pa gang yin pa de ni nye bar zhi ba ma yin la/ de dag bdag nyid kyis gnod pa byed cing lus la gdung bar byed pas / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa tsha ba myong ste/ 'on kyang de dag mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa/ 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du byed mi nus so/ /'di lta ste dper na skyes bu zhig me 'dod la shing rlon pa'i gtsub stan dang / shing rlon pa'i gtsub shing thogs la chur bcug ste gtsubs na des me 'byin par mi nus so/ /de bzhin du dge sbyong dang /bram ze de dag 'dod pa rnams las lus dben par mi gnas/ 'dod pa rnams las sems dben par mi gnas te/ de dag gis 'dod par dga' ba dang /'dod pa la sred pa dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / 'dod pa la brkam pa dang ske/ 'dod pa la yongs su gdung ba dang / 'dod pa la brkyal ba dang /'dod pa la zhen pa gang yin pa de ni nye bar zhi ba ma yin gyi de dag bdag nyid kyis gnod par byed cing / lus la gdung bar byed pas/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor 107—243

ba drag po mi bzad pa tsha ba myong mod kyi 'on kyang de dag mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du byed mi nus so snyam ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' la dpe mngon du gyur pa dang po'o/ /yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ gang dge sbyong dang / bram ze 'di dag 'dod pa rnams las lus dang sems dben par gnas kyang / de dag gis 'dod pa la dga' ba zhes bya ba nas me tshol ba zhes bya ba'i bar du thams cad snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ des shing rlon pa'i gtsub stan thogs la thang la bzhag ste/ shing rlon pa'i gtsub shing gis gtsubs na des me 'byin par mi nus so/ de bzhin du gang dge sbyong dang bram ze 'di dag ces bya ba nas thams cad snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du 'gyur bar mi nus so snyam te/ 'di ni sngon ma thos shing mi shes pas dpe mngon du gyur pa gnyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang gang dge sbyong dang /bram ze 'di dag 'dod pa rnams las lus dang sems dben par gnas shing /de dag gis 'dod pa la dga' ba zhes bya ba nas/ thams cad de bzhin du sbyar te de dag gis de ni nye bar zhi ba yin te/ de dag bdag nyid kyis gnod pa byed cing lus la gdung bar byed pas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa myong mod kyi 'on kyang de dag mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa/ 'phags pa ye shes mngon du mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du bya bar nus so/ /'di lta ste dper na skyes bu zhig me 'dod cing 'od 'dod pa dang / 'od tshol bar gyur la/des shing skam po'i gtsub stan dang / gtsub shing thogs shing thang la bzhag ste gtsubs na/ des me dbyung ba dang 'od 'bar bar byed nus so/ /de bzhin 107—244

du gang dge sbyong dang bram ze 'di dag ces bya ba nas/ tshor ba myong zhes bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin te/ 'on kyang de mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du bya bar nus so snyam ste/ 'di ni sngon ma thos shing sngon mi shes pa'i dpe gsum pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//de ltar byang chub sems dpa' mngon par byung nas zla ba gsum dang zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis ga ya'i ri'i rtse mor gnas te/ rkang gis rgyu zhing sde dpon gyi grong lteng rgyas ga la ba der gshegs pa dang / sa'i phyogs de dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa ljon pa'i shing gi tshang tshing 'khrigs pa chu klung nai rāñdza na lho nas byang du bsil bar 'bab pa/ 'jug ngogs bde zhing mtha' rgya che la 'bab stegs bde ba/gseng ma sngon pos bkram pa/ nye 'khor na spyod yul gyi grong yod pa gzigs nas 'di nyid du gnas par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas chu klung ne+e rāñdza na'i nub 'gram shing ljon pa zhig gi drung gding ba med pa la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs nas/da ltar ni 'dzam bu'i gling du snyigs ma lnga bdo ba/ log pa'i lam la brten pa/mu stegs kyi sdes gang ba/ thar pa ma yin pa la thar par 'du shes pa dag gdung bas yongs su gdung bar byed kyi/ ma la bdag gis kyang las kyi bya ba chud mi za bar bstan pa dang / lha bsam gtan gyi spyod yul can rnams 'dun par bya ba dang —/ mu stegs can rnams gdul ba'i phyir dka' thub drag pos spyod do snyam du dgongs so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer sde can gyi legs skyes ma sogs bcus byang chub sems dpa' der bzhugs pa lta ba'i phyir 'ong ste phyag btsal bsnyen bkur yang byas so/ /lnga sde bzang po la yang de dag gis rgya shug dang / 'bras dang til gyi 'bru dag phul lo/ /de nas mkha' khyab kyi bsam gtan la snyoms par 107—245

zhugs te 'dug pa dang / sku las rngul byung ba zags nas sa la lhung ba'i rlangs pa byung ngo / /zhal dang shangs kyi dbugs rngub pa dang 'jug pa 'gags te rgyun chad nas dbugs gyen du song ste dbu la tshor ba mi bzad pa dang / snyan gyi bu ga nas rgyu ba'i sgra drag po grags pa dang / dbugs thur du rgyug nas 'phyan yongs su rgyas pa dang / de nas kyang dbu la tshor ba drag po dang / khong du tshor ba'i zug rngu dang / sku la tsha ba'i gdung ba mi bzad pa skyes so/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu gcig gis byang chub sems dpa' mthong ste gzhon nu don grub 'chi ba'i dus byas so zhes smra'o/ /kha cig gis 'chi ba'i dus byas pa ma yin gyi dgra bcom pa bsam gtan la gnas pa rnams kyi tshul ni de lta bu'o/ /zhes smras nas lha de sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i nang du song ste lha mo sgyu 'phrul la gzhon nu ni 'chi ba'i dus byas so zhes brjod pas/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas / nam phyed tsam na chu klung nai rāñdza na'i 'gram du byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ba dang / des byang chub sems dpa' lus skams shing 'chi ba'i dus byas pa dang 'dra ba mthong nas mchi mas brnangs te smre ba/ lum bi'i tshal du bu btsas tshe/ skye ba tha ma yin zhes dang / drang srong nag pos sangs rgyas su / /lung bstan pa yang nyams gyur cing / /'khor los sgyur dpal ma myong na//bu gcig srog ni su yis sbyin/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ shin tu snying rje bar ni ngu byed cing / /skra yang bshig la mdzes pa rnams bor ba/ /shin tu bu yi smre sngags 'don byed la/ /sa steng 'dug cing 'gre ba 'di su zhig /lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyis smras pa/ bdag gi zla ba bcu bar du/ /rdo rje 'dra ba mngal du bcangs / /bu de'i ma ni bdag yin te/ /rab tu sdug bsngal rnam par smre/ /187—246

de nas byang chub sems dpas ma'i dbugs 'byin cing smras pa/ bu la byams pa khyod kyi ngal ba 'bras bu yod par byas/ ma 'jigs shig /sangs rgyas par bya ba'i phyir yongs su btang ba ni don yod pa ste/ drang srong nag pos bstan pa yang mngon du gsal bar bya'o/ /mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa yang mngon du gsal bar bya'o/ /sa ni rnam brgyar 'thor bar 'gyur yang srid/ /rin chen rtse mo lhun po chur 'phyo srid/ /nyi zla skar tshogs sa la lhung 'gyur srid/ /so so'i skye bo yin yang nga mi 'chi/ /de phyir 'di la mya ngan khyod ma byed/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub sangs rgyas mthong / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyis thos ma thag tu rab tu dga' ste ba spu g.yos nas byang chub sems dpa' la me tog man dā ra bas gtor te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas lha'i sil snyan dkrol zhing rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/dge sbyong dang bram ze kha cig zas chung ngus dag par sems pa yod kyi ngas kyang zas chung ngu la nan tan bya'o snyam nas rgya shug gi 'bru gcig pu gsol lo/ /de nas lha rnams kyis sku la mdangs bsgrub par gsol kyang ma gnang ste/ mon sran sde'u sogs kyi zhu ba cung zad cig gsol kyang sku sgom zhing bal chung bar gyur te/phyag gnyis kyis sku las rdul yogs pa rnams phyis pa dang / ba spu rul ba rnams sa la lhung ngo / /sku mdog gnag cing mi sdug par gyur pas spyod yul gyi grong na gnas pa'i skye bo nyen kor ba rnams kyis e ma'o dge sbyong gi ta ma ni gnag go/ /sngo bsangs so nya mang ku ra'i mdog 'dra'o/ /sngon 'di'i mdog mdzes pa gsal bar gyur pa de yang med par gyur to/ /zhes smras pa dang / de bzhin du lha gsum gyis kyang gi ta ma mdog nag po dang / sngo bsangs dang / dmar smug 107—247

go zhes brjod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas sngon ma gsan pa'i dpe gsum yang mngon du mdzad nas/ lam 'dis kyang byang chub thob par mi nus pas 'jig rten du bya ba rmad du byung ba bstan pa dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag dbye ba dang / tshogs gnyis kyi yon tan bstan pa'i phyir/ til dang / 'bras dang / sran ko la dang / rgya sran dang / mon sran gre'u dang / mon sran sde'u rnams 'bru re re gsol bar mdzad de rtswa'i gding ba la mnal bar mdzad do//de yang til 'bru gcig gis zas sku la mdangs yal bar ma gyur gyi bar du gnyis pa mi gsol lo/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / legs par rab sad kyis gzhon nu'i spyod lam ci 'dra ba rtog pa'i phyir nyin re bzhin pho nya lnga brgya lnga brgya btang ngo / /pho nya rnams kyis kyang gtam bskyal bar byed cing dka' ba spyod tshul rgyas par smras so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis de thos nas bu'i mya ngan gyis non pas mchi ma 'byin bzhin du btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas rtswa'i gding ba la nyal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dgongs te kha cig zas mi za ba mchog tu 'dod pa dag yod kyi/ bdag gis zas mi za bar bya'o snyam nas 'bru de rnams kyang spangs pa dang sngar bas kyang bcu 'gyur gyis skem zhing sku'i bal srabs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe grong de'i gzhon nu dang / phyug rdzi rnams kyis kyang gtam snga ma bzhin du brjod do/ /de ltar lo drug tu skyil mo krung bcas nas 'dug ste/ nyi ma las kyang grib mar ma song char rlung dang dgun dpyid kyi gdung ba la skyabs kyang ma btsal/ sdig sbrul kyang ma bskrad/ bshang gci dang mchil ma rnams kyang ma dor/ spyang bskums yang mi bgyid/ kha bub dang gan rkyal du yang mi gnas par 'dug go/ /de la mu stegs kyi rigs 'dul 107—248
