ba tha dad pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' chu 'thung ba tsam dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma'i thig pa tsam gyis 'tsho ba dang / zhag drug smyung ba dang /zas gtan nas mi za ba la sogs tha dad par mthong / byang chub sems dpas ni zas phal pa be'u'i lci ba dag kyang bzhes so/ /gzhon nu rnams kyis snyan gyi bu gar rtsa dang shing bal yang bcug go/ /de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang ba 'dus te se gol dang dbyangs gcig gis gsung pa/ bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ mkha' khyab kyi bsam gtan btang ngo / /bsam gtan de sems can gzhan sus kyang spyod par mi nus so/ /de ltar dka' ba spyad pa'i brtul zhugs lo drug po des lha dang mi khrag khrig phrag bcu gnyis dang / bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi theg pa gsum la smin par mdzad/ lha nas lto 'phye'i bar sde brgyad rnams kyis nyin mtshan du mchod cing smon lam 'debs/ lha dang mi gang dag rgya chen po la mos pa de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i khang pa brtsigs pa na 'dug cing bde ba myong bar mthong / lha dang mi chos bstan pas smin par mdzad pa rnams kyis chos 'ba' zhig 'chad par mthong / /sems can spyi mthun gyis ni dka' ba spyad pa sngar smras pa bzhin du mthong ste/ lo drug tu rtswa'i gdan la mi g.yo bar bzhugs nasal/ bzhengs bzhugs bzhed pa na kha bub dang gan rkyal du 'gyel lo/ /de lta na'ang dgun zla ra ba'i yar tshes brgyad la bzhengs te dur khrod chen por gshegs nas mi ro dbu rten du bcug /glo g.yas pa phab ste mnal bar mdzad/de'i tshe grong khyer gyi gzhon nu dang gzhon nu ma dang phyugs rdzi dang rtswa thun dang shing thun rnams lhags nas/ kye phyag dar khrod kyi sha za la ltos zhes sa dkar 107—249

gyis byugs/ mi gtsang ba dang / bang rdog dang / gsegs mas 'thor bar byed do/ /snyan gyi bu gar yang shing bal dkris pa'i rtsa dang shing bu btsugs nas zhal dang shangs kyi bu ga nas 'byin/ shangs nas zhal dang snyan du 'byin/zhal nas shangs dang snyan du 'byin no/ /de ciltar sems can dman pa la mos pa la sogs smin par bya ba dang / brtson 'grus mchog dag bstan par bya ba dang /bde ba lhur len pa rnams skyo bar bya ba dang / brtson 'grus rtsom pa la sbyor ba sogs rnam pa bcus dka' ba spyod par mdzad do/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon par bstod na/ dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo me tog 'bras ldan gyi/ /lang tsho'i rnam 'gyur dus las yol mi srid/ /mgon med skyabs su 'ches pa'i 'phrin las kyang / /dus las yol ba med par gzigs shing ston/ /mngon par 'byung dang bdud rtsi rtogs pa dang / /ring ba'i thugs ni rjes su mtshon pa'i slad/ /sil snyan rol mo dag gi dbyangs las kyang / /nyid kyi thugs bzhin nyid kyi mthu yis bsgrags/ /na rga 'chi dang mngon par 'byung ba dag /gzigs pa nyid kyang mgyogs 'gro'i chu gter bzhin/ /snying rje'i 'o mtsho lhag par bskyod pa yis/ /mngon par 'byung la rings pa'i thugs kyis myos / /ji lta ji ltar gzhon nu mngon dgyes pa/ /de lta de ltar yab ni lhag par gdung / /nyin mtshan go skabs med par dpa' bo'i dpung / /gzhon nu bsrung ba'i las la rab tu gzhol/ /'khor sgyur rin chen mdun du lding ba yis//gling bzhir dbang ba kho nar yab nyid sems/ /gzhon nu nyid ni sems kyi 'khor lo yis/ /mkha' khyab skyabs su bzhengs pa kho nar dgongs/ /dgung bdun nyid nas 'khor sgyur nyid 'gyur zhes/ /nyin mtshan sems pa bgrang bya 187—250

bzhin dub kyang / glang po pad+mo'i skud pas 'khyig 'dod bzhin/ /srid mtha'i sems dpa' 'ching re ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'khor sgyur dga' ston sang ni thob 'gyur zhes / /bag phebs nub der rgyal bu khyim las brgal/ /dpag tshad du mas bskal par ngur smrig gi/ /rgyal mtshan srid zhi'i gtsug tor dpal du bsgreng / /'khor sgyur srid las dge sbyong brtul zhugs spro/ /rin chen rgyan las ngur smrig mchog tu bgos/ /nor bu'i mdzod las bsod snyoms 'tsho bar dgyes/ /blon 'bangs 'khor las gcig pur nags su gzhol/ /dka' thub snying por zhen pa'i drang srong gis/ /khengs pa gcig car 'phrog byed dka' spyad kyis/ /rdo rje'i sku yi rang bzhin mtshon pa dang / /lhan cig grangs med 'gro tshogs sgrol bar mdzad/ /rgyal bu rgyal srid srid 'byor kun dor nas/ /dka' spyad dka' thub thub pa'i brtsol zhugaco brnyan/sgo /dus bzhi dus su su yis mi thezlog bzhino/ /gyegs stobaskyed thugs rjes rjes chags 'as 'di skyongags/4 4/zhes bya ba ni bar skabs su zigs su bcadi pa'i dbyengs kyis mngon par bstod pa'o//gsum pa byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpas spyod pa 'di dang sgrub pa 'dis mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa/'phags pa'i ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par gang yang mngon du ma byas te 'di ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin/ lam 'di ni ma 'ong pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang 'chi ba 'byung ba nus par byed pa ma yin te/ byang chub kyi lam ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba nus par byed pa gzhan zhig yod cing / sngon skyed mos tshal du 'dzam bu'i shing gi grib ma la 'dug ste/'dod pa rnams las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa 107—251

rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar du bsgrubs te gnas pa de byang chub kyi lam yin te skye ba dang / rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba rnams nub par 'gyur la/ de byang chub kyi lam yin pas ci bder dbugs 'byung rngub dang / 'bras chan dang kha zas rags pa za zhing lus kyi mthu stobs bskyed de gdod byang chub kyi snying por 'gro'o snyam du dgongs pa na lha'i bu gang dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i thugs shes te skyes bu dam pa zhal zas rags pa ma gsol cig /bdag cag gis ba spu'i khung bur mdangs stsal bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpas bdag ni zas mi za bar bdag nyid kyis dam bcas la/ bdag gi spyod yul gyi grong na gnas pa'i skye bo nyen kor ba rnams kyis kyang / 'di ltar dge sbyong gi ta ma ni zas mi za ba yin par shes te/ nga la mos pa'i lha'i bu 'di dag gis nga'i ba spu'i khung bur mdangs bcug par gyur na/ ngas shin tu brdzun smras par gyur to snyam ste rdzun smra ba spang ba'i phyir lha'i bu de dag gi tshig ma nyan par kha zas rags pa gsol bar dgongs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rags pa'i zas ma zos kyang 'tshang rgya bar nus mod kyi/ phyi ma'i byang chub tshol ba rnams la snying rje ba'i phyir dang / ci nas kyang bde bas chos la mngon par brjod par nus pa dang /bde bas ye shes rtogs par bstan pa'i phyir dang / dub pa'i mtha' spangs pa'i phyir dka' thub dang mnal ba las bzhengs nas/ chu klung nai rāñdza na'i ngogs su byon te 'jig rten dang mthun par sku khrus mdzad nas kha zas rigs pa bu ram gyi dbu ba dang / mon sran spe'u'i khu bcud dang / ha re ṇa ma'i khu bcud dang /107—252

zan dang 'bras chan dang 'dres mar bza'o zhes tshig tu brjod do/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas kyi sde dpon gyi grong khyer sde can na gong pa'i bu mo stobs sbed ma dang /shin tu sdug dang / de las rnam par rgyal dang / a ti muk+ta ma'i phreng ba can dang / mdzes ma dang / rdza byed ma dang / skra lcang lo rgyas dang / ral pa can dang / zhing pa dga' byed dam grong de'i ming gis sde can zhes pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma ming gzhan dga' mor grags pa/ yang de'i bu mo gnyis pa stobs ldan ma ming gzhan dga' stobs mar grags pa te bcu po de rnams kyis tshod ma'i bye brag rnams phul te bzhes so/ /byang chub sems dpas kha zas rags pa gsol zhing sku lus mar sar dang til mar gyis kyang byugs la chu 'jam pos kyang bkrus so/ /rim gro pa lnga sde des ma gus te dge sbyong gi ta ma 'di ni sdom pa lhod pa mang pos 'tsho ba spangs pa nyams pa yin te/ da 'di ltar gyur pas ye shes thob par mi nus snyam nas byang chub sems dpa' spangs te wā rā ṇa sīr drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su phyin nas lnga sde zhes bya bar grags la/ yul der gnas pa'i mes byin yang de rnams kyis smos 'drin du gyur to/ /de'i tshe sa 'tsho mas kyang dka' thub bor te zas rags pa za'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rim gyis spyod yul gyi grong du bsod snyoms spyad pas stobs rgyas te snga ma las mdzes pas dge sbyong mdzes pa zhes ming chags so/ /legs skyes ma'i bran mo grub mo zhes bya ba shi nas sha na'i ras kyis dkris te dur khrod du bor ba gzigs nas 'doms g.yogs kyi ched du de'i ras blangs par bzhed de zhabs g.yon pas mnan nas phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste bsnams so/ /sa bla'i lha rnams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid spangs te phyag dar khrod pa len pa ngo mtshar te/187—253

'di ni rmad du byung ba'o zhes bar snang gi lha rnams la bsgrags shing / de nas rim gyis rgyal chen ris bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'og min gyi bar du grags par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du phyag dar khrod pa 'di bkru ba'i chu zhig rnyed na dgongs pa la de nyid du lhas lag pa sa la brdabs pas rdzing bu zhig byung ste lag pa brdabs pa'i rdzing bu zhes grags so/ /yang bdag gi chu ni rnyed na/ gal te phyag dar khrod 'di bkru ba'i rdo leb zhig rnyed na dgongs pa la brgya byin gyis rdo leb phul bas der phyag dar khrod pa de bkrus so/ /brgya byin gyis skyes bu dam pa/ 'di kho bo la stsol cig dang kho bos bkru'o zhes gsol kyang / rab tu byung ba ni bdag nyid kyis bya bar bstan pa'i phyir brgya byin la ma gnang bar rang nyid kyis bkrus pas sku ngal te rdzing nas phyogs gzhan du 'gro dgongs pa la bdud sdig can phrag dog gi chos dang ldan pas rdzing gi 'gram du gad pa mthon po zhig sprul to/ /rdzing de'i 'gram na sgrub byed ces bya ba'i shing chen po zhig yod de byang chub sems dpas 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba dang lha mo la phan gdags pa'i phyir shing de'i lha mo la smras pa/shing gi yal ga mar smod cig /lha mos kyang yal ga 'dud pas byang chub sems dpas 'jus te yar byon nas shing de'i drung du phyag dar khrod pa'i na bza' drubs nas mnabs par mdzad do/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu 'od dri ma med pa zhes bya ba des/ lha'i gos ngur smrig dge sbyong gi tshul dang mthun pa dag byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas snga dro chos gos bzhes nas kyang spyod yul gyi grong du phyogs pa dang / grong pas bu mo legs skyes ma dang dga' stobs ma gnyis kyis rgyal po don grub 'khor los sgyur 107—254

bar lung bstan pa thos la/ bud med gang gis lo bcu gnyis su dka' thub blangs te rdzogs par byas nas 'o thug sbrang rtsi can gyis drang srong dka' thub kyis yongs su dub pa la phul na de'i khyim thab tu 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa yang thos nas lo bcu gnyis kyis dka' thub rdzogs la/ byang chub sems dpa' dka' thub la bzhugs pa thos nas nyin re bzhin du bram ze brgyad brgya la 'o thug dbul zhing / 'o thug 'di gsol bas yang na ni bdag cag gi zas zos te don grub 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /yang na rang nyid de'i btsun mor smon lam 'debs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi grogs bshes bram ze lhas smras pa / bdag nyid chen po de ni dka' thub kyi gdung ba spyad de bzhengs na/ de la thog mar bsod snyoms phul cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas bu mo gnyis po des dpyid zla tha chung sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ ba stong bzhes nas stong po de nyid la blud do/ /ba stong de nyid bzhes nas ba lnga brgya la blud do/ /tshul de 'dra bas nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / de brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / de drug cu rtsa gsum dang / de sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / de bcu drug dang / de brgyad la blud pa ste/ de ltar lan bcu drug tu nying khur byas pa bzhos te bzhag go/ /de'i nub mo nam phyed tsam na legs skyes ma la lhas khyod kyis smon lam btab pa bzang ba'i phyogs de de ring gyis shig ces smras ma thag langs nas 'o ma'i nying khu blangs te 'bras chan dang bcas pa shel gyi phru ba gsar par blugs nas/ 'o thug sbrang rtsi can bskol bar byed pa las/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams dang brgya byin gyis 'o thug 'di byang chub sems dpas gsol na de nyid du ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ro snyam nas de'i nang du sman mthu bskyed pa zhes bya ba blugs so/ /'o 107—255

ma rab tu khol ba'i rlangs par 'khor lo dang bum pa dang bkra shis dang g.yung drung 'khyil ba dang pad+ma dang sdong ris la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dag snang ba dang /de'i tshe rgya mtsho pa ye shes pa'i mtshan mkhan rnams kyis kyang 'o thug 'di 'thungs na bdud rtsi thob par lung bstan to/ /de nas legs skyes mas 'o thug tshos pa thang la bzhag ste me tog dang spos chus gtor nas gus par stan bting bas/de'i tshe kun tu rgyu nyer 'gros tshul de mthong nas bkres pa ltar byas te 'o thug bslangs pas ma byin no/ /'o thug bskol ba'i bkra shis kyi mtshan mas bram ze mang du 'dus kyang gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyi mthus 'ga' tsam yang mi snang ngo / /de nas legs skyes mas rang gi bran mo gong ma zhes bya ba la smras pa/song la bram ze bos shig /ngas ni 'o thug sbrang rtsi can de blta'o/ /des de bzhin du nyan nas phyogs kun tu song ba las/ de'i tshe brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bram zer sprul te 'dug pa la/ bu mo gnyis kyis sbyin par brtsams pa dang / de re res smras pa/ ci bdag la sbyin nam bdag las ches khyad par du 'phags pa la 'bul/ smras pa/ khyod las ches khyad par 'phags pa la'o/ /rim gyis brgya byin gyis tshangs pa la/ des gnas gtsang ma'i lha la/ des byang chub sems dpa' la phul cig ces so/ /byang chub sems dpas nai rāñdza nar sku khrus mdzad nas brgal bar bzhed pa na sku nyam chung bas brgal bar mi spyod pa na lha rnams kyis shing ardzu na'i yal ga btud pa la 'jus te brgal nas sprul pa bkye bas/ bran mo gong mas shar phyogs su song ba dang / des byang chub sems dpa' mthong ngo / /de bzhin du lho dang /nub dang / byang ste phyogs gang du song yang byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas 187—256

slar log ste rje mo la gang dang gang du phyin kyang de dang der dge sbyong mdzes pa gda' ba las/ dge sbyong ngam bram ze gzhan ni 'ga' yang mi gda'o/ /legs skyes mas smras pa/ de nyid bram ze yin gyi bos shig /des spyan drangs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' legs skyes ma'i khyim du stan la bzhugs pa la/ legs skyes ma dang dga' stobs mas gser gyi yol go'i nang du 'o thug sbrang rtsi can gyis bkang te phul lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas 'di snyam du sems te/legs skyes mas kha zas 'di lta bu byin pa 'di bdag gis de zos te/ the tshom med par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam ste byang chub sems dpas zas de blangs nas grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe/ gser gyi snod chen po 'di ji ltar bya/ des smras pa/ khyod snoms shig /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/kho bo la ni snod 'di lta bu mi dgos so/ /legs skyes mas smras pa/ ci dgyes su mdzod cig /gsungs pa/ sbyin pa 'dis ci zhig don du gnyer/ de gnyis sngar gyi bsam pa drag pos gdung nas gsol pa/ dge ba 'dis rgyal po don grub 'khor los sgyur bar lung bstan pa de bdag cag gi khyim thab tu gyur cig /gsungs pa/ de 'dod pa don du mi gnyer bas rab tu byung zin to/ /gsol pa/ gal te 'dod pa don du mi gnyer na/ bsod pa phul ba'i bsod nams ci mchis pas/ /grags dang ldan pa don rnams kun grub pa/ /mi yi mchog gyur blo mchog ldan pa de'i/ /don kun myur du shin tu 'grub gyur cig /byang chub sems dpas de bzhin du gyur cig ces gsungs nas 'o thug bsnams te sde can nas klung nai rāñdza na'i 'gram du byon te 'o thug dang na bza' rnams 107—257

phyogs gcig tu bzhag ste lus bsil bar mi bya ba'i phyir chu klung nai rāñdza na'i nang du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu brgya stong du ma dag 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i a ka ru dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang ske/ byug pa dag klung du lhugs shing lha'i me tog kha dog sna tshogs dag kyang chu'i nang du 'thor bas chu klung chen po de lha'i spos dang / me tog rnams kyis gang bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos chu gang gis khrus byas par gyur pa de lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag gis blangs te mchod rten du bya ba'i phyir rang rang gi gnas su khyer/ byang chub sems dpa'i skra dang ag tshom gang yin pa de dag kyang grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma la stsal nas/ na bza' bzhes te nai rāñdza na'i klu'i bu mos phul ba'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /bu mo gnyis kyis byang chub kyi chos rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'o thug sbrang rtsi can de lhag ma ma lus par gsol nas gser gyi snod la ma chags par chur bor bas klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos mchod pa'i 'os yin no zhes dad pa dang gus pas blangs nas rang gi gnas su song bas/ brgya byin gyis mkha' lding gi gzugs su sprul nas kha rdo rje'i mchur bsgyur te/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho las gser gyi snod chen po 'phrog ste rang gi gzugs kyis mchod rten du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba'i phyir sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su khyer nas snod chen po'i dus ston byas so/ /seng ge'i khri de yang klu'i bu mo de nyid kyis mchod par bya ba'i phyir khyer te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'o thug gsol ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs kyis skad cig de nyid la lus la snga ma'i kha dog bzang po rgyas pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /107—258

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / 'od 'dom gang ba yang byung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sa btsal ba'i phyir gshegs pa dang / me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i brag chen po zhig gzigs pa la 'dzegs nas dben zhing gsal ba'i phyogs su skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs ma thag ri de nyil to/ /byang chub sems dpas bdag gis las skyon can zhig byas pas ri nyil to snyam pa na/ lha rnams kyis gsol pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pa dang / sbyangs pa gnyis ni sa thams cad kyis bzung bar rngo mi thog pas / khyod ni dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyangs pa lags so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas ma lags te/ chu klung nai rāñdza na brgal ba'i nub phyogs na rdo rje'i gdan mchis kyis/ der ni dus gsum gyi byang sems thams cad bzhugs nas bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur bas der bzhud cig gsol bas / byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu chen po'i stabs la sogs pa stabs lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad blta ba dang gom pa 'dor 'dreg la ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs rnam pa bcus byang chub kyi snying por chas so/ /rna rāñdza na dang byang chub kyi snying po'i bar der rlung gi sprin gyi lha rnams kyis lam phyag dar byas/ spos chus chag chag btab/ me tog kyang chal mar bkram mo/ /stong chen po 'di'i shing ljon pa mtha' dag dang /ri dang / byis pa btsas pa ji snyed pa rnams kyang byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der logs su mgo bo btud do/ /'dod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis de'i bar rgyang grags tsam tshun chad kyi lam mngon par bkod de lam de'i 'gram g.yas g.yon du lha'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan sogs kyis legs par brgyan pa'i rin chen 107—259

sna bdun gyi stegs bu 'phangs su tā la bdun tsam du mtho ba/ shing tā la gnyis gnyis kyi bar du bai ḍūr+ya'i them skas dang / rin po che'i stegs bus bskor ba'i rdzing bu gser gyi bye ma bdal zhing / ut+pa la la sogs pas gang ba/ rma bya dang / chu bya sna tshogs pa sgra 'byin pa dag byas so/ /tā la thams cad kyi mdun du rin po che'i mkha' rten bzhag pa la tsan dan dang a ga ru'i spos phor thogs pa brgyad khri dang / glu dbyangs len pa'i lha mo lnga khri dag 'khod do/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dbang sgyur chen pos tshangs pa'i 'khor rnams la bsgo ba/ grogs po dag /skyes bu chen po 'di ni sngon dam bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa dang / chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes par mdzad pa'i phyir byang chub kyi snying por gshegs kyi khyed rnams kyis mchod par gyis shig /'dod pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pas stong chen brgyan par byas pa la ltos zhes bskul ba dang gzugs kyi lha rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che'i rang bzhin la gser gyi pad+ma bkram pa kha khyer rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba dang / gshegs lam du shing rta bdun kyang sprul/ lha'i bu mo bye ba drug cus rdo rje'i gdan rin po che bkram pa sogs mchog gi bkod pa dang ldan pa dga' tshal lta bur byas/ tshangs pa chen po rang nyid kyang skad cig de la stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phyin te sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa rin po che sna bdun gyis gang ba reg na bde bar byas so/ /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis mchod pa'i las kyi phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong legs par brgyan cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang lha dang mi'i las 'das pa'i bkod pa dpag tu med pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa legs 187—260

par brgyan pas zhing gcig lta bur snang bar gyur to/ /lha'i bu u kha li dang /muṅka li/ skye dgu'i bdag po la sogs pa byang chub kyi snying po yongs su skyong bar byed pa bcu drug gis byang chub kyi shing de la dpag tshad brgyad cu 'khor yug tu rin po che sna bdun gyi stegs bu dang / shing tā la'i phreng ba dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba dang / rin po che'i phreng ba rnams rim pa bdun bdun gyis bskor/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi glegs ma rin po ches spras pa dang ske/ tshong tshong dang / pad+ma dag gis khebs par byas so/ /'od ma dang /snyan ldan dang / yid bzang dang / mdangs ldan ma ste byang chub shing gi lha mo bzhis kyang shing de'i rtsa ba dang / sdong po/ yal ga sogs phun sum tshogs pa/phyi rim la stegs bu dang / g.yer kha'i dra ba/ rin po che'i phreng ba bdun rim gyis bskor to/ /de ltar mi mjed kyi zhing bkod pa mchog tu gyur la gser ltar 'bar ba 'di mthong nas lha'i bu bsod nams che ba rnams kyang rang gi gnas la dur khrod tsam du mthong na gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos pa de lta bur gyur to / /byang chub sems dpa' dka' thub drag po las bzhengs te chu klung ne+e rāñdza na brgal nas zhabs kyi mthil las ngan song dang / nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zhi la/ bde ba dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byed pa'i 'od bkye bas klu'i rgyal po nag po zhes bya ba'i khyim 'od kyis snang bar gyur te bltas pa na/ byang sems de'i mthu las byung bar mthong ste klu'i 'khor rnams dang ske/ rang gi chung ma gser 'od ces bya ba dang bcas dong te mchod cing bstod par byed do/ /de nas byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa na/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rtswa'i gdan la bzhugs par dgongs nas rtswa tshong bkra 187—261

shis lam gyi g.yas rol na rtswa 'jam zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba/ rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu/ ka tsa lin+da'i gos ltar reg na bde ba yid du 'ong ba dag brnga ba gzigs nas de la/ bkra shis rtswa dag nga la myur du byin/ /de ring nga la rtswas ni don chen 'gyur/ /dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud ni bcom nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi ba reg par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtswa tshong bkra shis rab tu dga' bas rtswa 'jam gzhon zhing bzang la reg na bde ba spar ba gang thogs nas byang chub sems dpa' la phul te/ rtswa yis byang chub mchog gyur pa/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i lam thob na/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed bzhes shig /bdag kyang thog mar 'tshang rgya bgyi/ /zhes gsol pas/ byang chub sems dpas rtswa de bzhes nas rdul bral zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ /byang chub snying po de yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i rdo rje'i dkyil/ sra ba snying po yod pa mi phyed pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gnas so/ /der lha'i bu rnams kyis me tog dang —/ spos dang / tsan dan dang / gos dang / rin po che dang / rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin can gyi byang chub kyi shing 'phang du dpag tshad brgya dang / stong dang / 'bum dang / 'bum phrag bcu pa/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong can rnams bkod de/ de thams cad kyi drung na ji ltar 'tshams pa'i seng ge'i khri lha'i ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba dag bshams shing / kha cig gi drung du ni pad+ma dang / spos dang / rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khri stan dag kyang bshams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni dman pa la mos pa'i sems can rnams kyi blo gros yongs su tshim par bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi shing la lan bdun bskor ba mdzad de rtse mo nang dang / rtswa ba phyir bstan pa'i rtswa'i gding ba kun nas 107—262

bzang po bting ba'i steng du zhal shar phyogs su bltas/ sku lus drang por bsrang ske/ dran pa mngon du bzhag /yi dam brtan po bcas te snyoms par zhugs so/ /de lta mod kyi/ lha'i bu rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag nyid kyi khri la snyoms par zhugs kyi/ gzhan gyi khri la ni ma yin no snyam du sems shing / shing drung gi seng ge'i khri thams cad kyi steng du byang chub sems dpa' re re bzhugs pa'ang kun tu snang bar gyur/ byang sems bskul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od byung bas kyang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu bskul bas phyogs bcu'i zhing gi byang sems rnams 'khor byang sems grangs las 'das pa dag gis bskor cing mdun du bdar te byang chub kyi snying por byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der phyin nas rang rang gis mchod pa dang / bstod pa dpag tu med pa dag gis mngon par btud do//bzhi pa bdud sde bcom pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' gling bzhi pa 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug bdud sdig can de dang g.yul sprad de de las rgyal bar byas na 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha thams cad tshar bcad par 'gyur ba dang / bdud ris kyi lha'i bu dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dag gis seng ge'i rtse ba mthong nas sems bskyed par 'gyur bar dgongs nas smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung ste/ 'od zer des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams kyi bdud kyi gnas thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to / /'od de las tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ sems can shin tu dag pa bskal mang spyod spyad pa/ /zas gtsang sras pos rgyal srid dag ni 107—263

rab spangs te/ /phan byed de ni bdud rtsi mngon par 'dod pas byung / /byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyi de ring sgrim par gyis/ /zhes so/ /de'i skabs su bdud sdig can la bdag nyid kyi gnas mun pas khyab cing rdul gyis gang ba dang /rang nyid dngangs skrag nas phyogs phyogs su 'bros pa dang / cod pan dang bral zhing rna cha lhung ba sogs rmi ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /de sad pa dang 'jigs shing dngangs nas rang gi 'khor rnams bsags te smras pa/ mdangs sum rmi lam 'di ltar rmis shing shākya'i bu sangs rgyas nas des nga'i gnas ma lus pa stong par byed kyi/ bdag cag dpung dang bcas pa byang chub kyi shing drung du dong ste de gzhom par khyed rnams mthu skyed cig /bdud sdig can gyi bu ded dpon gyis/ kye yab/ stobs dang ldan pa de la rtsod par mi nus zhes phan tshun mang du med kyang ma nyan te/ yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug stobs che ba/ 'thab mo la dpa' ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyis sngon ma mthong ma thos pa/ rkang lag sbrul brgya stong gis dkris pa/ ral gri dang /mda' gzhu/ mdung thung / mda' bo che/ rtse gsum/ dbyug to/ 'khor lo / rdo rje rtse gcig pa sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ go cha bgos pa/mgo dang / rkang lag dang / mig rnams log par 'dug pa bzhin gzi brjid drag po dang ldan pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ lce stug cing che ba 'bar 'bur can re lde dang 'dra ba 'phyang ba/ mig dmar ba/ wa dang /ce spyang dang / bong bu dang / ba lang dang / glang po dang / rta dang / rnga mong dang / rkyang dang / ma he/ seng ge/ stag /phag rgod/ dred/spre'u / gzig /sbrul/ chu srin/ rus sbal/ bya rog /bya rgod/ 'ug pa/107—264

nam mkha' lding gi gzugs su 'dug pa/ mgo gcig pa nas stong gi bar du ldan pa/ de bzhin du rkang lag stong gi bar du ldan pa dag dang / gdong kha cig ser ba/ dkar ba/ sngo ba/ gnag pa/ ral pa brjes pa/ lus mgo lba ba can/ lus mi'i khrag gis sbags pa dang / keng rus dag dang / rid cing gsus pa che la sna gzhom pa dag dang / mgo dang rkang lag med pa dang /mi'i mgo la sogs pa za ba dang / kha/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lte ba'i khung bu rnams nas sbrul 'byin pa dang / ri la zhon te ri 'bar ba thogs pa dang /mi'i sor mo gyon pa dang / thod skam dang / zhugs ling me can thogs nas rnga mo la zhon pa dang / sprin nag las rlung dang mda' char 'bebs shing rdo dang /gnam lcags dang / lcags kyi bye ma tshan mo dang / rdo rje'i lce dang / zangs 'bar ba'i char 'bebs pa dang / ri chen po snyil bar byed pa dang / rgya mtsho 'khrug par byed pa dang / ri chen po las 'chong ba dang / lhun po skul ba dang —/ rgyug pa dang / 'bros pa dang / brang la rdeb pa dang / mgo gsig pa dang / mgo 'bar zhing skra gyen du 'greng ba sogs 'jigs su rung ba'i cha byad sna tshogs pa sgra rtsub cing mi snyan pa/ hu lu hu lu/ rgyob cig /sod cig ces pa'i sgra brgya stong du 'byin pa/ bud med rgan mo dag kyang ngu zhing / kye hud nga'i bu longs shig zer ba dang / srin mo'i gzugs dang / sha za mo'i gzugs dang / yi dwags long ba kha gcus pa lag pa bsgreng ba ngu zhing mdun du rgyug pa de lta bu thad ka dang / steng gi khor yug dpag tshad brgyad khri khebs pa dag gis byang chub sems dpa' la 'jigs par byed do/ /bdud sdig can gyi bu stong gi nang nas ded dpon la sogs pa gang dag byang chub sems dpa' la 107—265

mngon par dad pa de dag ni bdud kyi g.yas su 'khod/ blo gros ngan pa sogs bdud kyi phyogs byed pa de dag g.yon du 'khod pa na sdig can gyis/ yu bu cag gi tshul ci 'dra ba'i dpung gis byang chu sems dpa' gdul bar bya zhes smras pas/g.yon rol na 'khod pa'i blo gros ngan pa dang / lag brgya pa dang / gzi brjid drag shul la sogs pa rnams kyis bdag cag la mthu 'di dang 'di lta bu mnga' bas de 'joms par nus kyi/ thabs drag pos gzhom par bya'o/ /g.yas rol nas ded dpon dang / dbyangs snyan dang / blo bzang po dang /mig bzang la sogs pa rnams kyis ni/ stobs 'dis byang chub sems dpa' 'dul bar mi nus kyi/ de yon tan gyi khyad par che zhing / de'i stobs kyis tshur non par 'gyur ro zhes phan tshun legs nyes kyi gtam dag bgyid do/ /bdud kyi sde dpon sde bzang po zhes bya bas kyang bdud sdig can la khyod kyi rjes 'brang mtha' dag 'di la dang ba'i yid kyis phyag byas shing zhum par gyur na thub par mi nus kyi/ do mod 'di rgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes smras pas/ bdud kyi bu gzhan zhig khros te/ khyod ni de gcig pu'i bsngags pa rjod par byed na/ des ci nus/ 'jigs pa'i dpung chen po ma mthong ngam zhes spyos so/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams dang / nag po'i phyogs kyi gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / srin po rnams sgra sgrog bzhin par lhag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ni thugs ka dpal gyi be'us brgyan pa rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i stobs mnga' ba dang / sgyu ma dang mtshungs par gzigs pas de dag la bag tsha ba dang g.yo ba med cing / bdud dpung mthu chung bar bya ba'i phyir dpung de dag zhal gyi nang du zhugs pa lta bu'i mthu bstan pas bdud rnams bros so/ /yang ci'ang ma yin 107—266

no snyam nas slar log te mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang / ri rab tsam pa'i ri bo dag kyang 'phang bas thams cad me tog gi bla bre dang gzhal med khang du gyur/dbugs gdug pa'i me lce gtor ba de dag kyang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor lta bur gnas pa'i phyir pad+ma 'dab brgya rgyas pa lta bu'i bzhin bskyod do/ /yang phyag g.yas pas mgo la byug pa dang / bdud kyis byang chub sems dpa'i phyag na ral gri 'bar ba thogs pa mthong nas lho phyogs su bros te/ ci'ang ma yin snyam nas slar log ste mtshon cha drag tu 'phangs pa rnams kyang me tog gi phreng ba dang /bla brer gyur te byang chub kyi shing brgyan par byas so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa de dag mthong nas sdig can phrag dog dang / ser snas byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ kye rgyal bu gzhon nu/ bzhengs la rgyal srid la spyod cig /khyod kyi bsod nams de tsam gyis thar pa ga la thob/bka' stsal pa/ sdig can khyod kyis gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gcig gis 'dod pa'i dbang phyug thob tu zad na/ ngas ni mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byas shing / yongs su btang bar dka' ba'i mgo dang / rkang lag sogs kyang sems can gyi phyir du sbyin no/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / bdud kyis smras pa/ bdag gis mchod sbyin gcig gis 'dod pa'i dbang phyug thob pa'i dpang por khyod yod na/ khyod kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi phyir du mchod sbyin bye ba brgya stong du byas pa'i dpang por su yod ces sgra gsang chen po bsgrags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang snying rje'i thugs kyis bag tsha ba med par dung dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i phyag g.yas pas sku lus thams cad la byugs nas tshul du shis par sa chen po la 107—267

brdabs te/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi gnas yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon med/ /'di ni bdag gi dpang de bdag rdzun med/ /'di la khyod ni bdag gis dpang byos shig /ces sa la reg ma thag tu sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu sa brdol ba'i gseb nas stong chen gyi sa'i lha mo 'khor bye ba phrag brgya dang ldan pa de lus phyed phyung nas byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der lus btud de thal mo sbyar nas gsol pa/ skyes bu chen po/ de de bzhin no/ /khyed kyis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin te/ 'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo de lta mod kyi/ khyod nyid ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi dpang du gyur pa lags so/ /zhes smras nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /tshul des bdud sdig can sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde bzhin du nga rgyal gyi zil gyis non pas phyir yang ma log cing bros kyang ma bros par phyir bltas nas yang dpung rnams la smras pa/khyed lhan cig 'dus te cung zad cig sdod cig /kho bos rjes su chags pas 'di bslang bar nus sam mi nus sad par bya'o zhes smras te bdud kyi bu mo rnams la / khyod rnams byang chub snying por song la bud med kyi sgyu rtsal dag ston cig /de rnams kyis kyang gzugs dang lang tsho'i rgyags pas gos dang rgyan gyis klubs nas byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du 'khod de/ bud med kyi sgyu sum cu rtsa gnyis dag bstan cing sdod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ni chags pa dang /sdang ba med la/ dbang po ma 'khrugs par bzhin gyi 'dzum phyung ste/ bud med kyi skyon dug dang 'dra ba dang / 'dod pa dag gi nyes dmigs bka' stsal nas bdud kyi bu mo rnams rgas shing 'khog pa'i rang bzhin can du byin gyis brlabs 787—268

pas lhag par dad de phyag btsal/ khyed kyi smon lam 'grub par gyur cig ces bstod nas song ste/ pha sdig can la byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rgya cher bsgrags pas sdig can ches mi dga' bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe lha mo dpal ldan ma dang —/ 'phel mo dang / dka' thub dang / dge ma dang / mkhas ma dang /mdangs stobs dang / bden smra dang / ldan pa ste byang chub shing gi lha mo brgyad kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad kyis bstod/ gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud nyams dmas par byed/ byang chub kyi shing gi bsnyen bkur ba'i lha rnams kyis bzlog pa rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud zlog par byed de/ des kyang sdig can phyir ma log par cher khros te dpung gi mchog bye ba khrag sum cu rtsa drug dag gis byang chub sems dpa' la bskor/ rang nyid rab tu khros pa'i mda' gzhu rna drung du bkang ste smras pa/ 'di slongs shig /rgyobs shig /srog kyang ma 'byin zhig /'di langs te 'bros pa las thabs gzhan med do zhes smra'o/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ lhun po gnas nas g.yo ba dang / rgya mtsho skem pa dang / nyi zla mkha' las lhung ba srid kyi/ nga 'dra ba shing gi rgyal po'i drung nas g.yo ba mi srid do/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ kho bo 'dod pa'i dbang po yin la khyod nga'i yul na 'dug gi longs la tshig bzhin gyis shig /gsungs pa/nga ni chos kyi dbang phyug yin gyi lam gol ba spangs nas khyod pham par byas nas byang chub thob ste sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dngos po bstan par bya'o/ /bdud lhag par khro nas rtsub pa'i tshigs su/ /dge sbyong 'di zungs la nga'i khyim du lcags sgrog gis bcings te sdug bsngal bas nyen pa'i smre ngag 'don du chug cig /byang 187—269

chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ nam mkha' la rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i ri mo bri bar nus srid kyi/ khyod 'dra ba mang pos nga shing drung nas bskyod nus par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud sdig can dpung dang bcas pa langs te ha zhes zer ba'i sgra drag tu 'byin/ gnya' shing gang tsam du 'ongs nas ral gri shubs nas phyung ste/ dge sbyong longs la nga'i bsam pa bzhin du song / myu gu sngon po bzhin du do mod bcad ta re/ gsungs pa/ gal te kun gyi lag na ri bo 'dra ba'i ral gri thogs pa'i bdud kyis stong gsum gang bar gyur kyang nga yi ba spu tsam yang bskyod par mi nus na gnod par mi 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ sdig can na re / ngas brtan por dran pa bya yi/ khyod ma rings shig ces slar yang dpung bshams te me 'bar ba'i ri dang / rdo rje'i lce dang / lcags kyi tho lum gyi char dang / mtshon cha rnon po dag 'beb/ lag pa brgya nas mda' brgya 'phen/kha nas sprul dang me 'don/ mkha' lding du bsgyur nas klu 'byin/ sa dang chu rab tu 'khrug par byed cing mdun dang rgyab tu mchong / kye ma bu zhes g.yas nas g.yon dang / g.yon nas g.yas su mchong / mig nas me 'bar ba sogs byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa'i mthus mtshon cha de dag ni lha'i me tog gi phreng bar gyur to/ /bdud rnams gzi brjid nyams nas lus la rdul byung la brang brdung / cho nge 'debs shing byer nas ci bya'i gtol med de sdug bsngal/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po/ grul bum bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang /srog chags bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug gis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i stobs dang /seng ge'i rnam par rtse ba mthong nas byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de ltar 107—270

byams pa'i stobs dang mthu thogs pa med pa dang / gzhan spro bar bya ba la sogs pa rnam pa bcus bdud rnams 'dul bar mdzad do//lnga pa mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi dpung chen po btul nas g.yul ngor rgyal ba'i mtshan ma thob ste byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos rnams bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas bsam gtan bzhi dang / lha'i mig dang / rna ba dang / gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon par shes pa rnams bskyed do/ /de nas sems can 'di dag zag pa gsum gyis 'khor bar 'khor na / rgyu 'di dag ni ji ltar spang bar bya snyam du dgongs nas nam gyi cha smad skya rengs 'char ba'i dus kyi tshe bden pa bzhi thugs la gtad de/ rgyu 'bras kyi go rim ji lta ba bzhin dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog la mang du sems par mdzad cing rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas sgrib pa'i sprin rum mtha' dag rmeg med par bcom nas gang gis byang chub kyi phyir dka' ba spyad pa dang / tshangs par spyad pa dang / rab tu byung ba rnams kyi don du gnyer bya dam pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du mdzad pas zag pa zad pa'i mngon par shes pa bskyed do/ /lha'i bu rnams kyis smras pa/ grogs po dag /bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi/ me tog gtor cig ces smras pa dang / sngon gyi rgyu shes pa'i lha rnams kyis smras pa/ brda ma mdzad kyi bar gtor bar mi bya'o zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das skyil krung dang bcas bzhin par tā la bdun tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags te/ lam gyi rgyun ni chad/ rdul ni nye bar zhi/ zag pa 187—271

ni bskams so/ /'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' zhes bya'o zhes ched du brjod pas/lha'i bu thams cad kyis me tog gtor te pus mo nub tsam du bkram par gyur to/ /de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa legs so zhes stong chen 'di khebs pa'i rin po che'i gdugs 'od zer gyi dra ba snang ba chen po dang ldan pa dag bskur to/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis tsan+dan gyi phye ma dang / 'od gsal gyi lha rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyis rin po che'i dra ba/ bdud kyi bu dkar po'i phyogs dag gis rin po che'i bla re dang /dbang sgyur sogs kyis gser gyi pad+ma/ 'phrul dga' bas dar gyi lda ldi/dga' ldan pas lha'i gos kyi dra ba/ 'thab bral bas spos kyi phreng ba/ brgya byin gyis byugs pa/ rgyal chen bzhis me tog sna tshogs pa/ bar snang gi lha rnams kyis g.yer kha'i dra ba/ sa bla'i lha rnams kyis sa gzhi me tog gis bkram pa bcas phul nas rang rang gis tshigs su bcad pas mngon par bstod cing byang chub kyi snying po legs par brgyan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'ang skyil krung ma bshig par bsam gtan dang dga' ba'i zas kyis bde ba myong bar byang chub shing drung du zhag bdun du bzhugs so/ /de ltar chos kyi ro'i dga' bde bla na med pa'i bdud rtsis sku lus brtas par mdzad de dal gyis bzhengs nas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa na 'dod pa dang gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams spos chu'i bum pa nyi khri thogs te bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub kyi shing bkrus/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs bgrangs pa las 'das pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsil ba'i spos chus rang rang gi lus la bskus nas sems bskyed do/ /lha'i 107—272

bu kun nas me tog gis zhag bdun du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de'i ming ci lags zhes zhus pas/ lha'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin 'di ni dga' ba'i zas bkod pa zhes bya ste/ 'di dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa zhag bdun du skyil mo krung ma bshig par bzhugs so zhes bka' stsal bas des kyang bstod par byed do/ /zhag bdun phrag gnyis pa'i tshe na stong gsum gyi bar du rgyang ring du 'chag pa dang —/ gsum pa'i tshe/ nga sangs rgyas nas skye rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthar phyung ngo zhes byang chub kyi snying por spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/ bzhi pa'i tshe/shar nub kyi rgya mtsho'i bar du mi ring bar 'chag /bdun phrag lnga par yul ngan byung ba'i tshe klu'i rgyal po btang bzung gi gnas su gshegs te/ klu btang bzung gis sku la lan bdun du dkris nas gdengs ka rnams kyis bkab bo/ /de bzhin du phyogs bzhi'i klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis dkris shing bkab pas yul ngan bsrung ste/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la reg pas sngon ma rnyed pa'i bde ba brnyes so/ /bdun phrag drug pa la nai rāñdza na'i ngogs/ shing n+ya gro dha'i drung du bzhugs te rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog la gzigs/ bdun phrag bdun par byang chub kyi snying por sā ra dang 'od ma'i tshal nang gi shing sgrol rgyu'i drung na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe sngon smon lam btab pa byang phyogs kyi tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po spun gnyis rnyed pa chen po rnyed nas zong rnam pa mang po thogs te 'gron po phal po che dang / shing rta shin tu gang ba lnga brgya dang lhan cig lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dong ba lam du zhugs so/ /de gnyis la glang bu cang shes legs skyes dang / grags pa zhes bya ba gang du mdun rol na 'jigs pa yod pa der de gnyis phur pa la btags pa bzhin du 'dug cing / lcag gis 107—273

mi 'ju bar me tog ut+pa la sbar gang ngam/ sna ma'i me tog gi phreng bas 'dred par byed dgos pa gnyis yod do/ /'od ma can gyi nags tshal gyi lha mos byin gyis brlabs nas shing rta thams cad mi 'gro bar 'phang lo nub/ glang bu de gnyis la 'dren du bcug ste sna ma'i me tog gis bdas kyang 'gro bar ma gyur pa na / tshong pa de rnams skrag nas sa 'khru ba'i rta pa btang ba dang 'jig pa ci'ang med do zhes smras/ shing gi lha mos kyang rang gi gzugs bstan nas dbugs phyung ngo ske/ /de'i tshe glang bu de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du shing rta drang ba na / ga gon spun gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis 'bar ba mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te lha'i dbang po'am/ 'on te rnam thos kyi bu yin nam snyam du sems pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pas na bza' ngur smrig rnams bstan pas/ 'di rab tu byung ba yin gyi/ bdag cag 'jigs pa med do zhes dad pa thob bo/ /de nas ba stong gi 'o ma bsdus pa'i spris ma bzhams nas zhal zas sbyar te rin po che'i gzhong pa bkang ba dang / sbrang rtsi dang bu ram dang 'dag gu dag khyer nas de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der song ste bdag cag la thugs brtse bar dgongs nas spyan gzigs 'di bzhes su gsol zhes phul bas lag pas 'di blang na ma legs kyi sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis snod ji lta bus bzhes dgongs pa na skad cig de nyid la phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po bzhis gser dang / dngul dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / shel dang / spug dang / rdo'i snying po las byas pa'i lhung bzed bzhi bzhi thogs te phul bas/ de dag dge sbyong gi cha ma yin par dgongs nas ma bzhes so/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis rdo'i lhung bzed du bzhes par mkhyen nas thugs bskyed pa dang / de rnam thos 187—274

kyi bus shes te/ sngon po'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnam par snang byed sogs kyis 'di shākya thub pa la phul cig ces bdag la rdo'i lhung bzed bzhi byin pa de blang bar bya'o zhes rgyal po gzhan gsum la smras pas/ de rnams kyis de dag re re blangs nas khyer te lha'i me tog gis bkang nas phul ba dang / phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste thog mar rnam thos kyi bu dang / de bzhin du yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po/ mig mi bzang gi lhung bzed rim pa bzhin du bzhes nas thams cad gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas tshong pa ga gon dang / bzang po gnyis la thugs brtse bas zhal zas blangs te gsol nas gzhong pa nam mkhar bor ba lha'i bu rab tshangs kyis tshangs pa'i gnas su khyer te mchod pa byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong pa gnyis la/ lha yi bkra shis don grub cing / /phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des/ /khyod kyi don rnams 'grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun par shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal nas/ de'i sbyin pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i phan yon gyi sgo nas bsngags te sbrang rtsi 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag gis chos zab mo rab tu zhi ba/ gya rnam pa/ mthong bar dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba/rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa 'di lta bu rtogs na/ gzhan dag la bstan kyang mi shes pas snying las chung ngur gnas par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ zab zhi rdul bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi'i chos ni bdag gis thob par gyur/ /bdag gis bstan kyang gzhan gyis mi shes te/ /mi smra nags 'dabs gnas par bya ba snyam/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ 'on kyang tshangs pas bskul na chos 187—275

'khor bskor bar dgongs nas smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od bkye bas stong gsum snang bar byas shing / tshangs pas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs shes te 'khor 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du chos gsungs par gsol ba btab pas cang mi gsungs pas gnang bar rig nas lha'i tsan+dan gyi phye ma dang / a ga ru'i phye ma gtor/ dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba skyes te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhan dag chos la gus par 'gyur ba dang / tshangs pas yang yang bskul na dge rtsa 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / chos zab par bstan pa'i phyir thugs las chung ngur bzhugs par dgongs pa na/ de tshangs pas shes nas brgya byin la bskul te gzugs kyi lha'i bu kha dog mngon par 'phags pa brgya stong mang po dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags nas chos gsungs par bskul bas ma gnang ste/ de rnams sdug bsngal nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe ma ga dha'i mi rnams la mi dge ba'i ltas kyi sems 'di lta bu byung ste/ rlung ldang bar mi 'gyur / me mi 'bar/ char mi 'bab/ lo tog mi skye/ bya rnams nam mkhar mi 'phur/ sbrum ma rnams bde bar btsa' ba mi 'gyur zhes zer/ bcom ldan 'das kyang lan gsum gyi bar thugs las chung ngur bzhugs so//drug pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa ni/ de'i tshe tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis de shes nas nam srod la tshangs pa drug khri brgyad stong gis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin te thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba/ ce ma ga dhar ni sngon chad chos byung ba/ /dag pa ma lags dri mar bcas pas rtogs/ /bdud rtsi chos kyi sgo ni phye mdzod la/ /dri ma med pas rtogs pa bshad par 107—276

mdzod / /thub pa chos kyi sgron mas mun pa sol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal mtshan khyod kyis bsgreng / /snyan pa'i gsung brjod pa yi dus la bab/ /rnga sgra ri dwags dbang ltar bsgrag tu gsol/ /bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa ngas ni tshogs chen gyis/ /skyon rnams bcom nas rtogs gyur pa/ /srid dang chags pas dkris rnams kyis/ /chos ni legs par rtogs mi 'gyur/ /gsol pa/'jig rten na dbang po rno 'bring rtul po dang / gdul sla ba'i sems can mchis pa de dag gis chos ma thos na nyams par 'gyur bas chos bshad du gsol/tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das sngon dam pa'i chos kyi phyir dka' ba de lta bu spyad pas chos kyi rgya mtsho ni rdzogs/ chos kyi sgron me yang gsal bar mdzad na/ ci'i slad du chos ma bstan par btang snyoms su bzhugs zhes gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bdud rtsis sgo mo dag ni dbye bar byas/ /nyan par su 'dod som nyi sol cig dang / /tshangs pa mi rnams la ni gya rnam chos/ /klan ka mi btsal mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / tshangs pa drug khri brgyad stong byang chub tu sems bskyed de mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos 'chad par dgongs pa dang lha rnams kyis do med bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur te des ni phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro zhes sgra bsgrags so/ /byang chub kyi shing gi lha chos sred dang / chos 'dod dang / chos kyi blo gros dang / chos spyod dang / bzhi po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gang du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad/bka' stsal pa/ wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su'o/ /de dag 107—277

gis gsol pa/ de ni skye bo'i tshogs dang / zhugs shing gi grib ma chung ba lags te/ grong khyer 'byor pa rgyas pa/ skye bo mang pos gang ba/ nags dang /nags 'dabs kyis brgyan pa gzhan dag mchis pa de dag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol zhes gsol bar/ wā rā ṇa sī der ni nga yis mchod sbyin stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig drug cur byas pas der chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar thog mar su la chos bstan par bya/ chos bstan pa shes shing tho 'tsham par mi 'gyur ba ni gang zhig yin/ de yang rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod ni dag pa/ go sla ba/ rnam par shes pa lkog tu ma gyur pa ste / de chos ma thos na yongs su nyams par 'gyur snyam du dgongs so/ /de'i tshe lhag spyod 'chi ba'i dus byas nas zhag bdun lon par mkhyen cing lha rnams kyis kyang gsol to/ /de nas ring 'phur la chos bstan par dgongs pa na de'ang 'chi ba'i dus byas nas zhag gsum lon par mkhyen cing / gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis kyang gsol ba dang / e ma sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur de chos shin tu bzang po 'di lta bu ma thos par shi ba ni cher nyams so/ /de nas sems can dag pa gdul sla ba ni lnga sde bzang po yin par dgongs te da lta gang na 'khod snyam du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs pas grong khyer wā rā ṇa sī'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'khod par gzigs so/ /de nas stong chen po'i 'jig rten thams cad du gshegs nas ri ga ya dang / byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du kun tu 'tsho ba pa gzhan zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa rgyang ring po nas gshegs pa dbang po shin tu gsal ba/ bzhin gyi mdog legs par mthong ste phyogs der song nas gsol pa/ gau ta ma khyod kyi dbang po rnams 187—278

ni shin tu gsal/ pags pa'i mdog ni yongs su dag /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni yongs su byang ba lags na su las tshangs par spyad pa spyod/ bka' stsal pa/nga la slob dpon gang yang med/ /nga dang 'dra ba yod ma yin/ /nga ni gcig pu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsil 'gyur zag pa med pa yin/ /gsol pa/ gi ta ma bdag ni sangs rgyas su zhal gyis 'ches sam/ bka' stsal pa/ gang dag zag pa zad brnyes pa/ /nga 'dra rgyal bar shes par bya/ /nga ni sdig pa'i chos las rgyal/ /de bas nyer 'gro nga rgyal yin/ /des smras pa/ de lta gar bzhud/de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ nga ni wā rā ṇa sīr 'gro/ /grong khyer gsal ldan song nas ni/ /long ba lta bu'i 'jig rten la/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ gi ta ma/ de bzhin du 'gyur ro//de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras te lho phyogs su song ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa ri ga ya'i klu'i rgyal po blta mdzes kyi gnas dang / grong tsan da la dang /grong khyer kha lo sgyur rnams su khyim bdag rnams kyis bshos gsol bar spyan drangs te mthar gyis chu klung gaṅgā brgal ba'i phyir mnyan pa'i gan du gshegs pa dang —/ gau ta ma/ gru btsas stsol cig /grogs po/ nga la gru btsas med do zhes nam mkha' las gshegs pa mnyan pas mthong ste 'gyod nas sa la 'gyel to/ /de rgyal po gzugs can snying pos thos nas phyin chad rab tu byung ba la gru btsas mi dbab par khrims bcad/ de nas grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr gshegs nas bsod snyoms bzhes te drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su byon pa na/ lnga sdes rgyang ring po nas byon pa mthong ste 'di skad du/ dge sbyong gi ta ma lhod pa/ mang du za ba/ spong ba las nyams pa 'dir 'ongs na bdag cag rnams kyis 'di la smra 187—279

bar mi bya/ ldang bar mi bya/ stan stob par mi bya zhes 'og khrims bcas pas kauṇ+ḍi rgyas ni sems kyi khas ma blangs so/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sde'i gnas su byon ma thag bcom ldan 'das kyi dpal dang gzi brjid ma bzod nas stan gyi steng na 'dar zhing kun gyis 'og khrims bral te stan las langs nas la las ni rim gro byed/ la las ni bsu ba byas te na bza' chos gos dang lhung bzed blangs/ la las ni gdan bting / la las ni zhabs bzhag pa bshams/la las ni zhabs bkru ba'i chu bshams te/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma/ khyod legs par byon to/ /gdan bting ba 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la bzhugs pa na/ lnga sde rnams kyis lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la mtshan dang / gdung dang / tshe dang ldan pas brjod pa kun tu brjod do/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyed de bzhin gshegs pa la tshe dang ldan pa zhes ma zer zhig /khyed la yun ring por gnod pa dang / mi phan pa dang /mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /ngas ni bdud rtsi dang / 'chi ba med par 'gro ba'i lam mngon du byas so/ /khyed cag tshur shog /rna ba gtod de legs par nyon cig dang / ngas gdams shing rjes su bstan par bya yi/ khyed kyang zag pa zad pa'i sems dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / lnga sde rnams skad cig der mu stegs can gyi rtags dang rgyal mtshan med par gyur te/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam dang 'dra ba skra dang kha spu breg /chos gos gsum dang / lhung bzed dang ldan pa'i dge slong gi dngos por gyur to/ /dge slong lnga pos dad pa dang gus pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsil zhing yongs su sbyang ba'i las byed do/ /de bzhin 187—280

gshegs pas drang srong lhung ba 'di nyid kyi sa'i phyogs gang du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor snyam du dgongs pa na/ gang du sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sa phyogs der rin po che sna bdun gyi khri stong byung zhing / sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gus par mdzad pa'i phyir khri dang po gsum la bskor ba mdzad nas seng ge ltar bag tsha ba mi mnga' bar khri bzhi pa la skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so/ /dge slong lnga pos kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar dul ba'i tshul gyis 'dug go/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer bkye bas sdug bsngal rgyun bcad/ ltas chen po bco brgyad byung / mi mjed kyi zhing mnyam zhing kun byams pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /'od de las/ rgyal bas bskal pa khrag khrig bsgrubs/ /chos de nyan par gang 'dod pa/ /de ni rings par la gor du/ /chos mnyan pa yi phyir shog cig /mi dang sangs rgyas 'byung rnyed dka'/ /dad pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /mi khom brgyad spangs rnyed pa dka'/ /chos nyan pa ni gtso bo yin / /zhes sogs kyis bskul bas sa bla'i lha dang / 'dod gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams spyan sngar lhags te chos kyi 'bor lo bskor ba'i phyir 'khor gyi khyams chen po blta na sdug pa gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i legs par brgyan pa dang / seng ge'i khri brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams phul te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing / phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi smon lam dang ldan pa bye ba phrag mang po dang / mi mjed 'di'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyang lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te skye bo mang po la sman pa'i slad du chos kyi 'khor lo 107—281

bskor du gsol/ zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya ba des lha'i 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las byas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa 'od zer stong dang ldan pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyis brgyan pa sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bzhes pa de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phul te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa dang / chos nyan pa'i 'khor lha klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding /mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa dang / phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa stong chen 'di skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas tsam yang ma khyab pa med par 'dus pa mtha' dag 'dus pa'i sgra tsam yang med par rgyal ba'i zhal 'ba' zhig la blta'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam gyi cha stod kyi thun la cang mi gsung bas bzhugs shing / dgung thun la yang dag par 'chag par 'gyur ba'i gtam dag gsungs so/ /nam gyi cha smad kyi thun la lnga sde bzang po la bos te/bden pa bzhi po dag gi ming dang / spang blang dang / de dag yongs su shes pa/spang ba/ mngon du bya ba/ bsgom pa gshegs shul yan lag brgyad mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu ma'i lam rnam pa bcu gnyis su bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / gsung gi sgra dbyangs de las gang dang gang gis 'dul ba'i sgra de dang der 'tshams pa'i gtam sna tshogs pa theg pa so so dang mthun pa'i chos thos te/ stong chen 'di na bden bzhi gcig pu'i ming bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa bzhi so sor go ste thams cad kyang ji lta ba bzhin gyi bden par 'du ba'i dgongs pas chos bstan pa des tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang / 'bar ba'i gzi brjid la sogs pa'i lha brgyad khri chos rnams la chos kyi mig dri ma dang 107—282

bral ba skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kauṇ+ḍi n+ya la bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis chos kun shes sam/ gsol pa/ kun 'tshal lags so/ /de nas kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya zhes ming chags pas/ 'jig rten du dkon mchog gsum po dag kyang grub cing / lha rnams kyis kyang grogs po dag /bcom ldan 'das kyis wā rā ṇa sīr lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su chos kyi 'khor lo sngon 'jig rten du chos dang mthun pa 'ga' yang ma bskor ba zhig bskor to zhes sgra grags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gnyis su'ang lnga sde rnams la bden pa bzhi bstan pas kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya len pa med par zag pa las rnam par grol te dgra bcom par gyur/ dge slong lhag ma bzhi po rnams kyis bden pa mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong lhag ma bzhi po la gzugs bdag ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / mi rtag pa yin pa rgya cher bka' stsal pas lhag ma bzhi pos kyang dgra bcom pa mngon du byas/ lha bye ba phrag brgya bzhi bcu dang /mi brgyad khri bzhi stong gis kyang bden pa mthong ngo / /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan kun tu grags pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa na rim gro pa rnams kyis ci'i phyir bka' mchid bkum zhes zhus pa dang / bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa byang chub brnyes te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa'i phyir mi smra'o zhes gsungs pas sems can bye ba phrag brgya byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam 'phrul nyan par 'tshal lo zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis spros pa dang bral ba dang / don dam pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/187—283

de ltar bskor bas de bzhin gshegs pa dang / chos kyi rje dang / 'dren pa dang / rnam par 'dren pa zhes grags so zhes gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul gang yin pa de ni shā ri'i bus kyang lo brgyar rtogs par mi nus la/ de'i tshe kā shir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mchod rten sgo mang po dang ldan pa brtsigs so/ /de ltar sems can ma rig pa'i ling tog gis g.yog /bdag lta'i mdud pas bcings / skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo'i klong du byings pas sdug bsngal ba rnams sdug bsngal de las grol ba'i phyir du wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags/rgyal po'i khab tu bya rgod phung po'i ri/ yangs pa can khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzhal med khang la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su gdul bya'i khams dang skal bar 'tshams pa'i zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor bar mdzad do//bdun pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bos mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa bskul ba'i phyir du/kun dga' bo/ gang su yang rung rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten bsgoms mang du byas pa de 'dod na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du'ang 'dug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten bsgoms mang du byas pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhed na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du'ang bzhugs so/ /zhes lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du bskul yang kun dga' bo bdud kyis khebs pas cang mi zer zhing /bdud sdig can spyan sngar 'ongs te mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol bas zla ba 107—284

gsum nas 'da' bar zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku tshe'i 'du byed ni spangs/ 'tsho ba'i 'du byed ni byin gyis brlabs te bzhugs pa dang —/ sa chen po yang g.yos/ skar mda' lhung / phyogs tshig /lha rnams bar snang nas rnga yang brdung ngo / /kun dga' bos ci'i don gyis sa g.yos snyam nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i rgyu brgyad gsungs pas/bcom ldan 'das sku tshe'i 'du byed spangs par rig nas mi dga' ste bskal par bzhugs par gsol bas/ khyod kyis nyes te sngar gsol ba ma btab bo zhes gsungs nas ma gnang ngo / /de nas rtsa ba la'i dge 'dun rnams la gdams pa gsungs nas yangs pa can la g.yas phyogs kyis gzigs te bri dzi'i grong gi byang shing sha ba'i tshal du byon/ der dge slong rnams la bslab pa gsum gsungs nas ru ta'i grong / dum pa'i grong / a 'dra'i grong sogs su rim gyis rgyu ste longs spyod kyi grong gi byang phyogs shing sha ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa dang / sa g.yos/skar mda' lhung ba las/ kun dga' bo/ nga myur du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i snga ltas yin pas/ deng phan chad mdo sde'i mtha' la 'jug par bya yi/ gang zag la ma yin no/ /mdo sde la 'jug /'dul ba la snang / chos nyid dang mi 'gal na de la chos su zungs shig /de las ldog na de ni chos ma yin par zungs shig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sa pa'i grong du mgar ba'i bu tsun das spyan drangs te dge 'dun dang bcas pa la gdugs tshod gsol ba bzhes/ chos bstan nas grong khyer rtswa can du gshegs te sdig pa can dang / chu bo dbyig ldan gyi bar du sku rgyab bsnyung bas gzim zhing / chu'i dgos pa byung ba na kun dga' bos chu bo ka ku ta shing rta lnga brgya brgal bas rnyog chu las lhung bzed gang blangs 187—285

te drangs pas zhal bshal/ zhabs bkrus pas bde bar gyur nas bzhengs te/gyad kyi g.yung po dad par mdzad nas des ras bcos bu gser ltar ser ba zung gcig phul ba sku la gsol ma thag sku'i kha dog shin tu gsal bar snang nas de'i rgyu zhus pas/ kun dga' bo/ gang gi nub mo 'tshang rgya ba dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba na kha dog 'di lta bu 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs nas chu bo dbyig ldan du khrus mdzad nas rtswa can du gshegs pa'i lam du bsnyungs te gzim mo/ /de nas kun dga' bos byang chub kyi yan lag smras pas bzhengs te grong khyer rtswa can gyad kyi yul dang nye ba'i shing sa la zung gi bar du khri bcas sngas byang du bstan pa la glo g.yas pa phab/ zhabs kyi steng du zhabs bzhag nas snang ba'i 'du shes dang / dran pa dang shes bzhin dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 'du shes mdzad nas gzim pa na/ kun dga' bos grong khyer drug spangs nas 'dir ci'i slad du mya ngan las 'da' zhes gsol pas/ kun dga' bo de skad ma smra zhig /'dir sngon nga'i lus drug btang zhing nga dang bdun no/ /de'i tshe dge slong dpe can gyi gzi brjid lha rnams kyis mi bzod pas bskrad do/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ sku gdung la mchod pa ji ltar bgyi zhus pa/sa/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal la byed pa bzhin du lus shing bal gyi lwa bas dkris/ ras zung lnga brgyas g.yogs/ lcags kyi sgrom bur bcug nas 'bru mar gyis bkang ste dri zhim po'i shing spungs pas bsregs/ me 'o mas bsad de rus pa gser gyi bum par bcug pa bzhi mdor mchod rten brtsigs te dus ston byed pa bzhin du byos shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas ston pas sku dngos kyi gdul bya rab bzang dang rab dga' lus pa la rab dga' 'dul ba'i phyir pi wang rgyud stong pa khog bai ḍūr+ya las 107—286

byas pa bsnams te dri zar sprul nas rab dga'i sgo drung du byon pa dang / rab dgas smras pa/ khyod su/ bka' stsal pa/ dri za de phur yin no/ /tshur shog pi wang 'gran no zhes gnyis kus pi wang gi rgyud re re bcad cing / rim gyis rgyud gcig ma gtogs bcad kyang skad thams cad grags la/ mthar ston pas rgyud gcig kyang bcad de nam mkha' kho na la sgra gdangs sngar bzhin gyur pa dang /de pi wang gi nga rgyal zhi ste ngo mtshar skyes pa dang / sku dngos su bstan nas dad pa la chos bstan nas bden pa mthong ngo / /mtsho ma dros pa'i byang phyogs rdzing bu dal 'bab kyi 'gram na u dum wa ra'i tshal ston pa bltams pa'i tshe kha bye/sangs rgyas pa'i tshe me tog dkar po rgyas/ sku che'i 'du byed btang ba'i tshe rnying pa zhig yod pa der gyad rnams kyi bla ma kun tu rgyu rab bzang lo brgya nyi shu lon pa gnas la/ de tshal gyi me tog rnying pa na/ da ni bdag 'chi bar 'gyur te tshal 'di yang rnyings so snyam pa dang / lha zhig gis 'di ni khyod kyi mtshan ma ma yin gyi / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das do mod mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ltas so zhes zer bas/ bdag la the tshom yod pas 'dri ba'i dus la bab bo snyam ste song nas kun dga' bo la lan gsum zhus pas ma gnang ba ston pas mkhyen nas nga dang mu stegs can gtam gleng ba'i tha ma 'di yin pas thongs gsungs nas rab bzang la dga' bar bya ba'i gtam mang du mdzad pas bden pa mthong ste/ kun dga' bo la slob dpon chen po/ bdag tshangs par spyod do/ /de ston pa la zhus pa dang rab bzang tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs pas dgra bcom thob/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba blta bar mi bya'o snyam nas mya ngan las 'das ste gnas lnga byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya dang / me pa ral 187—287

pa can ma gtogs pa'i mu stegs can bsnyen par mi rdzogs pa sogs bslab gzhi phran tshegs 'ga' zhig dang / phyi pa'i gdul bya'i ched du 'khor rnams bden bzhi la the tshom med pa nges par mdzad/ sku'i stod g.yog bsal nas sku gser gyi mdog can bstan te bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ltos shig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blta ba ni rnyed par dka' ba u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin no/ /khyed cag re zhig cang ma smra zhig dang / 'di ltar 'dus byas thams cad ni 'jig pa'i chos can no zhes gsung gi tha ma stsal to/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku ni rtag tu bzhugs mod kyang / sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pas gdul bar bya ba rnams la mi rtag pa ston pa dang /skyo bar bskul ba dang / chos kyi sku la sbyar ba la sogs pa'i don bcu la dgongs nas dgung lo brgyad bcu par khri bzang po'i steng du seng ge'i stabs kyis mnal te mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ /de ma thag sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas cher 'khrug pa rgyal po'i khab nas 'od srung chen pos brtag pa na bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtags su rig nas/ gal te rgyal po ma skyes dgras thos na khrag skyug nas 'chi bar 'gyur snyam nas dbyar gnas byed la thabs bstan nas btang ngo / /des kyang 'od srung gis bstan pa ltar skyed mos tshal du ston pa'i rnam thar mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar ri mor bris pa rgyal pos mthong nas brgyal ba na/ mar gyi gzhong ring du lan bdun dang / tsan+dan go shīn+tas gang ba'i gzhong ring du bcug pas sos/ lha rnams dang nyan thos kyi dge slong rnams mya ngan gyi rnam 'gyur ci'ang bstan la/ kun dga' bos rtswa can gyi gyad rnams la sbran pas/ de dag sku gdung la mchod pa'i phyir lhag go/ /de 187—288

nas zhag bdun du yo byad sta gon byas te gyad rnams rtswa can nas chu bo dbyig ldan par dang / sa la zung gi tshal nas gyad kyi bar rnams su 'khor yug tu khebs pa'i dri dang / phreng ba sogs mchod pa'i yo byad rnams thogs nas lhag ste khyogs btegs/ lha rnams kyi dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang /phye ma dang / rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyis bkur ste dang / gyad kyi chung ma dang ske/ bu mo rnams kyis bla re dang / gdugs sogs kyi bkod pa dang bcas grong khyer rtswa can gyi nub sgo nas zhugs shing shar sgo nas thon te chu bo dbyig ldan brgal nas gyad kyi dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du bzhugs su gsol / de'i tshe rtswa can du lha'i me tog man dā ra ba'i char babs so/ /de nas gyad rnams kyis sku gdung la shing bal gyi 'da' ba dang / ras zung lnga brgyas dkris te 'bru mar gyis bkang ba'i lcags kyi sgrom bu bcug /lcags kyi kha gab gnyis kyis bkab cing / dri bzang po'i shing spungs nas zhugs la zhen par byed kyang me mi 'bar ba ma 'gag pas 'od srung chen po ma slebs pa'i ltas su gzigs sol/ /'od srung chen po 'khor lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu 'ongs nas lam bar na skye bo'i tshogs chen po rjes su 'brang ba rnams dang bcas sku gdung gi drung du lhags te shing dang / lcags kyi kha gab dang / ras dang shing bal rnams bsal nas phyag byas/ shing bal gyi 'da' ba dang / ras zung lnga brgya slar bsnan te/ras zung stong gis dkris nas lcags sgrom du 'jug pa sogs sngar bzhin byas te me rang 'bar du gyur to/ /de'i tshe ras zung phyi ma shos dang nang ma shos gnyis ma tshig cing / me 'o mas bsad pa las/ gser can dang / ser skya/ rta don / u dum wā ra bzhi skyes so/ /gdung yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel du 107—289

gyur pa gser gyi bum par blug nas gyad rnams kyis bkur ste chen pos gser gyi khyogs la spyan drangs/ grong khyer gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol te mchod par byed do/ /sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams dang / rtog la g.yo ba'i rgyal rigs bu lug dang / sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs kro rgya dang / khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze dang / ser skya'i rgyal rigs shākya dang / yangs pa can gyi li ts+tsha bī dang / ma ga dha'i mdun na 'don dbyar byed rnams so sor dpung gi tshogs dang bcas gdung skal len par lhags pa la/ gdung sha ri ram gyi tshogs cha brgyad du bgos te so sor sbyin pas/ de dag yid rangs nas so so'i yul du khyer nas/mchod rten brtsigs te dus ston chen po btsugs nas/ mchod par byed do/ /ring bsrel gyi snod gser gyi bum pa de gyad rnams kyis bram ze bre bo dang mnyam pa'i rigs can la byin te/ des bre bo dang mnyam pa'i grong du mchod rten brtsigs nas/ de bzhin du mchod do/ /bram ze'i khye'u n+ya gro dha la gdung sol byin pas/ des grong n+ya gro dha can du mchod rten byas so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba bzhi po sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / tshing 'dzin gyi grong khyer yid 'ong ba rnams dang / sum tshan gyi rgyal po dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis so so'i yul du mchod do/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste / bskal pa stong gsum rdul du brtsegs pa'i sngon/ /gzhi dang snying por ye shes snang ba'i mdzod/ /bzung ba mkha' mnyam kun rmongs mun pa'i khur/ /'phrog pa'i spros pa 'gro 'dir du mar ston/ /dka' thub la zhen dka' thub kyis btul nas/ /dka' thub tsam gyis byang chub bla med min/ /de phyir mtha' gnyis ma lhung bsod snyoms kyis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dren pa'i cho ga 107—290

bstan / /lhun po bye ba las brjid ye shes khur/ /dbyig 'dzin phal gyis bzod par ma nus pas/ /gser gyi pad+mo brgyud mar 'god pa'i zhabs/ /ne+e rāñdza nar g.yo med skyil krung bcings/ /dam chos snang ba snying la mun stug bzhin / /'babs pa mi bzod chu srin rgyal mtshan dpung / /mdzes ma'i sgyu dang sna tshogs thabs dag ni/ /spros kyang bsam gtan gzhig par ga la nus/ /de snying zhe sdang dug gi me lce yis/ /bsregs pas rab 'khrugs mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /skal bzang gang gis 'dzin pa'i dbyig ldan yang / /spro bas brtan pa gzhan bzhin bskyod par 'gyur/ /dgyes 'dzum chu 'dzin gdung sel bla bre bzhin/ /ljags yangs glog 'od rtse dgas 'gror 'khyud bzhin/ /gsung dbyangs 'brug sgra gcig gis mtha' dag 'gro/ /ma rig gnyid 'thug g.yur las skad cig bslang / /gsung dbyangs 'khor lo bdud rtsi'i phyogs rdzogs zla/ /cha shas ga bur zegs ma 'dzum pas kyang / /zhi bsil thig le 'gro rgyud chu snod bzhin / /'god pa'i ngo mtshar srid gsum dogs por mdzad/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin bde gshegs chos kyi sku/ /'gro 'ong skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur ga la zhig /gang 'dul rjes su 'dzin phyir rol pa'i gar/ /gshegs dang bzhud pa'i cho 'phrul du mar 'gyed/ /chos sku nam mkha' mkha' khyab ting 'dzin las/ /g.yo ba med bzhin bzhin lag sgyu ma'i gar/ ོ/bcu rgenyis mdzad mchog mchog gi sprul sku'i tshul/ོ /'gro 'dir rab ston ston mchog khyod nyid rgyal/ byu /zheso bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'o// ོgnyis pa la/ gdams ngag la yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir chos kyi che ba spyi 107—291

dang / khyad par bka' thams cad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs su gzhol tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ lung rtogs kyi chos spyir bstan pa dang / lung gi chos kyi che ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos zhes bya ba don bcu la 'jug tshul rnam bshad rig pa las gsung ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi sgra don rnams gong du bshad zin la/ dam pa'i chos de la dbye na sngar drangs pa ltar ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ sogs lung gi chos dang /rtogs pa'i chos gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rtogs pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i rjod byed te/ de yang rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can thob pa'i thabs ji ltar bsgrub par bya ba'i rim pa ma nor bar ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ste/ de ni thos bsam gyis nges par byas pa las rtogs pa'i chos bsgrub pa lag tu len pa'i tshul gtan la 'bebs par byed pa yin la/ de'i dbye ba'i tshul sogs rgyas par ni 'og tu de ma thag tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa'i chos ni/ de ltar gtan la phab pa'i don yang dang yang du yid la byed cing / rtse gcig nang du yang dag par 'jog pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mngon du 'gyur ba ste/ de la dbye na/ thob bya'i 'bras bu 'gog bden dang / thob byed lam gyi bden pa gnyis yod de/ rgyud bla ma las/ bsam med gnyis med rtog pa med/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang / /lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus/ /zhes dang / kun btus las/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa yang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye bas 'gog pa 107—292

dang ske/ lam gyi bden pa dag go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang thob byed kyi lam gyi ngos skal gyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i cha de la 'gog bden zhes brjod de/ sde bdun las/ 'gog pa'i bden pa ni lam gyi spangs bya'i sa bon ci rigs spangs pa'i bral ba zhes gsungs/ bsam med sogs gsum gyi don dar ṭika las/'gog pa'i bden pa mtha' bzhi po gang du yang bsam du med pa dang / rtsa ba las dang nyon mongs pa ci rigs pa med pa dang / gzhi bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa med pa dang / zhes dang / thogs 'grel las/ rnam par rtog pa ni las dang nyon mongs pa kun tu 'byung ba'i rgyu tshul bzhin ma yi na pa yid la byed pa/ zhes gsungs / de la theg pa gsum gyi 'gog bden gsum yod/ 'gog bden thob byed kyi thabs su gyur pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi lam la lam bden zhes bya ste/mdzod las/ zag med lam gyi bden pa dang / /zhes dang / rgyud bla mar/dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /zhes gsungs/ dag gsal sogs gsum gyi don dar ṭika las/ dag pa ni lam gyi ngo bo sgrib pa dang ma 'dres pa'o / /mngon par gsal bar byed pa ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rig pa'o/ /gnyen po'i phyogs nyid ni nus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la dbye na theg pa gsum gyi mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum yod do/ /spyir lung rtogs kyi chos la chos kyi 'khor lo zhes pa'i tha snyad gsungs te/ de yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ston pa thugs rje can gyis bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor te lnga sde'i rgyud la mthong lam bskyed nas bstan pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa'i lung rtogs kyi chos thog mar byung ba na/ lha rnams kyis a la la 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mthong zhes bsgrags pa'i phyir ro/ /dam pa'i chos la ci'i phyir chos 107—293

kyi 'khor lo zhes bya zhe na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis te/ 'khor lo rin po che de yul gzhan dang gzhan du rim gyis 'pho ba dang / de'i dbang gis mi mthun pa'i phyog las rgyal bar byed pa bzhin du/ lung rtogs kyi chos de yang gdul bya'i rgyud la rim gyis 'pho ba dang / 'dod chags sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rgyal bar byed pas na de ltar bshad de/ bsdu ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por kun shes kauṇ+ḍi na'i rgyud la kun shes pa'i chos nyid dang mthun par rab tu bskor la/des kyang gzhan dag la rab tu bskor ba dang / de dag gis kyang gzhan dag la rab tu bskor bar 'gyur te/ des na gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de bskor bas na 'khor lo/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la sogs pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin can yin pas na chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos la dbye ba yang na 'bras bu'i chos/ sgrub pa'i chos/ bshad pa'i chos gsum ste/de rnams spyir bstan pa dang / bshad pa'i chos bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la 'bras bu'i chos thar pa'am myang 'das la bya ste/ de yang gang las thar pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rang dbang med par nyid mtshams sbyor ba'i rgyun las ldog pa'i thar pa dang / sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya/ de la gang zhi ba ni bdun te/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba dang / 'phrad pa dang / bral ba dang /'dod pa ma 'byor ba/ phung po'i sdug bsngal zhi ba nyid do/ /de lta bu'i myang 'das kyi ngo bo ni/ bye brag smra ba rnams ni nyon sgrib spangs par gyur pa'i ma yin dgag gi dngos po zhig la 'dod cing / mdo sde pa yan chad rnams ni myang 107—294

'das kyi ngo bo med dgag tu bzhed pa yin te/ de la glo bur rnam dag gi phyogs dang —/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi phyogs gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis nyon sgrib sa bon dang bcas pa slar skye mi rung gi chos can du byas pa la 'jog /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag dang /chos bdag ci rigs bkags pa'i nyon sgrib spangs pa'i khyad par du byas pa'i med dgag gcig la 'jog go/ /dbu ma thal 'gyur ba rnams 'gog bden la don dam bden pas khyab par bzhed pas myang 'das la don dam bden pas khyab par bzhed/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams ni/ myang 'das la bden pa gnyis ku'i cha yod par bzhed do/ /myang 'das la dbye na/ theg chen pa'i myang 'das dang / theg dman gyi myang 'das gnyis yod do/ /de'i dang po ni/srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das dang don gcig go/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i chos ni/ lam ste 'bras bu'i chos de thob byed kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'dis mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du phyin par byed pa yin gyi/ 'khor ba'i grong khyer du phyin par byed pa ma yin pas yod pa ma yin pa dang / myang 'das dang 'brel bas bar ma chod cing mi 'gyur bas rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i chom pos mi 'phrog pas gnod pa med pa dang / chos la dga' ba'i zas dang ldan pas nye bar ston pa rnams so/ /gsum pa bshad pa'i chos ni/ lam gyi chos gsal bar byed pa'i rjod byed kyi ngag bya ba bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di ni lam yin no zhes nye bar nyan pa nyid dang / 'di nyid lam yin gyi gzhan ni ma yin no/ /zhes nges par byed pa dang / dran pa nye bar bzhag 107—295

pa la sogs pa 'di ni lam gyi rgyu yin no/ /zhes de'i tshogs gsal bar byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang / las dang / rnam smin gyi tshe'i sgrib pa 'di ni lam gyi gegs byed pa yin no/ /zhes sgrib pa rab tu nye bar ston pa dang bzhi'o/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ ston pa nyi ma'i gnyen gcig 'jig rten 'dir//bcu gnyis mdzad mchog rnam par rol pa yang / /gdul bya nges legs sa la bkri phyir te/ /de ni lung rtogs chos kyi 'khor lo nyid/ /lung gi chos 'khor gsung gsang bdud rtsi yis/ /bskyangs pas rtogs pa'i chos 'khor 'gog lam mchog /spangs rtogs lus stobs dar ba'i rtsal gsum gyi/ /gom stabs kun mkhyen sa la 'god par 'gyur/ /lung rtogs chos kyi 'khor lo'i mu khyud rlabs/ /'gro rgyud ri gling gcig nas gcig 'pho zhing / /las nyon mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /kun mkhyen 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal sar spyod/ /kun nyon dra bar bsdoms pa'i nyer len khur/ /shes rab ral gri rnon po'i 'phrul 'khor gyis / /bral ba'i zhi ba gya rnam bla med pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa de ni 'bras bu'i chos/ /bden bzhi'i rnam pa brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i 'dzum/ /mngon sum spyod pa'i ltad mor 'byams klas pa/ /kun nyon skyo ba 'gog pa'i lam dag ni/ /thar pa 'bras bu'i dbyings de sgrub pa'i chos/ /srid pa'i 'brog dgon stug por phyogs bslad pa'i/ /don mthun bde ba'i lam du dbug dbyung ba/ /legs gdams sbrang chang dngar po'i mchod yon ni/ /bstab pa ji ltar sgrub pa bshad pa'i chos/ /tshul bzhin 'doms las las nyon 'gog pa'i tshul/ /de bzhin yid la la 'ur byed pa de/ /mngon mtho nges legs legs tshogs mtha' dag kun / byu nga/'bad med thob 'gyur 'gyur med brtson 'ogs 'obungs/ /zhes bya ba 107—296 sto sgo

ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa lung gi chos kyi che ba bye brag tu bshad pa la/ bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis te/ ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du/ /legs par gsung dang de yi dgongs 'grel pa/ /de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa 'di/ /'jig rten khams su yun ring gnas par 'gyur / /zhes so/ /bka' la mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba gsum las/dang po ni/ don smra sde gnyis kyis bka' dang bstan bcos ming tshig yi ge gsum tshogs par 'dod pa mthun kyang / bye smras sgra'i phreng ba'i tshogs spyi ldan min 'du byed dang rdzas grub tu 'dod/ mdo sde pas de gsum ngag gi rang bzhin sgra rang mtshan dang gzugs phung du 'dod de/ mdzod rtsa las/ gang rnams thub pa'i gsung de dag /tshig gam ming yin de dag ni/ /gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu 'dus/ /zhes dang / legs bshad gser 'phreng las/gnyis gas kyang ming tshig tshogs pa bka'i rang bzhin du 'dod pa dang / zhes dang ske/ gcig ni tshogs gsum sgra spyi'i phreng bar 'dod pas ldan min dang /zhes dang / gcig ni de gsum ngag gi rig byed kyi sgra rang mtshan la 'dod pas gzugs kyis bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na brjod bya don ldan gyi chos dang nye bar 'brel zhing / byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs su gyur pa/ 'bras bu zhi ba myang 'das kyi phan yon ston pa'i ngag /bdag rkyen gyi gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la brten nas 'byung ba ste/ spobs pa bzhi ldan gyi gsung rab/ bka'i 'jog byed dam mtshan nyid yin te/ rgyud 187—297
