mchi / zhes gsungs pa'i lan du/ bu ji srid sa thob kyi bar du khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni nga nyid do zhes gsungs te mi snang bar 'gyur te zhes 'byung ngo / /slob dpon 'di 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dang po yi ge na zhes pa/ /lho yi phyogs su yang dag brten/ /bsheg nyid chen po sngags bzlos ldan/ /nges par byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma las kyang lung bstan to/ /des tshad ma kun las btus rang 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams shing / de'i slob ma dbang phyug sdes 'grel bshad kyang mdzad do/ /slob dpon chos kyi grags pa ni/ lho phyogs rgyal dbang gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya bar mu stegs kyi bram ze'i rigs su skyes te/ chung ngu la sgra legs par 'byongs nas / zhang po mu stegs kyi ston pa gzhon nu legs ldan la mu stegs kyi rab tu byung ba'i chas blangs pas/ ngan du smras te bskrad do/ /der mu stegs thams cad pham par byed pa zhig bya'o snyam ste/ nang pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas sbyangs par mdzad cing / slob dpon dbang phyug sde la tshad ma kun las btus tshar gsum nyan pas/ gnyis pa slob dpon las kyang mkhas par gyur te slob dpon yang shin tu mnyes nas/ khyod kyis nga'i grub mtha' nor ba rnams phyogs sngar gyis la kun las btus la 'grel pa yang rtsoms shig ces rjes su gnang ngo / /de nas slob dpon chos grags kyis grangs can gyi grub mtha'i gsang tshig shes pa'i ched du zhang po'i chung ma'i g.yog byas nas mgu bar byas pas/ grub mtha'i gsang tshig dri dgos byas pas 'dod pa spyod pa'i tshe 'dri yi/ khyod rang yid la zungs zer nas de bzhin byas pas legs par shes so/ /de nas mkhas pa yod na rtsod par byed do/ /zhes dril bsgrags pas/ phal cher yul gzhan du bros/107—446

rtsod pa byas pa rnams rigs pas tshar bcad de chos kyi lam la bkod nas/gal te chos kyi grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub gyur na/ /chos rnams gnyid log yang na shi /chos ma yin rnams da gdod longs/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon rim gyis grong khyer dang ljongs rgyu zhing / mthar rgyal po me tog rgyas pa'i sgo drung du phyin pa na/ rgyal pos da lta su mkhas dris pas/ shes rab can gyi mchog ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /tsan+d+ra go mi brjod pa rnam par dag /snyan ngag dpa' bo las byung sdeb sbyor mkhas/ /me tog kun tu rgyas pa longs spyod ldan/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su/ /zhes gsungs pas/rgyal po na re/ dharma kirti yin nam zer/ de skad du'ang grags gsungs pas/rgyal pos gdan drangs te sbyin bdag byas/ rab tu byed pa sde bdun dang /rnam 'grel gyi le'u dang po'i rang 'grel mdzad de/ bstan bcos rnams mkhas pa'i grwar 'grims pas phal cher gyis ma shes/ la las shes kyang phrag dog gis nyes zhes bsgrags te khyi mjug la btags pas slob dpon na re/ khyi grong dang srang kun tu rgyu bzhin bstan bcos kyang dar bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon 'di yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan te/ yi ge dha zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /lho yi phyogs su rnam par bsgrags/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog nas kyang / /de bzhin sdom brtson sngags kyang 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /slob dpon des paṇ+ḍi ta lha dbang blo la 'grel pa rtsom par bka' gnang bas lan gcig brtsams te gzigs su phul bas chus bkrus/ yang brtsams pas mes bsreg /phyis brtsams nas phul bas 'phros dang / tshig zur gyis mtshon pa'i don rnams ma byung bar 'dug ste/ dngos bstan gyi don tsam byung 'dug 187—447

gsungs / de'i slob ma shākya blos 'grel bshad byas/ de'i slob ma rgyan mkhan pos spur las lung blangs te 'grel pa mdzad/ dzam ri'i rgyan la 'grel bshad byas so/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phar phyin rang las mkhas pa 'phags pa rnam grol sde ni/ yul dbus lho phyogs kyi mtshams sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi dbon sras su 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nyid nas rab tu byung / gtsug lag khang du ma'i bdag po/ gnas ma bu pa ku ru kul+le pa'i sde pa/ sa rab tu dga' ba thob ste/ des byams mgon la dngos su nyan nas mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa nyi khri snang ba mdzad/ mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i thog ma 'di yin no/ /btsun pa rnam grol sde ni gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / sde snod gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ 'phags pa grol sde las sher phyin gyi man ngag gsan nas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ sreg blugs 'bum phrag bcu gnyis phul ba'i byams mgon gyi zhal gzigs/ mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i gzhung nyi khri rnam 'grel mdzad do/ /slob dpon mchog gi sde dang / dul ba'i sde yang sher phyin gyi don mngon du mdzad nas rgya cher spel bar mdzad do/ /slob dpon chen po shan+ta rak+ṣi ta'am zhi ba 'tsho ni/ shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ khyim las yid 'byung ste rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor nas mkhan po ye shes snying po'i drung du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa las bcas rang gi nyes pa phra mos kyang ma gos pas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas/ sde snod gsum la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ khyad par slob dpon dul ba'i sde las sher phyin gyi man ngag gsan te tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs rnams la'ang sbyangs pa thugs su chud 107—448

par mdzad/ dbu ma rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pamadzad de 'phags yul du bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam chos kyi sgron me spar bar bzhed nas sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang / rten 'brel dus su 'dzoms dgos pas bod je khri srong lde btsan ma byon par dgung lo brgya phrag dgu'i bar byin gyis brlabs te bzhugs/ bod du bstan pa'i don mdzad tshul ni 'og tu ston par 'gyur/ sku tshe'i stod smad bar gsum gyi slob ma rim pa mang du yod cing / sras kyi thu bo 'gran zla dang bral ba slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang ske/ mkhas mchog ka ma la shī la'o/ /slob dpon seng ge bzang po ni rgyal rigs las rab tu byung / phyi nang gi grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas pa/khyad par du yum gyi don la ring du goms pa zhig ste/ des rang gi mkhan po rnam snang mdzad bzang po la byams pa'i sgrub thabs zhus nas bsgrub pas rmi lam du dge slong gur gum gyi mdog can spyod lam shin tu mdzes pa zhig rmis te/ shar phyogs kha sarba ṇir songs shig ces lung bstan to/ /sang der song nas zhag gsum du smyung gnas byas te rmi lam brtags pas rmi lam na o tan+ta pu ri bi ha ri'i garnyo la'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ sprin phung 'thug po zhig gi gseb na lha'i bu lus sprin gyi gseb nas phyungs nas mchod pa byed par mthong nas ci byed dris pasal/ rje btsun byams pa brgyad stong gsungs pa la mchod pa byed pa yin zer bas ring du bltas pas/ rje btsun zhal gser gyi mdog can spyi gtsug mchod rten gyis spras pa/ phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa tsam zhig mthong nas phyag dang mchod pa byas te nyid kyi bstan bcos la 'grel pa mang du mchis na gang gi rjes su 'jug par bgyi zhus pas/ thams cad kyi gzhung legs par 187—449

rtogs la 'thad pa bsdus te/ khyod kyis phyogs gcig tu rtsoms shig ces gnang ba thob bo/ /mnal sad de mchod pa byas nas bstan bcos brtsams pa'i sbyin bdag btsal ba'i phyir shar nas nub tu byon pa na/ rgyal po sa skyong gis yum 'chad pa la slob dpon seng ge bzang po mkhas par thos te/ gdan 'dren btang ba'i pho nya dang 'phrad nas gdan drangs te/ nyi khri bsdus don le brgyad ma / brgyad stong 'grel chen rgyan snang / 'grel pa don gsal/ bsdus don rtogs par sla ba/ sher phyin sgom pa la sogs pa mdzad ces grags la/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ dpal ldan chos skyong gis sbyin bdag byas nas/ tsha ba gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du byas par bshad de/ dpal ldan chos skyong ni sa skyong gi yab mes yin par grags so/ /de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis rang gi slob ma gu ṇa mi tras bskul nas bsdus 'grel brtsams/ gsang 'dus la lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad do/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa yon tan 'od ni/ rgya cher 'grel las / 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po/bram ze'i btsun pa yon tan 'od bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i snying khus shes rab kyi dbang po rgyas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dam pa nan tan snying por sgrub pa/ zhes byung ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa des lo bzhi brgyar bzhugs nas 'dul ba'i mdo/ de'i rang 'grel/ kurma sha tam/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad cing / mdo rtsa la chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis rgya cher 'grel mdzad de/ de yon tan 'od kyi slob mar yang kha cig 107—450

'dod do/ /slob dpon shākya 'od ni/ ma ga dhar bzhugs pa'i mkhan po bsod nams grags pa dang / zhi ba 'od kyi slob mar 'od ldan las bshad cing /des 'dul ba sum brgya pa dang rang 'grel 'od ldan mdzad do/ /zhi ba 'tsho'i sku tshe smad kyi slob ma mkhas mchog kā ma la shrī la ni/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ sde snod gsum la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ rgya gar du yang bstan pa'i don rgya chen po mdzad cing / mkhan chen zhi 'tsho'i lung bstan ltar bod du byon nas hwa shang ma hā ya na'i ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i lta ba ngan pa sun phyungs te/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta sgom gsal bar mdzad pas bod la shin tu bka' drin che/ slob dpon 'dis dbu ma'i sgom rim gsum dang / dbu ma snang ba sogs mdzad do/ /seng ge bzang po'i slob ma ku sā li che ba'am rin chen bzang po yang rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/sangs rgyas gsang ba/ blo gros brtan pa sogs la brten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma ku sā li chung ba rin chen sde ni/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ ku sā li che ba bsten nas sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas par sbyangs/ sa lam gyi nyams rtogs spyi dang / khyad par bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems khyad par can thugs rgyud la mnga' bla ma 'dis chos gsungs pa'i rtsar gzhan zhig gis khyi la dbyug pa brgyab par/ bla mas a zhes gsungs nas 'gyel ba/ gzhan gyis rtog pa la khyi la ci yang mi sto 'dug pa tshul 'chos re che snyam pa la/ bla mas mkhyen nas sku rgyab bstan pas/khyi la rgyab pa'i thad la khyur re spang 'dug pas thams cad yid ches/ chu bo 107—451

gaṅgā'i 'gram la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom zhing nyams mgur mdzad pas rje btsun byams mgon dngos su byon nas bsngags brjod mdzad/ mi dang mi ma yin dang / dud 'gro la sogs pa srog chags rnams kyang sems zhi bar gyur nas gus par byed do/ /slob ma'ang mang du yod pa las gtso bo dpal mar me mdzad do/ /sems dpa' chen po gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa ni/gser gling rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ gling de ni dzasbu'i gling dang cung zad nye ba'i rgya mtsho'i dkyil du gser dngul sogs rin po che mang po'i 'byung khungs yod pa'i yul shin tu bde skyid che ba zhig ste/ yul nyer bzhi'i gas su war+ṇa dī pa zhes pa de yin par grags/ rgyal sras 'di 'khrungs ma thag tu si na si na zhes skyabs 'gro'i tshig rgyun du gsungs par/ yul der mu stegs dar ba'i skabs yin kyang rgyal sras su song bas sus kyang bzlog ma nus/ rgyal bu de cher skyes nas ri phug cig nas ston pa'i sku li ma zhig rnyed/ de la mchod pa byas pas yul de shin tu bkra shis par gyur/ des gser gling pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas rgyal bu 'di chos tshol du btang ba drag zer bas/ rgyal bu shin tu dgyes nas 'dzam bu'i gling du byon/ mkhas pa dang grub pa mang du 'dus kyang mos pa ma skyes/ ma hā shrī rat+na la mos pa cher skyes nas zhag bdun 'grogs pas slob dpon med par song / rgyal bus phyogs kun tu btsal kyang ma rnyed pas ngal nas gnyid log pa'i rmi lam du byis pa gnyis glu len par/ rang yul 'khor dang longs spyod bor/ /zhes sogs zer ba rmis/ des rgyal bu gnyis sad pa na slob dpon ma hā shrī rat+na zhes skyes mchog byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa dngos su bzhugs pa mthong / dad gus tshad med pas gsol ba btab pas/107—452

bla ma de dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas par sbyangs/mtshan yang gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa zhes grags/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya chen po mnga'/ khyad par bdag gzhan mnyam brje byang chub kyi sems rlabs po che thugs la 'khrungs te/ de dus rgya gar shar nub kun la byang chub kyi sems kyi bdag por grags/ gser gling du byon nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgya cher spel zhing mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan pa thams cad nub par mdzad/mdo rgyan ma sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dang / blo sbyong sems pa'i rim pa sogs mdo sngags kyi gsung rab kyang mang du mdzad/ slob ma yang mang du byung zhing sras kyi thu bo 'gran zla med pa ni jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad do/ /jo bo chen po dpal ldan mar me mdzad dam a ti sha ni/ shar phyogs r+ghaṃ ga la'i yul za hor rgyal po zhes stobs 'byor mnga' thang shin tu che ba zhig gi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams/ chung ngu nas rje btsun sgrol mas rgyun du zhal gzigs shing / bya ba gal che rnams sgrol ma nyid la zhus nas mdzad/ 'khrungs nas zla ba bco brgyad lon pa na yab rgyal pos lha khang du gdan drangs par skyabs 'gro'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / lam du 'bangs kyi skye bo rnams gzigs pas snying rje chen pos tshigs su bcad pa rang chas su gsungs/ dgung lo drug lon pa na rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i tshe rtog ge pa mkhas par grags pa zhig dang rtsod pas pham par mdzad/yab rgyal pos btsun mo khab tu bzhes pa'i grab byas kyang skye ba mang por goms pas srid pa'i phun tshogs srin mo'i bslu brid ltar gzigs pas khyim nas 'byung 187—453

bar rings/ bla ma dze ta ri dang / byang chub bzang po/ rig pa'i khu byug /a wa dhu tī pa sogs kyi zhabs la gtug nas sems bskyed dang gdams ngag gsan / khyad par bla ma a wa dhu tī pas lung bstan pa bzhin ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang gi bla ma rā hu la gup+ta las dbang rdzogs par gsan cing / zhag bcu gsum la rim gnyis kyi khrid dang rtogs pa rdzogs par mdzad/ rgyal srid las phyungs te a wa dhu tī pa'i spyod pas dngos grub brnyes pa'i bla ma du ma'i spyan sngar rdo rje theg pa la sbyangs pas shin tu mkhas par gyur/ lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs / ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes rgya chen po thob/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas myur du 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam du dgongs pa na/ he ru ka dang /thub pa'i dbang po sogs kyis brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas gar yang mi phyin/ rab tu byung dang phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la phan par 'gyur zhes bskul ba ltar phal chen pa'i sde pa shī la rak+ṣi ta las rab tu byung / mtshan dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes gsol/sde snod gsum dang / bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo mtha' chod par sbyangs/ sde pa bco brgyad po kun gyis gtsug gi nor bur bkur/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi srog shing byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa nyid kyi thugs la mnga' yang rgya mtsho chu'i mi ngoms pa bzhin du byang chub sems sbyong gi man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa gsan phyir rgya mtsho chen por zla ba bcu gsum gyi ring gru rdzings bcas nas bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du phebs/ theg pa chen po'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i man ngag spyi dang / khyad par byams pa nas thogs med la rgyud pa dang /'jam dbyangs nas klu sgrub la brgyud pa/ 'jam dbyangs nas zhi ba lha la brgyud pa sogs byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul 107—454

du gsan nas lo bcu gnyis bar gser gling pa'i spyan sngar bzhugs/ gser gling gi thub dbang gi gser sku de yang jo bo'i phyag tu phul nas bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas rgya gar du tshur phebs te bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po mdzad cing bzhugs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di la klu sgrub las lhag pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta med cing / klu sgrub kyis mkhyen pa 'dis mi mkhyen pa med par grags / mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan pa lan gsum du tshar bcad/ rgyal khab phan tshun dmag 'dren pa zlum par mdzad de skye rgu rnams bde ba la bkod/ gtsug lag khang bco brgyad kyi bdag po mdzad nas bstan pa rgya cher spel/ de'i tshe rgya gar shar nub dbus dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis gtsug gi nor bur bkur te rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba rang nyid slar byon pa lta bu gyur/ de nas sngon gyi thugs bskyed btsan pos bod du phebs te bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad de/ de'i tshul 'og tu 'chad do/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i yul gyi slob dpon grags che ba 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar sgo bstan pa tsam brjod cing /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po in+d+ra bho dhi/ sa ra ha/ sha ba ri/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ra pa/ nag po pa/ la lī ta / pad+ma badz+ra/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ khosnyi pa/ birlu pa sogs grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ji snyed cig byon te zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas mod/ 'dir paṇa grub mtha' dag gi rnam par thar pa ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das shing rags rim de tsam mo/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad na/ mkhas mchog dbyig gi gnyen po'i gsung skyes tshogs/ /rang las mkhas pa rnam bzhir grags pa yi/ /107—455

snyan pa'i dri bzang dri yi bzhon pa yis/ /btegs pa da dung mi nyams 'gro 'dir rgyu/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho rnam dpyod hub gcig gis/ /sto bar bskyil ba blo brtan dza hu nu/ /phug ron gyur dang dad pas gsung byon sogs/ /ngo mtshar 'di 'dra dad pa'i gsos su che/ /tshad ma kun las mkhas pa phyogs glang zhes / /grags snyan mkhas kun snying du lang tsho bzhin/ /brgya phrag lnga yi mdo sde zhal 'don mdzad/ /bstan pa'i 'khor los nam 'dod mchog kyang sbyin/ /bstan dang ston pa tshad mar bsgrub pa yi/ /rigs tshul glog zhags 'bum phrag 'od kyi rlabs/ /mkhyen pa'i ba gam gcig las spros pa yis/ /sa gsum nges legs snang ba gsar par spyod/ /'dul gzhung rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur brtan mkhas kyi/ /yon tan gdengs ka rab brjid yon tan 'od/ /thub dbang gnyis pa ji bzhin khyod gsung kyang / /mdo zhes mkhas kun gtsug gi nor bur gyur / /'phags pa'i sa brnyes 'phags mchog grol sde zhes/ /sher phyin zab don mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing / /byams mgon gsung gis dbugs dbyung mdo dang rgyan/ /sbyar ba'i legs bshad dbang gi do shal spel/ /rigs tshul rdo rje rtse brgya'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /rgol ngan sa 'dzin rkang pa 'thag byed pa'i/ /skabs gsum dbang po dpal ldan chos kyi grags/ /spangs rtogs sa srung gnya' bar 'gying 'di bsngags/ /btsun pa grol sde mchog sde dul ba'i sde/ /kun kyang byams pa mgon pos rjes su bzung / /sher phyin gzhung brgya smra ba'i spobs pa dang / /mkhas shing grub pa'i sa la gshegs pa mtshungs/ /rgya gar yul du 'khrungs kyang gangs can 'gror/ /mi mnyam bka' drin lhag pa zhi ba 'tsho/ /khri srong lde btsan byon par sku tshe ni/ /brgya phrag dgu'i bar byin gyis brlabs 187—456

te bzhugs/ /de tshe khri srong rje dang sba gsal snang / /rnam gsum thugs bskyed dus su 'dzoms pa yis/ /rgyal bstan snang ba dkar pos kai la sha'i/ /'khor yug 'od chags mog por bsgrub par mdzad/ /seng bzang ka ma la shī ku sā li/ /rig pa'i khu byug gser gling mar me mdzad/ /paṇa grub skar tshogs thub bstan kun gsal gyi/ /lang tshor spud pa'i ngo mtshar ji ltar 'gran/ /log smra smra ngan ji tsam mkhas kyang te/ /gang 'dul 'dul bya de tsam 'dul byed kyang kyo/ byu /gsung rab rab 'byams de bzhin paṇ+ḍa grub rnya/ /sa 'di 'di ltar rin chen khur gyis borjide/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs du brtsod pa'i bsnyad pa'o//gnyis pa bod kyi yul du bstan pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la/ thog mar bod yul ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ kha ba can gyi mtsho bri nas/ /sā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyis lung bstan pa kha ba can gyi yul 'di nyid sangs rgyas sku dngos kyis 'dul ba'i zhing du ma gyur/ sems can rnams la 'phags mchog thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs shing 'dul zhing du rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/ gnas lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas ka ba shing lo can gyi byang ngos nas bzhes pa'i bka' chems bka' 'khol ma dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs gangs can gyi ljongs na dar ro cog gi thugs rje chen po'i chos skor du ma zhig dgongs pa'i khog gcig pa las/ bod 'dir spre'u dang brag srin mo lhan cig tu 'dus pa'i phru gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs las chad pa bshad pa ltar/rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i mngal khur las thon pa'i 107—457

gsung gi snang bas bskul ba la brten nas/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams su 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon pos gzigs pa dri ma med pa'i 'dren byed kyis gzigs pa na/ stod mnga' ris kyi cha ni glang po che dang ri dwags kyi yul/bar dbus gtsang gi cha ni ri dwags dang spre'u'i yul/ smad mdo khams kyi cha ni spre'u dang brag srin gyi yul/ de yang stod g.ya' ri/ bar brag dang spang ljongs/smad rtsi shing dang nags tshal gyi yal ga stug pos dbyig 'dzin gos su klubs pa lta bur rgyu ba'i 'gro ba kun kyang srog gcod sogs ngan song gi rgyu la bag med du longs spyod pa'i rkyen gyis yul gru de dag gi 'og tu mi zad pa'i duḥkha'i 'byung gnas dmyal ba'i khams lcags kyi za ma tog 'dra ba'i nang du lhung bar ye shes kyi gzigs pas mkhyen nas 'phags pa rnam gsum bka'i bgro ba las thog mar 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'dul ba'i phul du byung ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs te 'phags pa phyag stong spyan stong gi sku'i rnam pas lha sa'i thad kyi 'dzin ma'i ngos su byon pas dmyal ba'i gnas kyang yid du 'ong ba'i 'chi med bdag po'i dga' ba'i tshal la skyengs pa ster bar gyur pa lta bu'i snang ba dang bcas te der gnas pa'i sprin mgrin phal cher lha'i bde ba la spyod par dbugs dbyung nas/ bod kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad par yang dud 'gro ni glen zhing gti mug pa'i ngang tshul can la blang dor gyi gnas tshul bzhin blta ba'i mthu med pas mi'i rigs spel bar dgongs / 'phags pa'i thugs rjes rigs bsgyur ba'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' zhig dang / 'phags ma sgrol ma'i byin rlabs kyis ri dwags gzugs brnyan blo'i zla gzhon dwangs pa'i ngos su shar ba'i brag srin mo gnyis tshogs pa las rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i spyod tshul mi 'dra ba'i phru gu drug byung ba yang /107—458

pha rigs rnams 'char sgo myur zhing snying rje che ba khog grims pa/ ma rigs rnams gdong dmar sdig las la rngams shing ro gyong ba byung ba de dag las rim par 'phel bas bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur to/ /lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel las kyang de dang mthun par 'byung ngo / /de yang rgyal phran sil ma mang du byung yang 'phags pa mchog gis byin gyis brlabs pa ma mchis shing / khyad par yongs la mnga' bsgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig med na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'byung dka' bar dgongs nas/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa zhes bya ba las sras 'phags pa'i byin rlabs kyis byad gzugs mi las 'das pa zhig bltams te/ mig yas 'gebs su yod pa/ g.yu'i smin ma/dung so 'khor mar yod pa/ lag pa 'khor lo'i yan lag can lta bur yod pa'i mtshan ldan zhig byung ba/ yab kyis lha 'dre'i sprul par dgongs nas spyugs pas/pad dkar 'dzin pa'i ye shes mchog gi 'od zer gyis snang ba bsgyur nas/ lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la byon nas gzigs pas/ yar klungs kyi yul ni mtho ris kyi yon tan sa la 'phos pa ltar bzang zhing / yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di lhun po'i mdzes sdug la chags pa'i chu shel gyi dbang po nya gang bas 'khyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha ri rol pa'i rtse la gshegs nas lha skas la babs te/ btsan thang sgo bzhir zhabs zung gi 'khor lo bskyod pas bon po sogs yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis phyugs skyong bas mthong ste gang nas 'ongs zhes gtam dris par/mkha' la mdzub mo ker bas lha las chad par go nas bod khams kyi rjer 'os so zhes gnya' bar khri byas btegs nas 'ongs pas rje gnya' khri btsan por grags la / deb sngon du khri btsun po 'od ldan zhes pa dang don gcig /rje 'dis pho 107wa 459

brang yum bu bla sgang brtsigs/ tshe mi gshen gyi dmu rgyal gyis bon bsgyur/ de dang gnam mug mug gi sras mu khri btsun po/ de dang sa ding ding gi sras ding khri btsan po/ de dang so tham tham gyi sras so khri btsan po/ de dang don mer mer gyi sras mer khri btsan po/ de dang gdags kyi lha mo dkar mo'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de dang srib kyi lha mo'i sras srib khri btsan po/ 'di rnams rmu thag la byas nas nam mkha' la yal bas bang so med par grags shing / gnam gyi khri bdun no/ /srib khri btsan po dang / sa btsun rlung rje'i sras gri gum btsan po/de dang klu btsan mer sras gsum byung yang / blon po lo ngam dang 'thab pas rgyal po bkrongs/ bod du khyab kyi thog ma 'di'i dus su rmar khams nas blangs/sras rnams yab mes kyi dkor mdzod nas rte'u glang ru dkar zhes pa'i glang 'phur shes la zhon nas kong po'i phyogs su bros shing yun cig blon pos rgyal srid bzung / mi ring bar rgyal po'i btsun mo dang yar lha sham po'i sprul pa gcig 'dus pa las byung ba'i blon po ru las skyes kyis lo ngam bsad de/ sras bya khri rgyal sar bskos/ rje gri gum nas rmu thag chad pas pur byung ba zangs kyi ga'ur bcug ste lcags gzer btab nas chu la bskyur ba kong chu rlag tu 'khyer ba chu srin bye ma lag ring gis rnyed nas jo mor phul ba mdzod du sbas pa las bton nas/'phying yul dar thang du bang so brtsigs te bang so'i thog ma yin zhing / yum gyis lha la dmod pa bor bas nam mkha' nas khyod kyi bu de kun las rgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i sgra byung bas bya khri'i mtshan la spu de gung rgyal zer/ yab kyi ring la zhang zhung dang / bru sha'i gshen gyi dur bon byung zhing / sras kyi ring la sku mkhar phying nga stag rtse brtsigs/ sgrung dang lde'u gnam bon gshen chen po 187—460

byung / ru las skyes dang / sras lha bu mgo dkar te blon po gnyis kyi ring /chu yur bar drangs/ spang zhing du rmos/ rdo bzhu bas dngul zangs lcags gsum bton/ chu la zam pa btsugs/ rgyal po de dag bar gyi steng gnyis yin/bang so g.ya' dang rdza la btab bo/ /spu de gung rgyal dang bom thang rmang mnya'i sras e sho legs/ de dang rmu lcam bla ma na'i sras de sho legs/ de dang klu sman mer mo'i sras kyi sho legs/ de dang btsan mo gur sman gyi sras gu ru legs/de dang mtsho sman 'brangs ma'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams sa'i legs drug ste bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab bo/ /i sho legs dang rmu lcam smad legs kyi sras za nam zin lde/ de dang mtsho sman khri dkar gyi sras lde 'phrul gnam gzhung btsan/ de dang se snyan mang ma'i sras se snol gnam lde/ de dang klu mo mer ma'i sras se snol so lde/ de dang 'o ma ste mo mcho'i sras lde snol nam/ de dang khri sman rje ma'i sras lde snol po/ de dang se btsun gnyan rje'i sras lde rgyal po/de dang sman btsun lug sgong gi sras lde sprin btsan/ de dag lde brgyad de bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab bo/ /lde sprin btsan dang nyi btsun mang ma rje'i sras/rgyal po ti long btsan 'di yan chad kyi rgyal po rnams lha klu'i bu mo 'ba' zhig btsun mor bsten pas yum rnams grongs pa'i tshe pur ma byung zhing / 'di man nas 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te/ rgyal po ti long btsan dang 'o ma sde bza' 'bri btsun byang ma'i sras su khri btsan nam/ de dang sman bza' khri dkar gyi sras la khri sgra dpung btsan/ de dang sman bza' klu steng gi sras khri thog rje btsan te gdung rabs nyer bdun gyi ring chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs pa yin/ khri rje thog btsan dang / ru yong za stong rgyal chan mo mtsho'i sras su 107—461

dpal dge legs kun tu 'bar ba'i bzang po'i snang ba can gyi rnam 'phrul/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan 'khrungs te/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi yang thog gi steng du spang skong phyag rgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa/ tsin+dha ma ṇi'i skos phor rnams mkha' las babs te / gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan gyi sgra nam mkha' las grags pas/ ngo mi shes pa ltar bcos kyang / ngo mtshar du bzung nas / pho brang gi dkor khang du ming gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthus rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu pa slar na tshod dar la babs pa'i lang tsho ltar ya mtshan du gyur cing / yongs su bsgril bas lo brgya nyi shu'i bar bzhugs so/ /deb sngon du nel pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i lugs dang sba bzhed gtsang ma gung bsgrigs pa mkhas pa'i gsung yin kyang / nel pa paṇ+ḍi tas nam mkha' las babs pa mi 'thad par smra ba ni blo chung gi gtam ste/bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel du 'phags pa'i gang zag gi sprul pa dang thugs rje bsam las 'das pas so/ /de rnams la btsan lngar grags shing bang so phying lung dar thang du btab bo/ /rtsad po de dang rno za mang po rje'i sras khri gnyan gzung btsan te bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ de dang 'brong bza' mo dur yang gzher la sras 'gro gnyen lde'u ste btsun mo mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan bu mtsho khab tu bzhes pas de klu'i rigs yin pas sbal pa'i ro mar khur btsos pa'i za ma'i rigs mdzod phug tu bzhag pa gzigs pas rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur nas snyun du klu nad kyis thebs shing sras kyang dmus long zhig byung bas ming dmus long dkon pa bkra zhes btags pa la zhal chems su/787—462

bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste/ /bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin zhes nyon/ /ngan pa rnams kyang me dang 'dra bas gsos/ /mi chos rtog pa yin gyi rnam rtog skyungs/ /khyod yab mes kyi gnyan po gsang bar mchod pa gyis/'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos la mig phye/ mig ma byung na sum pa'i yul na bon po zhig gi chung ma rgya mo rgya lcam bya ba la nub gcig 'grogs pa'i shag mo tsam pa la skyes pa'i bu sum ri ring mo bya ba yod pas de bos la gcen chol rgyal sar chug gsungs nas bang so zhing mdar brtsigs par yab yum gson por bzhugs skad do / /de nas sras kyis yab kyi gsung bzhin byas pas mig bye ste/ skyid shod stag mo ri la gnyan 'dug pa gzigs pas stag ri gnyan gzigs su grags/bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs so/ /rje de dang 'ol gong bza' stong btsun 'gro dkar gyi sras gnam ri srong btsan te 'di'i ring la rgya nag nas rtsis dang sman byung zhing / ba dmar po'i 'o ma las sbrus pa'i 'jim pa las brtsigs pa'i pho brang khri brtsegs 'bum sdug ces bya ba brtsigs/ brag gsum lding ma'i mtsho 'gram nas rta mdo ba cang shes rnyed par chibs nas/ phung g.yag thal dkar ru ring zhes bya ba'i 'brong bsad pa'i sha sga la btags pa sa la lhung ba las tshwa rnyed/ bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ mi rje srong btsan sgam po ni/bka' gdams glegs bam las/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du bde bar song / /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed / /ces lung bstan gyis bsngags pa ltar/ yab rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan / yum tshe spong bza' 'bri za thod dkar gyi sras su/ 'gal ba zhes pas mo glang gi lo la pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu 107—463

gsum bzhes pa na yab kyis 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri la stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por dbang bskur/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la/ngas kha ba can pa'i 'gro don byed pa la dbang bskur ba po zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe/ dpal kun tu bzang pos rin po che'i bum pa lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas sku khrus gsol zhing / a mi de was rgyal po'i dbu la reg nas dbang bskur bas brjod par dka' ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa dang gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mtha' klas par gyur te/ po ta la'i ri 'di'i rtse la pho brang btab nas bzhugs na mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan gyi rgyal po thams cad kyis rang dbang med par gus pas 'dud pa'i dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par dgongs nas shul du bzhugs te ge re'i 'phrang du phebs pa na/ yig drug rang byon zhal gzigs nas sku khrus gsol zhing gsol ba btab pas/ de las dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i kha dog sna lnga 'phros pa pha ri brag la spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ rta mgrin gyi sku'i snang brnyan rang byon du shar ba la phog /de las kyang yi ge drug pa tshur la phog pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'dren byed kyi yul du ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs mor gyur pa 'ja' mdangs zhes skye bo rnams gleng ngo / /de nas bal po'i lha bzo dag gis sku dang gsung gi rten rnams ji ltar byon pa bzhin du gsal bar bskos/ rim bzhin rgyal po 'khor bcas po tā lar phebs nas 'chi ba med pa'i pho brang sa la 'phos pa ltar yid du 'ong zhing kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram stegs ltar mtho btsan gyi pho brang bzhengs nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pas/mtha'i rgyal po thams cad kyi rna bar da lta bod kyi yul na rgyal po mgo gnyis pa 187—464

thogs pa med par sprul pa'i dmag 'gyed thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul yod pa thos pas 'jigs rngam gyi dbang gis gus 'dud lhur len pa'i skyes bzang po dang blon po mngags pa rnams la bzang po'i gsung dang / dngos po gya rnam pas tshim par mdzad / rgyal srid lugs zung gi khrims rnam par dag pas 'dzin pa la yi ge 'di yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu dgos par dgongs nas/ mgon po zur phud lnga pa'i byin rlabs kyis thon mi a nu'i bu saṃ bho ṭa bran dang bcas par gser phye dang / gser gyi pa ṭa sogs rig byed smra ba'i ston pa yid rang dbang du byed pa'i dngos po dang bcas nas 'phags yul du yi ge slob par bka' gnang ste/ shul du 'tshe ba dang bral nas bgrod de bram ze li byin la yig rigs dang ske/ paṇ+ḍi ta lha'i rig pa seṅge la sgra'i skor mthar phyin pa gsan nas bod du rgyal blon gnyis pho brang ma rur lo gsum gyi ring yi ge dang sgra rnams slob par mdzad / bod la mkho ba'i dbyangs dang gsal byed 'phri bsnan gyis lañdza la dpe byas nas dbu chen/ wa rtu la dpe byas nas bshar ma sogs yi ge'i gzugs dang brda gsal bar byed pa'i sum rtags sogs bod la nyer mkho'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad nas rgyal po la phul/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs chos du ma bsgyur ba ni ljongs 'dir dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i thog ma yin no/ /de ltar yi ge 'dri klog gi srol legs par gtod nas/ dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims btsan pos phyag rgyas btab ste bod chen po'i rgyal khams kyi khyon kun la gnas pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa'i dga' ston la lan gcig min par myong bar mdzad do/ /de nas lhas lung bstan pa ltar/ yi dam gyi lha khyad par du 107—465

'phags pa med na mi 'byung bar dgongs te smin mtshams nas sprul pa'i dge slong a kur ma ti sprul/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po sogs dang gnas chen gyi sa byin rlabs can dang / ring bsrel du ma spyan drangs/ de yang bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rje dkon mchog 'bangs ni bod du 'gro/ /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yul rnams gdul bar byed/ /nga rgya nag yul nas der drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgrol ma zag med la/ /mi kho bo'i btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /ces pa'i lung bstan skabs su babs te/ bal yul na jo mo khro gnyer gyi sprul pa lha gcig khri btsun bya ba dang / rgya yul du jo mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa lha gcig kong jo bya ba gnyis btsun mor bzhes pa'i tshul gyis rgya bal gyi rten khyad par can jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis mtshon/ nor sna khyad par can du ma thabs mkhas kyis gdan drangs/mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul/ ru gnon dang / ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas lha mi'i 'dren mchog dam par mig gi yul du gyur pa gsar du bskrun nas/ mtha' 'khob bsil ldan gyi sa gzhi kun la rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i gzhi tshugs par mdzad do/ /de nas rgya bza' dang /bal bza' gnyis la sras ma byung bar/ ru yong bza' dang / zhang zhung bza'/mong bza' khri lcam rnams khab tu bzhes par/ sngon ma gnyis la sras ma byung yang / brag lha dang / thim bu lkog gi lha khang bzhengs/ mong bza' la sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ yum sras gnyis kyi rten skal du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dbyibs can gyi ri la/ dpal gyi yer pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ lo bcu 107—466

gsum lon tshe rgyal sar dbang bskur/ btsun mo 'a zha bza' kho 'jo mong rje khri dkar ti shags bya ba khab tu bzhes pas sras mang srong mang btsan 'khrungs/gung ri gung btsan lo bco brgyad lon nas gshegs/ bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs / slar yab rgyal pos rgyal srid bzung / khra 'brug gi mchod rten rtse lnga'i drung na rab tu byung gi rtags can hrul po zhig la phyag mdzad nas/ nga bod kyi rgyal po zhig gis bstan pa la bsam te khyod la phyag btsal ba ngo mtshar ram gsungs pas/ rab byung des mchod rten sor mo'i rtse la blangs te 'di ngo mtshar ram zer bar/ lan du rgyal pos a mi de wa bstan pas/ btsun pas gri gug gis brang kha phye nas sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga bstan pa sogs dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad cing / rgyal pos ka ba shing lo can na chos gter/ seng ge lag zan dang sbrul mgo can la drag sngags/ bum pa can la rin po che'i gter / klu khang na klu gter dang rin po che rat+na de wa/ dkyil 'khor 'og la rin po che stag sha chu dar gyis bsgril/ sbrul lpags kyis gtums pa/ them pa'i nye 'khor na be+e ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed rnams sbas/ skal ldan rnams la thugs rje chen po / rta mgrin/ gshin rje'i gshed sogs yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zab chos dang ske/ ma 'ong lung bstan/ rje 'bangs yongs la zhal gdams mtha' yas pa stsal ba phal cher yi ger btab nas/ rgyal po'i bka' bzhin blon po rnams kyis gter mdzod dang rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu sbas so/ /de nas thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo la las can 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor chos rgyal yab yum gsum gtsang khang byang mar byon nas gsum ka 'od kyi gong bur byas te thugs rje chen po'i thugs kur thim par/ rgyal po yab yum gsum de ltar mdzad na/ nged 107—467

bod 'bangs rnams ji ltar byed ces smre sngags bton pas/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas rgyal po dang / nu ma gnyis nas khri btsun dang kong jos dbu nyug mdzad de zhal gdams 'ga' zhig gsungs so/ /thun mong gi snang ngor yab yum gsum ka 'phan yul zal mo'i sgang du gshegs pa'i pur yang 'phyong rgyas su spyan drangs te bang so brtsigs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten dang rten dang brten pa'i gtsug lag khang bzheng pa/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba thos bsam sgom gsum sogs kyi srol legs par btod pas na dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod par grags so/ /de nas dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung / dus der rgya rnams kyis sprul pa'i rgyal po ma bzhugs par shes nas dmag 'ongs pa 'phrul snang du slebs pa dang / sme brtsegs kyi sku las sprul pa'i dmag byung bas phyir bros/ mgar gyis bod dmag 'bum tsho khrid nas rgya rnams bcom/ mgar yang dmag thog tu grongs/ de nas slar yang rgya dmag gi skad chen po byung bas jo bo lho sgo me long can du bcug /sgo la zhal ba byas nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris/ mi ring bar rgya dmag rnams lhags te po ta la'i pho brang me la bsregs/ jo bo shākya mu ni 'khyer ma thub kyang mi bskyod rdo rje snga dro gcig gi sar gdan drangs so/ /mang srong dgung lo nyer bdun la gtsang gi bar snang sgang du gshegs/ bang so mang srong gi sgang du brtsigs / rje de la 'brong bza' khra bo khri ma lod khab tu bzhes pa'i sras 'dus srong mang po rje rlung rnam 'phrul gyi rgyal po yab 'das nas zhag 'ga' zhig song ba dang 'khrungs/ 'di'i ring la blon po rtsal po che bdun byung zhing / ja dang /dkar yol la sogs pa'i srol btod/ bang so mang srong gi g.yon du brtsigs/187—468

rje de dang mchims bza' btsan mo rtog ge'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshoms pho brang ldan mkhar du 'khrungs/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ da ste gdung rab lnga na nga'i dbon sras rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i lung bstan zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa rnyed pas/ rang nyid du go ste/gangs ti se nas paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gdan drangs kyang ma drongs/ 'on kyang pho nya bas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs pas/ glegs bam lnga po bzhengs te/ bzhugs khang du brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ke ru/ gsang mkhar brag /mchim po snar la/ ma sa gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul king shi nas gser 'od dam pa dang / 'dul ba las rnam par 'byed pa dang / sman dpyad kyi rigs 'ga' zhig bsgyur/ li yul nas rab tu byung ba spyan drangs nas gus par mdzad kyang bod nas rab tu byung ba ni ma byung / phying nga stag rtse nas nor khyad du 'phags pa'i g.yu zhig rnyed/ ljang mo khri btsun khab tu bzhes par sras ljang tsha lha dbon zhes pa lta bas chog mi shes pa'i mdzes sdug can zhig 'khrungs par bod na de'i btsun mo 'os pa'i na chung ma rnyed pas/ rgya rje yag 'jam li khri bzher lang ma'i sras mo kong jo bsu ba'i skyes kyi dngos po dang pho nya mngags par kong jo de la legs nyes ston pa'i me long zhig yod par bltas pas yar klungs kyi yul dge bcu'i yon tan yongs su tshang zhing / rgyal bu de lha'i khye'u ltar mdzes pa zhig tu mthong nas byon na'ang / gnyags kyi bu mo ma blangs pa'i 'khon gyis gnyags khri bzang yang 'don gyis rgyal bu bgrongs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsisas/dus der kong jos me long la bltas pas rgyal po bzhin mi sdug pa zhig tu mthong 107—469

ba bzhin bod nas gtam ngan pa skyel mi byung na'ang byon/ jo bo rgyal rabs gsum du mun par bzhugs pa lho sgo me long can nas bton te gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa btsug /mchims phur mes ag tshoms kyi btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad de brjod na/ mu khyud ke la sha yis rab bcings pa/ /thub dbang nam mkha'i nor bus gzung min kyang / /snying rje'i ga bur thig le mig mi 'dzum/ /bsil ldan bsil ba'i dpal du bdag gir mdzad/ /tshang tshing stug por tshogs pa'i mi min 'gros/ /lung rtogs sgron me 'dzin par mi nus pas/ /'phags pa'i sgyu 'phrul spre'u brag srin las/ /mi yi 'gro ba thog mar spel bar mdzad/ /glang yan bag med 'khyams pa skye dgu'i tshogs/ /brlangs por spyod pa bag yod la 'god phyir/ /chos kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po yis/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing thog mar sbyin/ /sgrung bon lde 'u mtshan gyi thun gsum mthar/ /rgyal bstan nyi ma'i snga ltas khyung sngon skyes/ /ngo mtshar rten bzhi yum bu bla mkhar rtser/ /tho ri gnyan btsan phyag char mdzes par gyur/ /srong btsan a mi de ba'i gtsug tor bcas / /sa skyong gru 'dzin bdag po dngos nyid kyis/ /mdzad pa'i gru 'dzin zhing khams bod 'di 'am/ /ri bo ta la gang snyam 'phyang mo nyug /bsod nams sngo sang khang par lugs gnyis kyi/ /nyin byed rtse dgas 'khyud pas dbyig 'dzin khyon/ /phan bde'i gser zhun lang tshos byug pa yi/ /skal bzang gangs can pa la lhag par sbyin/ /shākya mu ni sku dngos jo shāka zung / /gangs can bsod nams spyi nor nyid du drangs/ /'phrul snang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi/ /phan bde'i me btsa' sa gnad gzer bur btab/ /'tshe ba med 787—470

par sprul pa'i dmag dpung gis/ /log par 'khu ba'i sbyin skyes sa 'og bcings / /bka' lung gser gyi me tog mtha' bzhi yi/ /dregs ldan zur phud mdzes pa'i rgyan du bcings/ /kun khyab pha mtha' mkha' lding dbang pos kyang / /gzhal min nyam chung sbrang bus ji ltar gzhal/ /gang gi rnam thar 'phags mchog dag gis kyang / /dpog min nyam chung byis blos ji ltar gzhal/ /mang srong mang btsan 'dus srong mang po rje/ /khri lde gtsug brtan la sogs chos rgyal kun//rgyal ba'i bstan pa ngo mtshar phyag rjes kyi/ /'phrin las 'od dkar 'gro ba'i snying du bsil/ /bod yul yul la dge bcu tshang ba'i sar/ /chos rgyal rgyal rabs du ma'i 'phrin las skyas/sgo /dam chos chos spyod rnam bcu'i dge mtshan rmo/ /'od snang snang byed 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigos du bcad pa'o//yab khri lde gtsug brtan dang / yum kong jo gnyis kyi sras su sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta'i lo pho brang brag dmar du khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams/ dus der rgyal po'i btsun mo sna nam bzas kyang rgyal po'i sras zhig mngal du chags pa skad zer nas kong jo'i sras 'phrog ste khong rang las skyes pa ltar byas pas/ rje blon rnams the tshom du gyur pas zhal lce gcod pa'i spobs pa ma byung zhing / kong jo yid ma rangs par bod kyi sa dpyad bzang ba 'ga' zhig nyams su bcug /mi ring bar sras zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la btsun mo gnyis kyi pha ming dang blon 'bangs rnams 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rgyal pos 'bras chang gis bkang ba'i gser gyi phor pa sras kyi lag tu gtad/ snod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di/ /bu khyod rang gi zhang po'i lag tu sprod/ /ma gang yin gyi yid ches de 187—471

la byed/ /gsungs pas/ sras kyis rin po che'i phor pa rgya rnams kyi lag tu gtad nas/ nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ /sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshal/ /gsungs pa dang / kong jo yid rab tu dga' ste/ tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /nga rgya nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo la/ /rje 'gran med rgyal po'i sras shig 'khrungs / /zhes sogs kyi gtam smras nas sngar sa dpyad nyams su bcug pa rnams phal cher gsos 'ga' zhig lus skad/ sras dgung lo chung ngu'i dus/rgya yul nas sang shi gtsug lag 'ga' zhig len du btang bar lam du zhugs/yab rgyal po dgung lo drug cu re gsum la gshegs/ /bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/sang shi slar bod du yong ba'i lam du hwa shang mngon shes can zhig la bod kyi bde don dris pas/ btsad po gshegs/ rgyal bu nar ma son/ bdud blon rnams kyis khrims bcos nas chos bsnubs pa sogs kyi lung bstan/ 'on kyang rgyal bu nar son pa na glegs bam gsum po 'di rnams rim gyis snyan du gsol/ za hor gyi dge slong shan+ta rak+ṣi ta spyan drongs shig ces zer ba yid la bzung nas hwa shang gcig khrid nas bod du 'ongs pa na/ ma zhang sogs kyis rgyal po sku tshe thung ba dang / bkra mi shis pa chos kyis lan pas chos byar med pa'i khrims bcas te/shākya mu ni rgya yul du bskyel ba'i thabs byas kyang ma theg par sa 'og tu sbas/'phrul snang du bshas ra byas/ dus der sna nam khri thog rje thang lha 'bar rgyab gas nas shi /lcog gru skyes mgo skam nas shi bas/ ltas mkhan dang mi phal cher gyis lha sa 'og tu sbas pas lan zer bas/ skyid grong du bskyal/ brag dmar mgrin bzang bshig /sang shis rgya'i glegs bam rnams mchims phu'i rdza la sbas/ hwa shang slog /mi ring bar rgyal bu sku nar son te/ yab mes rnams 187—472

kyi yig tshang gzigs pas chos mdzad par dgongs pa'i gtam mdzad pas sang shis sngar hwa shang gis lung bstan pa'i dus der go nas glegs bam rnams rdza khrod nas blangs te/ dge ba bcu'i mdo/ rdor gcod/ sa lu ljang pa rnams gzigs su phul bas lta spyod dag cing zung du 'brel bar go nas dad ste/ rgya me mgo dang kha che a nan+tas skad bsgyur byas pas ma zhang sogs kyis bkag /chos blon rnams kyis sang shi stod du brdzangs/ gsal snang gis byang chub chen po dang / na len+d+rar mchod pa byas/ mkhan po dang mjal te mang yul du spyan drangs / gsal snang gis btsad po'i drung du 'ongs nas mkhan po'i gsung dang rgyu mtshan rgyal por gsol/ ma zhang gis chad pa byung dogs nas gsal snang yibs su bcug /btsan pos lkog tu 'gos rgan sogs chos blon rnams dang bka' bgros nas/ mo rtsis pa sogs lung bstan mkhan po rnams la bya dga' sbyin te/ rgyal po rgyal srid dang bcas pa la chags chen po 'dug pas/ de'i rim gror blon chen zhig zla ba gsum gyi bar la dur du 'jug dgos par bsgrag tu bcug ste/ 'gos kyi rkang pa la bya rgod kyi lham gyon pa sogs thabs 'phrul du mas ma zhang dang lhan cig par dur nang du phyin nas phyir bros pas ma zhang gis bsnyabs kyang rgod spu snyim pa gang las ma byung / de ma thag dong kha bcad de/rje blon kun chos byed pa'i chad so byas/ de nas rigs kyis mngon par mtho ba za hor rgyal po'i gdung las 'khrungs pa mkhan chen bo dhi satwa spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar gsal snang brdzangs pa bzhin rim gyis phebs te/ 'om bu tshal du mjal/mkhan pos rgyal po la dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad la sogs pa'i chos mang po bshad pas/ bod kyi lha srin rnams khros nas dmar po ri'i pho brang la thog 187—473

rgyab / lo nyes dang mi phyugs la nad chen po byung bas/ sdig blon rnams kyis 'go byas pa'i bod 'bangs phal cher gyis chos byas pas lan zer nas mi dga' ba byas pas/ btsad pos rgyu mtshan mkhan po'i snyan du gsol ba la/ mkhan pos yab mes kyi ring la gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa / chos bsgyur ba sogs mdzad na'ang / lha srin rnams ma btul bas/btsan po 'ga' zhig gi sku tshe la bar chad dang / chos la sked nyag sogs skyon 'ga' zhig byung 'dug pas/ sa gzhi 'di drag pos 'dul ba'i ched du/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'dzam bu gling na che ba'i rigs sngags mkhan zhig yod pa de/ rgyal po nyid dang sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs pa'i dus su smon lam gyi 'brel pa yod pas spyan drangs na/ btsad po'i rnam par dkar ba'i thugs kyi bzhed pa mtha' dag 'grub par lung bstan nas/mkhan pos bal por byon/ de nas slar btsan pos thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pas 'bangs mtha' dag chos bya bar khas blangs/ mkhan pos lung bstan pa de rmi lam du byung ba ltar mdzad nas slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya snga rting du bsdangs shing / slar sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs rin po che'i phyag rten dang bcas te mngags pas pho nya rnams ngal zhing dub pa slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis mang yul gung thang du phebs pa na mjal/slob dpon gyis nyi zla thang la 'beb pa/ chu bo gyen la bzlog pa sogs sku'i bkod pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan te pho nya rnams ldog tu med pa'i mos pa brtan po thob/ phyag rten gyi gser rnams mnga' ris phyogs su gtor te/ ma 'ongs par bod du gser gyi 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/ de nas 187—474

rim gyis lam du zhugs te phebs pa na/ bod kyi lha 'dre stobs po che phal che bas mtho brtsam par/ gsang ba gsum mtha' klas pa'i nus mthus srog gi snying po blangs nas dam la btags/ stod lung gzhong pa mda' ru phebs pa na/ lha bzang klu dpal sogs blon po rnams kyis bsu ba dang mjal nas dro 'debs par chu med pa la slob dpon gyis phyag 'khar btab pas nyal 'gro'i rgyun babs pa / gzhong pa lha chur grags/ de nas mnga' bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas mjal nas/ brag dmar mgrin bzang du bzhugs / slar mkhan po gdan 'dren gyi pho nya mngags te phebs/ dus der rje blon gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i bka' bgros nas 'bangs rnams bsags te / zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba'i mkhar zhig rtsig gam/ shel gyi mchod rten shar ri dang mnyam pa zhig rtsig gam/ gtsang po sbubs su 'jug gam/ lha khang bre tshad tsam zhig rtsig gam/ zhes 'dam ga btang bas gzhan rnams blo'i yul las 'das te lha khang brtsig par kha 'cham/ shākya mu ni mang yul nas gdan drangs te 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su bcug /de nas slob dpon gyis sde brgyad dam la btags/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ rgyal pos dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol/ gser gyi sta re thog nas rmang brkos pas khru gang tsam gyi 'og nas sa zhag dkar dmar ser gsum ro phun sum tshogs pa bro ba byung bas btsan po thugs dgyes so/ /mkhan pos gtsug lag khang gi bzo dbyibs kyi bkod pa mdzad par bzhed de/ ri rab gling bzhi dang bcas pa la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba yod pas/ de la dpe bya bar gsungs te/ dge byed ces pa chu pho stag lor dpal bsam yas mi 107—475

'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rmang btings/ rgya khyon gyi tshad/btsad po rang gi mda' rgyang gang bya bar gsungs pas blon po rnams kyis lkog tu bgros te/ rje'i mda' rgyang gang la gzhan gyi mda' rgyang gsum yod pas de tsam mi 'grub/ bka' bcag pa yang mi rigs pas thabs shig byed par mthun te/mda'i snyug sbubs su dngul chu blug pas gzhan gyi mda' rgyang gang dang mnyam pa byung la de yang dbu rtse ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ yak+ta gong 'og nyi zla/mthar lcags ri/ zur bzhir mchod rten/ sgo bzhir rdo ring / khyad par jo mo'i gling gsum dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyis lha 'dre dregs pa can thams cad las bkol bas nyin mis brtsigs pa bas/ mtshan lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho bar gyur/ dus der rgyal po'i mnal lam du has po ri'i rtser byon pas shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu'i snang brnyan sangs rgyas dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs pa 'dug pa gzigs pas dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa'i ngang la mnal sad de/ nang par blon po kham pa go cha khrid nas gzigs par byon pas/bye ma'i 'og nas rdo sku rang byung thon te gtsang khang du spyan drangs pas sa g.yos pa sogs ltas khyad par can byung ba'i jo bo byang chub chen po'i nang rten du bzhugs pa'i ma hā bo dhis thog drangs/ 'og khang bar khang steng khang 'khor sa bar ma dang chen mo/ gling gzhan rnams kyi bde gshegs zhi khro 'khor dang bcas pa'i snang brnyan thams cad 'dren byed kyi dga' ston rmad du byung ba'i zil mngar du gyur/ khyad par mchod rten dkar por maṅga dha'i rgyal po'i sgo mdun gyi rin po che'i bum pa nas blangs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung ring bsrel dang / mes kyi gnyan po gsang ba dang mdo lnga bzhugs pas byin rlabs mchog 707—476

tu che bar grags shing / tshe spong bza' dmar rgyan mas khams gsum zangs khang gling dbu rtse rigs gsum la dpe blangs te bzhengs/ 'bro bza' khri rgyal mang mgo btsun gyis dge rgyas kyi lha khang la/ pha ming thag ring zhing sras med pas/zhig gsos dang mchod pa 'byung dka' bar bsams te/ rtsig pa so phag la zha nye'i chu sbyar/ zangs kyis thog bkab/ mchod par rol mor cong btags/mar mer rin po che margad sku gzugs kyi dpral bar btab zer/ pho yong bzas bu tshal gser khang logs la rtsig pa med pa/ nang ka ba med pa sogs bzo sna bcu gsum gyis khyad par du 'phags skad/ de ltar dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo la rdzogs par grub ste/ mkhan slob gnyis kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad pas/ dbu rtse'i lha rnams phyi rol tu byon pa/ rta mgrin gyis rta skad theng gsum bton pa/ pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa sogs ltas khyad par du 'phags pa byung ba'i grags snyan srid rtse'i bar du grags so/ /rab gnas kyi dga' ston grub nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pas/ bod yul gyi mis rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa bsrung nus mi nus brtag pa'i phyir du/ rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi las thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa bod du legs par dgongs nas/ dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs/ gnas mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tshos mkhan po mdzad de/ sad mi mi bdun gyis bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mnos/ de'i rjes su blo gsal zhing yid gzhungs pa'i las ldan gyi skyes bu du mas rab tu byung zhing /shes rab kyi rtsal dang ldan pa dag la lo tsā bslabs pas/ gzhung lugs kyi don khong du chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu skad gnyis smra ba mang du byon/ rgya 107—477

gar sogs yul gru rnams nas paṇa grub du ma spyan drangs/ lo paṇa de dag gis dam pa'i chos bsgyur zhing bshad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rnams rang nyams kyis spyod par mi nus pa'i khrims btsan po zhig dgos pas/ mes srong btsan sgam po sogs kyis bkas bcad pa'i rgyal khrims yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bar skabs su mi dge bar spyod pa'i dri mas cung zad sbags pa rnams slar byi dor mdzad nas/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ltar lci bas mchog dman kun gyi gnya' kha gnon par mdzad do/ /de nas gtsug lag khang gi srung mar mkhan slob chos gsum bka' bgros te/rgyal po'i dmag gis bha ta hor gyi sgom gra bcom pa'i ka ca'i rjes su dpe har 'brangs te byung bar dkor srung bcol/ rgyal po chags pa'i rten g.yu'i thub pa/bse 'bag /za hor rgyal rigs rnams drangs par bshad do/ /de yang rgyal po rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo la bod 'bangs byings kyi snang ngor tsha ba'i snyun gyis mya ngan las 'das la/ las can rnams kyi yid ngor rje btsun 'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs kur thim mo/ /bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ chos kyi rgyal po 'di la btsun mo 'ga' zhig yod kyang tshe spong bza' la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba mu ni btsan po rgyal sar bskos/ 'bangs kyi ltog phyug lan gsum du snyoms kyang / mi 'gyangs par sngar bzhin gyur par/ lo paṇa rnams kyis sngon gyi sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yin par gsungs pas/ rnam dkar gyi las la lhag par mos pa thob ste/ bsam yas su sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ mdo sde'i mchod pa deng sang yang yod/ rgyal srid mdzad nas lo gcig dang zla ba bdun la yum gyis dug btang nas 'das/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ 'bring po 187—478

mu rug btsan po ni rgyal po dang blon po zhang gnyis 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang du bsdu ba'i gros mdzad tshe/ sras kyis bka' bgros sar byon pas/ zhang gis 'u bu rings kyis rje blon bka' bgros sar re zhig ma 'byon byas par/ sras kyis chu gri bsnun te bkum/ blon po 'gos kyis zhal lce 'dar gsum dang dga' gsum bcad de/ sras re zhig spyugs pa slar mon nas spyan drangs te rgyal srid la bsko bar brtsam pa na/ blon po'i shul mi zhang sna nam gyis bkrongs so/ /sras chung ba mu tig btsan po sad na legs mjing yon gyis dgung lo bzhi'i steng du rgyal srid bzung / slob dpon gyis chos skal stsal/ yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa/ shul na bzhugs pa'i lo paṇa rnams la phul du byung ba'i bsnyen bkur dang bcas te/ sngar ma 'gyur ba'i gsung rab 'ga' zhig bsgyur / bod kyi rgyal po la nga che bas lha khang nyi ma tsam zhig rtsig go gsungs pas/slob dpon mdzod mkhan gyis nyi ma'i rgyar dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pas/bod 'dir mi shong zhes zhus par/ zla ba tsam zhig rtsig gsung bar de yang sngon ma dang 'dra tshul smras/ skar ma tsam zhig rtsig gsung bar rgyang grags bco brgyad yod tshul bzhin/ byang 'brog gi thang yangs pa zhig tu rtsig par bka' gnang bas / blon po kun gyis byang du brtsigs na lha khang stong par lus 'gro tshul zhus pa dang / slar rje 'bangs kun gros mthun par/ rgyal sde dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ bod kun phan pa dang bde ba'i lam du 'god par mdzad nas gshegs/ bang so 'phrul rgyal mdun na brtsigs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ bsod nams dpangs su mtho ba lhun po'i spo/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten snyegs pa de yi tshe/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo nyid kyang bod 107—479

skyong rje/ /khri srong lde btsan zhes byar rnam par rol/ /sdig blon sdig pa'i bsam sbyor rtsub mo yi/ /chu khur ardza nag por brtsegs byas te/ /rgyal bstan snang byed sgrib tu re ba yang / /thugs rje'i 'thor rlung gcig gis lhag med bcom / /rgyal bstan nyin byed 'bum phrag gangs ljongs 'dir/ /'dren pa'i thugs bskyed rta ljang shugs bdo ba/ /zhi 'tsho spyan drangs lung rtogs dam chos kyi / /snang ba nyi ma bye ba'i rlabs su dros/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal ldan pad+ma skyes/ /spyan drangs sde brgyad dregs pa phyag rgyas gzir/ /zan yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / /mi las mtshan mo lha 'dres lhag par bzhengs//gtsug lag khang bzhengs rten gsum khyad 'phags bskrun/ci /paṇa grub brgya phrag gdan drangs mdo rgyud bsgyur/ /khrims ldan 'dus sde'i thog ma gsar du btsugs / /bod ljongs rin chen gsum gyis phyung bur gtams/ /mkhan slob chos gsum gcig tu gdan 'dzom nas/ /chos dang srid kyi dge mtshan mtha' dag gis/ /bod 'bangs bu bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa yi/ /bka' drin 'di 'dra gang gis gzhal bar nus/ /mu ni btsan pos 'bangs kyi ltog phyug snyom/ /sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa 'dzugs par mdzad/ /mu tig btsan po'ang dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /lha khang bzhengs dang mdo rgyud gtsug lag bzhengs/ /chos rgyal mkhan slob slob rgyud dang bcas pa/ /ljongs 'dir chos srid srid zhi'i dge mtshan kun/ 4 4/spungs pa'i dga' ston ston gyi dus ji bzhin/byu nga /skal bzang de dag dag pa'i zhing ltar gyur/ sgo/ces4 bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o༅// gyergyal po de la sras gtsang ma/ lha rje/ lhun grub/ dar ma/ ral pa can 107—480

dang lnga byung kyang / lhun grub chung bur gshegs pas bang so med/ lha rje ni dgung lo bco lnga la gshegs pa'i bur skye ba bdun pa shel gyi brag la rgyas btab/sras che ba gtsang ma rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher zhugs/ de'i 'og dar ma ni na tshod rgan kyang rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs bsgrub pa'i bsam pa las phyi rol tu gyur/ mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan ral pa can bod 'bangs yongs kyi khri la mnga' gsol/ de yang mnga' bdag 'di pa mi zad zhes pa me pho khyi lor 'khrungs pa nas bzung ste lang tsho gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas sngon gyi bag chags bzang po sad pa'i rnam 'gyur yang mdzad cing / khyad par khri thog tu phebs pa nas rgyal thabs kyi bya ba legs byas kyi rgyur bsgrubs nas 'bras bu'i dga' ston la spyod par rab tu chas pa/ chos blon bran kha dpal gyi yon tan gyis byas/nyi 'og gi mkhan po dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi/ dha na shī la sogs paṇ+ḍi ta du ma dang —/ lo tsā ba ska cog sogs gdan 'dzoms par byas te/ go dka' ba rnams skad gsar gyis bcos nas gtan la phab/ mtha'i yul gru rnams dang /tsi na'i yul cham la phab/ rgya'i hwa shang dang / bod kyi lo paṇa rnams kyi bar bzhugs te mthun par mdzad nas sa mtshams rdo ring la yi ge bris/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher dgongs te btsan po'i dbu skra la dar yug btags pa'i steng dge 'dun rnams bzhugs su 'jug pa dang / dge 'dun re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun re phul ba sogs 'phags yul chos rgyal rnams kyang ngal gso ster bar mdzad/ yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang la bsnyen bkur zhig gsos dang / 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar du bzhengs nas rgyal bstan bde skyid rdzogs ldan 187—481

bzhin mdzad nas/ mchog dman kun la bde skyid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad / de ltar skye rgu mtha' dag ngal gso'i bde ba la spyod pa'i skabs/ nag po'i phyogs kyis yid rnam par brlams pa'i sdig blon rnams mi bzod pa'i zug rngu chen pos mnar bar gyur te/ chos khrims 'jig pa'i ngan gros gshom nas/mo rtsis mkhan po rnams bya dgas tshim par byas nas/ lha sras gtsang ma ma spyugs na/ rgyal srid 'jig par lung bstan pa bzhin du mon la spyugs/ sbas stag snas blon po bran kha dpal yon dang btsun mo gnyis mthun zhes rgyal po la phra ma bcug pas/ btsun mo ngang tshul lcebs/ bran chen pos lcags kyi srog rtsa bsgrubs pas ma 'grub par bkum/ de rjes btsad po sbas stag sna sogs sdig blon rnams kyis zhal ltag pa'i ngos su gcus te bgrongs nas bang so don mkhar mda'i g.yon phyogs su brtsigs so/ /de nas bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir dkar min las kyi 'bras bu bzlog tu med pas thub bstan nub ri'i phag tu yib cing /me tog mda' can sde dang bcas pa rnam par dge ba'i g.yul las rgyal ste/glang dar ma 'u dum can rgyal srid du dbang bskur/ sbas stag snas nang blon byas te/ chos bsnubs par bsams kyang bsnyad ma rnyed pa'i skabs su/ sad ser mu ge nad yams 'ga' zhig byung ba la bsnyad gdags par 'dod de 'bangs rnams la rgyu mtshan dris pas ma shes zer bar/ btsad pos rgya mo kong jo zhes bya ba'i gnod sbyin mo zhig gis gnod sbyin gyi lha shākya mu ni bya ba bod du khyer 'ongs pas lan te/ de yang dang por lha 'di ri rab kyi rtser 'ongs pas lha rnams kyi g.yul pham zhing 'ongs/ de nas o rgyan/ ma ga dha/ rgya nag sogs su rim gyis 'ongs pas mi shes pa byung ba sogs yid nag po'i gdon gyis bskyod 187—482

pa'i gtam du ma smras/ lo paṇa phal cher yul gzhan du bros shing / ma byon pa 'ga' zhig bkum/ rab byung phal cher 'dul ba'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i rtags dang phral zhing / mi nyan pa rnams rngon pa byed du bcug /gsung rab phal cher lha sa'i brag la sbas shing / 'ga' zhig me dang chur sbyangs/ gtsug lag khang rnams 'jig pa'i thog ma 'phrul snang nas bya bar brtsams te/ jo bo rnam gnyis chu la bskyur ba'i gtam smras pa dang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis/ sku gzugs lci bas sgul mi nus par bsnyad btags te bye stongs su sbas / byams pa chos 'khor dngos yin pa ltar byas nas rdo mtsho la bskyur te ku sgra chen po bton/ ra sa/ bsam yas/ ra mo che rnams kyi gtsug lag khang gi sgo la zhal ba byas/ rgyal po dgyes su re nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba sogs kyi gzugs brnyan bris/ 'on kyang khyim pa gos dkar gyi rten la gsang sngags sgrub pa dag ni nang gi de nyid rgyal blon gyis ma rtogs shing / rab byung gi rtags med pas gnod pa ma byung ba dpag med yod pas/ kun mkhyen ye bzang rtse ba'i zhal nas/ de ltar 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel grib byung mod kyi/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhes gsungs pa yang 'di la dgongs so/ /dus der yer par lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje ting nge 'dzin la 'khor mo yug tu gnas pa'i skabs/ dpal lha mos/ deng sang bod na grub thob khyed las med pas/ rgyal po sdig can sgrol ran zer ba'i brda zhig byung bas / nang par bran la rgyu mtshan dris par lo rgyus rnams zhib tu bshad pas bsgral bya'i zhing du dgongs te/ rta dkar po la sol ba byugs/ gos phyi nag nang dkar gyon/ lha sar 'ongs pa dang / btsad pos rdo ring gi yi ge klog 107—483

pa'i skabs su 'grigs pas/ phyag byed pa ltar byas te mda' gzhu mtheb stong sbyar / bden pa brdar te brgyab pas brang la phog /de ma thag bros te grib kyi ma gdong gi chu la bshan pas sol ba dag ste rta dkar por song / gos phyi nang bsgyur bar grags shing / don du mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje dang / rang gi grub pa'i mtshan ma sogs kyis sna tshogs pa'i mthong snang grub bo/ /btsad po lag pa gnyis kyis mda' la 'ju zhing / yang na lo gsum gyis gsod pa sngas/yang na lo gsum gyis 'phyis zhes smra ba'i mus la lnga pa'i lam du gyur to/ /bang so 'phrul dang rgyal chen bar du brtsigs pa 'phror lus skad/ dus der btsad po'i btsun mo chung ba la sras shig btsa' bar nye skabs su yod pa btsun mo che bas shes te/ lus la gos mang po dkris nas mngal du sras chags pa skad smras mi ring bar chun ma la zla dus them pa dang sras 'khrungs pa shin tu gces pas mtshan mo mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs pas gnam lde 'od srung du grags shing /chen mas kyang sprang phrug cig rin gyis nyos te/ mdang 'di skyes pa yin no zhes bstan pas/ so 'dug pa mthong ste/ mdang skyes kyi bu chung la so ni gda'/'on kyang yum gyi bka' brtan du chug zer bas/ khri lde yum brtan du ming chags / de nas mnga' bdag gnyis lang tsho yar ldan du gyur pa dang / chos blon rnams kyis rgyu mtshan brjod pa ltar/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams mgon so so'i khri la bzhugs su bcug cing / gtsug lag khang rnams su mchod pa'i rgyun 'dzugs pa sogs mdzad/ 'on kyang mnga' ris la ma 'cham par 'od srung gis g.yon ru dang / yum brtan gyis sbus ru bzung ste 'khrug long chen po byung bas/de dag nas bzung ste rje gnya' khri btsan po'i gdung brgyud kyis bod kyi spyi la 107—484

dbang ma sgyur skad do/ /de nas mi ring bar gyen log byung / gyen log gi rjes su bang so phal cher kyang brus te bshig go/ de ltar yum brtan gyi brgyud pa skyid g.yor kun la shin tu mang zhing / 'od srung gshegs pa'i bang so 'phrul rgyal gyi rgyab tu brtsigs/ de nas bang so rtsig pa'i srol nub cing / de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de la sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / khri skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis 'khrungs/ nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris su byon nas chab srid bzung / sras gsum byung ba'i che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyis spu rangs bzung / chung ba lde btsan mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / lde btsun mgon la sras kho re dang /krong nge gnyis byung ba'i gcen gyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes 'od du grags sol/ /de dag gi skabs su rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar bar mdzad pa'i rgya gar bal po kha che sogs kyis slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta dang / skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba ji snyed byon pa dag gi mtshan tsam bkod na bstan pa snga dar la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra/ bram ze shaṅka ra/ bal po mañdzu shrī/ mkhan chen shārnyi rak+ṣi ta 'am zhi ba 'tsho/ pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ sngags 'chang dharma kirti 'am chos kyi grags pal/ bi ma mi tra 'am dri med bshes gnyen/ bud+dha gu h+ya 'am sangs rgyas gsang bte/ shārnyi gar+bha 'am zhi ba snying po/ bi shud dha sidha 'am rnam dag seng ge/ ka ma la shī la 'am pad+ma'i ngang tshul/ bram ze ā nan+da/ kulpa mi tra 'am dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dzi na mi tra 'am rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi 'am lha dbang byang chub/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi 'am tshul khrims dbang po byang chub/ dā na shrī la / bo dhi mi tra/ mu ni warma 'am thub pa'i go cha/ sarba dzñā de wa'am kun 107—485

mkhyen lha/ bit+yā ka ra pra bhā 'am rig byed 'od zer dang / rgya nag gi slob dpon hwa shang ma hā de wa tshe/ hwa shang ma ko sa/ hwa shang ma hā yā na sogs byon cing / de'i skabs lo tsā ba yang thon mi sasto ṭa/ dharma koṣ+ṭha/ lha yul rdo rje dpalam/ bran ka mū la ko ṣa/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra 'am ye shes gzhon nu/ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rba ye shes dbang po/ 'ba' khri bzher saṃ shi ta / sbrang rgyar legs gzigs/ seng gong lha lung gzigs/ rba mang rje gsal snang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ lce dzñā na sirnyi/ mchims shākya pra bha/brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge/ dpa' mañdzu shrī/ tsangs de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta 'am lha dbang srung / bran ka mu ti ka /pa gor bai ro tsā na rak+ṣi ta 'am rnam snang srung / 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta 'am klu dbang srung / rma rin chen mchog /gtsang sa la'i bu rin chen legs grub/ dharma ā lo ka /dran pa nam mkha' / sgro rin chen sde/ rma rnam par mi rtog pa/ rma shākya 'od/ lce khyi 'brug /rlangs khams pa go cha/ gnyags dzñā na de wa ko ṣa/ zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang / 'gos chos grub/ stong ā tsar+ya/ dharma tā shrī la/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan / ska ba dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ zhang ye shes sde/ dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī wa rma 'am 'jam dpal go cha/ rat+nan+t+ra shrī la/ bzang skyong / lha'i zla ba/ dpal gyi lhun po/ dpal 'byor/ ye shes snying po/rgyal ba shes rab/ shākya bshes gnyen/ dge ba dpal/ legs pa'i sde/gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ yi ge pa dgon gling rma/ gzhon nu sung ba/nam mkha' skyong ba rnams byon no/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lugs gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo'i shugs btsan pos/ /'dzam gling sum gnyis phyag 107—486

rgyar bzung ba yis/ /sa skyong tshogs kyi zur phud zhabs sen gyi/ /pad+mor bcings pa mnga' bdag khri ral gyi/ /gser zhun prog zhus mdzes par bcings pa yi/ /phal gyis blta bar mi bzod dbu'i lan bur/ /dar yug dang bcas 'dus sde'i stan nyid du/ /'bul ba'i sri zhu 'di 'dra su yis byed/ /dge 'dun re rer mi khyim bdun phrag re/ /bran gyi don du 'bul sogs srid zhi yi/ /dpal yon rgya cher 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las 'di/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal kun la skyengs pa ster/ /de nas skal ngan mun stug mtshan mo ni/ /stang zil khro gnyer glal ba'i srin mo'i khas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i snang ba kun/ /cig car za ba'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs nyid/ /yab mes rgyal rabs du mar 'bad pa yis/ /bskrun pa'i srol bzang dpag bsam rin chen tshal/ /btsad po dar ma gcig pu'i log bsgrub kyi/ /sreg zas skad cig dmigs med byas 'di ci/ /de lta na yang dpal gyi rdo rje yi/ /snying rje'i nyag phran rnon pos sdig can snying / /tshal par bkas pa'i tsha dbal ngan song gi/ /me rgyun bsnyil ba'i thabs su lhag par sbyin/ /de nas mnga' bdag 'od srung yum brtan zhes/ /rigs kyi khyad par dpag bsam phal pa'i ljon/ /'on te bsod nams dgung du mnyam pa yis/ /mnga' ris phyed phyed rgyal sar dbang bskur gyur/ /de ltar bod yul bstan pa snga dar gyi/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa grub pa'i skyes mchog tshogs/ /nyi zla'i phreng ba brgyud mar spros pa bzhin/ /sa chen phan bde'i snang bas skal bzang gyur/ /yang yang nam mkha' mkha' rlangs kyis sgrib bzhin/ /yang yang rgyal bstan bstan stodagrarmi glag gtsos kyang / /yang yang skyes mchog mchog 4gi 'phrin zlos kyiso/ /yang yang 'dzoms 'di 'di ltar stobasame bzhin spre/ /zhis bya 4 4 4 4 107—487

ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su sgeg pa'o//gnyis pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi rnam bzhag ni/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i skabs der 'jad kyi khyel mi gtsang rab gsal/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung / stod lung pa dmar shārkya mu ni gsum chu bo ri na bsgom zhing yod pa na/btsun pa khyi ra byed pa mthong ste/ gtam dris pas/ rgyal pos bstan pa bsgrubs par thos nas 'dul ba'i dpe dre'u khal gcig bkal te stod phyogs la bros nas mnga' ris brgyud/ hor yul du phyin/ der bstan pa dar bar bya snyam pa la/ dar bar ma nus te mdo smad tsha mtsho nas tshur byung ste rma lung rdo rje'i brag ra an chung gnam rdzong ngam/ dan tig shel gyi yang chung yang zer/der bsgom zhing yod pa'i tshe bon po'i rigs las dang skal bar ldan pa mu zu gsal 'bar zhes bya ba dad nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ gtsang gis mkhan po g.yos slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung zhing mtshan dge ba rab gsal du btags / phyis thugs rab che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de nas lo gcig nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas/ dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi 'ong gsungs pa dang / sngar lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang / dge slong gsum glang thang na 'dug pa btsal te dpal gyi rdo rje dang mjal nas zhus pas/ ngas rgyal po bsad pas kha skong mi 'ong gi/ ngas btsal gyi gsungs te/ rgya'i hwa shang ko wang dang / gyim bag bya ba gnyis btsal te btang ngo / /de nas sngar gyi mkhan slob gnyis kyis mkhan slob byas/ dmar gyis gsang ston byas/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis kyis kha skong byas te lnga'i tshogs kyis bsnyen rdzogs byas so/ /gzhan yang mkhan slob de dag las grum ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / bsnubs byang chub rgyal 187—488

mtshan sogs khams pa mang pos kyang rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba dang mngon pa la sogs pa'i bshad pa'ang mnos/ de nas lo lnga lon pa dang / mdo smad na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod pa'i gtam thos te dbus nas klu mes tshul khrims shes rab sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bcus khams su phyin nas gtsang la bka' drin zhus pas nga rgas nas mkhan bu mi skyong bas/ bla chen po la zhus gsungs nas zhus pas nga bsnyen rdzogs byas nas lo lnga las mi 'gro bas mkhan po mi btub gsungs pas/ gtsang na re dmigs gsal btub pas gyis gsungs nas/ bla chen pos mkhan po/ gtsang dang g.yos las slob dang gsang ston / dmar dang hwa shang gis kha skong byas te thams cad chig rdzogs byas so/ /de nas bla chen gyi zhal nas/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan srung gyis/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ chang btsun blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring bskos mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung gsungs so/ /de nas klu mes kyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan las 'dul ba nyan zhing bzhugs/ bying pos yar yong pas sba dang /rag shi gcung po gnyis phu bo bsu ru 'ongs pa dang glang thang du mjal bas gcung gnyis dad de lo ston dang phu bo gnyis las rab tu byung ngo / /de'i phyi lo klu mes kyis bla chen po la bdag dbus gtsang du 'gro bas mchod gnas zhig zhu byas pas bon po'i zhwa 'obs zhu sa ser btab pa gcig gsol 'phro la gnang ste 'di gyon la nga rjes su dran pa gyis gsungs/ yar byon te lcags mo lug gi lo thams cad dbus su 'dzoms pa dang / sngon mkhas btsun gyi gdan sa lha sa yin yang chad pa gcod pa'i sa yin pas/ 'gro ma nus par bsam yas su byon/ de nas rim gyis gnas gzhi brtsigs nas bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa la bstan pa'i me 187—489

ro smad nas gsos zhes grags/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len rgyas par mdzad / slob ma pā la rnam gsum byung ba stod 'dul bar grags/ kho re'i sras lha ldes paṇ+ḍi ta su bhu ti shrī shārnyi gdan drangs nas sher phyogs kyi bstan bcos mang du bsgyur/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos dbu'i mchod gnas su mdzad cing /lo tsā ba 'di gu ge'i sa'i char snyung waṃ rat+na du zhes bya bar 'khrungs shing / lo gnyis lon pa'i tshe dbyangs gsal gsungs shing sa la ri mo 'dri ba sogs tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su blun po lug lta bu'i skye ba ma yin par mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rim par brgyud pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba bstan/ khyad par rgya gar du byon pa'i bskul ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta bsod snyoms pa cig gis rgya dpe klog ma mkhyen pas thugs phyung nas/ shing gi grib ma la gzims pa'i mnal lam du mkha' 'gro'i rtags ldan gyi bud med cig gis/ srin bu'i kha chus rang lus bcings pa ltar/ /yul la zhen pas bdud kyi rgya ru tshud/ /de 'dra thar bar 'dod pa'i mi su dag /byang phyogs kha che'i yul du phyin nas kyang / /rgya gar shar nub chu bzhin myul nas ni / /dam chos rgya mtsho bod du bsgyur na bde/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan byung ba'i rkyen byas te/ dka' spyad du mas kha cher byon/ ka la wa ri bya ba'i grong du slebs / bram ze zhig gis phyag gi ri mor bltas te shis pa brjod/ rkang mgyogs yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel bya ba la brten nas paṇa chen nā ro pa dang / ka ma la gup+ta/ dzi na mi tra sogs kyi drung nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos dpag tu med pa gsan/ mdor na paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma yang bdun cu rtsa lnga bsten pas gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu son cing bstan pa phyi dar la 107—490

skad gnyis smra ba 'di nyid 'gran zla thams cad dang bral bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ye bzang rtse bas kyang bstan pa snga dar las phyi dar sngags kyi bstan pa bod du dar ba yang / lo tsā ba 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin zhes che ba mdzad pa yin no/ /lha sde la sras 'od lde/ zhi ba 'od/ byang chub 'od dang gsum las/chung ba dge slong byang chub 'od bya ba/ phyi nang gi chos dang lo tsā la shin tu mkhas pa zhig bzhugs shing / de yang ye shes 'od rang gi gcung la rgyal srid gtad zin kyang / gar log dang 'thab pa'i dmag dpon du byon pas g.yul pham ste btson du shor ba na/ gar log gis/ dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro 'dor ram/ lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser gang yang rung ba byung na phyir gtong zhes gdam ga byung bas/ dbon sras rnams kyis gser mang du btsal kyang yun du 'gor zhing / ye shes 'od kyi gsung las/ da nged na tshod mthon por gyur pas 'di nas thon kyang bstan 'gro la phan par dka' bas/ gser rnams kyis paṇ+ḍi ta spyan drongs la chos dar bar byed pa'i bka' gnang ste mi ring bar 'das/ dus skabs de dag tu rnga la zhon nas nam mkha' la 'phur thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ ar tsho banadhe bco brgyad sogs kyi lugs 'dzin du mas skye bo mtshon gyis gsod pa dang / sha chang bud med la bag med du spyad pa dang /'dul ba'i bstan pa yang gong du bla chen sogs nas brgyud de dar rgyas che bar yod na'ang / bstan pa snga dar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag srol phal cher nyams/ gsar du paṇ+ḍi ta tshad thub ma byon pa sogs kyis/ bod ston rnams kyis so so'i 'dod sbyar gyi lugs re byas pas/ bslab bya'i gnas phra zhing zhib pa mtha' dag lung sde bzhi/ de dag gi 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa bzhin 'phags yul 107—491

mkhas pa'i lugs dang mthun pa zhig med par mkhyen nas lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ log par rtog pa'i tshul min gyi mun pa drungs nas phyung bar bya ba'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa rta ljang gi dbang po lta bu zhig spyan drang bar dgongs so/ /de nas mi g.yo ba'i snying stobs phul du byung ba'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che bskrun pa la bag tsha ba mi mnga' zhing /rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i dal 'gro'i klung gis / rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' lding rgyal mtshan can gyi bgrod byed la sri zhu'i dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs yang dag par bzung / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas kyi ya lad btsan po gyon cing / mdzangs pa'i yon tan gyi du kū la'i ba dan dkar po srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo ba'i paṇa grub dam pa dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i snyan grags lha bla ma'i snyan gyi dbang por son pa la brten nas/nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du chos slob par phyin par slar yang rang yul du 'khor ba/zhabs sen gyi pad+mo rnam par bskyod pa'i pho nyar rin po che gser gyi phyag rten sogs gya rnam pa'i dngos po dang bcas brdzangs pa lam du nyes pa'i skyon dang bral nas/ bṛ ka ma la shrī lar slebs te/ rgya brtson seng gis mjal ba'i grogs bgyis te/ jo bo'i spyan sngar phyag rten rnams dang bcas/ sngar bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung tshul/ deng sang bstan pa dar yang sde snod lag len du 'debs par dka' zhing / de dag gi tshul la blang dor gyi gnas ston par jo bo lta bu las gzhan pa'i paṇ+ḍi tas phan thogs par dka' tshul rnams zhus te/ lo tsā ba re zhig slob gnyer byed pa ltar bsdad/ jo bos yi dam gyi lha dang grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma la dri ba mdzad pas/ spyi sgos mtha' dag tu 'phrin las kyi sgo che 107—492

zhing ske/ khyad par u pa si ka zhig la brten nas phan thogs 'byung bar lung bstan par brten/ thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas mnga' ris su byon te/ mtho lding gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs nas/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od sogs las can rnams la zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsungs shing / bod du chos bab col du spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por byang chub lam gyi sgron mar grags pa'i bstan bcos khyad par can mdzad/ sngar rgya gar nas phebs khar lo gsum la phyir phebs pa'i khas len gnas brtan shī la ka ra'i drung du nag tshos khas blangs pa bzhin 'phags pa'i yul du byon par chas pa'i tshe/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas jo bo se btsun gyi drung na yod skabs/ mnga' ris su paṇ+ḍi ta byon pa'i gtam gsan pas mgyogs par bshul du bzhugs te jo bo dang mjal/ dbus phyogs su lha sa dang bsam yas kyi thog drangs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyi bsngags brjod mdzad pas/ jo bo chen po dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis phyag lan grangs mang por gnang bas spobs pa lhag par skyes te/ dbus su 'byon par gsol ba bzhin zhal gyis bzhes/ /dus der 'brom gyis bod ston rnams la/ shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam gling gi/ zhes sogs 'phrin yig brdzangs pa bzhin bsu ba la byon/ de nas rim gyis g.yas ru gtsang gi sa'i char phebs te/ yol chos dbang la sogs pa'i slob ma khyad par can 'ga' zhig smin par mdzad/ khu ston gyis yul yar lung bzang ba'i bsngags pa brjod pa la brten nas thang po cher phebs kyang bsten bkur tshul bzhin ma byung bas bros stabs su bsam yas la phebs/ rgya dpe rnams klog pas sngar ma gzigs pa mang po gzigs pas/ slob dpon pad+mas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas spyan drangs 107—493

pa yin nam gsungs/ de nas bod ston dang rngog sogs kyis btegs nas/snye thang / yer pa/ lan pa sogs su phebs te/ gdul bya'i blo mchog dman dang bstun pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos kyi man+da ra ba'i 'phreng ba spel legs kha ba ri pa'i lus can rnams kyi thod du bcings par mdzad do/ /'od lde'i sras rtse lde'i dus su dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher 'dus te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bsnyen bkur dang bdag rkyen mdzad/ jo bo bod du lo bcu bdun bzhugs nas/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa rta'i lo la snye thang du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas/ dga' ldan du byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' dri ma med pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smos na/ ga bur rdul mang brtsegs pa'i do shal gyis/ /'khor yug lang tshor spud pa'i nor 'dzin ma/ /thub bstan snga dar nyin byed 'dzum ma'i bzhin/ /dus kyi chu lha'i phang par rab sbas te/ /nyes brgya'i ral pa nag po bsig pa yi/ /skal ngan mtshan mo srin mo'i khar bzung yang / /rgyal bstan 'od stong lang tsho gsar pa'i bzhin/ /slar yang skal bzang shar ri'i phrag par ngoms/ /dge ba rab gsal thugs bskyed rmad po ches/ /gur gum bla gos 'chang zhing chos spyod bcu/ /mgrin pa'i dbyangs su snyan pa ngur pa'i khyus/ /gangs can pad mtsho li khri'i mdangs su bskrun/ /lhag pa'i thugs bskyed mthu grub lha bla ma/ /ye shes 'od kyis lo paṇa dge 'dun sde/ /legs bshad mgrin glu 'khrol ba'i ngang mo'i khyu/ /bsil ldan chu gter rgyan du stod nas sbyin/ /lhag bsam ba dan bskyod pa'i mkhyen rab gzings/ /gsung rab rin chen rgya mtshor dbang bskur ba/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i ded dpon rin chen bzang / /187—494
