phyi dar nor bu'i gter brgya thog mar drangs/ /'on kyang ar tsho la sogs byung rgyal du/ /spyod pas rgyal bstan pad mtsho rnyog byas pa/ /grung byed dī paṃ ka ra ke ta ka /'dren pa kho na lha gcig thugs la gzhol/ /btson khung nas kyang bod yul bstan 'gror sems/ /sku dang srog kyang de yi ched du btang / /ye shes 'od kyi bka' drin 'di bsam tshe/ /'dren byed khrus kyi rdzing bur yang dag rtsenam/ /byang chub 'od dang nag tsho lo tsā ba'i/ /thugs bskyed rta bdun sbrel ba'i shing rta yis/ /mkhas mchog nam mkha'i nor bu mar me mdzad/ /bod yul mun pa'i gling gi mgon du drangs/ /mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas gang zag gcig /nyams su blang byar sgril la lam rim zhes/ /'phags yul paṇa chen kun kyang smon bya'i gnas/ /rtsal 'dir nyams su mi len 'dor ba 'phangs / /bstan pa snga dar dar mas rab bsnub kyang / /slar yang phyi dar dar bas gangs can ljongs/sgo /'odab brgya rab dar dar dir bung bas bzhinag/ /gyeb bstan rab dar dar dir chos dbyangs 'gengasi/ byu /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcade pa'o//dus tshod der stobs bcu mnga' ba zas gtsang sras po'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i chu shel dbang po ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang / thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas kyi nya yongs su gang ba ltar bod kyi skyes bu dam pa ring nas dam chos 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed rmad po che grub pa rnams kyis rang rang gis rgya gar mkhas pa'i rjes su zhugs nas spel ba'i grub mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bod yul 'dir byung ste/ de la bka' gdams pa ni/ jo bo la rgya bod gnyis su slob ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa 107—495

mang du byung ba las bal bod du byung ba gtso bo 'ga' zhig smos na/ rgya brtson seng / gnas brtan 'on pa/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od dang / zhi ba 'od khu dbon / lo chen rin bzang / lo tsā rma dge slong / pu rang lo chung / go mi sgom chen/ nag tsho lo tsā/ 'gos lo tsā/ 'brog mi/ yol chos dbang sku mched / rong ba mgar dge/ rngog sgom/ gro lung pa/ 'dre shes rab 'bar/yer pa'i zhang btsun ye shes 'bar/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug /rgyal gyi zhang chen po / gar mi yon tan g.yung drung / ye shes sems dpa'/ sgom pa rin chen bla ma/ yon tan rgyal po/ dge ba skyong / phyag khri mchog /a mes byang chub rin chen/ shes rab rdo rje/ phyag dar ston pa/ dgon pa ba/ kha rag sgom chung / 'ben gung rgyal/ khu ston chen po/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab khu dbon sogs mang du bzhugs pa las gdams ngag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis brlabs pa ni spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul a ti sha nyid la sgrol mas lung bstan cing / sangs rgyas phal po che dang / snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes lung bstan pa 'brom rin po che rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin la/ ston pa rin po ches bka' gdams kyi srol phye ba dang / sku mched gsum sogs kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad tshul rnams 'dir zhib tu brjod na ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas bka' gdams chos 'byung sogs las shes par bya zhing / mdo tsam ni chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me las/ de nas lo ngo bcu yi bar dag tu/ /dge bshes ston pas tshogs kyi dpon mdzad de/ /jo bo'i gdan sa dpal gyi rwa sgreng btab/ /yongs su dag pa'i slob 'khor smin par mdzad/ /de nas lo grangs nyi shu lhag 107—496

tsam na/ /sku mched gsum gyi 'phrin las klong rdol te/ /dbu ru byang du bka' gdams nyi ma shar/ /gangs can ma lus 'od kyis gang bar mdzad/ /drang srong chen po po to ba la ni/ /lta spyod yongs su dag pa'i slob ma ni/ /dus re la yang nyis stong lhag tsam dang / /spyan snga pa la brgyad brgya dgu brgya 'dus/ /phu chung ba yis tshogs pa ma bskyangs kyang / /sbas pa'i tshul du dpag med smin par mdzadam/ /khams pa lung pa'i thun brgyad ma la yang / /rnam grol don gnyer brgyad brgya 'dus par grags/ /sku mched gsum gyis legs par bskyangs pa'i sras / /glang thang pa la stong phrag re tsam dang / /dge bshes chen po sha ra ba la ni / /rnam thar gtsang ba sum stong lhag re 'dus/ /dge bshes ya gad pa la stong lhag dang / /bya yul ba la nyis stong bdun brgya sogs/ /'phrin las bskyangs pa'i bshes gnyen mtha' yas te/ /de dus kho na bstan pa'i gdal che'o / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i rjes su bshes gnyen chen po 'chad kha bas mal dro 'chad kha dgon pa btab/ /'gro don lo bcu gcig tsam bskyangs/tshogs pa dgu brgya 'dus/ bshes gnyen dgyer sgom chen po ni sgom pa gtso bor mdzad / mi g.yo ba'i yi ge bcu pa dung phyur bcu gsum gsungs/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du sdod ma myong gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'khrungs shing lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas/ rin chen sgang btab/ dgung lo gya brgyad bar tshogs pa bskyangs te 'gro don mdzad/ byang sems spyil bu pas 'chad kha gsar ma dang / spyil bu dgon pa btab/ dgon pa gong 'og tu lo bcu bzhi'i ring du tshogs pa mang du bskyangs nas 'gro don mdzad/ sangs rgyas 107—497

dbon ni sngon bskal pa dpag med zhig nas phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob/dgyer chen po la bsten tshul khyad par 'phags shing bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gdengs rnyed/ mngon shes dang / rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas / 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob/ mtshan bzang rjes mthun pa dang ldan / skad cig re re la'ang sangs rgyas byang sems nyi zer gyi rdul ltar gzigs pa sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar/ lha lung gi dbang phyug ni sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i zhal gzigs/ spyan ras gzigs nam 'dod du mjal ba sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas/ lo zhe gsum ring 'chad kha'i gdan sa mdzad de 'gro don bskyangs/ lha 'gro ba'i mgon po ni mi g.yo ba'i sprul par grags/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ a ti sha dngos su mjal nas gdams pa mang du stsal/ 'chad kha'i gdan sa lo nyer bdun du bskyangs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ gzhan yang sne'u zur pa/ rgya lcags ri ba/gnyug rum pa/ thag ma pa/ gtsang pa rin chen bla ma/ glang lung pa/ nam mkha' seng ge/ zangs chen pa/ mtsho sna pa/ mon gra pa/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal po/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ rgyal sras bzang po/ mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po sogs rim par byon nas bka' gdams kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad/ de ltar mnga' ris kyi rgyal po lha bla ma khu dbon gyis bstan pa 'ba' zhig thugs la brnags te lus srog longs spyod gang la'ang ma ltos par dka' ba chen pos jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod du gdan drangs pa la brten nas / sngags la snyad btags pa'i rtsing spyod sogs log par spyod pa rnams dang /mdo sngags gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i log rtog rnams nyi ma shar 107—498

bas mun pa rang sangs la song ba bzhin du gyur/ bla chen po'i brgyud 'dzin sogs bstan pa phyi dar gyi lta spyod rnam dag 'dzin pa thams cad kyang jo bo'i bka' brgyud la zhugs pas/ dbus gtsang gi sa'i khyon thams cad rnam thar phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad+ma'i sbubs lta bu dang ldan pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyis yongs su gang bar gyur to//dpal ldan sa skya par grags pa ni/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba rgya gar du byon/ bī ka ma la shī la'i mkhas pa sgo drug la gtugs shing / khyad par du sharnyi pa lo brgyad du bsten nas 'dul phar/ sngags sogs gsan/ rgya gar shar phyogs mi thub zla ba'i slob ma praṣ+ṭha in+d+ra ru rtse zhes pa nas kye rdor gyi dab nga rgyud bshad/man ngag sogs lo bzhi gsan/ khyad par rtsa tshigs med pa'i lam 'bras gsan/bod du phebs nas mang mkhar mu gu lung btab/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra bod du lan gsum byon pa'i dang po'i dus gser srang lnga brgya phul nas gsung ngag rin po che tshang bar gsan/ de'i gzhung gdams ngag gnyis ku'i rgyud 'dzin dpal sa chen kun dga' snying po ste/ bā ri lo tsā las chos mang du gsan/ 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs/ zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i gdams ngag gsan/brang ti las mngon pa/ khyung rin chen grags pa dang / mes lhang tsher las dbu tshad/ gnam kha'u pa sku mched las gsang 'dus dang / gnyan mgon sogs gsan/ khyad par zhang ston las 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i gsung ngag gi gdams pa lo bzhi'i bar du gsan/ grub chen birlu pa chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du sa skyar byon nas spyir rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis kyi man ngag /khyad par lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bcu bzhi/ gsung ngag nye brgyud kyi bdud rtsi — 107—499

ngoms par gsol/ lha'i zhal gzigs pa/ sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba drug dus gcig tu bstan pa sogs rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par grags/ slob ma mchog thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun/rtogs ldan brgyad cu/ gzhung bshad 'dzin pa bcu gcig sogs byon/ zhing 'dir mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan te bde ba can/ po tā la/ o rgyan/byang gser mdog can bzhin sku'i bkod pa bzhi bstan nas 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs skad/ de'i sras bsod nams rtse mo ni/ dgung lo bcu drug tsam nas rgyud dang man ngag gi sgro 'dogs chod/ lhag pa'i lha du ma'i zhal gzigs/gsung ngag sogs gdams pa mtha' yas pa stsal/ chos khri'i steng nas sku de nyid lha'i rol mo sogs bkod pa dpag med dang bcas bde ba can du gshegs/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ rgyud gsum gyi po ti gsol ba'i mnal lam byung ste / de nas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu gcig gi dus kye rdor gsungs pas/ bshad pa 'gang che bas thams cad ya mtshan du gyur/ yab ma gshegs bar chos mang du gsan cing / yab gshegs nas kyang ye shes kyi skus zhal bstan te lam 'bras shin tu nye brgyud gsungs/phyi ma bde ba can du byon/ de nas byang phyogs gser mdog can du rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas su 'gyur bar gsungs/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta ni/ sku bltams ma thag tu saṃ kṛ ta'i skad gsung / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan las mdo sngags kyi zab gnad ma lus pa gsan/ rig pa'i gnas bcu phrag la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i snyan grags che/ mu stegs 'phrog byed sogs rgol ngan drug rigs pas tshar bcad nas bstan pa la bcug /hor go than rgyal pos gdan drangs nas yul 107—500

der bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ dgung lo bdun cu'i steng mkha' spyod du gshegs / de'i phyi ma'i phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing du bde gshegs dri med dpal zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar gsungs/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa ni/ sa paṇa gyis 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'ong zhes gsungs/dgung lo gsum pa'i dus sgrub thabs mtsho skyes thugs thog nas gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar che zhing 'di ni nges par 'phags pa'o zhes de nas bzungs te 'phags par grags/ dgung lo dgu par brtag gnyis tshogs bshad mdzad pas mkhas pa rnams ya mtshan du gyur/ chos rje sa paṇa la mnga' ba'i phyi mtshan nyid dang / nang gsang sngags kyi yon tan phal che ba thugs su chud/ hor se chen rgyal pos kye rdor gyi dbang zhus nas ti shi'i mtshan gsol/ dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum sogs phul/ slar sa skyar phebs dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la gser dang / ja sogs kyi rnyed pa 'bul ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor / dgung lo zhe drug par zhi bar gshegs/ gcung 'gro mgon phyag na ni/shi ba gso nus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bdag nyid can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags / de phyin gyi gdung brgyud ni/ zangs tsho'i sras ye shes 'byung gnas/de'i sras bzang po dpal/ de la sras bco lnga byung bas sras kyi gtso bo ti shi kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' blo sogs da lta'i bar rim par byon/ chos brgyud 'dzin pa mtha' dag ni bgrangs kyis mi langs shing / gtso che ba 'ga' zhig smos na/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston smra ba'i seng ge/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams mdo phyogs kyi brgyud 'dzin dang /187—501

sngags kyi brgyud 'dzin ni/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ budha shrī/ ngor pa kun bzang / rdzong pa kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs mtha' yas pa byon no//bka' brgyud la dwags po bka' brgyud dang / shangs pa bka' brgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni/ grub dbang mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros nas brgyud pa ste/ mar pa lo tsā ni rgya gar du lan gsum byon nas paṇa chen nā ro pa/ ye shes snying po sogs las gsang ba 'dus pa/ kye rdor/ gdan bzhi sogs kyi rgyud dang / bshad pa man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa las lta ba'i sgro 'dogs bcad/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/dgyes pa rdo rje sku dngos su grags/ dgung lo gya drug pa la rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs pa dang bcas te gshegs/ mar pa'i gzhung gi bshad srol 'dzin pa rngog chos sku rdo rje yang grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs shing / rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mtha' yas pa mnga'/ rong gi mes ston tshon po la 'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la 'pho ba'i bka' babs/gung thang gi mi la ras pa la gtum mo'i bka' babs pas bka' babs bzhir grags so/ /mi la ras pa bzhad pa'i rdo rje ni/ rgya gar gyi grub chen dang 'dra bar grub mtha' ris med kyis gtsug nor du 'dzin pa'i rnam thar yongs su grags / mi la'i slob ma nyi ma lta bu dwags po lha rje/ zla ba lta bu ras chung rdor grags / rgyu skar lta bu zhi ba 'od sogs grub thob nyi shu rnams byon no/ /sgam po pa'i slob ma rnams la dwags po bka' brgyud zer zhing / de la nang bses kyis dbye na kurma bka' brgyud/ de bzhin phag gru/ tshal pa/ 'bri khung / 'brug 107—502

pa / stag lung / 'bam rong / g.ya' bzang rnams so sor gyes so/ /de la dang po kurma bka' brgyud ni/ dwags po'i slob ma kurma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'am khams pa dbu se las brgyud pa ste/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ras chen/de'i slob ma sgom brag pa/ de'i slob ma kurma pak+shi sogs byon no/ /gnyis pa phag gru bka' brgyud ni/ dwags po lha rje'i sras kyi thu bo bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba bde gshegs phag mo gru pa las brgyud pa ste/de'i slob ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i bu chen bzhi/ gdams pa'i bu chen bzhi/ro gcig rtogs pa bzhi/ thugs kyi sras bzhi/ yi ge ma'i bu chen bzhi/ nye ba'i sras bzhi segs grub pa'i skyes bu bgrang las 'das/ gdan sa skyong ba ni 'gro mgon gyi rjes su skyu ra rin po che/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas sogs rim par byon/ gsum pa tshal pa bka' brgyud ni/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa las brgyud pa ste/ de'i slob ma nam mkha' 'od/ 'dul ba 'od/nyi zla 'od/ shākya 'od sogs rim par byon/ bzhi pa 'bri khung bka' brgyud ni/skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po las brgyud pa ste/ de'i slob ma spyan snga bzhi/gnyos mgar chos gsum/ dpal chen bcu gnyis sogs mtha' yas shing /gdan sa skyong ba ni rje spyan snga rin po che/ dbon rin po che sogs rim par byon/lnga pa 'brug pa bka' brgyud ni/ bde gshegs phag gru'i slob ma gling ras pad+ma rdo rje dang / gtsang pa rgya ras las brgyud pa ste/ slob ma mang du byung ba'i gtso bo ni dang po che ba rba rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis/ gzhan yang ras pa gsum/ rnal 'byor gsum/ zhig po gsum sogs mang du byon/ gdan sar dbon ras dar ma seng ge/ rgyal 107—503

dbang chos rje sogs rim par byon/ drug pa stag lung bka' brgyud ni/ stag lung thang pa chen po las brgyud pa ste/ de'i dbon rin chen mgon po/ sangs rgyas yar byon rnams rim par byon no/ /bdun pa 'bam rong bka' brgyud ni/grub chen nag po'i sku skyer grags pa 'bam rong dar ma dbang phyug las brgyud pa ste / sras kyi thu bo ti shi ras pa sogs byon no/ /brgyad pa g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud ni/ phag gru'i slob ma skal ldan ye shes seng ge las brgyud pa ste/ slob ma bu chen bzhir grags pa ni gnyal smad dpal ri ba sangs rgyas bya sgom/ go ra gdong pa sangs rgyas lha sgom/ gser lde ba sangs rgyas legs sgom/ dgon gsar ba sangs rgyas rgya sgom bzhi/ de las brgyud pa g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud ste de dag la bka' brgyud zung bzhi ya brgyad du grags so/ /de dag las logs su shangs pa bka' brgyud ni mkhas grub byung po rnal 'byor las brgyud pa ste/de ni rus khyung po/ gzhon nu'i dus nas bon la zhugs pas thugs la ma 'thad par rdzogs chen bslab/ des kyang thugs ma khengs par rgya gar du byon/mkhas grub kyi bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ gzhung dang man ngag mtha' yas pa thugs su chud/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan bzhin g.yas ru shangs su byon nas lo gsum gyi nang du zhong zhing gi dgon pas mtshon dgon pa brgya rtsa brgyad btab/grwa pa khri tsho brgyad 'dus/ sku lus kyi bkod pa brgya rtsa brgyad cig car du ston pa/ri brag la thogs med du byon pa/ bum pa'i nang zhag bdun bzhugs pa/ nam mkha' la bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rnam thar mang /slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab kyang gtso bo ni sme'u ston pa/ g.yar po rgya mo che/rngul ston ri dbang / la stod dkon mchog gar/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 187—504

'grus / zhang sgom chos sems rnams so/ /rmog lcog pa'i slob ma skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge sogs shangs pa rin chen sna bdun nas rim par byon no//zhi byed pa ni/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum ste snga ma kha che dzñā na gu h+ya nas brgyud pa dang / bar pa rma chos kyi shes rab nas brgyud / phyi ma dam pa 'phyar chen/ 'phyar chung sogs nas brgyud pa rnams yin no/ /de'i ya gyal gcod lugs ni/ dam pa bod du lan gsum byon pa'i dus gtsang du skyo ston bsod nams bla ma dang / yar klungs sma ra ser po gnyis la gcod kyi gdams pa gnang / sma ra ser pos nye gnas smyon pa se rong nas rim par brgyud pa la pho gcod dang / skyo ston bsod nams bla mas lab sgron la gnang ste de nas brgyud pa la mo gcod ces grags so//gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa dus phyis byung ba 'ga' zhig brjod na/ rong zom/ lce sgom nang pa/ zur chung pa/ rje sgro phug pa sogs kyis lung gi mdo bdun/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad/ sems sde nyi shu'i skor sogs rgya cher spel/ gzhan yang zhang ston bkra shis rdo rje/ zhang ston/ rta ston/ jo 'bum / mnga' bdag myang / zhig po bdud rtsi/ nyi 'bum/ rta ston jo ye shes / jo bsod/ jo 'bum/ yon tan gzung / jo 'bar/ gu ru chos dbang glu/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ legs ldan skyes/ mnga' ris pad+ma dbang rgyal / rig 'dzin rgod ldem/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ rat+na gling pa/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ gter bdag gling pa/ zur chos dbyings rang grol / pad+ma 'phrin las/ lo chen dharma shrī sogs bka' gter man ngag 'dzin pa'i rig sngags 'chang grags las 'das pa byon no/ /jo nang pa'i grub mtha' 107wa 505

ni / kun spang thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis jo mo nang du dgon pa btab/ dol po pa der bzhugs nas grub mtha' de rgya cher spel bas brgyud 'dzin rnams la jo nang pa zhes grags so/ /grub mtha' nyi tshe ba 'ga' zhig byung tshul ni/ ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la slob ma dang yang slob mang du byung zhing grub mtha' 'di yin bya ba ma byung / bo dong er bshad gra chen po byung bas mkhas grub mang du byon/ khyad par paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal bas bo dong pa'i grub mtha' 'dzug par mdzad na'ang 'phel rgyas yun ring ma byung / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis zhwa lu chos sder rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa'i 'chad nyan yun ring mdzad/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdun cu lhag tsam btsugs/ slob ma gong gsum pa chos kyi dpal ba/ khyung lhas pa/ sgra tshad pa sogs mang du byon/ bu ston gyi rjes su sgra tshad pa khrir bzhugs/ shar chen dang / tsan+d+ra pa sogs brgyud 'dzin rim par byon pa la zhwa lu pa'i grub mtha' 'am bu lugs pa ces grags so/ /bstan pa phyi dar la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha pā la/sangs rgyas skyong / dharma pā la/chos skyong / pradzñā pā la/shes rab skyong / su bha ṣi ta/legs par gsung / shrad+dhā ka ra warma/dad byed mchog pad+ma gup+ta/pad+ma sbas pa/ musti mi tra/grol ba'i bshes gnyen/ bud+dha shrī shārnyi/sangs rgyas dpal zhig pradzñā warma/shes rab go cha/ dri paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na/mar me mdzad ye shes te jo bo rje/ de'i dbon po dā na shrī/ smṛ ti dzñā na klirti/dran pa'i ye shes grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta phra la ring ba/ su na ya shrī/legs par rig pa'i dpal/ kha che dzñā na shrī/ tsan+d+ra rā hu la/ dhī ra pā la/brtan skyong ste 'bum phrag gsum pa/ a tu l+ya da shāmi mnyam khol po/ su ma ti gīrti/blo bzang grags pa/ a ma ra tsan+d+ra/ thig le bum pa/gzhon nu bum pa/ ka na ka warma/gser gyi go cha/ dam pa rgya gar/ dza yā ā nan+ta/107—506

ga ya dha ra/ don yod rdo rje/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje / ye shes rdo rje/ shes rab gsang ba/ ma hā dza na/ pa la tsan+d+ra/stobs kyi zla ba/man+d+ra ka lak+ṣa/ kurma badz+ra/ dza ma ri/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa/ bai ro tsa na badz+ra/snang mdzad rdo rje/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ srur+ya gīrti/ pradzñā shrī dzñā na/ gi gā dha ra/ nor sbas/ sa man+ta shrī/kun bzang dpal/ niṣ+ka laṅga de wa/dza ga mi tra ā nan+ta/'gro ba'i bshes gnyen dga' ba/ bud+dha shrī dzñā na/ shākya shrī bha dra/ bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra/rab 'byor zla ba/ su ga ta shrī/ dā na shī la/ dza yat+ta/ saṃ gha shrī/ su ma ti sā ga ra/ ka la tsan+d+ra/ dzi na gup+ta/ ma hā bo dhi/ dza bha ma shrī/ tre+e lokya ā nan+ta / longs spyod rdo rje/ rat+na shrī/ bal po ma hā pa na/ bal po badz+ra krirti/bal po kā ya shrī/ bal po grags pa dpal/ ku mā ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal / sā dhu krirti/ bi na ya shrī/ shrī la shrī/ maṅga la shrī/ bi ma la shi/bār+shan ā tsar+ya/ dza ya de wa/ lasmri ka ra/ ā nan+da shrī/ rā hu la shrī/ bla ma zangs gling ba/ kirti baṇ+ḍi ta/ sha ri pu tra/ nags kyi rin chen/ bud+dha gup+ta rnams so/ /de'i skabs kyi lo tsā ba yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ grags 'byor shes rab/ 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od/ lha bla ma zhi ba 'od/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ khu dngos grub/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'brog mi shākya blo gros/ chos kyi shes rab/ mar thung dad pa shes rab/ rma dge ba'i blo gros/ ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ khyung po chos kyi brtson 'grus/stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus/ mgar chos bzang / she'u badz+ra de wa/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ pu rang legs pa'i shes rab/107—507

zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ gzu dga' ba rdo rje / gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ chos kyi yon tan/ chos kyi rin chen/ lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas / gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ glog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo blo gros grags / se tsa ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rong pa chos bzang yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug /mang 'or byang chub shes rab/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags / khye'u gad kha 'khor lo grags/ spong zho gsal ba grags/ ding ri chos grags/ rgyus smon lam grags/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ ba ri rin chen grags / 'byo shes rab grags/ rwa rdo rje grags/ sga lo gzhon nu dpal/ kre bo shes rab dpal/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ ba reg thos pa dga'/ rma ban chos 'bar/ mtshur ston dbyig gi rgyal mtshan/ mtshur ston dbang nge /dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ dpyal kun dga' grags/ mar do chos kyi dbang phyug /chos kyi snying po/ kum chos ye shes/ phyugs mtshams dbang phyug rgya mtsho / tshul khrims yon tan/ khye'u gad pa yon tan dpal/ bsod nams bzang po/ sum pa dpal mchog rdo rje/ nyi ma rdo rje/ khu dge bsnyen ne tso/glog skya gzhon nu 'bar/ lha ye shes rgyal mtshan/ byang chub 'byung gnas/glan chos kyi blo gros/ cog gru bstan 'dzin bzang po/ shes rab ye shes/rig pa gzhon nu/ gzhon tshul/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ shes rab brtson 'grus/g.yung drung 'od/ bsod nams rgyal ba/ cog gru shes rab bla ma/ cog gru mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ la chings yon tan 'bar/ bsod nams mos pa/dge tshul khyung grags pa/ tshul khrims brtsegs/ lha btsun pa/ lha btsan po 187—508

mu ni rā dza/ rngog sangs rgyas bskyangs/ rgya lo tsā/ sbal rdo rje rgyal po/ lha rin po che/ lha chos kyi rin chen/ skyu ra tshul khrims 'od zer/ dge slong bya'i gdong pa can/ ra byid lo tsā ba/ phur bu 'od/ pa tshab tshul rgyal/ shes rab legs/ nag tsho dharma grags/ mar pa blo gros bzang po/ se lo tsā/ zla ba grags pa/ gnyal mi ye shes chos/ chos kyi zla ba/ dge slong shes rab bskyabs / nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs/ gnyan ston bsod nams dar/ ba ri chos grags/ ong po lo tsā/ gzhon nu shes rab/'gar shes rab 'byung gnas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ shes rab 'od zer/lce dga' ba dpal/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ shākya brtson 'grus/ rwa chos rab/lo btsun chung rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ zha ma dge bsnyen seng rgyal/ lce bkra shis/chag lo dgra bcom/ dpyal chos bzang / gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chag chos rje dpal/ dpyal shes rab 'od/ zhang grub pa dpal/glo bo shes rab rin chen/ lho brag dar ma seng ge/ mi mnyam bzang po/ shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shong blo gros brtan pa/ o rgyan pa rin chen dpal/khams pa blo gros rgyal po/ ldan ma tshul seng / ra sa gzhon brtson/ shu ke grags pa rgyal mtshan/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/sgra tshad smra ba rin rgyal/ dbus pa blo gsal/ stag lung pa legs pa'i blo gros/yar lung grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub/thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ jo nang blo gros dpal/ kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ bo dong grags pa rgyal mtshan/snar thang sat+ta shrī/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/ chos 'khor sgang pa shes rab 187—509

rin chen/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khrims khang pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ jo nang tā ra na thā/ 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs rnams byon cing de dag gi bka' drin la brten nas ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad do/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ man shel do shal rgod pa'i 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ /sna tshogs tshon brgyar phye ba'i grub pa'i mtha'/ /nges legs sbrang rtsi'i zil dngar gcig nyid du/ 'dzum pa'i saspre gsar pa'i thig les gtams/ /tshul khrims dri bzang khang pa dkar po'i 'dzum/ /lhag bsam ga bur 'dab ma stong bskyod pa / /legs gsung gdams par 'khyer ba'i dpal gyi gos/ /gangs can 'o mtsho mdzes pa'i lang tshor bkab/ /gzhung lugs yal ga'i khyon yangs gsang chen gyi/ /gdams zab rin chen gang bu bye ba'i khur/ /'dzin pa dpal ldan sa skya sa rtol dbang / /bsil ljongs nor 'jin dga' ba'i tshal du gtams/ /nyams rtogs 'dab ma yangs por bskyod pa'i rtsal/ /grub pa'i mkha' dbyings mthon por rtsen pa yi/ /bka' brgyud zung bzhi ya brgyad bzhad dkar khyu/ /nyams mgur mgrin glu snyan pas bsil ljongs khengs/ /a don skye ba med pa'i sbrang rtsi'i sgras/ /bdud bzhi'i snyems pa gcod cing sim pa'i dpyid/ /ster ba zhi byed gcod yul gzhan gsos bus/ /bho ṭa'i sman ljongs dog por bgyid la brel / /khreg chod thod rgal gom pa'i stabs gcig gis/ /gdod ma'i sa chen cig car 'phrog byed pa'i/ snga 'gyur rig sngags 'chang ba'i gom gsum non / /slar yang bsil ljongs khyab pa'i 'jug pa spro/ /rtag brtan ther zug lta ba'i tsher rno yang / /dbang brgyud man ngag ha rir 'gran pa'i dris/ /ngal 107—510

bso'i ljon shing jo mo nang pa nas/ /bsil ldan sa 'dzin tshang tshing dkrig par byas / /gangs can grub mtha' mtha' dag mtshon min yang / /grags can 'ga' re re zigs tsam du bkodi/ sgo/kun la dag snang snang byed nor bu yi/ /'od chargeso spros na na rga kun las grol/ /zhes bya ba g.yang chubar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ོ ོde nas bka' gdams gsar ma'am dge ldan ring lugs ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar mkhas grub kyi skyes bu du mas ris su ma mchis pa'i grub mtha'i khyad par ji snyed cig srol gtod de thub bstan nyin byed gzhon nu'i rtse dgas gangs can pa mtha' dag gtan bde'i snang ba mchog la 'god par mdzad na'ang ske/ de dag kyang dus kyi rim pas je nyams su gyur te mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mtha' dag gzugs brnyan tsam du spyod pa na/ slar yang snyigs ma'i dus su gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa tshang la ma nor ba spel ba la mkhyen brtse nus gsum gang gi thad nas kyang 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba rigs gsum mgon po dang mtshungs shing / nges pa'i don du 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon po nyid mi'i sha tshugs su byon pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba rang nyid slar byon pa lta bur gyur pa gangs can gyi shing rta chen po rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po zhes grags pa don ldan gyi gdugs dkar srid zhi'i bla na g.yo ba de nyid byon te/ de yang mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po'i bstan pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u las/ kun dga' bo/ da lta nga la shel dkar gyi/ /phreng ba ster ba'i khye'u 'di/ /nga yi bstan pa'i gso byed la/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su ni/ /'bri dang ldan pa'i sa mtshams su/ /dge zhes bya ba'i dgon 107—511

pa 'debs/ /blo bzang zhes bya'i ming can 'gyur/ /'khor ni rnam mang bsdu bar byed/ /chos spyod bcu yi rgyun 'dzag cing / /lha khang ka ba shing lo can/ /nga yi gzugs sku rnam gnyis la/ /dbu rgyan 'bul zhing mchod par byed/ /ston pa'i mdo bzhin gsung sgrog cing / /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs / /de la gsol ba rab 'debs na/ /bstan pa lo stong bar du gnas/ /de nas 'phos nas shar phyogs kyi/ /rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten du/ /seng ge'i nga ro zhes byar gyur/ /de la dad byed zhing der skye/ /zhing mchog de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs/ de'ang da lta ngal sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis lta spyod gtsang ma'i brgyud pa rgyal ba rang nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin spel bar mdzad pa dang / ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i zhes sogs tshig rkang pa bzhis 'bri khung dang / skyid shod ldan gyi mtshams su dga' ldan zhes bya'i dgon pa 'debs pa dang / rjes 'jug rnams la'ang dge lugs pa zhes pa'i ming gis bsngags pa dang / blo bzang zhes pa'i mtshan zur gsal bar lung bstan/'khor ni mang po bsdu bar byed ces pas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa rang nyid ljongs 'dir gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na rje btsun spyan ras gzigs rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po mkhas grub rje'i rnam par bstan pa sogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras mthu chen mang po zhig sras kyi thu bo'i tshul du 'byon pa dang / slob ma sde snod 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyis sa steng khyab pa dang / bod rje mang po dang / rgya nag rgyal po sogs kyis gtsug gi nor bus bkur ba sogs bstan/ chos spyod bcu yi rgyun 'dzug cing / zhes chos sde chen po se 'bras dga' gsum la sogs pa dge 'dun gyi sde 187—512

bod dang bod chen po/ rgya dang chen po hor sogs sa'i khyon du 'gengs pas thos bas sgom gsum la sogs pa'i chos spyod bcu'i rgyun da lta'i bar mi nyams par 'byung bar bstan/ lha khang ka ba shing lo can/ zhes pa nas/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis jo shāka rnam gnyis la dbu rgyan 'bul zhing / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgya chen 'dzug pa dang / de'i dus dge 'dun khri phrag rgal ba rnams kyis gsol ba 'debs pa dang / de la gsol ba zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis thub pa'i bstan pa lo stong gi bar 'phel zhing gnas pa dang / de nas 'phos nas zhes pa nas/ khyad par 'phags zhes pa'i bar gyi rkang pa lngas rje nyid ma 'ongs pa na ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing du rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ror 'gyur ba dang / rje nyid la dad pa rnams kyang zhing der skye zhing / zhing de ni dag zhing gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa sogs gsal bar lung bstan cing / lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas dung dkar po zhig phul ba moṅgal gyi bu la gnang nas/'di khyod kyis 'gog pa rir sbos shig /ma 'ongs pa na dge slong pad+ma'i ngang ldan 'dis gter nas 'don pas de'i tshogs dung du 'gyur gyi/ gter bdag spre'u'i gnas byed do/ /zhes rje bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ 'gog pa ri zhes bya ba 'brog ri bo che dga' ldan gyi byang ngos nas dung gter nas bzhes te lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dung mdzad/ de nas 'jam dbyangs chos rje la gnang ste 'bras spungs su rje'i bstan pa ches cher 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad / thugs smon mdzad pa ltar grub ste da lta yang 'dzam bu'i gling na mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub 'phel ba dang / dge 'dun grangs mang bar bzhugs shing /107—513

gter dung yang kun gyi mig la bltar yod pa 'di ltar ro/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng 'di stong gyur na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sa steng 'dir stong pa ltar gyur pa na 'jam dpal dbyangs khyod nyid gyis pa ste so so skye bo'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa kun gyi mchog gsung gi mdzad pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mdzad pa dang / dgon pa dang chos lugs kyi ming dga' ldan zhes gsal bar lung bstan/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos kyang / de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing skyes chen dam pa ni/ /snying po'i mtha' rten rnal 'byor chen po des/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur chen po mdzad/ /de la bsnyen bkur cher byed de dge ni/ /'phags pa'i gang zag dge sbyong sha stag go/ /de phyir de dag kun la gus pa bskyed / /de dag ci phyir 'phags pa yin zhe na/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mdzad pa chen po mdzad/ /de phyir de ni 'phags pa'i gang zag go/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams 'byung zhing / /'khor ni legs gnas ston pa'i gsung rab dang / /ston pa'i sku gzugs dngos su bzhugs pa dang / /ri bo yon tan can yang de na yod/ /ces bdag nyid chen po 'di 'khrungs yul dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan dang / jo bo rnam gnyis la dbu rgyan 'bul ba dang / mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad de bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa dang /gsung las skyes pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag mtha' yas pa 'byung zhing ston pa'i 10 7—514

bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa rnams gsal bar lung bstan/ bka' gdams glegs bam las kyang bla ma dri ma med pas/ sprul pa gcig ni mdo khams smad nas 'byung / /zhes dang / yang / bdag gi sprul pa dam pa gcig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ /zhes rje nyid dang / res 'ga' gsol 'debs dbyangs kyi gzugs/ /zhes gsol 'debs dmigs brtse ma dang —/ res 'ga' yig 'bru gzungs kyi gzugs/ /zhes sku 'bum du sku'i lte khrag sa la dor ba las 'khrungs pa'i tsan dan gyi ljon par gzungs sngags rang byon du 'khrungs pa dang / grags pa can ni dge slong ngo / /zhes mtshan zur dang bcas pa gsal bar lung bstan/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan pa rab grags cho ga bzang zhes ldan 4pa yo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med pa yin pa ༄ste/ /bshad pa'i skye bo'i stonang na nyi ma bzhin du lham/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las kyang / blo bzang nyi mas mun pa stug po rnam par sel nas ni/ /mkhas pa dag gis stong nyid khong du chud cing grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes so so'i gzhung gis dngos bstan gyi 'grel tshul rang gi 'grel ba ltar yang / sbas don du rje'i mtshan sgra dang mdzad pa sogs gsal bar lung bstan pa mkhas mchog gong ma rnams kyi zhal rgyun du 'byung zhing / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ma gcig lab kyi sgron mas gcod gzhung chen mor bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib lung bstan pa las/ yum gyis de lta bu'i rgyal khrims dang chos khrims 'chug pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mun nag tu glog 'khyug pa lta bu zhig 'byung zhes gsungs pa la/ bsod nams rgyan la sogs pa bu mo bzhis/de lta bu'i bka' drin can de su lags/ zhes sogs mang du zhus pa'i lan du/107—515

bu mo khyod kyis dris pa'i byang sems de/ /ma 'ong bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa yin/ /da lta byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs che/ /snyigs dus log spyod bod yul byung ba'i tshe/ /dge slong tshul 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan thogs te / /gang gi zhing du seng ge'i nga ror grags/ /khrims 'chal log spyod spobs pa zil gnon pas/ /khrims 'chal bag med yang dag khrims la sbyor/ /thub nyid srol gtod bstan pa'i phyag rtags 'dzin/ /bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong ngo / /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa'i bcud phyung nas/ /gdul byar gyur pa'i skal ldan tshim par mdzad / /ces bdag nyid chen po 'di snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bsam bzhin du byon te mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa ches cher spel bar mdzad pa gsal bar lung bstan to/ /de bzhin du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis kyang gsal bar lung bstan pa sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas lung bstan tshul mtha' dag ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das so/ /de ltar 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni mdo khams smad kyi sa'i cha shar tsong kha zhes grags pa de yin la/ der ji ltar 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/me pho spre'u'i lo dgun gyi dus rje 'di'i yab kyi mnal lam du/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas 'ong zer ba'i btsun pa me tog gi 'phreng ba du ma sbrel ba'i chos gos dang /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi shing lo yin zer ba dar ser po 'dra ba'i sham thabs can po ti khyer ba zhig byung nas/ nga khyed la gnas shig g.yar ba yin zer nas mchod khang zhig yod pa'i nang du song ba'i snang ba byung ba ni khye'u 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa zhig 'byung ba'i mtshan ma dang / yum gyi mnal lam du yang me tog gi 187—516

thang chen po zhig tu bud med stong tsam gral byas pa'i nang yum rang yang bsdad paral/ shar nas khye'u dkar po bum pa 'dzin pa gcig dang / nub nas bu mo dmar mo rma bya'i sgro mdongs sder ma tsam yod pa cig lag pa g.yas na bzung /me long chen po zhig g.yon na bzung nas byung bas/ bu mo de gnyis gros byas te bud med thams cad la 'dis rung ngam 'dis rung ngam zhes khye'u des bu mo de la 'dri zhing bu mo des gzhan rnams re re la skyon re btags/ khye'u des yum la mdzub mo btsugs nas 'dis rung ngam zhes 'dri ba la/ bu mo des 'dzum byas nas rung zer/ 'o na 'di la khrus kyis zer nas/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs dbyangs dang bcas khrus byas pas lus kyi dri ma dag nas bde sangs sangs pa'i snang ba zhig byung ba dang / gnyid sad nas lus yang ba dang sems bde ba la sogs pa'i dge mtshan du ma byung ngo / /dus de nas bzung ste khyim mtshes dang yul mi rnams kyi rmi lam du'ang dge 'dun mang pos jo bo rin po che dbus nas gdan drangs byung ba sogs rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba mang du byung ba dang /nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig la shar ba dang / me tog gi char yang yang 'bab pa dang ske/ spos kyi dri bzang po bro ba dang / nam mkha' la rol mo'i sgra grags pa dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas yul der kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa du ma byung ngo / /bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nub mo yum gyi mnal lam du dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa bzung ste/ spyan ras gzigs byon pa la bsu ba byed zer ba'i rjes la bltas pas gser sku ri bo tsam 'od zer 'phro ba chos kyi sgra dbyangs dang ldan pa lha'i bu dang bu mos bskor ba zhig mar bab byung bas gser sku je chung la song ste 'khor 107—517

dang bcas rang la thim pa'i snang ba byung ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i khye'u zhig 'byung ba'i mtshan ma dang / de phyin chad lus la gtsang sbra dang gces spras rang shugs kyis byed dgos pa byung / yang yab kyi mnal lam du lcang lo can nas 'phags sam snyam pa'i gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig yum la thim pa rmis pas bu stobs ldan zhig skye ba yin nam zhes gleng yang / don du phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i khye'u zhig 'byung ba'i mtshan ma gsal/ sku bltams pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe yum gyi mnal lam du dge 'dun mang po dang skye bo'i khrom chen pos mchod pa rnam lnga khyer nas mchod khang mjal zer/ de gang na yod dris pas sngar gyi khye'u dkar po des chu shel gyi lde mig gcig bzung nas 'di na yod zer zhing yum rang gi brang na sgo chung ser po zhig 'dug pa phye ba'i nang nas sngar lus la thim pa'i gser sku de bton nas dri mas cung zad nogs pa la sngar gyi bu mo de byung nas de la bum chus khrus byas/ rma bya'i sgros byabs/ rgya gar gyi skad yin nam snyam pa'i dar dir mang po dbyangs su len zhing lha de la mchod pa 'bul gyin 'dug pa'i snang ba byung / gnyid sad nas tho rangs skar chen shar ba dang stabs gcig par rab byung drug pa'i me mo bya'i lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po dang bcas bde bar 'khrungs so/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu de 'khrungs pa'i sang nyin yul de'i phur 'jigs mdzad rdo rje grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po chos rje don grub rin chen zhes bya ba bzhugs yod pa des yab yum gnyis la legs so'i bsngags pa dang gnang sbyin/ rgyal sras gzhon nu de la bzhes rgyu'i bdud rtsi ril bu/sku la bcangs rgyu'i srung mdud/ rten 'brel bsgrigs par dgongs te rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bris sku byin rlabs can gcig dang / bu chung skyong lugs kyi yi 107—518

ge la sogs pa nye gnas tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhig la bskur nas byung ste bla ma des thugs mkhyen gyis mkhyen par 'dug /phyis rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ ngas rmi lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mjal bas gsol ba btab/ khyad par du zhal yang yang bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ sang phod da tsam lung pa 'di'i mda' ru yong / de bar du bde bar gyis gsungs pas/ de gang yin dpyad pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas khyed kyi bur 'dug pa thigs pa yin gsung ba la sogs pa'i gsang ba'i gnas du ma gsungs nas/ phyis kyang bu chung bskyed bsring ba dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyangs can ma la sogs pa'i sgo nas shes rab 'phel ba'i thabs du ma'ang mdzad do/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu de yum gyi mngal nas 'khrungs ma thag lte ba bcad pa'i mtshal khrag sa la lhung ba las tsan dan dkar po'i sdong po zhig gsar du skyes pa de la yal ga mang du gyes shing lo ma 'bum yod pa/ lo ma re re la de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge nga ro'i sku re re yod pa zhig byung bas sku 'bum zhes grags/ dus phyis 7rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho gnas der byon nas gus pa chen pos mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad cing / shing 'di 'dra las lhag pa'i byin rlabs can dkon zhes shing de'i phyi dngul gyis gtums te byang chub mchod rten gyi rnam par byas/ gnas der rje bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa la bshad sgrub byed pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde zhig gsar du 'dzugs par bzhed de zhal bkod gnang ba thugs bzhed ltar grub nas sku 'bum byams pa gling zhes btags/ mchod sdong de'i phyi rol du tsan dan gyi sdong po gsar pa zhig thon pa de la yang yal ga dang lo ma rnams la a ra pa tsa na dang / dhīḥdang hūṃ la sogs pa yi ge'i gzugs rang byon 107—519

du 'khrungs pa dang / de'i yal ga dang lo ma zos na shes rab skye zhing rims nad sogs zhi ba kun gyi mthun snang du yod cing ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar 'di gcig pus kyang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos dang mi gnyis par grub bo/ /de lta bu'i rgyal sras gzhon nu de nyid snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byon kyang 'dam gyi dbus su skyes pa'i pad+ma 'dam gyis mi gos pa ltar snyigs ma'i skyon gang gis kyang ma gos shing / gyis pa'i tshul bzung yang byis pa'i ngang tshul las yang dag par 'das / dam pa'i rang rtags rlabs chen rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag rang shugs su byung / dgung lo gsum pa la bab pa na chos rje kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yongs su rdzogs par mnos te/ mtshan yang kun dga' snying po zhes btags so/ /de nas dgung lo bdun pa la nye bar chos rje don grub rin chen gyi zhabs drung du phebs/ rab tu ma byung ba'i snga rol nyid du'ang chos rje des rje 'di pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du bcug dbang bskur te gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor smin par mdzad cing / de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa dang /kyai rdo rje dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dbang bskur / gsang mtshan don yod rdo rje zhes btags/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa dang dam tshig dbang dus su ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par bsrung bar mdzad/ gsung rab klog pa thogs pa med par rang shugs kyis mkhyen/ bde dgyes/ kun rig la sogs pa'i mngon rtogs dang /dkyil chog mang po tshegs med du thugs su chud/ gshin rje gshed dang bde mchog la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa yang mdzad nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i bdag 107—520

'jug yang lan mang bzhes/ phyag rdor gtum po phyag gnyis pa zhig nub re bzhin mnal lam du yun ring gsal ba dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i snang ba shar zhing / khyad par jo bo a ti sha mnal lam du nar mar 'ong ngo / /dgung lo bdun la babs pa'i tshe khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar mdzad de/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan yang dag par bzhes/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son cing lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs kyis mngon par mtho ba'i bla ma don grub rin chen pas mkhan po mdzad / dbus gtsang dang bal po sogs su mkhas grub dang paṇ+ḍi ta du ma la gtugs nas mdo sngags mang po la sbyangs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po ta dben gzhon nu seng ge zhes grags pa'i slob ma gzhon nu byang chub ces bya bas slob dpon mdzad de tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos shing /mtshan yang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes bya bar gsol to/ /de ltar chos rje don grub rin chen pas rje 'di nyid thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po chos kyi rgyal po chen por 'gyur bar gzigs nas 'khrungs ma thag nas bzung / dbus gtsang du 'byon pa'i chas rkyen dang bskul ma mdzad pa'i bar sman gyi shing ljon pa chen po'i myu gu ltar shin tu gces par bskyangs par mdzad pas chos rje 'di nyid bka' drin zla med du 'dzin par mdzad do/ /dgung lo bcu drug la babs pa'i tshe chos rjes kyang bskul zhing / rang nyid kyang spro shugs chen pos thub bstan rin chen du ma'i mngal khur 'dzin pa'i sa'i thig le dbus gtsang nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i lto bar zhabs zung gi pad+mo 'god par bzhed pa na/ chos rje don rin pas zhal gdams lhug pa mang po dang / gzhon nu blo bzang grags pa khyod/ /107—521

ces sogs tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas gzhung lugs la thos bsam mdzad tshul/ thos don nyams su bzhes tshul/ gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung nas 7rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por bzhengs dgos tshul gdams par mdzad/ rje 'di pas kyang chos rje don grub rin chen gyi bka' bzhin bgyi'o zhes zhus shing phyag btsal te byin rlabs zhus nas 'bri khung mthil pa'i 'bul dpon ldan ma rin chen dpal gyis gdan drangs nas 'phrin las pa dang 'grogs te reg pa don ldan zhabs sen bkra shis kyi re kha bsgyur/ glang lo'i ston gyi dus su 'bri khung dpal gyi nags khrod du phebs/ de'i tshe 'bri khung gi spyan snga rin po che chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa mjal/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang / phyag chen lnga ldan la sogs pa zab khrid mang du gsan/ de nas slob gnyer la byon par bzhed pa la grogs 'ga' zhig gi dbang gis tshal pa'i sman pa mkhas pa dbon dkon mchog skyabs zhes pa'i gam du byon nas gso dpyad kyi gzhung la sbyangs shing / yan lag brgyad pa thugs la bzung ste gso dpyad kyi skor rnams bslabs pas gzhung man ngag lag len dang bcas pa la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ mi ring ba chos gra chen po bde ba can du byon/ bde ba can pa'i rin po che snye thang pa bkra shis seng ge dang / gdan sa dge bskong pa gnyis la chos 'brel gsan/ klog pa'i slob dpon yon tan rgya mtsho dang /zhar chos pa slob dpon u rgyan pas mdzad nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel la legs par thugs sbyongs mdzad/ zhag bco brgyad tsam gyis gzhung tshig mtha' dag shin tu byang bar thugs su chud/ ring po ma lon par tshig don mtha' dag la shin tu mkhas 107—522

par gyur/ mdo sde rgyan ni sngar mdo smad du bzhugs pa'i dus nas thugs su chud de rtsal bshad mdzad cing / 'dir yang byams chos mtha' dag gsan cing thugs su chud/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po'i cod pan dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dben gnas chos rdzong du phyag phebs pa'i spyan sngar mjal / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / bde mchog dril bu pa phyi dkyil dang lus dkyil gyi dbang / gur gyi mgon po'i rjes gnang rnams gsan no/ /de ltar lo gnyis tsam la phar phyin gyi tshig don la shin tu mkhas par gyur nas dgung lo bcu dgu'i steng du gsang phu dang bde ba can la sogs pa rnams su grwa skor la byon/ blo gros dang chos skad phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan pa ring du song zhing / bshes gnyen mkhas pa dag gi yid kyi dbang po rnam par dpyod pa'i lcags kyus drangs par gyur to/ /de dag la dbyangs kyis cung zad sgeg par spro na/ mkhas grub sgron me'i phreng bas gangs can ljongs/ /rang rang 'bad brgya'i snang bas gsal brtson pa'i/ /ngal ba cig car 'gog pa'i 'od kyi rlabs / /blo bzang nyin byed dbang po 'gro 'dir byon/ /ral gri'i gdengs ka blo bzang blo yi tshul/ /li khri'i lang tsho ngur smrig gos kyis bkab/ /nī la'i zur ced goser sbyangs zhwa ru sbas/ /'jam dbyangs sbas pa'i brtul zhugs grags pa'i dpal/ /sgyu 'phrul gnyis pa'i lhums kyi sprin rum las/ /blo bzang ston sad dbang po khyod shar tshe/ /sa gsum rgyad pa'i smag rum kun btang nas/ /rgyal bstan gser zhun bla gos ngoms la brel/ /yab gcig gzhon nu'i lus 'chang blo yi gter/ /gzhan zhig sa yi thig le der snang ste/ byis pa byis pa'i rang bzhin kun spangs pa'i/ /mthun snang rgyal ba'i yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /187—523

tshul khrims phung po nor bu dmar po'i rdul/ /bcu gnyis gang ba rdzogs kyang slar yang ni/ /sa gsum tshangs spyod snang ba 'grems pa'i slad/ /ngur smrig 'od chags klubs la brel bar gyur/ /mkhyen pa'i grwa zur gcig tu shes bya'i khyon / /dog pa med par bcug kyang mi ngoms par/ /chu gter chu phran sdud la brel ba bzhin/ /legs bshad 'tshol la rings pa'i tshul gyis brel/ /thugs bskyed rta bdun sgyur ba'i kha lo pas/ /mtshan dpe'i nyin byed ljongs 'dir drangs pa na/ /tshangs pa'i gtsug tor mdzes pa'i zhabs kyi rdul/ /dbus 'gyur sa yi thig les 'dzin par gyur/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can gang gi mkhyen rab tshul/ /thugs rje rje btsun spyan ras gzirges nyide de/ /gsang bdag bdag nyid mthu nus rirgos gsum gar/ /blo bzang bzang po'i byin brgyos bdeg skyongs shig /ces bya ba 'di bar skabs kyi tshogs du bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smos pa'o//de nas gtsang phyogs la byon par bzhed de/ rin spungs kyi phu'i la la byon myang stod khar kha brgyud nas zhwa lur phebs/ bu ston rin po che'i dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i gdan sa pa lo tsā ba mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal gyi drung du mjal/ bde mchog mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang zhig gsan/ de nas rim gyis snar thang dang dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ sa skya'i dus chos ma tshugs kyi ring la sa bzang du byon nas paṇa chen ma ti pa'i drung du chos bka' ci rigs pa gsan/ dus chos tshugs nas sa skyar phar phyin gyi grwa skor mdzad/ de nas la stod byang la byon/ 'dar bzang ldan/ ngam ring / 'ga' rong chos sde rnams su'ang grwa skor mdzad nas jo mo nang du phebs/ chos rje phyogs las rnam 107—524

rgyal pa'i drung du sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid la sogs pa gsan/ de nas bo dong la byon/ mar res spyi bo lhas su phebs/ de'i mkhan chen pa la bka' gdams lam rim gyi lung gsan/ de nas chos grwa chen po er grwa skor mdzad nas snar thang du phebs/ snar thang gi mkhas pa bla ma lo tsā ba don bzang ba la mdzod kyi bshad pa tshar gcig gsan/ de nas myang stod du phebs te gnas rnying pa'i gzungs sgrub kyi steng du phar phyin gyi grwa skor mdzad/ dbyar chos la rtse chen du phebs par mdzad nas mkhas pa'i dbang po nya dbon kun dga' dpal ba'i spyan sngar phar phyin gyi gzab bshad tshar gcig gsan/ thugs rab gsal zhing rnam dpyod yongs su rno ba dang / bshad par bya ba'i gnad rnams brda sprod pa phul du byung bas gdul bya'i rna bar 'bab cing / mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis shin tu thugs rangs par gyur/ rje btsun red mda' ba dbyar de sa skya nas rtse chen du phebs 'dug pa la mngon pa mdzod kyi rang 'grel gyi steng nas mdzub khrid du mdzad de gsan pas/ gzhung gi tshig rigs tsam la brten pa ma yin par bstan bcos kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i don gyi khog legs par bsgrigs nas 'gangs chun pa'i go ba bogs chod du ster nus pa zhig 'dug pas dang ba chen po 'khrungs / gang gsung thams cad lan re kho nas tshig don lhag ma med par thugs su chud cing / dka' ba'i gnad rnams la dri gtugs legs par mdzad pas rje btsun red mda' ba yang thugs shin tu 'phrog par gyur te khyed la mdzub khrid byed pa la legs par bsgrims dgos par 'dug ces gsungs so/ /rje rin po che 'di nyid kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang nges rnam par 'byed pa'i shing rta chen po dag gi lam srol dang / dbu tshad kyi rigs pa'i sgo dang po rje btsun 'di 107—525

nyid las rnyed pas/ de'i phyir rje red mda' ba 'di 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma'i gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i bla ma de nyid la mdzod kyi chos thun 'ga' zhig mdzub khrid kyi lugs su mdzad/ de lhag don la khyad par mi 'dug kyang da lta'i mtshan nyid pa rnams la grags pa dang bstun nas chos nyan bshad kyi lugs su byas nas gsan gsungs/ rtse chen gyi dbyar chos de grol nas ston bla ma rje btsun pa dang dpon slob gnyis gas myang stod bsam gling du chos bar la byon nas rje btsun red mda' ba las dbu ma 'jug pa tshar gcig gsan/ rje btsun red mda' bas kyang dbu ma gsung ba'i snga shos der 'dug /ston mjug myang stod nas phyag btegs nas dbus su phebs par mdzad/ po tā lar byon nas lo chen byang rtse la mngon pa gsung bar zhus pas khong pa rang shin tu gsung bar bzhed pa 'dug pa la/ 'on kyang dgung lo mang du bzhes pa sogs kyi dbang gis myur du kho rang gi gdan sar phebs pa 'thad snyam pa yid la bzhag nas / myur bar gtsang phyogs su thegs par 'dun pa'i zhu ba rdzong ji bas phul ba la brten nas de 'phral dbus nas gtsang phyogs su phyag btegs pas mngon pa'i thugs bzhed ma grub kyang chos 'brel zhig gsan/ de'i dgun chos bde ba can du byon nas bzhugs/ de rjes skyor mo lung pa'i mkhan po dka' bzhi pa blo gsal ba zhes grags pa 'dul mdzod la shin tu mkhas par byed pa de'i drung du skyor mo lung du byon/ khong sngon dus kyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i khrod na nyi ma ltar grags pa'i 'dul 'dzin chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen thag ma pa'i bu chen sbas ti dgra bcom pa'i bshad rgyun 'dzin pa'i gdan sa pa 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas/ de'i legs par bshad pa'i bgo skal blang bar 107—526

bzhed de khong la 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba 'grel pa cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan te/ long gi thugs la mnga' ba'i 'dul ba'i bshad srol lhag ma med par thugs su chud cing khyad par lhag por rtogs/ de'i tshe chos gsan pa'i zhar la mdo rtsa ba'i rgya cher 'grel gyi dbu nas nyin re bzhin shog bu mda' tshad bcu bdun re tsam ma chag par thugs la bzung / de skabs tshogs su yum gyi mdo 'don pa'i tshe chos thams cad snang la ngos bzung med par rnam rtog gi rgyu ba rags pa thams cad log nas gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la thugs rtse gcig tu gnas pa mang ja'i 'go mjug 'khyongs pa 'bad rtsol med par gnas pa byung /bod kyi grub thob tu byed pa'i rtogs pa bzang shos mthar thug pa de de dus thugs la 'khrungs 'dug na'ang bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni de 'dra ba la sems gnas kyi nyams bzang po tsam las yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyogs na'ang med par bzhed pa 'di la legs par dpyod shes na gdams ngag gi gnad khyad par can snang ngo / /de'i tshe rgya cher 'grel gyi bam po bzhi bcu lhag tsam thugs la chud par mdzad/ skabs der sku stod la bsnyun gzhi drag po zhig rgyun ring tsam byung yang rgyal sras rtag tu ngu sher phyin 'tshol ba'i tshe lus dang srog la'ang mi lta bar sher phyin btsal ba ji lta ba bzhin du bsnyun gzhi de la ji mi snyam par slob ma 'ga' zhig dang bcas gtsang phyogs la byon/ sa skyar byon bzhed pa la lam du ha cang grang ba'i reg pas 'o brgyal bar 'dug pa dang bshul thag ring bas ngur smrig gi phu la lam mdzad de gnas rnying du byon/ de'i dgun gnas rnying du bzhugs / de nas sa skyar byon/ de'i tshe sa skya na bla ma rje btsun red mda' ba chen po lam 'bras gsan kyin 'dug pa dang mjal/ de nas bzung ste zla ba 107—527

bcu gcig tsam gyi ring la sa skyar rje red mda' ba'i spyan sngar bzhugs/ rje btsun pa kho rang lam 'bras sogs gsan pa'i ngang nas rje 'di la mngon pa kun las btus gzab bshad tshar gcig mdzad/ gzhan yang tshad ma rnam 'grel la gtso bor sbyangs shing gsan pa dang / dbu ma 'jug pa sogs kyi bshad pa dang /'dul ba lung la sogs pa bka' bstan bcos mang po'i lung yang gsan/ bla ma rdo rje rin chen pa'i drung du brtag gnyis sa lugs kyi bshad pa tshar gcig kyang gsan cing / sa skyar bla ma rje btsun pas mtshams sbyor mdzad nas bla brang shar pa tshang gi sngags kyi dge bshes bgres po man ngag la mkhas par byed pa zhig 'dug pa las man ngag blangs te bla brang rin chen sgang gi rgyab phyogs de la byon gyin ma ning gi ha 'don pa la sogs pa mdzad pas sngar gyi sku stod kyi bsnyun gzhi de lhag ma med par thon/ de'i ston 'khrungs yul nas rkyen du bab pa'i tshogs bcas ci rigs pa 'phrin las pa'i nang du 'bul ba bskur yod pa 'dra zer nas de bzhes pa la sogs pa'i slad du ngam ring nas sa skya la lam mdzad de dbus su byon / dbus su phebs nas grogs dang slob 'brel mang pos bskul zhing mdo smad nas yum gyis kyang zhu ba nan cher byung ba'i rkyen byas nas/ lan gcig mdo smad la 'byon par bzhed pa 'khrungs te/ mal gro lha lung du byon/ lag len 'ga' zhig la thugs sbyong yang mdzad par brtsams pa la mtshams shig nas/ci byed de 'dra la dgos pa mi 'dug /da ni mdo khams rang yul gyi phyogs la gtan nas mi 'gro ba'i yid dam bca' bar bya'o snyam du dgongs pa shugs drag po skyo shas dang bcas pa zhig 'khrungs nas de 'phral du mdo smad la mi 'byon pa'i thugs thag bcad do/ /de nas ston de la mal gro lha lung pa'i bla ma bsod nams 187—528

grags pa la chos lung yang mang rab gsan zhing / bar zhig tu sku mtshams bcad nas thugs dam mdzad/ rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad rigs mdzod la gzigs rtog mdzad cing / le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi lam gyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i skabs la legs par gzigs pa'i rkyen byas nas/ chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs dang rigs pa'i srol la ldog tu med pa'i dad pa shugs drag po mnan pas mi non pa 'khrungs shing / ston der bzhugs kyi ring la rnam 'grel gyi gzhung la gzigs tsam nas dad pa'i spu long g.yos te spyan chab kyi rgyun bcad par mi nus pa rtag tu 'ong ba zhig byung gsungs so/ /de'i dgun chos bde ba can du bzhugs/ dpyid chos sngon ma la grwa skor mdzad bzhed pa'i po ti 'ga' yar gyi gzigs rtog mdzad nas gtsang la byon/ snar thang du phebs/ bla ma lo tsā ba don bzang pas tshad ma'i ṭīk+ka zhig mdzad 'dug pa de tshar gcig kyang nyon/ces bka' gnang nas gsan/ dbyar chos de snar thang du rnam 'grel/ mngon pa gong 'og /mdo rtsa dang bcas pa'i grwa skor mdzad/ snar thang du gzhung bsgyur btsugs pa'i thog ma de yin par 'dug /de nas ston chos la bla ma rje btsun red mda' ba chen po bo dong du chos bar la byon pa gsan nas er byon/bla ma lo tsā ba nam mkha' dpal bzang po la snyan ngag me long gi bshad pa la sogs pa gsan/ gtso bor rje btsun red mda' ba la dbu tshad mngon pa sogs gsan zhing phar phyin dang 'dul ba yang rje btsun nyid kyi drung du tshar re nyan na rten 'brel gyi khyad par zhig 'ong du re bas gsung 'tshal zhus nas tshar re gsan/dbu ma 'jug pa'i bshad pa zhib tu gsan/ de nas dpon slob gnyis ka thabs cig tu sa skyar byon/ rje rin po che 'dis de'i tshe sa skyar gong du smos pa'i dka' 107—529

chen rnams kyi grwa skor mdzad/ de dus po ti gzhan bcu lhag tsam gyi grwa skor yang mdzad pas chog pa yod kyang / de dus kyi grwa sa rnams na po ti gzhan rnams kyi grwa skor byed pa'i lugs ma dar 'dug pas ma byas gsungs so/ /de nas de 'phral dbus la byon nas sos tshal gung thang nas brtsams te rim pa bzhin du gsang phu dang rtsed thang la sogs pa'i grwa sa chen po rnams su phar phyin sngar nas mdzad tshar bas de ma gtogs pa dka' chen lhag ma bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad cing /de'i tshe dbus gtsang gi grwa sa chen po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa rgya mtsho lta bu mtha' dag kyang rje bla ma 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la snying nas dad pa thob cing bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sngon yun ring po nas lam la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa zhig zhing 'dir gdul bya'i don du bsam bzhin du byon pa zhig yin pa ni gor ma chag go/ /zhes mthun par brjod cing dam pa'i mgon 'di lta bu la brten pa las lhag pa gang na'ang med do zhes rje 'di'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te bka' bzhin du sgrub pa la 'bad par gyur to//de nas rtsed thang gi grwa skor tshar nas yar klungs rnam rgyal du ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i mkhan brgyud tshogs chen po'i mkhan po dka' bzhi pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis mkhan po mdzad / tshogs pa byi rdzong pa'i mkhan po gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa shes rab mgon pos las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ byi rdzing pa'i dbu mdzad sdom brtson bsod nams rdo rjes gsang ste ston pa mdzad cing / tshogs pa gnyis kyi dge slong kha skong du 'os pa grangs tshang bas dad pa'i dge 'dun mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa yang dag par bzhes te gnas brtan 'od srung chen po 107—530

gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir slar yang byon pa ji lta ba bzhin du lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing gcig pur gyur to/ /de nas gdan sa mthil du byon/ spyan snga rin po che grags pa byang chub pa'i drung du mjal/legs bshad kyi skyes phul zhing dam pa'i chos kyi bka' mchid mdzad pas chos rje spyan snga ba dad pa'i shugs kyis spyan chab phyung / phyis kyang drung na 'khod pa dag dang 'bel ba'i bka' mching gleng ba na sku na gzhon nu 'di 'dra ba la'ang yon tan gyi gter chen po 'di lta bu 'dug na kho bo'i skye ba 'di 'dra ba zhes thugs phyung ba'i gsung yang yang 'byon par mdzad/ de'i tshe spyan snga rin po che de nyid la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang / nā ro chos drug dang / rje phag mo gru pa dang chos rje 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' 'bum la sogs pa/ lho brag mar pa nas rje btsun mi la la brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gang yod dang / lho brag mar pa nas rngog chos sku rdo rje la brgyud pa'i man ngag gang yod dang / 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i gsung dang man ngag gang yod gsan te man ngag de dang de dag gi nus pa thon par mdzad do/ /de nas 'on gyi lha khang ke rur chos bar la byon/ tsha kho dbon po sogs sde snod 'dzin pa mang po zhig la phar tshad dbu ma sogs kyi chos mang du gsungs/ de nas skyid shod du phebs te tshal du bzhugs nas bka' dang bstan bcos bod yul du 'gyur ro 'tshal la gzigs rtog zhib par mdzad/ gsung rab mtha' dag gi don la rnam par dpyod pa'i sgo du ma zhig thugs la 'khrungs/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad chen mo'i rtsom pa'ang mdzad/ tshal nas dgun chos la bde ba can du byon/ sde snod mang du gsungs/ dpyid dbus stod bya 107—531

yul du phebs/ bshes gnyen bdun cu tsam la phar tshad/ 'jug pa/ kun btus rnams gsungs/ slar yang tshal du byon nas phar phyin rnam bshad kyi 'phro mdzad cing mjug bde ba can du rdzogs par mdzad/ skyor mo lung du tshal pa bla ma rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan pa las dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi zhib bshad gsan/ rtsis dang lag len mkhas par sbyangs/ der sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la gzhung che chung mang po'i bshad pa gsungs/ de'i phyi lo dbyar chos bde ba can du bzhugs/ sde snod kyi bshad pa mang du gsungs/ dgun stod lung mtsho smad du dus 'khor la thugs sbyongs mdzad/ de nas srin po ri/ gong dkaral/ yar klungs rnams su byon/ sde snod mang du gsungs/ thams cad kyis gus pas mchod/ de ltar snga phyir sde snod dpag tu med pa nar mar gsung ba de dag gi skabs rnams su'ang / rgyud sde gong 'og gi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams su skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya dbang gis smin par mdzad pa dang /gzhan yang lha so so'i rjes gnang dang / lung dang man ngag la sogs pa gang 'tsham chos kyis gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad do/ /lhag par yang de'i tshe rje 'di nyid ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung bar grags shing / de'i rjes gnang zhu ba gar byon du mang ba zhig 'ong zhes grags so//de nas dgun mon mkhar bkra shis gdong du bzhugs/ de dus nub gcig zhugs mer bzhugs nas bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ci rigs pa gsung ba'i skabs su/ dka' bzhi pa sher seng gis chos thog gcig la po ti bcu gcig gsung 'dug /dus phyis bod du po ti dus gcig la gsungs pa de mang shos su 'ong ba 'dra gsungs/ de nas dge bshes sha ston la sogs pas rje 107—532

nyid nas kyang de tsam zhig dus gcig tu gsung 'tshal zhus pas/ rtsol ba byas na de tsam zhig 'chad thub pa 'dra gsung / 'o na cis kyang gsung 'tshal zhes nan gyis gsol ba btab pa zhal gyis bzhes te zla ba de'i tshes bcu nas gnam gang gi bar sku mtshams bcad nas gzigs rtog mdzad/ gnam gang gi nyin phyag dpe thams cad kyi sku rags bcings tshes gcig nas chos 'dzugs par bzhed pa la gsang phu sogs nas 'byon pa'i don gnyer ba sde snod 'dzin pa mang po zhig sgug dgos pa byung bas nyin gsum tsam gyi bar du mi la dang mar pa sogs kyi gsung rgyun thor bu 'ga' gsungs/ tshes lnga nas nyi ma gcig la rgya gar skad bco lnga'i dbu dus gcig la btsugs nas nyin re bzhin tho rangs nas srod kyi bar la chos thun bco lnga re ma chag par thugs bshad mdzad/ de'i nang nas po ti chung ba gnyis rdzogs par gsungs tshar ba na de'i dod du slar yang chung ba gnyis btsugs nas tshad ma rnam 'grel/ phar phyin/ mngon pa gong 'og gnyis / 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs lnga/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ spyod 'jug ste bstan bcos bcu bdun gyi bshad pa dka' chen 'ga' zhig bod kyi ṭīk+ka chen mo re gzhir bzhag pa'i 'og tu 'grel pa'i 'chad tshul du ma dgag sgrub dang bcas pas gtan la phab cing /gzhung phal che ba rang rang gi 'grel pa'i steng nas gzhung phra rags ma lus pa la bshad pa zhib par mdzad de zla ba gsum la rdzogs par mdzad cing / de'i skabs su'ang srod chos grol nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug la sogs pa thugs dam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor rnams ma chag par mdzad de/ skye bo kun gyis 'di ni lhag pa'i lhas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ gzungs thob 187—533

pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig yin par nges kyi/ gzhan la 'di lta bu 'byung ba mi srid do zhes mthun par gleng ngo / /de'i dbyar yar lung a ka brag tu dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang bdag 'jug mang du mdzad/ ni gu chos drug rnams nyams su bstar/ zhag re la gtum mo'i rlung sbyor brgyad brgya tsam re mdzad pas nyams bzang po 'khrungs/ ston skyid shod du red mda' ba dang dpon slob gnyis po tā lar bzhugs/ gdul bya rnams la legs par bshad pa'i skyes stsal/ dgun skyor mo lung du sde snod 'dzin pa du ma la dus 'khor/ phar tshad/ mngon pa sogs gsung / de'i dpyid rta lor gtsang du byon/ bsgrubs chos lung du mkhan po rin chen grags pa las bka' lung ci rigs pa gsan/ de nas bla ma dbu ma pa dang zhal 'dzom mdzad de/dbu ma pas rje'i mdun nas dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang gsan/ dbu ma pa kho rang la mdo khams nas phyugs skyong ba'i dus nyid nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba nar mar 'ongs tshul dang / de la snga phyir brtag pa byed tshul la sogs pa zhib par zhus nas/ da dung 'di la brtag dpyad yang dag cig thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ da lan yang rje btsun gyi sku'i snang ba des gsungs nas rje nyid la dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang zhu bar song gsungs par yong ba yin zhes zhus par/ rje 'di pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba sogs dka' gnad mang po 'dri gtug mdzad pa'i sgo nas legs par brtags pas/brtag thub par 'dug pas thugs yid gnyis za dgos pa mi gda'/ gsol ba drag tu thob mdzod/ ngas kyang 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub skor man ngag zhu dgos na'ang —/ da lan stag tshang du red mda' ba dang mjal 'phrad dgos pas rjes 107—534

su rten 'brel bsgrig 'tshal zhes gsungs nas stag tshang du byon/ red mda' ba'i drung nas gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa tshar gcig gsan nas rong chos lung du byon/ bla ma dbu ma pa dang chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi chos skor yang mang du gsan/ bla ma dbu ma pas kyang rje rin po che nyid la dbu ma 'jug pa'i rang 'grel sogs chos bka' ci rigs gsan par mdzad do/ /de nas ston mjug gong gsum bde chen du phebs nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bu chen rnams kyi nang nas dus 'khor la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa chos kyi dpal ba'i drung du mjal/ 'grel chen cha lag dang bcas pa gsung bar zhus/ de dus khong rgyud 'grel gsung pa'i le'u dang po'i rdzogs mtshams la 'dug pa'i khong gi zhal nas/ phyag rten mdang gi dar ser po de sa khams sdud rim dang mthun pas rdzogs rim yongs rdzogs yong bar 'dug /da nang gi gos yug ljang gu nam mkha'i khams yin pas bskyed rim dang mthun pas bskyed rim yongs rdzogs yong bar 'dug /chos mtshams gang zhig chen po'i mi rnams smin par bya ba'i don du zhes pa'i skabs la slebs pas rten 'brel shin tu legs/ chos thams cad rdzogs par byed do zhes le'u de nas gsungs shing / slar le'u dang po'i dbu nas skyar du gsung / phyag len mdzub khrid/ sbyor drug gi nyams khrid la sogs rdzogs par gsan no/ /de nas yo ga'i bka' lung bshad pa mtha' dag gsan par bzhed pa la/ sngon du phyag len zhig sbyang bar bzhed nas/ zhwa lu na de dus bu ston rin po che'i mchod g.yog pa gtso bo zhig yin pa yo ga'i phyag len shin tu mkhas par grags pa'i yo ga pa tshe dbang zhes pa'i slob ma bran pa yo ga pa mgon bzang zhes bya ba gdan 107—535

drangs nas/ khong dang rje rin po che gnyis kyis myang stod smad kyi mtshams 'khris rtsa khang zhes par bzhugs nas rdo rje dbyings dang / dpal rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa yo ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' dag gi bris thig gar dbyangs/ dkyil chog gi khrid/ phyag rgya 'ching ba sogs la shin tu byang bar sbyangs/ de'i tshe nub gcig mnal lam du khri chen po zhig gi steng na bla ma khyung po lhas pa yin zer ba'i bla ma bgres po dbu rgyan gsol ba/ rdo rje dril bu phyag na bzung ba zhig bzhugasal/ de'i sku mdun na rje rin po che nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bla ma de bzhengs nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dril stabs dang bcas rje 'di nyid la g.yas skor lan gsum mdzad cing / phreng ba nas byung ba'i e kā pa tsi kā pa zhes sogs kyi sgra bsgrags nas rje'i dbu'i steng du rdo rje dril bu bzung ste kurma badz+ra zhes bya ba'o/ /zhes gsungs nas khri la bzhugs song ba zhig byung / mnal sad nas brtag pa na sngar gyi gsang mtshan don yod rdo rje yin pa dang / kurma badz+ra yang don grub kyi rigs kyi ming du 'dug pas 'dra ba 'dug dgongs pa zhig byung gsungs / slar yang dpyid smad de nas dbyar dang ston 'go ma'i ring la gong gsum bde chen du byon nas rin chen chos kyi dpal ba la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang lung mdzub khrid bshad pa gar thig dbyangs gsum gyi phyag len khrid dang bcas pa'i sgo nas phreng ba skor gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ gzhan yang phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po la sogs pa'i dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa zab cing rgya che ba'i chos mang du gsan/ sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rin po che khyung po lhas pa'i drung du yo ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyis thog drangs rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyi bka' da lta bod na rnam par dag pa'i dbang gi chu bo rgyun ma chad 107—536

par yod pa phal che ba yongs su rdzogs pa gsan cing / bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lū i pa dang nag po pa'i lugs la sogs pas thog drangs pa'i bla med kyi bka' lung yang dpag tu med pa gsan/ khong la mnga' ba'i bka' lung phal cher bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs rgyud la gtams par mdzad/de'i tshe 'bul ba tshogs 'khor zhabs tog nar ma sogs kyis mnyes par mdzad do / /de dus rje btsun khyung lhas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis dbang re re gnang tshar ba'i mjug tu 'di nga la yang bla ma 'di zhes bya bas dgyes bzhin du gnang ba yin bya ba re cis kyang gsungs shing / bka' lung rnams rdzogs pa na/ da ni chos bdag po la 'phrod pas 'gyod pa med do zhes gsungs shing / dang po bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / bla ma khyung lhas pa gnyis gas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od pa'i drung du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / yo ga la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi dbang gsan dus tshogs 'khor zhig gi gral du/kun mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ rje mar pas/ nyi ma shar du ka chen btsugs pa de/ /zhes sogs kyi mgur ma de 'don pa spos nas/ nyi ma shar du ka chen btsugs pa de / /khyung po ston sgom khyod la mi zer ram/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lo rgyus kyang gsungs / de ni rje btsun khyung lhas pas kun mkhyen 'phags pa dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis las sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu bzhes pa'i byin rlabs kyi bcud ma nyams par rje rin po che 'di pa'i phyag tu rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs par 'phrod nas phyogs 'dir skye rgu thams cad kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa 'di'i don la dgongs par gsal lo/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa'i lta ba dang / gsang 107—537

ba 'dus pa'i lam rim pa lnga/ de'i nang nas kyang sgyu lus 'di shin tu rtogs dka' ba/ rtogs na don che zhing ma rtogs na ni log par ltung ba'i g.yang sa'ang shin tu che la/ de kho na nyid sgom pa dang / sngags bla med kyi lam la brten nas sangs rgyas 'tshol ba sogs tshig tsam du 'gyur bar dgongs te/'di dag mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa bzhin 'khrul med du ston pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa rgya bod bal gsum/ dbus gtsang khams gsum sogs gang na yod kyang de'i khungs shig rnyed na ni de tshol ba'i phyir du lus srog thed la bor nas dka' ba ci byung yang dang du blangs te da lta nyid du'ang 'gro dgos dgongs pa snying nas shugs drag po de'i tshe yod do zhes rje nyid kyis gsungs so/ /de'i dus su'ang bla ma dbu ma pas lo tsā byas nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la dbu ma'i lta ba dang / sngags bla med kyi lam gyi gnad che shos rnams la dri ba dang ske/ dog pa chod pa'i phyir du brgal zhing brtag pa'i sgo nas kyang dri ba mdzad pasate/ thal rang gi khyad par/ rtags kyi dgag bya'i tshad phra rags/ lhan skyes dang / kun btags kyis ji ltar bzung ba ltar gyi bdag ngos 'dzin tshul/lta ba rtogs pa'i tshad/ kun rdzob 'jog tshul/ sngags kyi zab gnad rnams kyi don shin tu 'dril ba re gsungs/ mi go bar 'dug lags zhus pas/ 'di rnams ma brjed par gyis la zin bris su gyis/ bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad du byas pa la gsol ba 'debs shing bsnyen sgrub byed pa dang / bsags sbyang gnyis la legs par 'bad pa dang / gzhung lugs kyi don la rigs pas rnam par dpyod cing zhib tu sems pa rnams sum sgril du nyams su longs la tshim ma sla bar rgyun bsrings la legs par dpyod cig dang / skabs su bab pa na ngas sa bon 107—538

btab pa 'di rnams kyis kyang rkyen byas nas legs par go ba zhig myur du 'ong ba 'dug ces gsungs so/ /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras lugs kyi dbu ma dang /gsang ba 'dus pa la shes 'dod che ba yod pas rtsad gcod pa'i bla ma bod na su drag zhus pas/ red mda' ba las drag pa med/ 'on kyang khyod la mtha' ma lus par chod pa'i go ba rdzogs par bskyed mi thub/ dbu ma pas lo tsā byas nas ngas khyod la bshad na de ga drag par 'ong na'ang kho yang myur du mdo khams la 'gro dgos par snang / des na da lta nas bshad pa ma byed par bya bral gyis la dben pa bsten zhes gdams/ de nas skyid shod dga' ba gdong du bla ma dbu ma pa dang / rje rin po che rnam pa gnyis sku mtshams dam por mdzad de gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i zhal gzigs/ gsung gi snang ba byung / bla ma dbu ma pa mdo khams su byon pa'i skyel mar lha sar byon par mdzad do/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon par bsngags na/ mkha' dbyings 'od stong lang tshos bcings pa na/ /zla skar tshom bu mtha' dag mal du yib/ /de bzhin blo bzang 'od stong 'char ba na/ /mkhas grub skar tshogs 'od gsal mal du mnal/ /mkhyen pa'i zer rnon cha shas gcig gis kyang / /gzhung lugs 'bum phrag pad tshal cig car du/ /'byed la 'phags yul rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi/ /mkhyen rab mtha' dag gong bur byas sam ci/ /mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas lam gsum 'gro/ /rnam dpyod hub kyis drangs nas slar yang ni/ /'gro ba'i gdung sel dpyid du sbyin mkhas pa/ /khyod ni sngon med drang srong dza hu nu/ /mkhas grub nyi zla'i zer rnon stong gis kyang / /'byed min dka' gnad ba ku la yi 'dzum/ /khyod kyi mkhyen 107—539

rab 'gram chang gis phye tshe/ /mkhas grub bung ba'i khyu tshogs dar dir brel/ /spong bdun nor bu'i rdul dmar spungs pa yi/ /ba gam gang ba rdzogs pa'i 'od snang gis/ /tshangs spyod yid dga' dmar po'i tshom bu yis/ /sa chen da dung li khri'i bla gos 'dzin/ /gsang chen rgyud don man ngag chu klung 'bum/ /khyod thugs rin chen 'byung gnas la bskyil nas/ /'jam dbyangs zhal lung srub shing gis blangs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin mkhas khyod las su/ /dmar ser 'od kyi phung po 'bar ba'i skus/ /legs bshad 'od stong nyin bzhin mngon sum du/ /sbyin pas mkhyen rab 'dab stong yangs pa'i tshal/ /zab don sbrang rtsi'i dogs pas 'gyur bar gyur/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rje btsun tsong kha pa//gang gi mkhyen rab rab 'byams chos kun mdzod/ /zabo rmi'i gnad kun kun byang 'jug ldog starnamatho/ /gzigs nas 'gro la la 'ur ston 'di bsngag / sdi /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o༅// d+nghade nas rim gyis rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad dang bcas bya bral la byon te 'ol khar phebs/ de'i dgun dpyid rnams 'ol kha chos lung du bzhugs shing / de nas bzung ste 'ol kha pa yab sras rnams kyis dad pa chen pos sbyin bdag mdzad de zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/ 'ol kha chos lung du bzhugs ring la yang thog mar bsags sbyang gnad che bar dgongs te dpon slob thams cad kyis stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bsags sbyang la shin tu 'grus par mdzad/ rje rin po che nyid kyis kyang ltung bshags dang brgya phyag sbrags nas mdzad pa dang / phyag sor gyi rtse mo rnams ser khar song gi bar du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs la dpag par dka' ba'i brtson pa drag po mdzad/ mdo 107—540

sde phal po che'i steng nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rnams la thugs sbyong mdzad pas snying stobs dang spyod pa rmad du byung ba ci 'dra la'ang zhum pa med pa'i gdengs thob/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sku'i snang ba dngos su gzigs pa nar mar byung / rje btsun byams pa mgon po gser btso ma'i kha dog lta bu la rin po che'i rgyan dang chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas me tog gi sdong bu bsnams pa/rin po che'i khri la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa de 'dra ba'i sku shin tu che ba dang /rgyal ba sman gyi bla bla gos ser po mnabs pa/ rje btsun byams mgon bzang po'i 'dug stangs mdzad pa rab byung gi cha byad can snam sbyar gsol ba phyag gis klu shing gi sdong bu ril bas mtshan pa 'dzin pa de 'dra ba dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa sogs sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i sku'i snang ba gzigs pa mang du byung / 'di rnams nyams snang yin pa'i nges pa cher med dgongs nas thugs gtad ma mdzad kyang / bla ma rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ba la rje btsun gyi sku dang / gsung gi snang ba dngos su 'byung ba 'khrul med cig yod pas/ des rtogs ldan pa la rje'i zhal snga nas kyi gzigs snang byung ba de rnams nyams snang rang ga ba min pa'i gsol ba drag tu thob/ phyis rten 'brel khyad par can yong ba yin zhes gsung ba byung / rtogs ldan pa'i snang ba de la'ang rje'i drung nas brtag dpyad mang du byas pas zab mo'i gnad la lan thogs med du byung bas thugs legs par ches so/ /de nas rje rin po che 'khor bcas kyis rdzing phyi'i jo bo byams pa mjal/ mchod pa dang smon lam rlabs po che mang du mdzad/ /de nas dwags po sman lung gi rgya sog phur byon/ dgun gyi ring der bzhugs thugs dam shin tu 'phel zhing yon tan gyi khyad par bsam 107—541

gyis mi khyab pa mang du brnyes te/ de dus rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku shin tu che ba gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa zhig la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas 'khor gyis bskor ba dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ār+ya de wa/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ klu byang/ zla ba grags pa/ thogs med sku mchedam/ phyogs glang / chos grags/ yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od/ lha dbang blo / rgyan mkhan po/ ka ma la shī la/ a bh+ya ya la sogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta du ma dang / rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ lū i pa/ dril bu pa/nag po spyod pa la sogs pa'i grub chen du ma'i sku'i snang ba dngos su gzigs/nyams snang la gtad pa med las che dgongs pas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis sngar bzhin nyams snang rang ga ba min pas gsol ba drag tu thob/ 'di rnams kyi gzhung la brten nas rang gzhan la phan thogs rgya chen po 'ong ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa shin tu che ba gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba zhig zhal gzigs/ de dus nas 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug nyin re bzhin mdzad pa nam yang chag med du mdzad/ yang rje btsun gyi thugs ka dang rje'i thugs ka phan tshun ral gris sbrel ba las bdud rtsi dkar ser babs pa thugs kur zhugs pas bde ba chen po 'khrungs pa'i snang ba dngos su byung / de nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang la zhig gso mdzad na bstan par phan che zhes bskul ba la brten nas rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang la zhig gso mdzad par brtsams so/ /de yang rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang de sngon gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis bzhengs pa jo bo byams pa'i sku li ma shin tu byin rlabs che zhing 107—542

ngo mtshar ba phul du byung ba zhig bzhugs na'ang / phyis ldebs ris thams cad nyams shing gogs/ jo bo'i sku de yang rdul khrod na 'o brgyal zhing / sku la bya thal sogs mi gtsang bas gos par gyur pa gzigs pas thugs kyis ma bzod par spyan chab byung zhing / de'i zhig gsos mdzad par dgongs nas 'ol kha stag rtse ba la zhal ta gnang ste/ rtsig pa dang thog dang zhal ba sogs 'chos dgos rnams khong gis legs par bsgrubs shing / de nas ldebs bris par dpon slob rnams rang gis cha rkyen dang zhal ta mdzad nas bsgrub par brtsam pa'i tshe/dpon slob bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyag rdzas gtor cha sogs gang yod la rin btab pas zho bcu gnyis las ma byung bas ji ltar mdzad kyi rngo ma thogs pa la/rnam sras kyi 'dzin gtor zhig bcas nas 'phrin las 'chol bar dgongs pa'i tshe mar med pa la btsun pa zhig gis mar grod bu gang phul/ de la mar gyi 'dzin gtor bcas nas 'phrin las bcol bas de'i sang nyin rang la 'brog pa 'gas mar thud mang po bkal byung ste phul/ de nas bzung ste 'bul ba mang po rim pa bzhin byung bas yo byad kyis ma 'thogs/ 'dir ma zad chos ldan gyi dgos pa khyad par can gzigs pa'i skabs gzhan du'ang rnam sras la mar gyi gtor ma dang bcas te 'phrin las bcol bas yo byad dpag tu med pa glo bur du byung ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod/ de nas yar klungs phyogs nas kyang lha bzo ba tshon rtsi khyer nas ri mo'i dad blangs la 'ongs pa mang du byung ngo / /rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhing bkod bzhengs te skya ris btab tshar ba de la rab gnas mdzad pas rje btsun gyi sku dngos su thim par gzigs/ sangs rgyas so lnga bris pa'i tshe sku mdog phyag rgya sogs rim bzhin gzigs pa ltar 'bri bcug par mdzad/107—543
