zhing bkod re bris tshar rim gyi rab gnas mdzad pas lha de dang de dngos su thim par gzigs/ mar me phul bas ma bzung ba gcig kyang ma byung / de ltar ri mo rnams legs par grub nas 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te / rje rang nyid kyis rab gnas rgyas par mdzad cing / rab gnas dngos gzhi'i nyin nyi ma'i tshad kyang ches ring du gyur pa zhig kun gyi mthun snang du byung ngo / /de'i tshe lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i gzigs snang la/ sangs rgyas rab bdun nam mkha' nas byang phyogs su 'byon pa gzigs/ gang du bzhud ces gsol bas rdzing phyi'i rab gnas la spyan 'dren gyin 'dug ces gsung ba'i tshes grangs de dang rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshes grangs gnyis phyis brtsis pas mthun par byung ngo / /de nas lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas 'dir cig ci nas phyag phebs par zhu/ bka' 'dri zhu ba'i 'dod pa'ang yod/sku tshe bsring ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa sogs kyi bsnyen bkur 'dra yang 'bul ba lags / zhes gsung yig nan cher byung zhing rje rang nyid kyang lho brag mkhan chen gyi drung nas bka' gdams gdams ngag pa nas brgyud pa'i lam rim gyi khrid sogs chos bka' ci rigs gsan par bzhed nas lho brag bgro ba dgon du byon/de'i tshe lho brag mkhan chen gyis rje nyid rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'od kyi dra bas mdzes pa zhig phebs byung ba gzigs/ rje nyid kyis kyang lho brag mkhan chen pa phyag na rdo rje dngos su gzigs pa sogs gnyis ka la dag pa'i gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba mang du byung zhing / chos bka' mtha' yas pa phan tshun gsan res mdzad / rje bla ma rgya gar rdo rje gdan du phebs bzhed yod pa lho brag mkhan chen nas bshol ma gnang ste bod rang du bzhugs rgyu'i gsol 'debs mdzad pas 187—544

bka' drin che/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis don gyi ngo bo dang / go rim sogs gsungs nas bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin byams mgon gyi bstod pa dang ske/ bde ba can gyi smon lam/ rang nyid ma 'ongs pa na 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing yongs su bzung ba'i smon lam rnams mdzad/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par dgongs te phyag len nyams pa med par thub pa'i dgongs pa bzhin bcas mtshams phra rags thams cad gsar du btsugs te dag ther rmad du byung ba mdzad de 'dul ba'i bstan pa rmangs nas gso bar mdzad/ gro lung pa'i bstan rim chen mo gzigs nas dpal a ti sha'i gdams ngag byang chub lam gyi rim par thugs nges 'khrungs/ gnyal gyi mo la'i la rtsar byams mgon gyi sku shin tu che ba nyi ma ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba zhig gis rigs kyi bu khyod sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong zhes seng ge'i sgras dbugs dbyung / gnyal smad seng ge rdzong la bzhugs dus dpal dus kyi 'khor los/ khyod dus kyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal po zla ba bzang po byon pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong zhes gsungs/ de ltar loral/ e/ 'ol kha sogs su bya bral la theg /de skabs rgyal tshab chos rje sogs bu slob tshad med pa 'dus te mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mtha' yas pa stsal/'ol kha lha sding du lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa'i tshul gnang / thub pa'i dbang po la zab mo rten 'byung las brtsam pa'i bstod pa legs bshad snying po mdzad/ de nas dpal ldan a ti shas lung bstan pa'i gnas rwa sgreng du byon/ mdo sde rgyan dang ske/ dbus mtha'/ kun btus/ nyan sa sogs sbyar te zhi gnas kyi bshad pa zhib par gsungs pa ltar bsgom pas 'ga' zhig la gzhung chen po dang mthun pa'i zhi gnas kyi myong ba skyes/ de'i dbyar rje red mda' ba dang / lo 187—545

chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang bcas gnam rtse ldeng du gshegs te bstan pa'i dag ther rmad du byung ba mdzad/ der dge 'dun brgya phrag mang por mdo sngags kyi chos mang du stsal/ slar yang rwa sgreng du byon/ brag seng ge'i zhol du bzhugs gnas skabs jo bo rje'i sku dbu yon ma gdan drangs te sku mtshams mdzad / mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas gsol 'debs lam mchog sgo 'byed mdzad pas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po nas bzung lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma zhal gzigs / mthar jo bo la thim/ jo bo rjes phyag dbu thog tu bzhag nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po gyis/ byang chub sgrub pa dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs bdag gis bya'o zhes gsung gi dbugs dbyung stsal/ de nas jo bo'i byang chub lam sgron bshad bya rtsa ba'i gzhung du byas/ rje btsun gyi gsung lam gtso gsum srog tu byas nas gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i nyams len gyi rim par bsdus pa byang chub lam rim chen mo ljags rtsom mdzad/ gnyan chen thang lha dang / rma chen spom ra sogs gzhi bdag chen po rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar zhing smon tshig zhus pa/ lam bzang bsgrigs pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub byed cing / /zhes sogs gsungs/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis kyang bskul ma mdzad par/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i rmad byung 'phrin las las/ /zhes sogs sbas te gsungs/ lhag mthong chen po ni mdzad kyang 'gro don mi 'byung snyam du thugs las chung ngur bzhugs pa na/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rtsom par bskul ba ltar slar mdzad/ de nas lhas phu dgon du byon/ sde snod 'dzin pa du mar tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi ljags bshad gnang / bod 'dir tshad ma'i gzhung lugs la phyi'i go rgya gcod pa'i yan 107—546

lag tsam las nyams len gyi gnad med par 'dzin par rje 'di'i tshad ma kun las btus kyi mchod brjod lugs 'byung dang / lugs ldog gis thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la rigs tshul bla na med pa'i nges pa ster ba'i gzab bshad mdzad pa nas bzung nyams len du 'khyer shes pa byung / de nas 'ol dga'/skyid shod phyogs su rim gyis byon te mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mang du stsal/khyad par rje btsun gyis rnam bzhag rim pa'i ṭik+ka mdzad na bstan par phan che bar bskul ma mdzad par ljags rtsom mdzad/ ser chos sding du sku mtshams gnang —/ de bzhin du lo chen skyabs mchog pa dang / spyan snga bsod nams bzang po sogs dam pa mang pos gsol ba btab par brten gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i lam rim sngon med pa'i shing rta'i srol phye bar mdzad do/ /de skabs nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa sogs paṇa grub du ma rjes su bzung / der rtsa she'i rgya cher 'grel mdzad par bzhed nas dka' gnad phra mo rnams la dpyad pa mdzad pa'i skabs sher phyin gyi mdo'i 'gres rkang rnams gser sbyangs btso ma'i yi ge'i rnam pa bar snang la gzigs/ ra kha brag tu phebs nas drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po zhes pa gangs can gyi mkhas pa dang grub pa sus kyang rnam dpyod kyi rwa ba las 'gongs pa ljags rtsom dang / chos sding du rtsa she'i rnam bshad chen mo'ang mdzad/ de skabs rgya nag nas gdan zhus gser yig pa 'byor kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes par phyir slog par mdzad do/ /de dag la ni 'di skad ces bya ste/nang du yang dag 'jog la chags pa'i thugs/ /gzhan gyis bskul ba'i rkyen la ga la ltos/ /'on tang mkhyen pa'i gter des bskul ba'i tshul/ /zas gtsang 107—547

sras por gnas gtsang lha yis bzhin/ /spangs dang rtogs pa bde gshegs gsum ldan gyi/ /sa la bzhugs pas sgrub la ga la ltos/ /'on tang thos bsam sgom gsum bstan pa spyi'i/ /'jug pa'i bzhed srol thabs kyis 'doms par mdzad / /yab gcig dag pa gnyis ldan sku mnga' bas/ /bsags sbyang 'grus la brtson par ga la ltos/ /dang po'i las can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /thabs la mkhas pas bsags sbyang tshul kyang bstan/ /sras bcas rgyal kun 'dzum zhal khyod la ngoms/ /paṇa grub kun kyang zab don khyod la gyer/ /nyams rtogs bdud rtsi'i bcud kun khyod kyis gsol/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor khyod nyid bzhengs/ /'jam dbyangs bka' bzhin rdzing phyir ma pham pa'i / /gzhal med dga' ldan gnyis par bsgrubs pa na/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing nas ye shes sems dpa' rnams/ /lhag gnas me tog 'thor dang lhan cig thim/rje dang las kyi rdo rje mngon sum du/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang gsang bdag skur bzhengs te/ /phan tshun chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa yis/ /sa de 'og min dngos sam 'phyang mo nyug /rtags tsam byung rgyal spyod pa'i 'byung po'i bya/ /tshul khrims snang ba dkar pos mthar bskrad nas/ /rnam dag khrims ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i khyu/ /sa chen dog por bkang ba da dung 'phel/ /gsung rab mtha' dag 'gal med gang zag gcig /sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su khyer ba yi / /gdams zab 'di 'dra blo bzang khyod drin las/ /'phags bod mkhas grub sus kyang ga la rnyed/ /lta ngan mun pa 'thug pos ring zhig bar/ /gangs can mkhas grub dag kyang 'thum pa na/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i yang rtse snang ba'i mchog /sbyin pa blo bzang 'od stong las gzhan su/ /chos phung brgyad khri'i 107—548

'gag mdo lam rim zhes/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las rang gzugs pusta ka /sa gsum mun pa sel ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /dbang gi nor bu gcig pu khyod kyis sbyin//nang du yang dag dag pa'i 'khor lor gzhol/ /phyi ru gzigs snang snang stong rol pas 'byarmos/sgo /lta spyod gtsang mar mar gyur 'gro tshogs 'gode/ sgo /chos kun gdams zab zab dgur bsgril te bostarno/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcade pa'o dbyangs kyis sgeg pa'o//gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad gsar du bzhengs pa lta bu'i nyams gso legs par mdzad de sa glang gi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi mchod pa dngos gzhi mdzad pa la/ jo bo rin po cher dar dpyang dang bcas pa'i dbu rgyan rgyu gser bzang po 'ba' zhig las grub pa/ rin po che nal dang mu tig dang g.yu la sogs pa'i phra bzang po bkod pas mdzes par byas pa dang / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang bcu gcig zhal la dngul bzang po las byas pa'i dbu rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa phul zhing / jo bo rin po che'i drung du dngul gyi lhung bzed che tshad du longs pa de'i kha la 'tshams pa'i dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa dang —/ jo shāka rnam gnyis bcu gcig zhal dang bcas pa la cho 'phrul gyi ring nyin re bzhin zhal gser/ tshes brgyad dang bco lnga la sku yongs rdzogs la gser chab dang bcas pa phul zhing / jo shag rnam gnyis dang thub pa gangs can mtshos gtso mdzad sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi sku 'bur du dod pa rnams la gos dar phun sum tshogs pa las byas pa'i bla gos dang snam sbyar dang / sems dpa' 187—549

sems ma bcu drug la sogs pa dang / khro bo'i rnam par bzhugs pa la sogs pa rnams la ni dar chen dang gan gos la sogs pa'i stod g.yog dang smad g.yog dang ske/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang che chung rnams kyi tog dang bya 'dab la sogs pa'i rtse zur phan tshun du tha gus sbrel ba thams cad la ba dan dang / rnga yab dang / dril bu la sogs pas bar ma chad par mdzes par byas shing /phyi'i skor lam chen mo'i phyi rol nas shing chen po 'phang shin tu mtho ba rnams la gos dar sogs las byas pa'i ba dan chen po 'jigs su rung ba la phyogs skyong de dang de'i skus tog la brgyan cing / de dang de'i sngags ba dan nyid la bris pa bco lnga phyogs skyong ba bco lnga po rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa rang rang gi phyogs su legs par btsugs nas nub re bzhin de dag gi rtsa ba'i gtor stegs khar phyogs gtor gtong ba dang / de dag gi bar bar du gdugs dkar la sogs pa'i rgyal mtshan rang rang gi cho ga bzhin du legs par btsugs shing /ba dan dang rgyal mtshan de dag gi shing rnams tha gus sbrel ba la 'phan dang / rnga yab dang / dril bu la sogs pas bar ma chad par mdzes par byas pa ni 'ja' tshon kun nas bkra bas nam mkha'i lam khyab par byas pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang nyin par yang khyams nang ma yan chad la dkar me brgya phrag bzhi re tsam dang ske/ bar skor la brgya phrag lhag pa dang / jo bo rin po che'i zhal gyi drang thad du kong bu chen po gru bzhi pa phyogs re la 'dom tshad ma gsum gsum yod pa de nyid mar khus legs par bkang ba la 'tshams pa'i sdong bu las 'bar ba'i me lce ni gser gyi mchod sdong gis nam mkha'i lam 'gog par byed pa lta bus thog drang ske/ rdza'i khog ma chen po mar khus bkang ba'i sdong bu mi chen po'i lag pa'i 187—550

sbom tsam la 'phang mda' tshad lhag tsam gyi mar me bar thag 'tsham par bkod pas phyi skor gyi phyi rim 'khor ba dang / gzhan yang ra mo che/ klu sgug /po tā la / gung thang rnams su'ang dkar me du ma dang / mtshan mo ni bar skor gyi rtsig 'gram 'khor ba dang / khyams grwa phyi ma'i ka rtsar ji ltar yod pa bzhin du mar me'i phreng ba bkod pas mig gis blta ba tsam yang bzod par dka' bar byas te/ mtshan mo'i gung la'ang steng du mngon par bltas pa na nam mkha' mar me'i 'od kyis gos dang bcas pa kha dog dmar skya nyid du mthong ba ma gtogs skar ma gcig gi gzugs kyang mthong ba'i yul las 'das par gyur to/ /gzhan yang yon chab brgya phrag brgal ba nyin re bzhin gsar du mngon par bshams pa rnams la kha che gur gum sbangs pa'i khu bas kha legs par bsgyur ba'i gur kum gyi ro ma ni nyin re la'ang bres gzhal dgos pa dang / gzhan yang spos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / spos snod tha dad du mngon par bsregs pa la sogs pa'i dri bzang pos phyi rol gyi khor yug thams cad du'ang nyin mtshan gnyis ka mngon par khyab cing / du ba rnams ni bar snang la sprin gyi sna ring po dag phan tshun mdud pa'i lda ldi bres pa lta bu/ tha na phyi skor gyi skor lam rnams kyang spos kyi chus chag chag btab par byas na gzhan lta ci smos/ zhal zas mda' tshad lhag tsam la mar gyis rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i rgyan yid 'phrog pas kha rgyan pa brgya rtsa brgyad nyin re bzhin gsar pa gsar pa phul zhing ske/ kong bu chen po'i g.yas g.yon du sa stegs la rtsam pa khal bzhi brgya re las byas pa'i lha bshos rgyan bzang po dpag tu med pas spras pa/ 'phyar dar btsugs pa dang bcas pa mngon par bshams pa'i zhal zas rnying pa rnams ni 107—551

bdag gir byed pa med par skye bo phongs pa sprang po'i tshogs la ltos pa med par byin / gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa dang / rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i bkod pa yid 'phrog pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas pas mngon par mchod do/ /rje bla ma nyid kyis sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs nas mdo sde dang rgyud sde nas byung ba'i cho ga rnam par dag pas mngon par mchod cing / bstan pa dang sems can 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed shugs drag pos bstan pa rgyas pa dang sems can la phan bde 'byung ba'i smon lam rnam par dag pa nyin re bzhin mdzad/ snga rol rgya sog phur cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa mdzad pa'i dus dang / skabs 'di rnams su rgyal ba sras bcas rnams rang rang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog can nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par bzhugs pas mchod pa bdag gir mdzad pa sogs kyi gzigs snang mtha' klas/ dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la nyin re bzhin slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs kyi chos thun re gsungs te de'i dus su smon lam la 'dus pa'i skye bo thams cad rang bzhin gyi rgyud 'jam pa dang / dang ba dang / dge ba la spro ba sogs kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pas nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu chos mnyan pa dang / phyag dang / skor ba dang / smon lam 'debs pa dang / gzungs kha 'don du byed pa sogs dge ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar gyur cing / de yang mtshan phyed la bab pa'i dus rang na phyi skor byed pa nyin mo bas cung zad nyung bar mngon pa tsam ma gtogs/ skor ba byed pa bar chad pa ni cung zad kyang ma byung ngo / /de lta bus lha mi bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig smin cing grol bar mdzad de ngan 107—552

song gi rgyun lam ni bcad/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam ni lam po che bzhin du byas te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba rang nyid slar yang byon pa lta bur mdzad do / /de'i tshe rje rin po che la gangs can gyi bstan 'dzin dam pa mang po dang /yon bdag che phra mang pos rgyun du sa gcig tu bzhugs chog pa'i dgon gnas shig btab chog pa dgos zhes yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pa na/ rje rin po ches kyang ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan par dgongs nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ lho brag grub chen la gsang ba'i bdag pos/ dbang bskur ri yi ldeb dag tu/ /btsun mo lding gi ngos phyogs su/ /dge 'dun dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /ri ni gang yin 'jam dbyangs 'chad/ /dbus gtsang mdo khams rgya yul gyi/ /mchod gnas dam pa tshogs gsog rten/ /mnga' ris bod khams kun gyi skyabs/ /phyogs bcur sde dgon rgyas pa 'byung / /zhes lung bstan pa dang sngar gyi mdo dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs kyi lung bstan thog tu bab ste 'brog ri bo cher dgon gnas 'debs par dgongs nas smon lam grol 'phral 'brog ri bo cher zhabs kyis bcags nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs / sras kyi thu bo rnams la 'di ltar gyis kyi bka' lung stsal/ de nas ser chos sding dang 'ol kha sogs su phebs/ mdo sngags kyi zab chos mtha' yas pa stsal/ sras kyi thu bo dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gtso mdzad dge 'dun phal che bas 'brog ri bo cher byon te dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/ phyogs kyi yon bdag dang / nye skor gyi ban skya'i sde thams cad kyis dad blangs tshad med pa dga' spro dang bcas pas bsgrubs pas de kha'i lo la gzim khang gis thog drangs brang khang rdzogs par grub 107—553

pa bdun cu lhag tsam dang / gzhi bting ba brgya phrag brgal ba byung / brang khang so so phal che ba la'ang 'dul ba nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du dang por gzhi brtag pa dang / brtags nas dge 'dun la gsol ba dang / de nas dge 'dun gyis gnang ba sbyin pa dang / lag gi bla bsko ba dang / rdo bteg pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang gcod pa dang / khang pa'i tshad las ma lhag par rtsig pa sogs kyi phyag len dag ther can mdzad pas/ mkhar las kyi phyag len tsam gyis kyang bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad do/ /rje nyid lo de'i dbyar gnas 'ol dga' bsam gling du mdzad de/ rim lnga gsal sgron rtsom pa'i thugs 'dun gtad/ zin bris 'debs pa'i skabs su gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba byung ba brda tshig gis bsnyel tho mdzad pa ltar la/ gnas der mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsungs/ stag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phyag phebs/ lam rim gsang 'dus sgron gsal rim lnga dang bcas pa gsungs shing / mngon pa kun las btus dang / sa sde la sogs pa dang / tshad ma'i dka' gnas kyang mang du gsungs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud lha mo bzhi zhus dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus gnyis kyi rnam bshad rgyas pa'i rtsom pa'ang mdzad/ de'i phyi lo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga rab tu gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa'i gter chen po de nyid dang / rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi khrid yig dang bcas pa'ang mdzad nas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'byor pa dpag tu med pa stsol bar mdzad do/ /de nas mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gsol ba btab nas 'on bkra shis rdo khar spyan drangs/ chos 'khor mang po bskor/107—554

rje'i sku bkra shis rdo kha mar grags pa'i ngo mtshar can rnams kyang de dus byung ba yin / de nas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs nas rim bzhin bskyed rim 'dod 'jo dang / rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi ldan gyi khrid/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ sgron gsal gyi mchan bu/ de'i mtha' dpyod/ bsdus don rnams mdzad nas rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad pa mtha' dag rgyun ma chad par gsungs pas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa nyin byed 'bum phrag gi dpal yon 'dzin par gyur to/ /de nas lug gi lo'i dbyar nas 'go brtsams sngags kyi sgrub mchod khang pa zhig gsar du bsgrub pa'i zhal bkod mdzad de gtsug lag khang khyams gtsang khang dang bcas pa la ka ba bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi sa la/dbus kyi gtsang khang du ston pa'i sku jo bo rin po che'i sku tshad las cung zhig che ba dang ske/ steng gi gtsang khang du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis/dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang blos bslang rnams rgyu rin po che 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs/ de yang gzhal yas khang dang lha gzhan rnams zangs la gser gsol ba/ gtso bo rnams dang / phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang / snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dngul bzang po 'ba' zhig las bzhengs pa'i gtso bo yum dang bcas pa rnams re re la'ang dngul bre chen gnyis lhag re dang / rdor dbyings kyi gtso bo la dngul bre chen gnyis ma 'ongs tsam dang / 'khor gyi lha bcu gnyis rnams re re la'ang dngul bre chen phyed dang gnyis re cung ma longs tsam dang bcas pa dang / de dag la rin po che dang / g.yu rnying bzang po dpag tu med pa'i phra bsam gyis mi khyab pa 187—555

dang / gzhan yang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med/rje btsun byams mgon/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa rnams kyi gser sku mda' tshad re dang / bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dang / gtsug tor gdugs dkar gnyis kyi gser sku khru tshad re dang / gos dar bzang po mtha' yas pa brdungs pa'i dar 'dam 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku la rgyab mtho bcu bdun yod pa rnams bzhengs shing /de dag thams cad kyang lha bzo'i thig dang phyag tshad gzhung dang mthun pa mjal ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren pa mig gi bdud rtsi lta bur byon/ khyad par gzhal yas khang gsum bzhengs pa'i lugs snga ma btang ba'i lugs phud la/ dpa' bo khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la 'ja' tshon ma byon te/ de yang rgyu zangs yin yang lugs kong nas byon ma khad la zangs kyi kha dog yungs 'bru'i rjes tsam yang mi mngon par sku thams cad 'od zer lnga'i gong bur gyur pa mig gis bzod par dka' ba'i 'od kyi phung po chen po zhig byon to/ /de ltar rten de rnams dang gtsug lag khang bcas rags rim zhig lo de ga'i khongs su grub/ nye skor gyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams dang phyugs lhas kyi grong ba skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bsags te rab ston bzang po rmad du byung ba mdzad cing / rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pas rab tu gnas pa phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par mdzad/ sde snod 'dzin pa grangs las brgal bar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad do/ /lhag par 'jug pa'i rnam bshad chen mo dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi ṭik+ka sbas don kun gsal 107—556

mdzad / ri bo dga' ldan nas phyag btegs te lha sar mchod pa dang smon lam rnam par dag pa mdzad nas stod lung gi chab tshan khar byon/ 'on kyang chab tshan gyis ni zhabs la cung zad tsam bdug pa las ma mdzad/ gtso bor stod lung phu mda'iskye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pa dag la chos dang byin rlabs kyi skyes gnang zhing / dad ldan so sos bsnyen bkur ba dang / zang zing gi dngos po phul ba rnams dad pa can de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed phyir bzhes/ zhal mthong zhing gsung thos pa tsam gyis kyang don dang ldan par mdzad/ slar 'bras spungs su byon pa'i tshe 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pas gtsos dge 'dun thams cad kyis mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa thogs shing / gsol ba 'debs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas bsus/ 'do li la gdan drangs pa'i 'do li'i sna la 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga pa kun nas bkra ba thal byung du zug pa dang ske/ 'bras spungs su chos gsungs pa'i tshe chos grwa'i dbus su 'ja' tshon sna lnga pa nam mkha'i dbyings nas ka ba btsug pa ltar ches gsal bar zug pa sogs rje rin po che'i sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa phal cher rdzogs nas zhing khams gzhan du 'byon par bzhed pa na dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa bshams pa dang / lhag par nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'ja' ka ba btsugs pa ltar byung ba ni dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis rje rin po che dga' ldan du byon pa la bsu ba'i bkod pa bshams pa yin par nges pa de lta bu'i ltas mngon sum du bab par gyur la/ gzhan yang 'bras spungs su bzhugs ring la dge ba'i bshes gnyen stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dus shing / sne'u nas zhabs tog dang ci dgos kyi phog bsnyen bkur 'bul nod sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad la/ de'i tshe 187—557

lam rim gyi khrid/ na ro chos drug /dbu ma la 'jug pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa gsungs shing / de yang sngon chad grong pa'i skye bo pho mo du ma la khrid cher mi gnang / khyad par lam rim gyi khrid la'ang tshogs su mi rung ba la sogs pa'i dam bzhag che bar yod pa la/ de dus grong pa'i skye bo ji tsam zhig 'ongs pa dang / dus nam 'ong thams cad la khyad par med pa/ tha na sprang po'i tshogs du ma 'dus pa yan chad thams cad la lam rim dang dbu ma la sogs pa'ang bkag pa med par gnang / 'bras spungs su skabs shig nas gzhan phal mo che la lkog tu gyur pa'i mngon chung bar gyis gsungs nas lha bzo ba la dam bzhag che bar mdzad de bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dngul sku chen po zhig bzhengs pa'i zhal lta mdzad do/ /de dag la dbyangs kyis cung zad bsnyad pa ni/ mnyan yod cho 'phrul sa 'dir 'phos pa bzhin/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung bkye ba na/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs sras bcas chu 'dzin gyi/ /phung por gtibs bzhin mchod tshogs bdag gir mdzad/ /'dus pa'i mtsho chen 'khor lo gsum gyis brel/ /skye bo kun kyang rnam dkar las la brel / /nyin mtshan 'khor mor skal bzang dga' ston dang / /bsod nams phung po 'gran bzhin mkha' la bsnyegs/ /rgyal bas lung gis bsngags pa 'brog ri'i spor/ ye shes rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'phos pa na/ /mthun snang rten dang brten pa bzo bo yi/ /'du byed las kyi 'khor los bsgrubs sam snyam/ /gangs can grub pa'i mtha' yi ba dan kun/ /gtsug tor dge ldan ring lugs yid bzhin nor/ /'dzin pa khyad par du ma'i che ba yi/ /dpal yon gzur gnas blo ldan kun gyis bsngags/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas btab rdo rje'i 187—558

mdud / /mkhyen rab sor mo'i 'phrul gyis cig car dkrol/ /sus kyang dpog min sgyu 'od zung 'jug gi/ /zab gsang gnad kun rjen par gsal bar mdzad / /mkhyen pa'i gter las dngos su blangs pa yi/ /sprul pa'i glegs bam dang bcas snyan brgyud mdzod/ /sras kyi thu bor dngos su gtad pa yi/ /brgyud pa zung 'jug nor bu'i phreng ba bstar/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor spro dang bsdu ba dang / /rgyud kun 'chad la thogs pa med pa 'di/ /byang chub rdo rje nam mkha'i gos sbas phyir/ /thun mtshams bla gos gsar pas klubs min nam/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po mi yi tshul bzung nas/ /nyin mtshan 'bral med bran du khol ba 'di/ /'jam dpal zhi khro nyid las gzhan du na/ /khams gsum zas su za bar byed min nam/ /bde ba chen po'i rol par 'byams klas pa'i/ /gsang gsum khrag 'thung dpa' bor ro gcig pa/ /gnas gsum ḍā kyis rdo rje'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /mchod pa'i zol gyis sgrog pa'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /'phags bod mkhas grub sus kyang rnyed min pa'i/ /tshang la ma nor thub bstan yongs rdzogs lam/ /ji bzhin rnyed nas tshul bzhin 'doms pa yi/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs bdag po khyod min su/ /byang chub rdo rje rje btsun khyod nyid de/ /he ru ka dpal dpal ldan bla ma khyed/ /'jigs rmedzade dngos nyid nyid kyi skur bzhengs te༄/ /reb 'byams rgyal kun kun 'dus khyod kyis skyongasang/ sgo/zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyengs kyis smos pa'o//de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor nas/ sngon chad dus 'khor ma gtogs pa'i rgyud la le mtshams mdzad pa'i lugs med pa la de'i tshe gsang 'dus kyi le'u dgu pa'i/ mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i sras 107—559

su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i mtshams su chos mtshams mdzad nas myur du 'brog ri bo che dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nyid du 'byon par bzhed pa'i zhal ta gnang / de la sbyin bdag dang / chos gsan pa rnams kyis da dung zla ba gcig gam zla phyed tsam du'ang bzhugs nas chos 'phro rdzogs par gsung pa zhig thugs rjes bzung 'tshal/ tha na rgyud kyi 'phro rnams bklag lung mdzad pa tsam zhig kyang gnang 'tshal zhes gsol ba nan cher btab kyang gsan du ma bzhed nas / da lan myur du bteg pa thams cad la dga' bas 'degs/ rgyud dang lam rim 'phro la 'jog pa'i 'dun pa kha sing du btang tshar gsungs nas chos mtshams mdzad de/ de yang da dung du sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi gsung sgros kyi bshad rgyun rdzogs pa med par 'phro ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i dgongs pa mdzad/ de nas lha sar phyag btegs jo bo rin po che'i drung du byon te phyag dang mchod pa dang smon lam rnam par dag pa rgya cher mdzad nas da dung yang bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i gsol 'debs shugs drag mdzad / de nas byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes pas spyan drangs te se rwa chos lding du byon/ byams chen chos rje dpon slob rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa tshad med pas mchod/ byams chen chos rje la se rar shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs rnams la 'chad nyan gyis bstan pa rgya cher spel dgos pa'i zhal ta mang du gnang zhing / khyad par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sngags kyi rgyud sde la 'chad nyan rnam par dag pa yong ye rnam pa thams cad du nub par gyur nas ring zhig lon/ rje rang nyid kyis bshad pa rnam par dag pa mdzad pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi nyams su myong bas blo gros kyi lus yongs su tshim pa mang du byon mod kyi/107—560

de lta na'aja da dung rgyud sde'i 'chad nyan rkang tshugs pa'i grwa sa things pa sngon chad med pas/ de 'dra ba'i 'chad nyan gyi gzhi rnam par dag pa tshugs na ci ma rung snyam du bstan pa 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa'i thugs kyi 'dun pa shugs drag pos byams chen chos rje la se rwa chos sding du gzhi 'dul ba'i bslab khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bde mchog gnyis kyi bshad sgrub rkang tshugs pa'i rgyud grwa zhig 'dzugs dgos pa'i zhal ta gnang ste se rwa chos sding du chos rje bas thugs khur ches cher bzhes nas/ gzhi 'dul ba'i bslab khrims rnam par dag pa la brten te dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang /bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud la 'chad nyan rkang tshugs pa'i grwa sa rnam par dag pa 'dzugs pa'i zhal bkod dang chos dpon bsko ba sogs mdzad cing / rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrig pa'i ched du gnas der gso sbyong mdzad/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi dbu nas chos thun re gsungs/ de nas rim gyis yar lam bde chen rtser phyag phebs/ der yang brag dkar rdzong dpon pa yab yum la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gnyis kyi bshad grwa rnam par dag pa tshugs pa'i grwa tshang zhig 'dzugs dgos pa'i zhal ta byon zhing/khong pas kyang dad pa chen pos dga' spro dang bcas te bka'i khur spyi bos mnos nas bde chen rtser dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa gnyis kyi 'chad nyan rnam par dag pa rkang tshugs pa gzhi 'dul ba'i bslab khrims phyag srol ma nyams pa la brten pa'i grwa sa btsugs/ rje rang nyid kyis kyang mthun rkyen gyi gnas gzhi 'dzugs pa sogs kyi rkyen du bab pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa'i gnang sbyin mdzad cing rdzong dpon pas bdag rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i 187—561

thugs khur bzhes/ de nas gnas gzhi de nyid la rab tu gnas pa zhus pas/da lan min pa rab gnas byed pa mi 'ong bas da lan rgyas pa zhig byed dgos gsungs nas rab gnas rgyas pa mdzad de/ gnas de nyid kyi gtsug lag khang de la gsang sngags mkhar zhes bya bar ming du gdags pa'ang mdzad do/ /de nas brag dkar du byon/ de nas gru bzhir gdan 'dren zhus nas byon te/ de yang 'bras spungs nas phyag bteg nas dga' ldan du ma phebs kyi ring la gang du spyan drangs pa thams cad du da yang yang 'ong ba mi 'ong bas da lan 'gro dgos gsungs nas zhal gyis bzhes par mdzad do/ /gru bzhir phebs pa'i nub gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa'i sgra chen po grags pa thams cad the tshom du gyur nas brtag kyang /mi zhig gis brdung ba ma yin par nges pa tsam du zad kyi/ gzhan du na rdung bar byed pa su zhig gis gnas gang du brdung ba sogs gang du'ang brtag par mi nus par yun ring du sgra shin tu grags shing gsang mtho brdung bar byed pa zhig byung ngo ske/ /gzhan du 'bras spungs nas yar la phyag ma bteg pa'i gong tsam gyi skabs su'ang sa chen po glo bur nyid du g.yo ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' mi mngon pa'i lam ring mo nas 'ongs pa'i 'ja' tshon rnam par bkra ba mtha' yas pa ri bo dga' ldan gyi rtse la yang dang yang du zug pa byung ste/ de ni rje rin po che 'di nyid 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad nas gzugs kyi skur bzhed pa dang mnyam du phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad du sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag nas mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i lha bgrang ba las 'das pas bsu ba byas pa yin par mngon no/ /gru bzhi nas phyag btegs te dga' ldan du phebs pa na thog mar yangs pa can gyi 107—562

gtsug lag khang chen por byon te 'dir da yang yang 'ong ba mi 'ong bas mchod gtor rgya cher gshoms gsungs nas ston pa'i sku dang / gzhal yas khang rnams dang ske/ yi dam gyi drung du mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya cher mdzad de gsol ba gdab pa dang smon lam gyi rim pa la sogs pa mang du mdzad/ de nas 'du khang du dge 'dun gyi mang ja 'dren pa zhig gis gdan drangs pas tshogs kyi dbus su phebs te sbyin bdag sogs kyi ched du zhu ba su'ang med par bde ba can gyi smon lam rgyas pa dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su shis brjod dang bcas pa mdzad de/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la rje nyid kyis ji ltar gsungs pa'i mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam srol bzang po 'di nyid mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i phyir 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su byon nas thugs smon dang bkra shis de ltar mdzad do/ /de nas gzim khang du phebs te gdan la bzhugs pa na/ da ni rang re'i dgon pa rang dbang thob pa 'dir slebs byung bas blo bde'o zhes bka' stsal/ de'i nyin mo 'das pa'i mtshan mo'i gung thun la bab pa tsam nas sku khams cung zhig bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan te/ de'i sang nyin nas dge 'dun thams cad kyis kyang sku rim la 'bad pa 'don par mdzad/ de lta na'ang sang gi nyin phyed tsam bar du sku lus kyi cha so sor bsnyun zug tu mngon pa cung zad yod gsung ba ma gtogs de nas bsnyun zug kyang chen po med par cung zad thugs nyog par gsal tsam gyi bar la nyin zhag gnyis kyi ring sku rim bsgrub/ de'i tshe sras kyi thu bo dar ma rin chen la bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul 'di ltar dgos bya ba la sogs pa'i zhal ta zhib par snga mo nas gnang tshar bas de'i tshe rgyas par ma gsungs shing dbu zhwa rna ring dang/107—563

gos ber zhig gnang ste don gyis rgyal tshab tu bsko bar mdzad/ gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan la sogs pa sku drung na 'khod pa la tshul 'di shes par gyis la byang chub kyi sems sgoms shig ces sogs tsam gsungs/ gzhan sku khams cung zad bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan pa'i ring la'ang sngar gyi thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang bdag 'jug la sogs pa'i thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams chag med du mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang gtso bor nang gi ting 'dzin la mchog tu gzhol ba'i thugs dam la khor yug tu bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas nyi shu bzhi'i dgong mo bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod pa rgyas pa zhig mdzad de/de'i tshe ka pā la mar med pa cig khyer shog gsung nas der nang mchod rgyas pa zhig mdzad de bdag nyid kyis bdud rtsi myang ba lan sum cu rtsa gnyis sam/bcu drug phrag gnyis su mdzad pa la/ de yang bde mchog gi mchod pa de dang 'brel bas de nyid kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin la rag cing / gzhan du na lha'i 'khor lo 'di 'dra zhig gi dbang du mdzad nas bdud rtsi myang ba mdzad do zhes bya ba ni sus kyang khong du ma chud de/ sku drung na 'khod pa kha cig ni grangs la dpag nas bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgo nas mdzad par yang rtog go/ /gzhan yang de dag gi tshe yi dam gyi khyad par mngon sum du gzigs pa la sogs pa'i gzigs snang khyad par can mang du yod pa'i rnam pa du ma mngon mod kyi/ sku drung na 'khod pa dag gis ji ltar mchis pa zhu bar ma nus so/ /de nas mtshan mo'i ring la thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs te/ de yang phyi rol nas mngon pa la rdo rje'i bzlas pa la sogs pa mdzad pa shas che bar mngon no zhes zer te/ mdor na 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku dang bsre ba'i man ngag 187—564

rnams thugs nyams su bstar ba yin par nges so/ de'i sang nyi shu lnga'i snga dro dang po nas zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du mdzad/ phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag ste thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa las nyi ma shar rjes tsam la stong pa gsum rim gyis thim nas thams cad stong pa 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du mdzad de gang du 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad pa dang dus mnyam du phyi'i sku lus bsgyur te/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor de gong cung zad sku khams bsnyel ba sogs kyis sngar las sku mdangs cung zhig chung bar yod na'ang / de'i tshe glo bur du zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba ltar rgyas par gyur te sku'i cha thams cad 'od kyi lus can gyi lha bu gzhon nu ltar gyur cing / sku'i sha zhu ba dang / ltar ltar por gyur pa dang / kham khum du gyur pa la sogs pa cung zad kyang med la/sngar gyi sku'i gnyer ma rnams kyang skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshag pa'i tshod tsam du'ang thams cad kyi thams cad du med par gyur te blta bar mi bzod pa'i 'od kyi phung po dang ldan zhing / de yang kha cig ni 'od dmar ser du snang ngo zhes zer/ kha cig ni dkar ser du snang ngo zhes zer/ kha cig ni gser btso ma lta bur snang ngo zhes zer te/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa'i lha'i lus can/ ji ltar 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa rgyan dang cha lugs spangs nas nang du yang dag 'jog la mnyam par bzhag pa ji lta ba de ltar gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du mdzad de/ 'chi ba chos skur bsgyur ba'i sgo nas bar do sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs te bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang mthar thug pa mngon du mdzad pa yin no zhes nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dang grub chen 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs 107—565

rje'i thugs sras rnams mthun par gsungs so/ /de ltar rje rin po ches 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad nas 'od gsal de las bzhengs pa dang dus mnyam du mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs kyi sku 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam du/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'od dag gis/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yis/ /dam pa'i bdag nyid snang bar gyur/ /tshangs pa drag po la sogs lhas/ /nam yang mthong bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'od zer gyi dra bas 'gengs shing tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha mthu bo che de dag gis kyang mthong bar mi nus na gzhan dag gis lta ci smos pa ye shes kyi sku nam mkha' ma zad kyi bar du 'gyur ba med pa/gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs la 'gag pa med pa/ thugs bden pa gnyis mngon sum du gzigs pa las nam yang nyams pa med pa/ sku las sprul pa phyogs bcur spros pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa'i sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi don mdzad bzhin du zhing 'di'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du sngar lhag pa'i lha mang pos lung bstan pa ltar dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du phebs nas rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sras kyi thu bo'i tshul bzung ba 'jam dpal snying po zhes bya ba dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'dus pa'i gdul bya sa'i rdul dang mnyam pa dag la theg pa chen po'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed cing bzhugs so/ /de nas sras kyi gco bo rnams kyis gtsos dga' ldan du gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang / phyogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i dad ldan bgrang las 'das pa dag dang / dkar phyogs kyi lha dang klu la sogs pa sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba'i dad ldan khag gis phyi nang gsang 187—566

ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa tshad med pas mchod de/ phyi rol du gling me yang rgyu skar gyi phreng ba sa la 'phos pa lta bu dkrigs pas bar snang dang / sa gzhi'i mun pa cig car du 'phrog ste nyin mo'i snang ba ltar du gyur la/ deng sang gi bar du yang dga' ldan lnga mchod zhes bod dang bod chen po'i ljongs/ rgya dkar nag /chen po hor gyi yul dang bcas pas grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i skye bo/ skya ser mchog dman mtha' dag gis gling me'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs par byed do/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs gsar du 'dzug par mdzad pa 'di nyid nam yang rgyun mi 'chad cing mi nyams par gnas pa'i rten 'brel du sku gdung ril po tsan dan gyi sgrom gyi nang du gzhug /de yang rin po che'i sgrom gyi nang du gzhug ste dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nyid na lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs so/ /mdor na rje bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos 'phags yul paṇ+ḍi ta'i gzhung lugs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad rigs pa dri ma med pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i dpyad pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyis sngags kyi bshad srol ji snyed cig mchis pa dang / bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi gsung mtha' dag thugs su chud/ mkhas pa rang rang gi bzhed srol phra mo rnams kyang ma 'dres par mkhyen/ mdor na mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel man ngag lag len dang bcas pa nyid kyi mkhyen rab kyi yul du ma gyur pa cung zad tsam yang med pas 'phags yul shing rta chen po la co 'dri ba lta bu / mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur/ de dag thams cad kyang gang 107—567

zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i nyams len gyi gdams par shar/ 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra mo yang 'da' ba med par gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'phags pa nye bar 'khor ltar gyur cing / ljongs 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur pa rmangs nas gso bar mdzad/ nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid mi'i rnam par rol ba yin kyang / drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor yang ji ltar thos pa'i don la tshul bzhin bsam pa dang / sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / zhi lhag rim gnyis dang bcas pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs te grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ mdo sngags lam rim gnyis dang /drang nges legs bshad snying po/ rtsa 'jug gi ṭika chen rnam gnyis/ rim lnga gsal sgron la sogs pa 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub sus kyang rtsom par mi nus pa'i legs bshad kyi gter chen po mkhyen rab kyi mdzod las phyungs/ de dus bod kyi sgom chen pa rnams la sgom gyi gnad las brtsams pa'i dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar mdzad par sus kyang lan zhu ma nus/ gzhung chen po dang mthun pa'i zhi gnas sgrub tshul gyi man ngag /zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba tshol tshul/ bde stong / 'od gsal/ sgyu lus/ lam rim pa lnga'i zab gnad khyad par can rnams rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhal chab dron mo lta bu rje btsun nyid las dngos su gsan pa sprul pa'i glegs bam dang bcas bka' rgyas btab ste phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la pham phabs su stsal/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rgya nag rgyal pos gdan drangs pa la'ang thugs mi gzhol/mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā ba dang / 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ kurma 107—568

pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis sku che'i stod la phyogs lhung gis dgag pa ci rigs mdzad kyang / rjes su gsung rab rnams gzigs pas 'gyod pa dang dad pa drag po 'khrungs nas tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod bsngags kyis me tog 'thor bar mdzad pa da lta rang rang gi gsung la gsal/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis kyang dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / dpal ldan zla ba dang mi gnyis pa lta bur gzigs nas mchod par mdzad/ de dus kyi mkhas pa thams cad kyis sgro 'dog gcod yul dang / sgom chen pa rnams kyis nyams rtogs 'bul sa/ skye bo mchog dman mtha' dag gis mchod pa'i zhing / mi'i dbang po kun gyi gtsug nor / 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po gcig gis sa chen po 'di yongs su bzung bar mdzad do/ /deng sang gi dus su'ang khrims ldan dge 'dun gyi sde gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bus lung rtogs kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub dri ma med pa 'dzin cing spel ba 'di dag kyang rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'phrin las kho na la brten nas byung ngo / /'di ni rags pa tsam ste thun mong ba'i rnam thar gyi cha 'ga' zhig ni rnam thar chen mo rnams su gsal bar bzhugs la/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag ni sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i spyod yul las 'phags chen dag gis kyang brjod pa'i yul las 'gongs so/ /gsung las skyes pa'i slob bu yang lung bstan thob pa'i thugs sras bdun/ sras kyi thu bo gnyis / 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi/ dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i sgron me bcu/ gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' drug /mi dbang gtsug na bkur ba'i ti shri gnyis/ sa skyong chos rje drug /skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan spyan snga brgyad sogs mkhas grub/ bla 107—569

chen / bya bral/ gnas brtan/ rtogs ldan sogs mtha' yas nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byon pa phyogs tsam yang brjod par mi lang ngo / /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ rgyal rnams bzhed don gcig pu 'gro ba'i don/ /de slad bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i tshul ston te/ /la lar gshegs dang la lar bltams pa sogs/ /dpag dka'i cho 'phrul bye ba cig car ston/ /ji ltar bden stong stong pa'i rnam 'gyur ni/ /sna tshogs rten 'byung 'byung dang 'jig par ston/ /de phyir g.yo med chos sku'i 'dzum bag kyang / /sna tshogs skye dang sdud pa'i rnam 'gyur ngoms/ /sangs rgyas kun dang ro gcig chos dbyings sku/ /skye 'jig 'pho 'gyur g.yo ba ga la srid/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar spro dang sdud pa ni/ /'gro la rjes su brtse phyir sna tshogs ston/ /sgyu 'phrul bkod pa 'gog pa'i sta gon du/ /gsang gsum 'phrin las khyad par du ma yis/ /thabs kyis sbran pas blo gros ldan pa kun/ /yid ni zug rngu'i phyogs la 'phyang bar gyur/ /ye shes rdo rje'i dngos po stong bzhi'i dbyings/ /sgyu 'phrul lang tsho mgron du bkug pa na/ /rags pa'i za ma tog tsam zhing 'di yi/ /bgo skal nyid du gyur 'di kye ma hud/ /'on te zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku/ /mkha' khyab 'gro 'ong 'du 'bral ma dmigs pas/ /dad pa'i kun mthong gtsang mar ye shes sku'i/ /skal bzang 'dzin pa da dung 'gro 'dir mang / /sras kyi thu bo gnyis sogs mkhas grub kyi/ /slob brgyud gser gyi sa 'dzin bstar chags pas/ /dge ldan ring lugs gser sbyangs btso ma yis/ /sa 'di da dung skal bzang dog por gnas/ /'jam mgon mgon med mgon du du ma'i gar/ /blo bzang bzang po'i skur ston ston mtshig deso/ /mkha' sgrub 4khyab bdag sa la la 'ure du/ sto /'god thabs thams 107—570 4 4 4 4 sgo sgo

mkhas lam mchog mchog tu bstan/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyengs sum̐ smos pa'o//de dag las sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam 'god na/de la sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen ni/ sngon dus yun ring po nas thugs bskyed de rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la slob bzhin pa las/ zhing 'dir 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa spel ba'i slad du smon lam gyi mthus byon pa zhig ste/ sems dpa' chen po 'di gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs shing bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa gtsang myang stod kyi sa'i cha ri nang zhes bya ba ste/ nang gi lung lag mdzo chad ces bya bar yab blon po rba'i rigs brgyud rta dbon pa dang / yum jo mo shes rab ces bya ba'i sras su rab byung drug pa'i shing pho 'brug gi lo la bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bzhes pa chu mo glang gi lo gdan sa chen po gnas rnying du mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan pa dang / brag thog pa gzhon nu tshul khrims gnyis la mkhan slob zhus nas tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ mtshan dar ma rin chen zhes gsol/ de nas mkhan slob kyi spyan sngar ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i so thar gyi bslab bya rnams mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung zhing slob dpon dpal mgon pa'i drung du yi ge 'dri klog phul du phyin pa bslabs/ de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po kun dga' dpal yongs 'dzin du bsten te tshad ma rnam 'grel dang tshad ma rnam nges cha lag dang bcas pa la sbyangs/de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po ri nang pa rin chen rdo rje yongs 'dzin du bsten te phar phyin gyi gzhung rnams la sbyangs/ de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po bran ma brag 107—571

kha ba chos rje don grub rin chen gyi drung du mngon pa la sbyangs/ de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po blo gros bzang po'am dka' bzhi pa blo gsal zhes yongs su grags pa de'i drung du 'dul ba la sbyangs/ gzhan yang lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang / shangs pa kun mkhyen pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma la mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad par gangs can gyi shing rta chen po rje red mda' ba'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten te phar phyin tshad ma 'dul ba mngon pa dbu ma sogs mdo phyogs kyi gzhung rnams dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sogs sngags kyi gzhung rnams phal che ba gsan te rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur te rje btsun red mda' ba'i sras kyi thu bo gzhung lugs rab 'byams shes pa'i bshes gnyen bdun gyi nang tshan gcig yin no/ /de nas dpal ldan sa skya sogs gtsang phyogs kyi chos grwa chen po rnams su dka' bcu'i grwa skor mdzad de snyan pa'i grags pas sa'i steng khyab par gyur te/ de nas dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa sa pho 'brug gi lo la gtsang la stod ldog lho pa chos rje kun dga' dpal bas mkhan po/ rje btsun red mda' bas las slob/ rje gangs can kun dga' dpal bas gsang ston mdzad/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa dpal ldan blo gros dang / blo gros mtshungs med sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun nyer gnyis kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa mnos nas bslab pa rin po che mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces spras su mdzad de 'phags mchog nye bar 'khor slar yang gangs ri'i khrod du byon pa ji lta bar gyur to/ /de nas dbus phyogs kyi grwa sa rnams su grwa skor mdzad de rtsed thang gi grwa skor mdzad nas rje rin po che gnyal stod ra grong du 107—572

bzhugs pa'i tshe mjal du byon/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i spu long g.yos shing / sku mdun du bzhugs te chos kyi bka' mchid stsol bar zhus pas/ rje rin po ches sems dpa' chen po 'di rin po che lta bu'i gdul byar gzigs nas gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i snying po'i don lam gyi dka' gnad rnams dri med rigs pa'i lam nas drangs te rgya cher gsungs pas yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po 'khrungs te 'di lta bu'i dam pa'i mgon la brten pa las lhag pa gang yang ma mchis shing / rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bshes gnyen dam pa 'di lta bu bor nas gzhan du 'gro ba ga la rigs snyam du zhabs kyi pad+mo la spyi bos gtugs te de nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du zhabs kyi pad+mo la brten chog pa dgos zhes gsol ba nan cher btab pas rje rin po ches kyang dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas bzung ste rje rin po che'i zhabs drung du bcar bzhugs mdzad nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dang /bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs mdo sngags kyi lung khrid man ngag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ de yang thugs rab kyi rlabs phul du phyin pas rje rin po ches chos gang gsungs thams cad lan res bum pa gang byo lta bur thugs la chud de / rje rin po ches gnam rtsed ldeng du 'dul ba'i bslab bya rgyas par gsungs pa'i tshe gang gsungs thams cad thugs su chud de/ de ma thag zin bris su btab pa bslab bya gnam rtsed ldeng mar yongs su grags pa dang / rje rin po ches se ra chos lding du ma rgyud rdzogs rim dpyid thig gsung ba'i tshe gang gsung thams cad thugs su chud de de ma thag zin bris su btab pa rdzogs rim dpyid kyi thig le'i zin bris lta bu shin tu mang / de nas sa mo glang gi lo cho 'phrul mchod 107—573

pa grub rjes dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'debs par mdzad tshe sems dpa' chen po 'di dang 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis khur bzhes te dge 'dun la gnang ba zhu ba dang / rdo bteg pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang gcod pa dang / lag gi bla bsko ba sogs 'dul ba nas ji ltar gsungs pa thams cad ji bzhin phyag len la btab nas mkhar las kyis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa gzhi nas gso ba'i bya ba mdzad cing / rtag tu ngus chos 'phags bsten pa ji lta ba bzhin du lus srog longs spyod gang la'ang mi lta bar rje rin po che'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa la nam yang g.yel ba med par mdzad do/ /de nas rje rin po che zhing gshegs pa la phyogs pa'i tshe ji ltar lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar pos 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon pa la phyogs pa'i tshe mi pham mgon po rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos kyang paṇa zhwa sne ring dang na bza' gos ber bcas bdag nyid chen po 'di la gnang ste rgyal tshab tu don gyis bsko bar mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa sa mo phag gi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i gza' skar dus sbyor bzang po la ri bo dga' ldan du rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas gdan sa lo bcu gsum bar du mdzad de bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad do/ /dgung lo re brgyad bzhes pa lcags mo phag gi lo hor zla bcu pa'i gza' tshes dge bar mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid dga' ldan gyi gdan sar rang gi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur bar mdzad/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i ched du bstan bcos kyang mang du bzhugs te rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/107—574

spyod 'jug sogs kyi ṭik+ka dang / rnam 'grel thar lam gsal byed sogs rigs pa'i rgya mtsho bsrub pa'i legs bshad 'od dkar gyi phreng ba dran dbang bde 'byung gi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa las phal gyi blo gros kyis gcib par dka' ba'i gzhung chen mo rgya gar mkhas pa'i gsung dang mi gnyis pa mang du mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo re dgu bzhes pa'i tshe zhing khams gzhan gyi 'gro don la dgongs nas chu pho byi lo hor zla lnga pa'i snron gyi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la lha sa'i po tā lar mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ de nas bzung ste bdun phrag gsum gyi bar du dbus gtsang thams cad dang / khyad par dge ldan dang lha sa gnas rnying rnams su gser btso ma'i me tog dang / gzhan yang tsam pa ma'i me tog dang ske/ pad+ma ra ga dang / in+d+ra ni la lta bu'i kha dog dang ldan pa'i char chen po babs / khyad par sku gdung dga' ldan du gdan 'dren pa'i dus dang /zhugs 'bul ba'i dus rnams su rol mo'i sgra dang / 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas brjod kyis mi lang ba byung ba ni kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa yin no/ /de tshe mkhas grub rjes zhal bkod gnang nas dge ldan dang gnas rnying sogs su thugs dam gsol 'debs kyi mang ja tsha ra 'bul rgyun gral 'gyed sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs so/ /sku gdung rgyal khang rtser zhugs la phul ba las phyis kyi gdul bya rnams kyi gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten du ring bsrel mang du byon pa dad ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la gsol 'debs kyi rten du rgya cher gnang / sku gdung byings rnams dngul gyi mchod rten nang bzhugs te dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling na gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ blo bzang snang 107—575

gter dus kyi chu bdag ma'i/ /stang zil ral pa brtsegs pa'i klong mnal kyang //rgyal tshab 'od stong gzhan zhig shar ri'i rtser/ /thub bstan pad tshal skyong ba'i gnyen du 'dzum/ byang chub rdo rje mi yi srid gzung tshe/ /mthu chen rgyal sras rnams kyang sras kyi tshul/ /gzung nas 'chad rtsod rtsom la brel ba na/ /sa chen mkhas dang grub pas bkang bar gyur/ /gzhung brgya ut+pal ri dwags lang tsho'i 'dzum / /mkhyen rab ba gam gcig gi ngos chags pas/ /'jig rten gsum mgon dar ma rin chen zhes/ /bdud rtsi'i thig le gcig gi gar du rol/ /zab brling gting mtha' dpag dka' nyid kyi phyir/ /khyod thugs zla ba'i ma ma ji bzhin te/ /khyod gsung nyid kyang bde 'byung gtsug rgyan bzhin/ /mkhas rlom lha dbang phal gyi spyod yul min/ /rigs pa'i rgya mtsho zab brling gting mtha' bral/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa mkha' ltar yangs/ /'di ni rgyan drug mchog gnyis gras sam ci/ /bod yul 'khrungs pas rgyal tshab dar ma nyid/ /gzungs spobs mkhyen brtse ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' klas pas/ /blo bzang chos kyi khri la khyod kho na/ /blo bzang rgyal ba nyid bzhin mdzes par gyur/ /lung rtogs lus stobs rab dar dar ma zhes/ /'jigs bral smra ba'i gdong lnga lnga rig dbang / /rigs pa'o gde rgyangs smra ngan ngan dgu'i blo/ /'chang ba'i le skyes tshogs kun kun nas bskrad/ /ces bya stob mang bar skabs su tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangaso kyi 'edu bgyis pa'o//nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang ni / sngon dus yun ring po nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtshor bslabs nas zhing 'dir 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi 107—576

bstan pa'i snying po mthar thug pa 'di nyid 'dzin cing spel ba'i ched du smon lam gyi dbang gis bsam bzhin du byon pa zhig ste/ mkhas grub chen po 'di la stod byang gi sa'i cha rdog gzhung du byang pa'i dpon rigs yab bkra shis dpal bzang dang ske/ yum bu 'dren rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i shing mo glang gi lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te 'khrungs so/ /yab yum de gnyis la sras gsum yod pa las/ rje 'di che ba dang / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan bar pa dang —/ chung ba bsod nams bkra shis zhes pa zhig byung ngo / /de ltar mkhas grub chen po 'di ni sngon nas lam la sbyangs pa'i mthu brtas pas 'khrungs tsam nyid nas byis pa'i rgyad pa gang yang med cing / chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i blo gros thogs pa med pa zhig byung nas bdag nyid chen po 'di ni skyes bu dam pa bsam bzhin du byon pa'o zhes gleng zhing / mkhas grub lha dbang pa'i skye ba yin par grags pas mkhas grub ces mtshan chung ngu nas thogs so/ /de nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang / dam can chos srung thams cad kyis rje 'di pa 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin phyir thugs rgyud bskul zhing sngon nas goms pa'i mthus nges 'byung gi bsam pa shugs drag pos rab tu byung ba'i lo tshigs su slebs ma thag gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan po mdzad/ rgya ma pa yon tan 'od kyis slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ de nas mkhan slob gnyis las bslab bya gsan te dge tshul gyi bslab bya yan lag dang bcas pa mig gi 'bras bu las kyang gces par bsrungs te tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir bzung nas gangs can 187—577

gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rje btsun red mda' pa'i zhabs la gtugs te tshad ma sde bdun/mngon pa gong 'og /byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma rigs tshogs/ 'dul ba rnams la sbyangs te ring por ma thogs par mkhas pa'i pha rol tu son/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dpal ba la kye rdo rje'i dbang dang lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang / na bza' pa sogs bshes gnyen dam pa du ma las mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan te/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob cing rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son par gyur to/ /de nas gtsang phyogs kyi grwa sa rnams su grwa skor mdzad cing / ngam ring chos sder phebs pa na gangs can gyi mkhas pa chen po paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal yang der phebs nas 'jigs med smra ba'i gad rgyangs bsgrags te dam bca' bzhag pa na phyogs de'i mkhas pa sus kyang rgol bas glags ma rnyed pa na paṇa chen phyogs rgyal bas sa paṇa gyi rigs gter 'di nang 'gal gyi phung po yin pas ngas mthar chags su dgag par bya yi/ lan spobs pa yod na smros shig ces ngam ring / sa skya/ bo dong sogs chos sde phal mo cher dril bsgrags pa na/ ji ltar seng ge'i skad kyis wa skyes rnams 'dar ba bzhin du phyogs de'i mkhas par rloms pa sus kyang lan 'don par ma nus pa na/phyogs de'i dge 'dun phal mo che gros byas te skyes tsam nyid nas shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas pa dka' bcu dge legs dpal ba 'di la gsol ba btab pa drag ces thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu mkhas grub chen po la zhus pa na/ de dus mkhas grub chen po 'di pa dgung lo bcu bdun gyi skabs yin pas sku na shin tu 187—578

phra ba yin yang 'jigs pa med par khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bcas te de kho bos nus so zhes zhal gyis bzhes te dge 'dun thams cad tshogs pa'i dbus su paṇa chen phyogs rgyal bas dam bca' bzhag /de la mkhas grub rin po ches re re nas 'di ni mi rigs pa/ 'di ni mi 'thad pa/ lung dang 'gal ba dang ske/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba ste/ de dag mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'di ltar ro zhes rig gter 'gog pa'i dam bca' re re nas dri ma med pa'i rigs pa brgya phrag stong gis sun phyung nas paṇa chen phyogs rgyal ba spobs pa lan med du gyur/ slar yang mkhas grub rin po ches rigs pa'i nga ro ches cher bsgrags pa na rigs pa'i 'phul mtshams ches zhib cing phra bar gyur te paṇa chen phyogs rgyal bas mdo sde pa'i lugs la rgyu las ma skyes pa'i dngos po yod gsung dgos pa byung nas de mdo sde pa rang gi grub mtha'i nang 'gal yin gsungs shing cung zad zhal skyengs te phyag gis zhal rgya la nom zhing bzhugs pa na/ mkhas grub rin po ches nyams mtshar gyi tshul du rgyu las ma skyes pa'i dngos po yod gsung ba de mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i nang 'gal yin gsung ba/ da kha spu 'thog pa'i las la brtson par byos shig /ces gsungs pa na tshogs pa thams cad gad mo'i gnas su gyur to/ /de dus su khong gnyis kyis rtsod pa mdzad pa'i tshe bdag nyid chen po de gnyis ka dri ma med pa'i rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur gzhan dang mi 'dra bas mkhas pa mang pos rtsod yig zin bris su mdzad pa yod 'dug cing phyis mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyis tshad ma sde bdun gyi dka' gnad gsal bar ston pa yid kyi mun sel mdzad pa'i nang du'ang de dus kyi rtsod pa'i tshig rnams drangs so/ /de nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i lo grangs su son pa na/107—579

stod 'dul ba'i mkhan brgyud gangs ri'i khrod kyi shing rta chen po red mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros kyis mkhan po/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen po dpal 'byor shes rab kyis las slob/ mtshan don dang mthun pa'i gnyal pa blo gros mtshungs med kyis gsang ston/ gzhan yang dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes te 'dul 'dzin gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu'i dbus na zla med pa'i lhun po lta bur gyur to/ /de nas rje btsun red mda' pa chen pos mkhas grub rin po che la khyed rje btsun tsong kha pa dang mjal na gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'ong zhes bskul ba dang / rang nyid kyang rje rin po che'i snyan pa gsan pas dad pas ches cher bskul te me mo phag gi lor khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal mjal du byon te sang mjal rgyu'i nub mo snye thang du bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du/ mun pa nag po phyogs gar 'gro'i gtol med pa zhig tu phyin pa na/ shar phyogs nas ral gri'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i ral gri'i so rnams phyi dang yu ba nang du bstan pa/ ral gri re re'i rtse nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brgya phrag re shar ba/'khor lo de'i lte ba'i dbus su 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i dra bas bskor ba'i nang du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser la ral gri dang glegs bam bsnams shing rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ gzhon nu'i cha byad can ral pa'i thor tshugs la mu tig gi phreng bas dkris shing shin tu mdzes pa blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig byon byung bas mun pa thams cad sangs/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la snang ba chen pos khyab pa dang / rje btsun gyi sku yang rang gi lus la thim pas bde ba'i nyams khyad par can skyes pa zhig byung / sang nyin 107—580

se ra chos sding du phebs pa na thog mar dge slong zhi dul can zhig dang mjal ba na de la chos rje blo bzang grags pa'i gzim khang gang yin dris pas/ lan ma smras par nang du song nas spos reng sbar nas khyer byung ste/ gzim khang ser po'i drung du slebs pa na phyag gsum btsal/ phyag gnyis kyis spos reng bzung ste/don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te bdag gi mkhan po rin po che blo bzang grags pa'i zhal snga nas bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di'o zhes spos kyi rtse mo de phyogs su bstan pas dge slong de 'dul ba nas gsungs pa ltar gyi kun spyod yongs su dag pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la shin tu gus pa'i tshul rnams gzigs pas rje tsong kha pa'i zhabs 'bring dge slong 'di dag kyang 'di ltar dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i lag len la mkhas shing zhi zhing dul ba bla ma lnga bcu pa nas bshad pa'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul rnams kyang phyag len la thebs pa 'di 'dra na/ rje rin po che ji 'dra zhig yod snyam du lus kyi spu zing zhes byed cing 'jigs shing dpa' zhum par gyur/ de nas rje rin po che mjal bas dad pa dpag tu med pa 'khrungs / rje rin po ches khyed la lam du rmi lam ci byung gsungs par sngar snye thang du byung ba rnams zhus pas khyed sngags kyi gdul bya dbang rnon yin par 'dug /khyed kyis gdul bya mang po la phan thogs chen po 'ong gsungs/ de dus rje rin po ches khyed yi dam gang la byed kyin yod gsungs pas/ mkhas grub rin po ches bdag yi dam gshin rje gshed dmar la byed kyin yod zhus par/rje rin po ches gshin rje gshed dmar po la yi dam byas na'ang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur mod/ 'on kyang 'jigs byed la yi dam byed pa byung na rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur 107—581

'gro ba la gshin rje gshed gzhan gnyis las khyad par 'phags pa'i chos mang du yod gsungs par brten/ mkhas grub rin po ches kyang de nas bzung ste rdo rje 'jigs byed la yi dam du mdzad cing / rje rin po che la rdo rje 'jigs byed la khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos ji lta bu yod ces gsol ba btab pas/ 'o na maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa zhig phul gsungs nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul bas zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi man ngag dang / rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu gzhan gnyis dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa rnams rgyas par gnang / de'i tshe mkhas grub rin po che ches rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pas / rje nyid kyis dkyil 'khor bri thig gnang nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / rtog bdun/ rtog gsum/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi khrid sogs gnang nas khyod bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa cig 'ong bar 'dug ces dgyes pa'i bka' stsal/ rje rin po che'i tshems brul ba yang dgyes bzhin du gnang bar tshems yig lung bstan du gsungs so/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du rje rin po che la tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pas mchod cing / gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba shugs drag tu 'debs par mdzad pas/ rje rin po ches zla ba bcu'i ring la nyin mo rgyud sde dang gzhung chen mo rnams kyi bshad pa/ mtshan re bzhin bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag rnams dang /khyad par zhal las shes par bya ba'i gnad mtha' dag rgyun ma chad par stsal ba rnams tshig zur phra mo tsam yang nyams pa med par thugs la bzung zhing nyams su bzhes te gdeng thob par mdzad do/ /rje rin po che zhing gshegs nas phal cher ri bo mdangs can du bzhugs te rje rin po che'i mdo sngags kyi man ngag rnams 187—582

thun bzhir bcad de nyams su bzhes pas bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi bar mdo sngags gnyis ku'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa la myong ba phul phyin thon te phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la sangs rgyas dngos su byon yang de phan chad du gsung du med pa'i mdo sngags kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di 'dra thob nas kha phyir bltas ma song bar rang gi rgyud la bskor te nyams len mthar phyin par bya dgos so zhes 'doms phyir dam bca' bcu pa zhes pa'i tshigs bcad mgur dbyangs su mdzad/ skal ba dang ldan pa gzhan dag la'ang rje rin po che'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa bsre bslad med pa rnam par dag pa rgya cher spel zhing —/ chos rgyal bdag po rab brtan pas gdan drangs te dpal 'khor chos sder rje rin po che'i lugs bzang 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde mang du spel te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas dgung lo zhe gsum bzhes pa me mo lug gi lor bdag po rab brtan pas dbus nas rong ston chen po gdan drangs te rje 'di dang rtsod pa mdzad par dril bsgrags/ mkhas grub rin po ches kyang zhal gyis bzhes/ gtam de dbus gtsang yongs la bsgrags pas mkhas pa mang po dpang por byon cing bka' bstan 'gyur yang brtsigs/ rtsod pa'i dus tshes btabaske/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i 'du khang du rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor bshams/mkhas grub rin po che dang / rtsod pa'i dbang po rnams kyang gdan 'dzom pa na/rong ston pas rtsod par nus pa lta ci/ rgol pa'i gdan gyi steng du byon par ma nus par bdag po rab brtan pa dang gnyis gas byol thabs kho na mdzad pas/mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang pos rtsod pa'i do zla ma rnyed pas 'jigs pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa sgrog par mdzad pa ni/ blo 107—583

bzang gsung gi legs bshad me tog phreng / /zhes pa nas/ 'di ltar mngon du ma nus pa'i/ /zhum tshig smras pa dran byos la/ /phyis nas mkhas pa'i legs bshad la/ /lkog tu ngan smras ma byed cig /dri med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs gcig gis kyang / /dregs ldan phas rgol glang po stong gi snying / /lkog mar 'byin pa'i 'jigs ster dge legs dpal/ /bzang po las gzhan smra ba'i seng ge gang / /zhes pa'i bar gyi gdong lnga'i gad rgyangs rgya cher tshogs kyi dbus su bsgrags te dpal 'khor chos sde'i rgyal sgo la bslan par mdzad do/ /de nas mkhas grub rin po che dpal 'khor chos sder ma bzhugs par ri bo mdangs can du bzhugs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa na/ sa skyong rab brtan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa ched du bsam ste brlag par byas pa ltar 'gyod pa tshad med skyes te mkhas grub rin po cher dngos su zhu ma nus par nye gnas la gser mang po dang bcas slar gdan 'dren pa'i zhu ba byas par phebs su ma bzhed par zhal gdams tshigs su bcad pa bskur bar mdzad do/ /de ltar mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa 'di ni rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son cing / rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kuḥl sogs pa lhag pa'i lha mang pos rjes su bzung ba dang /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ gur gyi mgon po/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa sogs dam can chos srung rnams kyis rgyun du zhal bstan te bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang la'ang thogs pa med pa dang / rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lha mo dbyangs can ma/ sa ra ha dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub 707—584

sogs paṇa grub mang pos zhal bstan te byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam thar mang du mchis te/ 'dir mtha' dag bkod na mang du dogs pa dang / gsang ba bsgrags par yang 'gyur dogs nas ma bkod pas gsang ba'i rnam thar dag las shes par bya'o/ /don 'di dag la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pas/zhing 'dir khyod sku'i nyin byed shar ba'i tshe/ /log smra 'byung po'i bya rnams long gyur cing / /gsung rab 'dab brgya'i tshal kun rgyas mdzad pa/ /sngon med nyi ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngags so/ /lan gcig chos grol nas nang du phebs pa'i skabs shig la rje bla ma dran nas/ log pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i sems can 'di rnams la gzigs dang zhes thugs shin tu skyo nas spyan chab mang du shor zhing / mchod pa bzang po bshams nas gsol ba btab pas/ glang po che mche ba drug ldan lus dril bu dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i steng du rje rin po che sngar gyi dbyibs ji lta bar byon nas bu sems mi dga' ba mi dgos/ bla ma dran na sngar bsags kyi sdig pa 'dag cing bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa yin/ nged rang dpon slob kyi mdun ma legs/ rje btsun mi las kyang bla ma dran nas dran mgur mdzad pa yin/ nga'i bstan pa rgyas par gyis gsungs/ yang lan gcig lta ba dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad phra ba gcig la the tshom du byung nas bdag gi bla ma de bzhugs na zhu ba yin pa la/ da thag chod pa'i zhu sa gzhan ni med snyam du dgongs nas maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba btab pas/ gser gyi khri rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig lha'i bu mang pos btegs pa'i steng du rje bla ma bzhugs pa dngos su byon nas/ nga'i sngags mtshan nyid kyi lam rim gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i yig cha rnams la ltos dang kha chems kyi 107—585

tshab yin gsungs nas gang la the tshom byung ba'i lta ba dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad rnams zhib tu gsungs shing dbang rjes gnang kha yar gnang / yang skabs shig tu rje'i gsung rab rnams kyis thugs 'phrog nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i dgongs don lam gyi go rim grangs nges/ shing rta'i srol 'byed rnams kyi bzhed pa ji ltar yin pa dang /khyad par sgyu lus 'od gsal sogs zab lam gyi rnam gzhag /de yang 'dul ba nas bzung ste shin tu spros med kyi bar thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs su hril gyis dril nas ston cing lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa 'di lta bu ston pa nga'i bla ma tsong kha pa chen po ma gtogs rgya bod gang du yang ma byung 'dug snyam pa'i dad pa chen po 'khrungs nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje rin po che seng ge la chibs pa/ sku mdog dmar ser ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa gzhon nu ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi cha byad du byon nas nga'i bu sems mi dga' ba mi dgos/spyir sems can gyi rigs la sna tshogs 'ong / khyad par da lta snyigs ma'i dus su mi rtag pa dang / ngan song gi sdug bsngal ma dran pas rnyed bkur sogs la zhen cing tshe 'di'i mdun ma bsgrubs nas phyi ma'i don lta zhig /tshe phyi ma ji ltar gyur snyam pa'ang dkon /chos byed 'dod cung zad yod kyang phyi shol du song / chos byed par shom pa tsho yang bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnyed dka' zhing de'i legs bshad go bar dka'/ shes kyang tshe 'di blos btang nas sgrub pa snying por byed pa nyin mo'i skar ma las dkon par 'dug /kho bos bla ma dang yi dam la gsol ba btab nas tshogs bsags/ sgrib pa sbyangs/ gzhung lugs kyi don 107—586

la brtag cing mtha' dpyod pa'i legs bshad rnams bltas la yid ches par byas nas nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas lag mthil du rnyed pa ltar thob sla bar yod kyang byed mkhan nyung / 'on kyang snod rung gi gdul bya re gnyis byung na de dag la phan par gyis/ khyad par sngags kyi gzhung lugs rnams rgyas par gyis dang skye ba phyi ma 'phrad pa yin gsungs/ yang skabs shig tu myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcas byon te zhal nas shā sa na'i sngags 'dren zhing bskor ba byas te khyod kyis nga'i sgrub skor las kha tshar dang bcas pa tshang bar rtsoms shig gsung ba zhig byung bas/ mgon po'i be'u bum cha lag dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /de nas lcags mo phag gi lo rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa gnas rnying du phebs pa mjal bar byon pas rgyal tshab rin po ches mkhas grub rin po che la dga' ldan gyi gdan sa byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin yab sras lhan du dbus su byon/'jam dbyangs chos rje sogs 'bras spungs kyi dge 'dun tshang mas yab sras gnyis ka la gus 'dud bla med mdzad cing chos kyi bka' drin zhus/ de nas dga' ldan du phebs pa na gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan pas gtsos dga' ldan gyi dge 'dun tshang mas zhabs spyi bor blangs te gus pa bla med mdzad cing /rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa zur bzhugs mdzad de mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa gser khrir mnga' gsol/ de nas rje bla ma'i gdan sa lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par bskyangs te lo re bzhin lam rim gyi khrid rgyas pa re dang /gzhan yang dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa stsal zhing rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/chos kyi sgra dbyangs chen po bsgrags te smra ba ngan pa thams cad tshar bcad/ rje 107—587

bla ma'i bstan pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar gus pas mchod cing / rnam pa kun nas bsre bslad med par rnam par dag pa 'dzin pas 'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab par mdzad/ gser gdung gi dbu thog tu gser phibs gsar bskrun sogs sri zhu phu dud bla na med pa mdzad/ dga' ldan du shing rta chen po'i gzhung rnams la bshad gra gsar 'dzugs mdzad de/ mkhas pa chen po shākya shrī/ snon pa dpal ldan pa/ bla ma yar 'brog pa/ rje chos grags pa dang bzhi slob dpon du bskos nas mtshan nyid kyi bshad gra btsugs te ches cher dar bar mdzad do/ /de nas dus nam zhig na rje thams cad mkhyen pa dran nas / nga'i bla ma gang na bzhugs yod snyam du sku lus 'dar ba dang / ba spu g.yo zhing spyan chab dang bcas nas/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / sems can dmu rgod kyi spyod pa la gzigs shig /khyed kyi bstan pa yang myur du 'jig pa 'dra/kho bo bla ma khyed kyi drung du nam zhig 'ong / zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/rje rin po che stag chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig la chibs nas rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs sku mdog dmar po spyan dang shangs che ba/ snum zhing bkrag pa phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kur bzung ba/ grub chen brgyad cus bskor ba zhig byon nas/ bu snying mi dga' ba bya mi dgos/ ngas khyod bzhag nas gang du yang mi 'gro/ nga dran na nga yi yig cha rnams la ltos/ nga dngos su yod kyang 'di las smra rgyu gzhan med/sems can rnams bsod nams chung ngur song nyon mongs rags bstan pa'i mjug sdud pa'i 'go yang brtsam 'dug /khyod rang yang mkha' spyod du 'ong ba'i 'dun pa thongs gsungs/ de nas mi ring ba na da rang 'gro ba'i 'dun pa byas 107—588

na legs pa 'dra snyam du dgongs nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas gsol ba btab pas/ rje rin po che sngar gyi ji lta ba bzhin du sprin dkar po zhig gi steng du byon nas/ bu da ni myur du 'ong ba'i grab gyis/ ngas bsu mkhan gtong gsungs / de'i tshe rje rin po che khyed da lta gang du bzhugs/ bdag kyang der 'ong lags zhus pas/ spyir nga'i sprul pa dga' ldan/ mkha' spyod/ 'dzam bu'i gling sogs su mang / da lta rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa stong phrag brgyad brgya re tsam la snga dro dbu ma dang / lam rim/ phyi dro bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs 'chad kyin yod/ khyod rang yang der 'ong ba'i 'dun pa thongs/ ring por mi thogs par 'phrad pa yin gsungs/'o na gdul bya gzhan gyis gsol ba btab na zhing der skye zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ngam zhus pas/ kho bo dang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dbyer med du gsol ba btab na rjes su 'dzin cing / zhing der skye yang de ltar byed mkhan med pas lan gsungs pas/ rje rin po che dang rje btsun gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu la ji ltar dgos zhus pas/ rgyu thun mong ma yin pa ni nges 'byung dang / byang chub kyi sems/ lta ba rnam par dag pa gsum rgyud la skyes shing bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dbyer med pa la rtse gcig tu mos pa cig dgos gsungs/gzhan ji ltar bsgrub dgos lags zhus pas/ nga dang rje btsun gyi sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dbyer med 'bral mi rung du gsol ba btab/ bstod pa dang / smon lam tshig tsam min par 'debs/ las 'bras la yid ches dang stobs bzhi'i bshags bsdam la 'bad par byas na rjes su 'dzin par the tshom med gsungs/ de'i tshe/ rje 107—589

btsun bla ma blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /mos gus snying nas yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /mgon khyod gang du bzhugs pa'i zhing khams der/ /bdag kyang myur du 'ong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes smon lam btab bo/ /de nas sku tshe dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas rje rin po che'i zhabs drung du byon par dgongs pa'i tshe myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po byon nas bstan pa'i bdag po khyed med na bstan pa sus 'dzin zhes dang / mgon po zhal byon nas rje dang mgon po klu sgrub la khyad med/ khyod med na klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i rje bla ma'i lta ba rnam dag sus 'dzin/ kha lta mkhan mang ste zhes zhal nam mkha' la gzigs so/ /de nas dam can chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa byon nas/ bdag cag rnams rje bla ma'i bka' sdod thun mong ma yin par gshin rje'i gshed kyis bka' bsgos pa yin / rje bla mas bdag cag rnams nyid bsu ba la btang ba yin zer ba dang /lha'i bu mang po gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa mchod rdzas mang po khyer nas bsu ba sogs zhing gzhan du 'byon ltas ngo mtshar ba mang du byung zhing ske/ dgung lo nga bzhir phebs pa sa pho rta'i lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig la dga' ldan khri thog tu gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te bu pha khyim du 'gro ba ltar dga' bzhin spro bzhin du dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du mi pham 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs drung du phebs so/ /de nas sku gdung zhugs la phul bas gdung ring bsrel mang du byon pa rnams dngul dkar las grub pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs te de'i nang du bzhugs nas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs so/ /mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyis phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du mdzad pa'i bstan bcos ni rje bdag 107—590

nyid chen po'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/ rnam 'grel ṭika chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho/ phar phyin rtogs dka'i snang ba/ stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs gzhung chen mo man ngag dang bcas pa'i legs bshad dri ma med pa bdud rtsi'i gter lta bu phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du 'jog par mdzad do/ /de ltar rgyal ba gnyis pa dang ske/ sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus tsam bkod nas/de las gzhan rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa/ byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa/ rje shes rab seng ge la sogs pa gsung las skyes pa'i mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byon pa dang / /de'i rjes su yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / grub pa'i brtul zhugs chen po bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa dngos dang sbas pa'i tshul sna tshogs pa gang gā'i rdul dang mnyam pa ji snyed cig byon te/ de dag gi rnam par thar pa lta ci/ mtshan gyi phreng ba tsam yang 'dir 'god pa'i yul las 'gongs shing —/ 'ga' zhig rang rang gi rnam thar dang chos 'byung sogs su gsal la/re zhig 'dir ni gangs can pa dag gi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po nyid ljongs 'dir rgyal blon/ paṇa grub/ sngags 'chang ske/ gter ston/ skye bo phal pa/ ku su lu/ tha na bya ri dwags tshun gyi rnam par rol pa ji snyed cig mchis pa las/ skabs su babs pa gsum ldan ngur smrig gi rol gar gyis gangs can pa rnams la chos dang srid kyi bka' drin rmad po ches rjes su skyong bar mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi phreng ba phyogs dang rtse 107—591

mo'i grangs ldan gyi bar zam mi chad du byon pa'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus tsam re 'god pa la zhugs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'gro 'dir blo bzang rgyal bstan srog 'dzin phyir/ /gsang ba'i bdag po nyid kyang mkhas grub ces / /ming dang don mtshungs mkhas shing grub brnyes dbang / /bsam bzhin gos sngon ngur smrig rnam par rol/ /bcu drug lang tsho 'chang ba'i gzhon nu'i lus / /tshul khrims gur gum 'od chags gsar pa'i 'dzum/ /mkhyen rab ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor g.yo ba 'di/ /'jam dpal nyid dam mkhas grub gzhon nu'i sku / /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal paṇa chen yang / /gzhon nu'i rigs tshul ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /ro 'dzin dum bur gyur pas 'jigs skrag nas / /rnam par rgyal ba la 'ur khyod la sbyin/ /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang dang gsang ba'i bdag /mi yi sha tshugs sbas pa'i zol bstan kyang / /gang la gang gis mdo rgyud kun gtad pa/ /'di yis zol de sgrib par ga la nus/ /mkhas mchog rong ston gnyis 'thung dbang po yang / /lung rigs sbar khyim rnon por skrag pa yis/ /byol zhing yib pa'i ngang tshul lhur mdzad na/ /smra ngan wa skyes klad bum cis mi bral/ /khyod ni ji tsam mkhas kun rtser gshegs pa/ /de bzhin grub pa mchog gi rtser gshegs te/ /dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor rtag 'byams shing / /ye shes spyan ldan dag kyang bran du 'khol/ /blo bzang chos dbyings gshegs kyang lan lnga'i bar/ /dngos su byon nas rjes su gdams pa 'di / /yab sras thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa yi/ /ngo mtshar gzugs su 'phos pa nyid las ci/ /legs bshad 'od stong 'gro 'di'i dpal du sbyin/ /rgol ngan mtshan spyod bag yod khung bur bskrad/ /blo bzang ring lugs pad+ma 107—592
