dkar po yis/ /dbyig 'dzin dog por gyur 'di khyod kyi drin/ /dge ldan ring lugs lugs bzang kun gyi phul/ /skye dgu'i gdung sel sel ba'i dpyid du 'phel /snyo /'di ni rgyal sras sras kyi thu bo 'di'i/ /bka' ngadrin gnyid de de bzhin bsam kyin dad/ /ceso bya sba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dibyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa'o// de la sku phreng dang po thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po ni / sa skya pa'i ru ba gur ma zhes bya ba'i yul gyi lhas ra zhig tu yab mgon po rdo rje dang / yum jo mo nam skyid ces bya ba gnyis la sras po bzhi dang / sras mo gcig ste lngar yod pa las/ sras gsum par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ /de'i nub mo 'brog par dgra jag byung ste mas khyer ma thub par sku gzhin nu de nyid rdo'i gseb tu sbas te bzhag /sang bltar 'ongs pas/bya rog chen po zhig gis khye'u 'khrungs ma thag pa de gcan gzan sogs kyi gnod pa las bsrungs te ma nongs par bzhugs pa mthong ste dga' zhing ngo mtshar du bzung nas khye'u de khyer te bros nas phyin/ de dus kyi bya rog ni mgon po zhal gyi rnam 'phrul du 'dug /de lta bu'i rgyal sras gzhon nu de nyid byis pa'i gnas skabs su'ang tha mal gyi spyod pa ring du dor te/ chos 'chad pa'i tshul sogs dam pa'i rang rtags mngon sum gsal/ jag pas bcom pas 'byor pa dbul bas yab yum gyi ra rdzi'ang mdzad/ yab 'das nas sgrib sbyong du sman mdo phyag bris kyis bzhengs/ dpal snar thang du byon mkhan chen grub pa shes rab nas dam pa'i skyes bur gzigs nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra pa las klog yig mthar phyin bslabs nas klog gi slob dpon du gyur/187—593

dgung lo bco lnga pa me bya lo la mkhan chen grub pa shes rab kyis mkhan slob dang /bshes gnyen blo ldan pas dus go ba mdzad de/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes / mtshan dge 'dun grub par gsol/ slob dpon sat+ta shrī las rig gnas dang / dbang rjes mang du gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags stag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nang sngar gyi mkhan slob dang bcas dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pas thugs rgyud gtams/ de nas tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi gzhung la sbyangs te grwa skor mdzad/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan gang che'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don byas/ da ni sngar nas yang yang yid la yod pa bzhin dam pa'i chos 'tshol ba dang / rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i drung du myur du 'gro bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas de lugs kyi grabs byas nas dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing mo lug lor dbus phyogs su byon te/ khra 'brug tu sems dpa' chen po kun bzang pa la tshad ma dang dbu ma sogs la thugs sbyong mdzad/ de nas rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po sa skyong mi'i dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bkra shis rdo khar spyan drangs pa'i drung du/ sems dpa' chen po kun bzang pa'i phyag phyi mdzad de byon nas/ der rje rin po che las tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dogs gcod/drang nges rnam 'byed/ rtsa she'i rnam bshad/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam bshad/rtsa ltung gi rnam bshad sogs chos mang po gsan cing / rje rin po che yang thugs shin tu dgyes par byung ste/ 'dul ba'i bslab khrims khyad par can spel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i phyir du mthang gos bzhes 'phro zhig gi gnang sbyin kyang mdzad / de nas rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gsung gis thang po che'i bla brang pa nyi ma 107—594

rgyal mtshan pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' zhig zhu ba la phyin pa legs zhes bskul te der byon/ rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa la gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa dang ske/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang / gshed dmar bcu gsum ma dang / gshed dmar lha lnga ma sogs kyi dbang rjes mang po gsan/de nas dpon slob rnams dge ldan du byon/ rje shes rab seng ge gsang phu la byon / dge ldan du rje rin po che'i drung nas man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/rje bla ma 'dis bdag gsang phur rje shes rab seng ge'i drung du phyin na bsam pa lags zhus pas/ ces kyang legs gsungs nas slob dpon rab mchog pa dang gnyis la spyi ru gser zho gang / rngul gzan legs po zhig gnang / gser khong pa la phul/ gzan de rje 'di pas bsnams te dgun chos la gsang phur phebs rigs 'bring man chad la ma brten par dang po nas tshad ma'i rigs chen mdzad / thugs gsal ba dang ston pa bzang ba'i snyan pa'i grags pa yang rgya cher byung ngo / /de nas rje 'di pas ston chos sogs la dge ldan du phebs/ rje rin po che las lam rim chen mo dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa/sngags dbang / sgrub dkyil gyi lung sogs sngags chos mang po gsan zhing / rje dar ma rin chen la tshad ma/ phar phyin/ byams chos phyi ma sogs kyi bshad pa mang du gsan pas rje dar ma rin chen 'di pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i phyogs la bka' drin che ba yin gsungs/ yang gsang phur phebs te rigs lung 'grim pa sogs kyi thugs sbyong mdzad/ ston dge ldan la phebs te rje rin po che dang rgyal tshab rje ste yab sras gnyis la mdo sngags kyi chos rgya cher gsan pa dang /'dul 'dzin chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa la drang nges rnam 'byed tshar gcig 107—595

dang / gzhan yang chos bka' mang du gsan/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis gsang phu dge ldan gnyis la lo gsum tsam zhig bzhugs/ de nas sa mo phag gi lo rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po stod lung chab tshan la byon te slar 'bras spungs su phebs pa'i tshe rje 'dis kyang der byon te lam rim gyi khrid/ na ro chos drug /dbu ma 'jug pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa mang du gsan/ de nas 'di ltar dgongs te/ spyir 'dul ba'i bslab khrims rnam par dag pa zhig byed pa la 'dul ba shes dgos par 'dug /khyad par gro sa 'di 'dul ba'i 'byung khungs lta bur 'dug pas der 'dul ba slob tu 'gro snyam du dgongs te de'i rgyu mtshan rje btsun tsong kha pa la zhus pas/ 'dul ba slob pa la nyams su len 'dod kyi bsam pas slob dgos pa yin/ de ltar yin na ngo mtshar che gsungs nas chos kyi mthun rkyen du gser zho gang gnang / de'i cha shas zhig la lha sa nas rtsam pa bsgrubs te sgo la brgyud gro sa la byon/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen pa dang /rgya mtsho rin chen pa gnyis la lo gnyis kyi bar du mdo rtsa ba dang / mngon pa mdzod legs par gsan/ khyad par rgya mtsho rin chen pa las lung sde bzhi'i lung yang gsan la/ dmar ston pa'i zhal nas/ nged kyi slob ma gtsang phyogs na khyed dang dka' bcu pa gzhon nu rgyal mchog gnyis las 'dul ba la mkhas pa med pas khyod kyis kyang bstan pa la phan pa'i 'chad nyan legs po mdzod ces gsungs / de nas slar yang gsang phu la phyag phebs/ sngar gyi thugs sbyong gi 'phro rnams legs par mdzad/ gling stod du mthong smon pa zhes pa'i grwa tshang zhig gi 'chad nyan pa rje shes rab seng shes mdzad kyin yod pa'i gdan sar rje 'di pa dang shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal ba gnyis bsko bzhag mdzad de lo 107—596

kha yar 'chad nyan kyang mdzad/ de nas me pho rta'i lor gtsang phyogs la phyag phebs te byang chen du grwa pa bdun cu tsam la 'chad nyan mdzad/ rigs lung yang shin tu 'phel bar byung / de nas grwa tshogs kyang je che la song ste snar thang /byang chen/ rta nag /ri khud rnams la rim gyis chos bar la byon te lo lnga drug gi ring la 'chad nyan 'phel bar byung / yang de dus rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub rje yab sras gnyis gnas rnying du phebs/ de'i drung du rje shes rab seng ge dang yab sras gnyis kyis kyang byon te rgyal tshab rje las spyir chos mang po dang /khyad par mngon pa kun las btus kyi ṭīk+ka de gsan/ rim gyis rje 'di pas phyag bris mdzad de gzhan la'ang gsungs/ mkhas grub rje la yang chos bka' mang du gsan no/ /de nas dbus gtsang stod smad khul gyi dgon pa mang du byon/gsan bzhes 'chad nyan dpag tu med pa gnang / de skabs pad+ma chos sding du paṇa chen 'jigs bral dang mjal/ zhag shas der bzhugs chos mang du gsan/paṇa chen gyis dri ba mang po mdzad par lan thogs pa med par phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes nas/ da phyin chad thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub gyis zhes mnga' gsol mdzad/ de yang shangs mdo dge 'phel du phebs nas zla ba gcig tsam sku mtshams la bzhugs pas nub gcig mnal lam na/ da lta bkra shis lhun po'i rgyab ri 'di'i rnam pa can gyi ri rtse la rje tsong kha pa bzhugs/ skyed pa tsam na rje blo gros sbas pa bzhugs/ de'i smad tsam na rje rang nyid bzhugs 'dug par / blo gros sbas pas/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos rang re la lung bstan mang po mdzad kyin 'dug zer ba la/ rje 'di pas legs par gsan pas/ gsung gi sgra dbyangs mang po sgrog pa phal cher ma go/ /gsung gi cha shas zhig la dge 'dun 107—597

grub ces bos nas/ khyod la brten nas sa phyogs 'dir tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas par 'gyur ba zhig 'ong ba yin zhes gsungs pa gsal bar byung bas sku lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba zhig byung gsungs/ yang bo dong du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tho rangs bud med kyi skad lhang ba zhig byung ba gsan pas/ de na khyod kyi dgon pa yod/ /gdul bya dag cing dgon pa yod/ /sogs gsungs par / dgon pa ji lta bu 'ongs/ ming la ji skad zer byas pas/ lag pa gnyis kyis thal mo khong stong sbyar te dgon pa 'di lta bu 'ong / ming la mu khyud can zer/ de mkha' 'gro'i brda skad yin no zer nas yal song ba zhig byung /de 'dra ba'i lung bstan gzhan yang kha shas byung / de ltar rje tsong kha pa chen pos lung bstan pa dang / phyis bo dong du lha mos lung bstan cing / khyad par rje shes rab seng ges kyang bsam 'grub rtse nas snar thang la byon res kyis bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa'i sa 'dir phyag mdzub gtad de sa phyogs 'di na dge 'dun grub mgo skya ye yer chos 'chad kyin 'dug pa cig sems snang la dus rgyun du 'ong gsung ba zhig yang yang yod pa la brten/ sa phyogs de dag dgon pa'i gnas su bzang bar gzigs te dgon pa 'debs par thugs thag bcad la/ spyir snga mo nas bla ma lha dang bcas pa'i lung bstan de ltar yod cing rje rang la nges nges yod na'ang sbas pa'i tshul du de ltar mdzad do/ /de nas me mo yos lo'i dbyar sos nas brtsams te bsam 'grub rtse'i brag dmar bla brang du rten bzhengs kyi mgo btsugs te lugs btang bas/ thad la ma byung ba la/ myang stod pa'i dka' bcu pa zhig rmi lam brtag tu bcug pas/ khong gi rmi lam du cha lugs mdzes pa'i bud med gsum mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud cing 'di skad do/ /skyes bu 187—598

dam pa'i thugs kyi mun pa gting nas bsal/ /zhes sogs lung bstan/ de ma thag thub pa chen po la bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa mdzad de lugs phud la rje btsun ma'i sku bzhengs shing / de nas ston pa'i sku rgyab mtho nyer lnga pa gcig gi lugs btang bas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar zhing ngo mtshar bar byon nas rten de'i thugs kur rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos thog drangs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi ring bsrel mang pos gtams pa'i dngul gyi rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa'i sku/ rje btsun shes rab seng ge'i dbu thod rin po che sna tshogs pas bkang ba dang bcas bzhugs shing / sku'i stod smad kyi char gzungs sngags byin rlabs can mang po dang / smad kyi cha la 'dul ba'i gsung rab kyi glegs bam mang po/ rje tsong kha pa'i mthang gos dang bcas pa rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrig pa'i phyir du gzhug /de nas bsam 'grub rtser gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun mang po bsags nas rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas 'di phyogs la bzhugs pa lung bstan byung / de nas dgon pa'i 'gram bting bar bzhed de dngos kyi sbyin bdag dar rgyas pa dpon bsod nams dpal bzang bas mdzad nas/ rab byung zhes pa me mo yos kyi lo'i smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po la rje rang nyid sbyin bdag dang bcas pa 'dir phebs/sa brtag pa dang / gzhi bdag la gtor ma sbyin pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad de/ sa'i cha 'dir gtsug lag khang dang / 'dir bla brang / 'di rnams su brang khang so so rnams gyis gsungs te/ gtsug lag khang dri gtsang khang dbus ma dang bcas 'gram bting ste bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi bde chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab bo/ /de yang gtsang khang chen mo la ka ba drug 107—599

gi sa dang / 'du khang ka ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ byams khang ka ba bcu gnyis/sgrol ma lha khang ka ba drug /mgon khang ka ba gnyis kyi sa rnams phyis bzhengs pa yin no/ /yang de'i dus su rje bla ma 'di gtsug lag khang 'di'i khyams su gur dkar po zhig gi nang du bzhugs pa'i tho rengs shig sngar gyi bud med de'i skad bar snang la lhang ba zhig byung ba gsan pas/ dgon pa'i ming la bkra shis lhun po gyis/ sngar gyi mkha' 'gro'i brda skad des khrol lo ang gsung ba cig byung bas bkra shis lhun po zhes lha mo 'dis btags pa yin/ dpal gyi bde chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes pa rje rang gis byas pa yin gsungs so/ /yang de dus dgon pa'i mdun gyi ne'u thang der rab byung zhig bsgrubs/ de gnas der rab byung byed pa'i thog ma yin pas ming tshogs pa rgya mtsho 'phel du btags / rab byung bsgrub pa'i dus rje'i zhal dgon pa phyogs la bstan te gzigs pas sngar ri bo dge 'phel du rmi lam la rje btsun tsong kha pas lung bstan pa'i gnas de 'di yin par gor ma chag par 'dug snyam du thugs nges dang /khyad par glegs bam rin po che las kyang dgon pa 'di nyid kyi lung bstan mang du gsungs shing ches gsal bar/ glang chen bzhengs dang bzhugs 'dra ba/mthar thug bsam don lhun grub shog /ces sogs bkra shis lhun po'i rgyab ri dang ske/ gnas kyi dbyibs dang / des bsam gtan 'grub lugs dang /rten khyad par can 'byon lugs la sogs pa rnams lung bstan to/ /de nas lcags pho rta'i lo'i dgun chos grol mtshams shig tu rje bla ma 'di ri bo dge ldan gyi mkhan po la gdan 'dren pa la bla ma dka' bcu pa sbyin pa dpal ba dang dge bskos dpal ldan rin chen pa gnyis kyis thog drangs dpon slob thogs shig gis 107—600

slebs nas dga' ldan gyi gdan sa la 'byon dgos pa'i zhu ba phul bas rje 'di pas bdag dge ldan gyi gdan sa byed du mi 'gro/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang dgon pa 'di btab ma thag tu song bas rgyun brtan pa zhig ma byung dogs shing / khyad par sngar byas pa thams cad kyang bstan pa spyi sgos 'ba' zhig la bsams da dung yang rje btsun cong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig la bsam ste 'di gar sdod pa yin/ da lam mkhas grub rin po che'i gcung po chos rje ba so ba 'di lung rtogs kyi yon tan gang sa nas rje'i gdan sar 'os pa yod pas 'di dge ldan gyi khri la gdan 'dren par mdzod gsungs nas rje nyid mi 'byon par thag bcad/de nas rta nag ri khud dang / lha rgyal rtse sogs su chos bar mdzad cing skal ba dang ldan pa mtha' yas par chos ston par mdzad do/ /de dag gi bar skabs shig rje 'di nyid byang chen du sku mtshams la bzhugs nas rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan pa'i snying po mthar thug pa rnams la nyams bzhes mdzad pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams dang sngags kyi zab lam rim gnyis kyi gnad rnams la myong ba phul phyin 'khrungs shing / shar gyi ri bo'i rtser sprin dkar po zhig gzigs pa'i rkyen byas rje yab sras kyi bka' drin dran pas mos gus shugs drag 'khrungs te/ shar gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo na/ /zhes sogs kyi nyams mgur mdzad/ de nas rje btsun byams mgon gyi sku brnyan sogs rten dang brten pa phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs te mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams don dang ldan par mdzad do/ /de ltar chos grwa bkra shis lhun po btab nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa dri ma med pa bsre bslad thams cad dang bral ba mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshad pa dang sgrub pa gnyis ka tshang ba rkang 107—601

tshugs par mdzad de 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyogs mtha' dag nas 'dus pa'i mkhas grub bgrang ba las 'das pa rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad kyis tshim par mdzad de sa chen po'i khyon thams cad rnam thar gtsang mas khyab par mdzad nas sku tshe 'di'i dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhir phebs pa shing pho rta'i lo rgyal zla'i yar tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung /phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad de/ stong pa gsum rim gyis thim nas thams cad stong pa 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du mdzad de/ de yang sngar bsnyun pa sogs kyis sku mdangs cung zhig chung bar yod na'ang / de'i tshe sku lus glo bur du zla ba ltar rgyas par gyur te/ sngar gyi sku'i gnyer ma rnams kyang med pa blta bar mi bzod pa'i 'od kyi phung po dang ldan zhing / de la kha cig ni sku'i 'od dmar ser/ kha cig ni dkar ser/ kha cig ni gser btso ma lta bur snang ngo / /zhes zer ro/ /de bas na rje 'di ni de'i tshe 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon sum du mdzad de/ 'chi ba chos skur bsgyur ba'i sgo nas bar do sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs te/ de la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub mngon du mdzad pa yin par gdon mi za ba yin no/ /gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob dang / gsung rtsom sogs mtha' yas te zhib par rnam thar chen mo rnams su gsal ba ltar ro/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ zla ba'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i khor yug dang / /rgyal bstan ga bur 'dzum pa'i zer phreng gi /bsil ba cig car thob pas bsil ljongs zhes/ /ming dang don du snyan pa'i zhing 'di nyid/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i brtse chen zhags pa yis bcings pa'i skal mnyam mkha' khyab mtshungs par spyod/ /de lta na yang gru 'dzin bdag po 107—602

yis / /bskyangs pa'i skal bzang lhag par ljongs 'dir 'dzin/ /rgyal blon paṇa grub phal pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /bkod pa rab 'byams sprin gyis ma tshim par / /phyogs dang rtse mo'i grangs su ngur smrig gar/ /zam mi chad du byon 'di lhag par bsngags/ /thub bstan snying po pad+ma dkar po dang / /lnga bdo'i byin za gzhil ba'i thugs rje'i chab/ /gang gi phyag char 'dzin pa 'di yis ni/ /dge la 'dun pa lo ke shwa rar grub/ /'khrungs tsam nyid nas dpal mgon godong ba'i pa/ /bya rog zol 4gyis gang sku srung byed cing / /lang tsho'i zla tshes shin tu phra mor yang / /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'od dkar dra ba 'dzin/ /blo bzang rgyal bas sras kyi thu bor gzung / /mdo rgyud zab don rgya mtsho rjes su gdams / /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas kyang / /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces mtshan du bsngags/ /mkha' 'gro'i brda dang bla ma lhar bcas kyi / /lung bstan me tog gang du 'phangs pa'i gzhir/ /bkra shis dge mtshan mtha' dag lhun po bzhin/ /spungs pa'i chos grwa thugs bskyod btsan pos bskrun / /regaso pa'i gsang gsum 'od gsal klong bsdus nas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i gar/ /zung 'jug gdod ma'i rgyal sar ngal bso ba'i / /ngo mtshar bsam bzhin dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ /gzhung brgya smra mkhas mkhas kun gtsug na rol/ /rig sngags kun grub grub pa'i sa la gshegs/byu /gdung skyes bstan 'dzin 'dzin ma'i khyon kun brkong /ོ /bstan 'gro'i gnyen gcig gcig chog khyode kyis khyings/ /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcod pa'o//sku phreng gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i 187—603

yul ni/ rta nag yol dkar rdo rje gdan du yab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang /yum kun dga' dpal mo gnyis kyi sras su shing mo lug gi rgyal zla'i tshes gsum nyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mtshan ltas du ma dang bcas te bltams so/ /bltams ma thag nas tā re'i sngags rgyun du gsung ba dang / dgung lo gnyis gsum nas rje tsong kha pa chen po dang / dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod pa sogs rtsom pa mang po thogs med gnang / sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung mang du gnang bas kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ de nas paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang por gsol / de nas gnas rnying zhabs drung kun dga' bde legs kyis mkhan po dang / paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyis slob dpon/ dbu mdzad sangs rgyas tshul khrims pas dus go ba mdzad de gnas brtan sde snod 'dzin pa bcu phrag gsum gyi dbus su dge tshul gyi brtul zhugs yang dag par bzhes / paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo sogs yongs 'dzin du bsten nas tshang ma rnam 'grel la sbyangs shing / gzhung chen mo gzhan rnams la'ang sbyangs te lung rigs seng ge'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pas dge 'dun mtha' dag dad pa'i sa la bkod/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo las dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan no/ /de nas 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi gdan sa pa 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor gyis dbus phyogs su 'byon dgos par bskul zhing / dga' ldan khri rin po che 'jam dbyangs smon lam dpal bas kyang dbus phyogs su byon na bstan par phan che bar lung bstan pa 107—604

sogs rkyen sna tshogs pas bskul te zhabs 'bring ba 'jam dpal grags pa dang bcas dbus phyogs su phebs pa na 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor gyi mnal lam du nub phyogs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig shar byung ba'i 'od kyis gangs can gyi ljongs kun gsal bar byas pa zhig byung snang / sang de sku 'khor rnams la skyes bu dam pa zhig 'byon pa'i ltas su 'dug ces lung bstan yang mdzad/de nas rim gyis phebs te dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa'i sras po legs pa chos 'byor de nyid kyis skal ba dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa'i tshogs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos zab mo rgyun mi 'chad du 'doms par mdzad pa de gzigs par gyur to/ /de nas lo gsum du rtsa 'jug gi bshad pa mdzub khrid dang bcas pa zhig thog mar gsan/ de nas phar tshad/'dul mdzad sogs nang rig pa'i skor dang / dbang khrid/ mdo sngags kyi zab bshad mtha' yas pa gsan/ lha sa/ dga' ldan sogs su gzigs snang yang mang du byung / mchod 'bul dang thugs smon kyang rgya cher mdzad do/ /de ltar gzhung lugs la thos bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad nas rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas dang / 'o de gung rgyal gyi dben gnas sogs rje rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas de dag blta zhing / thos pa'i don rnams nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du dgongs te bstan pa dang sems can thugs kyis ma bzod pa'i sgo nas thugs la skyo shas drag po 'khrungs/ nyams mgur yang mdzad do/ /rje de nyid dgung lo nyer gcig bzhes pa yos lor gnas rnying mkhan po dbus phebs skabs rje de nyid kyis mkhan po/ rje legs pa chos 'byor gyis las slob/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang pos gsang ston/ rigs 187—605

smra sangs rgyas pas dus go mdzad de dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge slong gi dngos po legs par bzhes te tshangs par spyod pa'i mchog dang ldan par gyur/ paṇa chen mchog lha 'od zer sogs dad ldan gyi slob ma mang du 'dus / dbus gtsang lho dwags sogs gnas chen du mar zhabs kyis bcags/mdo sngags kyi chos bka' dang / sngon gnas rjes dran gyi bka' lung yang stsal/'o de gung rgyal gyi zhol du grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje nor bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du phebs te/ mdo sngags kyi lam gyi gnad ma lus pa gsan nas gdams pa'i gter du gyur/ rwa sgreng du phebs te bden tshig gis shugs skam las kyang lo ma skyes/ tsa rir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ de nas bka' gdams glegs bam las lung bstan pa ltar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gnas sbas pa'i yul dkar mo ljongs dang dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i bla mtsho mjal bar phebs/de lta bu'i gnas ngo mtshar can la zhabs bcags/ yar ngo'i gso sbyong zhig dang 'grig nas gso sbyong yang der mdzad/ yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la chos gsungs shing dam la bzhag go/ /de nas sa mo sbrul gyi lo lag gi bla bsko ba dang /lto 'phye'i thig 'debs pa dang / rdo ba bteg pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang gcod pa sogs sngags mtshan nyid kyi phyag len rnam par dag pa la brten pa'i sa yi lte ba de nyid du gtsug lag khang dngos gzhi la ka chen brgyad cu gya gnyis kyi 'gram bting ste/ thog mar dge 'dun dar zhes pa gcig gis 'gram brus pa'i 'og nas rdo'i dung g.yas 'khyil rang byung zhig dang / rdo pad 'dab can bzhi thon byung bas de'i tshe me tog gi char babs so/ /de nas rgyal legs 187—606

bshad sgrog pa'i dga' tshal bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas chen rten dang brten par bcas pa bstan pa'i snang byed du bzhengs nas mtha' 'khob kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod do/ /de nas bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos gtso mdzad mkhan slob dge 'dun tshang mas bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar 'byon dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa ltar gtsang phyogs su phebs nas gza' skar 'grub sbyor bzang po la seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'dzegs te paṇa chen rin po ches gtso mdzad dge 'dun tshogs pas bkra shis kyi me tog gtor / paṇa chen rin po ches bla brang ser por kun spangs mdzad/ rje nyid bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por gzhi phab ste bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad/slar yang dbus phyogs su phebs te lo re bzhin dgun dpyid gnyis 'bras spungs su bzhugs/ dbyar ston gnyis rgyal du bzhugs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan spel bar mdzad do/ /de ltar dgung lo re drug gi bar la bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i legs bshad bka' rtsom gsung par du bzhugs pa ltar ro/ /sku tshe 'di'i dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na dgung lo re bdun du phebs pa chu stag lo nag zla'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rengs su sku'i bkod pa bsdus te dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams su sprul pa'i bkod pa bye ba phrag brgyar sprul te rgyal ba rnams mchod pa dang sems can rnams kyi don mdzad cing bzhugs so/ /rje 'di'i brgyud 'dzin mtha' yas shing gtso bo ni khri bde ba can pa sogs zhib pa rnam thar rgyas pa las shes par bya'o//187—607

sku phreng gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ dbu ru skyid shod kyi sa dge bcu tshang ba stod lung mda' khang gsar gong zhes bya bar rma mchog rin chen grags kyi rigs rgyud las gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yab sde pa rnam rgya grags pa dang / yum dpal 'dzoms bu khrid gnyis kyi sras su chu mo yos kyi dpyid ra'i nyer lnga la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ bltams tsam nyid nas ma ṇi zhal 'don du mdzad/tha mal gyi spyod pa las 'das te skabs rer chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang / skabs rer ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshul mdzad/ dgung lo gsum tsam nas rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dus kyi sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung mang du byon pas phyogs thams cad du dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sprul skur grags/ me rta nag pa zla ba'i tshes la dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sde chen por gdan drangs te gser gyi khri 'phangs mthon por mnga' gsol/ slob dpon bsod nams grags pa'i drung nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan bsod nams rgya mtsho bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang por gsol/ mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ sa mo bya lo'i sa zlar paṇa chen bsod grags kyis mkhan po/ gsang phu ba legs pa don grub kyis las slob/ shar rtse ba legs don gyis dus go ba mdzad de dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ paṇa chen bsod grags / chos rje legs don pa/ shar rtse legs don pa/ rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis rnams las dbang lung man ngag sogs mang du gsan/ chu pho byi ba'i lo paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa zur bzhugs mdzad de dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po'i 'jigs med seṅge'i khril zhabs sen bkod de lugs 107—608

gnyis kyis bskyang bar mdzad/ chu mo glang gi lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs/ skyes rabs kyi zab bshad stsal/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang / sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis gnyis kyi drung nas gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ phreng kṛ sogs dbang dang rjes gnang lung khrid mang du gsan / kun bzang rtse ba'i drung nas rnying lugs drag sngags 'ga' shas gsan/bar bar du thugs gnyer gsan sbyong dang / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa sogs bstan 'gro bde thabs kyi rim gro mdzad/ tshar chen blo gsal gyi drung nas kyang chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ de nas rwa sgreng du phebs pa na jo bo phying dkar bas dngos su gzugs bstan te bsu ba byas shing / 'dus tshogs la bka' gdams glegs bam dang / snying po don gsum sogs chos mang du gnang /de nas 'bras spungs su phebs pa na ba so chos rgyan gyi dngos slob 'ja' lus grub pa rdo rje mched gsum gyi nang tshan grub chen dpal ldan rdo rje dngos su byon pa las 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi man ngag mang du gsan/ shing pho byi ba'i lo sa zla'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin dga' ldan khri zur dge legs dpal bzang pos mkhan pol/ khri pa dge 'dun sangs rgyas kyis las slob/ shangs pa chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis gsang ston/ lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang gis dus go mdzad de/ dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ chos rje bde ba can pa nas 'dul ba'i bslab bya dang / lam rim chen mo sogs kyi chos bka' gsan / dad ldan rnams la rab byung / bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun/ dbang rjes / lung khrid sogs mtha' yas pa stsal/ bar du bstan 'gro'i bde thabs 107—609

su mngon spyod kyang mang du mdzad/ bkra shis lhun po'i gtsos gtsang phyogs kyi dgon gnas che phra dang / chos 'khor rgyal gyis mtshon lho dwags khul gyi gnas dgon rnams la zhabs bcags te bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i thugs smon dang 'brel bar chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i thabs tshul dpag med mdzad/ ra sa 'phrul snang du'ang cho 'phrul smon lam gyis mtshon bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad/ al than rgyal pos gdan 'dren nan zhus ltar 'bras spungs nas rim gyis lha sa/ tshal/ dga' ldan brgyud/ ra sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su phebs/ dga' ldan khri gdan zur sogs bla grwa/ /sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan sogs dpon 'bangs rnams phyir slog gis gsung gleng gnang skyes bcas stsal/ byang lam brgyud mtsho sngon du phebs/ lam bar nag phyogs mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis btul bas/ de rnams kyis bsu ba sogs gus 'dud zhus/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs 'dod chos kyis kun la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ gong ma chen pos gser yig tham ka sogs stsal/ bod yul nas sa skyong sogs kyis yar phebs rgyu'i zhu yig byung ba dang / mdo khams li thang phyogs su sgar btegs/ lcags 'brug lo dgon chen phyag btab/ thub chen sogs rten dang bcas pa bzhengs nas rab gnas mdzad/ de nas yar chab mdor phebs/ de phyogs skye dgu rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ khams klong thang brgyud rje tsong kha pa chen po'i 'khrungs yul sku 'bum du phebs/ rab byung / bsnyen rdzogs/ dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa stsal/ de nas rim gyis ri bo dan tig tu phebs/ sku mtshams mdzad skabs bde mchog sogs lha tshogs mang du gzigs/ brag ngos nas tshe chu 107—610

bzhes pa sogs rten 'brel du ma 'grigs/ 'ur du su dpon sdig la rngam pa thar pa'i lam du bkod/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ de nas rma chu'i 'gram du phebs / rdzu 'phrul gyis rma chu'i dar lam la gshegs/ a rig dkar po thang du bzhugs sgar btegs/ phyogs de'i skye 'gro'i re ba yongs su skong / na kha ba grub chen thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs pa dang mjal 'phrad gnang /grub chen la rgyal nas nam phebs gsungs par/ da nang nyi ma shar nas phebs pa yin gsungs pa ngo mtshar che gsungs/ sku snyun tshul cung zhig mdzad/ al than rgyal po'i phebs bsu rta pa stong phrag mang po dang bcas rgyal po'i pho brang du phebasal/ skye bo phal cher dge ba la bkod/ yul der phyugs kyi mchod sbyin byed pa dang / gshin po'i rjes su gshin po'i dge rtsar rlom nas srog chags mang po gsod pa sogs bon dang mu stegs kyi srol lugs ngan pa rnams rgyun bcad/dam pa'i chos nyin mo ltar gsal zhing / skye rgu thams cad dge ba la 'god par mdzad pas khrag mtsho 'o mar bsgyur ba 'di bka' drin che zhes gleng / de nas yar phebs te li thang dang / sku 'bum sogs su dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/khyad par sku 'bum du rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i sku'i lte ba'i mtshal khrag las 'khrungs pa'i tsan+dan gyi sdong po de nyid phyi nas dngul gyis gtums te mchod rten du byas/ de nas slar yang khar chin gyi rgyal pos nan gyis gsol ba btab pa ltar hor rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ yul de'i skye rgya rnams la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam yangs por mdzad/ de nas gong ma'i pho brang du phebs dgos pa'i gdan 'dren la rten 'brel zhal bzhes gnang / nag pa zla bar snyun babs lci tshul bstan nas zhal chems phyag bris su bstar/ nag zla'i tshes nyer drug gi 107—611

tho rangs gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te 'jam dpal snying po'i drung du gshegs so / /sku phreng bzhi pa thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ gnas chung sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po dang tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can gyis sog yul du 'khrungs par lung bstan pa ltar/ se chen chos phur 'a phen sbu la'i sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'khrungs/ dam chos pad dkar gyi glegs bam gzigs pa na 'di nga'i rnam thar ro zhes sogs gsungs pa ni sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung nyid do/ /sku gzhon nu'i dus su'ang byis pa'i ngang tshul ring du dor te dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar snang zhing gzigs snang kyang mang du byung /skabs shig 'dod khams dbang mo zhal gzigs nas mkhar sngon por myur du byon dgos gsungs pa ltar/ mkhar sngon phyogs su phebs/ ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur kyang 'ga' shas gsungs/ phyag mdzod dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ mi dbang sne'u gdong pa dang / se 'bras dga' gsum sogs kyis gtsos gangs can gyi che rgu mtha' dag gdan 'dren la 'byor/ khri zur rgyal khang rtse ba dpal 'byor rgya mtsho nas thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bcu bzhi par byang phyogs skye rgya'i re ba yongs su bskangs nas dbus su chibs zhal bsgyur / rwa sgreng du gser khrir 'khod nas gsang chos glegs bam gsungs/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang du ma byung / de nas rim gyis dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbreng dang bcas dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sde chen po'i dga' ldan pho brang gi gser gyi khri 'phangs mthon por mnga' gsol/ dga' ldan khri zur sangs rgyas rin po che dang / khri dge 'dun rgyal mtshan sogs las rab byung dang / dge 107—612

tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ bkras lhun nam bzang las dbang rjes bshad khrid lung sogs gsan bsam rgya cher gnang / de nas lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi gnas gzigs thugs smon mdzad/ de nas 'ol dga' dang / chos 'khor rgyal sogs la gnas gzigs dang / bka' chos/ mang 'gyed sogs lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas dga' ston spel/ slar lha sar phebs/ se ra dang 'bras spungs su chos 'khor bskor/ de nas yar klungs dang / e phyogs kyi dgon sde/ sde dpon rnams la so so'i re 'dod skong bar mdzad/ slar yang 'bras spungs su sku mtshams bcad de thugs dam la brtson/ de nas gtsang phyogs nas gsol ba btab pa ltar bzhugs sgar btegs te/ lam bar dgon sde rnams kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog bcas rim gyis bkra shis lhun por phyag btegs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpon slob rnams kyis chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun rnams nas ser sbreng bcas zhabs sor 'khod/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher dngos 'bul gya rnam bcas dbang lung chos bka' mang du gsan/ de phyogs kyi dgon sde rnams su zhabs bcag ste thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ de nas 'bras spungs su phebs te thugs dam la brtson/ bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su mngon spyod mang du mdzad dgos shar/ dgung lo nyer drug pa shing stag lor paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang / sprul sku bsod nams dge legs kyis las slob/ gzhan yang gsang ston/ dus go ba bcas dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te ngur smrig 'chang ba rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur to/ /de nas bod bde gzar la brten bzlog rim mang du mdzad/ gong ma 'un shu wang gis mi sna mngags te 187—613

las ka dang / tham ka phul/ rgya nag tu phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul/rten 'brel gyi sgo nas zhal bzhes gnang / bla ma blo gros kyis rgya yul du bzhengs pa'i lha khang la rab gnas zhus par dga' ldan pho brang gi rtse nas de phyogs su zhal gzigs te phyag nas gnang bas de'i phyi nang kun tu phyag nas kyis khyab pa byung / de nas dgongs pa gzhan du gtad pa'i brdar gsang yib chab tshan bzhes tshe rdo la zhabs rjes gnang ba dang / bka' rus pa can mang du stsal/de nas sku dngos kyi gdul bya'i mdzad pa rdzogs nas phyis kyi zhal chems mdzad de/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus te dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/'phags mchog gangs ri'i mgon nyid gangs ri'i khrod/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho zhes byar zlos pa'i gar/ /bltams ma thag nas tā re'i sngags gosung stobazhino/ sgo /'phags mar 'gro kun sgrol ba'i grogs su sbran/ /na tshod ches phra mig dang rtse mor yang / /'jam mgon zhal gzigs dmag zor bran du 'khol/ /'chad rtsom klong rdol sngon gnas rjes su dran/ /khyad par 'di yis 'phags par dngos su grub/ /'on te bshes gnyen du mar bsten pa'i tshul/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i rtsal la sbyangs pa'i tshul/ /bslab gsum brtul zhugs legs par bsdoms pa'i tshul/ /'di dag thub bstan kho na'i ched du brtson/ /mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba'i dkar mo ljongs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par rgyal ba bskrun/ /'khor lo gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom rgesum rmos/ /rgyal bostan dbyar gyi chu gter rjes su bcings/ /phyag na pad+mo'i sgyu 'phrul bsil sbyin dbang / /bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho srub pa'i dpyid/ /gangs can skal bzang bde 'byung zer /87—614sto sgo

phud na/ /phan bde'i 'od chags spro ba'i dpal du thob/ /'khrungs tsam nyid nas ma ṇi gsung bzhin pa/ /nga yi snying po 'di zhes rjes su bstan/ /chos 'chad ting 'dzin phyag rgya rtag mdzad pa/ /bshad dang sgrub la goms pa'i rang rtags nyid/ /gzhon nu nyid nas gong ma'i ngang tshul kun/ /gsal bar gsungs pas ngo mtshar yid ches rnyed/ /'ja' lus grub pa'i dpa' bo dngos byon nas/ /'jam mgon snyan brgyud lhug par rjes su gdams/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i rang bzhin 'grog pa med/ /mngon par shes dang rdzu 'phrul ngang gis gsal / /'khor lo gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis/ /mtha' dbus bstan 'gro phan bde'i dpal la bkod/ /ches phra'i gzhon nus dam chos pad+ma dkar / /'di ni nga yi rnam par thar pa zhes/ /phyag na pad+mor dngos su zhal 'ches te/ /'phags pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho ngoms 'di mtshar/ /dus gsum gzigs shing dmag zor bran pru 'khol4/ sne /lhag gnas me tog rgya yul dngos su babs / /de sogs rdzu 'phrul bkod pa mtha' yas kyang / /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom la slob tshul mdzad/ /na tshod ches phra phra zhib lung rigs mkhas/ /grub pa'i go 'phang 'phang mthor mngon par spyodang/ gye /snod bcud mtha' dag dag pa'i 'khor lore 'byarmos/ /'di dag 'phags mchog mchog gi sprul skur nges/sgo /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/byu/ sgosku phreng lnga pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ 'phyong rgyas 'phying bar stag rtser yab hor bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum khri lcam kun dga' lha mdzes kyi sras su rab byung bcu pa'i me mo sbrul la ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa'i ltas dang bcas sku bltams/107—615

byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas dman pa'i spyod pa ring du dor te/ chos ston pa'i tshul sogs dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar bstan/ jo bo rje dang / rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po sogs lhag lha du ma'i zhal gzigs/ bka' gdams glegs bam dang / gzhan yang lha bla'i lung brtag du ma mthun par rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin/ de skabs dus gzir che bas paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal pos thabs mkhas kyis dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sde chen por dgung lo drug pa chu khyi hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga la gangs can 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel/ se 'bras kyi bla ma slob dpon rnams dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po khog tu brlams pa sogs kyis phebs bsu ser sbreng bsam gyis mi khyab pa/skye bo khri phrag brgal ba'i khrom bcas dga' ldan pho brang du phebs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po dang / khri rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis slob dpon mdzad de dge tshul bzhes nas mtshan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes gsol/ de nas paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la thog mar dge tshul gyi bslab bya dang / chos spyod rnams kyi lung / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang sogs dbang dang rjes gnang mang po dang / lam rim che chung sogs lung mtha' yas pa gsan/ khri dkon mchog chos 'phel la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung sogs chos mang du gsan te rgyun gyi yongs 'dzin du bsten/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyang yongs 'dzin du bsten nas chos mang du gsan/ gzhan yang 707—616

yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan cing /rig pa'i gnas lnga la'ang sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis su phebs pa sa pho stag gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te thub pa'i dbang po slar yang gangs ri'i khrod du byon pa lta bur gyur to/ /de nas dgung lo nyer lnga pa lcags mo sbrul gyi lo gau shrī bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos gtsang sde srid bcom nas/ bod khri skor bcu gsum dbang du bsdus te kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po 'di'i phyag tu phul/ pho brang chen po po tā la brtsigs te bzhugs yul mdzad/ bod kyi lha gcig 'phags pa thugs rje chen po lo ke shwa ra'i sku rang byung yang phebs nas pho brang du bzhugs/zur dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/khri dkon mchog chos 'phel sogs yongs 'dzin du ma rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te mdo sngags kyi dbang lung man ngag khrid sogs gsar rnying gi chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ gau shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis gdan drangs nas gtsang phyogs su phebs te chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i dge 'dun rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal zhing / mchod yon gnyis gas paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gus 'dud dang bsnyen bkur rgya chen po mdzad/ser skya bgrang ba las 'das par zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bstan cing chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal nas mthong thos dran reg thams cad rjes su 'dzin par mdzad/ dgung lo so drug tu phebs pa chu pho 'brug gi lo shar phyogs rgya nag pho brang du phebs te rgya dang hor sogs kyi skye bo bgrang ba las 'das pa'i don mdzad/ slar bod du 107—617

phebs nas mtha' dbus skye 'gro bgrang ba las 'das pa la rang rang gi dbang po dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing lhag par rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bgrang ba las 'das pa stsal/ chos 'khor yang rtse sogs chos grwa chen po mang por 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa'i rgyun gsar 'dzugs mdzad / sngags grwa'i dge 'dun gyi sde yang mang du btsugs te kun mkhyen lnga pa chen pos gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i gling chen bcu gsum zhes yongs su grags pa ltar dang / gzhan yang sngar yod pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la chos gzhi gnang ste gong 'phel du mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sde gang na yod pa thams cad la bca' khrims dam por mdzad/ gangs ri'i ljongs kyi sa'i cha thams cad la sku gsung thugs rten mang du spel/ rgyal bstan yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su re mos kyis bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog rgyun mi chad du mdzad/jo bo shākya mu ni la rin po che las grub pa'i dbu rgyan gsar du sgron/ bod 'bangs bde thabs su mchos dman bar ma thams cad kyis yi ge drug pa bzla ba dang / dge 'dun sde rnams su sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi thugs dam bskul ba'i cho ga dang / gnas brtan chen po bcu drug mchod pa'i cho ga rgyun mi chad pa'i gzhi btsugs shing bka' 'doms che bar mdzad/ rgyal bstan yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad kyi snying po'i don phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i man ngag byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid yig 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhal lung sogs gsung rtsom rmad du byung ba bka' 'bum bzhugs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar gangs ri'i mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kun gzigs lnga pa chen po 'di nyid kyis rang cag kha ba ri pa'i skye dgu rnams 107—618

lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la bkod de/ zhing 'di'i gdul bya mtha' dag gi don mdzad zin pa na dgung lo re drug tu phebs pa chu pho khyi'i lo sku'i bkod pa bsdus te ri bo gru 'dzin du gshegs so/ /rnam thar ches zhib pa ni du ku la'i gos bzang dang / gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun sogs su gsal ba ltar ro//sku phreng drug pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ sbas yul mkhan pa ljongs kyi 'dabs 'brel mtsho sna la 'og yul gsum du yab rig 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin/ yum tshe dbang lha mo gnyis kyi sras su phal pa'i spyod yu la las 'das te chu phag lor sku bltams so/ /de dus nyi ma bdun shar ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ltas mang du byung / lo shas gsang rgya'i tshul du bzhugs/ me glang zla ba dgu pa'i nang sna dkar rtser paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po blo bzang ye shes kyis mkhan slob sbrag ma/ 'dul 'dzin 'jam dbyangs grags pas grib tshod/ mkha' reg pa zil gnon rdo rje sogs dge 'dun gyi dbus su rab byung gi dngos po bzhes te mtshan thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshor gsol/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs lung yang mang du gsan/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin gru 'dzin gyi pho brang po ta lar gser gyi khri 'phangs mthon por lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par mnga' gsol to/ /de nas paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes/ khri tshul khrims dar rgyas/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rje dge legs rgya mtsho sogs kyi zhal snga nas dbang rjes man ngag lung khrid mtha' yas pa gsan/ rab 'byams pa chags pa chos 'phel 107—619

sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po dang lhan du mtshan nyid gsan sbyongs legs par mdzad/ zhar du rig gnas gzhan rnams la'ang sbyangs pa gnang /byang phyogs kyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus la babs pa dang rkyen sde srid dang / rgyal po lha bzang ma mthun zhing bod ljongs skye dgu'i bsod dman gyi 'bras bu bdo bas 'khrug zing gis sde srid chen po lnga lam du gyur/ gong ma chen po'i mi sna 'byor ba la lha bzang gis tshig sna tshogs zhus pa'i rkyen byas dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa me phag lo rgya nag tu gdan drangs/ yangs can brgyud byang lam nas stod sog brgyud phebs/ gdan zhu ba rnams la gong ma chen pos bka' bkyon drag tu phebs nas ci bya gtol med du gyur skabs gdan zhu rnams nas gsol ba btab pa ltar dgongs pa gzhan du gtad tshul dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar ni gtam snyan lha'i tam bu ra'i rgyud kyi sgra dbyangs las shes par bya'o / /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ snying rje'i lha mchog snying rjes myos pa yis / /sna tshogs zlos gar 'gro 'dir bsgyur la ltos/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i gnyen/ /smra ba'i zla ba mchog gcig 'dir snong gyur/ /gong gzhig bltams ma thag nas lha rnams kyis/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang du mas sbran pas ci/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin lhun rdzogs su waṇ+ḍa/ /phal pa'i ra gan nyid du su zhig 'khrul/ /bcu gcig zhal dang stong phrag phyag sbas nas/ /'dir ni dge sbyong gcig bu'i zol du bstan/ /yon tan lhun rdzogs nyid kyang gsan bsam dang / /sgom pa'i bya ba dag la ltos tshul mdzad/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas dang bka' pod lnga/ /mdo rgyud gzhung brgya thugs su ma chud ci/ /bod yul gsar rnying grub mtha' tshad ma'i chos/ /mtha' dag khyod kyis ma gsan 107—620

pa de gang / /de phyir 'phags yul dī paṃ ka ra bzhin/ /bod yul grub mtha' ris med gtsug na bkur/ /bla ma lha sogs dag pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /sku dang gsung gi snang bar rtag tu 'byams/ /stobs kyi 'khor sgyur rgyal pos bod kyi yul / /khri skor bcu gsum bsod nams yon du btab/ /rigs kyi cod pan 'od mtshan mtha' yas gar/ /rgyal po mchod yon dang bcas bkur stis bsnyen//gru 'dzin gzhal med khang yang 'dir bskrun te/ /sa 'di ri bo tā lar gnyis su med / /stobs dang yon tan grangs su rtsen pa yi/ /mdo sngags chos dbyangs 'phel ba'i 'dus sde bskrun/ /stobs kyis dregs pa'i rkang mthil rgyal phran gyi/ /gtsug rgyan nor bu'i lan tshar gyis bcings pa/ /de yi gtsug na zhabs sen ngal bso bzhin/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis skyongs pa khyod nyid tsam/ /chos srid dge mtshan 'dod rgu'i za 'og gos/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi 'og pag mdzes pas bsdams/ /nges legs nor bu'i gtsug rgyan sbyin pa yi/ /bka' drin gangs can pa kun dran par byos/ /bde chen ril pa'i gar mkhan gcig nyid kyang ske/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i khyad par gzhan dang gzhan/ /sgyu 'phrul dpag dka' rang gi tshangs dbyangs kyis/ /blo bzang rgya mtsho nga zhes zhal gyis 'ches/ /sku phreng du mar sgos bsarmo sgom gsum gyis/ ོ/gyeb pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa yis/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong ba'i dus 'di na/ /seṅge bzhin du 'jigs pa med par spyod/ /gang gi snying rje rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /mkhyen pa'i klong zab zab dbyangs 'jam dpazlo rto/ /nus pa'i mthu stobs stobs ldan gsang stoba'i stobadag /khyod ni 'dren mchog mchog gsum kun 'asdus nyide / /ces bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcade pa'o/sgo/107—621

sku phreng bdun pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ mdo khams li thang thub chen byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs rab byung bcu gnyis pa sa pho byi ba'i lo la yab bsod nams dar rgyas dang / yum bsod nams chos mtsho gnyis kyi sras su dpag par dka' ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas sku bltams/ de tshe lha dang bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ltas mkhan gyis lung bstan pa ltar bskal bzang rgya mtshor mtshan gsol/ de lta bu'i rgyal sras gzhon nu de tha mal pa'i ngang tshul las 'das te/ 'phags chen dam pa'i spyod pa rang chas su byung / lha bla du ma'i lung bstan phyogs kun tu bsgrags pas gau shrī bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rgyud sogs byang phyogs dpon rigs dang / 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen pos gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po 'di'o zhes gzengs bstod/de la brten mdo smad bla chen dgon sde rnams kyis gus 'dud dang bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ dgung lo bzhi la babs pa'i tshe thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pas dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ /dgung lo lnga pa'i dus tsong kha pa chen po zhal gzigs/ sku na phra mo de tsam gyi dus na'ang gdul bya rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi stsol zhing / chu bzang no mon han gyis gsol ba btab pa ltar/ thogs pa med pa'i ljags rtsom 'di ltar mdzad de/ chos gos ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i sku/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sgrogs pa'i gsung / /chos dbyings ngang las g.yel ba med pa'i thugs / /chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ /zhes sogs stsal bas dad pas spu long g.yo bar gyur/ chu bzang no mon han dang / cha gan no mon han las 187—622

dbang rjes man ngag du ma gsan/ dgung lo brgyad pa'i thog li thang du chibs zhal bsgyur/ mdo smad dgon sde rnams su zhabs sor 'khod de spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang dang lung sogs stsal te skye bo phal mo che la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ sku na phra yang sngon 'gro chos bshad sogs rgya cher stsal bas kun dad cing ngo mtshar du gyur/ me pho spre'u'i lor sku 'bum du gdan drangs / rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mcho3re chos kyi khri la zhabs sor bkod nas dge 'dun stong phrag mang po tshogs pa la skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i dbu nas chos thun gcig zab bshad gnang ba sogs bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad cing / chu bzang no min han las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang gsan/ de nas sngon yun ring mo nas goms pa'i bag chags brtas pa'i mthus khyim pa'i cha lugs la mi dgyes shing skra breg /rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs mdzad bzhed pa na lo de'i hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin cha gan no min han dang / chu bzang no min han gnyis kyis mkhan slob mdzad de dbu'i lan bu dor ngur smrig gi na bza' gsol te bslab sdom phul/ mtshan ngag gi dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa thub bstan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ de nas gzhung lugs la sbyong bar bzhed de chu bzang no min han gyis yongs 'dzin mdzad nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung chen mo lnga'i dbu nas brtsi bzhag gnang ste gsan sbyong gi dbu tshugs/ rim gyis bsdus gra'i gsan sbyong mdzad pas ring por ma thogs par mkhas pa'i phul du gyur te sku 'bum 'dus tshogs kyi dbus su dam bca' yang 'jog par mdzad/ de nas gangs can skye 'gro yongs kyi bsod nams kyi mthus dgung lo bcu gsum pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo gong ma chen po'i sku tshab sogs dang dpa' bo stong phrag mang 187—623

pos bar chad bsrungs shing bla chen mang pos mtha' skor te sku 'bum nas chibs bskyod / lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du phebs/ ser skya bgrang ba la 'das pa la zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bstan te gangs can skye 'gro mtha' dag dbugs 'byin par mdzad/ de nas pho brang chen po po tā lar phebs/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs kyi cod pan snang ba mtha' yas ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang ye shes spyan drangs te/ pho brang chen po'i gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil du lcags byi lo de ga'i mgo zla'i yar ngo'i tshes lnga'i nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyis dus go ba mdzad de/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul du bsgrubs/ mtshan sngar gyi thog tu blo bzang zhes bsnan te blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rje btsun blo bzang ye shes la lam rim chen mo las dbu btsugs te chos rgyun du ma dang / lhag par dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas kyang rje 'di la rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar ltar dang por shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs rnams la mtha' chod par sbyong ba dang / de nas gzhung lugs gdams par 'char ba'i nyams bzhes rnams la 'bad pa dang /de nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs kun tu spel bar mdzad nas bstan pa'i srog shing g.yo ba med pa zhig mdzad dgos zhes zhal ta zhib par zhu bar mdzad/ de nas rje 'dis 'brom rin po ches jo bo ji ltar bsten pa ltar gyi rnam thar rjes su bskyangs te paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa 187—624

rigs kyi cod pan du bzung nas gus pa bla lhag tu mdzad do/ /de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' rnams thugs su bcangs te khri rin po che blo bzang dar rgyas yongs 'dzin du bsten nas 'bras spungs su chibs bskyod de tshad ma sde bdun sogs gzhung lugs bka' bod lnga gsan bsam la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brtson pas mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par gyur to/ /de nas rje 'di pa yongs grags kyi dgung lo bcu dgu mngal bshol rtsis pa'i nyi shur phebs pa me pho rta'i lo paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang ye shes spyan drangs te lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin jo bo shākya mu ni'i sku mdun du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po mdzad/ khri rin po che dpal ldan grags pas las slob/ rgyud smad mkhan po mkhas grub ngag dbang mchog ldan pas gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/ sde snod 'dzin pa dka' chen blo bzang smon lam gyi dus go ba/ rgyal sras sprul sku 'jigs med ye shes grags pa sogs gangs ri'i ljongs kyi gnas brtan chen po sum cu rtsa gcig gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad de thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen por mnga' gsol to/ /de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa las mdo sngags kyi chos bka' rgya cher gnang dgos pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad pas dus tshes khyad par can dang bstun nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gzim chung bde ba can du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs sta gon dang bcas pa rgyas par stsal/ gzhan yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad lung ske/ ba ri brgya rtsa sogs dbang rgyun man ngag khrid lung mtha' yas pa gsan bzhes mdzad/ de nas bod sde gzar dus 'khyoms che bar byung ba na 'jam 107—625

dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen pos rje 'di pa re zhig mdo khams phyogs su phebs na legs tshul phebs pa ltar/ se 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma mang po dang /mtshan nyid zhabs phyi rnams dang / gzhan yang bla chen mang po dang / drung skor ser skya phon che ba dang bcas chibs kha bskyod de mgar thar du phebs/ khri ngag dbang mchog ldan yongs 'dzin du bsten nas byang chub lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi steng nas myong khrid zla sbrel gyi bar du gsan cing gdengs thob par mdzad/ 'dus pa'i 'grel pa bzhi sbrag gi zab bshad lo sbrel gyi bar du gsan / gzhan yang 'dus pa'i rim gnyis kyi zab bshad/ nyams khrid sogs dga' ldan snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rnams mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dkar chag tho'i yig chung ltar gsan te/ rgyud kyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsang ba'i bdag po la ji ltar gtad pa ltar snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rgya mtshos thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas lcang skya ho thog thu sogs gdul bya rnams la'ang dbang rjes lung khrid sogs so so'i mos ngo dang 'tshams par zab rgyas stsal/ de nas mgar thar nas yar chibs zhal bsgyur/lam bar gyi skye 'gro ser skya grangs las 'das par mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel pa thogs pa thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis ri bo gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang du zhabs sor 'khod/ dad ldan rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i don bzhin dbang lung / man ngag /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas spel/ paṇa chen mchog gi sprul sku rin po cher rab byung dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa stsal/mtshan blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes su gsol/ dad ldan ser skya mchog dman 707wa 626

yongs la ci 'dod kyi re ba bskangs/ gdan sa chen po se 'bras dga' gsum dang ske/ chos 'khor rgyal sogs gnas chen du mar zhabs kyis bcag ste bstan pa rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba bde ba'i thugs smon dang 'brel mchod 'bul rten bzhengs / nyams gso sogs chos dang zang zing gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ lhag par dgung lo nyer brgyad nas zhe dgu'i bar nub phyogs kha che'i yul nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen po la thug gi dad ldan grangs las 'das pa la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa rgyud mar stsal/ mdor na rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po 'di nges pa'i don 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra nyid mi'i sha tshugs su byon pa ma zad/ tha mal pa'i snang tshul dang bstun pa'i rnam thar yang shin tu khyad par 'phags pa zhig ste/ 'khrungs tsam nyid nas snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas ci mdzad thams cad bstan 'gror sman pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu sbyor bar mdzad/ 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i che rgu kun gyis mchod kyang khengs pa'i dri ma tsam yang med par dman la lhag par brtse/ spangs rtogs kyi go 'phang mthon por bzhugs kyang phyi ma'i skye bo rnams rjes su 'doms pa'i phyir mkhas pa mang po yongs 'dzin du bsten te mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la gsan sbyong mthar phyin par mdzad de mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra mo spang ltung byin rlabs/ chab len lham phud sogs phyag len du bstar/ 'byor ldan kun gyis dad pas rang dbang med par yo byad thams cad drung du spungs pas nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes kyang thugs kyi 'khri ba cung zad tsam yang mi mnga'/ gzab 'phyor dang 'phyar g.yeng 107—627

gi rnam pa skad cig mi mdzad par lo rer na bza' gsar pa tshar re las mi brje/mi rtag pa/ nges 'byung / byams snying rje/ zab mo'i lta ba/ lam rim gnyis kyi nyams myong khyad par can klong rdol bas rang rtags rdo rje'i glu'i nyams mgur du ma thol byung du gsungs/ lo ke shwa ri'i drung du 'phags bstod gsungs pa na nyid dang thugs rgyud gcig par bstan pa'i phyir lo ke shwa ri'i skus kyang mthun par gsungs/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi skabs spyan chab mnyam du 'byin pa sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar/ lhag pa'i lha du mas dngos su zhal gzigs gsung gi gnang ba stsal ba dang / bstan srung mthu bo che dag bran du 'khol ba sogs gsang ba'i rnam thar mtha' yas/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad du bskor bas gsung skyes kyi slob bu mkhas grub chen po gser gyi ri lta bus bod yul mtha' dbus/ rgya nag /chen po hor gyi yul tshun du yongs su gang bar mdzad pas 7rgyal ba tsong kha chen po'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od rlabs su grol ba lta bu de dus las lhag pa ma byung / dpyad gsum dag pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsi ji snyed cig stsal ba gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas pa mtha' dag rnam dpyod kyi brtan pa rang dbang med par 'phrog pa da lta'ang tshang mas mjal du yod pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa me glang gi lo dbo zla'i tshes bcu gsum nyin rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i don du re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ bskal bzang rgyal ba rgya mtsho stong dag ni/ /phyag na pad+mo nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul gar/ /phyog na thocho nyid kyange gongs can 'dir/ /bskal bzang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying por rol/ /na tshod ches por 'phags pa'i gsong gsem gyi/ /byu 107—628

yon tan lhun rdzogs 'gog pa med pa 'di/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid las gzhan su zhes/ /grags pa'i me tog phyogs kun rna lung 'bar rab 'byams rgyal bas mtshan snyan cod pan gyi/ /dbang bskur ltas mkhan ngag las zol gyis grags / /nges don gsang ba lta ci mthun snang gi/ /ngo mtshar nyid kyang tshur mthong blo las 'gongs/ /lang cho'i zla tshes cha shas phra mor yang mang thos 'od dkar dra ba stong g.yo zhing / /legs bshad ga bur zegs ma 'bum 'dzag pas / /mkhas mchog bde 'byung gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la/ /thogs pa med 'di 'jam dbyangs las gzhan su/ /brtse chen shas mi bzod pas 'gro ba kun/ /'dren la rings 'di 'jig rten gsum mgon nyid/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs rnam par dag pas bsdams/ /mkhas dang grub pa kun gyi rtse mor son/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs bdag po nyid gyur pas/ /khyod las lhag pa'i blo bzang rgyal ba gang / /de phyir khyod kyi yon tan phung po ni/ /bsam bzhin dad pa'i chang gis rab myos kyang / /brjod pa'i ngal ba gaṅgā'i rdul gyi grangs/ /'dren pa ji bzhin bdag ni lhag par zhum/ /rgyal kun thugs rjes rjes chags brtse chen gyi/ /gar bu rnam 'dren 'dren byed stong ldan gar/ sne/dbol ldan bla ma ma nor lam ston dpal/ /khyode kyis thodag nyid nyid bzhin byin gyis rlobs/ ste nga/zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcade pa'o//sku 'phreng brgyad pa rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni thob rgyal lha ri sgang zhes par yab bsod nams dar rgyas dang / yum phun tshogs dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su sa pho stag gi lo chu stod zla bar sku bltams/187—629

bltams ma thag nas byis pa'i ngang tshul las 'das te/ rab tu byung ba la lhag par spro ba sogs dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar bstan/ de nas dgon sde rnams brgyud bkra shis lhun por phyag btegs/ paṇa chen rin po che nas byad grol gnang / mnyan yod cho 'phrul dus chen gyi yar tshes bcu gcig nyin rab byung gi sdom bzhes mdzad de mtshan rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtshor gsol / gzhung sa'i bka' blon/ bod bzhugs e ban bcas nas legs 'bul phul bzhes mdzad/ paṇa chen mchog gi drung nas bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang sogs 'ga' shas gsan/ nag zla'i tshes gsum nyin rgyal tshab no min han gyi sku tshab/ gong ma'i mi sna/ gzhung sa'i mi drag gdan sa'i bla ma las sne bcas phebs bsu ba rnams la mjal phyag gnang / tshes nyer gnyis nyin chibs zhal bsgyur te rim gyis phebs/ chu rta gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes dgu'i nyin pho brang chen po po tā lar gser khrir mnga' gsol/ shing bya zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang chos grags pas dus go ba mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan rje btsun blo bzang bsta na pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal rgya mtshor mnga' gsol / paṇa chen rin po che las 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang / lam khrid sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ khri yongs 'dzin rin po che'i zhal snga nas bka' pod lngar gsan sbyong dpyis phyin par mdzad/ me bya lo ji ltar gru 'dzin zhing nas thugs bskyed kyi go char yongs su bzung ba ltar chos srid gser gyi 'khor lo phyag char bdag gir bzhes te kha ba can pa rnams lugs gnyis dpag 107—630

bsam gyi grib bsil du bde bar spyod pa'i skal bzang thob/ sa zla'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po/ khri zur ngag dbang chos grags kyi las slob/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang chos 'phel gyis gsang ston/ khri chen bstan pas dus go ba sogs bshes gnyen mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su tshigs phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por gyur/ yongs 'dzin du ma rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te man ngag mtha' yas gsan/ bar bar du dad ldan skye 'gro rnams la rab bsnyen gyi sdom rgyun dang / dbang lung man ngag rnams so so'i 'dod mos kyi re ba bskangs / gdan sa gsum dang / mtha' dbus kyi dgon gnas rnams su nyams gso mchod 'bul/ bsnyen bkur dang 'brel thugs smon rgya cher gnang /bar skabs gor dmag bkras lhun par 'byor yang bsrung mar 'phrin las drag tu bskul bas de 'phral phyir bzlog /gong ma chen pos kyang bkur bzos che ba gnang ske/ dad ldan rnams kyi gsol ba btab ngor zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang bka' rtsom sogs gangs can pa rnams bstan bde'i sa la 'god pa sogs zhib par rnam thar chen mor gsal ba ltar ro/ /skabs shig nas sku ltems pa'i tshul mdzad pa na sman pa dang / zhabs brtan gsol 'debs sogs ji ltar zhus kyang bod ljongs bsod nams dman pa'i 'bras bu bzlog tu med pas shing byi zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin dgongs pa mnal du gzim pa'itshul bstan te 'jam dpal snying po'i drung du gshegs so//sku phreng dgu pa rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ ldan thub bstan chos 'khor gyi nye 'gram/ chos 'khor dpon 107—631

tshang gi yab bstan 'dzin chos skyong dang / yum don grub sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing mo glang gi hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin ngo mtshar gyi ltas khyad par can dang bcas sku bltams/ sku bltams ma thag nas mar gyur sems can rjes su dgongs nas a ma dang / rang gi snying po 'dren pa bskul phyir ma ṇi gsungs/ skabs shig po tā la nas rol mo brdung byung / jo bo lo ke shwa ra yang bzhugs 'dug gsung ba dang / nga la yang lag pa bzhi yod e mthong zhes spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i phyag stabs mdzad pa sogs sngon gnas rjes dran dang / lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes mnga' ba sogs sku shin tu phra mo'i dus nas mkhas pa dang grub pa mtha' dag rang chas yod pa'i rnam par thar pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba ni rnam thar dad pa'i yid 'phrog tu gsal ba ltar ro/ /rgyal tshab de mo no min han gyis gtsos bod kyi bka'i blon chen rnams nas snyan pa'i grags pa gsan te gong ma bdag po chen por gser snyan dang bcas gdan 'dren zhus te 7gung thang du phebs bzhugs mdzad/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dang / rgyal tshab no mi han/ bod bzhugs am ban/ se 'bras kyi bla sprul slob dpon/ gzhung sa'i drung rigs bcas lhan 'dzoms nas ngos 'dzin gsal ba yid ches su mdzad/ paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhal snga nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan blo bzang bstan pa'i 'byung gnas ngag dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ 'on rgyal sras sprul sku rin po che dang / rgyal tshab rnam gnyis rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te gsan sbyong legs par mdzad/ sa pho 'brug lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis lha las 107—632

babs pa'i dus chen gyi nyin pho brang chen po po ta lar gser gyi khri 'phangs mthon por mnga' gsol/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs te thugs gnyer gsan sbyong dang / bar bar du dbang rjes lung khrid man ngag kyang mang du gsan cing /khri ngag dbang snyan grags yongs 'dzin du bzhes te gsan bzhes mang du gnang /chu bya lha las babs pa'i dus chen gyi nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas mkhan po/ yongs 'dzin khri ngag dbang snyan grags nas las slob/ yongs 'dzin shar pa byang chub chos 'phel nas dus go ba/ tshe smon gling sprul sku sogs dge 'dun gyi dbus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes te ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur to/ /bar skabs su'ang gsan bzhes dang / dad ldan rnams la 'dod chos ci rigs pa stsal/ gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa'i nyams gso gsar bskrun/ dge 'dun gyi sde spel ba sogs mtha' yas pa mdzad / shing phag zla ba dang po nas sku khams cung mi bde ba'i tshul bzhes kyis dbo zla'i tshes bcu gcig nyin 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad do//sku phreng bcu pa 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ spo 'bor sgang gi char gtogs gnas stod nor bu'i grong zhes par yab blo bzang snyan grags dang / yum rnam rgyal bu khrid gnyis kyi sras su me byi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i snga char ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i ltas khyad par can du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs so/ /de lta bu'i mtshan snyan bod gzhung rgyal blon rnams kyis gsan nas mi sna 'byor bar brtag dpyad thog re zhig li thang dgon par bzhugs/ gong ma bdag po chen por gser snyan dang 107—633

'brel bod phyogs su gdan drangs te lha bla'i lung bstan dang / 'phrin las dang / thugs bskyed kyi mthu las gser bum nas thon te lha yi rgyal rnga brdungs/de nas khri la gsol ma ran par snye thang bde ba can du bzhugs/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che nas dbu'i gtsug phud bzhes pa dang / yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ ngag dbang blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal bzang por mtshan gsol/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang pos mkhan po/ khri 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis slob dpon/ sems dpa' sprul sku dus go ba/ yongs 'dzin khri zur ngag dbang snyan grags sogs dge 'dun gyi dbus su bar ma rab byung dang / dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te drang srong rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur to/ /kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i ljags lung zab khrid dang / 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dbang bka' sogs ci rig pa gsan/ yongs 'dzin khri zur rin po che nas yi ge'i phyi mo klog 'don sogs gsan sbyong zhabs bskul mdzad/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin snye thang bde ba can nas chibs bskyod de tshes brgyad nyin pho brang po ta lar gser khrir mnga' gsol/ khri chen ngag dbang snyan grags zhing gshegs kyi tshab khri chen ngag dbang chos 'phel yongs 'dzin du bsko bzhag stsal/bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma sogs kyi ljags lung khrid bcas gsan/ sa mo glang gi lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs su chibs bsgyur thog yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang mtshan zhabs pa bcas mtshan nyid thugs gnyer mdzad/ bar bar du dad ldan rnams la 'dod chos dang / gtsug lag khang gi nyams gso sogs 107—634

zhal bkod bskyangs/ de nas se ra/ dga' ldan sogs su chibs zhal bsgyur te mdzad sgo'i rim pa mtha' dag dang / gsan sbyong sngar ltar bskyangs/ shing rta zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos mkhan po/ yongs 'dzin no min han srid skyong ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims nas las slob/ yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang chos 'phel nas gsang ste ston pa/ khri zur 'jam dpal tshul khrims nas dus go ba/ tshe gling yongs 'dzin sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur to/ /me bya zla ba bdun pa nas sku bsnyun tshul bstan cing / gzhung sa/ se 'bras dga' gsum sogs ser skya mtha' dag nas zhabs rim rgya cher bsgrubs rung bstan 'gro'i shegs dbang dang / bod ljongs bsod dman lhag par bdo bas zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig nyin sku'i bkod pa bsdus te dag pa chos dbyings su mnal lo//sku phreng bcu gcig pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ mgar thar dgon gyi nye 'dabs su man chod dkon mchog gshis zhes pa de nyid la yab dkon rtse tshe dbang don grub/ yum g.yung drung bu khrid gnyis kyi sras su sa khyi hor zla dgu pa'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang por sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag nas dam pa'i rang rtags ni tsan+dan dang de'i dri bzhin du ngang gis byung / lha blas khams phyogs su yod par lung bstan pa ltar mngon sum gsal bar nges pa rnyed/ dgon par gdan drangs nas rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/ de nas dbus su gdan drangasal/ gung thang du bzhugs/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ rgyal tshab khri 187—635

chen no mon han/ bod bzhugs am bam/ bka'i gung blon sogs kyis das ther mdzad pa na bag tsha ba med pas thams cad yid gnyis bsal/ tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin pho brang chen po po tā lar gser bum nas thon/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi nyin paṇa chen rin po ches dbu'i gtsug phud bzhes re zhig ri rgyar bzhugs su gsol/ chu stag sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu drug la gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol te/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas mjal 'bul rnams rim par mdzad/ rgyal tshab yongs 'dzin no mon han nas yi ge'i phyi mo ka kha'i klog spron gyis mtshon thun mong rig gnas kun la gsan sbyong 'bul bzhes kyis tsheg med par thugs su chud par mdzad/ me rta zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nyin lha ldan jo bo rin po che shākya mu ne'i sku mdun du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang pos mkhan po/ yongs 'dzin khri chen blo bzang lhun grub nas slob dpon/ srid skyong rwa sgreng no min han nas grogs dan/ yongs 'dzin rta tshag pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dus go ba/ shar byang chos rje sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bar ma rab byung dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob zla med par gyur/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang dang /rin 'byung sogs rgyud sde mang po'i dbang dang rjes gnang zab khrid man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ chu khyi hor zla gsum pa'i nang gdan sa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su chibs zhal bsgyur te srid skyong no min han/ yongs 'dzin rin po che/ mtshan zhabs pa bcas nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung chen mo rnams la 187—636

thugs gnyer gsan sbyong dang / tshogs chen grwa tshang so sor chibs bsgyur gyis rab 'byams mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams dang bgro gleng / legs 'bul mjal dmangs / dgyes ston/ mchod 'bul/ bsnyen bkur sogs tshim par mdzad/de nas se ra theg chen gling du chibs bsgyur gyis tshogs chen dang / grwa tshang so sor zhabs bcag ste bgro gleng / dgyes ston sogs rgyas par stsal/ de nas gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du chibs bskyod kyis mdzad sgo'i rim pa sngar lam nyams med du bka' drin bskyangs thog bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i thugs smon rgya cher gnang / de nas mal gro brgyud lho gnas khag dang / chos 'khor rgyal bcas par mchod 'bul gnas gzigs/ dge 'dun gyi sde che chung mtha' dag la bsnyen bkur dang / gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par nyams gso'i thog thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ de nas pho brang chen po po tā lar zhabs sor 'khod de/ thugs gnyer gsan sbyong dang / dbang lung sogs gsan bzhes mdzad/ dad ldan rnams la 'dod chos kyi re ba bskangs/shing yos zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum nyin 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren la gong ma chen pos chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i khri la mnga' gsol bstod/ spyi sger gyi 'bul ba dang / rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye/ zla ba drug pa'i nang sku'i bsnyun babs bzhes te zhabs brtan gsol 'debs sogs la ji ltar 'bad rung bod 'bangs kyi las ngan bzlog tu med pa'i mthu las zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to//sku phreng bcu gnyis pa rgyal ba'i dbang po 'phrin las rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ dbu ru lho brgyud 'ol dga' rdzing phyi'i nye 'dabs 'ban 'brog 107—637

nyang tshang du/ yab phun tshogs tshe dbang dang / yum tshe ring g.yu sgron gnyis kyi sras su me pho 'brug gi lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i ches gcig nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs so/ /de nas lha bla'i lung bstan ltar rwa sgreng ho thog thu mchog dang / bka'i gung blon/ se 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla ma las sne bcas nas brtag dpyad kyis 7gong ma chen por gser snyan thog gser bum brtag dpyad kyis ngos 'dzin zhus te yang srid mchog gi sprul sku dgon gsar nas nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du gdan drangs/ srid skyong rwa sgreng ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du gtsug phud 'bul gnang rab byung gi rtags yang dag par bzhes te/ rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsol/ sa lug hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyin nor gling bskal bzang pho brang nas gdan zhus kyis rtse pho brang chen po po tā lar gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang gi gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sor 'khod do / /spyi sger gyi dngos 'bul/ mjal dmangs rnams rgya che zhing grangs mang ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan gyi snang ba rdzogs ldan dpal la 'gran pa bzhin du mdzad/ chu khyi hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bdun nyin 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po lugs gnyis kyi bdag po chen por mnga' gsol zhing / sku na phra ba'i phyag rog zhabs zhu/ yongs 'dzin khri zur mkhyen rab dbang phyug bskos/ phur lcog yongs 'dzin blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtsho gnyis las rig gnas sogs gsan bzhes rnams rim par bskyangs/ shing pho byi ba'i lo hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes 107—638

bcu gsum la yongs 'dzin khri zur mkhyen rab dbang phyug dpal bzang pos mkhan po dang / yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po ches slob dpon/ byang rtse bstan 'dzin rab rgyas nas dus go ba mdzad de/ mkhan slob dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen/ bar ma rab byung / dge tshul gyi bslab sdom legs par bzhes te ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i gtso bor gyur to/ /yongs 'dzin khri zur rin po che srid kyi las don skyong rog dang no min han gyi go gnas stsal/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i zhal snga nas dbang rjes lung khrid sogs seng bar du yang yang gsan/ smon lam chen mo'i mdzad sgo rnams kyang sngar lam bzhin bskyangs/ de nas lcags rta hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin gdan sa chen po 'bras spungs su gsan bzhes la chibs bsgyur gyis tshogs chen/ grwa tshang khag rnams su dgyes ston thog chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pas mkhas rnams mgu ba bskyed cing / chos 'brel stsal/ de nas se ra theg pa chen po'i gling du chibs bskyod de/ tshogs chen/ grwa tshang khag la zhabs bcag bgro gleng dang / chos 'brel/ dgyes ston mjal dmangs bcas bstan pa'i mig rgyan du che ba mdzad/ chu bya hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin sku nar son stabs skyabs mgon chen po de nyid nas srid kyi thugs 'gan bskyangs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar phye/ khri grags pa don grub la yongs 'dzin bka' bsgyur stsal / shing khyi hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bzhi nyin lha ldan nas chibs btegs te phebs gru brgyud/ gung thang / bde chen gsang sngags mkhar rnams la gnas gzigs dang 'brel thugs smon mdzad/ de nas dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du zhabs sor 'khod de sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu sogs la gnas 107—639

gzigs dang / tshosas chen/ grwa tshang so sor zhabs bcag /bgro gleng /chos 'brel/ dgyes ston sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ de nas la mo brgyud 'khrungs khang rdzing phyi dgon du phebs/ gnas gzigs dang 'khrungs gsol gnang / 'ol dga' nas klong la brgyud chos 'khor rgyal du phebs/bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su gsung bskang sogs mdzad sgo'i rim pa sngar lam nyams med bskyangs/ de nas dbus phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur te 'ol dga' brgyud kyi gnas dang / zangs ri/ yar lung phu mda'i gnas/ bsam yas sogs la mchod 'bul dang 'brel thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ rgod dkar la nas rim bzhin lha gdong shan kha nas lha ldan du gnas gzigs kyis nor gling du zhabs sor 'khod de gsan bzhed dang / bcad rgya mdzad/ shing phag hor zla dang po'i mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar bskyangs rjes/ lha ldan smon lam chen mor chibs bskyod kyis mdzad sgo rnams nyams med ngos bka' slob kyang rgyas par gnang / de nas sku bsnyun pa'i tshul cung zad bzhes/ zhabs rim gyis mtshon gsol 'debs kyi rim pa mang du btab kyang bstan 'gro'i bgegs dbang bzlog tu med pas rim gyis je zhan la zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su thims pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/zla ba'i ba gam brtsegs pa'i khor yug khrod/ /rdzogs ldan ku mud ta yi do shal dwangs / /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs rgya chen mtsho/ /spel ba'i rgyas sras zla ba gzhon bye byon/byu /spangs rtogs nor bu'i ba garmo gang ba rdzogs/ /brtse chen 'od dkar 'dzum zer kun la spro/ /chos srid 'phrin las ga bur bsil ba'i rgyun/ /gangs can 'gro kun ngal bso'i dpal du sbyin/ /bltams 707—640

tsam nyid nas lung dang rtogs pa yi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rang chas nyid mnga' bas / /gzhon ston nyid na'ong rlabs chen bstan 'gro'o don/ /mkhas grub rgan po'i tshogs la skyengs pa ster/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog gis legs bsdams shing / /snying rje'i rgya mtsho 'ogro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /'khor lo gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsurmi rgyas/ /sa 'dir phan bde'i lang tsho bzhad par mdzad/ /mkhas dang grub pa rgya mtsho'i zur phud kyis/ /zhabs sen bkra shis re kha gus bcinges pa/ lge/de yi ༅mdzade phrin dpag bsam grib bsil du/ /gangs can 'gro kun ngal bso lhag par thob/ /'phrin las 'od dkar dra ba yongs bskyod pa/ /rgyal bstan rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i gasgron gcig pu/ /gang gi rnam thar ga bur gsar pa'i rdul/byu /snyigs lnga'i tsha gdung 'phrog pa'i dga' ston nyid / /rgyal kun snying rje'i gar bu rjes chags 'dzum/ /mkha' khyab sgyu 'phrul rab 'byams lta ci zhig /gangs can kho nar sprul pa'i zlos gar yang / /rgyu mtsho rab 'byams sprin gyi rjes su 'chings/ /lhag par gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar/ /ngal bso med par ljongs 'dir ston pa yi/ /brtse chen thugs rje de yi dpe zla ru/ /bka' drin dran pa'i dad gus brtsegs par 'os/ /gru 'dzin bdag po po tā la yi rtser/ /snying rje'i spyan yangs yangs pa'i 'gro khams la/ /bskyod pa de bzhin bzhin lag sgyu 'phrul gyis/byu /maze' yas zhing kun kun nas 'gengs par mardzid/ sne /ces bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su sgocad 4pas sgeg pa'o//rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs rang cag kha ba ri pa'i me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 'phags mchog spyan ras 107—641
