gzigs sku'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa bcu gsum pa chen po 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa mtha' dag pa ni/ ji skad du/ mdo sde phal po che las / byang chub rgya mtsho rab brnyes gyur nas kyang / /sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgya mtsho ston mdzad cing / /mi 'grib spyod pa rgya mtsho dus kun ston/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi rnam 'phrul de 'dra 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nges pa'i don du sngon ring mo zhig nas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi pha mthar son te byang chub chen po'i go 'phang bla na med pa brnyes zin na'ang / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin par bya ba'i phyir/ rlabs chen sems bskyed rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' ji tsam pa de tsam nam yang 'grib pa med pa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho srid pa ji srid pa de srid du ston par mdzad pa gsungs pa ltar/ sku'i 'khrungs rabs gzhan dang gzhan gyi rnam par thar pa gaṅgā'i rdul gyi phung po lta bu rnams lta ci/ sku phreng 'di nyid kho na'i gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa mtha' dag pa ni sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i spyod yul las/ bdag cag tshur mthong gis cha tsam yang brjod pa'i yul las 'das shing / de lta na'ang rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig spel ba la/ bdag nyid chen po snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis bsam bzhin srid pa bzung bas gzigs pa lnga'i sgo nas gangs ljongs skye dgu'i mgon du 'byon pa'i dus la babs pa na/ de yang gnas tsa ri tra dang / bod kyi ri bo 187—642

shan ti'i nye 'dabs shar phyogs dwags smad kyi yul gyi bye brag glang gling lha par grags pa/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gyi rang byon gyi bkod pa gsal zhing ri bo glang chen 'gying 'dra'i mdun du yod pas na glang mdun du grags pa/ dwags po lha rje sogs dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs shing / rgyun mi 'chad par rgyu ba'i chu klung / rtsi shing nags tshal du mas mdzes pa/ bya dang ri dwags du mas kun nas bskor ba dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas su rgyal yab ni gong dkar lugs stod du 'khrungs pa ya rabs rigs bzang kun dga' rin chen dang / sgam po'i bla sprul bag zam sku skye'i rgyud las 'khrungs pa rgyal yum blo bzang sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams so/ /de yang lhums su zhugs pa dang sku bltams pa sogs kyi dus su ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i snga ltas su kun gsal ngogs su skya rengs dang / mtshams sprin gyi rang mdangs 'gog med du 'char ba ltar/ snga lo shing phag zla ba bdun pa'i nang du ji ltar bdag nyid chen po 'khrungs pa'i snga ltas su sa chen po 'di'ang ches cher 'dar zhing g.yos te/'khrungs khang gi rtsig pa dang / thog mtshams bar mtho gang bye ba zhig dang /de nas gzhan 'gar sa g.yo cher byung zhing / khyim gzhan la zhig ral byung kyang /'khrungs khang rten gsum dngos nor gang la'ang 'tshe ba phra mos kyang ma gos pas kun kyang ngo mtshar du gyur/ de skabs rtsis 'bras su ngan tshul gleng bar skye bo phal pa rnams som nyir gyur skabs/ bdag nyid chen po bam chos sprul sku rin po che nas sa g.yo ba la bzang ngan gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa' sku 'khrungs pa sogs kyi skabs su'ang 'byung ba yod pas 7gong sa 7rgyal dbang 187—643

thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul zhal gzigs snga ltas yin 'gro dogs pa ma byed ces bka' stsal pas skye bo rnams ngan rtog las bzlog ste yid bde ba'i gnas la bkod/ yum gyi mtshan lam du lha sa nas yong zer ba'i bud med dbus chas sprad pa dar dkar thogs pa yab kyi mdun du bcar ba dang / spro khang nang du chu 'khyil ba las dung dkar rnyed pa dang / 'khrungs khang nas po tā la'i bar dar gyi lda ldi bres pa dang / rtse drung gcig dang bud med rgyan ldan zhig gis skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal dkar yin zer ba'i snod phra ldan gnang ba rmis pa sogs gzhung rten sung ma'i gtso bo rnams kyis 'phrin las tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i mtshan ma gsal ba dang / gzhan yang bsod nams nor bu zer ba ru bar mar do rgyag dus ltang phyed tsam nas yar lud mthar gtun shing lta bu bzo dgos byung / zla ba dgu pa'i nang nye 'dab nub phyogs su shing nye khri sdong po la me tog phra mer gyis gang ba kun gyis mthong yul du gyur pa dang / gzim khang la 'ja' zug pa sogs ltas mang du byung ba rgyas par rnam thar chen mo las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i ngang nas / ji skad du/ gtsug na nor bu'i yal 'dab las/ de na dus ni yongs rdzogs te/ /mkha' las bdud rtsi'i 'od zer bzhin/ /'gro ba'i rab rib kun 'joms phyir/ /lha mo las ni btsas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang tshan 'dzin byed ces pa me byi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gnas chen dwags lha sgam po'i dbu rtser nyi ma shar ba/ nam mkha' nas 'ja' sprin 'khrig pa/ char gyi rgyun zim bu babs pa / yab rje mchog nas srung ma rnams kyi 'phrin skyems mdzad pa/ sgam po'i 107—644

bdag mos gtsos bu slob rnams kyis khang pa'i cha thar rkang dung 'bud pa rnams dang dus mtshungs su ji ltar bdud rtsi'i thig le mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin gyi rgya las grol ba bzhin du sku bltams par gyur to/ /de ltar sku bltams nas rgyal dbang mchog gi yang srid du 'khrul med nges pa rnyed tshul ni/ de yang 7rgyal dbang sku gong ma zhi bar gshegs skabs shar rgyud gzim chung nyi 'od dga' ldan snang gsal du zhal shar lhor phyogs te gshegs pa dang / de nub zhal lho gzigs kyi bzhugs su gsol yang gzhan gyi rkyen med par shar lhor rang shugs kyis 'gyur ba dang / de rjes pur khang nang du zhal lho drang thad du pur tshwas gtams te bzhugs su gsol ba na'ang / slar zhal phye dus shar lhor zhal bsgyur nas bzhugs pa yang yang byung ba ni yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che sogs zhabs zhu ba rnams kyi mig shes tshad mar lan gcig ma yin par gtan la phab pa dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po cher thugs dam zhus pa'i phyir phebs su'ang mchog gi sprul sku shar lho'i mtshams su bltams pa zhig byung na bstan 'gro kun la sman yon che ba zhig yod zhes phebs/ 7rgyal mchog sku phreng yongs kyi dgra lha gnas chung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po nas lo de ga'i zla ba drug pa'i nang du sku gdung rin po che'i drung du dbyar gsol zhu skabs nas bzung lha tshes rgyas pa gang yin la shar lhor pad 'bul dang / kha btags re bskyur thabs su 'bul bar mdzad cing / de rjes bka' lung la/ re ba'i 'bras bu mngon dga'i phyogs nas 'byung / zhes sogs dang dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i ljongs rgyur skabs 'di nas rtsis pa'i nyi ma shar phyogs pha ming kun dga' dang /ma sgrol ma gnyis kyi phyogs bshes gnyen dam pa tshul ldan zhig rtsad gcod byed 107—645

par 'phral gtong dgos zhes phebs pa ltar/ rgyud stod mkhan zur blo bzang dar rgyas zla ba dgu pa'i nang ched phebs chos 'khor rgyal bla mtshor lha mo'i bskang ba 'bum ther sgrub pa dang 'brel mtsho dar 'grig dus yin kyang mtsho mjal gsal bar byung zhing rmi lam na'ang de dang mthun par byung ba bcas glang mdun du phebs skabs rtse mthun byung bas 'khrul bral du nges pa rnyed/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang / rgyal tshab rta tshag rje drung thong shan ho thog thu rnam gnyis kyi mtshon bod 'bangs mgrin gcig nas gser bum brtag dpyad mi dgos par ngos 'dzin zhus chog pa'i 7gong ma chen por gser snyan zhus pa ltar/ de bzhin bgyis chog pa'i bka' bzhes thob pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lag tu son pa ltar yid kun tu tshim par gyur/ de nas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos yab gzhis glang mdun nas rim gyis gdan drangs te/ sa stag zla ba dang po'i tshes la/ catshal gung thang du zhabs sor 'khod/ kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas la dbu skra gtsug phud 'bul gnang mdzad de mtshan rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gsol te drang srong bden pa'i tshig gis dbu 'phang bstod/ de nas re zhig ri rgya bsam gtan gling du gdan zhus kyis sku ngal bso ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ 7gong ma chen po'i gser snyan 'khor 'phral gser khrir mnga' gsol ched/ sa yos zla ba drug pa'i nang rgyal tshab thong shan ho thog thu'i gtsos bod kyi che rgu lha sde mi sde bcas kyis ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa lha las babs pa'i mdzad pa ston pa'i dus dang mtshungs par phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang pho brang chen 187—646

po po tā lar gdan drangs/ tshes bcu bzhi gza' skar mchog tu dge bar tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sor mngon par 'khod de/ bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs kyi sgo nas shis par brjod cing me tog gi char phab ste mnga' gsol/ 7gong ma chen po nas kyang nor bu'i tham ka /gser gyi 'ja' sa sogs gnang skyes rgya che dang bcas dbu 'phangs bstod/srid skyong ho thog thu dang / mdun na 'don gyi gtsos lha sde mi sde rnams kyis mchod tshogs mtha' yas pas mchod par byas so/ /rje lnga pa chen pos/ srid 'byor glog gi bu mo'i gar mkhan ma/ /sdug bsngal mun par mal 'cha'i mtshang rig ste/ /'khor ba'i mtshan mo'i mtha' las nges 'byung ba'i/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyi skya rengs dang po shar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi gshegs shul du gzigs shing / sku phreng du mar goms pa bla na med pa'i mthus/ rab tu byung zhing gsan bsam gyi brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten pa'i slad/ srid skyong rta tshag rje drung thong shan ho thog thu dang / phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtsho rnam gnyis rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la bslab pa'i gzhi lnga 'dzin pa'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa legs par bzhes te rnam byang zhi ba bdud rtsi'i go 'phang la gnas/ de 'brel thog ma'i thugs gnyer gsan bzhes dbu 'dzugs kyi rten 'byung sgo brgya phye ste thar 'dod blo gsal yongs kyi mig rgyan du che bar mdzad/ lcags 'brug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nang srid skyong rta tshag ho thog thu'i zhal snga nas 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang gsan bzhes thog lhan rgyas ljags bsnyen mdzad/ chu rta zla ba dang po'i tshes drug nyin yongs 'dzin 107—647

srid skyong ho thog thu nas smon lam tshogs dbur gdan zhus kyi chibs bsgyur skabs / yongs 'dzin dam pa rnam gnyis dang bka'i mdun na 'don sogs gzhung zhabs ser skya/ gdan sa gsum gyi bla sprul slob dpon las sne sogs chibs zhabs stong phrag brgal ba'i mdun bdar te sum rtsen khang bzang sa la 'phos 'dra'i lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du chibs zhal bsgyur te e waṃ du phebs ston dkar spro mjal dmang bgro gleng sogs legs par mdzad/ tshes bcu gsum nyin lha ldan jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar/ thub dbang sta zur ma dang /'dul ba lung gzhi'i glegs bam gdan drangs mchod sprin gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thog /bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag rgyal tshab yongs 'dzin rta tshag thong shan ho thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan slob dang / ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan phur lcog yongs 'dzin blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtsho nas dus go mdzad/ zhwa ser bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khri chen rin po che'i gtsos dad pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su bar ma rab byung dang tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi bslab sdom rnam par dag pa bzhes te/drang srong gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas shing thub pa'i nang gi mdzod 'dul ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad/ de nyin kun gling bla brang nas gsol ba btab pa bzhim tshogs dbus su zhabs sor 'khod de/ snyan zhing brjid pa'i gsung dbyangs mthon pos ljags bsngo mthun 'gyur sogs dang ba 'dren par mdzad pa skye bo kun gyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog par gyur/ tshes bco lnga la gsung chos ra bar chibs bskyod kyis sngar lam mdzad sgo nyams med thog /sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad dang 'brel dga' ldan lha 107—648

brgya ma'i ljags lung stsal nas 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar phye ste 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba gnang / nyin gung skam tshogs su sngar lam mdzad sgo spyi dang / ljags bsngo bstan 'bar ma/ bde smon bcas kyi mthun 'gyur rje bla ma'i phyag bzhes nyams med du stsal/ tshes bcu drug nas bla brang khag /sde dpon mi drag /lha sde mi sde cas nas rab bzhes gtang rag legs 'bul bstar ba bdag gir bzhes/ chu lug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyin cha gan ho thog thu kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas gsol ba btab pa ltar 7gong sa mchog nas sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad dang 'brel/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs zhes pa'i bar ljags lung stsal te slar chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba'i rten 'brel mdzad do/ /de dag la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis cung zad bstod na/ 'gro 'di'i phan bde'i snang ba ga bur 'dzum/ /thun mtshams gos dmar g.yogs bzhin chu lhar mnal/ /dus kyi srin mo glal bas snyigs ma lnga'i/ /ngan skyugs mig sman stug pos rab bkabs kyang / /ji lta ji ltar 'gro rnams rab gdung ba/ /de lta de ltar rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i stobs/ /khams dang mos par mtshams pa'i sgyu 'phrul kyang / /gdul bya'i khyad par de de bzhin du 'jug /skal ngan mun pa bye ba spungs pa'i dus / /'phrin las 'od dkar rgya mtshos yongs btang kyang / /thub bstan rdzogs ldan nyino mo'o snang ba 'bum/byu nga/rgya mtsho'i gos can cig car 'obyed 'edi byon / /gzigs pa lnga yis sgyu 'phrul garnyas po'i lhums/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mi yi srid gzur tshe/ /dbyig ldan brtan pa 'phrog pas 'khrig cing 'dar/ /lha dang srung ma kun kyang sri zhur brel/ /sher phyin sgeg mo skal bzang 'dzin ma 187—649

de'i / /lhums las mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor grol ba na/ /chu 'dzin rum rgya las ni nyin byed bzhin/ /sa 'di mgon dang snang ba bcas par gyur/ /nyin byed 'od stong 'gog par mi nus bzhin/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin sgrib tu ma dmigs pas/ /gangs can mgon po nyid ni 'di 'o zhes/ /nges rnyed mnga' gsol bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor/ /'khrungs rabs du mar 'brel ba'i rigs kyi bdag /de la mthon mthing lan bu dor ba na/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan bsgreng dang chab cig tu/ /mtshan snyan nor bu'i gtsug tor 'chings par mdzad//ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang thub dbang rje'i/ /bstan dang chab srid rgya chen debyar gyi metsho/ sgo /sdo bzhin sal la 'jigs bral dbang cuphyug gar/ /phyogaso las rnam par sgrol ba'i sde zhes bsngags/ snyo /gru ga'adzin gzhal med khang du sgru 'dzon rbodagayo /'jigos khrol gdong lnga'i khri la mnga' gsol zhing / /bkra shis me tog char du bsnyil ba yis/ /gangs can bkra shis dge mtshan thog mar bzhad/ /thugs rgyud shel dkar bum bzang tshangs spyod kyi/ /rnam dag tshul khrims bdud rtsis yongs gtams shing / /mkhas mang 'dus pa rgya mchoXre tshogs dbus su/ /tshangs dbyangs gsung gi bdud rtsi thog mar stsal/ /skyabs mgon mgon med gnyen gcig gcig chog sku/ /'gro kun kun mkhyen lam ston stono pa mastsag /dge mtsharno mtsharno dpe'i dkyil 'khor 'khong lo'i 'dzum/ sgo/'khri 'di 'di ltar skal bzeng bzeng dgur thob/ sne /ceso bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshirgos du bcad pa'i dbyengs skyas mngon par bstod pa'o//srid skyong rin po che'i drung nas/ tshe gling chos spyod dang / 'bras spungs chos spyod sogs kyi ljags lung gsan cing zhal 'don dang thugs 'dzin la brtson 107—650

par mdzad/ me khyi zla ba gnyis pa'i nang / yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa bdud las rnam rgyal gyi dbang sta gon dang bcas dbang brda 'phrod nges su gsan cing dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam sdom tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i steng / cho ga'i nyams bzhes kyang chag med mdzad/ 'di skabs zhig tu skyabs mgon chen po'i zhal snga nas mdangs nub mi nag po zhig yong nas khyod rang sku ngal chen po 'ong kyang sku tshe ring po yod zer nas shing tog zhig ster byung gsungs pa ma 'ong 'byung 'gyur gyi lung gsal bar bstan par nges/ yang nub gcig nga'i rtsar mi nag po mgo dang ske/ rkang lag mang po yod pa zhig byung gsungs/ de ni dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzigs snang byung bar mngon/ me phag lo nang / yongs 'dzin rin po che'i drung nas tshe rta zung 'brel/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/gnyen po lha bzhi bcas kyi rjes gnang gsan cing / yongs 'dzin dang lhan du gzim chung dga' ldan yang rtser de dag gi ljags bsnyen mdzad skabs shig tu gzim dpon lags su nub gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i bskangs gso gtong dgos khyed rang dpe char bltas te mnyam du 'don dgos gsungs/ bskangs pa'i mtshams su zhal phra phye zhig /gang mthong byung gsungs par gang yang ma mthong zhus pas/ dpal ldan lha mo phebs byung da mi 'dug zhal phra rgyob gsungs/gzab gsol skabs zhal thang la gzigs nas ri rgyar sdod skabs dgong mo rtag par 'ongs pa'i mi gnyis po 'di red zhes jo bo dang / 'brom la phyag mdzub gtad par gnang ba sogs gzigs snang mang du byung zhing lhag par jo 'brom gnyis zhal gzigs nar mar yod pa gdon mi za yang thugs sgam pas gsal 107—651

bar ma gsung ngo / /zla ba dgu pa'i tshes lnga nyin phar phyin gsan bzhes dbu 'dzugs rten 'byung slad yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis nas phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gyi steng nas ljags khrid rags tsam 'bul bzhes mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin dgung skeg las grol zhing 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan slad yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che nas/ 'phags pa rin po che'i spyan sngar stong mchod dang bcas rnam par rgyal ma'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs mdzad de gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang khams brtan par byas/ skabs skabs su skye rgya'i mos blo dang 'tsham pa'i 'dod chos kyang stsal/ me phag zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nyin bcad rgya'i skabs nyi 'od dbu gur rgya khang du ljags thun grub nas sku phyag phyag gdan steng bka' mol gyi mu gang yang med par snang med zhig la snga nyin lun am ban nas ljon 'bras tsha lum 'bul mi khrims dpon ched gtong mdzad pa'i tsha lum rnams gsol thab nas bkrus te dngul gzhong nang yod pa de rnams gsol lcog steng 'don gnang song bar de skabs kyi sku bcar gzim dpon gsham du phyag 'tshal gyin yod pa la 'bod pa gnang ste mig ltos dang 'di gsum paṇa chen gyi yang srid skor yin cung mi 'dra tsam yod pa 'di dwags rgyu/ 'di thob rgyal / 'di la mo yin pas ngo shes pa byed dgos gsungs te tsha lum rdog gsum dngul gzhong du blugs nas 'phags pa rin po che dang lha mor zhal phyogs te bh+yo bdun ma gsung bzhin par dngul gzhong phyag gis bskor gnang mdzad song bar sku bcar gzim mkhan nas yengs med bltas par gsum gshibs kyis yud tsam 'khor mthar dwags rgyu yin zhes pa de 'phar te sku mdun du thon song bar dwags po red ces phebs pa dang / slar yang de gtan khel e yin zhes yang tsha lum 187—652

gsum ga dngul gzhing nang blugs te bh+yo bdun ma zhal 'don mdzad bzhin par bskor gnang mdzad song bar yang dwags r+ghaṃ yin zhes pa de bzhin 'phar te sku mdun du thon/ thob rgyal dang la mo yin zhes pa'i tsha lum gnyis mnyam gshib kyis sku rgyab phyogs phyir song bas paṇa chen gyi yang srid dwags rgyu gtan khel red ces phebs/ rjes su gser bum nas kyang dwags r+ghaṃ thon pas yid ches nges pa rnyed / gong zla'i tshes bzhi nyin/ gzim chung phun tshogs 'dod 'khyil du phyag bris gnang mus gsung 'phros kyi mu gang yang med par snang med zhig la mdang nga'i rmi lam du gnas chung chos skyong phebs te gzim dpon lags rang gi skor kha shas zhig gsung byung ba gzhan nges po mi 'dug cing / khyod rang la bar chad kyi ngo zhig 'dug /bla ma mgon po dbyer med rgyun 'don byed dgos zhes lab dgos chos skyong nas gsung byung bas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /zhes sogs 'don dgos phebs pa dang / de nub sku gzim grub nas kyang bla ma mgon po dbyer med mang nyung ji ltar rung ba nyin ltar ma chag pa ma shi'i bar 'don dgos zhes nan tan phebs/ sa byi zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la paṇa chen mchog gi sprul sku rin po che'i dbu'i gtsug phud bzhes te/ mtshan blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang po zhes gsol te bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nang dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sde chen por chos zhugs kyi slad du chibs bskyod thog kun dga' rwa bar thugs gnyer gsan bzhes dbu 'dzugs/ 7gong sa mchog dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis / mtshan zhabs dge bshes bcas rten 'brel legs skyes dang 'brel brtsi bzhag dang / shing rta'i srol 'byed nas bgro gleng mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dgongs 187—653

don ji lta ba bzhin rigs pa'i lam nas drangs te phul ba la/ ji skad du/tshig phreng lbu bas ngoms pa mi mnga' zhing / mkhas mchog bye bas rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas/ /zhib cing ches phra dri med rigs pa yis/ /ma lus chos kun gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 7gong sa mchog nyid gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la gsan sgom mthar phyin pa'i bag chags kyi mthu yongs su sad de gsung lan thogs med du gnang bas kun kyang 'di lta bu'i dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar bstan pa ni ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor bar gyur/ sgo mang grwa tshang dang blo gling grwa tshang so sor chibs zhal bsgyur te dgyes ston 'bul bzhes thog /mjal dmang stsal/chos ra so sor chos 'brel dang / bgro gleng mdzad de dpyis phyin pa lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs te mtha' chod pa'i zhib cha bcas gsung rab kyi dgongs don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i 'bel gtam dang gsung lan thogs med du mdzad pa'i sngon goms dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar mthong / bar du yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'jigs byed dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs dbang lung kyang 'bul bzhes mdzad/ sngags pa gra tshang du dgyes ston thog mjal mang dang / chos 'brel kyang stsal/ yi dam sku brnyan sogs rten gsar bzhengs rnams la 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgo nas rab gnas gnad smin mdzad de/ dam ye dbyer med kyi rtags mtshan gsal bar shar chos skyong thog phebs kyi snyan dar sna lnga phul ba dbu ras bzhes/ lha rgyal glu dbyangs kyis mchod de dge mtshan spel/ gsang sngags mkhar bkra shis khang gsar ba'i dkar spro'i dgyes ston thog rnam grwa tshogs yongs su chos 'brel kyang gnang /107—654

dge 'phel ri khrod du chibs zhal bsgyur te/ sku'i bcad rgya zhag bdun mdzad/nag po'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bsangs mchod/ dgra lha dpangs bstod bcas mdzad de bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma byung / de nas se ra theg chen gling du chibs bsgyur mdzad rgyu'i lam bar dbang drag rol pa'i dga' tshal rdo rje sgra dbyangs gling du phebs skabs bstan srung chen po rdo rje grags ldan chibs bsur phebs / mjal dar dang mthun rdzas bstar/ dkar spro dgyes ston mjal mang bcas dang / chos skyong chen po nas dngos 'bul/ phyi nang gi rten rnams mchod yon lhan rgyas la gsang bas spyan zhu bstar/ de nas se rar chibs bskyod kyi dgon gsham du bya khri khog rloms kyis phebs bsu'i mjal dar dang mthun rdzas sbel gzim chung phebs ston dkar spro/ ser smad thos bsam nor bu'i gling dang ske/ ser byes mkhas snyan grwa tshang du chibs bsgyur mdzad de dgyes ston dkar spro / mjal mang / chos rar chos 'brel dang / bgro gleng bcas mkhas rnams mgu ba bskyed pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis tshogs pa mtha' dag mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod/ ser sngags grwa tshang du'ang dkar spro'i dgyes ston rol zhing /chos 'brel kyang gnang / ser byes har gdong du phebs te sngar lam mdzad sgo nyams med bskyangs/ de nas dben gnas pha bong kha kun bzang nags khrod rdo rje'i pho brang du chibs kha bsgyur/ ri khrod dge slong rnams nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bar mjal kha dang / chos 'brel kyang stsal/ de ga'i gnas rten la mchod 'bul dang 'brel thugs smon rgya cher mdzad de me tog 'thor/ de nas se rar chibs kha bsgyur/ de ltar 7gong sa rgyal dbang mchog nyid shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed gzhung la dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas 187—655

rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs don gtan la 'bebs pa'i gsan sbyong legs par grub ste/ ded dpon rin po che'i gling nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lon pa ltar thugs dgyes bzhin du pho brang chen po po tā lar zhabs sor bkod/de dag gi bar du yang / zhabs brtan 'bul mi/ phyogs 'grul mang por 'dod chos ci rigs su stsal te so so'i re 'dod yid bzhin du bskangs/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin rigs kyi bdag po yongs 'jin phur lcog rin po che'i drung nas bde mchog lū i pa'i dbang chen cha lag dang bcas pa legs par gsan te dpal ldan gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi bshad sgrub yar zla ltar rgyas pa'i thugs bskyed mdzad/ gzhan yang klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang / ljags lung 'ga' shas kyang gsan/ sa glang zla ba dang po'i nang sde dge sa skyong 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje/ sku bcar dza zur dar han blo bzang tshe dbang gi rjes 'jug nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor chibs bsgyur gyi tshogs dbus phebs/ tshes bco lnga nyin gsung chos dang /bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam dang 'brel mdzad sgo rgya cher bstar/sa glang zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer lnga nyin sde dge rgyal po dang / dza zur dar han gyi rjes 'jug nas smon lam tshogs dbur gdan zhus yar phebs kyi nub mo mtshan gzim khang du sku phyag skabs byang rgyud kyi zhal dkar 'khris phebs te yud tsam bzhugs/ de skabs kyi sku bcar gzim dpon phyag 'tshal gyin yod par 'dir ltos dang gsungs/ des sku mdun du phyin nas bltas par zhal dkar sgo spang la sol ba'i ri mos mi mgo bo rgya yod pa zhig 'dri gnang mdzad de mdangs rmi lam la mi 'di 'dra zhig gis bltas te khyed rang sku tshe ring po yong zhes nan 107—656

gyis zer byung bas da nang gsol ja'i skabs 'dir sol bas de ga rang 'dra ba zhig bris pa yin phebs/ gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen po nas legs skyes gser gyi bka' bzang / dngos 'bul gya rnam pa stsal ba bdag gir bzhes / yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i drung nas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi dbang chen/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/rnam sras bcas kyi rjes gnang byad grol gser gyi lde mig bcas dang / lung chos kyang 'ga' shas gsan/ thugs rje chen po'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/ lcags stag zla ba dang po'i nang yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che dang / rwa sgreng ho thog thu rnam gnyis nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs / tshes bco lnga'i nyin gsung chos/ smon lam skam tshogs sogs mdzad sgo rnams sngar srol nyams pa med par mdzad/ zla ba gsum par yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i drung nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dbang gong ma gong chen sogs dam pa'i phyag bzhes nyams pa med pa sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges su gsan bzhes mdzad/ dus 'khor tshogs mgon du byon te/ sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i cho ga /gar dbyangs/ phyag rgya sogs cha phra mo tsam yang nyams pa med par phyag bzhes su bstar/ yang yongs 'dzin de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang /rnam rgyal ma'i rjes gnang sogs mang tsam gsan/ sgrol dkar gyi bcad rgya mdzad de sku tshe tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ lcags yos zla ba dang po'i nang bstan gling bla brang dang zhabs zur blo bzang phun tshogs gnyis nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur chibs zhal 187—657

bsgyur te mdzad sgo rnams nyams med bstar/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga la 7gong sa mchog phar phyin gyi gsan bsam mthar phyin pa'i dgyes ston dang /dbu ma'i gzhung lugs la gsan bzhes dbu tshugs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar phye / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin mdo smad gter ston bsod rgyal gyis slob dpon sku brnyan gdan drangs par snyan dar dang thugs smon gnang / tshes gnyis nas bzung 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i dag snang gsang ba rgya can gyi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du yongs 'dzin de nyid kyi drung nas gsan bzhes gnang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang rgya can phur pa'i ljags bsnyen bcad rgya dang / kha skong gi sbyin sreg bcas mdzad/ yongs 'dzin mchog dang / drung spyi nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes mdzad/ yongs 'dzin de nyid kyi drung nas rdzong chung tshe dbang dang / bla mchod kyi ljags lung sogs mang tsam gsan/ chu 'brug zla ba dang po'i tshes nang dur bed wang shog mdzod pa nas gsol ba btab pa ltar sprul sku'i zhabs brtan ljags rtsom gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nyin dpal ldan thal 'gyur ba'i bzhed srol dbu ma'i dgongs don dri ma med pa thugs su chud nas/ bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba'i dgongs 'grel slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi bzhed gzhung mdo rtsa 'grel la gsan bzhes dbu 'dzugs kyi dgyes ston mdzad/ dur bod gsang sngags chos 'khor gling gi mkhan po nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ ma gcig grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dam pa'i phyag bzhes ltar nyams med du stsal/ de'i snga phyi rnams su dad ldan rnams kyi 'dod mos ltar brgyad stong pa sogs kyi ljags lung kyang mang du stsal/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i drung nas dus 'khor gyi cho ga 187—658

sogs ljags lung mang du gsan/ chu sprul lo nang / mtsho sna ba'i ṭika chen 'dul gzhung thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin rung / par bgres skyon che bas ma gsal bar brten bstan la sman pa'i dgongs bzhed bla na med pas par gzhi gsar bskrun bka' drin bskyangs/ yongs 'dzin gling sprul rin po che'i drung nas rje ye shes rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ myur lam dmar khrid/ lam zin drang srong bla ma'i zhal lung sogs ljags lung 'ga' shas gsan/ shing rta zla ba dang po'i nang sde drug ho thog thu dang / smon grong shag tshang nas gsol ba btab pa ltar smon lam chen mor chibs bsgyur thog /tshogs phebs mdzad sgo sngar lam bzhin bskyangs/ tshes nyer dgu nas bzung / grub chen a sgyu ka ras bzhed srol dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba dang / kṛ ya sa muts+tsha gnyis zung du 'brel ba phreng kṛ sbrag ma'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga dang / grub chen mi tra dz+wa ki'i bzhed srol mi tra brgya rtsar grags pa byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams zhing / ljags bsnyen sogs legs par mthar phyin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ dbang gi rim pa slob ma rjes 'dzin dang / gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dbang gi sta gon/ de nas snga dro bya spyod/ phyi dro bla med la rgyud sde so sor sta gon re bcas sngon byon dam pa'i phyag bzhes nyams pa med pa phyag len zhib rgyas su gsung bshad kyis mtha' brgyan te gsan bzhes gnang /slar yang yongs 'dzin de nyid kyi drung nas/ rnam snang mngon byang / thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/ rnam 'joms lha mang / gshed dmar/ dgra nag /zhe dgu ma/ ro langs brgyad bskor/ phyag rdor 'khor chen bcas kyi dbang dang ske/ mgon chen bcu gsum/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ chos rgyal yang 187—659

gsang dug ri/ mgon po snying zhugs bcas kyi rjes gnang legs par gsan/de nas 'dul ba'i sde snod la gsan bsam mthar phyin nas/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi bzhed gzhung mngon pa mdzod la gsan sbyong dbu 'dzugs kyi rten 'brel mdzad/ seng bar du'ang dad ldan rnams la 'dod chos ci rigs stsal/'dul ba lung las/ nye bar 'khor/ ji srid du las byed pa yang yod/ nan tan byed pa yang yod pa de srid du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /gang na las byed pa yang med/ nan tan byed pa yang med pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhig pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig rten na gnas mi gnas ni dam chos 'dul ba yod med la rag lus par gsungs pa dang /bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes sogs bka' dang dgongs 'grel du ma nas rgya cher bsngags pa ltar dkar chos kun gyi rtsa ba 'dul ba'i bslab gzhi yang dag par blangs nas tshul bzhin bsrung ba nyag gcig la rag las par dgongs te myos byed ces pa shing lug zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig la gnas phun sum tshogs pa lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por ston mchog mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhal tshab jo bo chen po shākya mu ni dang / thub dbang sta zur ma/'dul ba lung bzhi'i glegs bam sogs rten mchog rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin phung tshar du dngar ba dang bcas pa/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa phur lcog yongs 'dzin blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas mkhan slob sbrag ma/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gling sprul rin po che blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dpal bzang pos gsang ste ston pa/107—660

mang thos 'dul ba 'dzin pa sgrub khang mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas dus go ba/ khri chen blo bzang tshul khrims dang /shar byang chos rje rnam gnyis sogs brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po legs par bzhes te nye bar 'khor slar yang byon pa ltar 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan du lham mer mdzes par gyur to/ /gnas chung chos rgyal chen po thog 'bebs kyis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul/ brtan bzhugs 7zhabs brtan dang / khrus gsol/ rab gnas bcas lhan rgyas mdzad / de nas khyams ra chen mor ston chen dang / srid skyong mdun na 'don sogs gzhung zhabs ser skya/ gdan sa gsum sogs kyi bla brang rnams kyis legs 'bul bstar/ drung spyi dang / bstan gling bla brang bcas nas smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbus su gdan drangs te legs 'bul gyi mchod sprin rgya cher spros / gsung chos sogs mdzad sgo byings sngar lam ltar bskyangs/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang nor gling gzim chung du rgya can gu ru drag po'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/seng bar du 'grul rigs rnams la 'dod chos ljags lung mang du stsal/ de nas de mo ho thog thu srid skyong dgongs zhu nan tan mdzad pa dang / 7 gong sa 7skyabs mgon mchog kyang sku'i na tshod mtshan dkyil yongs su rdzogs te chos srid skyong ba'i skabs su bab par brten/ bod 'bangs lha mi mgrin gcig gis gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa na/ ji skad du/ dga' ldan chos srid pho brang skyong ba'i lha/ /mang pos bkur ba'i bka' rtags lung gi ljid/ /dzam+bu bṛk+ṣas mtshan pa'i nor 'dzin mngal/ /khur ldan phan bde'i rngul chu 'dzag par 107—661

shog /ces gsungs pa ltar dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i chos srid zung du 'jug pa sde bzhi'i dpal dang ldan pa'i pho brang chen po'i bka' rtags lung gis lci ba'i lugs gnyis kyi bgyi ba'i khur rlabs po che de nyid sngon gyi sdom brtson rgyal po'i rnam thar dang mthun par gang gi lhag bsam gyi phrag par 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes te/ khrums stod bkra shis zla ba'i tshes brgyad dge bar gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por lha mi 'gro ba kun gyi bdag por dbang bskur mnga' gsol zhing / dregs ldan che rgu mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan gyis mchod par gyur to/ /de yang ji skad du bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bod 'di rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /ces dang / legs bshad las/ 'jig rten bya ba legs shes pa/ /de yis dam pa'i chos lugs 'grub/ /de na chos lugs spyod pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod 'dul dka' ba'i gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sa chen skyong ba'i tshul bzung nas bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig bsgrub par bshad pa dang mthun par gzhan phan gyi thabs la mkhas pa spyod pa'i yan lag tu rgyal rigs kyi tshul bzung ba'i 'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes pa kho na'o/ /7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po mchog nas lugs gnyis 'gan bzhes bka' drin che bar gzhung sa bod ljongs lha sde mi sde rnams nas gsol ston dang 'brel legs 'bul dgyes bzhes mdzad/ de skabs 7gong ma bdag po chen po nas gser gyi bka' yig gi sgo nas nub phyogs rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ sngar lam srid skyong zur pa de mo ho thog thu nas dngul tham sogs 'bul bzhes mdzad/ me spre zla ba dang por yongs 'dzin 107—662

gling mchog sprul rin po che nas gsol ba btab ngor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs cing mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar bskyangs/ nor gling du bla sprul dang —/ rnam grwa tshogs par rnam grwa'i chos spyod/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa/lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung bcas kyi ljags lung stsal/ me bya lo nang tre bo khang gsar sprul skus gsol ba btab pa ltar smon lam chen mo'i tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyur thog mdzad lam sngar bzhin bskyangs/ 7gong ma mchod yon chab srid yar rgyas 'byung phyir 7gong sa mchog dang / gdan sa gsum gyi bla sprul che chung slob dpon gdan zur/ grwa tshang tshogs yongs bcas nas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bdag bskyed dang 'brel ba'i drug cu ma/ rgyags brngan lha bsangs dang /dgra lha 'od ldan dkar po spyan drangs bka' nan rab brjid kyi sgo nas bstan 'gror dge ba'i thugs smon dang / bka' bsgo nan tan mdzad/ de dag la 'di skad ces bsngags te/ zag bral ye shes dzasbu nā da yi/ /'khor lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres kun chub kyang ske/ /mthun snang gsan bsam sgom la 'grus tshul mdzad/ /'on te rang bzhin sgrib tu med pas na/ /jo 'brom 'jigs mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa'i/dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu bgro ba mdzad/ /dam can bstan srung rnams kyang bran du 'khol/ /mkhyen pa'i grwa zur gcig tu dog med par/ /bka' pod gzhung brgya mtha' dag bcug pa na/ /gangs can mkhas pa kun gyis mgrin gcig tu/ /'phags yul rgyan drug nyid du dogs cing bsngags/ /tshang ldan rigs kyi cod pan du ma las/ /dbang khrid man ngag zab don a mṛ ta/ /thugs kyi bum bzang gang byor gsan pa ni/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad dang 107—663

gnyis su med/ /mkhas mang khri phrag 'dus pa'i tshogs dbus dang / /dad ldan du mar gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /nges legs sa bon bskrun pa'i dga' ston dag /bar dang bar du stsol la ngal mi mnga'/ /spang bya'i khyad par kun thub nyes med kyi/ /phun sum tshogs ldan cho ga las bskrun pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs tshul khrims dngos po thub pa'i mdzod/ /gzung tshe thub dbang bstan pa'i bdag po khyod/ /'phrin las rin chen bdun du lding ba yis/ /'gro tshogs rdzogs ldan rwa bar bsrung ba'i slad/ /chos srid gser gyi 'khor lo phyogs kun las / /rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag cha bdag gir mdzad/ /zla ba zhun mar bsil ba'i rdzogs ldan gyi/ /grib ma snum por ngal bso'i mchog sbyin pa'i/ /thugs rje'i gdugs dkar srid pa gsum gyi blar/ /bsgrengs kyang gangs can pa la khyad par thob/ /chos srid chos spyod bcu yis rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rgyal srid dge bcu'i khrims kyis 'gro ba'i bde/ /spel ba'i rnam thar mchog gi rgyal mtshan khur / /khyod kyi phrag par ngal ba med par sgrengs/ /gzhung mang mang thos legs bshad bshad grar mkhas/ /zab don don gnyis dpal yon yon tan rdzogs / sgo/tshul gakhrims khrims ldan tshogs kun thonas gtso/ /chos sad sgod zhi'i dga' ston ston mjed rgyarme/ /zhes bya stob yong bar skabs kyi tshines du bcad pa'i dbyengs 4kyis bsngags pa'o//sa khyi lo nang / 7gong sa rnam 'dren chen po gang nyid yongs 'dzin dam pa rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te gzhung lugs bka' pod lnga zur bkol dang bcas pa la gsan bsam gyi mdzad pa mthar phyin nas mtshan btags kyi grwa skor dam bca' bstan pa'i mig rgyan du che ba mdzad slad chos sde chen po dpal ldan 107wa 664

'bras spungs su chibs bsgyur gyis/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i snga char tshogs chen rdo gcal pad spungs steng bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod 'phral yongs 'dzin gling sprul rin po che nas mjal dar rten gsum dang / 'khor lo/dung dkar 'bul gnang thog zhal 'don dpal ldan yon tan ma grub bstun/gong sa mchog nas spyi bshad gus 'dud dang mkhan po khri pa nas gzhung 'god dang ske/ de 'brel slob dpon bla sprul dge bshes rigs lung ba rnams nas rim pa bzhin bka' pod lnga la rtsa 'grel gzhung tshigs dang mthun pa'i brgal brtag gi rigs lam cha phra mo nas phul ba la/ grub mtha' so so'i bzhed srol rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don dang 'gal zhing / zlos bur smra ba'i skyon dang bral ba rang lugs kyi 'dzin mtshams ma 'chol ba sogs gzhung dang mthun pa'i gsung lan 'jigs med seṅge'i nga ros rgol ngan wa skyes kyi spobs pa 'phrog cing mkhas rnams mgu ba bskyed pa'i dga' ston rmad du byung ba bskrun pas kun kyang dga' dang gus gsum phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyur to/ /de rjes gdan sa'i rigs lam pa rnams dam bcar 'khod de/ 7gong sa mchog nas rtags gsal lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs te dpag par dka' ba gnang / chos skyong chen po nas maṇ+ḍal zhabs brtan 7snyan sgron zhus/ tshes bco brgyad nyin yongs 'dzin shar pa chos rje gling sprul rin po che nas 7gong sa mchog mkhas mang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su gdan drangs dngos 'byor 'bul ba dang / zhabs brtan gsol 'debs mdzad/ de rjes gnas chung sku rten tā bla ma shākya yar 'phel dang ske/ sgo mang lha ram pa blo bzang rdo rje gnyis nas tshogs dbus su gdan drangs te dngos 'bul dgyes bzhes thog thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ dge 107—665

'phel ri khrod dang / dbu rtser chibs bskyod rgyal bstan dar zhing / 'gro kun bde ba'i smon tshig gnang / 'bras spungs nas rdo rje sgra dbyangs gling du chibs bsgyur gyi gzab gsol dang / chos skyong chen por 'phrin las spel ba'i bskangs bskul mdzad/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gcig nyin se ra theg chen gling du chibs bsgyur thog grwa tshang byes smad gnyis su grwa skor dam bca' bgro gleng sogs 'bras spungs ltar mdzad/ de nas pha bong kha kun bzang rdo rje'i pho brang du chibs zhal bsgyur te gnas gzigs thugs smon mdzad/ se rar mdzad sgo grub nas pho brang chen po po tā lar 7zhabs sor 'khod/ tshes bcu drug nyin gdan sa chen po 'brog dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du chibs zhal bsgyur te/ dkar spro mdzad sgo rnams nyams med dang / shar byang gi grwa tshang so sor chos rar chos zhugs mtshon byed 7zhabs sor 'khod de/ slob dpon nas bgro gleng phul/slob dpon dam bcar 'khod de 7gong sa mchog nas rtags gsal gnang /tshes nyer bzhi nyin tshogs chen du grwa skor dam bca' chen mor zhabs sor 'khod de / byang shar slob dpon/ bla sprul/ dge bshes drag rigs bcas pa bgro gleng se 'bras ltar gnang / dbang bskur ri'i rtser bsangs 'phrin rgyas par mdzad / de 'brel gnas gzigs dang / mchod 'bul/ brtan bzhugs rab gnas sogs gnang / gser khri chen mo'i steng nas gso sbyong mdzad de dge ldan ring lugs dar ba'i legs tshogs rten 'brel bsgrigs par mdzad/ de yang / mthong ba don ldan mdzes sku mtshan dpes spras/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs thos pas grol/ /gting mtha' dpog min thugs kyis gzhan rjes 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog khyed brtan gyur cig /ces gsungs 187—666

pa ltar mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba thams cad smin grol gyi lam bzang por bkri bar mdzad nas/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin ri bo dga' ldan nas pho brang chen por chibs bskyod kyi lam zhir du'ang 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad de ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra che po tā la bcas la gnas gzigs kyis se 'bras dge gsum du gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas mang gi mdun sar grwa skor dam bca' legs par mdzad zin pa bstan pa'i sman yon du 'gyur ba'i thugs smon rgya cher bskyangs/ de ltar 7gong sa mchog nas grwa skor dam bca' chen mo legs grub kyi bka' drin gsab phyir/ gzhung gnas/ drung spyi/ tsho chen bcas nas dkar spro dang dngos 'bul bcas zhus/ 'grul rigs sogs dang dad ldan skye bo mang por mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i 'dod chos kyang mang du stsal/sa phag zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum nyin 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po smon lam chen mo'i grwa skor mtshan bzhes kyi rlon tshogs gsum dang / gsung chos/nyin gung dam bca'/ dgongs mo'i dam bca' bcas so sor zhabs sor bskyod de blo gsal mkhas mang tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su bdag nyid chen po phyogs glang dang chos grags mu stegs kyi rgol ba 'joms phyir zhugs pa bzhin du dri ma med pa'i rigs pa'i nga ro dang 'bel ba'i gtam gyis mkhas pa mtha' dag dgyes pa'i snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur pa ni/ 'chad pas skal ldan gdul bya rjes su 'dzin/ /rtsod pas phyir rgol snying rtsa lkog mar 'dren / /tshig sbyor don bzang rtsom pas rgyal bstan g.ya'/ /sel la blo bzang rgya mtsho'i rjes 'gror shog /ces gsungs pa dang mthun par gyur to/ /tshes bcu bzhi nyin yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che nas tshogs dbus su spyan drangs/107—667

thugs smon mdzad sgo sngar lam gnang / lcags byi zla ba dang po'i nang sgo mang mtshan zhabs blo bzang ngag dbang nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ lha ldan smon lam tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur gyis mdzad sgo sngar ltar bskyangs/ ji skad du ston pas/ kun dga' bo/ khyod kyis mkhan po dang slob dpon byas nas rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa byas na nga la bya ba byas pa yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar mdzad pa thams cad kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa yin pas de'i phyir rang nyid kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dri bsung la 'khor ba'i dad ldan gyi skyes bu dbus gtsang khams gsum mtha' dag dang / tha na rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang gling bar tshun chad nas rang dbang med par 'dus pa dag la dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa rnams gnang ba ni bgrangs pa las 'das te/ 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad rje nyid la bslab pa mnos pa'i khrims ldan gyis khyab cing /lhag par 'dir yang tshe chog gling sprul sku sogs la rab byung dang / mnga' ris sprul sku sogs bsgrub bya nyis brgyar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun stsal/ bka'i mdun na 'don dang / bla khag gis mtshon lha sde mi sde rnams nas dgung skeg gi 7zhabs brtan 'bul bzhes mdzad/ de nas lho dwags khul gyi gnas dang rten rnams mjal bar bzhed de zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin chibs bskyod thog yar lam ri bo dga' ldan nas mal gro brgyud/ 'ol kha/ chos 'khor rgyal/dwags la sgam po/ tsā ri/ 'khrungs gzhis/ yar lung khul/ bsam yas sogs kyi rten rnams la mchod 'bul gnas gzigs dang 'brel bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs smon mtshams sbyor bla na ma mchis pa gnang / de dag gi skabs 187—668

su gzigs snang ngo mtshar can mang du byung yang zhib tu 'bri ma spobs/ bod 'bangs spyir rdo rje tsher ma'i nad rims lci ba yod pa de dag myur du zhi phyir sku bsnyun tshul bzhes stabs/ gzhung zhabs ser skya/ gdan sa gsum sogs so so nas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs skyabs rten phul bas bsnyun gzhi myur dwangs kyi tshul bzhes/ de nas pho brang chen po po tā lar phebs/ sems dpa' sprul sku dang / lho pa sprul sku/ ser byes sog po sprul sku sogs bsgrub bya grangs chig stong skor la dge tshul dang / bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/ pha bong kha kun bzang rdo rje'i pho brang du gso sbyong dang / bcad rgya mdzad/ lcags glang zla ba dang po dang / sa zla/ drug pa tshes bzhi/ dgu pa lha bab bcas so sor bsgrub bya grwa tshig stong lnga brgya la rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ rnam grwa dge slong blo bzang byang chub nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 7gong sa phyag na pad+mo mchog nas/gzhung zhabs ser skya/ gdan sa gsum dang / gzhis dgon mtha' dag 'dus pa'i bla sprul/ dge bshes ser skya pho mo bcas nyis stong brgal bar thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs kyi dbang gi sta gon/ dngos gzhi mtha' rten bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi mthun 'gyur dang bcas pa dang / de'i rjes gnang / nyer mkho'i ljags lung sogs dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin nyams pa med par gsung bshad zhib rgyas dang bcas pa smin rgyas su stsal/ chu stag zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog nas gsol ba btab don bzhin/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du 7gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas mkhan slob sbrag ma mdzad de/ /dga' ldan khri gdan zur/ shar byang chos rje bcas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bslab gzhi 187—669

yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi bslab sdom stsal/ de mtshungs lo nang der bsgrub bya nyis stong brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi bslab sdom stsal/ bar skabs su dad ldan rnams la 'dod chos mang du gnang / rtser dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ljags bsnyen dang / sbyin sreg kyang mdzad/ chu yos lo nang bsgrub bya chig stong lnga brgya skor la bslab sdom stsal/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin tho 'dzugs cho ga dang bcas 'jigs byed kyi ljags bsnyen mdzad/ shing 'brug zla ba gsum bar bstan dgra rmeg med bzlog phyir chog gra dang bcas 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sgo nas mnan bsreg 'phangs gsum gyi las mtha' mdzad/bcad rgya'i khongs nas bsgrub bya tshig stong brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi bslab sdom stsal / de nas byang phyogs kyi gdul bya'i re ba skong ba dang / bod ljongs skye 'gro'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba chab srid kyi don du/ shing 'brug zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin rtse pho brang nas chibs zhal bsgyur bar/ yab gzhis sku ngo rnams nas ngu ngag gis gsol ba btab par zhabs sor myur du 'khod rgyu'i zhal bzhes dbugs dbyung stsal/ rta lam sgor mor 'ug pas chibs 'og 'dzul ba dang /chibs gdong phar tshur 'gro ba ni chos skyong lcam sring nas chibs zhal smad phyogs su bsgyur ba la mi bzod pa'i mtshan ma gsal bar bstan/ de nas gling bu rdzong sar phur lcog bla brang nas phebs bsgrig sar bzhugs zhag dang / de nas rim gyis rwa sgreng du bzhugs zhag nyin gsum la mjal kha dang bslab ston stsal/ tshes nyi shu nyin me rdo shar par bzhugs zhag thog nag chu mkhan nang 'go pa bcas phebs bsur bcar/ ma 'dangs nas sgrub khang sprul skus phebs bsur bcas gdan drangs nag chur bzhugs zhag bdun mdzad/ sgrub khang sprul sku rin po 107—670

ches dbus zhabs brtan dgon gyi bla brang dang / de phyogs kyi skye bo rnams la thugs rje chen po dang / rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang dang / ma ṇi'i ljags lung sogs chos 'brel dang / ngal bso'i dbugs dbyung stsal/ sgrub khang sprul sku nas thugs mkho dang / nag chu tsho pas rta brgya 'bul zhus/ bā rin bla ma rin po che dang / sog po zhig mjal te dngos 'bul thog lhan du zhabs zhur bcar/de ni sog yul gyi gzhi bdag nas phebs bsur bskul bar nges/ tshes bcu nyin gdang la'i rtser dgra lha dpangs bstod dang 'brel dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyi dbu 'phang srid rtser bstod de ba zhed don 'grub pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ de nub na ring shig chen mor bzhugs/ gsol tsha'i sar mgo log pa'i jag pa thab khag sum cu skor 'dug zhes thos par sku 'khor rnams dogs gnas che bar byung yang 7gong sa mchog nas blo dogs ma dgos pa'i bka' slob dang 'brel chibs zhal bsgyur/ nub ma ring brgyud du bzhugs zhag mdzad skabs jag dpon bla ma'i gtsos dmangs rnams nas dngos 'bul rgya che'i thog mjal kha dang 'di phyi'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ tshes bcu gsum la 'bri chu khar bzhugs zhag dang / de nyin chu shin tu che zhing thar re bral kyang phebs mtshams rabs bde ba byung / de nas ri phug ha las su bzhugs zhag phebs bsgrigs zhus par/ der brag mi mo'i gzugs lta bu mi mgo shin tu gsal ba zhig 'dug pal/ der ngang tsam bzhugs nas da lta 'phral du 'gro zhes tshang ma stab stab por chibs zhal bsgyur/ de gar mun rub tu rlung 'tshub shin tu che bas lam yang mi mthong bar zhabs zhu phal cher kha 'thor sku mdun pa 'ga' shas bcas sgrogs mo'i la chung brgal te zhal ba'i nang du dbu gur sku 'khor rnams kyis phyogs 107—671

mnan nas bzhugs grub tsam byung / der rgyal 'gong gi gnod pa shin tu che ba zhig yod par 'phral du chibs bskyod grub ste thugs dam ting nge 'dzin gyi zil gyis mnan pas rlung 'tshub tsam las gzhan gnod pas ma tshugs pa ni/'jigs mdzad rdo rje 'gran bzod mthu stobs kyis/ /bgegs tshogs mtha' bral dbyings su rgyas btab nas/ /lhar bcas skye dgu yongs kyi dbang phyug skur/yongs bzhengs/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas rim gyis thal ji nor du dza sag dpon 'bangs rnams kyi phebs bsgrigs sar phebs nas dngos 'bul dang / rta sum brgya phul/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos kyi re ba bskangs te thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ nag chu'i phebs bskyel dang / rta dmag rnams phyir slog gnang / de nas khor lug pi si'i gdan drangs phebs bsgrig gzab rgyas thog dpon 'bangs/ dgon grwa bcas la snga phyir tshe dbang / rjes gnang / 'dod chos ci rigs stsal/ chibs rta gsum dang / rnga mong sbyar rtse sbyar ma brgya dang brgyad cu skor sogs dngos 'bul rgya cher phul/ gnang cha gsol ras zab rgyas stsal/ de nas sha ra sgo che nas g.yung drung pi si'i thog sde dgon rnams la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal/chos grar rtsod gzigs bskyangs/ yul der lo lnga la char ma babs par 7gong sa rin po cher gsol ba btab pa/ klu gtor dang khrus gsol gnang bas char rgyun shin tu bzang ba byung ba bcas so so'i re 'dod bskang dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba bstar / erte ni paṇ+ḍi ta ho thog thu'i bstan gling dgon par gdan drangs brtan bzhugs maṇ+ḍal bshad pa bcas phul te dngos 'bul gya rnam pa bstar/ tshe dbang ske/ rjes gnang lung khrid mang du gnang / chos rar phebs mtshan nyid kyi 187—672

'bel gtam kyang mdzad/ de nas san no yon dgon par gdan drangs dpon 'bangs dang dgon sde rnams la/ dbang rjes lung khrid sogs 'dod chos stsal/dngos 'bul tshad med pa phul bdun gcig bzhugs de skabs bod kyi dngul khang do dam rtse drung sogs bod kyi mi sna'i phebs bsu dang / rje btsun dam pa'i gsol dpon mkhan chung mtshams zhur bcar/ 7gong sa mchog nas kyang mtshams zhu 'bul mi gnang / shing 'brug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nyin khu ral gyi phebs bsgrigs gsol tsha'i thog /rje btsun dam pa'i thugs sras/ho thog thu khag /bla sprul/ rgya sog gi dpon po/ tshogs chen dang grwa tshang gsum gyi las sne bcas mjal phyag gnang / de nas grwa dmangs ser steng /rnga dung dar phyar sogs dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos gdan drangs/ dga' ldan shar du bzhugs/ gzhung sa'i rten gsum dkar spro dang mjal phyag zhus/ rje btsun dam pas sku 'khor rnams la 'bul ston rgyas par gnang / bkra shis chos 'phel gling / kun dga' chos gling / yid dga' chos 'dzin bcas grwa tshang so so'i chos rar phebs te rtsod rgyugs bzhes pa/ dpe khrid gnang ba bcas dag ther mdzad/ rgya sog gi dpon rigs dang / ser skya spyi la chos 'brel dang mjal mang gnang / shing sbrul gsar lo'i tshes gtor sogs sngar lam gnang /7gong yum chen mos mañdzu am ban la bka' phabs te sku srung dmag mi dang /dbyin ji'i don gcod skor gyi bka' yig /thugs mkho sogs rgya cher stsal/zla ba gsum par brgyad gtor sogs gnang / dbang rjes/ lung khrid sogs rgya sog gi mjal zhu rnams kyi so so'i re 'dod yongs su bskang / u cu mu ci ching wang nas brtan zhugs dang 'brel gos dar dang / rgya dngul khri 'bul zhus/107—673

khu ral dgon sde rnams kyi mi sna/ rgya sog dpon rigs sogs nas phebs skyel dang / de nas rim gyis mkha' 'gro ching wang gi phebs bsu/ ser sbreng sogs kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas/ mkha' 'gro chin wang rdo rje'i khu ral bkra shis lhun po gling du zhabs sor 'khod/ phebs ston mjal kha sogs rgyas par gnang / chos rar mtshan nyid kyi 'bel gtams/ dpe khrid/ bla grwa/dpon 'bangs bcas kyi mos pa dang mthun pa'i chos bka' stsal ba/ ljags rtsoms gnang ba/ rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa sogs bstan pa'i sman yon du smin par mdzad/ der bod kyi mi sna 'byor/ me rta lo'i dgung gsar gyi mdzad sgo mtha' dag rgyas par gnang / der rag lugs lha mo'i gtor sgrub skabs nyi mar 'ja' phyi nang rim pa gsum yod pa bar rtsibs dang / mthar 'ja'i 'dzar ldan kun gyi mthong lam gyur pa ya mtshan du byed/ gong sa mchog la gzigs snang khyad par can yod 'dug rung thugs sgam pas bka' ma stsal/yul de'i phur sngar chu yod kyang bar lam chu med par yun ring song ba/ 7gong sa mchog la gsol ba btab pas der chibs zhal bsgyur/ klu gtor dang /bden tshig mdzad pas chu sngar bzhin babs pa byung / de nas ol khang go lo nas rim brgyud/ dza ya nas gsol ba btab pa ltar phebs bsu'i bkod pa chen pos gdan drangs/ dga' ldan gling du zhabs sor 'khod de phebs ston zhus/tshogs phebs kyis bka' dbang sogs 'dod chos mang du stsal dngos 'bul rgya cher bstar/ chos rar bshad grwa la dag ther/ rab bsnyen sdom pa 'bog pa/sems bskyed cho ga /'dod chos ljags rtsom sogs bstan 'gro'i don bla na med pa mdzad/ dgon de'i gar 'chams/ sber ga /rdo mgyogs/ rta rgyugs 107—674

sogs spyan lam bstar/ mi rgan mgon po tshe ring gi 'chams rnam grwa bar slob sbyangs gnang / dza ya'i sku dmar gdung mjug ma 'khyongs par lus pa la pur sbyang gnang / 7gong yum chen mo nas nyid kyi phyag bstar spyan ras gzigs sku 'tshems grub ma/ dra gru'u/ dngul dngos rgya che ba dang / am ban/ sku srung dmag mi bcas stsal ba legs bzhes mdzad/ san no yon nas gdan zhus kyis dgon par zhabs sor 'khod/ dgon gyi bla grwa dpon bcas kyi 'dod mos dbang bka' rjes gnang lung khrid sogs dang / chos rar rtsod rgyug dang /dpe khrid mdzad/ der rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs mdzad de bkra shis dang dge mtshan du ma byung bar grags/ san no yon/ lcang jun gung bcas kyi phebs skyel zhus/ de nas rim gyis lam bar ser skya mjal mi rnams la 'dod mos kyi re ba bskangs/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig la sku 'bum bla spyi'i phebs bsu'i mjal zhus dang / sung kru'u yir/ lcang skya bla brang / sum pa mkhan chen sogs bla brang khag nas mtshams zhu bcar/ gzhung gnas kyi rtse shod drung rigs drug bcas nas 'byor phyag zhus/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ sku 'bum gyi phebs bsu sku 'bum khri pa sogs las sne'i phebs mjal zhus/ chibs rag /ser sbreng / spos sne bcas kyis sku 'bum byams pa gling gi gzim chung du gdan drangs / khri pas gtsos las sne rnams nas rten mjal zhus/ gser sdong rin po che dang / tshogs chen sogs gnas gzigs dang thugs smon mdzad/ tshogs dbur gdan drangs/ dge bshes dpa' ris rab gsal dang / zhwa dmar ye shes dge legs gnyis nas bgro gleng dang / mkhan an gya zi sprul sku nas maṇ+ḍal bshad pa 'bul thog dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba dang grwa dmangs la phyag 107—675

dbang dang / tshogs pa nyis stong brgal bar tshe dbang stsal/ rab byung brgya phrag brgal bar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun spel/ 7gong sa rin po ches mkhas grub zhwa dmar rin po che dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i drung nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams khrid dang / bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang /rngog dkyil sogs dbang dang man ngag mang du gsan/ de nas bde yang rin po che snyan grags rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen chen skor dang / gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi bka' khrid zab rgyas lhug par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ de dag gi lo tsā'i tshul che shos rdo rje 'chang nas mdzad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rab gsal rin po che'i drung nas snyan ngag le'u gsum pa'i khrid dper brjod dang bcas pa legs par gsan / dbyangs can sgra mdo'i steng nas sgra ris gsan bzhes kyi dbu 'dzug mdzad / de dag gi skabs su gdul bya'i mos pa dang 'tshams par chos bka' ci rigs kyang gnang / lnga mchod chen mo'i mchod 'bul sogs gnang / gser sdong rin po che'i sku mdun du nyin bzhin sku phyag brgya phrag re chag med gnang /'dzin grwa so so'i dpe cha ba rnams la dpe khrid dang / rtsod rgyugs bzhes pa sogs 'chad nyan la dag ther bla na med pa mdzad/ de ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan la kun gzigs lnga pa dang mtshungs par mdzad pa ni/ 'chad pas skal ldan gdul bya rjes su 'dzin/ /rtsod pas phyir rgol snying rtsa lkog mar 'dren/ /tshig sbyor don bzang rtsom pas rgyal bstan g.ya'/ /sel la blo bzang rgya mtsho'i rjes 'gror shog /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /me lug gnam lo'i dgung gsar mdzad sgo grub nas/ smon lam skabs gso sbyong /107—676

gsung chos la sngon 'gro'i zab bshad dang 'brel skyes rabs kyi dbu nas rags tsam thog rgyun gyis nyams len gyi rim pa cha tshang ba yid 'khul nges su stsal/smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur dang / mchod gzigs kyis mtshon bstan pa'i mig rgyan du che ba bla na med par mdzad/ de nas brgyad gtor chen mo dang / sa zlar rab bsnyen sdom rgyun spel ba dang / gsan bzhes/ 'chad spel sogs rgya cher mdzad/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin 7gong ma bdag po chen pos bka' phab pa ltar gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar chibs bsgyur mdzad rgyur sku 'bum gser sdong rin po che sogs la gnas gzigs thugs smon dang 'brel/zi ling rgya dpon rigs/ sku 'bum bla ma las sne bcas phebs skyel bla grwa yul mi bcas la phyag dbang stsal te rim gyis chibs zhal bsgyur/ lcang skya ho thog thu dang ske/ dgon lung / bkra shis chos gling sogs phebs lam du bla grwa rnams kyis gdan zhus kyi chos 'brel gyis thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ de nas lan grur tsong thu'i dpon rigs rnams kyis mjal kha dang / phebs bsgrigs/ dmag mi'i ru bsgrigs sogs rgyas par zhus/ de nas sang ko mir/ srin kru'i shing rngun pu/ lan tung brgyud cing shu'i yu'i to'o krin dgon par chibs bsgyur gyis sa spre dgung gsar sngar lam ltar dang / de nas chibs bsgyur gyis/ tshes bco brgyad nyin ri rtser dza sag gi phebs bsu dbu gur du phebs mtshams skabs/mgon po'i bla ri'i rtser 'ja' 'od gur khang shin tu ya mtshan pa byung ba rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs zhal 'dzoms pas dag pa'i snang ba khyad par can yod par mngon/ de nas chibs bsgyur gyis phu sar steng gzim chung du bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod/ gzhung sa/ gdan sa 187—677

gsum / bkras lhun/ drung spyi/ stong 'khor ho thog thu/ sku 'bum ches shos dang bla spyi/ ri rtse bla grwa/ rgya dpon sogs mjal kha bcas snga lam bskyangs/lcang skya ho thog thu sogs bla sprul/ sog po'i dpon rigs khag /gzhan dad ldan ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag nyin bzhin mjal mang dang / tshe dbang /spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang / lung khrid bar ma chad pa stsal te ci 'dod kyi re ba yongs su bskangs/ zla ba gsum par brgyad gtor chen mo sngar ltar dang /zla ba bzhi par lha ldan rgyal khab nas gdan zhur/ mkhan chen grags pa blo ldan sogs 'byor bar mjal kha gnang / rgyal khab rten 'bul mi sna/ mkhan chung blo bzang bstan 'dzin phyir 'khor gdong 7gong ma'i bka' yig gnang skyes 'bul bzhes bskyangs rgyur phu sar steng rigs gsum lha khang mdun khyams rwa bcas par phebs bsgrigs zhus te/ ri rtse dza sag dgon sde khag gi las sne/rgya dpon/ bod kyi gzhung zhabs che phra bcas bstar bsgrigs kyi rol cha bcas/7gong sa mchog bzhengs te bka' yig phyag tu phul/ man sog shan sbyar gnyis yod pa mkha' 'gro ching wang gung no yon/ sde drung gnyis nas 7snyan sgron zhus/gron ṭi dza sag / lo yer bcas la gnang cha stsal/ zla ba lnga par gza' skar dge ba'i nyin gnas chen ri bo dwangs bsil gyi 'jam dpal sde chen phu sar steng gzim chung kun gsal du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mtsho byung rol pa'i blo gros kyi drung nas dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel gsan bzhes legs par grub nas kun bshad kyi mtshan ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes gsol te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por legs 'bul dang /dgyes ston mdzad/ tshes lnga nyin 'khrungs skar chen mo'i dgyes ston dang /787—678

tshes bdun nas gnas chen ri bo rtse lngar ri bskor gnas gzigs sku 'khor hrag bsdus kyis mdzad par gang nas yong cha med sog po zhig nas 'jam dbyangs me tog chang pa gang phul/ rgya mi 'dra ba zhig nas spos shel gyi phreng ba rdog nyer gcig yod pa phul nas 'dir song med pa dang / tsan+dan gyi 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga bzhugs pa'i lha khang nas 'od zer lnga spros gzim chung sogs su zugs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung ba 'dir 'brir ma spobs/ rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs kyi sgrub phug tu grags pa kong yer gdong du zhag bdun gsum gyi ring thugs rje chen po'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/ zla ba drug par dbyar zhal bzhes dang ske/ yar mar gyi dus 'brel gso sbyong sogs legs par mdzad/ bo rod bka' 'gyur bla ma nas dgon pa gsar 'debs dang 'brel 7gong sa chen por 'bul sbyor zhus pas sku 'khor hrag bsdus kyis rab gnas dang rten 'brel spel/bar skabs rnams su dbang rjes lung khrid mang du stsal/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin 7gong ma chen po'i bka' 'brel pi cing rgyal khab tu chibs bsgyur skabs ri rtse'i dza sag sogs de phyogs kyi dpon rigs dgon pa'i las sne bcas chibs skyel/ phebs lam gyi dgon grwa dpon rigs rnams chibs bsu phebs bsgrigs/ drangs pa na/ dmag mi'i ru bsgrigs bcas rim gyis gdan drangasal/ 7gong yum hong tha'i hu'i bzhugs yul ri li ser po'i gzim chung du 7gong sa rin po che dang / de byings sku 'khor rnams sdod gnas bcas gzab rgyas stsal te/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la 7gong ma mjal 'phrad phebs lam du lo'i rda'o thal sogs dpon rigs/ 'go dmag nas drangs pa na/ dbu gdugs / nyi zla/ rtags rdzas sogs phyag mtshan gyi bstar bsgrigs/ zhi drag 187—679

blon chen rnams nas gdan zhus/ 7gong ma chen po dang yum lhan rgyas nas phebs bsur ched stsal cun ji rin mdun mtshams zhu phebs par sku phyag bskyangs / de nas gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod/ zhi drag blon chen/ ho thog thu khag /pi cing dgon khag nyer brgyad kyi dza tā bcas mjal phyag zhus/ /tshes nyi shu nyin/ 7gong sa mchog had tha'i pho brang du gdan drangs/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen po kong zhus dang /7gong ma'i yum bcas gser zhal lhan rgyas thog mtshan 'phar dngos 'bul bcas 7rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dus las kyang lhag pa'i gzengs bstod/ rgya sog gi mjal mi shin tu mang bar chos 'brel mjal phyag sogs stsal/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig nyin pi cing dgon khag gnas gzigs dang mchod 'bul sogs rgyas par mdzad/ tshes dgu nyin rgyal yum 'khrungs skar thog phebs rol sogs dang /nang blon rnams kyis gdan drangs/ hong tha'i hu'i mdun tshe rdzas bcas 'bul gnang mdzad/ 7gong yum nas mu tig gi phyag phreng gis mtshon dngos 'bul rgya cher bstar/ chos bcur 'khrungs skar dngos gzhir dpon chen sku srung rnams kyis gdan drangs/ hu'u min lha khang du sku phyag grub pa dang / khrang zhi gzigs 'bul dang sku 'khor tshang mar gsol ston dang / dngos 'bul spam mtho ba stsal/ zla ba dang po'i tshes lnga nyin kong zhu lha gnas su gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs ched gzhung sa nas g.yung dgon du mchod sprin sna lnga rgya cher 'bul thog pi cing dgon khag nyer brgyad phyogs bsdus kyi dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur thog /tshogs dbus su phebs nas zhal 'don ljags bsngo bcas mdzad/ de nas chen shon thong 7gong ma chen po'i gser 187—680

khrir mnga' gsol thog /7gong sa mchog nas dngos 'bul legs skyes rgya cher bstar nas bden tshig gi shis pa brjod pa dang / sku tshe chab srid yun brtan ched zhabs brtan bka' rtsom gnang ste yul gru kun tu khyab par spel/ 7rgyal yum hong tha'i hu gnam du gshegs par gong ltar mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad/tshes nyer lnga la 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i sku mchod la zhabs zhu mjal kha dang ske/ mchod 'bul zhal 'don snga lam ltar ro/ /de dag la 'di ltar bsngags par bya ste/ gzhung chen dka' ba'i gnas bcu sra ba'i gzhu/ /rnam dpyod sor mo gcig gis bkug pa na/ /mkhas kun lung rigs rnon po'i nyag phran gyi/ /rno dbal snying du 'tsher yang lhag par dad/ /mkhas mang khri phrag dbus su rab 'byams gzhung / /'jigs med seṅge glal ba'i gad rgyangs dbyangs / /grags pa'i ba dan dkar po srid gsum gyi/ /gtsug tor yid 'ong dpal du sbyin par gyur/ /khrims dag 'dul ba shes sogs lnga phrug gi/ /yon tan nyid kyis ston pa'i zhal tshab tu/ /'os pas sa steng ngur smrig 'chang ba'i sdes / /'gengs pa'i las kyi cho ga'i sgo 'phar dbye/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i rgyal rnga ldir ba sogs/ /dge mtshan du mar zhabs sen thig les spras/ /'gro khams bye ba'i rdo rje tsher ma'i nad/ /bzhes kyang rdo rje'i sku la ga la tshugs/ /stong phrag phyag dang bcu gcig zhal bzang skur/ /bzhengs nas rdo rje'i dal du skal ldan tshogs/ /khri phrag smin par mdzad pas stan thog der/ /'khor ba'i phyi mtha' gcod pa'i dga' ston thob/ /'od mtshan mtha' yas mchog gi sprul sku'i gar/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs spong bdun dngos po yis/ /shākya'i rgyal po nyid dang gnyis med pa'i/ /chos kyi khri la bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor/ /phyi 107—681

ru mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum dang / /nang du zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang //bar du 'phrin las rab 'byams bkod pa yis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la rtag tu brel/ /snang byed rta bdun myur ba'i bgrod pa yis/ /gling bzhi gzhan dang gzhan gyi mkha' dbyings mdzes/ /rgyal ba nyi ma'i 7zhabs sen 'od chags kyang ske/ /'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dang gzhan du rol/ /de bzhin dbang phyogs brtan g.yo'i bskal bzang gi/ /dpung pa'i ba dan mthon por btegs pa na/ /dbus 'gyur klu dbang gdengs ku'i nor bu yang / /gang gi gtsug tor mdzes pa'i dpal du gyur/ /mong gol ma hā tsi na'i yul gru yi/ /skal bzang las can grangs las 'das pa dag /mthong grol sku yi dkyil 'khor dngos su mjal/ /thos grol gsung gi bdud rtsi dngos su myang / /gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dbyangs dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang thabs gcig gdan 'dzoms nas/ /dag pa'i gzigs snang 'byams su klas pa dang / /ngo mtshar ltas bzang du ma 'gro la ngoms/ /byings rkyen rnam dbye sbyar ba'i brda sprod dang / /sgra don lang tshos sgeg pa'i snyan 'gyur nyams/ /phur bu'i khengs pa 'phrog la bsngags pas ci/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes ldan min nam/ /gnam bskos 7gong ma yum dang bcas pas kyang / /gtsug rgyan mu tig chun pos zhabs sen bcings/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim bzhin lha yul gshegs/ /gnam bskos rgyal po slar yang dbang bskur mdzad/ /bde gshegs gshegs ma ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ /tshangs dbyangs dbyangs snyan snyan dogur 'khrol ba'i rgosung / /kun mkhyen mkhyen rab rab ga'abyams 4spungs tho'i 4thugs/ /'gro don don gnyis gnyis mad lhum gyis 4grubasgo/ /ces bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs gsu byu1873682 byu

bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsngags pa'o//zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin 7gong ma yum sras mjal 'phrad sogs mdzad sgo mtha' dag legs par grub ste/ de phyogs kyi skye rgya'i re 'dod yongs su bskang nas slar bod yul chos ldan gyi rgyal khab chen por chibs bsgyur gyis spyi khyab na'i krung thang sogs nang blon rnams la mjal dar rtse sprod thog /bka' mtshams bskyangs/ rta dmag /rkang dmag nas rol cha dang 'brel ba'i drangs pan zhus/ bzhugs sgar chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ tshes nyer dgur gong ma chen po'i phebs skyel bka' mtshams zhus par sku phyag dang 'brel ba'i mjal dar nang mdzod ser po dang / tshe sku bcas 'bul gnang mdzad/ dpon chen phebs skyel gnang cha stsal/ lha ldan rgyal khab nas gdan zhur ched phebs blon chen chang khyim pa ngo las/ rnam grwa dge bskos sogs nas mjal phyag zhus/lan gru tsong thu'i mjal khar phebs sgo gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang / de nas sku 'bum bla spyi sogs kyis phebs bsu 'byor/ lam bar dgon lung / chu bzang sogs dgon sde mang por chos 'brel mjal phyag gnang / tshes nyer dgu la sku 'bum gyi bla sprul las sne/ zi ling dpon rnams phebs bsu dang / grwa dmangs ser sbreng bcas kyis gdan drangs/ sa bya zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nyin gnam lo gsar tshes kyi mdzad lam dang / sku 'bum smon lam dang bco lnga mchod pas mtshon rim par gnang / zla ba gsum par brgyad gtor gyi mjal kha dang /zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la chos rje don grub rin chen gyi gdan sa bya khyung dgon du chibs rags hrag bsdus kyis phebs lam du kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i gdung rten sogs la gnas gzigs dang / dgon gyi bla ma las sne bcas kyi 107—683

phebs bsu dang 'brel gdan drangs phebs ston sogs legs par zhus/ tshogs dbus gdan drangs te chos 'brel dang dngos 'byor 'bul ba rgya cher bstar/mjal dmang gnang / de nas sku 'bum/ gser sdong rin po che'i gtsos gnas gzigs dang 'brel thugs smon rgya cher gnang / grwa dmangs sogs mjal mi shin tu mang bar phyag dbang dang / las sne la gsol ras stsal/tshes bco lnga'i nyin phyogs de'i gdul bya'i re ba mtha' dag yongs su bskang nas bod yul gangs can bstan 'gro'i mgon du chibs zhal bsgyur te/ chibs rag dbu gdugs/ phyag mtshan phebs rol bcas dang sku 'bum bla sprul las sne/rgya'i dpon dmag ru bsgrigs/ phebs skyel dang bcas rim gyis cha gan no mi han nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i ljags lung stsal/sprul sku grwa dmangs nas dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba phul/ kho shog skye bo chig stong brgal bar phyag dbang gnang / lnga pa chen po'i bsten gsol mdzad pa'i mtsho mgo o sbog la mtsho rdzas dang / bla sprul sde dpon rnams la mjal kha gnang /zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu drug la lha ldan rgyal khab nas gsol 'debs gdan zhu phun khang tha'i ji sogs drung ser skya/ khri ngag nor sprul sku sogs 'bras se dga' gsum gyi sprul sku'i mthus mi sogs mi sna mang ba la mjal phyag gnang / rim gyis phebs lam du dgon sde khag dang shog so sor 'dod mos ltar chos 'brel dang mjal phyag gnang / zi ling drin thal phebs skyel dpon dmag rnams la gsol ras gzab rgyas thog phyir slog gnang / bstan 'dzin o sbog tu chibs bsgyur / o sbog rtser rgyal mtshan gser zangs tog ldan dang / gzhan yang spyan gzigs sku rlung dar pan/ tshogs 'khor bcas bskyangs te dkar phyogs 107—684

kyi dbu 'phang bstod/ de phyogs dad 'dus la mjal phyag gnang / de nas zla ba bdun par nag chu 'go ba ser skya/ byang rigs spyi mthus/ sgrub khang sprul sku sogs bla sprul/ byang rigs dgon khag gi las sne/ se 'bras dga' gsum gyi slob dpon/ 5 bla sprul/ 'dam rgya shog pa/ bkras lhun dza sag lha klu gung ske/ sku'i gcen po/ lcang can gung / 'bri gung / mtshur stag sprul sku mi sna bcas rim 'byor khag la mjal kha gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis nyin chu 'go ring mor 7gong sa mchog dang kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mjal dar rtse sprod zhabs sor 'khod nas/ kun gzigs rin po ches rten mjal dang / zhabs gas rnams la mjal kha gnang / de'i phyir nyin 7gong sa rin po che phebs gyoms chibs zhabs bcas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen po'i zhabs brtan dgon du gdan drangs/ rten 'bul mjal kha dang / chos bka' dbang lung ske/ dgon sde khag gi brtan bzhugs 'bul ba sogs mdzad sgo mtha' yas pa gnang —/ de nas rim gyis 'phags mchog 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdan sa rwa sgreng ho thog thu/ dza sag /dgon gyi las sne sogs kyis ser sbreng dang bcas gdan drangs/ bzhugs khrir 'khod pa dang / rwa sgreng ho thog thu dang —/ dza sag nas rten mjal/ mjal dmangs sogs rgyas par mdzad/chos rar 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod nas bla grwa yongs la thugs rje chen po mkha' 'gro lnga bskor gyi rjes gnang dang / yang dgon du rje bdag nyid chen po'i chos ra'i sa khrir bzhugs byang chub lam sgron gyi ljags lung gsung bshad dang 'brel ba rgyud 'khul nges su stsal ba rje 'brom nyid slar byon pa ltar gyur/ gzhan yang 'dod chos dang / brtan bzhugs mjal 107—685

kha'i mtshon rnam grangs shin tu mang ba stsal/ de nas stag lung du gnas gzigs dang / dga' ldan chos 'khor du zhabs sor 'khod/ der shar byang chos rjes mtshon bla sprul/ zhabs zhu ba ser skya sogs du mar mjal phyag gnang / de nas sgo la brgyud/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes dgur gra bzhi thang du phebs sgrigs dbu gur rma bya chen mor gdan drangs/ blon chen rnams dang / ho thog thu khag /gung bka' blon sogs drung rigs ser skya/ 'bras se dga' gsum gyi slob dpon/ bla sprul/ las sne/ am ban/ gor+ṣa/ kha bal mtshon mi rigs rnams mjal kha/ de nas chibs zhabs rgyas pa/ chibs dar/ gar pa/spyan rgya sogs mdzes pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bla brang steng gzim chung du gdan drangs gsol 'bras/ dkar spro bcas mdzad/ tshes bcu nyin khyams ra chen mo'i bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod/ blon chen rnams dang / ho thog thu sogs mjal kha sogs sngar lam ltar dga' ston rgya cher spel/ de nas gnas gzigs dang gzab gsol bcas bskyangs/ tshes bcu gsum nyin pho brang chen po po tā lar gdan drangs/ nyi 'od du dkar spro/ tshom chen srid zhi phun tshogs su rgya phebs mdzad sgo legs par grub pa'i rten 'byung gsol ston thog dngos 'bul mdzad lam rgyas pa ltar phul ba dgyes bzhes mdzad/ de nas dgu gtor 'chams gzigs gnang / lcags khyi dgung gsar sogs sngar lam rgyas par bskyangs/ de nas lho phyogs rgya gar gyi yul gru'i skye dgu rnams thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa dang / lu'u cun dpon dmag gis bstan dang chab srid skyon 'gyur mi yong ba'i ched tshes bzhi la pho brang nas chibs bsgyur/ lcags zam chu bo rir bzhugs zhag /yar 'brog bsam ldings nas rim gyis phag ri brgyud/187—686

rdor gling gram gling ko ṭir bzhugs zhag /ka li ka tar chibs bskyod kyi mo lugs lar dang mjal 'phrad gnang / brgyad gtor dang 'khrungs gsol lnga mchod sogs kyi mdzad sgo gnang / dad ldan khag la 'dod chos ci rigs pa stsal / zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nas gnas gzigs la ri lir chibs bsgyur gyis tshes lnga la rgyal po zas gtsang yab yum gyi pho brang dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyi sgrub khang bcas la gnas gzigs mchod 'bul/ tshes drug nyin ha ya gyi wa'i gnas khag rnams dang / lum bi nir/ ko sa la/ chos 'khor mchod rten/ tshes bcu bzhi la bya rgod phung po'i ri bcas la rim bzhin gnas gzigs mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya cher gnang / rdor gling rdo btsugs pho brang du lcags phag gnam lo gsar tshes mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar skye dgu'i 'dod chos kyi re ba bskangs/ rgya bod kyi chab srid skor dbyin ji bar dpang gis ching mol byas/ brgyad gtor chen mo/ 'khrungs gsol/ lnga mchod sogs mdzad lam khag nyams med thog thugs dam zab mo'i rim pa la brtson par mdzad/ chu byi gsar lor ka sbug pho brang gsar par dpal ldan lha mo'i tshes gtor gyi mtshon dgung gsar gyi mdzad sgo mtha' dag nyams med bskyangs/ sbel blon chen dang /legs ldan sa hob/ ka ci o rgyan bcas nas mjal phyag zhus/ de nas de phyogs kyi skye rgya'i re ba bskangs pa dang / thugs kyi bzhed pa 'grub nas kha ba can bstan 'gro'i mgon du ka sbug pho brang nas chibs zhabs dang bcas chibs bsgyur / nag thang / shar sing la nas rim par/ phag rir bzhugs zhag thog gangs rir gsol mchod bka' nan gnyer gtad mdzad de ngo mtshar ba'i ltas yang mang du byung / de nas rim gyis bod rgyal khab nas gdan zhu dang /107—687

'bras se dga' gsum gyi sku srung pa bcas kyis gdan drangs yar 'brog bsam lding du bzhugs 'jags mdzad/ de nas dpal sde brgyud chos 'khor yang rtser bzhugs / zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang chibs bsgyur tshar gling du bzhugs zhag dang ske/ de nas chibs rag rgyas pa/ ser sbreng / rol cha bcas rgyas spros kyis skyed tshal klu sding du gsol tsha phebs bsu mjal kha dang / de nas pho brang chen po po tā lar gser khrir zhabs sor 'khod nas dkar spro phebs ston gzab rgyas bstar / dgu gtor 'chams gzigs bskyangs/ chu glang gnam lo gsar tshes sngar srol nyams med dang / cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i gso sbyong dang gsung chos la sbyor chos/ skyes rabs/ bka' gdams bu chos bcas kyi gsung bshad yid 'khul nges dang / bka' bslab bcas stsal/ smon lam la'ang tshogs phebs kyis bstan 'gro'i don du thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ lo 'dir kun gling rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu sogs bsgrub bya tshig stong lnga brgya brgal bar bsnyen rdzogs dang / mtshur phu rgyal tshab sprul sku sogs bsgrub bya tshig stong brgal bar rab byung gi bslab sdom stsal/ khri chen tshe smon gling sprul sku rin po che nas srid skyong las tshab mdzad ring lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / pho brang yas mas la skyon gyur med ngos rgya dmag mthar 'bud grub pa'i bzos sgo legs skyes su ho thog thu'i go gnas dang / gzengs bstod gnang sbyin rgya cher stsal/gangs ljongs chab srid brtan cing bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel slad rtse pho brang chen por spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi dngul sku mthong ba don ldan bzo bkod phul du byung ba ye shes dngos bzhugs mig gi bdud rtsi lta bu gsar bzhengs dang 'brel lhag gnas kyi cho ga gnad smin mdzad/ shing stag mdzad 107—688

lam byings sngar ltar dang / lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por dmag zing skabs me mdas rgya phibs/ mda' yab sogs la skyon 'gyur byung ba rnams nyams gso legs par mdzad/ lo nang der bsgrub bya tshig stong lnga brgya brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ sgrub khang sprul sku rin po che'i drung nas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ ba ri brgya rtsa/ snar thang brgya rtsa bcas kyi rjes gnang gsan bzhes mdzad/ bā rin bla ma rin po che'i drung nas sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / bu ston rin po che'i gsung 'bum gyi ljags lung bcas gsan/ bā rin bla ma rin po che nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i don bzhin / zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi nas bzung nyin bcu ring nor gling du gdan sa gsum gyis mtshon dgon sde khag gi bla sprul/ slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen / dge 'dun skye bo pho mo sogs chig stong brgal bar rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod bya'i gnad ma lus pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i nyams len gyi rim par bsgrigs pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo'i zab bshad/dpe gtan tshigs/ lung rigs kyis mtha' brgyan pa zhib rgyas su stsal te gdul bya'i rgyud la mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon grung po bskrun cing / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i legs bshad kun gyi yang snying 'di nyid kyi srog 'thud pas rje'i bstan pa la bya ba rmad du byung ba mdzad do/ /'bri gung che tshang sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan blo bzang 'jam dpal 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug zhes stsal / shing yos lo nang mdzad sgo rnams sngar lam ltar dang bsgrub bya chig stong brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang bstan 'gro spyi sgos kyi sman yon spel slad rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su sku 'khor hrag bsdus kyis 107—689

chibs zhal bsgyur spyi sgor gyi thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ de skabs rwa sgreng gi shug pa ming can zhig skams 'dug pa srog shing du dgos zhes gru bzhir bzos te rwa sgreng du 'jog gnang mdzad pa/ da lan mchod sdong chen mo'i thig btab zin pa dang bum gdan pad+ma nas/ tog gi bar lhag chad til 'bru tsam med pa ma bsgrigs lhun gyis grub pa ni ma 'ongs mngon sum du mkhyen pa ma zad rje 'brom ston nyid slar byon pa yin par yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan stsal/ bar skabs su dad ldan rnams la 'dod mos chos 'brel kyang stsal/ me 'brug dgung gsar mdzad lam sngar ltar bskyangs thog /cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i gso sbyong dang gsung chos/smon lam sogs la chibs bsgyur gyi mdzad sgo sngar ltar dang / gsung chos su sbyor chos dang / skyes rabs/ bu chos bcas kyi gsung bshad zab rgyas thog spyi sgor gyi bslab ston rgya cher stsal/ brag ri sprul sku sogs grwa grangs dgu brgya skor la rab bsnyen gyi bslab sdom stsal/ zla ba gnyis pa nas nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gi rigs gsum lha khang dang / gzim chung / rten bcas gsar bskrun mdzad de rab gnas dang thugs smon gnang / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i nyin 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po nas yongs 'jin phur lcog rin po che'i bka' bzhin thub bstan spyi dang zhwa ser ring lugs dar zhing rgyas pa dang /bod ljongs chab srid mnga' thang gong du 'phel ba sogs phan bde'i legs tshogs du ma'i ched du dgongs te 'jam dpal khros pa'i gar mdzad dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa bdud las rnam rgyal gyi gzhi bsnyen chen mo 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bzhed srol rje gser khang pa yab sras kyi bkral 107—690
