ba'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin mchod pa 'bul bshams dang bzhugs gdan bca' ba/ mtshams tho 'dzugs chog sogs sngon 'gro'i rim pa mtha' dag legs par grub bstun dngos gzhi 'dzugs mdzad pa dang chabs cig /gru 'dzin pho brang gi lho phyogs su ku shu'i sdong po zhig 'dzugs par gnang te 'di skyes nas me tog shar na bzhed don mthar phyin yong ba'i ltas yin zhes bka' phebs paral/ de rjes sdong po cher skyes shing me 'bras sogs da lta'i bar nyams med 'di ni/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis me yi phung po zhi/ /zhes pa bzhin dam pa'i rang rtags dang bden pa'i 'bras bu gsal bar bstan pa'o/ /sngon 'gro'i rim pa skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/maṇ+ḍal sogs grangs tshad gnad du smin pa sngon du mdzad zin rung / rang cag rnams la 'doms slad thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor chag med thog /seng bar du'ang nyin rer sku phyag brgya re/ yon chab stong re/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig sogs phyag par satshwa sum brgya re/ gzhan yang chag med kyi zhal 'don/ skye 'gro'i bde sdug gi 7snyan zhu'i mtshon srid kyi mdzad sgo rnams kyang nyams med du bskyangs pa ni/ rje bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung las/ bsod nams tshogs rab rab 'byams rgyu las 'khrungs pa'i sku mchog mchog tu mdzes pa khyod kyi sku/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gtugs pa med pa'i zhing mchog kun du du ma'i 'gro la mig 'khrul bzhin/ /la lar bltams zhing zhing gzhan du yang byang chub tshul ston ston pa khyed kyi sku yi ni/ /bkod pa mchog 'di 'di dang gzhan du ma lus 'gro kun kun mkhyen gyur kyang brjod mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /me sbrul lo nang bcad rgya'i khongs nas rgyud stod smad kyi rab byung bdun cu don lnga 107—691

skor la bsnyen rdzogs sdom rgyun spel/ sa rta lo nang bcad rgya'i khongs nas rgyud stod smad gra grangs dgu bcu bsnyen rdzogs sdom par bkod/ sa lug lo nang bcad rgya'i khongs nas thor rgod tho yon dang rgyud grwa rnam gnyis kyi bsgrub bya chig brgya sum cu skor la rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nas thugs dam bcad rgya'i rim pa mtha' dag sbyor dngos rjes gtsang legs par grub bstun/ bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kha skong dang / rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bcas dam pa'i nyams bzhes 'khrul bral phyag len rnam par dag pa mdzad de/ de dag kyang bstan 'gro spyi dang / lhag par bstan dang chab srid la log par 'khu ba'i dam sri rgyal 'gong sogs gnod byed mtha' dag nam yang ldang ba med cing skye dgu rnams bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyis dus rtag tu 'tsho ba'i thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/de'i mthu las phyogs mtha'i rgyal khab thams cad du 'khrug rtsod sogs mi shis pas dus 'da' yang da lta rang cag bod ljongs rnams bde skyid kyi dpal la ci dgar spyad du yod pa mngon sum mthong chos su gsal ba 'di la kun gyis bka' drin ngo shes kyis thugs dgongs ji bzhin 'grub thabs la snying nas 'bad 'tshal/'di dag gi skabs su dag pa'i snang ba nar mar yod rung thugs sgam pas gsal bar ma gsungs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bsngags te/ brgya byin khang bzang khengs pa 'gugs pa yi/ /gser gyi rgyal khab che nas dbus 'gyur ljongs / /gru 'dzin gzhal med khang du ngal bso tsam/ /mdzad nas slar yang 'gro ba'i don la brel/ /ston pa mchog des bcu gnyis mdzad pa yi/ /bskal bzang gang gis 'dzin pa'i sa yi khyon/ /'phags pa'i yul der ston pa de yi bstan / /'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs chen slad du gshegs/ /byang chub 187—692

snying po'i spo sogs de dang der/ /rlabs chen thugs bskyed mdud pa slar yang bcings / /yul gyi dbus su gnas kyang mtha' 'khob kyi/ /skal ngan 'chang ba rnams la'ang skal bzang stsal/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i tha grur dbang sgyur ba'i//stobs kyis dregs ldan mtha' bzhi'i sa skyong yang / /khyod kyi gzi byin gser gyi khu ba la/ /dad pa'i pad+mo ngoms pa med par spyod/ /de tshe gangs can bsod nams min pa yi/ /dpung pa chu khur nag po'i khro gnyer las/ /spros pa'i bde skyid lo tog 'phrog pa'i gshed/ /gang gi dmod sngags 'thor rlung gcig gis bskrad / /skal ngan mtshan mo'i thun gsum rdzogs pa'i mthar/ /rgyad pa'i mun brgya 'phrog pa'i 'od chags dang / /mngon 'dod 'dod dgu yid bzhin stsol ba yi / /gangs can yid bzhin dbang gi nor bu ni/ /gangs can bsod nams rgyal mtshan tog tu mdzes/ /mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dbyangs kyi nyams 'gyur stong —/ /gsung gi rgyud mang gcig gi sgrar bkug pa'i/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i tasbu ras/ /gsung rab gdams ngag gcig tu 'doms la brel/ /rim gnyis mchog gi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa kun gyi mthar son pa/ /thun mong grangs bsnyen tsam la ltos sam ci/ /de phyir bstan 'gro'i don nyid kho nar nges/ /sku ni snang stong dus dgra'i dbang por bzhengs/ /gsung ni grags stong sngags kyi bzlas par brel/ /thugs ni bde stong mnyam gzhag ngang du mnal/ /gsang gsum 'jigs mdzad rol gar gcig tu 'byams / /nang du zab mo'i rnal 'byor ma g.yos bzhin/ /phyi ru rgyal srid bya ba skyong ba ni/ /rgyal rnams chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /bcu gnyis mdzad par rol dang cis mi mtshungs/ /zab zhi zhi dbyings dbyings las ma 4 4 4 1rā7—693

g.yos bzhin/ /rgyal thabs thabs shes shes bya'i 'khor lo 'bum/ /spro mdzad mdzad mchog mchog des bodud sdo las4/ d+ngha /rab rgyal rgyal dbang dbang rtseg brgyod ldano nyid/byu ces bya ba yang bar skabs skya tshigos swo bcado pa'i dibyangs kyis bsngags pa'o//de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas 7zhabs brtan legs 'bul bdag gir bzhes shing / lan gru tsong thu'i mi snar mjal phyag gnang / lcags sprel lo'i dgung gsar gyi mdzad sgo dang cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor 'on rgyal sras sprul sku/ spang mda' tshong nyi rgyal zung nas gsol ba btab pa ltar tshogs dbur zhabs sor bkod de sngar lam mdzad sgo mtha' dag legs par bskyangs/ sngon du bstan pa'i gsos sman la dgongs bzhes bla med kyis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyi legs bshad rnams dpe rgyun dkon gshis par gsar brkos gnang ba cha tshang spus legs grub pas/ slar yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung bar gsar bskrun gyi dbu tshugs/ lo der bsgrub bya brgyad brgya skor la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang / lcags bya lo dgung gsar gyi mdzad sgo dang cho 'phrul smon lam gyi mdzad sgo bcas sngar ltar bskyangs/ lo der bsgrub bya lnga brgya lhag par rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ chu khyi dgung gsar dang /lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i mdzad sgo rnams sngar ltar bskyangs/ lo nang der bsgrub bya tshig stong brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ chu phag dgung gsar dang / cho 'phrul smon lam gyi mdzad sgo sngar ltar bskyangs/ lo der bsgrub bya grangs dgu brgya brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ shing byi dgung gsar gyi mdzad sgo sngar ltar gnang / tre bo khang gsar sprul sku nas gsol 'debs zhus 187—694

pa bzhin cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur zhabs sor bskyod/ mdzad sgo sngar ltar bskyangs/ lo nang der bsgrub bya bdun brgya brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ shing glang dgung gsar dang / cho 'phrul smon lam du phur lcog sprul sku rin po che nas gsol 'debs mdzad pa bzhin lha ldan smon lam chen mor chibs bsgyur gyi mdzad sgo sngar ltar bskyangs/ lo nang der bsgrub bya chig stong tshig brgya brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang rtse pho brang shar rgyud le lag gsar bskrun legs grub kyi zhal spro'i mdzad sgo dang ske/ brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes mdzad/ me stag lo'i dgung gsar dang /cho 'phrul zla ba'i mdzad sgo sngar ltar bskyangs/ lo der bsgrub bya tshig stong bzhi brgya la rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ zla ba bcu gnyis par rtse gzim chung nyi 'od du rnam grwa slob dpon ngag dbang tshul khrims nas gsol ba btab pa ltar rnam grwa tshogs yongs la mgon chos lha mo rnam sras bcas kyi rjes gnang dam pa'i phyag bzhes ltar nyams med bka' drin stsal/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos lo'i dgung gsar dang cho 'phrul mdzad sgo sngar ltar dang / lo der bsgrub bya chig stong lnga brgya bdun cu lhag tsam la rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ zla ba bcu par spyan gling gzim chung skal bzang bde 'khyil gsar bskrun zhal gro'i mdzad sgo bskyangs / sa 'brug lo'i dgung gsar dang / cho 'phrul smon lam mdzad sgo sngar lam nyams med bstar/ lo de nang bsgrub bya chig stong brgal bar rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ lo de'i nang ser byes sked tshang sprul sku dang / shing bzo kun dga' rgyal mtshan gnyis nas bka' 'brel rta phag yab yum gyi bla rdo ngo mtshar can gdan zhus gnang / zlab brgyad par spyan gling gzim chung skal 107—695

bzang bde 'khyil dang / bde skyid ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil/ chibs ra'i gzim chung gzhan phan dga' 'khyil/ 'khor yug lcags ri chen mo rgya bskyed gsar bzhengs legs grub kyi zhal spro'i thog /gzhung nas dkar spro dang / dngos 'bul bstar/ rnam grwa tshogs yongs nas mdo lugs zhabs brtan kyang phul te sku tshe spel zhing bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la co 'dri bar byas/ chab zhugs spro ston skabs rme ru ba nas chos rgyal dad pa brtan po'i rnam thar sogs sna tshogs pa'i bkra shis dge mtshan spel/ de ltar snga phyi ci rigs par ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang / rgya btab ra mo che/ /khra 'brug /spu rang jo bo/ byang skra bdun / ru lag grom pa gyang / lho brag ban pa phyag rdor/ sol nag thang mo che / sras mkhar dgu thog /dwags la sgam po/ /tsā ri cig car lha khang /'ol kha rdzing phyi sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams nyams gso dang gsar bzo 'os rigs skabs dang mthun pa legs par mdzad pa ni bod kyi rgyal sa gzhi ma yin pa dang / lhag par yab mes chos rgyal gong ma rnams bod kyi bde skyid kyi rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan par rag las pa dang / de yang dge 'dun gyi sde dang gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa yin par bka' chem dang bka' gter du ma nas 'byung ba ltar thugs bskyed rlabs po che legs par bskrun par mdzad pa ni bka' drin gyi mtha' ma mchis so/ /gzhan yang dga' ldan du rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gser gdung rin po che hrul skyon yod pa gzhi nas gsar bzhengs bzo bkod phra rgyan gyis phyug pa mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa la rab gnas dang bcas gnang ba ni 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i dgongs bzhes bla na med pa dang / mdo khams dgon sde khag nas 187—696

tshogs su sha 'grem gyis sems can grangs med gsod pa mkhyen te sha tshab byed pa las srog gcod mi byed pa'i rgya khyab bka' bsgyur dam sbrag gnang ba snying rje'i lha mchog gi rol gar yin par gsal bar 'doms par mdzad pa'i slad du'o/ /zla ba dgu par rta tshag ho thog thu'i sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te/ mtshan gsol mdzad / sa sprul lo'i dgung gsar dang / cho 'phrul smon lam gyi mdzad sgo sngar bzhin nyams med bskyangs/ rtser dus 'khor lha khang nyams gso gsar bzhengs grub ste tshogs dbus su zhabs sor bkod/ bsnyen bkur gya rnam pa dang bstan dang chab srid 'phel ba'i thugs smon gnang / nor gling spyan gsal pho brang nyams gso legs par grub par/ dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyi sgo nas rab gnas kyis ye shes pa dngos su thim pa'i rtags mtshan gsal zhing / bkra shis dang dge mtshan rgyas par spel/ lo de nang grangs chig stong nyis brgya skor la rab bsnyen gyi bslab sdom stsal/ lcags rta gnam lo gsar 'char gyi mdzad sgo dang —/ mong gol shog dar han ching wang gi mi sna tā bla ma bstan pa'i snying po can nas zhus ngor cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor tshogs mgon chibs bsgyur dang 'brel mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar nyams med bskyangs/ lo de'i khongs grwa grangs tshig stong bdun brgya lnga bcu skor la rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ lcags lug dgung gsar mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar bskyangs/ bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rwa sgreng ho thog thu nas gsol ba btab pa ltar cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur chibs bskyod dang / mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar mdzad/ lo nang der rwa sgreng ho thog thu rin po che sogs gra grangs chig stong lnga brgya skor la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa stsal te/ tshe smon gling ho thog thu dang /107—697

mtshur phu kurma pa'i yang srid sprul sku rnam gnyis kyi gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan gsol mdzad/ chu sprel dgung gsar mdzad sgo mtha' dag sngar lam nyams med thog /cho 'phrul smon lam gyi gso sbyong dang / gsung rar skyes rabs kyi mtshon gsung bshad bslab ston sogs dang / smon lam dang gnas gzigs 'brel bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i thugs smon rgya chen mdzad/ lo nang der snga phyir rab byung grangs drug brgya don gnyis dang / rgyud stod smad kyi gtsos mtha' dbus kyi bsgrub bya chig stong dang bcu gsum la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/zla ba lnga par 'khrungs gsol dang / sprel zla'i tshes bcur gnas chung dpe har lcog tu chibs bsgyur te chos skyong chen po'i gtsos bstan srung khag la lha gsol dang bka' bsgo gnyer gtad stsal/ skyor lung gzhong ba lha chu'i tshes bcu pa rnams kyis gar 'chams gzigs 'bul zhus/ rwa sgreng ho thog thu mchog nas gsol ba btab pa'i don bzhin tshes nyer gsum nyin nor gling nas chibs zhal bsgyur te rtsa rkang rgod phug tu bzhugs sgar sar rwa sgreng ho thog thu dang / dza sag nas rten gsum dang / gsol gro sogs phul te chibs zhal bsgyur/ de skabs dbu gur nang du sbrul ser khra gcig dang / sbal pa gcig glo bur du 'ong nas 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs khri'i 'og tu 'dzul ba ni 'dzin pa lag mang dang /dung skyong gnyis phebs bsur mngon sum bcar bar nges/ de nas rnga dung dar 'phyar ser sgreng bcas kyi gdan drangs gzim chung byang chub 'od snang du zhabs sor 'khod/ de nas nyi 'od du gdan drangs/ rwa sgreng ho thog thu dang / dza sag /dgon gyi las sne grwa dmangs sogs kyis mjal kha zhus/ tshes sum cu'i nyin gso sbyong tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ zla ba lnga pa phyi ma'i tshes 187—698

gnyis nyin 'chams gzigs phul/ tshes bdun nyin bla grwa nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i don bzhin mgon po tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig gi sgo nas rwa sgreng ho thog thus gtsos ser skya yongs la tshe dbang smin rgyas stsal/ de 'brel gnas rten khag la gnas gzigs dang / mchod 'bul/ thugs smon dang 'brel bas brtan bzhugs mdzad/ tshes bcu nyin rwa sgreng nas chibs zhal bsgyur te rim gyis nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang chos skyong chen po'i bka' lung dgongs don 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po'i 7zhabs pad brtan cing / bod ljongs chab srid dang / skye 'gro'i bde skyid 'phral yun tshugs thabs/ mgon po gang gi snga phyi'i bka' drin dpag tu med pa gsab ched du bka' 'bangs yongs nas 7zhabs brtan dgos tshul phebs pa ltar/ srid blon/ bka' blon mtshon rtse shod drung ser skya/gdan sa gsum/ rgyud grwa gnyis kyis mtshon bod ljongs lha sde mi sde spyi mthun nas dga' ldan khri zur rin po che/ rnam grwa gsung bzang pa/ gdan sa gsum/rgyud grwa stod smad/ gnas chung / rme bzhi bcas slob dpon las sna rnams nas bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma dang 'brel ba'i mkha' 'gro sun bzlog /brtan bzhugs bcas 'bul bzhes legs par mdzad/ lo nang der rab bsnyen gyi sdom pa bsgrub bya mig stong brgal bar stsal/ chu bya dgung gsar mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar dang / tshes gsum zan ril skabs sku phywa dang / bstan srid la 'tshub 'gyur shin tu che bar phebs pa ma 'ongs lung bstan gsal bar phebs par nges/ de nas smon lam chen mor gso sbyong / gsung rar sbyor chos/skyes rabs/ bu chos bcas gsung bshad thog spyi sger yongs la bslab ston pas 187—699

bu la 'doms pa ltar gdams par gnang / bum sgrub thog mtha'/ dus 'khor tshogs phebs bcas la chibs bsgyur thugs smon rgya cher gnang / dga' ldan yangs pa can gyi lcam shing 'bu zos skyon shin tu che ba bla spyi nas 7snyan zhus ltar zhwa ser bstan pa'i 'byung khungs su dgongs bzhed kyi nyams bzo bka' bla dang bshad phyag gnyis la bka' phabs pa ltar legs par grub nas rab gnas su chibs bsgyur mdzad rgyur tshes bdun nyin nor gling pho brang nas chibs zhal bsgyur te ri bo dga' ldan du phebs/ nyin gsum ring gong sa mchog dang /khri gdan zur/ shar byang chos rje/ rnam grwa gsung bzang bcas kyi gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba ye shes pa dngos bstim mdzad/ do dam par rdzas brgyad 'grims te rten 'brel mdzad/ de nas gnas gzigs dang / dbang bskur rir lha bsangs sogs thugs smon rgya cher mdzad nas chibs zhal bsgyur te nor gling du zhabs sor 'khod/ gzhan yang rang cag ser skya yongs kyi bslab ston zhu rgyu'i bka' yig 'byung 'gyur lung bstan dang bcas pa stsal/ lo nang der bsgrub bya grangs chig stong lnga brgya skor la rab bsnyen gyi sdom rgyun legs par spel te 'dul ba'i bcas khrims rnam par dag pas sa steng khyab pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ zla ba dgu par rab bsnyen gyi cho ga grub nas/ rgyun par bslab sdom gnang yul gzim chung srid zhi dpal 'bar bla bre sngar rgyun gtan 'jags yin pa la/ de nyin bla bre nges par bsdu dgos pa'i bka' slob stsal ba ni rang cag rmongs pas ma go ba ma gtogs re zhig bslab sdom mi stsal ba'i 'byung 'gyur gyi rtags mtshan gsal bar bstan/ lo snga phyir spyan gling rdo gcal mthil du bya rgod yong ba dang /187—700

spyan gling nor gling bar du skya ma'i khyu chen po yar mar 'gro ba dang / sa g.yo ba dang —/ thal char babs pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi chu srin khag gsum gyi kha nas chu babs pa sogs mi shis pa mang du byung / 7gong sa mchog kyang thugs dam la lhag par brtson zhing / dam pa gong ma mang po'i rnam thar la gzigs pa dang la/ bka' slob rus pa can yang yang stsal rung / kun dga' bo bdud kyis non pa ltar su la'ang snang ba ma byung / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas sku khams cung nyog tshul yod rung / thugs sgam pas snang med du lus/ skabs 'gar cung zad dwangs pa'i tshul kyang bzhes/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi dgun mjal du sku ngal la ma dgongs par chibs bsgyur gyis zhal bstan pa ni sngon bcom ldan 'das rtsa mchog grong du sku mya ngan las 'da' khar sku'i stod bsal te dge slong dag la ltos shig de bzhin gshegs pa mjal ba ni shin tu dka'o zhes gdams pa ltar de ltar mdzad sgo mtha' dag legs par bskyangs te thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ de'i sang nyin rtser dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang gi dgun mjal du'ang phebs 'dun yod rung sku 'khrug pa'i rnam pas sku khams cung zad je zhan du gyur pas sku mdun pa rnams kyis gdan zhu blos ma 'khyud par na bza' gdan zhu'i thog sngar lam mjal kha dang / mchod 'bul rnams nyams med bskyangs/ zhabs brtan kyang mtha' yas pa zhus rung / de nas rim gyis je zhan du gyur te zhing 'di'i sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa dang /bod 'bangs bsod nams dman pa'i 'bras bu bdo ba bcas kyi tshes gnam kung nub mo bcom ldan 'das sku mtha' ma'i gzim pa'i tshul dang mtshungs pa seṅge'i gzim stabs kyis snang ba gsum rim gyis bsdus nas thams cad stong pa 'od 107—701

gsal chos sku'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad de/ spros bral bde stong gi thugs dam ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhugs so/ /de nyin nam mkha' shin tu dwangs shing rlung rgyu ba phra mo tsam yang med pa dang / sku bgres pa'i tshul cher bzhes rung —/ de'i nyin zhal dkyil shin tu dwangs shing dkar ba thams cad kyis mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur/ de skabs rang cag rnams mgon med skyabs bral nyam thag 'o dod kyi ngang nas ci bya gtol med par gyur to/ /de nas mchod sprin sna lnga bshams te dga' ldan khri zur rin po che byams pa chos grags dang / yongs 'dzin phur lcog sprul sku/ mtshan zhabs pa ngos gnyis/ sked tshang sprul sku/rnam grwa rdor dbu sogs nas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam sogs zhus/ sang nyin nas bzung yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che dang / mtshan zhabs rgyal dbang sprul sku/ rnam grwa rdor dbu rnams nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa bdud las rnam rgyal gyi sgo nas sku'i gdung sgrub dang / gdung khrus 'bul gnang / rnam grwa tshogs yongs/rgyud grwa rnam gnyis sogs nas nyin bzhin bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgo nas mchod sprin sna lnga'i stong mchod/ 'bras se dga' gsum lhan tshogs smon lam 'phar ma sogs mtha' dbus kun tu mchod sprin dgongs rdzogs mtha' yas pa spel lo/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bsngags par bya ste/ rgyal bas dpal gyi mgul las legs gsungs bka'/ /ji snyed 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams par gyi gzhi//gcig las du mar 'char bas gangs can khyon/ /'gengs pa'i phan bde'i nor bu'i gter du bskrun/ /bod yul bstan pa'i rtsa lag chos 'khor gsum/ /nyams gso mchod rgyun mig gi bdud rtsir spel/ /pho brang yas mas ri bo tā la 187—702

yi / /gzhal med ljongs 'dir dngos su 'phos bzhin bskrun/ /bka' rtags phyag rgya btsan po'i nyin byed zer/ /bsil ljongs pad+ma'i gnyen gyur tsam min pal/ /mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan rkang 'thung dag gis kyang / /bka' lung zer brgya spyi bor len cing 'dud/ /gzhan gyi dring la ma ltos sa chen khyon/ /rang dbang phyag rgya'i snod du bgyis pa yis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chab srid kyi/ /dbu rmog btsan po gnam bskos rgyal por gyur/ /bag yod spyod pas bsdam pa'i chab 'bangs tshogs/ /thugs rje'i grib bsil snum por ngal gso zhing / /chos 'byor 'dod rgu'i dga' ston gyis 'tsho bas/ /khyod ni re skong dpag bsam dbang po nyid/ /phan bde'i pad tshal rnyog pa'i brlangs spyod kyis / /khrims gnyis las 'gongs bag med gnyis 'thung khyu/ /sku yi rnam 'gyur gcig gis ril non pas/ /khyod ni gdong lnga'i dbang po mchog nyid do/ /dbus 'gyur bde skyid 'phrog pa'i me tog mda'/ /'chang ba'i mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan nya yi tog /dmod sngags zhugs su 'bar ba tsam gyis kyang / /thal bar byed pa khyod ni dpal gyi mgrin/ /gsang gsum nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin ni / /zhugs su rno bas blo yi pad+mo'i 'dzum/ /dar dir dbyangs su snyan pa'i bung ba'i khyu/ /'gugs pa'i lhag bsam sbrang tsi'i phung po 'dzin/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i tha gru mtha' dag kyang / /li khri'i lang tsho gsar du bdo ba bzhin/ /khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pas gtam pa yis/ /khyod kyi rnam thar thub dbang gnyis par dran/ /kye ma 'od stong zhags pa can gyis bzungs/ /sprin 'byung lang tsho bsil ldan ma yis zos/ /gangs can bsod nams nor bu glo bur dor//sa 'di mun pa'i bskal pas glo bur bkabs/ /rnam 'dren mchog gi lhan skyes 107—703

bde chen sku/ /'od gsal mchog gi dga' ma'i rtsed 'jor rol 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal tsher ma'i mal sa ni/ /smre ngag bzlas brjod 'dren cing 'dre ldog brtson/ /de lta na'ang gsol 'debs shing rta yis/ /drangs pa'i snang byed gsar pas yongs gzung ste/ /rkang pa rig byed rnam par g.yo ba'i bzhin/ /rdzogs ldan 'dzum dkar lang tsho yid du 'ong / /gang gi rnam thar thar pa'i snying po can/ /gang gis legs thos thos 'dzin skal bzang gyur/byu nga/de phyir snyan ngag ngag gi rgyud mang gis/ snyo/brdeg gi legs tshogs tshogs gnyis yangs por sal / sne /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su brtsod pa'o dbyangs kyis rab tu bsngags pa'o//bzhi pa gdams pa dngos kyis slob ma ji ltar bkri ba'i rim pa dang mthun par dkar chag gi tho dngos 'god pa la/ de ltar par du bskrun pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs de dag gi bzhugs pa'i go rim snar sde dang mthun par dkar chag dngos la mdo dang / sngags gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'khor lo rim pa gsum du phye ba'i dang por gtogs pa 'dul ba lung gi skor/ bar pa sher phyin gyi skor/ tha ma legs pa rnam par phye ba'i skor/ 'khor lo gsum ci rigs par gtogs pa mdo mang gi skor dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston dang / gong dkar bas rnam 'byed sngon du mdzad kyang / 'dir tshal pa bka' 'gyur sor bzhag ltar 'dul ba gzhi/ rnam 'byed/ phran tshegs/gzhung bla ma rnams rim pa bsgrigs pa'i 'dul ba gzhi sh+lau ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya bam po brgya dang dgu bzhugs pa'i glegs bam sgror+sā par rab byung 107—704

gi gzhi/ gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/ dbyar gyi gzhi/ ko lpags kyi gzhi'i stod cha bcas bam po dang po nas nyer gcig par la shog grangs sum brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa/ 〈li par ko lpags kyi gzhi'i smad cha dang / sman gyi gzhi'i stod cha bcas bam po nyer gnyis nas nga bzhi'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya dang lnga/ sgrosgolji par sman gyi gzhi'i smad cha/ gos kyi gzhi/ sra brkyang gi gzhi / kau shasnyi'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ dmar ser can gyi gzhi/ gang zag gi gzhi / spo ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong bzhag pa'i gzhi/ gnas mal gyi gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi/ dbyen gyi gzhi'i stod cha bcas bam po nga lnga nas gya gnyis pa'i bar la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang so lnga/ sgros par dbyen gyi gzhi'i mjug bam po gya gsum nas brgya dang dgu'i bar paṇ+ḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa/ bit+yā ka ra pra bha/ dharma ka ra/ bod kyi lo tsā ba brje dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis bsgyur cing / slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang so drug /sgro'i par dge slong pa'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mdor bsdus te ston pa pa'i so sor thar pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun brgya bam po gnyis pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba brje klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / de'i don rgya cher ston pa pha'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa las pham pa bzhi dang / lhag ma bcu gsum gyi bcu pa dbyin byed pa'i lhag ma'i stod cha yan bam po dang po nas nyer gcig pa'i bar la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang bcu gsum/ tshomi par dbyen gyi lhag ma'i smad cha man dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis/ spang ltung sum cu/ ltung byed 'ba' 107—705

zhig pa dgu bcu las bcu gcig pa skye ba 'jig pa yan bam po nyer gnyis nas zhe gnyis bar la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang gnyis/ dzospyilji par bcu gnyis pa 'phya ba'i ltung byed nas bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ltung byed yan bam po zhe gsum nas re gnyis bar la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nyer gsum/ sgromi par bdun cu rtsa gsum pa sa brko ba'i ltung byed man dang —/ so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi/ bslab par bya ba'i chos mang po/rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun rnams sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong dang 'dra ba bam po re gsum nas brgya gsum rdzogs kyi bar la shog grangs sum brgya dang gya drug /tshomi par dge slong ma'i khrims sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi bsdus nas ston pa ma'i so sor thar pa sh+lau ka brgyad brgya bam po gnyis pa/ sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong dang 'dra ba/ de'i don rgyas par ston pa ma'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka brgyad stong bzhi brgya dang bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa paṇ+ḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa dang / dharma ka ra/ bi byā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis bsgyur cing / slad kyi bit+yā ka ra dang dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang drug cu tham pa/ (mi par lung phran tshegs sgo brgyad ka rdzogs pa sh+lau ka cig khri bdun stong bdun brgya bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu'i bam po nyer bdun pa yan la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang drug cu re bdun/ phran tshegs 'di skabs sngon gyi dkar chag rnams su bam tshad sogs sna tshogs byung ba ni lo tsā ba mang pos dum bur bsgyur bas phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i tshe tshang ma tshang ci rigs byung ba'i rkyen gyis yin la/ sgo brgyad ka yongs su rdzogs pa 'di ni la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang du gnas brtan dar ma seng ges lung sde bzhi bzhengs pa'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ges phyag len mdzad nas spyir dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang rnams na bzhugs pa dang / khyad par du bsam 107—706

yas mchims phu nas dag chung ba dang / dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis rnyed pa'i lung rnams btsal te/ de dag la gtugs pas lung phran tshegs kha cig la mi bzhugs pa/ kha cig la bzhugs pa rnams kyis bskangs nas bsabs pa ni bam po sum cu rtsa gsum sman chen po'i gtam rgyud kyi skabs nas/ bam po lnga bcu gnyis pa'i stod/ bar sdom ni/ tsa ba la dang tshe'i 'du byed mdzad/ ces bya ba'i bar snga phyi spyir bsdoms na bam po bcu gnyis dang / sdom tshig yig tshar gnyis chad pa bskangs par bshad cing / phyis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas kyang slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyi 'grel pa la gtugs te zhus dag mdzad par grags pa ltar them spangs ma'i dpe rgyun dang 'grel pa gnyi ga sgo bstun nas chad pa rnams bsabs par gsungs/ spyordolji par bam po nyer brgyad nas lnga bcu rtsa dgu'i bar rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha/ dharma shrī pra bha/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba la shog grangs lnga brgya dang dgu/ spyordolji par gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa sh+lau ka sum stong drug brgya bam po bcu gnyis pa lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dus su bsgyur ba/ zhu ba rdzogs pa sh+lau ka chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi nyi shu rtsa gnyis yan la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe brgyad/ lgo'i par de'i 'phros bam po nyer gsum nas lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'i bar rdzogs pa lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dus bsgyur mod kyi zhes pa tsam las sgyur byed lo paṇa gsal ba ma byung bar shog grangs bzhi brgya nga gsum bcas bzhugs/ khyon lung sde bzhi gcig tu bsgril ba'i gzhung tshad bam po sum brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi sum cha gcig /sh+lau kur phye na chig 'bum bzhi stong brgyad brgya bzhugs pa 'di rnams snar thang dkar chag tu sgyur byed lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi dus su bsgyur zhes pa tsam las lo paṇa gyi gsal kha ma byung bar gsungs kyang / glegs bam rang du 'gyur byang gsal bar gsungs 'dug pa ltar 'dir bkod/ de ltar lung zhu ba ma rdzogs pa dang rdzogs pa'i khyad par ni/lung zhu ba'i 'grel pa las/ ston pa 'das pa'i gsung rab la bram ze rgyal po rgyal bshes zhes bya ba bstan pa la snang ba zhig byung ba des glegs bam rnams phung por bcer nas bsregs so/ /de nas rim gyis dge slong rnams kyis sde snod 107—707

gsum gyi glegs bam thams cad bsdus nas bcom brlag tu yang dag par bsdu ba byas te/ gzhung bla ma'i glegs bam ni ma rnyed do/ /de dag gis 'di ltar kha che'i yul na dge slong zhig gzhung bla ma 'don to zhes thos nas de dag de'i drung du phyin nas smras pa/ kho bo cag gis khyod gzhung bla ma 'don to zhes thos pa gang yin pa de rje kha ton gyis shig /des smras pa / cung zad gcig ni dran/ cung zad gcig ni mi dran no/ /de nas de dag gis ji lta bu zhig dran pa de kho na bzhin du smos shig ces smras pa dang / des de kho na bzhin du kha ton byas so/ /dge slong rnams kyis kyang re zhig gzhung bsdu bar bya ste/ phyis tshig dang tshig gi don rnam par dpyad pa'i sgo nas sbyar bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas bris pa las/phyis 'phral gyi bya bas rnam par g.yengs nas dus ring mo zhig gi bar du ji lta ba bzhin du ma sbyar to/ /dge slong gzhan dag kyang yul gzhan dag na gzhan du 'don par gyur to/ /de nyid kyi phyir yang dag par bsdus pa'i gzhi po nyams pas gzhung bla ma 'di la 'don pa'ang rnam pa du ma la don kyang rnam pa du ma ste/ de'i phyir btsun pa yon tan 'od kyis 'dul ba'i bshad pa las yang dang yang du zhus pa la la las 'di skad du 'byung ngo zhes bshad do/ /de bas na 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa kha che ba zhes bya ste zhes 'byung bas zhu ba rdzogs pa dang bcas pa'i gzhung bla ma ni yang dag par bsdus pa'i gzhi po nyams pas ma dag cing / zhu ba ma rdzogs pa ni yul dbus kyi dge slong 'ga' zhig gi blo la snang ba'am/ mes ma tshig par phyis thal ba'i gseb nas rnyed par grags pas dang po'i gzhung ma nyams pa nyid yin pas shin tu dag go//༈ gnyis pa 'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi skor la/ sher phyin bye ba phrag brgya pa la sogs pa bod du ma 'gyur zhing / yum rgyas pa 'bum ni sngon gyi 'gyur rnying gzhir bzhag nas phyis rngog lo chen pos bal po pham thing gi gtsug lag khang gi 'bum la gtugs nas/ shes rab sgron ma/ snang ba gsal ba/ zla ba'i sgron me ste ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi ming gsar du bcug pa sogs dag par mdzad pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin brgya nyer gcig /sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig /zhus lan brgya dang nyi shu/ 'gres ring brgya lnga bcu/ phyogs skor bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ mtshon byed kyi chos bdun cu/ 'gres rtsa bdun brgya dang bcu gcig /'gres thung bsnan pa'i 'gres rtsa khri dang bzhi brgya nyer dgu zhes dpyod ldan rnams la yongs su grags pa/ sh+lau ka stong phrag brgya ste 'bum phrag gcig yod pas mtshan yang de ltar smos pa ste/187—708

klu sgrub kyis klu'i gnas nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe byams zhus/ chos 'phags/ rtag ngu / yongs gtad de le'u bzhi klus ma bskur bas ma tshang ba/ phyis nyi khri dang brgyad stong nas kha bskang ba'i lugs kyang yod de/ 'dir kha ma bskangs pa'i lugs kyis bam po sum brgya dang gcig le'u don gnyis su yod pa las/ tso kyi par bam po dang po nas nyer bzhi pa yan la shog grangs lnga brgya dang zhe bzhi/ spyosartsi par bam po nyer lnga nas nga gcig bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang so lnga/ 1)rtsi par bam po nga gnyis nas don brgyad bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang re bzhi/ tshosartsi par bam po don dgu nas brgya dang gnyis bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang drug /(mi par mthong lam rgyas bshad skabs snar thang par mar tshad ma med pa'i 'gres rkang chad pa 'dir gsar du bcugs pa bam po brgya dang gsum nas sum cu'i bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang zhe bzhi/ sgrospyispyi par bam po brgya dang so gcig nas nga bzhi bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang so drug /sgroslo par bam po brgya dang nga lnga nas don drug bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang so lnga/ sgros par bam po brgya dang don bdun nas nyis brgya gsum par shog grangs lnga brgya dang re gsum/ () par bam po nyis brgya dang bzhi pa nas nyer dgu bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyer gcig /〈milji par bam po nyis brgya dang sum cu nas nga lnga bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyer brgyad/ sgroslo par bam po nyis brgya nga drug nas don brgyad bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang bzhi bcu tham pa/ lgo'i/ par bam po nyis brgya don dgu nas sum brgya gcig gi bar dang / de steng byams zhus/ chos 'phags/rtag ngu / yongs gtad bcas kyi le'u gsum bam po gsum bsnan khyon bam po sum brgya bzhi'i bar rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa la shog grangs lnga brgya dang 187wa 709

nyer gcig /yum rgyas pa 'di la rlangs khams pa go cha/ be+e ro tsā na/ rtse khyi 'brug zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur byang drug yod par grags kyang / dpe phal cher la mi 'dug zhes snar thang dkar chag tu 'byung yang / dpe rang la 'gyur byang gsal/ — yum 'bring po stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa le'u bdun cu rtsa drug dang / bam po bdun cu rtsa brgyad yod pa las/ (shirtsi par bam po dang po nas nyer bdun bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang nga brgyad/ 1zlortsi par bam po nyer brgyad nas nga gnyis bar shog grangs lnga brgya dang zhe brgyad/ 〈shisnyi par bam po nga gsum nas bdun cu rtsa brgyad rdzogs par shog grangs lnga brgya dang so bdun/'gyur byang dngos ma 'khod kyang sde dger lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pa'i dus su bsgyur bar gsungs ༈khri brgyad stong pa bam po drug cu/ le'u brgyad cu rtsa brgyad yod pa las/ spyodaljipar bam po dang po nas nyer gnyis yan dang / le'u dang po nas nyer dgu yan bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nga gsum/ sgrozlortsi par bam po nyer gsum nas zhe bzhi'i bar dang / le'u sum cu nas drug cu re gsum stod cha yan bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe dgu/ 1shirtsi par bam po zhe lnga nas drug cu rdzogs kyi bar dang / le'u re gsum pa'i smad cha nas brgyad cu rtsa brgyad bar yongs rdzogs la 'gyur byang ma 'khod/ snar sder ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur bar gsungs shing /le'u brgyad cu rtsa gnyis su bshad pa'ang yod/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa'i stod bam po brgyad pa yan bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nga drug /lnga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa'i smad bam po dgu pa nas bam po so bzhi le'u so gsum rdzogs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sda sogs kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab par shog grangs bzhi brgya dang drug cu/ — yum bsdus pa brgyad stong pa rgya dpe tha dad pa'i dbang gis 107—710

phreng ba can/ bzo sbyangs/ sde can te tshig sna ring thung dang / 'gyur khyad mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa las/ rgyas pa phreng ba can gyi lugs pu sta ka gcig la/tshoshirtsi par bam po nyer bzhi le'u so gnyis/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya se na dang /dzñā na sidhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag bod kyi dpal lha btsan po bkra shis lha lde btsan gyi bkas rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā ṣi ta dang ske/ sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos 'grel pa dang mthun par bsgyur/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ kur shrī dzñā na dang ske/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos yul dbus kyi 'grel pa la gtugs nas bcos shing zhus te gtan la phab/ yang slad kyis skyid smad mnye thang na mo cher paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī tshwa na dang / lo tsā ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gnyis kyis brgyad stong pa bshad pa'i dus su che long zhig gtan la phab/ phyis ra sgreng gi gtsug lag khang du lo tsā ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rgya dpe gsum la gtugs nas lan gnyis gtan la phab/slad kyis yang lo tsā ba de nyid kyis bshad pa mdzad cing phran tshegs kyang gtan la phab / dus phyis lo tsā ba chen po shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis kha che'i dpe dang / yul dbus kyi dpe du ma bsags nas gtan la phab/ slar yang snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po zhwa lu lo tsā ba dpal rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis rgya bod kyi dpe du ma dang bstun nas shin tu rnam par dag par mdzad pa'i ma phyi las slar yang zhus te gtan la phab pa la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu/ ༈ sher phyin sna tshogs dang / mdo 107—711

gsar 'gyur skor/ (k+ṣi par rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus pa bam po drug dang le'u bdun pa/snar sde'i dkar chag tu bam po bdun gsungs kyang / mdo rang du bam po drug las mi snang /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ dkon brtsegs kyi 'dus pa zhe drug pa las byung ba/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis pa dang / sher phyin lnga brgya pa gnyis skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ khri brgyad stong pa'i le'u tha ma las byung ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa bam po gcig pa sh+lau ka nyis brgya/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sidha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ sher phyin sum brgya pa'am rdo rje gcod pa bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur la skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu 'di rgyud dang sher phyin gnyis kur gtogs/ pa/ sher phyin mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa / sher phyin lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ sher phyin ko'u shi ka /sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu rnams 'gyur byang med pa/ sher rgyud dang sher phyin gnyis kur gtogs phyin sgo nyer lnga pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa/ sher phyin shes rab snying po bam po gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba dge blo dang nam mkha' la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slar yang dus phyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rgya dpe dge rgyas bye ma gling gi rtsig ngogs la bris pa dang zhus dag bgyis pa/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/107—712

sher phyin kun tu bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams 'gyur byang med pa/ de nas gsar 'gyur gyi mdo rnams sher phyin du gtogs pa ma yin mod kyi/ dus phyis 'gyur ba rnams phyogs gcig tu sngar nas glegs bam 'di'i gsham du babod 'dug cing theg pa che chung gang yin dang / snga 'gyur dang zlos pa yod med sogs kyang ma brtag par bzhag snang ba bzhin/ de ltar byas zhes sde dge'i dkar chag tu gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang bod gra mtshungs ched 'dir bzhugs pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes rabs kyi gleng gzhi'i mdo/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo skabs gnyis pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/byams pa bsgoms pa'i mdo/ bslab pa lnga'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo/ tshe dang ldan pa ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' btul ba'i mdo/ 'od srung chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo / 'phags pa bkra shis chen po'i mdo ste mdo tshan bcu gsum po 'di rnams paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan ta shrī'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe gsum/⑫ gsum pa 'khor lo tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i skor/ sangs rgyas phal po che ni/ brda rnying du sangs rgyas rma ga chad dang / rmag chad dang / smad chad du grags shing / yang snyan gyi gong rgyan dang / pad+ma'i rgyan/ shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo zhes bsgyur ba'ang yod de/ de lta bu'i mchan de'ang bye brag gi ming spyi la btags par gsal te/ mdo 'di'i le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du phal po che zhes dkar chag ldan dkar ma sogs su bshad pa gang zhig /des lhag ma rnams la'ang mtshan deltar grags pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mtshan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i mdo sde 'di la/ spyir sh+lau ka 'bum dang / le'u brgya yod pa las/ sngon na len+d+ra bi ha ra la me'i dgra byung ba'i rkyen gyis/ ma 107—713

tshang ba'i 'phro ji tsam bzhugs pa bsgyur ba la/ glegs bam/ spyodaskyi par 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi le'u nas/ byang sems kyi rnam par dgod pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u'i bar le'u nyi shu/ bam po nyer gcig bcas la shog grangs sum brgya dang don brgyad/ sgromi par bam po nyer gnyis pa tshangs par spyod pa'i le'u nas/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u stod cha'i bam po bzhi bcu zhe gcig yan la shog grangs sum brgya dang nga dgu/ (k+ṣi par rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u'i smad cha bam po zhe gnyis pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u'i bar bam po drug cu re gnyis yan la shog grangs sum brgya dang gya drug /slospyismi par bam po re gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u'i stod cha bar bam po gya bzhi yan la shog grangs sum brgya dang bdun cu tham pa/ 1spyilji par bam po gya lnga pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u smad cha nas sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u'i stod cha bam po brgya pa yan la shog grangs sum brgya dang dgu bcu tham pa/tshomi par bam po brgya dang gcig nas bam po brgya dang bco lnga bar sdong po brgyan pa'i mdo yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ciren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing / lo chen bai ro tsā nas zhus chen mdzad pa bcas la shog grangs sum brgya dang zhe gcig /'di la snar thang dkar chag tu bam po brgya dang sum cu/ sde dger brgya dang bcu drug gsungs kyang mdo rang la bam po brgya dang bco lnga snang / ༈ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'phags yul du le'u stong phrag brgya bzhugs pa las gong du phal chen gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar 'phags yul du ma tshang bar gyur pa phyis ji tsam rnyed pa bsdus nas le'u bzhi bcu 107—714

rtsa dgu'i bdag nyid can 'di'i glegs bam/ 1shis par sdom gsum bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pal lar bam po phyed bzhi/ sh+lau ka bcu zhes bshad pa'ang mchis/ sgomatha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba chos kun gsal ba'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u nyer lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'aga' zhig gis bam po bcu gcig dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgyar bshad pa'ang mchis/ rmi lam bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos dkar chag ldan dkar mar sh+lau ka stong dang / rig ral gyis sh+lau ka brgya par bshad/ pa/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang bco brgyad/ sgrosale par mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod pa'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang —/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po drug pa/ lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya dpe las bsgyur ba/chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med par bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye 107—715

shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa chos bcu pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/'di'i bam grangs dang /sh+lau ka 'dra min ci rigs snang / 'phags pa kun nas sgo'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa 'od zer kun nas bkye ba'i mdo bam po lnga pa 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nyi shu tham pa/ 9shirtsi par byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bstan pa'i mdo bam po nyi shu dang le'u bcu gcig pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsar+ya su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / ā tsar+ya dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'adi la sde dger le'u bcu gnyis dang / sh+lau ka drug stong zhes snang / dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag gi dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa sde dger 'gyur byang mi gsal/ dga' bo mngal na gnas pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe brgyad/ldan dkar mar bam po gnyis zhes gsung /ltadzosmi par 'jam tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po phyed bzhi/ chos 'byung rnams su bam po gsum dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya bzhi bcu/ dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu bam po gsum dang / sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcur gsungs / dpal gyi zhing bkod pa'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo bam po cibaco lnga dang le'u nyer drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad 107—716

gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/sde dger sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya dang / bcom ldan ral gris sh+lau ka nyis brgya lnga bcu lhag yod par gsungs/ gang pos zhus pa'i mdo bam po drug dang le'u brgyad pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang brgyad/'di la sde dger le'u gnyis gsungs kyang gzhung la mi gsal/ spyo:snyipar khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/'di la ldan dkar mar sh+lau ka bdun brgya lnga bcu/ tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po phyed gsum/ chos 'byung rnams su bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ sman lung pa'i gsan yig tu bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya dang bcu/ dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu sh+lau ka lnga bcu zhes byung / glog thob kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/'ga' zhig tu sh+lau ka grangs 'dra min sna tshogs snang / cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pasne dger sh+lau ka dgu brgya zhes snang / byams pa seṅge sgra'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/sde dger sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya zhes snang / nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing 107—717

zhus pa/sde dger sh+lau ka drug brgya zhes snang / lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/sde dger sh+lau ka drug brgya zhes snang / lag bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu sh+lau ka brgya zhes byung /'phags pa des pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ khyim bdag dpal byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa'i mdo bam po phyed pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/kun mkhyen bus sh+lau ka nyis brgyar bzhed/ bu mo gaṅgā'i mchog gis zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya dang bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu bam po phyed ces 'byung / mya ngan med sbyin lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu bam po phyed / sman lung pas sh+lau ka sum brgya zhes 'byung / dri ma med kyi sbyin pa lung bstan pa'i mdo bam 107—718

po gnyis pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po phyed gnyis zhes byung / yon tan rin po che me tog kun tu rgyas pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/bcom ldan ral gri sogs kyis sh+lau ka grangs 'dra min sna tshogs gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shrī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don brgyad / 11rtsi par lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa seṅges zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka drug cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shrī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pasnar sder dā na shī la dang / garma warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur zhes byung yang / mdo rang la gong ltar gsal/ tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ bu mo rnam dag dang bas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gos chos grub kyis rgya dpe las bsgyur ba/snar sde gnyis la 'gyur byang mi gsal zhing / bam grangs dang sh+lau ku'i grangs 'dra min sna tshogs snang / byams pas zhu/sa pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo 107—719

dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ byams pas chos brgyad zhus pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pablo ka grangs 'dra min sna tshogs byung / 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo rang du bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pasde dger sh+lau ka drug brgya zhes gsal/ rin po che'i phung po lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/sde dger sh+lau ka drug brgya bdun cu zhes dang / blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ lo tsā ba dharma tā shī las skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa sher phyin bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ dpal phreng seng ge'i dngos zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/sde dger sh+lau ka drug brgya zhes gsal/ drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa rnams la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang gya brgyad/187—720

༈ bzhi pa 'khor lo gsum ci rigs pa'i sder gtogs pa mdo mang gi skor la / tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi bsgrigs rim ltar dgod par theg chen dang /theg dman gnyis las snga ma la 'khor lo tha ma shas che zhing / bar par gtogs pa'ang ci rigs yod mod kyi/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang ma phye bar bzhag pa ltar glegs bam sum cu'i 〈(lji par 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyer drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi byā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba la/ slar yang ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang bdun cu / tshosaspyi par rgya cher rol pa'i mdo bam po bco brgyad dang le'u nyer bdun pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni warma rnams dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos pa / 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pasnar sde gnyis su bam po gcig dang / sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa bzhi zhes byung yang / mdo rang du mi gsal/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs sems can thams cad la gzigs shing zhing gi bkod pa bstan pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang ske/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde dang cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/snar thang du bam po gnyis zhes byung yang / mdo rang du mi gsal zhing / 'ga' zhig gis 107—721

'di rgyud du bzhed pa'ang snang / dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyer gnyis/ (k+ṣi par ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che bam po nyer lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes snying pos bsgyur ba la slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta bi shud+dha sidha dang / sarba dzñā de ba dang —/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje dpal brtsegs rnams kyis zhus pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo bam po gsum dang sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas gtan la phab pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang so lnga/() par dge rtsa yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo bam po bco brgyad dang le'u bco lnga pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de legs kyi sdes bsgyur ba la / slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde rnams kyis zhus pa/ zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sh+lau ka nyis brgya bdun cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs phal chen nas zur du bkol ba/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ rgya 107—722

gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe bdun/ tshomirtsi par dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo le'u bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab zhes snang / lang gshegs rgya nag nas bsgyur bar grags pa bam po dgu pa lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis bsgyur ba/gsan yig dang dkar chag rnams su le'u drug pa brgyad pa nyer brgyad pa sogs 'byung yang glegs bam rang du le'u bdun las mi gsal/ lang gshegs rin po che'i mdo bam po brgyad pa/ rgya'i slob dpon we na tī yis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang sbyar nas lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba/ ga ya go ri'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don gsum/(spyilji par rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo bam po bzhi dang le'u dgu gsham ma tshang ba 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo gadhi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur zhes byung —/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po bam po drug dang le'u bcu gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra dang —/ shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal chems bam po bco lnga dang le'u drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /pra dzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don bzhi/ sgromi par dam chos pad+ma dkar po bam po bcu gsum dang le'u nyer bdun pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de sna nam ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ye shes 107wa 723

sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/dkar chag sngon ma rnams su bam po drug ces byung / bde ba can gyi bkod pa sh+lau ka sum cu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shrī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/sh+lau ga'i grangs la mkhas pa rnams kyis 'dra min sna tshogs gsungs/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo bam po bzhi dang le'u gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra sogs dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/sde dger bam po phyed lnga zhes byung —/ dkon mchog gi za ma tog bam po bzhi pa/ lo tsā ba brje rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ rin po che mtha'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya bcu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang re bzhi/ 9)rtsi par yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo le'u nyi khri lnga stong pa las lha dang mi la sogs pas zhus pa'i le'u nyi tshe ba bam po bcu gsum dang le'u lnga sh+lau ka sum stong dgu brgya mchis pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba brje de wa tsan+d+ras bsgyur te gtan la phab patshal pa dkar chag tu le'u khri zhes 'byung / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo chung ba sh+lau ka drug cu'i tshad tsam pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la gu bha dang /lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'da' kha ye shes sh+lau ka bcu pa/rgya nag nas bsgyur ba dkar chag ldan dkar ma las bshad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi chos kyi yi ge bam po bzhi dang le'u bcu gcig sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya pa 'gyur byang med pa/them spang ma las rgya nag nas bsgyur ba'i brda rnying par snang zhes bshad/ mdo 'di dkar chag chen mo gsum du tshad mar mdzad/ gzhan 'ga' zhig gis dpyad gzhir mdzad pa'ang mchis/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis 107—724

bcos pa/ gser gyi mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ gser gyi bye ma lta bu'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad cu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pra dzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe brgyad/9)lji par ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo bam po bco lnga dang le'u so dgu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pazla ba sgron ma'i mdo yang 'di nyid la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa mang ngo / / chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las mi g.yo ba'i mdo sh+lau ka dgu bcu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la dang /ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ rdo rje gdan pas bam po gsum zhes bshad/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting 'dzin gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos padakar chag dang gsan yig rnams su le'u so brgyad ces gsal yang mdo rang du le'u ma 'khod/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po phyed gnyis pal/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ snar sder le'u dgu par bshad kyang gzhung rang du le'u ma 'khod/ ye shes phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka drug cu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / mu ni warma dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pasne dge'i dkar chag tu le'u dgu/ dkar chag dang gsan yig gzhan du le'u bcu dgur gsungs kyang gzhung du le'u ma 'khod/ bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang lnga/ (mi par da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po bdun dang le'u nyer lnga 107—725

pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/le'u lnga bcu zhes byung yang mdo rang du le'u dang po zhes pa las ma byung / khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi rnam grangs yi ge bam po gnyis dang le'u dgu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog dam pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs bam po brgyad dang le'u bcu gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/rdo rje gdan pas le'u bcu gcig pa zhes gsungs/rdo rje snying po'i gzungs bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba/ sgo mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sh+lau ka nyis brgya dang bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/'di'i steng sh+lau ka drug cu lhag po yod ces bzhed pa'ang snang / sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sh+lau ka bco brgyad pa 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang re lnga/ sgo mtha' yas pa dang / sgo drug 'di gnyis rgyud kyi khongs su bzhugs kyang / dbyig gnyen gyis mdor bkral bar grags/(gyi par rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs sh+lau ka brgya dang nyi shu pa/paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/sman lung pas sh+lau ka brgya nyer gcig par bshad/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu bsgoms pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang le'u bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la 107—726

dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/snar sde'i dkar chag tu gong ltar gsal yang tshal pa dkar chag na le'u gsum dang sh+lau ka dgu bcu yod tshul gsungs/ byang sems kyi spyod yul thabs kyi yul las rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa'i mdo le'u bcu pa/paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur snar sder bam po lnga zhes gsungs kyang mdo rang la bam grangs mi snang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ nam mkha'i mdzod kyis zhus pa bam po brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dza ya shī la dang —/ shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/snar sder sh+lau ka bdun cu zhes gsal yang gzhung dngos la shog bu gcig las mi snang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang ske/ lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang gya bzhi/ 93lji par blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / bud+dha pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo rgyas pa bam po dang po las mi gsal ba le'u bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo 'bring po dge bcu bstan pa sh+lau 107—727

ka nyis brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo chung ngu sh+lau ka bcu gnyis pa/paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde dang / yi ge pa dgon gling rma la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus chen bgyis pa/ snar sder bam po bzhi gsungs kyang mdo rang du bam grangs mi gsal/mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ lo tsā ban+de dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang gya gsum/ spyosalji par tshangs pas zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tshangs pa'i sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang /lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/snar thang du bam po gcig par gsungs kyang /mdo rang la mi snang / tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po drug pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / dharma pā la dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī la sogs kyis bsgyur ba/ par zhus kyi lo tsā ba ban+de de wa tsan+d+ra rak+ṣi ta dang / ku mā ra rak+ṣi ta la sogs pas zhus pa/ rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya dang bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ rin chen dra ba can 107—728

gyis zhus pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/snar sder bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu gsungs kyang / mdor bam grangs mi gsal/ rin chen zla bas zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya nyer bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sidha dang / lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur te/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bibyā ka ra sidha dang /lo tsā ba ban+de de wa tsan+d+ras zhus/ bde byed kyis zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad cu pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa gsum pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra la sogs pa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyuraXdi yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo chung ba yin la/ che ba ni dkon brtsegs kyi le'u bco brgyad par ngos 'dzin / rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po bzhi pa 'gyur byang med pa/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ bu mo dpal ldan gyis zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka dgu bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ bgres mos zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya dang bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang gnyis/ tsho'i par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dris pa'i mdo sh+lau ka dgu bcu la bam po gcig pa 107—729

'gyur byang med pa/ bdag med pas dris pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gup+ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/'di la klu mes kyis bka' ma yin par bsgrags kyang / lo chen gyis bsgyur ba 'dis the tshom med/ 'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pa'i mdo bam po bzhi dang le'u bcu gnyis pa 'gyur byang med rdo rje gdan pas le'u bcu gcig tu bshad/ pa/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos gong dkar bas bam po drug tu bshad/ pa/ 'phags pa li tsā bi'i dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo le'u bcu gnyis pa lo tsā ba ban+de chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ snar sder bam po drug gsal yang / mdor bam grangs mi snang / 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka phyed dang bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang ske/ dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī la la sogs pas zhus pa/chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ lo tsā ba ban+de rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang re dgu/ 9mipar sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bstan pa'i sbyin pa'i le'u dgu/ tshul khrims kyi le'u bdun/ bzod pa'i le'u gsum/ brtson 'grus kyi le'u gcig /bsam gtan gyi le'u bzhi ste re re la rdzogs so yod pa bam po drug dang le'u nyer bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la 187—730

sogs pas bsgyur ba/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin bstan pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ mdo rang du le'u dang po tsam gsal zhing / dkar chag gsan yig sogs su bam po gnyis dang le'u bzhi par gsungs kyang ma 'khod/sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka sum cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/sde dge dkar chag dang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsan yig tu 'di la chos rnams kyi rgyan bkod spungs pa lhab lhub bkod pa'i mdo'i le'u bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa khol du phyung bar ngos 'dzin mdzad/ snar thang dkar chag dang chu bzang gsan yig tu mdo snga ma la ngos 'dzin mdzad 'dug /byang sems kyi spyod pa bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/snar thang du sh+lau ka nyis brgya nyi shu zhes gsal/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka bcu/ snar thang du bam po gcig /tshal par bam steng sh+lau ka lnga bcur bcas gsungs kyang / mdo rang du bam grangs mi gsal/ phal po che 'bum pa las le'u nyer dgu pa khol du phyung bar grags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang med pa/ mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sidha dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur cing / slad nas paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhus chen bgyis pa/ tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bzhi bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha 187—731

sidha dang / lo tsā ba dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur cing / slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta bit+yā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba brje de wa tsan+d+ras zhus pa/ bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/snar sder bam po gnyis pa zhes gsal/ bde ldan ma lung bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun cu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya pa 'gyur byang med pa/'di rgyal tshab pas rgyud du bzhed/ rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis zhus pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu gcig pa 'gyur byang med pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos pasnar sder bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cur gsungs/ 'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byams pa bdud rtsi brjod pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byams pa 'jug pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / dzi na mi tra dang /su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ byams pa dga' ldan gnam du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo/ lo tsā ba ban+de bab stong dang /ban+de shes rab seṅges rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba/ 'jig rten gyi rjes su mthun par 'jug pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar 107—732

bcad kyis bcos pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang gya drug /tshozlortsi par dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i stobs kyi mdo bam po lnga dang sh+lau ka bdun cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur/ nges pa dang ma nges pa 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/snar sder bam po gcig par gsal/ chos kyi phyag rgya'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad cu pa/ lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i dbang po dang / lha'i zla bas bsgyur ba/mar me phul ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/snar sder bam po gcig pa zhes gsal/ grong khyer gyi 'a31 ba'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bibyā ka ra sidha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de de wa tsan+d+ras zhus pa/ zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa'i mdo sh+lau ka so brgyad pa 'gyur byang med pa/ glang po'i rtsal gyi mdo 'gyur byang med pa/snar sder bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu zhes gsal/ sgra chen po'i mdo sh+lau ka re bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi shud+dha sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur cing / slar yang paṇ+ḍi ta bibyā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de de wa tsan+d+ras zhus pa/ seṅge'i sgra bsgrags pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta bibyā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de rba rje ye shes snying po'i 'gyurar/ kur chag chen mo rnams su bam po gcig tu byas kyang bam po'i sum cha tsam las med/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya nyer drug pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka sum cu pa 'gyur byang med pa/snar sder ban+de nam mkha'i 'gyur zhes theg dman du grags kyang mkhas pa dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel par rnam 107wa 733

shes tshogs brgyad sogs bstan pas theg pa thun mong ba yin zhes thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston bzhed do/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sor mo'i phreng ba can la phan pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shrī la dang ske/ rgya'i ban+de tong ā tsār+ya la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la dang / ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur / bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa'i mdo 'gyur byang gong mtshungs /'di gnyis mkhas pa mang pos dpyad gzhir mdzad kyang tshal pa si tu thams cad mkhyen pas tshad mar mdzad do / / rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa sel ba'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī gar+bha dang / a tsār+ya rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus chen bgyis pa/ khyim bdag dpal sbas kyi mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pasnar sder bam po gcig par gsungs/ las sgrib rnam par dag pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/sde dger bam po gcig dang blo ka bzhi bcur gsungs/ las sgrib rgyun gcod pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya sum cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don bdun/ 1zlortsi par sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u dgu pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī pra bha dang / lo tsā ba dge slong dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur / rgyal po gsal rgyal la gdams pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na 107—734

mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ rnga bo che'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/snar thang du bam po gsum zhes snang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/dkar chag sngon ma rnams su bam po bzhi dang / le'u gnyis bshad kyang mdo rang du bam grangs mi snang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo sh+lau ka sum cu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang —/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/rnam par thar pa thams cad sdud pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang ske/ mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/snar sder bam po gcig pa zhes gsal / sangs rgyas bgro ba zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal dbyangs dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba brje dpal dbyangs kyis bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/'dus pa chen po'i mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig gi mdo bam po gsum dang le'u bzhi pa/ 'dir las tshogs dang / bsnyen sogs bshad pas bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bzhugs dgos zhes mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gsungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de 107—735
