wa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don drug /sgrospyilji par dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ lo tsā ba rin chen 'tsho dang / chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ sprin chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u so bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /lo tsā ba brnye ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sprin chen po'i mdo las phyogs bcu'i byang sems rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston la rtse ba'i mdo le'u so bdun pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/snar sder bam po gsum pa zhes gsal/ sprin chen rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/snar sder bam po gcig pa zhes gsal/ sprin chen po'i le'u 'bum pa las re bzhi pa khol du phyung bar grags pa sprin chen po'i le'u las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa cho ga dang bcas pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pasnar thang du bam po phyed gsum par gsal/ gtsug tor chen po gsang ba grub pa'i mdo mngon par thos pa'i rgyud byang sems thams cad kyi spyod pa bsdus pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo le'u stong phrag bcu pa las le'u bcu pa khol du phyung ba bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang med pa/klu mes kyis bka' yin min the tshom du mdzad kyang —/ bu ston gyis tshad mar bzhed/ gtsug tor bam po dgu pa las bdud kyi le'u nyi tshe phyung ba sh+lau ka don lnga pa sngon gyi dkar chag rnams su rgya nag las bsgyur ba'i khung mar bshad/ bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang re drug /1spyi| par 'phags pa chos thams cad yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī gar+bha dang / bi dza ya shī la dang / shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā 187—736

ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa'adi la mtshan gzhan chos bgro ba zer bas dkar chag chen mo'i chos kun bgro ba dang gcig min brtag / 'dus pa chen po las sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u brgyad pa/rgya'i mkhan po hwa shang zab mo la sogs pa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/'di'i le'u lnga pa'i grangs mi gsal/ 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i mdo bam po drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo'i mdo/ shī la dharma dang / rnam par mi rtog pas rgya las bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo'i mdo/ li'i dge slong sde snod gsum dang ldan pa shī la dharmas/ rgya gar gyi dharma'i yi ge las ban+de rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don gnyis/sgrozloskyi par dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'i yi ge bam po gcig pa/ sngon rgya las bsgyur ba'i brda rnying pa skad gsar bcad kyis ma bcos par snang / /'di la'ang 'ga' zhig gis the tshom byas snang ngo / /'phags pa chos kyi tshul bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/'phags pa chos kyi phung po'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya brgyad cu pa / paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo sh+lau ka dgu bcu pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i chos bzhi bsgrub pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka 187—737

ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros dang / dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/snar sder bam po gcig pa zhes gsal/ 'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur / chos bzhi pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa bzhi sgrub pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya drug cu pa/rgyal tshab pas mdo 'di dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur zhes gsungs/'gyur byang med pa/ chos gsum pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de de wa tsān+d+ras bsgyur cing lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa chos rgya mtsho'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad cu pa/ rgya las 'gyur ba skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/'phags pa chos kyi rgya mo'i mdo bam po gnyis pa rgya las bsgyur ba/'di la'ang 'ga' zhig gis the tshom byas kyang / sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis tshad mar byas so/ /'phags pa nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo bam po bcu gsum dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang / bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / dharmā ka ra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de bzang skyong gis bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo bam po bcu pa gong ma gnam skyong gi dus su rgya dpe las bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang dgu bcu go lnga/ spyobartsipar 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /187—738

dā na shī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus pa/'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / brje rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus ces gsal/ 'phags pa thabs mkhas pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa bam po brgyad pa 'gyur byang med pa/'di mtshan mang po bsabs pa'i rgyun yin kyang da dung cung zad ma tshang bar yod 'dra/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po bcu gcig dang le'u bcu gnyis pa rgya nag nas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyis sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su sgrub pa rnam par bkod pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya bcu gnyis pa rgya nag gi 'gyur/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal ba'i cho ga dang mtshan nas brjod pa'i gleng gzhi 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang zhe bzhi/tshozloskyi par 'phags pa me tog gi tshogs kyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na sirnyi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dharmā tā shī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus chen bgyis pa/ pang skong phyag rgya pa thu mi saṃ bho ṭa'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun cu don lnga pa 'gyur byang med pa/phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sidha dang / lo tsā ba rtsangs de wan+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhu chen bgyis pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya rtsa lnga pa 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger paṇ+ḍi ta shākya sidha dang / lo tsā ba de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur zhes byung / 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa'i mdo sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa 187—739

gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu pa'i mdo yon tan rin chen me tog kun tu rgyas pas zhus pa sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma la sogs pa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang /lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas dbu brgyan gyi mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de de wan+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes ṭi ka dang sbyar te gsar du bsgyur cing zhus pa/ sangs rgyas mi spong ba'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bdun cu pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa'i mdo sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ chos rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo / sku gsum pa zhes bya ba'i mdo rnams 'gyur byang med pa/ dkon brtsegs kyi nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las byung ba'i 'phags pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo sh+lau ka lnga brgya sum cu pa/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad 187—740

gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'phags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i mdo sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa'i bsngo ba'i mdo sh+lau ka bzhi bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag bam po dang po nas nyi shu pa yan bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang bcu drug /spyotānywa par mdo dran pa nyer bzhag bam po nyer gcig nas zhe lnga yan la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang bdun cu don brgyad/ lgo'i par dran pa nyer bzhag bam po zhe drug pa nas zhe dgu'i bar dang / 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyi sa las rtag tu bde ba'i sa ste brgyad pa'i skabs yan dang 'thab bral gyi bdag po mu su lun+dha'i rdzu 'phrul chen po rdzogs pa'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig /1rdosnri par de 'phros longs su rdzogs pa/'di'i gzhung tshad sh+lau ka stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug /bam por bcad na brgya nyi shur bshad kyang bam po bzhi bcu rtsa dgu man bam mtshams ma bcad par snang ngo / /'di ni snga 'gyur la dus phyis shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bhu ti tsan+d+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra dang / pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur chad bsab ste bcos pa dang / yongs dril dran pa nyer bzhag po ti bzhi cung ma longs tsam zhig yod/ las mngags pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyuralha/ la par bam steng sh+lau ka bzhi bcur gsungs/ mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos bsu ba bam po phyed pa/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid sh+lau ka dgu bcu pa/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po bam po phyed pa/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog sh+lau ka bzhi bcu pa/mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa sh+lau ka bzhi bcu pa/ mdo chen po lnga gsum pa sh+lau 107—741

ka nyis brgya nyi shu pa rnams rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ lo tsā ba bzang skyong gi 'gyur la dpal brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ gzhon nu dpe'i mdo sh+lau ka nyi shu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ khams mang po'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur cing lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bcos pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa snar sder paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā ka ra dang / lo tsā ba bzang skyong gi 'gyur du gsungs/ bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang drug cu re lnga/ 1zloskyipar mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dharma shrī bha dra dang /lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/'di kha cig bstan bcos su 'dod pa'ang yod gsungs / dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ tshul khrims yang dag pa ldan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ ltung ba sde lnga'i dge mi dge'i 'bras bu brtag pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dzñā na shrī gup+ta dang / lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/'ga' zhig 'bras bu bstan pa zhes kyang bshad/ mchog tu dge ba'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/'di 'ga' zhig gis las gdags par ngos 'dzin pa byung ngo / /rnam par grol ba'i lam la sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi byā kur pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ tshe mtha'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya dang lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sidha dang /lo tsā ba brje dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur cing / slar yang bit+yā ka ra sidha dang /107—742

lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ 'chi 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'di'i 'gyur byang gsar pa ma rnyed kyang snga 'gyur zhig la skad gsar bcad kyis ma bcos par gsungs/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo sh+lau ka bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ 'du shes bcu bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgyad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal chems 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu gcig pa/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya pa rnams 'gyur byang med pa/'di bya rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs par bshad/ mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang —/ dā na shī la dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos par gsungs/ mun gyi nags 6595 3) byang phyogs rgyud kyi phreng ba'i khri pa'i nang nas yul na len+d+ra'i byang phyogs kyi mtshams kyi ri u shi ri'i bsngags pa'o/ /mdo/ pha ma'i mdo/ bden pa bzhi'i mdo rnams 'gyur byang med pa / don rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sh+lau ka bdun cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/snar sder bam po gcig par gsungs kyang gzhung rang la bam grangs med/ don rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sh+lau ka brgya pa 'gyur byang med pa/mjug cung zad ma tshang bar bshad/ rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs sh+lau ka bdun cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang —/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sh+lau ka drug cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing dpal brtsegs kyis zhus chen bgyis pa/ mchod rten skor 107—743

ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sh+lau ka bdun cu pa/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa sh+lau ka brgya pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa sh+lau ka brgya pa rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bam po bzhi dang / mi rtag pa'i tshoms nas bram ze'i tshoms kyi bar sum cu rtsa gsum yod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang ske/ lo tsā ba ban+de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/'di mdo sde pa rnams kyis bstan bcos su 'dod kyang / bye smras bka' yin par 'dod/skyes bu dam pa'i mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang /lo tsā ba bzang skyong gis bsgyur cing / ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa/ lo tsā ba rtsangs de wan+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus chen bgyis pa/ lha'i mdo sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa bdun pa 'gyur byang med pa/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu sh+lau ka bcu bdun pa/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur / zla ba'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu gsum pa 'gyur byang med pa/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo sh+lau ka drug cu pa/ lo tsā ba rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ gnas 'jog gi mdo sh+lau ka nyis brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ dga' ba can gyi mdo sh+lau ka nyi shu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de byin gyi snying pos bsgyur te/ ban+de de wa tsan+d+ras zhus pa/snar thang du 'gyur byang mi gsal/ 'khar gsil gyi mdo dang / 'khar gsil 'chang ba'i kun spyod bstan pa'i mdo gnyis 'gyur byang med pa/snar sder mdo gnyis bsdoms bam po gcig par gsungs kyang mdo rang la mi gsal/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu 107—744

bstan pa'i mdo/ lo tsā ba rgya nag lha btsun chos kyi rin chen gyi 'gyur/ las rnam 'byed bam po gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /mu ni warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ las rnam 'byed chung ba bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang med pa/ las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba'i mdo bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya bdun cu pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang bcu/1spyilji par mdo sde las brgya pa bam po dang po nas nyer drug pa yan dang / sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'i gtam rgyud dang po yan bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang bdun cu tham pa/ sgrozlortsi par bam po nyer bdun pa nas so bdun par dang / sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'i gtam rgyud gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar yongs rdzogs 'gyur byang med pa/ mdo sde mdzangs blun bam po bcu gnyis dang le'u nga gcig pa lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya gar dang rgya nag gi dpe las 'gyur bar snang/dkar chag bstan pa rgyas byed du bam po bcu gcig /su ren+d+ra dang ye shes sdes bsgyur bar bshad/ kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa sh+lau ka so bdun pa 'gyur byang med pa/ byams pa'i mdo/ ā nan ta shrī dang / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi 'gyur / byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya pa/ dzi na mi tra dang /dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang go drug /dzodhilji par gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po nyer gnyis pa dang ske/ sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang —/ lo tsā ba brje de wa tsan+d+ra'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo sh+lau ka bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sidha dang /sarba dzñā de wa dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/187—745

phag mo'i rtogs brjod sh+lau ka brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rtogs brjod/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bcos pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang drug cu re bzhi/ spyos: par 'phags pa bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de de wan+d+ra'i 'gyur/ zla 'od kyi rtogs brjod/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab legs pas bsgyur cing / rin chen bzang pos bcos pa/ dpal gyi sde'i rtogs brjod 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/rgyal po gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba bstan pa'i mdo sh+lau ka bcu bdun pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rgyal po don grub kyi mdo bam po gcig pa sngon rgya las 'gyur ba'i brda rnying pa can/thams cad sgrol gyi skye rabs yang 'di yin/ tshangs pa'i dra ba'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang med snar sder lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur zhes gsungs/ pa thabs la mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi drin lan bsab pa'i mdo bam po phyed brgyad dang le'u dgu pa rgya nag nas bsgyur ba/ legs nyes kyi rgyu 'bras bstan pa'i mdo/lo tsā ba ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba/ dge mi dge'i rnam smin bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang med pa/ zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las bstan pa gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshul lung bstan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/snar sder bam po gcig par gsungs kyang mdor mi snang / ri glang ru lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang med pa/ stag sna'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba 107—746

seng dkar dge slong shākya'i 'od kyi 'gyur/ mig bcu gnyis pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang zhe gnyis/ myu/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo/ lgo'i par bam po dang po nas nyer brgyad bar dang le'u dgu pa yan la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyer lnga/ sgrosaspyi par bam po nyer dgu pa nas nga drug pa mu stegs kyi rgyal po la shas gdung ma thob pa yan rgya nag gi mkhan po wang phab zhun dang / dharma'i gzhi 'dzin dge ba'i blo gros/ lo tsā ba rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur ba la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyer dgu/⑫/ gnyis pa sngags kyi skor la/ 'gyur la ltos te gsang sngags gsar ma dang ske/ rnying ma gnyis las/ dang po la rgyud sde'i sgo nas dbye na/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud dang bzhi/dang po ni/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos bla med kyi rgyud thams cad gnyis med kyi rgyud du bzhed pas thabs shes kyi rgyud las logs su gnyis med kyi rgyud mi bzhed kyang / 'dir dkar chag rnying pa rnams dang 'khrigs mthun par 'chad pas/ gnyis med kyi rgyud/ shes rab rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ thabs rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud dang gsum du mchis pa'i dang po la/glegs bam 9shirtsi par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsung rab thams cad la dbang 'byor ba'i bdag nyid chen po bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis nye bar bskyangs pa sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas/ bsam gtan gling gi dben gnas su bsgyur zhing dag par byas pa/ chu bzang gsan yig dang snar thang dkar chag tu le'u bcu pa sh+lau ka 107—747

sum brgya nyi shu dang rkang pa gnyis zhes dang / sde dge dkar chag tu le'u bcu bzhi par gsungs kyang rgyud rang du le'u mi gsal / 'di rgyud thams cad kyi dngos don mthar thug yin pa dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud rnams kyi snying por gyur pa gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir gnyis med kyi rgyud dang phyogs mtshungs su rgyud thams cad kyi dbur bkod pa yin no / /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan pa zhes bya ba/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ slar yang rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel bshad dang mthun par bsgyur cing zhus te dag par byas pa/ dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud le'u lnga pa/kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang bod kyi lo tsā ba 'byo dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ dus phyis yon tan phul du byung ba dpag tu med pas spras pa'i bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung dang /dpon chen shākya bzang po'i gsung bzhin du mkhas pa chen po zhang ston mdo sde dpal dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud pa'i dge slong tshul khrims dar gyis don gyi cha la legs par dpyad cing bskul te/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos rig pa'i dge slong shong ston gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i yul dbus kyi rgya dpe gnyis la gtugs shing legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po shākya'i dge slong gnyan chung dar ma grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bha dra bo dhi la sogs pa'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo 107—748

ban+de zla ba'i 'od zer la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/slad kyi rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sa man+ta shrī dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos rab kyis bcos shing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bha dra bo dhi'i zhal snga nas dang ske/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban+de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis 'bro dge slong gi phyir bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las dā ri ka las phyung bar grags pa'i dbang gi rab byed/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po sa man+ta shrī dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gnyis pa shes rab rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud rtog pa bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na klirti nyid kyis bsgyur/yon bdag bod kyi mkhan po gzhon nu grags pas zhus te bshad nas gtan la phab pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma rtog pa bco brgyad pa nas nyer gnyis yan gsal ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na klirti nyid kyis bsgyur/ yon bdag bod kyi mkhan po gzhon nu grags pas zhus te gtan la phab pa/dkar chag dang gsan yig rnams su rtog pa lnga par gsungs pa ni rtog pa bco brgyad nas nyer gnyis par rtog pa lnga yin pa gzhung du gsal/ kyai rdor rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa las btus pa'i rgyud brtag pa dang po la le'u bcu gcig dang gnyis pa la le'u bcu gnyis yod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/107—749

de'i rgyud phyi ma phyag chen thig le'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal sngar kai chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug mtshams dgra bcom gyis dad cing gus pas zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po le'u bzhi pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang gya gnyis/ sgromi par bshad rgyud ye shes kyi thig le le'u sum cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī pradzñā gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su zhu gtugs g.yar khral bgyis pa/ 'bras rgyud de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po pradzñā shrī gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ dus phyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su bsgyur cing zhus te dag par byas pa/ bde mchog gi rgyud 'bum pa las btus pa dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud le'u nga gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pad+mā ka ra dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba la/ phyis lo tsā ba pradzñā krirti dang / mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis nā ro'i phyag dpe las gtugs te bcos pa/ bshad rgyud mngon brjod bla ma le'u re dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dzñā na shrī dang / lo tsā ba khyung po chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis kyang zhus/ slar yang paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da dang / lo chung gis chad lhag rnams bsabs nas zhus dag byas nas legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi zhu 107—750

chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te dpe gnyis la gtugs nas gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcu bzhi pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mchog gi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyis grom pa ru lag rgyang bu'i lha ri mo'i mgul gyi dben gnas su bsgyur ba/ phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu pa sde rgyud ga pa nas phyungs pa/ dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma le'u gnyis pa gnyis rgyud 'di gnyis bu ston rin po ches tshad mar bzhed pa ltar 'dir gsar bsnan bgyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nga bdun / (snyo par sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u so gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gzhan la phan pa mtha' yas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rgyus ban+de smon lam grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slar yang yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i rgya dpe la btugs nas lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis kyang zhus/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud le'u nga gcig pa'i lnga bcu par rab byed nyer lnga yod pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rdo rje slob dpon rtog ge pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dus deng sang 'gran zla med pa/snying rje chen pos thugs brlan pa'i ngang tshul can/ phyogs sna tshogs nas 'dus pa'i skye 'gro rnams la chos dang zang zing char gyis tshim par mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs kyi chu skyes kyi tshul la reg pa shākya'i sras po rgyal ba'i sde'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong dharmā yon tan gyis mnyan cing bsgyur ba/ phyis gang zag chos kyi spyan can dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje'i bka'i tshul dang yang bstun te zhus gtugs legs par byas so/ /dpal khrag 107—751

'thung mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u zhe lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā dwa ya badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ phag mo mngon par brjod pa'i bshad rgyud phyi ma las phag mo mngon par byang chub kyi rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ ral pa gyen brjes kyi rgyud las phyung ba rig 'dzin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dzā ya se na'i zhabs dang /lo tsā ba btsun pa dharma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor ba'i rgyud brtag pa bdun pa/ lo tsā ba chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur te/ slad kyis de nyid kyi tshe paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis la'ang gtugs te gtan la phab pa/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud brtag pa bcu pa brtag pa re re la rab byed bzhi bzhi yod pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / bdag nyid chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba las/slad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis rgya dpe rtsa 'grel dang bstun nas hor khongs bsabs shing 'gyur bcos legs par mdzad pa las bris/de'i rgyud phyi ma yang dag par sbyor ba'i thig le/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā ya sba pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis yang bod kyi lo tsā ba gzhan rnams kyis bsgyur ba la zur mi 'dra bar bcos nas rang gi ming bcug cing gzhan gyi ming 'phyi ba de dag dang / mi shes pa de dag sun dbyung ba'i phyir slad nas yang 107—752

rgya gar gyi rgyud bzhi dang / dge slong shākya ye shes de nyid kyis gtugs nas bcos te gtan la phab pa/ 'di la bla ma kha cig kye rdor gyi bshad rgyud du bzhed/ bu ston gyis rgyud du ma'i bshad rgyud yin pa dang / khyad par bde mchog gi bshad rgyud yin par sgrub byed dang bcas nas gsungs/mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud rtsod pa can du grags pa le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gup+ta'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po khye'u rgang 'khor lo grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/yang slad nas mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas grags pa'i spyan sngar kre bo shes rab dpal gyis zhus tig bgyis pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang re drug /tshomiljipar rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /ra li so gnyis la 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos bod snga ma'i 'dod pa bkod nas/ mang du mkhyen cing blo gros che la zhib pa rnams kyis legs par dpyad par bya'o/ /zhes rgyud rnam dag yin min gyi gsal kha ma gsungs la/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung du/ 'di dag ga ya dha ras 'brog mi dang gnyos lo tsā ba gnyis la bshad pa'i rgya dpe can yin pas bod kyis byas zer ba mi bden no / /zhes rnam dag tu bzhed snang zhing / rgyal rtse dang / tshal pa bcas kyi dkar chag tu'ang bzhugs/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na pa ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje ā ra li'i rgyud le'u bcu pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ya sba pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa sde dger le'u dgu zhes 107—753

'byung —/ ri gi ā ra li'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ya sba pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pasnar thang du le'u bcu bzhi zhes 'byung / rnal 'byor ma rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud gdan bzhi re rer rab byed bzhi bzhi yod pas rab byed bcu drug pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po ga ya dha ra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i bshad rgyud sngags kyi cha'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/ rdo rje gdan bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba le'u brgya dang bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na krirtis gsar du bsgyur nas bshad cing gtan la phab pa snar thang du le'u brgya dang gsum zhes gsal/ de ltar rgyud 'di'i le'u sil bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms na le'u brgya dang bzhi bzhugs so/ /slad nas bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dam rgyud 'bum dang / dpe dpang rnying pa dag dang yang gtugs te sde bas zhus pa dang bcas pa ches shin tu dag par bgyis/mi g.yo ba rtog pa'i rgyud 'bum pa las byung ba dngos grub thams cad yongs su 'byung ba'i rtog pa le'u bdun pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a tu la da sa badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba/ mi g.yo ba'i gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa gnyis 'gyur byang med pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags ma sgrol ma ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po groṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab snar thang du 'gyur byang ma 'khod/ pa/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bstod pa phan yon 187—754

dang bcas pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgya dpe dang mthun par sa paṇa gyis bsgyur ba/ dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rwa dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/mi g.yo ba dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpa' bo gcig pa le'u nyer lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī dang / lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/gsum pa thabs rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma zur du phyung ba bcas le'u bco brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya shrad+dha ka ra warma dang / zhu chen lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing / gong gi le'u bcu bdun par slar yang rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dzñā na ka ra dang / lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis zhus gtugs bgyis pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang so drug /(zhi par bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba le'u drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su dza na shrī dzñā na dang / sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po bod kyi lha btsan po bla ma dge slong zhi ba'i 'od kyi zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur/slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ lha mo bzhi zhus kyi rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na 187—755

krirti nyid kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud/ bal po paṇ+ḍi ta de wa purgya ma ti dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ gos sngon can gyi bshad rgyud drag po gsum 'dul le'u gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wa purgya ma ti dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ gos sngon can gyi cho ga rdo rje'i be con gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa 'gyur byang med pa/ de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u/ paṇ+ḍi ta a ḍa ya shrī ma ti zhes bya ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gtum po gsang ba'i rtsa rgyud le'u nyer bzhi pa/ gtum po gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcu bzhi pa/ca de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u brgyad pa rnams rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yu ga ti la dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rmi lam mthong ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can rdo rje me lce'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po rat+na krirti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis bka' drin mnos nas rgya dpe bod du spyan drangs te bsgyur ba / rdo rje snying po lce dbab pa'i gzungs dang po ska cog gis bsgyur cing /phyis gnyan lo tsā ba dharma grags kyis kyang bsgyur/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu pa/ lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gshin rje nag po'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mkhas pa dī paṃ ka ra shri dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slad kyis 107—756

lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bcos la de las kyang dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bcos/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i las thams cad bsgrub par byed pa'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇ+ḍi ta bha ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud 'bum pa nas byung ba'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa bha ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud le'u bzhi pa rtog pa bzhi par grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a mo gha'i zhabs nus pa can dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te slad kyis grub thob chen po kur+ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas nyan te thar pa lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud rtog pa gsum pa 'gyur byang med pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger dri paṃ ka ra dang / rwa lo'i 'gyur zhes byung / las mkhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa 'gyur byang med pa/sde dger paṇ+ḍi ta bha ro phyag rdum dang / rwa lo rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur zhes byung —/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs rnal 'byor gyi rnal 'byor chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur nas bod kyi ban+de skye 'od 'byung la gnang ngo / /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta rā hu la shrī bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo brtan gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur pa/tsan+d+ra krirti dang / yar lung grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur yang yod/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa skad gnyis smra ba chen po thar pa lo tsā ba'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rin chen grub 187—757

kyis / chos kyi rje khro phu lo tsā ba'i gdan sa gnas gsar dgon par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i brtag pa'i rgyud/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da'i bka' drin la brten nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po badz+ra shrī kha la ru tra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/sde rgyud ja pa nas phyungs pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta wa la tsan+d+ra dang / lo tsā ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud le'u nyer gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsan+d+ra gu ru dang /lo tsā ba glan chung dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje bde khros kyi rgyud dzñā na ka ra'i 'gyur bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nga bdun/ (mi par dpal zla gsang thig le'i rgyud/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/snar thang du le'u drug pa zhes byung / gnyis pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud dum bu bzhi pa/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud nye bar bsdus pa dang bcas pa bam po dgu lhag pa paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā ka ra warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur bar grags/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo rtog pa bcu pa las rdo rje mtshan brgyas gsol ba btab pa man chad la rtog pa phyed drug yod pa/sde dger bam po bcu gnyis zhes snang / rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon chen po kurma badz+ra'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyi shu tham pa/ tshozlortsi par thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+ma kā ra wam dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'jig rten 107—758

gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po rtsa ba'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/'di'i 'gyur la lo chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur yang zer/ rnal 'byor rgyud la mkhas pa zhwa lu ba rgya mtshos tshig don la legs par dpyad nas zhus dag yang 'ga' zhig rma dge blos bsgyur ro zhes kyang 'dod pa yod/ rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'i rgyud/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dzñā na badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags pas bsgyur ba/ mngon spyod kyi las sh+lau ka dgu pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shārnyi gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/dpal mchog dang po theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po las dum bu dang po sher phyin gyi dum bu/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dha ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ dpal mchog dang po'i dum bu gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/rgyud phyi ma dum bu dang po dang / gnyis pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i rgyud dum bu gnyis pa nyid kyi rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang /gsang ba ras bris kyi cho ga dang / phyag rgya'i rgyud/ rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud/phyi ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa dang / rtog pa thams cad sgrub pa'i cho ga dang / phyag rgya'i rgyud thams cad kyi don gtan la 'beb pa rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga dang / rgyud nye bar bsdus pa dang bcas pa paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po man+t+ra kā la sha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba lha btsan po dge slong bla ma zhi ba'i 'od kyi zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal dang / lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa bam po 107—759

gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shārnyi gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba la/ a tsār+ya rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos pa/ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po brtag pa phyogs gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun chen po de ban+de de wa'i zhabs dang / bla ma paṇa chen skyes bu chen po ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas gus par nyan te chag lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang go gsum/ 〈mi par rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ paṇ+ḍi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal dang / 'jam dbyangs pa lo'i 'gyur la 'phros dpang los bsgyur ba/ sher phyin sgo nyer lnga pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa gsang ba nor bu thig le'i rgyud/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shrī dang / lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ gsum pa spyod rgyud la/rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i rgyal po rim par phye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga pa bam po bdun dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma rim par phye ba bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta tse lu dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/lag na rdo rje gos sngon can rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong bya'i gdong pa can gyis bsgyur ba/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa stobs dpag tu med pa rtul phod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa'i rtog pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po u pad+ma rak+ṣi ta'i 107—760

zhal snga nas lo tsā ba glan dge slong dharma blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te dge slong yon tan rdo rjes gsol ba btab pa/ phyis su'ang chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis rab brtan dpal bzang po'i bkas bskul ba bzhin/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos skyong bzang pos rgya'i dpe la legs par gtugs te gtan la phab pa dang / slar yang mi'i dbang po chen po bkra shis rab brtan sog po 'phags kyi zhal snga nas kyi sku ring la dge slong ā nan+da maṅga lo gyis dpal 'khor sde chen gyi gtsug lag khang du bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag gi rgya dpe la gtugs nas mi 'chos su mi rung ba rnams legs par bcos te dag par bgyis pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nga drug /6) par lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud bam po bcu gnyis pa mjug cung ma tshang ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje sa gsum du rgyu ba'i rgyud rtog pa lnga pa/ dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bka' khrims su/ dpal dpe med lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku ma ra badz+ra dang / ra byid lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang —/ lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang ske/ zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ bzhi pa bya rgyud skor la/ thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kriṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'adi kha cig gis spyod rgyud du bshad kyang a bh+ya ka ras 107—761

bya rgyud du gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa sh+lau ka brgyad brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyed pa be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas tho lding gser khang du skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ zag pa sbyin par gtong ba'i gzungs 'di dag ni ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo bam po gnyis dang le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur cing / slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ byang chub snying po'i rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs/ thang gur gyi dus the tsin zhi hung lu khong gos can rgya gar gyi byang phyogs kyi mkhan po sde snod gsum pa rig 'dzin don yod rdo rjes bka' yis bskul ba dang du blangs te rgya gar gyi dpe las rgya nag tu bsgyur bar mdzad pa las/ da lta chen po ching gur gyi lo tsar sgro btags pa bod yig gi slob gra'i mi bzang jing gir rigs las rim 107—762

pa dang po'i tha'i ji mgon po skyabs kyis bsgyur ba/ byang chub snying po'i rgyan las btus pa'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang /zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de gtsang de len+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang bcu bzhi/ 〈slo par yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i gzungs/ rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs / bde ldan gyi snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po bcas la 'gyur byang med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa 'di gsum/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang ske/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/sangs rgyas bdun pa'i mdo 'gyur byang med pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs/snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ rin chen gtsug tor gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa rnams 'gyur byang med pa / dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shrī la dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/107—763

skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa/ khyad par can zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu 'gyur byang med pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba dge blo dang / nam mkha' la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab padapal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dge rgyas bye ma gling gi rtsig ngos la bris pa dang zhus dag legs par bgyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 'gyur byang med pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u so drug pa/ dpal lha btsan po lha btsun pa byang chub 'od kyi bkas/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge bsnyen chen po ku mā ra ka la sha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas gtan la phab pa/ 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa gnyis la 'gyur byang med pa / 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lo tsā ba brje klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sidha dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de de wa tsan+d+ras gtan la phab pa/'jam dpal gyi dmod pa gtsug pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan gyi 107—764

gzungs / 'jam dpal shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyis dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i gzungs/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sher phyin kau shi ka rnams 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don brgyad/ (k+ṣipar gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u so gcig pa/ zhus chen gyi mkhan po dang / lo tsā ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po bam po bcu dang le'u nyer dgu pa/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde dbang po'i rgyal po bam po lnga dang le'u nyer gcig pa 'gyur byang med pa/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sidhi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/ slar yang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis chos rje chag lo'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus dag par bgyis pa bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang zhe gsumal/ spyosalji par rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo sh+lau ka bdun brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de 187—765

ye shes sdes zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/ slar yang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis chos rje chag lo'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus dag par bgyis/ bsil ba'i tshal chen po'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /dzñā na sirnyi dang / shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/ phyis 'gos gzhon nu dpal gyis chag lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe las zhus/ gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs / paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba/ sgyu ma 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud las byung ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/'phags ma 'od zer can gyi cho ga 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba'i 'od zer can gyi rtog pa bdun brgya pa/ 'phags pa par+ṇa sha wa ri'i mdo/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs bcas la 'gyur byang med pa'i/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i rgyud kyi rtog pa'i le'u bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a tu la dā sa badz+ra la zhus nas bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba/lha mo bskul byed ma'i gzungs/ dug sel ba'i rig sngags gnyis 'gyur byang med pa/ dbyig dang ldan pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ grags ldan ma'i gzungs/rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ 'di gnyis snar thang du 'gyur gong ltar gsungs kyang / gzhung du mi snang /107—766

rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya'i yang snying / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo sgron ma mchog gi gzungs gnyis la 'gyur byang med pa/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa 'di spyod rgyud du bzhed pa'ang yod / gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa 'chi bdag gi dbyug pa 'dzin par grags pa 'gyur byang med pa/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi sde dang / khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdom brtson dam pa 'dul ba'i gtsug lag la zla dpe med par smra ba ne'u mkhan po'i gsung bzhin du/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba gnas brtan dpal nyi ma rgyal mtshan bzang pos dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang du rang gis bsgyur ba/gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa chung ba 'gyur byang med pa/ gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 'gyur byang med pa/ gdugs dkar gzhan gyis mi thub phyir zlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta pa ri ha ta bha dra 107—767

dang / lo tsā ba gzu dga' rdor gyis kha che'i bdud rtsi 'byung gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gi dpe rnying la gtugs nas gtan la phab pa/ gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/lha yul ma che bar grags/ gtsug tor lha yul ma chung ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā dzñā nas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rnams 'gyur byang med pa/ gzhang 'brum zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ bu mang po so sor 'brang ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ stong 'gyur gyi gzungs/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gzungs/ khro bo sme brtsegs la bstod pa sngags bcas la 'gyur byang med pa/ 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa la/ jo bo a ti sha dang / dge bshes 'brom ston pas sngags rnams dag par bcos pa/ shes pa mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten gyi gzungs sam bi ma la utā ga'i gzungs/ mchod rten gcig btab na bye bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ rten 'brel snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs/107—768

rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mdo/ rten 'brel snying po/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gzungs/ stong chen mo nas byung ba sman la sngags kyis gdab pa'i gzungs/bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs/sh+lau ka brgya lobs pa'i gzungs/ yang sh+lau ka brgya lobs pa'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ yang sh+lau ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka sum stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs / yon tan bsngags pa dpag med kyi gzungs/ chos thams cad kyi yum gyi gzungs/ phyir bzlog pa stobs can gyi gzungs/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs / mchog thob pa'i rig sngags/sde rgyud tsha pa nas phyung ba/ phyag /sde rgyud na pa nas phyungs pa/ bstod pa/ mchod pa/ mchod pa'i sprin/ mchod pa bsnyen gnas/zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ba/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i gsang rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/'di la 'gyur rnying gsum tsam byung ba/ phyis rong zom chos bzang gis rgya dpe gnyis la gtugs nas 'gyur bcos mdzad par bshad pa'ang yod/gtsug gi nor bu'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ tsan+dan gyi yan lag gi gzungs/sde dger dzi dā ye'i 'gyur skad gsar bcad kyis bcos zhes gsungs/ phyir zlog rnam par rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i mdo rnams la 'gyur byang med/ gzhan gyis mi thub rin po che'i phreng ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra 107—769

dang —/ dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ gdon mi za ba'i gzungs / gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen mo gnyis la 'gyur byang med pa/gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / dbang bskur ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ mig rnam par sbyong ba'i rig sngags / bar gcod sel ba'i gzungs gnyis la 'gyur byang med/ 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/sa'i dbang po chen po'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ be con chen po'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/sgo bzang po'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad 107—770

kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ chos kyi rgya mcho༅re gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags bcas la 'gyur byang med pa/ gser can gyi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ snying rje'i mchog gi gzungasal/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs gnyis la 'gyur byang med pa/gzungs chen mo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i mdo/sde rgyud tsha ba nas phyungs pa/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa'i gzungs rnams 'gyur byang med pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang don drug /(/ ) par mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje khro bo'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud le'u bcu pa 'gyur byang med pa/bu ston gyis dpyad gzhir mdzad/spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa / nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel 107—771

ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rnams 'gyur byang med pa/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'gyur byang med pa/mdo chen po kun tu rgyu dang kun tu rgyu ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ sprin chen po'i mdo char dbab pa'i cho ga le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa zur du phyung ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ sprin chen klu thams cad kyi snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/klu'i rgyal po gzi byin gyis zhus pa'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i rgyud dngos grub 'byung ba le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po 'gyur byang med pa/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/sde dger 'di snga 'gyur la grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis zhus zhes 'byung / yang gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs sh+lau ka gya drug pa/ nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa le tshan gnyis rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/ nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba phur bu 'od kyis bsgyur 107—772

ba / dpal mgon po nag po'i gzungs sh+lau ka phyed bdun/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs bcas la 'gyur byang med/ nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad thar bar byed pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa'i rgyud/ de'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa yon tan dang bcas pabya rgyud yin min the tshom du gsungs/ brgya byin gyis lha mo la bstod pa sh+lau ka gnyis pa bcas 'gyur byang med/ ro langs bdun pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sidha dang ne/ brje ye shes snying po'i sdes bsgyur ba la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sidha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa su ru pa'i gzungs/ ye shes skar mda'i snying po/ yi dwags mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga /kha 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/ 'jur gegs kyi gzungs/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ tshe mdo che ba oṃ gsum ma/tshe mdo chung ba oṃ gnyis ma gnyis 'gyur byang med pa/ tshe dpag med kyi snying po'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po purgya saṃ bha wa dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ tshe nur ba'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi yang snying thung ba gnyis 'gyur byang med pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rtsa rgyud pad+ma'i dra ba le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rig pa'i 'byung gnas rig pa'i 'od zer gyis shes rab rgyas pa'i kha che'i yul bdud rtsi'i 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang chen por paṇ+ḍi ta chen po so ma shrī bha dra zhes bya ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba skyu ra dge slong tshul khrims 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ don yod zhags pa'i phyin 187—773

drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī warma dang / lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa la/ lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyis kyang bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi cho ga zhib mo 'gyur byang med pa/ phyag stong spyan stong thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa bam po gsum pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gsang mdzod thogs pa med pa yid bzhin 'khor lo'i snying po'i gzungs le'u drug pa/ zhus chen gyi mkhan po dang / lo tsā ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab / spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ sa bcu'i gzungs phan yon dang rtog pa 'gyur byang med pa/sde rgyud tsa pa nas phyungs pa/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal ba'i cho ga /paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī warma dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa ni la kuṇ+ḍa'i gzungs dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las byung ba'i smon lam gnyis la 'gyur byang med pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs phan yon dang bcas pa dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang dgu bcu tham pa/ () par spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ thugs rje chen po pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te 107—774

gtan la phab pa'adi la'ang mkhas pa rnams the tshom byed/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzam+bha la dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ spyan ras gzigs ha ya kṛ ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sde dger 'di bcad lhug gnyis yod par bshad/ gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bcas 'gyur byang med pa/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ seṅge sgra'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā kā ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis zhus shing bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ seṅge sgra'i gzungs/ kha che'i yul dur khrod 'bri sa ka rang byung gi mchod rten rtsar dngos grub brnyes pa'i rje btsun ma rdo rje sems ma dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba mgar shes rab 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ seṅge sgras dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang / glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ snying rje mi gshol ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum gyi gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa/ sgrol ma sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u so lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/107—775

sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ lha mo sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/sgrol ma mchog gi gzungs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gzungs/ sgrol ma rang gi dam bcas pa'i gzungs bcas la 'gyur byang med pa/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa gnyis la 'gyur byang med pa/ dpal chen mo'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal gyi lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta brda sprod pa chen po bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sgra sgyur gyi mkhas pa sgra'i gtsug lag la ma rmongs pa/gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i dpen gnas dam par bsgyur/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rgyud rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bud+dha a ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo bam po dang po nas bcu gnyis pa yan bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nyer dgu/ sgromi par don zhags kyi cho ga zhib mo bam po bcu gsum pa nas nyer lnga pa yan dang / 'phros bam grangs mtshams ma bgrang ba hor khong gsab cing yongs su rdzogs pa/ shākya'i dge slong rin chen grub kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ las sgrib thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs 'gyur 107—776

byang med pa/ phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud chen po bam le med pa'i stod cha bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nga bdun/ lgo'i par de'i 'phros yongs rdzogs / mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba brje dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sngags dang bcas pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed kyi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pal/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje'i mchu zhes bya ba'i klu'i dam tshig /rdo rje gnam lcags mchu/ 'phags pa lcags mchu nag po'i gzungs/ lcags mchu'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lcags kyi mchu'i gzungs / bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa/ stobs po che'i mdo/sde dger rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ces byung / bgegs sel ba'i gzungs rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/ gnod sbyin gar mkhan mchog gi brtag pa snga phyi gnyis la le'u bcu drug yod pa las snga ma le'u bcu pa/ rgya gar 107—777

gyi mkhan po dha na gup+ta zhes bya ba spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje'i slob ma dngos las/rab zhi lo tsā bas tho ling du bsgyur ba bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nyer gcig sgrospyilji par gnod sbyin gar mkhan mchog gi brtags pa phyi ma le'u drug pa/kha che'i mkhas pa dā na gup+ta las/ rab zhi lo tsā bas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag gi tho ling rgyan du bsgyur ba/ gnod 'dzin dpal gyi gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jigs pa brgyad las grol ba'i gzungs gnyis 'gyur byang med/ gnod gnas dbang po ji ltar 'byung ba'i rtog pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/sgrol ma ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtog pa las rtsa ba'i rtog par sgrub thabs thams cad ces bya ba 'di rdzogs so yan bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nyi shu tham pa/(mi par ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtog pa'i smad cha yongs rdzogs jo bo chen po a ti sha'i phyag dpe rwa sgreng nas dka' thub chen pos gdan drangs nas shākya'i dge slong rin chen grub kyis 'phar ba'i lo cho 'phrul chen po rta'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la rdzogs par bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lo tsā ba chen po 'di nyid kyi zhabs drung du nye bar gnas pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams grub kyis bgyis pa/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs sh+lau ka bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ me kha la'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ rgya 187—778

gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rin po che brdar ba'i gzungs/ bskor ba'i gzungs / rten la bskor ba bya ba'i gzungs/ yon yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs/yang yon sbyong ba'i gzungs/ phyag bya ba'i gzungs/ gos brgya thob pa'i gzungs / mi dga' bar byed pa'i gzungs/ pad+ma'i spyan gyi gzungs/ ye shes ta la la'i gzungs/ skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba'i gzungs / sdang ba thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ khro ba zhi ba'i gzungs/ khros pa zhi ba'i gzungs/tshig btsan pa'i gzungs/ bdag bsrung ba'i gzungs/ yid du 'ong ba'i gzungs / mgrin pa snyan pa'i gzungs/ don thams cad 'grub pa'i gzungs/las thams cad grub pa'i gzungs/ dug thams cad zhi ba'i gzungs/bcings pa las grol ba'i gzungs/ bdud skrag par byed pa'i gzungs/ rma 'byor bar byed pa'i gzungs/ me'i zug rngu rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/mkhris pa'i nad sel bar byed pa'i gzungs/ bad kun gyi nad sel bar byed pa'i gzungs/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa'i gzungs/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs/sher phyin stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i gzungs/ sher phyin brgyad stong pa'i gzungs/pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ phal po che gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/107—779

sdong po bkod pa'i snying po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs / rma bya chen mo'i snying po/ so sor 'brang ba chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad bklags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs sngags/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga gsang ba spyi'i 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur bar grags/ rgyud/bsam gtan gyi phyi ma rim par phye ba/snar thang du zangs mkhar lo tsā ba'i 'gyur du gsungs/ legs par grub pa byed pa'i rgyud chen po las sgrub pa'i thabs rim par phye ba rnams la 'gyur byang med pa/snar thang du rig byed seng ge dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur bar gsungs/ yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo'i mdo/ li'i dge slong sde snod gsum dang ldan pa shrī la dharmas rgya gar gyi dharma rgya'i yi ge las ban+de rnam par mi rtog pas bsgyur ba/dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba chen po byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par nges pa chen po bstan pa yongs su bsngo ba chen po'i rgyal po/ kha che'i mkhan po dharma ka ra dang / lo tsā ba brje dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba las/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po chen po sngags dang bcas pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes snying po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ legs sgrub kyi smon lam/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ stong chen rab 'joms las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig /sbyin pa'i rabs las byung ba'i smon lam/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las byung ba'i bde legs kyi 107—780

tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa lha so bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ dpal rigs gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ rigs gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa rnams 'gyur byang med pa/ dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag des pa la gsungs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rigs kyi 'jigs rten mgon po lnga bcu pa/sde rgyud ca pa nas phyungs pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī bha dra dang /shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po tāk+ṣa ka ga ṇa dang / lo tsā ba mang 'or dge slong byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal sde rgyud cha pa nas phyungs pa/ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa rab byed zhe gcig pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ā ka ra sirnyi dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gup+ta dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa gnyis su med 107—781
