pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'gyur/ 'phags ma sor mo can gyi gzungs 'gyur byang med pa/sde rgyud pha pa nas phyungs pa/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/sde rgyud ba pa nas phyungs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang so gcig/gnyis pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor la/ 〈spyilji par rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po le'u brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ti shrī sidha pra bha dang / bai ro tsā nas bsgyur ba/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud lung dgongs pa 'dus pa bam po bcu dang le'u bdun cu rtsa lnga sh+lau ka nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa/dharma bo dhi dang / dā na rak+ṣi ta dang / lo tsā ba che btsan skyes kyis bru sha'i yi ge las bru sha'i yul gyi khrom du bsgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod chen po rngam glog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa snar thang du badz+ra bi shwa mi tra dang / bai ro tsā na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur bar gsungs/ bcas la shog grangs lnga brgya dang nyer gnyis/ tsho'i par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi kun 'dus rigs pa'i mdo rnal 'byor grub pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ dpal gsang ba snying po rnam nges le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba'i me long le'u bcu gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang / ban+de dzñān ku mā ras bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid nges pa le'u brgyad cu pa/ thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo'i phreng ba las sgrub pa'i phan yon le'u bzhi bcu pa bcas la sheg grangs bzhi brgya dang go gnyis/ 〈snanywa par 107—782

lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud bla ma chen po le'u bcu gsum pa/ 'jam dpal 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum rgyud phyi ma dang bcas par le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa/ snying rje rol pa'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi lo tsā ba mkhas par lobs pa bal po shrī gīrtis gtan la phab ste skad gsar pas bsgyur nas sog po mchog gi snying po dang / an bkra shis dang / bal po bzang bkra shis rgya mtshos yon bdag bgyis nas mang yul byams sprin gyi gtsug lag khang gi ya thog gi dbu rtser shin tu gsang ste skad gsal bar bsgyur/ bdud rtsi bam brgyad pa spyir bdud rtsi 'bum sde las nyung shas tsam zhig bi ma la mi tras bshad cing —/ lo tsā ba dzñā na ku ma ras bsgyur ba/ mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa pad+ma saṃ bha was bsgyur ba/ drag sngags 'dus pa rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba bdag bai ro tsā nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bla'i phyag dpe la zhal bshus pa las brgyud pa/ 'jig rten mchod bstod sgrub pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa bcas la shog grangs bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i dkar chag rgyas pa snar sde sogs gong ma rnams dang mthun par bkod pa legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig la grangs lnga brgya dang bcu tham pa/chos tshan so sor gzigs bde'i dkar chag bsdus pa go rim gsan yig rnams dang mthun par bkod pa la grangs bzhi bcu zhe dgu bcas khyon pu sti ka brgya phrag bzhugs pa rnams so/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad par bya 107—783

ba ni/ grangs med bskal par goms pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /brtse chen ga bur zhun ma'i zegs ma ni/ /gcig tu bsil bas mtha' dag 'gror 'khyud kyang / /skal ngan byin za'i phung por rang gis lcebs/ /ji tsam rtsub mo'i skal ba 'gror 'phel ba/ /de tsam rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i stobs kyang ste/ /phyogs zung ri yi 'phrin las 'bad med du/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dga' ston 'gro 'dir sbyin/ /bkra shis bkra shis grangs su brtsegs pa yi/ /yan lag dbyangs kyi rgyud gcig la rdzogs pa'i/ /gsung dbyangs rol mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gis/ /sa gsum ma rig gnyid 'thug sangs par mdzad/ /gsung gi 'od zer cha shas re rer yang / /nyin byed bye ba'i 'od rlabs rdzogs pa'i 'phrul/ /gang gis blo yi pad+mor 'dzin pa'i mod/ /don gnyis sbrang rtsis phyur la rang dbang bral/ /ba gam ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gyis bcings pa'i/ /so sor thar pa dbang gi nor bu'i mdzod/ /gang du bsti ba lung sde rnam bzhi yi/ /khang par 'gro rnams thogs med bkri bar mdzad/ /dngos su zab mo shin tu dpag dka'i dbyings/ /ji bzhin rjen par gdams pa'i sbas don du/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa kun 'doms pa'i/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gzhung 'di ko mtshar/ /dus gsum rnam 'dren gang nas gshegs pa yi/ /bla med byang chub gzhung lam shing rta'i srol / /pha rol phyin gzhung zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /theg mchog skal bzang rmad po 'gro 'dir sbyin/ /gzhi rgyud rin chen lta bu'i gang zag sogs/ /lam rgyud rim gnyis bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /'bras rgyud zung 'jug tshe gcig la sbyin pa'i / /rjod byed rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i grangs su bstan/ /glan dka' sems kyi rta 'dul 'dul ba'i gzhung / /rlabs chen spyod pa'i 'gag mdo mdo sde'i sde/ /181—7tsha nga snyo

de nyid zab mo mchog mngon mngon pa'i chos/ /sde snod rnam gsum 'gro kun kun mkhyen dpal/ byu/zhes bye ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng stob sgol ba'o//de ltar ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba yin la/ de lta bu'i gsung rab ni lha dang ske/ klu dang / mi dang / dri za la sogs ris med 'gro ba rnams kyi khams bsam dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tshams par drang nges kyi chos so so'i skad dang mthun par bka' stsal ba ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' bzhin sar gnas kyi sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang bzung bar mi nus na so so'i skye bo rnams kyis brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ 'on te rgya mtsho chen po las chu thig tsam zhig yul dbus 'gyur 'chang sogs su 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum dang / 'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyis 'thor ba bsdus pa dang / 'chad nyan gyis gtan la babs te thos bsam sgom pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'khyil pa las/ byang phyogs gangs ris bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir mdo rgyud chu klung nye bar babs pa'i thog mar pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi yang thog tu dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lha tho tho ri'i phyag tu nyi zer dang lhan cig tu dpang skong phyag rgya pa dang / mdo sde za ma tog babs pas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i rnam sprul srong btsan sgam po'i dus thon mi sam bho ṭas tog gzungs/ sher phyin 'bum pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bsgyur te bstan pa'i srol gtod/ 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul khri srong lde btsan gyi sku'i ring la 107—785

mkhan slob gnyis dang / lo chen bai ro tsa na sogs slob dpon du mas theg pa che chung gi bka' dgongs 'grel mang du bsgyur nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/mnga' bdag sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus ban+de dpal brtsegs dang chos kyi snying po sogs kyis phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la sh+lau ka dang / bam grangs/ thems byang bkod par dkar chag phang thang ma zhes bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i thog ma yin/ de rjes ban+de dpal brtsegs dang / klu'i dbang po sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bsgrigs nas dkar chag ldan dkar ma mdzad/btsan po khri lde srong btsan gyis 'on ljang rdo na bzhugs pa'i dus nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra sogs dang / bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta sogs lo paṇa rnams kyis byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang bstun te go sla bar skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/ bstan pa phyi dar la paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na krirti dang /mnyam med jo bo chen po/ paṇa chen shākya shrī sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub du ma dang / lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes sogs 'jig rten mig gcig skad gnyis smra ba du mas mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' yas pa bsgyur/ phyis mkhas pa bcom ldan ral gri'i slob ma 'jam dgag pak+ṣis rgya nag nas bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen dngos po mang du bskur ba la brten nas 'dul ba lung gi phyi mo mchims nam mkha' grags kyis rgya 'dul 'dzin chen mo zhal bzhugs dus/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul 'dzin zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ges ched gnyer mdzad nas lung phran tshegs kyi bam po bcu gnyis ma tshang ba dang / gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po 107—786

bcu gnyis dang / sdom tshig yig tshar gnyis ma tshang ba rnams bsam yas mchims phu sogs dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang rnams nas btsal te/ la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang du gnas brtan dharma seṅges lung sde bzhi tshang bar bzhengs pa la ma dpe mdzad nas bzhengs pa dang / gzhan yang chu mig ring mo'i gtsug lag khang dang / rong klung shod grog gi gtsug lag khang gi 'dul ba lung la sogs pa rnams la khungs gtugs te dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du gsar bzhengs mdzad/ mdo mang skor gyi ma phyi 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i thugs dam lha mi'i rgyan mchog dang / gtsang chu mig ring mor grub thob 'dar phyar bas bzhengs pa'i mdo mang 'dar phyar ma zhes grags pa/'brang mtshams phug chung ma/ dga' 'bar ma/ snar thang gi gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang rnams kyi mchog gyur mchims kyi thugs dam gser gzhung ma/ zha lu gser khang du bzhugs pa'i mdo mang gzhi ma/ phyug rgyal ma/ dgon gsar ma le tshan/ bla ma gru spang rtsa ba'i mdo mang 'dzam gling rgyan/ spun gsum gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang / shog chung gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang drug cu rtsa gnyis/smon da rdo zhes grags pa la sogs pa mdo sna mang zhing go rim legs pa rnams dang ske/ sher phyogs skor reg zig sngo dmar/ bla 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum / 'bangs kyis bzhengs pa'i dpya 'bum sogs dang / de rnams las mched pa shin tu mang ba'i rgyun las ma nyams ma bslad pa'i phyi mo rnams la dbus pa blo gsal dang / lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mkhas pa mang pos sgo bstun te gtan la phab pa dang / gsang sngags rgyud 'bum gyi ma phyi rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ 'gro mgon 107—787

chos kyi rgyal po/ slob dpon rig pa'i ral gris mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi dkar chag rnams la brten nas dpal sa skya'i rgyud 'bum dang / shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gser sding pas zhus dag go rim mdzad nas/ dge bshes skye med ston shes kyi rgyud 'bum/ dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang gi dge bshes 'dar phyar gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyud 'bum/ bla ma gru spang rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum/ spun gsum gtsug lag khang gi rgyud 'bum sogs rgyud yang dag pa mang po dang /der ma 'dus pa'i phyi mo rnams kyang khungs bzang zhing / dpyad gsum gyis gtan la phab pa kho na la dper mdzad de go rim 'khrul pa med par dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por shākya'i dge slong mchims 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis bzhengs nas dkar chag tu btab pa snar thang bka' 'gyur du grags/gtso bor de nyid la ma phyi byas te tshal pa si tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs pa la tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes shin tu khungs btsun zhing grags che/ de nyid la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pal/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ rje ye bzang rtse pa dang / khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos kyang legs par gzigasashing zhus dag mdzad pa sogs bod yul du 'gran zla dang bral ba'i phyi mo dam par gyur/ de la ma phyi mdzad de/ rgyud skor stag lung rgyud 'bum dang bstun nas zha dmar ba drug pas bskyar zhus kyis par du bsgrubs pa/ da lta li thang thub chen byams pa gling du bzhugs/ tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang mthun par rgyal rtser bdag po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis bka' 'gyur rin po che rgyal rtse them spangs mar grags pa bzhengs/ de la phyi mo byas pa 'phags 107—788

mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug mi'i zol 'dzin ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos bka' stsal ba bzhin sa skyong sde srid bsod nams rab brtan gyis dpal thang po che'i gtsug lag khang du bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur skya pod shin tu dngos gtsang ba bod chen ljongs kyi skye rgu bsod nams 'phel ba'i ched dang / ma phyi phun sum tshogs pas gsung rab rnams la log rtog gi rnyog ma drung 'byin pa'i slad mdo stod lho rdzong du bzhugs/ gong du smos pa'i tshal pa bka' 'gyur la ma phyi mdzad/rgyal dbang sku phreng drug pa rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par srid gsum rgyan gcig par brkos kyi dbu brtsam ste/ rgyal mchog sku phreng bdun pa'i sku ring la/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba mi'i dbang po bsod nams stobs rgyas de nyid kyis 'jig rten kun gyi bde skyid rgyal bstan rin po che dang / de nyid yun du gnas pa sde snod gsum gyis bsdus pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i bang mdzod la rag lus pa mthong ste 'dzad med chos sbyin gyi sgo yangs por phye/ lhag bsam 'bad rtsol chen pos par gzhi gsar bskrun yongs su rdzogs par grub ste/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po la par shing rnams phul ba dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa dang / sngar gyi ma phyi tshal pa bka' 'gyur/ li thang mtshal par / rgyal rtse/ thang po che'i bka' 'gyur sogs dpe rgyun rnying ma khungs btsun rnams go bsdur nas zhus dag legs par bgyis bcug ste/ sde dge chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring nas par gsar bzhengs byas pa'i sde dge mtshal par sogs yod mod/ skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni/ gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po tā la'i 'dab zhol 'bras bu steng par khang gangs can 187—789

phan bde'i gter mdzod gling du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par gsar bzhengs 'di nyid kyi byung ba cung zad brjod na/ snar thang gsung par bgres skyon che zhing / li thang dang sde dge'i bka' 'gyur 'di phyogs su dpe rgyun dkon stabs bstan la gcig tu sman pa'i lhag bsam gyi spobs pa mchog tu yangs pa 'bri khungs sgo lcog sprul sku nges don bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang po nas par gsar zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du/ 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po mchog la bar gyi gzhi ma mtshon byed dngul ṭaṃ rdo tshig stong bdun cu don lnga dngos 'bul thog de don gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa'i don ltar dgyes pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes te/ gzhan yang dad ldan ser skya khag nas par gyi zhal 'debs byung ba rnams yig tshogs che bas 'dir ma bkod pa zur du gsal ba ltar gyi dngos 'bul steng / nyer mkho ji dgos gzhungs mchog nas thugs 'gan bskyangs te rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags spre lo sa zla'i nang yig 'bri/par brkos/ do dam pa/ zhus dag pa bcas bsko stsal thog dpal snar thang gi bka' 'gyur gzhir bzhag gi par yig gsar bris kyis mtshon thugs khur 'gan bzhes tshad med pa rmad du byung ba bskyangs rung ji lta ji ltar dkar phyogs kyi dge mtshan 'phel ba de lta de ltar nag phyogs yid srub kyi snying gi tsher mar che bas bar chad kyi 'tshubs lhong yang de snyed du bdo ba rang gshis la brten las byed che phra mtha' dag la 'gal rkyen ci rigs kyis 'jug 'khyongs rim lus su gyur pa/slar yang gong sa mchog nas thugs bskyed lhag par bzhes te mtshan zhabs go ming 'dzin pa 'bras sgo mang har gdong stag brag sprul sku ngag dbang gsung rab mthu thob bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / ser smad kong po rgyal dbang sprul sku 187—790

ngag dbang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan ngos gnyis la mjug skyong dgos rgyu'i bka' lung gser gyi cod pan nod pa bzhin gus pa gnyis nas kyang / chu sprel zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nang nas zhus dag grogs dan ser byes bya bral o tog sprul sku byams pa mchog ldan dang / ser byes lho pa ngag ldan dge slong thub bstan gsung rab bcas nas yang zhus dbu btsugs te/ 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs ltar snar thang par ma rgyal rtse them spangs/ sde dge'i mtshal par sogs bka' 'gyur gong ma dpe khungs thub rnams dang go bsdur gyis lhag chad yin nges blor chud pa rnams 'phri bsnan dang / blor mi chud pa dang / dpe dpang ma rnyed pa sor bzhag kha skong par snga phyi gnyis dang / bka' 'brel snar thang par du ma bzhugs pa'i kha skong du mkhas pa'i dbang po bu ston rin po che dang /gong sa lnga pa chen pos tshad mar bzhed pa rgyud skor khungs thub gsar bsnan bgyid 'os rnams gsung par byings 'khod zin gshis rgyud sde rang rang thad du bzhugs thabs ma rnyed pas rgyud kha pa/ ca pa/ na pa/ tsha pa bcas kyi zhabs su pod che chung dang bstun nas bzhugs shing mdo rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa gnyis kur yod pa rnams bka' 'gyur snga ma ltar sor bzhag /rgyud rang la lan gnyis 'khod pa rnams nas re re phyir 'then zhabs 'dregs zhu mus skabs bstan 'gro'i sku gegs dang / gangs ljongs skye dgu'i bsod nams dman pa'i 'bras bu bdo bas 7gong sa rnam 'dren mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan pas ci bya gtol med du gyur te 'phros lus par/ slar yang gangs ljongs chos srid kyi mdzad po rwa sgreng ho thog thu no min han chen po dang / sku'i gcung po srid blon mchog nas rnam 'dren chen po de nyid kyi thugs bzhed mtha' dag 187—791

yongs su skong slad 'phro skyong dgos tshul spyi stsal ltar yang bskyar shing khyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas par 'dzug zhus dag sogs 'go brtsams/ mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams la'ang bka' 'dri dogs gcod dang bcas/ 'thor ba bsdus / bsre slad dbyung / rang bzo'i bslad pa cung zad tsam yang ma zhugs par rang blos gang spobs kyis zhus dag dpyad bzod kyi khul du bgyis pa kun gyis yid ches khungs btsun du bgyis chog pa'i 'dzam gling bstan 'gro spyi'i phan bde'i dga' ston yid bzhin dbang gi nor bu lta bur bzhugs so/ ⑫/ /de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'phags yul thub gsung rin chen 'byung gnas kyi / /phung po gcig tu 'khyil ba'i klung chen las/ /gangs can bsod nams gshong bur skal bzang gi/ /bgo skal lo paṇa thugs rje'i yur bas drangs/ /rgyal bstan nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /sa gsum mun pa bcil ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /chos rgyal mes dbon 'phrin las rta bdun gyis/ /gangs can bsod nams mkha' la thog mar bkram/ /dpal brtsegs chos kyi snying po la sogs pas/ /bam grangs them byang dkar chag srad bu la/ /gsung rab dbang gi do shal phreng gcig tu/ /spel ba'i dga' ston thog mar ljongs 'dir sbyin/ /de nas lo paṇa rgyal blon du ma yis/ /gsar du bsgyur dang 'gyur rnying bcos pa dang —/ /glegs bam 'bri bzhengs la sogs sgo kun nas/ /rgyal bstan chu gter dbyar gyi dpal yon 'dzin/ /e ma legs gsungs ji snyed 'gyur ro cog /gcig las du mar 'char ba'i par gyi 'phrul/ /bzhengs pa'i sa skyong dbang po de dag gi/ /bsod nams nam mkha'i khyon 'dir shong ba mtshar/ /lhag par snyigs spyod ngan dgu'i ljan ljin khrod/ /ngo mtshar pad+ma dkar po'i ge 107—792

sar 'dzum/ /sngon med par gyi 'phrul du bltams pa 'di/ /phyag na pad+mo'i 'phrin las kho nar 'khums/ /'phags yul gsung rab rab 'byams chu gter las / /gangs can bgo skal skal bzang ji snyed kun/sgo /'edzad med par du du ma'i 'phrul sbyin gang / /bshīn 'edi rnam 'dren 'dren mchog 'phrin las nyide/d+ngha/ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad po'i dbyengs kyis bsnyad pa'o//rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa rnam dkar legs byas kyi phung po zad mi shes par bsgrub pa'i dge rtsa bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i 'brel thogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis gtsos pa'i mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs la bde dge zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i rgyur bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor la/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i phan yon bstan pa dang / de nyid zad mi shes pa'i rgyur bsngo ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams su gzung ba dang / bcang ba dang / bklag pa dang / yi ge 'bri ba sogs kyi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi langs la/ 'dir mdo tsam nye bar brjod pa ni/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la mngon par dad de rtog cing mos la sems dang bas byang chub tu sems bskyed nas lhag pa'i bsam pas nyan pa dang /'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang /rab tu 'don pa dang / nye bar ston pa dang / lung 'bogs pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang /'di'i don rnam par 'grel ba dang / yid kyis rjes su rtog pa dang / ji lta 107—793

bur grub pa'i shes rab kyis 'dir yongs su dpyod par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun chad par ma gyur cig /dam pa'i chos nub par ma gyur cig ces dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang / tshul dang ma bral bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phan gdags pa bsgrub pa byas par 'gyur bar chung du na glegs bam du chud par byas te 'chang ngam bzhag la / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang phreng ba dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dag dang / khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dag dang / mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis mchod par byed de bkur ster byed / bla mar byed/ rjed par byed/ mchod par byed/ ri mor byed/bsnyen bkur byed na/ kau shi ka bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa de la rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can la bkur ster byas pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byas pa snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ /stong gi char yang bye ba'i char yang bye ba brgya'i char yang bye ba stong gi char yang bye ba brgya stong gi char yang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /grangs su yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /char yang bgrang bar yang dper yang dpes bstan par bya bar yang rten du yang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /zhes dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di glegs bam du bris te/'chang ngam/ klog gam/ bsti stang du byed dam/ rim gror byed dam/mchod pa byed dam/ ser sna med pa'i sems kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i bsngags pa phyogs bzhir brjod pa dang / tshur shog chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi 107—794

ger bris shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /soms shig /kha ton gyis shig /ces rjod par byed pa des gter chen po brgyad thob par 'gyur te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ brjod pa med pas dran pa'i gter dang / blo gros rab tu 'byed pas blo gros kyi gter dang / mdo sde thams cad kyi rnam pa khong du chud par rtogs pa'i gter dang / thos pa thams cad kun tu 'dzin pas gzungs kyi gter dang ne/ legs par bshad pas sems can thams cad tshim par byed pas spobs pa'i gter dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrung bas chos kyi gter dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun mi gcod pas byang chub kyi sems dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pas bsgrub pa'i gter te/ gter chen po de dag thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo las/ gang yang 'dzam bu gling 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi mchod rten rin po che sna bdun las byas pas gang bar byas te/ lha'i phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / me tog dang / mar me dang ske/ rin po che'i gdugs dang / sil snyan dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams kyis lo 'bum du bkur sti byas te rjed cing mchod pa bas/ gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa dang /'dri ba dang / 'drir 'jug pa dang / gzhan dag la yang dag par rab tu bstan na de bas 'di ches bsod nams mang du 'phel lo/ /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can de dag 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la 'jog cing / bzhag nas kyang lha'i lo stong du yo byad thams cad kyis mi brel bar rjed cing mchod pa bas/ gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 187—795

las tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tsam yang nyan pa dang / 'chang ba dang /'dri ba dang / 'drir bcug pa dang / gzhan la rgyas par byed na de bas 'di ches bsod nams mang du 'phel lo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang gis bskal pa 'bum gyi bar du thabs la mkhas pa med par pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad pa bas/ gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di som nyi dang bcas pas thos na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams mang du bskyed na gang gis som nyi med par thos pa lta ci smos/ gang gis yi ger 'dri ba dang / lung nod pa dang /'chang ba dang / gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa lta ci smos/zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo las kyang / kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa dang /glegs bam du byas te 'chang ba des 'di snyam du bdag gis deng nyid bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo snyam du sems bskyed par bya ste/de ni ji ltar da lta dad pa bzhin du lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis phyag bya ba'i 'os dang / mchod pa'i 'os yin no zhes gsungs pa dang /pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las kyang / gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang 'dzin tam/ ston tam/ yang dag par brjod dam/ yi ger 'dri'am/ bris nas rjes su dran par byed dam/ dus dus su bltas/ glegs bam la de bzhin gshegs pa la bya ba bzhin du gus pa bskyed dam/ ston pa la bya ba bzhin du gus par bkur ste byed dam/ brtson 187—796

par byed dam/ rim gror byed dam/ mchod dam/ glegs bam de dag la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / 'phreng ba dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan dang ske/ rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa dang / phyag 'tshal dang / thal mo sbyor bar byed pas mchod dam/ sman gyi rgyal po/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 'dzin tam/rjes su yi rang na sman gyi rgyal po de dag thams cad ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /zhes dang / dkon brtsegs le'u nyer gnyis pa lha'i bu ded dpon gyis zhus pa las/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / mos pa dang ske/ mos nas kyang yi ger 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang ske/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par byed pa de dag ni bsod nams thams cad kyis yongs su zin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /le'u sum cu pa las kyang / 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byang chub 'dod pa gang gis bskal pa stong gi bar du thabs la mkhas pa dang bral bas pha rol tu phyin drug la spyad pa gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bris nas zla ba phyed kyi bar du lan re bklags na bsod nams kyi phung po snga mas ni bsod nams kyi phung po 'di'i brgya'i char yang mi phod/ stong gi cha dang / brgya stong gi cha dang ske/ bye ba brgya stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / bgrang ba dang / dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa'i mdo las/ gang gis rkang gnyis gtso bo rnams la ni/ bskal pa 187—797

bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /nor dang 'bru dang de bzhin gos dang rgyan/ /spos dang 'phreng ba byug pa phul ba bas/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di la dad byas te/ /nyan cing klog la yi ger 'dri byed pa/ /de la bsod nams tshad ni yod min te/ /bde bar gshegs pas de snyed tshad ma gsungs/ /zhes dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni rnam par blta ba'i cho 'phrul zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs mchis pa dran te bdag gis sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad ye shes tog ces bgyi ba'i spyan sngar de thos pas gzungs lags so//de gnyan cing gzung la bcangs shing bklags te/ gzhan la yang bsgrags shing bsnyen bkur bgyis nas yi ger bris sam yi ger 'drir stsal na phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i yon tan de dag thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur/ de ji ltar bsam pa thams cad kyang yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang byang bar 'gyur / ting nge 'dzin kyang thob par 'gyur/ bro nad rnams dang bral bar yang 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang mdo sdud pa las/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar mang du 'byung zhing / de ni rdzogs ldan la dgongs kyi/ deng gi dus snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo ba'i dus 'dir ni de bas kyang phan yon lhag par 'byung ste/ tha na yi ge'i 'bru gcig tsam 'bri ba yang ches khyad par du 'phags 107—798

pa ni/ mdo las/ gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa//de ni de bas bsod nams ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i phan yon gyi 'gyur khyad ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bsod nams kyi tshogs gzhan la'ang 'dra la/ theg pa chen po'i mdo las kyang / gang gis sangs rgyas stong rnams dang / /brgya dang bye ba grags dag la/ /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed / /de snyed bskal par bkur ba bas/ /'jig rten mgon gyis gsungs pa yi / /dam chos 'jig tshe gang zhig gis/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /chos 'jig dus na chos 'dzin pa/ /sngon gyi sang sa rgyas thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes rab gnas pa/ /nga la des ni mchod pa byed/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe/ /ston pa'i bstan pa srung byed pa/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /de ni nam yang rgyad mi 'gyur / /lus kyi bde ba myong 'gyur zhing / /de ni nad kyis btab mi 'gyur/ /de ni yid du mi 'ong bas/ /nam yang 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung byas na/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / /des dang gsal dang mnyen pa dang / /sems can rnams la byams sems 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /bde dang dga' thob mdzod ni mang por 'gyur/ /sngon gyi rim gro bye ba 'thob 'gyur zhing / /mi khom brgyad po ma lus zad par spong / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /dper na nam mkha' skar mas yongs gang ltar/ /rtag tu mtshan gyi go char byas pa dang glu/ /rab tu tshig snyan yid 'ong dbyangs ldan 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba 187—799

mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /gang na yid bde med cing rab sdug pa/ /rigs ngan de ni de yis spangs par 'gyur/ /phyug cing shin tu bde la longs spyod ldan//'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi dman pa rnams kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la bsnyen bkur byed/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas / /mchog tu rab mdzes gzugs ldan shes rab ldan/ /mi yi 'jig rten mchog tu bsnyen bkur 'gyur/ /rgyal po mkhas pa mdzangs pa rnams kyis bsngags / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mchog tu gzugs mdzes blta na sdug pa dang / /skyes pa bud med lha rnams dga' bar byed/ /bde zhing mkhas la bsngags shing shes rab ldan/ /ston pa stobs bcu mnga' ba lha yi lhas/ /gang gi mdun du mdo 'di rab bshad pa/ /mi 'di'i lag tu mdo sde 'di 'dra 'di/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe na thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /gser 'od dam pa las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu yang 'thor zhing nub par mi 'gyur bar byed pa de ni bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu yang dag pa yin pas bsod nams ji snyed cig thob par 'gyur ba ni bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du brjod pas kyang mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pa gang la la zhig /mchod pa dang bkur ste byas nas yi ger bris te rgya cher spel ba dang / gzhan dag la yang dag par ston par byed pas thob pa'i bsod nams gang yin pa de'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma las rgya cher bsngags pa ltar ro//107wa 800

gnyis pa rgyal ba'i gsung gi tshogs phyi mo bho ṭa'i skad du 'gyur ro cog par du bskrun pa'i phan yon de dag ni mtha' yas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nyid dge rtsa gzhan dang chab gcig zad mi shes pa'i rgyur bsngo ba la/ bsngo dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / tshul ji ltar bsngo ba gnyis las/ dang po la de yang nges tshig ni legs sbyar gyi skad du pa ri ṇ+ḍatra ste yongs su spel ba'am/ yongs su bsgyur ba la 'jug pas/ 'dzad par 'gyur ba'i dge rtsa mi zad par spel ba dang / rgya cher yongs su bsgyur bas na de skad du brjod/ bsngo ba'i ngo bo ni mdo sde rgyan las / brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni/ /sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge rtsa byang chub tu sgyur bar byed pa'i sems pa dang / mi zad par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa rnams ci rigs pa'o/ /des na dge ba gang yang mi zad pa'i don du thabs shes zung 'brel gyis gzhan don du rdzogs byang kho nar bsngo ba zhig la bya dgos/ spyir bsngo ba la mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa ni yongs su ma dag pa ste/ de yang sher phyin sdud pa las/ yongs bsngo gal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing / /byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngo sems can 'du shes na/ /'du shes phyir na lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags/ /dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngos par chud ma yin/ /zhes dang / gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin/ /ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin / /ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ /dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems dmigs pa dang bcas bsngo ba ni ma dag pa yin la/ des na bsngo ba ni 'khor 187—801

gsum rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas yongs su bsngo bar byed pa ste/mdo de nyid las/ gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang / /gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang / /chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na/ /de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsngo ba la dbye na rnam pa bcu gnyis su byed de/ rgyan las / yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /dben dang sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs/ /rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can/ /thabs bcas mtshan ma med pa dang / /sangs rgyas rjes su yi rang dang / /khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang / /chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi/ /bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum mo/ /bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang po byed las bsngo ba khyad par can nas bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chen po'i bar bcu gnyis su rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa las gsungs so/ /de yang dang po ni dbye gzhi yid la byed pa khyad par can gyi bsngo ba dang / lhag ma bcu gcig ni de yi khyad par gyi dbye bar gsungs/de la dang po ni mdo las/ rab 'byor/ byang chen rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bla med rdzogs byang du yongs su bsngo ba gang yin pa dang / zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i don bshad pa la rgyan las yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can zhes byung / de ni dge rtsa rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub chen por mi dmigs pa'i tshul 187—802

gyis yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /bsngo ba dang po 'di nyid lhag ma bcu gcig gi dbye gzhi yin kyang / slob dpon gyi don gsal sogs 'grel byed gzhan mang pos kyang bsngo ba gcig tu bgrangs nas bcu gnyis su mdzad do/ /rgyan gyi tshig rkang gnyis pa de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /zhes pa ni de ltar bsngo ba'i byed las kyi khyad par bstan te/ de lta bu'i bsngo ba de sems can thams cad kyi dge rtsa dang /nyan rang gi dge rtsa thams cad las byed las rab dang / mchog dang / dam pa zhes sogs mdo las rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dmigs pa med kyi rnam pa can gyi bsngo ba ni/ bsngo bya'i rdzas la bden zhen bkag pa'i bsngo ba ste/bsngo bya de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / sogs khongs nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po la sogs pa don dam par mi dmigs par yongs su bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims la sogs pa zhes sogs dang / rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can / /zhes dang / 'phags pa grol sdes nyi khri snang bar/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa can gyi yongs su bsngo ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dang po bskyed pa nas brtsams te dam pa'i chos gnas bar gyi tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po rnams dang / de yongs su bsdus pa dang / theg pa gsum gyis yongs su smin par byas pa dang / rnam par grol bar byas pa'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus te rjes su yi rangs shing yongs su bsngos nas dngos po gang zhig yin zhes bya ba nas brtsam ste/dngos po dang / dmigs pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po rnams 187—803

ni gang yin zhes bya ba dang / sems ni zad cing 'gags la bral zhing rnam par gyur pa nyid ces bya ba na/ chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i rjes su 'gro ba mi dmigs pa'i rnam par yongs su bsngos pa legs pa nyid kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ /de la dngos po ni rigs so/ /dmigs pa ni chos thams cad do/ /byang chub kyi ched du bya ba'i sems ni 'dzin par byed pa'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ni ma chags pa la sogs pa'o/ /bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ni sems pa'o/ /zad pa ni bsags pa rnam par 'jig pa'o/ /'gag pa ni rgyun gyis 'jig pas so/ /bral ba ni rang bzhin gyis 'jig pas so//rnam par gyur pa ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i 'jig pas so/ /zhes sogs dang /don gsal/ gser phreng / rnam bshad rnams las kyang de bzhin gsungs/gsum pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ming can gyi bsngo ba ni/ sngo byed kyi sems la bden zhen bkag pa'i bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa de dag la sems kyang / de la sangs rgyas su 'du shes par mi 'gyur zhes pa nas/ 'du shes phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba med do//zhes gsungs/ de'i don 'chad pa la rgyan las/ phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do / /zhes dang / nyi snang las kyang / phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su bsngo ba ni/ sems gang gis yongs su bsngo ba'i sems/ de nyid kyi chos nyid kyang de yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / don gsal/gser phreng / rnam bshad las kyang de bzhin du gsungs so/ /bzhi pa dben par shes pa'i bsngo ba zhes bya ba ni bsngo ba po la bden zhen bkag pa'i bsngo ba ste/187—804

mdo las/ gal te byang chen bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po mngon par 'du bya ba de phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyis dben par 'du shes zhes bya ba sogs gsungs/ de'i don 'chad pa la rgyan las/ dben dang zhes dang /nyi snang las/ dben pa'i gnas su bsngo ba ni/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' chen pos bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po mngon par 'du bya ba de phung po la sogs pas dben par shes te/ zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de nyid kyi ngo bos dben par shes te zhes bya ba'i bar du gang gsungs pa yin no/ /lnga pa sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi dge ba'i tshogs rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can zhes bya ba'i bsngo ba ni/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dge ba dang / byang sems rang gi dge ba ste rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la bzang ngan gyi bden zhen bkag pa'i bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ gzhan yang byang chen sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad rjes su dran par byas nas 'di ltar yongs su bsngo bar bya ste/ zhes sogs gsungs/de'i don 'chad pa la rgyan las/ sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs/ /rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can/ zhes dang / nyi snang las/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rigs su gtogs pa'i rang bzhin dran pa'i yongs su bsngo ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rigs gang dag yin pa dang /rang bzhin gang yin pa de bzhin du bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de yongs su bsngo bar byed pa zhes gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel pa gzhan las kyang de bzhin du gsungs/ drug pa thabs la mkhas pa'i yongs su bsngo ba 107—805

ni / sbyin pa la sogs pa phyin drug gi dge rtsa la bzang ngan du bden zhen bkag pa'i bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chen dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag mtshan mar mi byed cing / bla med rdzogs byang du yongs su bsngo ba yin zhes sogs gsung / de'i don 'chad pa la/ rgyan las/ thabs bcas/ zhes dang ske/ nyi snang las/ thabs la mkhas pas yongs su bsngo ba ni/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa' chen pos thabs la mkhas pa de dag la bslab par bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel pa gzhan las kyang de bzhin du gsungs/ bdun pa mtshan ma med pas yongs su bsngo ba ni/ bsngo ba'i 'khor gsum thams cad la bden zhen bkag pa'i bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/'di lta ste/ dper na kha zas bsod pa kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dri phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod kyang / dug dang 'dres par gyur na zhes sogs zas dug can 'dra bar dmigs pa'i 'du shes can la yongs su bsngo ba med par gsungs/de'i don 'chad pa la/ rgyan las/ mtshan ma med pa dang / zhes dang / nyi snang las/ mtshan ma med pas yongs su bsngo ba ni/ kha zas dug dang bcas pa'i dpes mtshan ma'i 'du shes can gyis yongs su bsngo ba ni dug can zug rngu can te zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel byed gzhan gyis kyang de bzhin du gsungs so/ /brgyad pa sangs rgyas kyis rjes su gnang ba'i bsngo ba ni/ tha snyad du rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur rtogs nas sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ ji ltar 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la rjes su yi rang ste yongs su bsngo bar bya zhes sogs gsungs/ de'i don 'chad 107—806

pa la rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rjes su yi rang dang / /zhes dang / nyi snang las/sangs rgyas kyis rjes su gnang ba'i bsngo ba ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bla na med pas mkhyen te de bzhin du yongs su bsngo'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang /'grel byed gzhan yang de bzhin no/ /dgu pa khams gsum du ma zhen pa'i bsngo ba ni/ 'khor ba'i rgyur mi bsngo zhing sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ji ltar gzugs gang 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang /gzugs med pa'i khams su ma gtogs pa de ni zhes sogs gsungs/ de'i don 'chad pa la/ rgyan las/ khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang / zhes dang /nyi snang las/ khams gsum du gtogs pa ma yin pa'i yongs su bsngo ba ni/gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo bar bya ste/ ji ltar gzugs khams gsum gyi khongs su chud pa ma yin te zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes sogs ltar ro/ /bcu pa bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chung ngu ni/ gdul bya dge ba bcu/ tshad med bzhi/bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhi/ mngon shes lnga thob pa'i las kyi lam la bkod pa'i dge ba rnams don dam par mi dmigs shing tha snyad du byang chen du bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ de ltar byang chen rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba'i phung po gang yin pa mtshan ma med pa'i tshul dang zhes pa nas/ bsngo ba de ni rab ces bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sogs gsungs/ bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba 'brir ni gdul bya rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong /dgra bcom/ rang sangs rgyas la bzod pa'i dge ba don dam par mi dmigs 107—807

shing ske/ tha snyad du byang chen du bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can ji snyed cig yod pa de dag rgyun du zhugs par gyur te/ zhes sogs gsungs/ bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chen po ni gdul bya rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod pa'i dge ba don dam par mi dmigs shing / tha snyad du byang chen du bsngo ba ste/ mdo las/sems can ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad bla med rdzogs byang du yang dag par zhugs te zhes sogs gsungs/ de ltar bsngo ba tha ma gsum po 'di rnams ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba ste mdo tshan gsum po de'i don dkyus gcig tu 'chad pa la / rgyan las/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi/ /bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum mo/ /bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/ /zhes dang / nyi snang las/bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba'ang chung ngu dang 'bring dang / chen po'i dbye bas rnam pa gsum yin no/ /de la chung ngu ni dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam nas brtsams te mngon par shes pa lnga zhes bya ba'i bar dang / 'jig rten pa'i rtog pa la gnas pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams sems can gyi dpes yongs su bsngo ba ni bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs pa'o/ /'bring ni/ yang de nyid cig kho na rgyun du zhugs pa nas dgra bcom par gyur pa la bkur sti dang / mchod pa sogs byas pa'i bsod nams kyi dpes bsod nams 'di snga ma bzhin du gang gsungs pa yin no/ /chen po ni sems can de snyed kho na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas pa la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can re res mtshon pa'i bsod nams kyi dpes mi dmigs par yongs su bsngo ba'i bsod 107—808

nams snga ma bzhin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag thams cad ni mi dmigs pa nyid kyis so zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang /de bzhin du 'grel pa don gsal/ legs bshad gser phreng / rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan sogs 'grel byed chen po dag gis rgyas par gsungs pa 'dir 'brir ma lang bar sgo bstan pa tsam du smras so/ /byang chub tu yang dag par bsngos zin na zad par mi 'gyur te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skems bar du de mi skem/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi zad / /zhes dang / pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bstan pa'i mdo las/ ji lta ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo bar byed pa de lta de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yongs su 'dzin cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yang nye bar 'gyur te/ gang gi tshe sbyin pa chung ngu'ang dpag tu med par byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs la mkhas pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ngo / /des na zhib tu bshad na gang du bsngo ba'i sa/ bsngo bya'i rdzas/ bsngo ba'i sems/ bsngo ba'i dbang po/ bsngo ba'i ched du bya ba/ bsngo ba'i dgos pa sogs zhib tu bshad par byar yod mod/ 'dir 'brir mi lang bas gzhung chen po dag dang / bla ma'i man ngag yongs su sbyar ba las shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi grub don bsngo ba'i tshul lag len la sbyar tshul ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog chos sbyin gyi dngos por zad mi shes pa par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon 'das ma 107—809

'ongs da ltar dus gsum du bsags pa'i bdag gzhan gyi dge ba ma lus pa bsngo bar bya ba yin la/ de yang rgyal ba'i yum las phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med cing grangs med pa yod pa'i phyogs re re'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lam chad pa/ 'jug pa chad pa/spros pa dang srid par 'dren pa chad pa/ mchi ma zad pa/ tsher ma bcom pa/khur shin tu bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag par kun shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/sems thams cad kyi dbang dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ gzhal du med cing grangs med pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar dang / phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar dang / dam pa'i chos nub par ma gyur pa'i bar te/de dag gi bar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du byed pa gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po gang yin pa rnams dang / phan par bzhed pa gang yin pa 187—810

dang ske/ byams pa chen po gang yin pa dang / snying rje chen po gang yin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gzhal du med cing grangs med pa gang yin pa rnams dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis chos gang bshad pa dang / chos de la gang gis bslab pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / gnas pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis gang zag rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can gang dag rang byang chub tu lung bstan pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa can dag gi sbyin pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ske/ slob pa'i zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / mi slob pa'i zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / chos de la so so'i skye bo gang dag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa gang dag gis chos de thos te thos nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas su song ba'i sems can gang dag gis chos de thos te/ thos nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / sems can gang dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das 187—811

pa de dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa ste/ zhes dus gsum la sbyar te gsungs pa dang / phal po che'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i 'khor 'das kyi dge ba ma lus pa rnams yongs su bsngo bar bya ba la/ de yang bsngo ba byed pa po rang nyid kyis dus gsum gi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dpang por gsol te lhag pa'i bsam pa rtse gcig pas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos khyab par bltas te/ de dag gi don bla na med pa sgrub par byed pa'i ched du rang nyid kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa dang / byed par 'gyur ba dang / bya bzhin pa'i dge rtsa 'dis mtshon nas bshad ma thag pa'i bsngo rgyu'i dge ba ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdoms shing bsdus te de dag la rjes su yi rang ba dang bcas pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen por dmigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis sgyu ma lta bur yongs su bsngo ba ste/ mdo sdud pa las / 'das dus sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang / /zhing mang mtha' yas bye stong dag na gang bzhugs dang / /gang yang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir rin chen chos ston pa/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bskyed pa nas/ /rnam par 'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus/ /de bar rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin pa / /pha rol phyin dang ldan dang sangs rgyas chos gang dang / /gang yang sangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang / /slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas 187—812

zag med pa/ /bsdus nas byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang zhing / /'gro ba'i don du byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro//de'ang 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i bsngo ba mtshan nyid pa yin la/ rang cag las dang po pa rnams kyis kyang 'dun pa drag pos 'phags pa rnams kyi rjes su bslab ste bsngo bar bya dgos pas/ 'dir yang ji ltar bsngo bar bya ba ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di rnams phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / lhag par gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / lhag par rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po de nyid kyi zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs te bstan 'gro'i mgon du mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal bzang mngon du gyur nas gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sor 'khod de bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par 'gyur ba dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing bshad sgrub kyi bya ba mi nyams dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba dang /dga' ba brgya ldan pa'i chab srid la log par 'khu ba nag po'i phyogs kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub mtha' dag rmeg med du zhi nas/ chab srid brtan cing dbu rmog btsan pa dang / yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang / lhag par bsil ldan ljongs 'dir mi mthun rgyad tshogs zhi nas 'gro rnams chos 'byor bde dgas 'tsho ba dang ske/ bskul ba po sku gshegs sgo lkog sprul sku dkon mchog nges don bstan 187—813

'dzin chos kyi dbang po'i thugs dgongs rdzogs shing sprul sku 'khrul bral nges rnyed mdzad 'phrin bstan 'gro'i gsos su 'gyur ba dang / mdzod pa chos 'phel gyis mtshon 'brel thogs 'das gson dang / gsung par do dam pa/ zhus dag pa/yig 'bri ba/ par brkos pas mtshon 'brel thog ci mchis rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon pa'i 'bras bu thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa sogs mdor na/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /zhes smon lam dbang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / kun tu bzang pos byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu dang / gaṅgā'i klung gi grangs snyed kyi ji ltar mdzad pa de de bzhin du gyur cig /ces lhug par smon nas / slar yang tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyi lam nas smon pa ni/ maṅga la shri yaḥsid+dhir+bha wa tu/ bden tshig grub pa rnams bsngo ba'i dpang por gsol ba/ mtha' dag rgyal ba'i ye shes 'khor lo mi phyed gcig nyid gar mkhan gtso/ /mtha'i daX legs gsung gdams pa'i 'khor lo mi phyed gcig tu ston pa'i gtso/ /metha' stodag 'gro ba'i bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen tsong kha pa/ /mtha' dag brtsed |sum bla mar bcas pa 'dir gshegs bden tshig mthun 'gyur stsole/ snyo/spros pa phra rabs rdul du mi dmigs sngo sangs nyer zhi gcer bu'i lus/ /zhi sgeg khro chags sna tshogs spros pa'i chu 'dzin gsar pa'i smad g.yogs grol/ /gser zhun bde 'thung do shal bskyod pa'i 'jo sgeg grub gnyis 'dod rgya'i char/ /sbyin la spros bral spros pa'i 'khor lor rol te kun gyis shig brjod stsol/ /mkha' khyab ma ma 187—814

snying du gces dgur bsil ba ga bur gsar pa'i rdul/ /lhag bsam thig ler 'khyil ba'i cha shas sems mchog 'khor lor rdzogs pa gang / /bsod nams ye shes bgrod pa'i pha mtha' kun khyab zhi ba gya rnam dbyings/ /ngal bso'i go 'phang 'dzin pa ji snyed de kun smon pa'i dpang por gsol/ /lnga phrag rgyad pa'i kha yis rdzogs ldan rkang pa bzhi pa'i lus zos kyang / /ngom pa ring btang da dung phan bde'i srog 'phrog dus kyi srin po yis/ /shin tu gdungs pa'i 'gro la rnam 'dren gzhan las thugs rje ches lhag mgon/ /pad dkar ltar bsngags ston pa shākya'i rgyal pos bsngo ba'i mthun gyur stsol/ /srid pa 'jigs rung na kra'i khar chud snying la gdung ba ha la'i zhugs/ /khol ba de kun de las 'don pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa'i gru bo che/ /bskyod pa'i lhag bsam ba dan dkar po snying stobs phrag par 'phyar ba yi/ /deng dpon rgyal ba'i myu gu de kun smon pa'i ra mda' cir yang mdzod/ /dpal 'byor be+eḍūr zhun mar 'khyil bar 'dod pa'i rtse dgas yongs 'khyud kyang / /nam zhig rang mtshang rgyad pa'i phung po 'khyags rom rang bzhin 'di ltar snyam/ /nges par 'byung bas bslab gsum gshog yangs thar pa'i mkha' dbyings mthon po ru/ /bskyod pa'i nyan rang ngang mo'i khyu tshogs mthun pa'i glu dbyangs 'di na stsol/ /bde chen chang gis myos pa'i glu dbyangs rdo rje'i brda ru 'tsher ba yi/ /gnas gsum yid ltar myur ba'i shugs 'chang ḍā ka ḍā ki'i tshogs kun dang / /rno myur las bzhi'i 'phrin las stobs shugs rdo rje'i thog ltar rgod pa yi/ /yeshes spyan dang dregs pa'i sde dpon mthu ldan kun kyang dpang por gsol/ /bden dang brtul zhugs grub pa'i ya lad ka shi'i bla gos dul bar mnabs/ /dmod pa'i dug mda' grub pa'i ro 'dzin gsong por 187—815

smra ba'i bzlas brjod brtson/ /bag yod tshangs pa'i skud pas bsdams shing dka' thub bdud rtsi'i go 'phang 'dzin/ /lha mi'i drang srong chen po de dag kun kyang grub pa'i bden tshig stsol/ /de ltar bla ma mchog gsum drang srong ngag gi mthu can rnams/ /deng 'dir smon pa'i dpang por byon nas yid la byed pa khyad par can/ /de de bzhin du grub pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum sbyin pa'i ngag gi tshig /shis pa 'bum gyi dbyangs su snyan pa'i mthun 'gyur re ba'i 'bras ldan mdzod / /gang bsngo bya'i rdzas ngos bzung ba ni/ gang la bsngo ba'i dbang po ru/ /'os pa'i tshogs kun la sbran nas/ /gang zhig bsngo bar bya ba yi/ /rdzas ni kun bzang sprin du spro/ /rin chen sems bskyed zla ba'i 'dzum/ /snying du bsil ba nas brtsam ste/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum pha mtha'i bar/ /de snyed dpal stug dge ba'i mdzod/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin phung sogs lnga/ /pha rol phyin pa drug dang bcu/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres sogs/ /bla na med pa'i yon tan chos/ /kun gsal pha mtha' shong min pa/ /de bzhin rjes su yi rang ba'i /bsod nams ji snyed de snyed kun/ /'dir ni yongs su bsngo bar bya/ /de sras snying stobs snying gi khur/ /rlabs chen sems dang spyod pa'i tshogs/ /de la yi rang rnam dkar kun/ /bsngo ba'i dga' ston grogs su bskrun/ /nyan rang bslab gsum zag med kyi/ /slob dang mi slob dge ba'i tshogs/ /de dag la yang yid rangs dge/ /'dir ni theg mchog yongs bsngor 'dzin/ /'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i khams/ /rnam dkar zla 'od phung po'i sprin/ /yid rangs bsod nams dngos po yang / /'dir ni bsngo ba'i gter du bya/ /lhag par gangs ri'i mgon po gang gi 'phrin las tsha zer 'bar ba'i bcud/ /gangs 107—816

can 'gro ba'i yangs pa'i bsod nams bdud rtsi'i phung por 'khyil ba yi/ /nyer len bzang po gcig tu tshogs las bskrun pa'i gsung par pad+ma dkar/ /'dzam gling tha gru rnam dkar dri bsung dog por byed pa'i dpal yon 'di/ /gang gi 'jung med bdog pa'i tshogs/ /gtong dang las kyis ngal ba dang / /lhag bsam khur gyis bcings pa yi/ /ji snyed 'brel thogs rnam dkar tshogs/ /'di dag gis mtshon bdag cag ni/ /yongs kyi dus gsum dge ba'i dpung / /lbu phreng zla ba'i do shal 'dzum/ /mkha' dbyings go 'phang 'dzin pa yi/ /gting mtha' med pa'i 'o ma'i klung / /dge legs rin chen gser bsnyil ba/ /mi zad spel ba'i 'du byed mchog /yongs su bsngo ba rgya cher bya/ /sa gang du bsngo ba ni/ /de ltar bsod nams ye shes rnam dkar ji snyed chu klung bye ba 'bum/ /bla med byang chen rgya mtsho nyid du ro gcig dngos por bgyis pa las/ /mngon mtho nges legs nor bu'i gter brgya mkha' khyab 'dod rgyar sbyin pa yi/ /dga' ston dam pa srid zhi'i 'khor yug dbyar mtsho'i dpal yon 'dzin gyur cig /rigs drug 'gro la brtse ba'i spyan stong lhag par gangs can 'dir g.yo ba/ /mthun snang khye'u chung gzhon nu'i rol sgeg nyin byed gsar pa'i 'dzum zhal gyi/ /rnam thar rmad byung nor bu'i ba gam 'phrin las 'od chags bye bar bcas phan bde'i pad tshal spel ba'i byed por sa 'dir mngon sum spyod gyur cig /'gro tshogs nges legs bla med dbyings su ngal bso'i dbugs dbyung mchog gi dpal//ston pa mchog de'i ring lugs dri med lung dang rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /ljongs 'dir gsar rnying grub pa'i mtha' yi sna tshogs tshon brgyar phye ba yang / /'chi med go 'phang gcig tu bkri ba'i thabs mkhas de dag kun rgyas shog /107—817

dpyad gsum dag pa'i byi dor gsum gyis gtsang byas tshang la ma nor lam/ /blo bzang ring lugs dbang gi nor bu grub mtha'i rgyal mtshan mtha' dag gi/ /gtsug na mngon par 'gyings pa de las lung rtogs 'dod rgya'i char g.yo ba/ /mtha' yas skye rgu'i snying la zhi bsil dpal yon rnam par rgyas gyur cig /ngag dbang blo bzang rgyal ba'i gsung rab thub bstan yang snying dam chos kyi/ /nyi ma 'bum zeg 'ebyed pa'i mthu thob 'jam gyedapazlo ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyo/ sgo/bstan tho'i rgyal mtshan 'gro 'dir 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog rmotha'o dag zhabs sen brtan/ /joge legos rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las dkar po sa gsum brdal gyur cig /mdus spa rgya rmetsho rig rgol 'phags chos nor bu'i gter brgyas yongs gtams shing ske/ /'khor lo gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rlabs phreng stong du gnyer ba yi / /ngo mtshar ri mo lung dang rtogs pa'i dbu ba dmar po'i do shal dang / /ngur smrig bla gos li khri'i lang tshos dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor kun 'gengs shog /chos srid gser gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs stong rnam par g.yo bas btegs pa yi/ /dga' ba brgya ldan pho brang chab srid phyogs las rnam rgyal gdugs dkar po/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i grib bsil ngal bso'i dbugs dbyung mchog sbyin pa / /mtha' bzhi'i dregs ldan bla na 'khor ba'i mnga' thang srid rtser sgrengs gyur cig /byams brtse'i phyag rgya 'jam po'i snod du chab 'bangs kun dga' gsar pa'i dpal/ /ngal bso'i dbugs 'byin sa yi dbang phyug chos rkyo rgyal blon mtha' dag kyang / /g.yung drung dwangs mar 'tsho gzheso snyingo po bstan dang chab srid 'gro ba'i don/ /skyong ba'i 'phrin las gser gyi 'khor lo'i dpung pa rnam par rgyal gyur cig /bstan dang chab srid zung du 'jug pa'i gdugs dkar 107—818

srid pa gsum gyi blar/ /'degs la 'grus pa'i sri zhu'i lhag bsam khur du spro ba de kun kyang / /thub bstan rin chen gtsug na bkur zhing rang bzhin drang po'i spyod pa yis/ /bsod nams zla ba'i them skas la brten mtho ris sa la brten gyur cig /mu khyud zla ba'i phreng ba de bzhin rgyal bstan 'od dkar phung pos te//cig car zla ba'i dngos po bsil yang snyigs lnga'i zhugs kyis rab gdung 'dir/ /rgyad pa'i ngal ba mtha' dag ring btang rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i lang tsho ma/ /'dod pa'i nu 'bur mngon par mtho bar rtse dga'i bde skyid dar gyur cig /ma rig rdog thabs gcig gis bskyed pa'i srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor rab g.yo ba/ /yan lag bcu gnyis ral gri'i rtsibs rnon snying la drad pa'i tshor ba'i dug /ji tsam myong yang zad pa'i mtha' med las kyi zhags pas bsdams pa yis/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo myur du zhig ste nyam thag 'di kun grol gyur cig /btso bsreg 'thag gcod 'drad pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'tshir spyad drag po'i tshor ba dang / /sha dang rus pa rkang yang rengs pa'i grang reg shin tu mi bzad pa/ /skyabs med nyid du khrag khrig ther 'bum bgrang byar brtsegs pa'i ngal ba rnams/ /bde can zhing gi 'byor pa nyid du e ma da lta 'tsho gyur cig /zas skom lta ci chu thigs tsam yang spyod pa'i bsod nams rab dman pas/ /bkres shing skom pa'i gdung ba gzugs can kha nas me lce lhab lhab 'bar/ /da dung srog gi 'tsho ba brgya phrag bgrang byar 'phel ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ba'i dpal yon ngal bsos po yi bde skyid bzang por myur rtsen shog /shin tu glen pas gces pa'i srog nyid dbrog dang sbyin pa'i skabs mi rnyed/ /sna tshogs dbyibs dang kha dog mi sdug bkres skom tsha grang ngal dang 'jigs/ /gcig la gcig za bkol spyod gdung 187—819

bas rang dbang bde ba'i 'tsho ba bral/ /shin tu skal chad nyam thag 'di dag dal dang 'byor pas 'tsho gyur cig /mtho ris na yang skye rga na 'chi sdug dang bral zhing mi sdug 'phrad/ /'dod pa'i dngos po btsal kyang mi rnyed nyon mongs drag po'i gdung bas gzir/ /'thab rtsod 'chi 'pho ltung sogs sdug bsngal brgyad dang drug dang gsum dag gis/ /bde ba'i go skabs bral ba 'di kun thar pa'i khang bzang la gnas shog /nyan rang byang sems kun kyang theg gsum lam 'bras bzhed don mthar son cing / /bdag sogs 'byor bcu'i 'tsho ba don ldan theg mchog lam du bkol ba yis/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i pha mtha' 'tshol la kun tu bzang dang 'jam dpal bzhin/ /smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu dang gaṅgā'i klung snyed 'dzin gyur cig /rgyan las gsungs pa ltar bsngo ba'i sa/ bsngo bya'i rdzas/ bsngo ba po sogs la bden zhen bkag ste mi dmigs par bsngo tshul mjug bsdu dang bcas pa ni/ de ltar gang du bsngo ba dang / /gang zhig bsngo dang gang gis bsngo/ /'khor gsum rang bzhin rdul tsam yang / /mi dmigs spros dang bral ba nyid/ /rang bzhin gdod nas rab stong kyang / /tha snyad rten cing 'brel 'byung du/ /'gog pa med par 'char ba yi/ /snang stong gcig grogs gcig tu brtsen/ /stong dang snang ba mi phyed pa'i/ /rnam 'gyur sgyu mar 'phrul ba'i gar/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dga' ston ni/ /smon pa de de bzhin gyur cig /ces bya ba ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa rnam dkar legs byas kyi phung po zad mi shes par bsgrub pa'i dge rtsa bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i 'brel thogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis gtsos pa'i mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs la bde dge zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i rgyur bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor ba rgya cher spros pa ste re zhig rdzogs 187—820

so // //'dir smras pa/ gting mtha' mi mngon srid pa'i chu gter klong / /sdug kun na kra bye ba 'dzings pa'i khar/ /rab tu gdungs pa'i 'gro kun de dag las//'don pa'i skyabs ni thub pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /lhag par snyigs lnga'i me chen drag po'i lce/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lor 'bar ba'i klong 'khyams pa/ /de dag 'don pa'i ma 'dris mdza' bshes gcig /de ni shākya'i rgyal po kho na nyid/ /de yi 'gro rnams de las 'don pa yi/ /thabs mkhas brgya phrag kun gyi snying po ni / /dpal gyi mgul las dam chos bdud rtsi'i dbyangs/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong phung por ston par mdzad/ /de las gangs can bsod nams gshong bu ru/ /ji snyed thob rnams ak+ṣa ra yi phreng / /'dzad med gcig las du mar 'char ba'i 'phrul / /spel ba kun las mchog tu 'phags par bskrun/ /phyogs su thor bur bzhugs rnams gcig tu bsdus/ /bsre bslad lhag zlos skyon kun ring du bsrings / /phyi mo'i gzugs kyi lang tsho mchog tu spud/ /'di ni gangs can bsod nams nor bur grub/ /yangs pa'i bsod nams blo dang rnam dpyod spobs / /'chang rnams glegs bam bzhengs dang klog dang len/ /bsam sgom 'chad nyan spel sogs chos spyod bcus/ /'dzam gling tha gru dogs por bgyis par thos/ /gsung bar man shel ba gam nor bu'i ris/ /'dzam gling chu snod bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /'dzad med srid pa'i phyi mthar spel ba yis/ /bkra shis bde legs chen pos khyab gyur cig /de ltar bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bka' gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi gsung par 'dzam gling spyi nor gyi dkar chag legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba 'di 107—821

nyid snga sor 7gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' rtsom ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i 'phro rnams mthud dgos zhes 7skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rwa sgreng a chi thu no min han mchog dang / mi dbang bka'i srid blon chen po rnam gnyis nas gus pa mtshan zhabs gong ming pa zung la rmad du byung ba'i bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bor lhung ba gus spro bdag gir nod de bka' 'gyur nas kha skong 'os rigs la'ang mkhas pa rnams kyis khungs dag min gyi bzhed srol mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig yod pa ma zad/ snar thang du par 'khod gras su'ang rtsod pa can yod rung / da lam 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po'i bzhed dgongs dang / dam pa gzhan la'ang bka' 'dri dogs gcod dang bcas bsre bslad / lhag chad/ zlos skyon dang bral bar zhabs 'dregs kyi tshul du legs par sbyar ba 7rgyal ba zas gtsang sras po grong khyer ser skyar sku bltams pa'i tshul bstan nas bgrang bya nyis stong brgyad brgya dgu bcu go bzhi/ rtswa mchog grong du gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas lo nyis stong brgyad brgya bcu bzhi 'das pa/sgrub pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i dus/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsod ldan 'char nas lo sum brgya so drug /gangs ljongs bod rgyal khab chen po'i lugs zung chab srid dbu brnyes kyi lo chig stong drug brgya brgyad cu 'das pa/ drag po 'khor lo can gyis kla klo bcom nas rdzogs ldan 'char ba la lo bzhi brgya dgu bcu yod pa/legs sbyar lha'i skad du bha wa/ stod 'grel ba dngos po/ ma hā tsi na'i skad du gya zu'i/ ljongs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa'i shing pho khyi/ 'byung ba lnga ldan / spen pa'i klungs kyi lo'i nyin mor byed pa gdong lnga'i khyim du rtsen cing /dus kyi 'khor lo'i ston 'bring khrums stod kyi nya ba/ gtsug lag sgor thang pa'i 707—822

dgun ra shing phag che ba'i dkar phyogs/ drang srong ri byi'i 'od rlabs dang /thub dbang gangs can mtsho rgyal gyi gtsug tor nor bu'i bdud rtsis 'gro ba'i sgo gsum bkru ba'i dus yar ngo'i rdzogs pa dang po'i dus 'khor ba'i dbyangs lo/gsal byed rli/ 'byung bas/ 'dod yon dri/ dbyangs 'char ba'i dbyangs o / gsal byed pa/ 'byung ba nam mkha'/ 'dod yon sgra/ gnyis ka mthun pa'i dar rgyad smin pa/ res gza' lha yi bla ma stobs dang ldan pa/las skar brgyad ldan ma dang dga' mgur spyod pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyor ba/'phrod g.yo/ sbyor ba tshangs pa/ byed pa gdab pa/ rten 'brel tshor ba nyi ma shing byi/ tshes spar dwa/ sme ba lnga ser rnams kyis gza' tshes skar sbyor dge zhing ske/ dus nam langs snga cha me yos/ dus spar dwa/ dus sme lnga ser/taṅgāl seṅge/ rags zhib mthun pa'i phyed bdag dge ba/ phur bu'i dus thun/zla snyigs dga' ba bcas kyi dus dge bar rdzogs par grub pa phyogs kun tu rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa datra/te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā// //107—823
go sdo stogo 'phagasam ga nga la ga/ / /'jam ma na bka' da bas rig rig dza go che shi rje'igar myur ma da ma na/ / na ga na rgyal/ /
hūṃ

deb brgya dang bdun pa/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis legs sgrig (5sa/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bsgrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkram/bka' bstanas spyadi /kā drir+sha g+ni /kā /sdu rtsis 'khor pe cin ta yun ho par 'debs 'gan tshad kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2 08lo'i zla 9par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo na/pa //sbya / 9par sdu/ /ngas /nga po btab/bo75978—7/rngo/shā/me 125—3
